AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >-
  Creates an IAM user and an IAM group for deployment purposes. The user is
  added to the group, and the group is attached to a managed policy that
  allows creating CloudWatch Logs log groups and log streams, putting log
  events, and putting, listing, and getting CloudWatch metrics on all
  resources.

Parameters:
  DeploymentUserName:
    Type: String
    Description: Name of the IAM user to create for deployment purposes.
    Default: deployment-user
    MinLength: 1
    MaxLength: 64
    AllowedPattern: '^[\w+=,.@-]+$'
    ConstraintDescription: DeploymentUserName must be 1-64 characters and contain only alphanumeric characters plus _+=,.@-

  DeploymentGroupName:
    Type: String
    Description: Name of the IAM group to create for deployment purposes.
    Default: deployment-group
    MinLength: 1
    MaxLength: 128
    AllowedPattern: '^[\w+=,.@-]+$'
    ConstraintDescription: DeploymentGroupName must be 1-128 characters and contain only alphanumeric characters plus _+=,.@-

Resources:
  DeploymentUser:
    Type: AWS::IAM::User
    Properties:
      UserName: !Ref DeploymentUserName
      Tags:
        - Key: Purpose
          Value: Deployment

  DeploymentGroup:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Group
    Properties:
      GroupName: !Ref DeploymentGroupName

  AddDeploymentUserToGroup:
    Type: AWS::IAM::UserToGroupAddition
    Properties:
      GroupName: !Ref DeploymentGroup
      Users:
        - !Ref DeploymentUser

  DeploymentGroupPolicy:
    Type: AWS::IAM::ManagedPolicy
    Properties:
      Description: >-
        Grants permissions to create CloudWatch Logs log groups and log
        streams, put log events, and put, list, and get CloudWatch metrics
        on all resources.
      Groups:
        - !Ref DeploymentGroup
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: AllowCloudWatchLogsAndMetrics
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - logs:CreateLogGroup
              - logs:CreateLogStream
              - logs:PutLogEvents
              - cloudwatch:PutMetricData
              - cloudwatch:ListMetrics
              - cloudwatch:GetMetricData
            Resource: '*'

Outputs:
  DeploymentUserName:
    Description: Name of the IAM user created for deployment purposes.
    Value: !Ref DeploymentUser

  DeploymentUserArn:
    Description: ARN of the IAM user created for deployment purposes.
    Value: !GetAtt DeploymentUser.Arn

  DeploymentGroupName:
    Description: Name of the IAM group created for deployment purposes.
    Value: !Ref DeploymentGroup

  DeploymentGroupArn:
    Description: ARN of the IAM group created for deployment purposes.
    Value: !GetAtt DeploymentGroup.Arn

  DeploymentGroupPolicyArn:
    Description: ARN of the managed policy attached to the deployment group.
    Value: !Ref DeploymentGroupPolicy

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: "2010-09-09"

Description: >
  Creates an Amazon Cognito Identity Pool with unauthenticated (guest) access
  for a chatbot application that uses Amazon Lex, Amazon Translate, and
  Amazon Comprehend. The unauthenticated IAM role grants access to these AI
  services plus standard Cognito Sync and Mobile Analytics actions. Outputs
  the identity pool ID.

Parameters:
  IdentityPoolName:
    Type: String
    Default: ChatbotGuestIdentityPool
    Description: Name of the Cognito Identity Pool for the unauthenticated chatbot.
    MinLength: 1
    MaxLength: 128

Resources:
  ChatbotIdentityPool:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::IdentityPool
    Properties:
      IdentityPoolName: !Ref IdentityPoolName
      AllowUnauthenticatedIdentities: true
      AllowClassicFlow: true
      IdentityPoolTags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-chatbot-identity-pool"
        - Key: Application
          Value: UnauthenticatedChatbot

  ChatbotUnauthRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      Description: Role assumed by unauthenticated (guest) users of the chatbot identity pool.
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Sid: AllowCognitoFederatedUnauthenticatedAccess
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Federated: cognito-identity.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRoleWithWebIdentity
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                "cognito-identity.amazonaws.com:aud": !Ref ChatbotIdentityPool
              ForAllValues:StringEquals:
                "cognito-identity.amazonaws.com:amr": "unauthenticated"
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: ChatbotGuestAIAccessPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: "2012-10-17"
            Statement:
              - Sid: AmazonLexChatbotAccess
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - lex:PostText
                  - lex:PostContent
                  - lex:RecognizeText
                  - lex:RecognizeUtterance
                Resource: "*"
              - Sid: AmazonTranslateAccess
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - translate:TranslateText
                Resource: "*"
              - Sid: AmazonComprehendAccess
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - comprehend:DetectSentiment
                  - comprehend:DetectEntities
                  - comprehend:DetectKeyPhrases
                  - comprehend:DetectDominantLanguage
                Resource: "*"
              - Sid: CognitoSyncAndMobileAnalyticsAccess
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - cognito-sync:*
                  - mobileanalytics:PutEvents
                Resource: "*"
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-chatbot-unauth-role"
        - Key: Application
          Value: UnauthenticatedChatbot

  ChatbotIdentityPoolRoleAttachment:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::IdentityPoolRoleAttachment
    Properties:
      IdentityPoolId: !Ref ChatbotIdentityPool
      Roles:
        unauthenticated: !GetAtt ChatbotUnauthRole.Arn

Outputs:
  IdentityPoolId:
    Description: The ID of the Cognito Identity Pool supporting the unauthenticated chatbot.
    Value: !Ref ChatbotIdentityPool
    Export:
      Name: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-IdentityPoolId"
  ChatbotUnauthRoleArn:
    Description: The ARN of the unauthenticated (guest) IAM role for the chatbot.
    Value: !GetAtt ChatbotUnauthRole.Arn
    Export:
      Name: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-ChatbotUnauthRoleArn"

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >-
  Creates the core event-driven architecture components for the Retail Demo Store
  application, including an EventBridge custom event bus (retaildemostore-bus), a
  disabled catch-all rule that sends all events to a CloudWatch log group with
  120-day retention, an event archive with 120-day retention, an EventBridge schema
  discoverer, and an SSM parameter that stores the event bus name for downstream
  services to consume.

Resources:
  EventBus:
    Type: AWS::Events::EventBus
    Properties:
      Name: retaildemostore-bus

  EventBusArchive:
    Type: AWS::Events::Archive
    Properties:
      ArchiveName: retaildemostore-bus-archive
      Description: >-
        Archive of all events published to the retaildemostore-bus event bus
      RetentionDays: 120
      SourceArn: !GetAtt EventBus.Arn

  EventBusSchemaDiscoverer:
    Type: AWS::EventSchemas::Discoverer
    Properties:
      Description: >-
        Discovers schemas for events published to the retaildemostore-bus event bus
      SourceArn: !GetAtt EventBus.Arn

  EventBusLogsCatchAllRuleLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: /aws/events/retaildemostore-bus-catchall
      RetentionInDays: 120

  EventBusLogsCatchAllRuleLogGroupPolicy:
    Type: AWS::Logs::ResourcePolicy
    Properties:
      PolicyName: retaildemostore-bus-eventbridge-logs
      PolicyDocument: !Sub |
        {
          "Version": "2012-10-17",
          "Statement": [
            {
              "Sid": "EventBridgeToCloudWatchLogs",
              "Effect": "Allow",
              "Principal": {
                "Service": "events.amazonaws.com"
              },
              "Action": [
                "logs:CreateLogStream",
                "logs:PutLogEvents"
              ],
              "Resource": "${EventBusLogsCatchAllRuleLogGroup.Arn}:*"
            }
          ]
        }

  EventBusLogsCatchAllRule:
    Type: AWS::Events::Rule
    DependsOn: EventBusLogsCatchAllRuleLogGroupPolicy
    Properties:
      Name: retaildemostore-bus-catchall
      Description: >-
        Disabled catch-all rule that matches all events published to the
        retaildemostore-bus event bus and sends them to a CloudWatch log group
      EventBusName: !Ref EventBus
      EventPattern:
        source:
          - prefix: ''
      State: DISABLED
      Targets:
        - Arn: !GetAtt EventBusLogsCatchAllRuleLogGroup.Arn
          Id: retaildemostore-catchall

  EventBusSSMParameter:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Parameter
    Properties:
      Name: RetailDemoStore-eventbus
      Description: >-
        Name of the EventBridge event bus used by Retail Demo Store services to
        publish and consume events
      Type: String
      Value: !Ref EventBus

Outputs:
  EventBusName:
    Description: Name of the Retail Demo Store EventBridge event bus
    Value: !Ref EventBus
    Export:
      Name: retaildemostore-bus

  EventBusArn:
    Description: ARN of the Retail Demo Store EventBridge event bus
    Value: !GetAtt EventBus.Arn
    Export:
      Name: retaildemostore-bus-arn

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >-
  Creates Amazon EventBridge rules that forward critical operational events to
  organization-level (org-sink) event buses in the central monitoring account
  (578003269847 in us-east-1). Each rule runs on the default event bus of the
  deploying account and targets an org-sink bus by name, using a fixed-name
  IAM role in the deploying account (PRX-*OrgSinkRole, referenced by ARN and
  not created by this template) for cross-account event delivery.

Parameters:
  CentralMonitoringAccountId:
    Type: String
    Default: '578003269847'
    AllowedPattern: '^[0-9]{12}$'
    Description: Account ID of the central monitoring account that owns the org-sink event buses.
  CentralMonitoringRegion:
    Type: String
    Default: us-east-1
    AllowedPattern: '^[a-z]{2}(-gov)?-[a-z]+-[0-9]$'
    Description: Region of the central monitoring account that owns the org-sink event buses.

Resources:
  CloudWatchAlarmStateEventsRule:
    Type: AWS::Events::Rule
    Properties:
      Name: cloudwatch-alarm-state-to-org-sink
      Description: Forwards CloudWatch alarm state change events to the CloudWatch-org-sink bus in the central monitoring account.
      State: ENABLED
      EventBusName: default
      EventPattern:
        source:
          - aws.cloudwatch
        detail-type:
          - CloudWatch Alarm State Change
      Targets:
        - Id: CloudWatchOrgSink
          Arn: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:events:${CentralMonitoringRegion}:${CentralMonitoringAccountId}:event-bus/CloudWatch-org-sink'
          RoleArn: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:role/PRX-CloudWatchOrgSinkRole'

  CloudFormationStatusEventsRule:
    Type: AWS::Events::Rule
    Properties:
      Name: cloudformation-status-to-org-sink
      Description: Forwards CloudFormation resource, stack, and stack set status change events to the CloudFormation-org-sink bus in the central monitoring account.
      State: ENABLED
      EventBusName: default
      EventPattern:
        source:
          - aws.cloudformation
        detail-type:
          - CloudFormation Resource Status Change
          - CloudFormation Stack Status Change
          - CloudFormation StackSet Status Change
          - CloudFormation StackSet Operation Status Change
      Targets:
        - Id: CloudFormationOrgSink
          Arn: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:events:${CentralMonitoringRegion}:${CentralMonitoringAccountId}:event-bus/CloudFormation-org-sink'
          RoleArn: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:role/PRX-CloudFormationOrgSinkRole'

  GuardDutyFindingEventsRule:
    Type: AWS::Events::Rule
    Properties:
      Name: guardduty-findings-to-org-sink
      Description: Forwards GuardDuty finding events to the GuardDuty-org-sink bus in the central monitoring account.
      State: ENABLED
      EventBusName: default
      EventPattern:
        source:
          - aws.guardduty
        detail-type:
          - GuardDuty Finding
      Targets:
        - Id: GuardDutyOrgSink
          Arn: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:events:${CentralMonitoringRegion}:${CentralMonitoringAccountId}:event-bus/GuardDuty-org-sink'
          RoleArn: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:role/PRX-GuardDutyOrgSinkRole'

  SlackMessageRelayEventsRule:
    Type: AWS::Events::Rule
    Properties:
      Name: slack-message-relay-to-org-sink
      Description: Forwards Slack message relay payload events to the Slack-org-sink bus in the central monitoring account.
      State: ENABLED
      EventBusName: default
      EventPattern:
        source:
          - com.slack
      Targets:
        - Id: SlackOrgSink
          Arn: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:events:${CentralMonitoringRegion}:${CentralMonitoringAccountId}:event-bus/Slack-org-sink'
          RoleArn: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:role/PRX-SlackOrgSinkRole'

  AutoScalingLifecycleEventsRule:
    Type: AWS::Events::Rule
    Properties:
      Name: autoscaling-lifecycle-to-org-sink
      Description: Forwards Auto Scaling instance launch and terminate lifecycle events plus instance refresh events to the AutoScaling-org-sink bus in the central monitoring account.
      State: ENABLED
      EventBusName: default
      EventPattern:
        source:
          - aws.autoscaling
        detail-type:
          - EC2 Instance Launch Successful
          - EC2 Instance Launch Unsuccessful
          - EC2 Instance Terminate Successful
          - EC2 Instance Terminate Unsuccessful
          - EC2 Auto Scaling Instance Refresh Checkpoint Reached
          - EC2 Auto Scaling Instance Refresh Started
          - EC2 Auto Scaling Instance Refresh Succeeded
          - EC2 Auto Scaling Instance Refresh Failed
          - EC2 Auto Scaling Instance Refresh Cancelled
      Targets:
        - Id: AutoScalingOrgSink
          Arn: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:events:${CentralMonitoringRegion}:${CentralMonitoringAccountId}:event-bus/AutoScaling-org-sink'
          RoleArn: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:role/PRX-AutoScalingOrgSinkRole'

  CloudTrailRootActivityEventsRule:
    Type: AWS::Events::Rule
    Properties:
      Name: cloudtrail-root-activity-to-org-sink
      Description: Forwards root user API calls and console sign-ins to the CloudTrail-org-sink bus in the central monitoring account.
      State: ENABLED
      EventBusName: default
      EventPattern:
        detail-type:
          - AWS API Call via CloudTrail
          - AWS Console Sign In via CloudTrail
        detail:
          userIdentity:
            type:
              - Root
      Targets:
        - Id: CloudTrailOrgSink
          Arn: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:events:${CentralMonitoringRegion}:${CentralMonitoringAccountId}:event-bus/CloudTrail-org-sink'
          RoleArn: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:role/PRX-CloudTrailOrgSinkRole'

  CloudTrailIamUserKeyCreationEventsRule:
    Type: AWS::Events::Rule
    Properties:
      Name: cloudtrail-iam-user-key-creation-to-org-sink
      Description: Forwards IAM CreateUser and CreateAccessKey API calls to the CloudTrail-org-sink bus in the central monitoring account.
      State: ENABLED
      EventBusName: default
      EventPattern:
        source:
          - aws.iam
        detail-type:
          - AWS API Call via CloudTrail
        detail:
          eventName:
            - CreateUser
            - CreateAccessKey
      Targets:
        - Id: CloudTrailOrgSink
          Arn: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:events:${CentralMonitoringRegion}:${CentralMonitoringAccountId}:event-bus/CloudTrail-org-sink'
          RoleArn: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:role/PRX-CloudTrailOrgSinkRole'

  CloudTrailIdentityCenterAdminEventsRule:
    Type: AWS::Events::Rule
    Properties:
      Name: cloudtrail-identity-center-admin-to-org-sink
      Description: Forwards Identity Center (SSO) permission set, trusted token issuer, user, and group administrative API calls to the CloudTrail-org-sink bus in the central monitoring account.
      State: ENABLED
      EventBusName: default
      EventPattern:
        source:
          - aws.sso
          - aws.sso-directory
          - aws.identitystore
        detail-type:
          - AWS API Call via CloudTrail
        detail:
          eventName:
            - CreatePermissionSet
            - ProvisionPermissionSet
            - CreateTrustedTokenIssuer
            - PutInlinePolicyToPermissionSet
            - PutPermissionsBoundaryToPermissionSet
            - PutPermissionsPolicy
            - UpdatePermissionSet
            - CreateUser
            - EnableUser
            - AddMemberToGroup
            - UpdateUser
            - UpdateGroup
      Targets:
        - Id: CloudTrailOrgSink
          Arn: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:events:${CentralMonitoringRegion}:${CentralMonitoringAccountId}:event-bus/CloudTrail-org-sink'
          RoleArn: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:role/PRX-CloudTrailOrgSinkRole'

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: Creates a Cognito User Pool with deletion protection enabled and a Python 3.11 Lambda function configured as the custom message trigger, including an IAM execution role with the AWSLambdaBasicExecutionRole managed policy and a resource-based permission allowing Cognito to invoke the function.
Resources:
  MyLambdaFunctionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSLambdaBasicExecutionRole
      Tags:
        - Key: 'lambda:createdBy'
          Value: SAM
  MyLambdaFunction:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    Properties:
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          def bar(event, context):
              return event
      Handler: bar
      Role: !GetAtt MyLambdaFunctionRole.Arn
      Runtime: python3.11
      Tags:
        - Key: 'lambda:createdBy'
          Value: SAM
  MyLambdaFunctionCognitoPermission:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Permission
    Properties:
      Action: lambda:InvokeFunction
      FunctionName: !Ref MyLambdaFunction
      Principal: cognito-idp.amazonaws.com
  UserPool:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPool
    DependsOn: MyLambdaFunctionCognitoPermission
    Properties:
      DeletionProtection: ACTIVE
      LambdaConfig:
        CustomMessage: !GetAtt MyLambdaFunction.Arn
      UserPoolName: my-user-pool
      UserPoolTags:
        'lambda:createdBy': SAM

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >-
  Provisions an IAM managed policy, an IAM service user, an inactive IAM access
  key, and a Secrets Manager secret to provide the Wave service with
  programmatic access to Amazon ECR. The secret is encrypted with the KMS key
  specified by the KMSKeyAlias parameter.

Metadata:
  AWS::CloudFormation::Interface:
    ParameterGroups:
      - Label:
          default: Secret encryption configuration
        Parameters:
          - KMSKeyAlias
    ParameterLabels:
      KMSKeyAlias:
        default: KMS key alias

Parameters:
  KMSKeyAlias:
    Type: String
    Default: alias/aws/secretsmanager
    Description: >-
      The KMS key ID, key ARN, or alias used to encrypt the secret. Alias names
      must be prefixed with alias/ (for example, alias/aws/secretsmanager). For
      keys in another account, specify the full key or alias ARN.

Resources:
  WaveEcrManagedPolicy:
    Type: AWS::IAM::ManagedPolicy
    Properties:
      Description: >-
        Grants the Wave service repository-level Amazon ECR operations across
        all repositories in the account and general registry-level Amazon ECR
        actions across all resources.
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: WaveEcrRepositoryLevelActions
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - ecr:BatchCheckLayerAvailability
              - ecr:BatchGetImage
              - ecr:CompleteLayerUpload
              - ecr:DescribeImages
              - ecr:GetDownloadUrlForLayer
              - ecr:InitiateLayerUpload
              - ecr:ListImages
              - ecr:PutImage
              - ecr:UploadLayerPart
            Resource: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:ecr:*:${AWS::AccountId}:repository/*'
          - Sid: WaveEcrRegistryLevelActions
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - ecr:CreateRepository
              - ecr:DescribeRegistry
              - ecr:DescribeRepositories
              - ecr:GetAuthorizationToken
              - ecr:GetRegistryPolicy
            Resource: '*'

  WaveEcrUser:
    Type: AWS::IAM::User
    Properties:
      UserName: wave-ecr-service-acct
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Ref WaveEcrManagedPolicy
      Tags:
        - Key: Service
          Value: wave
        - Key: Purpose
          Value: ecr-programmatic-access

  WaveEcrUserAccessKey:
    Type: AWS::IAM::AccessKey
    Properties:
      Status: Inactive
      UserName: !Ref WaveEcrUser

  WaveEcrSecret:
    Type: AWS::SecretsManager::Secret
    Properties:
      Name: nextflow/ecr_service_acct
      Description: >-
        Wave ECR service account credentials stored as a JSON string with a
        username key holding the access key ID and a password key holding the
        secret access key.
      KmsKeyId: !Ref KMSKeyAlias
      SecretString: !Join
        - ''
        - - '{"username":"'
          - !Ref WaveEcrUserAccessKey
          - '","password":"'
          - !GetAtt WaveEcrUserAccessKey.SecretAccessKey
          - '"}'

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: "2010-09-09"
Description: >-
  Creates a DynamoDB idempotency store for hybrid-mode deduplication, where both
  polling and event-driven workflows may trigger duplicate executions on the same
  file. The table uses a composite primary key (partition key plus sort key), has
  Time-to-Live enabled with a configurable default retention of 7 days, and has
  Point-in-Time Recovery enabled by default. A managed IAM policy grants Lambda
  and Step Functions read/write access to the table, and all resources are named
  using a configurable project prefix.

Metadata:
  AWS::CloudFormation::Interface:
    ParameterGroups:
      - Label:
          default: Naming
        Parameters:
          - ProjectPrefix
      - Label:
          default: Idempotency store configuration
        Parameters:
          - IdempotencyTTLDays
          - PointInTimeRecoveryEnabled
    ParameterLabels:
      ProjectPrefix:
        default: Project prefix
      IdempotencyTTLDays:
        default: Idempotency record Time-to-Live (days)
      PointInTimeRecoveryEnabled:
        default: Enable Point-in-Time Recovery

Parameters:
  ProjectPrefix:
    Type: String
    Default: fsxn-s3ap
    Description: >-
      Prefix used to name the idempotency table, the managed IAM policy and the
      TTL configuration parameter.
    AllowedPattern: '^[a-zA-Z0-9-]{1,40}$'
    ConstraintDescription: >-
      Project prefix must be 1-40 characters long and contain only alphanumeric
      characters and hyphens.
  IdempotencyTTLDays:
    Type: Number
    Default: 7
    Description: >-
      Default Time-to-Live (in days) for idempotency records. Records are
      automatically deleted by DynamoDB TTL after this retention period.
    MinValue: 1
    MaxValue: 365
  PointInTimeRecoveryEnabled:
    Type: String
    Default: "true"
    Description: Whether Point-in-Time Recovery is enabled on the idempotency table.
    AllowedValues:
      - "true"
      - "false"

Conditions:
  EnablePointInTimeRecovery: !Equals
    - !Ref PointInTimeRecoveryEnabled
    - "true"

Resources:
  IdempotencyTable:
    Type: AWS::DynamoDB::Table
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      TableName: !Sub "${ProjectPrefix}-idempotency-store"
      BillingMode: PAY_PER_REQUEST
      AttributeDefinitions:
        - AttributeName: FileKey
          AttributeType: S
        - AttributeName: OperationType
          AttributeType: S
      KeySchema:
        - AttributeName: FileKey
          KeyType: HASH
        - AttributeName: OperationType
          KeyType: RANGE
      TimeToLiveSpecification:
        AttributeName: ttl
        Enabled: true
      PointInTimeRecoverySpecification:
        PointInTimeRecoveryEnabled: !If
          - EnablePointInTimeRecovery
          - true
          - false
      SSESpecification:
        SSEEnabled: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref ProjectPrefix
        - Key: Purpose
          Value: Hybrid-mode deduplication idempotency store

  IdempotencyTtlConfiguration:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Parameter
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub "/${ProjectPrefix}/idempotency/ttl-days"
      Type: String
      Description: >-
        Default Time-to-Live (in days) for records written to the idempotency
        store. Lambda and Step Functions workflows read this value to compute
        the ttl attribute stamped on idempotency records.
      Value: !Ref IdempotencyTTLDays
      Tags:
        Project: !Ref ProjectPrefix

  IdempotencyStoreAccessPolicy:
    Type: AWS::IAM::ManagedPolicy
    Properties:
      ManagedPolicyName: !Sub "${ProjectPrefix}-idempotency-table-rw"
      Description: !Sub >-
        Grants Lambda and Step Functions read/write access to the
        ${ProjectPrefix} idempotency store table (default record retention is
        ${IdempotencyTTLDays} days). Attach this policy to Lambda execution
        roles and Step Functions state machine roles.
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Sid: IdempotencyTableReadAccess
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - dynamodb:BatchGetItem
              - dynamodb:DescribeTable
              - dynamodb:DescribeTimeToLive
              - dynamodb:GetItem
              - dynamodb:Query
              - dynamodb:Scan
            Resource:
              - !GetAtt IdempotencyTable.Arn
          - Sid: IdempotencyTableWriteAccess
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - dynamodb:BatchWriteItem
              - dynamodb:ConditionCheckItem
              - dynamodb:DeleteItem
              - dynamodb:PutItem
              - dynamodb:UpdateItem
            Resource:
              - !GetAtt IdempotencyTable.Arn
          - Sid: ReadIdempotencyTtlConfiguration
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - ssm:GetParameter
            Resource:
              - !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:ssm:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:parameter${IdempotencyTtlConfiguration}"

Outputs:
  IdempotencyTableName:
    Description: Name of the idempotency DynamoDB table.
    Value: !Ref IdempotencyTable
    Export:
      Name: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-IdempotencyTableName"
  IdempotencyTableArn:
    Description: ARN of the idempotency DynamoDB table.
    Value: !GetAtt IdempotencyTable.Arn
    Export:
      Name: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-IdempotencyTableArn"
  IdempotencyTableReadWritePolicyArn:
    Description: ARN of the managed IAM policy granting read/write access to the idempotency table.
    Value: !Ref IdempotencyStoreAccessPolicy
    Export:
      Name: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-IdempotencyTableReadWritePolicyArn"
  IdempotencyRecordTtlDays:
    Description: Configured default Time-to-Live (in days) for idempotency records.
    Value: !Ref IdempotencyTTLDays
  IdempotencyTtlConfigurationParameterName:
    Description: Name of the SSM parameter that stores the default idempotency record TTL.
    Value: !Ref IdempotencyTtlConfiguration

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >-
  Amazon Cognito authentication resources for an Amazon Elasticsearch Service domain
  with Kibana. Creates a User Pool (KibanaUsers) that uses email as the username,
  requires email verification, allows only admin-created users, and enforces a
  password policy with a minimum length of 8 characters. Creates an Identity Pool
  (KibanaIDPool) that allows unauthenticated identities and is integrated with an
  IAM role granting authenticated users Elasticsearch HTTP (es:ESHttp*) permissions.
  Exports the User Pool ID, User Pool ARN, and Identity Pool ID for cross-stack
  referencing.

Parameters:
  UserPoolName:
    Type: String
    Default: KibanaUsers
    Description: Name of the Cognito User Pool used to authenticate Kibana users.
    MinLength: 1
    MaxLength: 128
    AllowedPattern: '[\w\s+=,.@-]+'

  IdentityPoolName:
    Type: String
    Default: KibanaIDPool
    Description: Name of the Cognito Identity Pool that federates Kibana users.
    MinLength: 1
    MaxLength: 128
    AllowedPattern: '[\w\s+=,.@-]+'

  PasswordMinimumLength:
    Type: Number
    Default: 8
    Description: Minimum password length enforced by the User Pool password policy (allowed range 8-99).
    MinValue: 8
    MaxValue: 99

Resources:
  UserPool:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPool
    Properties:
      UserPoolName: !Ref UserPoolName
      UsernameAttributes:
        - email
      AutoVerifiedAttributes:
        - email
      MfaConfiguration: 'OFF'
      AdminCreateUserConfig:
        AllowAdminCreateUserOnly: true
      AccountRecoverySetting:
        RecoveryMechanisms:
          - Name: verified_email
            Priority: 1
      EmailVerificationSubject: 'Kibana account email verification'
      EmailVerificationMessage: 'Welcome to Kibana. Your email verification code is {####}.'
      Policies:
        PasswordPolicy:
          MinimumLength: !Ref PasswordMinimumLength
          TemporaryPasswordValidityDays: 7

  UserPoolClient:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolClient
    Properties:
      ClientName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-kibana-client'
      UserPoolId: !Ref UserPool
      GenerateSecret: false
      PreventUserExistenceErrors: 'ENABLED'
      ExplicitAuthFlows:
        - 'ALLOW_ADMIN_USER_PASSWORD_AUTH'
        - 'ALLOW_USER_SRP_AUTH'
        - 'ALLOW_REFRESH_TOKEN_AUTH'

  UserPoolDomain:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolDomain
    Properties:
      Domain: !Sub 'kibana-users-${AWS::AccountId}'
      UserPoolId: !Ref UserPool

  IdentityPool:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::IdentityPool
    Properties:
      IdentityPoolName: !Ref IdentityPoolName
      AllowUnauthenticatedIdentities: true
      CognitoIdentityProviders:
        - ProviderName: !GetAtt UserPool.ProviderName
          ClientId: !Ref UserPoolClient

  AuthenticatedRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      Description: Role assumed by authenticated users of the Kibana identity pool to access Elasticsearch HTTP endpoints.
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Action: 'sts:AssumeRoleWithWebIdentity'
            Principal:
              Federated: 'cognito-identity.amazonaws.com'
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                'cognito-identity.amazonaws.com:aud': !Ref IdentityPool
              'ForAnyValue:StringLike':
                'cognito-identity.amazonaws.com:amr': authenticated
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: ElasticsearchHTTPAccess
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: AllowElasticsearchHttpActions
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - 'es:ESHttp*'
                Resource:
                  - !Sub 'arn:aws:es:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:domain/*'

  IdentityPoolRoleAttachment:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::IdentityPoolRoleAttachment
    Properties:
      IdentityPoolId: !Ref IdentityPool
      Roles:
        authenticated: !GetAtt AuthenticatedRole.Arn

Outputs:
  UserPoolId:
    Description: ID of the Cognito User Pool (KibanaUsers) for the Elasticsearch domain Cognito configuration.
    Value: !Ref UserPool
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-UserPoolId'

  UserPoolArn:
    Description: ARN of the Cognito User Pool (KibanaUsers).
    Value: !GetAtt UserPool.Arn
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-UserPoolArn'

  UserPoolProviderName:
    Description: Provider name of the Cognito User Pool for identity provider federation.
    Value: !GetAtt UserPool.ProviderName
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-UserPoolProviderName'

  UserPoolClientId:
    Description: App client ID of the Kibana client in the Cognito User Pool.
    Value: !Ref UserPoolClient
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-UserPoolClientId'

  UserPoolDomainName:
    Description: Cognito hosted UI domain used for the Kibana login page.
    Value: !Ref UserPoolDomain
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-UserPoolDomainName'

  IdentityPoolId:
    Description: ID of the Cognito Identity Pool (KibanaIDPool) for the Elasticsearch domain Cognito configuration.
    Value: !Ref IdentityPool
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-IdentityPoolId'

  AuthenticatedRoleArn:
    Description: ARN of the IAM role assumed by authenticated users of the identity pool.
    Value: !GetAtt AuthenticatedRole.Arn
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-AuthenticatedRoleArn'

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >
  Creates a DynamoDB table and a Step Functions standard workflow for testing.
  The workflow inserts an item (PutItem) using an ID taken from the execution
  input and a formatted description string, then retrieves the same item
  (GetItem) by that ID and returns only the retrieved item as the final output.
  Start an execution with input such as {"id": "example-1"}.

Parameters:
  TableName:
    Type: String
    Description: Name of the DynamoDB table used by the state machine.
    Default: my-table
    AllowedPattern: '[a-zA-Z0-9_.-]+'
    MinLength: 3
    MaxLength: 255

Resources:
  DynamoDBTable:
    Type: AWS::DynamoDB::Table
    Properties:
      TableName: !Ref TableName
      BillingMode: PAY_PER_REQUEST
      AttributeDefinitions:
        - AttributeName: id
          AttributeType: S
      KeySchema:
        - AttributeName: id
          KeyType: HASH

  StateMachineRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: states.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: DynamoDBItemAccess
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - dynamodb:PutItem
                  - dynamodb:GetItem
                Resource: !GetAtt DynamoDBTable.Arn

  TestStateMachine:
    Type: AWS::StepFunctions::StateMachine
    Properties:
      StateMachineType: STANDARD
      RoleArn: !GetAtt StateMachineRole.Arn
      DefinitionString: !Sub
        - |
          {
            "Comment": "Test workflow: inserts an item into DynamoDB using the execution input ID and a formatted description, then retrieves the same item by ID and returns only the retrieved item.",
            "StartAt": "PutItem",
            "States": {
              "PutItem": {
                "Type": "Task",
                "Resource": "arn:aws:states:::aws-sdk:dynamodb:putItem",
                "Parameters": {
                  "TableName": "${TableName}",
                  "Item": {
                    "id": {
                      "S.$": "$.id"
                    },
                    "description": {
                      "S.$": "States.Format('Description for item {} created by the Step Functions test workflow', $.id)"
                    }
                  }
                },
                "ResultPath": null,
                "Next": "GetItem"
              },
              "GetItem": {
                "Type": "Task",
                "Resource": "arn:aws:states:::aws-sdk:dynamodb:getItem",
                "Parameters": {
                  "TableName": "${TableName}",
                  "Key": {
                    "id": {
                      "S.$": "$.id"
                    }
                  },
                  "ConsistentRead": true
                },
                "OutputPath": "$.Item",
                "End": true
              }
            }
          }
        - TableName: !Ref DynamoDBTable

Outputs:
  StateMachineArn:
    Description: ARN of the Step Functions state machine.
    Value: !Ref TestStateMachine
  StateMachineName:
    Description: Name of the Step Functions state machine.
    Value: !GetAtt TestStateMachine.Name
  DynamoDBTableName:
    Description: Name of the DynamoDB table.
    Value: !Ref DynamoDBTable
  DynamoDBTableArn:
    Description: ARN of the DynamoDB table.
    Value: !GetAtt DynamoDBTable.Arn

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: "2010-09-09"
Description: >
  Backend infrastructure for the Ask Around Me realtime messaging application.
  Provisions an AWS IoT Thing (askaroundme-realtime), an Amazon Cognito User
  Pool (askAroundMeUserPool) that requires email as a mandatory immutable
  attribute, a User Pool Client without a secret, a federated Cognito Identity
  Pool (askAroundMeIdentityPool) that allows unauthenticated identities, and
  IAM roles for authenticated and unauthenticated users granting Cognito Sync
  access to the identity pool, IoT Connect restricted to clients with the
  askAroundMe- prefix, IoT Subscribe to any resource, and IoT Receive from any
  topic, with the roles attached to the Identity Pool via a role mapping.

Parameters:
  CognitoCallbackURL:
    Type: String
    Default: http://localhost:3000
    Description: Callback URL registered on the Ask Around Me User Pool Client.

Resources:
  AskAroundMeRealtimeThing:
    Type: AWS::IoT::Thing
    Properties:
      ThingName: askaroundme-realtime

  AskAroundMeUserPool:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPool
    Properties:
      UserPoolName: askAroundMeUserPool
      AutoVerifiedAttributes:
        - email
      Policies:
        PasswordPolicy:
          MinimumLength: 8
          RequireLowercase: true
          RequireNumbers: true
          RequireSymbols: true
          RequireUppercase: true
      Schema:
        - Name: email
          AttributeDataType: String
          Mutable: false
          Required: true

  AskAroundMeUserPoolClient:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolClient
    Properties:
      ClientName: askAroundMeUserPoolClient
      GenerateSecret: false
      UserPoolId: !Ref AskAroundMeUserPool
      CallbackURLs:
        - !Ref CognitoCallbackURL

  AskAroundMeIdentityPool:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::IdentityPool
    Properties:
      IdentityPoolName: askAroundMeIdentityPool
      AllowUnauthenticatedIdentities: true
      CognitoIdentityProviders:
        - ClientId: !Ref AskAroundMeUserPoolClient
          ProviderName: !Sub "cognito-idp.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com/${AskAroundMeUserPool}"

  AskAroundMeAuthenticatedRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Federated: cognito-identity.amazonaws.com
            Action: "sts:AssumeRoleWithWebIdentity"
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                "cognito-identity.amazonaws.com:aud": !Ref AskAroundMeIdentityPool
              "ForAnyValue:StringLike":
                "cognito-identity.amazonaws.com:amr": authenticated
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: askAroundMeAuthenticatedPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: "2012-10-17"
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - "cognito-sync:*"
                Resource: !Sub "arn:aws:cognito-sync:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:identitypool/${AskAroundMeIdentityPool}"
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - "iot:Connect"
                Resource: "*"
                Condition:
                  StringLike:
                    "iot:ClientId": "askAroundMe-*"
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - "iot:Subscribe"
                Resource: "*"
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - "iot:Receive"
                Resource: "*"

  AskAroundMeUnauthenticatedRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Federated: cognito-identity.amazonaws.com
            Action: "sts:AssumeRoleWithWebIdentity"
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                "cognito-identity.amazonaws.com:aud": !Ref AskAroundMeIdentityPool
              "ForAnyValue:StringLike":
                "cognito-identity.amazonaws.com:amr": unauthenticated
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: askAroundMeUnauthenticatedPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: "2012-10-17"
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - "cognito-sync:*"
                Resource: !Sub "arn:aws:cognito-sync:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:identitypool/${AskAroundMeIdentityPool}"
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - "iot:Connect"
                Resource: "*"
                Condition:
                  StringLike:
                    "iot:ClientId": "askAroundMe-*"
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - "iot:Subscribe"
                Resource: "*"
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - "iot:Receive"
                Resource: "*"

  AskAroundMeIdentityPoolRoleAttachment:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::IdentityPoolRoleAttachment
    Properties:
      IdentityPoolId: !Ref AskAroundMeIdentityPool
      Roles:
        authenticated: !GetAtt AskAroundMeAuthenticatedRole.Arn
        unauthenticated: !GetAtt AskAroundMeUnauthenticatedRole.Arn

Outputs:
  UserPoolId:
    Description: ID of the askAroundMeUserPool Cognito User Pool.
    Value: !Ref AskAroundMeUserPool
  UserPoolClientId:
    Description: ID of the askAroundMeUserPoolClient Cognito User Pool Client.
    Value: !Ref AskAroundMeUserPoolClient
  IdentityPoolId:
    Description: ID of the askAroundMeIdentityPool Cognito Identity Pool.
    Value: !Ref AskAroundMeIdentityPool
  IotThingName:
    Description: Name of the AWS IoT Thing representing the messaging device.
    Value: !Ref AskAroundMeRealtimeThing
  IotThingArn:
    Description: ARN of the AWS IoT Thing representing the messaging device.
    Value: !GetAtt AskAroundMeRealtimeThing.Arn
  AuthenticatedRoleArn:
    Description: ARN of the IAM role assumed by authenticated users.
    Value: !GetAtt AskAroundMeAuthenticatedRole.Arn
  UnauthenticatedRoleArn:
    Description: ARN of the IAM role assumed by unauthenticated users.
    Value: !GetAtt AskAroundMeUnauthenticatedRole.Arn
  IotEndpoint:
    Description: AWS IoT endpoint used for realtime MQTT connections.
    Value: !Sub "${AWS::AccountId}.iot.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com"

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >
  Chaos engineering workflow for ECS service resilience testing. Creates a VPC,
  an ECS cluster with a container instance and service, an SNS alert topic, two
  Lambda functions (instance termination and ECS service health check with
  alerting), and a Step Functions state machine that terminates the instance,
  waits 300 seconds, checks the ECS service health and sends an SNS alert if
  the service is unhealthy.

Parameters:
  InstanceType:
    Type: String
    Default: t3.micro
    Description: EC2 instance type for the ECS container instance that the chaos test terminates.
    AllowedValues:
      - t2.micro
      - t3.micro
      - t3.small
      - t3.medium
      - m5.large
  VpcCidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.0.0/16
    Description: CIDR block for the chaos test VPC.
  SubnetCidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.1.0/24
    Description: CIDR block for the public subnet hosting the ECS container instance.
  AlertEmail:
    Type: String
    Default: alerts@example.com
    Description: Email address subscribed to the SNS chaos alert topic (must be confirmed).
    AllowedPattern: '^[^@]+@[^@]+\.[^@]+$'
  LatestEcsOptimizedAmi:
    Type: 'AWS::SSM::Parameter::Value<AWS::EC2::Image::Id>'
    Default: /aws/service/ecs/optimized-ami/amazon-linux-2/recommended/image_id
    Description: Latest Amazon ECS-optimized Amazon Linux 2 AMI resolved via SSM public parameter.

Metadata:
  AWS::CloudFormation::Interface:
    ParameterGroups:
      - Label:
          default: Compute
        Parameters:
          - InstanceType
          - LatestEcsOptimizedAmi
      - Label:
          default: Networking
        Parameters:
          - VpcCidr
          - SubnetCidr
      - Label:
          default: Notifications
        Parameters:
          - AlertEmail

Resources:
  ChaosVpc:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPC
    Properties:
      CidrBlock: !Ref VpcCidr
      EnableDnsSupport: true
      EnableDnsHostnames: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-vpc'

  InternetGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::InternetGateway
    Properties:
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-igw'

  VPCGatewayAttachment:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      InternetGatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway
      VpcId: !Ref ChaosVpc

  PublicSubnet:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref ChaosVpc
      CidrBlock: !Ref SubnetCidr
      AvailabilityZone: !Select
        - '0'
        - !GetAZs ''
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-public-subnet'

  PublicRouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref ChaosVpc
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-public-rt'

  PublicRoute:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    DependsOn: VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      GatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  SubnetRouteAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable

  ContainerInstanceSecurityGroup:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroup
    Properties:
      GroupDescription: Security group for the chaos ECS container instance
      VpcId: !Ref ChaosVpc
      SecurityGroupIngress:
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 80
          ToPort: 80
          CidrIp: !Ref VpcCidr
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-ecs-instance-sg'

  ECSCluster:
    Type: AWS::ECS::Cluster
    Properties:
      ClusterName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-cluster'
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-cluster'

  ECSInstanceRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: ec2.amazonaws.com
            Action: 'sts:AssumeRole'
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - 'arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AmazonEC2ContainerServiceforEC2Role'
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-ecs-instance-role'

  ECSInstanceProfile:
    Type: AWS::IAM::InstanceProfile
    Properties:
      Path: /
      Roles:
        - !Ref ECSInstanceRole

  ChaosInstance:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Instance
    Properties:
      ImageId: !Ref LatestEcsOptimizedAmi
      InstanceType: !Ref InstanceType
      IamInstanceProfile: !Ref ECSInstanceProfile
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet
      SecurityGroupIds:
        - !Ref ContainerInstanceSecurityGroup
      UserData:
        Fn::Base64: !Sub |
          #!/bin/bash
          echo ECS_CLUSTER=${ECSCluster} >> /etc/ecs/ecs.config
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-chaos-ecs-instance'

  ECSTaskDefinition:
    Type: AWS::ECS::TaskDefinition
    Properties:
      Family: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-chaos-task'
      RequiresCompatibilities:
        - EC2
      NetworkMode: bridge
      ContainerDefinitions:
        - Name: chaos-web
          Image: public.ecr.aws/nginx/nginx:latest
          Essential: true
          Memory: 128
          PortMappings:
            - ContainerPort: 80
              Protocol: tcp

  ECSService:
    Type: AWS::ECS::Service
    DependsOn: ChaosInstance
    Properties:
      Cluster: !Ref ECSCluster
      TaskDefinition: !Ref ECSTaskDefinition
      DesiredCount: 1
      LaunchType: EC2

  ChaosAlertTopic:
    Type: AWS::SNS::Topic
    Properties:
      TopicName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-chaos-alerts'
      DisplayName: ChaosEngineeringAlerts
      Subscription:
        - Endpoint: !Ref AlertEmail
          Protocol: email

  TerminateInstanceLambdaRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: 'sts:AssumeRole'
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - 'arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSLambdaBasicExecutionRole'
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: TerminateChaosInstance
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - 'ec2:TerminateInstances'
                Resource: '*'

  TerminateInstanceFunction:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    Properties:
      Runtime: python3.12
      Handler: index.lambda_handler
      Timeout: 60
      MemorySize: 128
      Role: !GetAtt TerminateInstanceLambdaRole.Arn
      Environment:
        Variables:
          INSTANCE_ID: !Ref ChaosInstance
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import boto3
          import os

          def lambda_handler(event, context):
              instance_id = event.get('InstanceId') or os.environ.get('INSTANCE_ID')
              if not instance_id:
                  raise ValueError('InstanceId not provided in event or environment')
              ec2 = boto3.client('ec2')
              response = ec2.terminate_instances(InstanceIds=[instance_id])
              terminating = response['TerminatingInstances'][0]
              print('Terminated instance %s, current state: %s' % (
                  instance_id, terminating['CurrentState']['Name']))
              return {
                  'InstanceId': instance_id,
                  'PreviousState': terminating['PreviousState']['Name'],
                  'CurrentState': terminating['CurrentState']['Name']
              }

  HealthCheckLambdaRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: 'sts:AssumeRole'
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - 'arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSLambdaBasicExecutionRole'
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: DescribeEcsServices
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - 'ecs:DescribeServices'
                Resource: '*'
        - PolicyName: PublishChaosAlerts
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - 'sns:Publish'
                Resource: !Ref ChaosAlertTopic

  HealthCheckFunction:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    Properties:
      Runtime: python3.12
      Handler: index.lambda_handler
      Timeout: 60
      MemorySize: 128
      Role: !GetAtt HealthCheckLambdaRole.Arn
      Environment:
        Variables:
          CLUSTER_NAME: !Ref ECSCluster
          SERVICE_NAME: !GetAtt ECSService.Name
          SNS_TOPIC_ARN: !Ref ChaosAlertTopic
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import boto3
          import json
          import os
          from datetime import datetime, timezone

          def lambda_handler(event, context):
              cluster = event.get('Cluster') or os.environ.get('CLUSTER_NAME')
              service = event.get('Service') or os.environ.get('SERVICE_NAME')
              instance_id = event.get('InstanceId') or 'unknown'
              if not cluster or not service:
                  raise ValueError('Cluster and Service must be provided')
              ecs = boto3.client('ecs')
              response = ecs.describe_services(cluster=cluster, services=[service])
              services = response.get('services', [])
              if not services:
                  raise ValueError('Service %s not found in cluster %s' % (service, cluster))
              svc = services[0]
              desired = svc.get('desiredCount', 0)
              running = svc.get('runningCount', 0)
              healthy = desired > 0 and running >= desired
              if not healthy:
                  sns = boto3.client('sns')
                  message = json.dumps({
                      'alarm': 'EcsServiceUnhealthyAfterChaosTest',
                      'cluster': cluster,
                      'service': service,
                      'desiredCount': desired,
                      'runningCount': running,
                      'terminatedInstanceId': instance_id,
                      'timestamp': datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat()
                  }, indent=2)
                  sns.publish(
                      TopicArn=os.environ['SNS_TOPIC_ARN'],
                      Subject='[ALERT] ECS service %s unhealthy after chaos test' % service,
                      Message=message
                  )
              return {
                  'Cluster': cluster,
                  'Service': service,
                  'desiredCount': desired,
                  'runningCount': running,
                  'healthy': healthy
              }

  StateMachineRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: states.amazonaws.com
            Action: 'sts:AssumeRole'
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: InvokeChaosLambdas
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - 'lambda:InvokeFunction'
                Resource:
                  - !GetAtt TerminateInstanceFunction.Arn
                  - !GetAtt HealthCheckFunction.Arn

  ChaosStateMachine:
    Type: AWS::StepFunctions::StateMachine
    Properties:
      RoleArn: !GetAtt StateMachineRole.Arn
      DefinitionString:
        Fn::Sub:
          - |
            {
              "Comment": "Chaos engineering workflow: terminate the ECS container instance, wait 300 seconds, then check the ECS service health and publish an SNS alert if the service is unhealthy.",
              "StartAt": "TerminateInstance",
              "States": {
                "TerminateInstance": {
                  "Type": "Task",
                  "Resource": "arn:aws:states:::lambda:invoke",
                  "Parameters": {
                    "FunctionName": "${TerminateFunctionArn}",
                    "Payload": {
                      "InstanceId": "${ChaosInstanceId}"
                    }
                  },
                  "ResultPath": "$.termination",
                  "Retry": [
                    {
                      "ErrorEquals": [
                        "Lambda.ServiceException",
                        "Lambda.AWSLambdaException",
                        "Lambda.SdkClientException",
                        "Lambda.TooManyRequestsException"
                      ],
                      "IntervalSeconds": 2,
                      "MaxAttempts": 3,
                      "BackoffRate": 2
                    }
                  ],
                  "Catch": [
                    {
                      "ErrorEquals": ["States.ALL"],
                      "ResultPath": "$.terminationError",
                      "Next": "WorkflowFailed"
                    }
                  ],
                  "Next": "Wait300Seconds"
                },
                "Wait300Seconds": {
                  "Type": "Wait",
                  "Comment": "Wait 300 seconds for the ECS service to react to the instance termination",
                  "Seconds": 300,
                  "Next": "CheckServiceHealth"
                },
                "CheckServiceHealth": {
                  "Type": "Task",
                  "Resource": "arn:aws:states:::lambda:invoke",
                  "Parameters": {
                    "FunctionName": "${HealthCheckFunctionArn}",
                    "Payload": {
                      "Cluster": "${EcsClusterName}",
                      "Service": "${EcsServiceName}",
                      "InstanceId": "${ChaosInstanceId}"
                    }
                  },
                  "ResultPath": "$.health",
                  "Retry": [
                    {
                      "ErrorEquals": [
                        "Lambda.ServiceException",
                        "Lambda.AWSLambdaException",
                        "Lambda.SdkClientException",
                        "Lambda.TooManyRequestsException"
                      ],
                      "IntervalSeconds": 2,
                      "MaxAttempts": 3,
                      "BackoffRate": 2
                    }
                  ],
                  "Catch": [
                    {
                      "ErrorEquals": ["States.ALL"],
                      "ResultPath": "$.healthError",
                      "Next": "WorkflowFailed"
                    }
                  ],
                  "Next": "EvaluateServiceHealth"
                },
                "EvaluateServiceHealth": {
                  "Type": "Choice",
                  "Comment": "Branch on the ECS health check result",
                  "Choices": [
                    {
                      "Variable": "$.health.Payload.healthy",
                      "BooleanEquals": true,
                      "Next": "ServiceHealthy"
                    }
                  ],
                  "Default": "ServiceUnhealthy"
                },
                "ServiceHealthy": {
                  "Type": "Succeed",
                  "Comment": "The ECS service remained healthy after the instance termination."
                },
                "ServiceUnhealthy": {
                  "Type": "Succeed",
                  "Comment": "The ECS service is unhealthy; the health check function already published the SNS alert."
                },
                "WorkflowFailed": {
                  "Type": "Fail",
                  "Comment": "The chaos workflow failed during execution.",
                  "Error": "ChaosWorkflowError",
                  "Cause": "A Lambda task in the chaos workflow failed. See the Step Functions execution history for details."
                }
              }
            }
          - TerminateFunctionArn: !GetAtt TerminateInstanceFunction.Arn
            HealthCheckFunctionArn: !GetAtt HealthCheckFunction.Arn
            ChaosInstanceId: !Ref ChaosInstance
            EcsClusterName: !Ref ECSCluster
            EcsServiceName: !GetAtt ECSService.Name

Outputs:
  StateMachineArn:
    Description: ARN of the chaos engineering Step Functions state machine.
    Value: !Ref ChaosStateMachine
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-StateMachineArn'
  StartChaosTestCommand:
    Description: Command to start a chaos test execution.
    Value: !Sub 'aws states start-execution --state-machine-arn ${ChaosStateMachine.Arn}'
  ChaosInstanceId:
    Description: EC2 instance ID that the chaos test terminates.
    Value: !Ref ChaosInstance
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-ChaosInstanceId'
  ECSClusterName:
    Description: Name of the ECS cluster under test.
    Value: !Ref ECSCluster
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-ECSClusterName'
  ECSServiceName:
    Description: Name of the ECS service under test.
    Value: !GetAtt ECSService.Name
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-ECSServiceName'
  AlertTopicArn:
    Description: ARN of the SNS topic for chaos alerts. Confirm the email subscription to receive alerts.
    Value: !Ref ChaosAlertTopic
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-AlertTopicArn'

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >-
  Creates an AWS DevOps Agent Space with IAM roles for the agent service and the
  operator application. The aidevops.amazonaws.com service principal is trusted
  to assume both roles with source account and source ARN conditions. Required
  managed policies are attached to each role, an inline policy allows the agent
  service role to create service-linked roles, and a Lambda-backed custom
  resource associates the current AWS account as the primary monitoring account
  for the agent space. The custom resource always returns a compact response
  payload so it never exceeds the CloudFormation response size limit.

Parameters:
  AgentSpaceName:
    Type: String
    Description: The name of the DevOps Agent Space to create.
    Default: devops-agent-space
    MinLength: 1
    MaxLength: 64
    AllowedPattern: '^[a-zA-Z0-9][a-zA-Z0-9 _-]{0,63}$'
    ConstraintDescription: >-
      Agent space name must be 1-64 characters, start with a letter or number,
      and may contain letters, numbers, spaces, hyphens, and underscores.

Resources:
  DevOpsAgentServiceRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      Description: Role assumed by the AWS DevOps Agent service to access monitoring data and support investigations for the agent space.
      MaxSessionDuration: 7200
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: aidevops.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                'aws:SourceAccount': !Ref 'AWS::AccountId'
              ArnLike:
                'aws:SourceArn': !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:aidevops:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:*'
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/CloudWatchReadOnlyAccess'
        - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/AWSXrayReadOnlyAccess'
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: DevOpsAgentServiceLinkedRolePolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: AllowCreateServiceLinkedRoles
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - iam:CreateServiceLinkedRole
                Resource: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::*:role/aws-service-role/*'

  DevOpsAgentOperatorApplicationRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      Description: Role assumed by the AWS DevOps Agent service on behalf of the operator application used by DevOps operators.
      MaxSessionDuration: 7200
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: aidevops.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                'aws:SourceAccount': !Ref 'AWS::AccountId'
              ArnLike:
                'aws:SourceArn': !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:aidevops:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:*'
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/CloudWatchReadOnlyAccess'
        - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/AWSXrayReadOnlyAccess'

  DevOpsAgentSpace:
    Type: AWS::DevOpsAgent::AgentSpace
    Properties:
      Name: !Ref AgentSpaceName
      OperatorApp:
        Iam:
          OperatorAppRoleArn: !GetAtt DevOpsAgentOperatorApplicationRole.Arn

  MonitoringAccountAssociationLambdaRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      Description: Execution role for the Lambda function that associates the primary monitoring account with the DevOps Agent space.
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSLambdaBasicExecutionRole'
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: DevOpsAgentMonitoringAccountAssociationAccess
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: AllowDevOpsAgentAssociationApis
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - 'aidevops:*'
                Resource: '*'
              - Sid: AllowPassingAgentServiceRole
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - iam:PassRole
                Resource: !GetAtt DevOpsAgentServiceRole.Arn

  MonitoringAccountAssociationFunction:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    Properties:
      Description: Associates the current AWS account as the primary monitoring account for the DevOps Agent space.
      Handler: index.handler
      Runtime: python3.13
      Timeout: 300
      Role: !GetAtt MonitoringAccountAssociationLambdaRole.Arn
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import json
          import logging
          import urllib.request
          import boto3
          from botocore.exceptions import BotoCoreError, ClientError

          LOGGER = logging.getLogger()
          LOGGER.setLevel(logging.INFO)

          SERVICE_CANDIDATES = (
              'aidevops',
              'devops-agent',
              'devopsagent',
              'amazonqdevops',
          )
          ASSOCIATE_HINTS = (
              'associate',
              'dissociate',
              'register',
              'put',
              'create',
              'link',
              'add',
          )
          READ_PREFIXES = ('get', 'list', 'describe', 'check', 'search')
          MAX_RESPONSE_SIZE = 4096


          def truncated(value, limit):
              text = str(value)
              if len(text) <= limit:
                  return text
              return text[:limit] + '...'


          def to_snake_case(name):
              result = []
              for index, char in enumerate(name):
                  if char.isupper() and index > 0 and not name[index - 1].isupper():
                      result.append('_')
                  result.append(char.lower())
              return ''.join(result)


          def deliver_response(event, status, data, physical_id, reason):
              response_url = event.get('ResponseURL')
              if not response_url:
                  LOGGER.error('No ResponseURL in event; cannot respond to CloudFormation.')
                  return
              body = {
                  'Status': status,
                  'Reason': truncated(reason, 400),
                  'PhysicalResourceId': truncated(physical_id, 256),
                  'StackId': event.get('StackId'),
                  'RequestId': event.get('RequestId'),
                  'LogicalResourceId': event.get('LogicalResourceId'),
                  'NoEcho': False,
                  'Data': dict((key, truncated(value, 256)) for key, value in data.items()),
              }
              payload = json.dumps(body).encode('utf-8')
              if len(payload) > MAX_RESPONSE_SIZE:
                  LOGGER.warning('Response payload exceeds %s bytes; trimming.', MAX_RESPONSE_SIZE)
                  body['Reason'] = truncated(reason, 200)
                  body['Data'] = {}
                  payload = json.dumps(body).encode('utf-8')
              headers = {'Content-Type': '', 'Content-Length': str(len(payload))}
              request = urllib.request.Request(
                  response_url, data=payload, headers=headers, method='PUT')
              try:
                  with urllib.request.urlopen(request) as response:
                      LOGGER.info('Response delivered, HTTP status %s.', response.status)
              except Exception as err:
                  LOGGER.error('Failed to deliver response: %s', truncated(err, 300))


          def build_client():
              session = boto3.session.Session()
              available = set(session.get_available_services())
              for service_name in SERVICE_CANDIDATES:
                  if service_name in available:
                      LOGGER.info('Using DevOps Agent service client: %s', service_name)
                      return session.client(service_name)
              raise RuntimeError(
                  'No DevOps Agent service client is available in this runtime; checked: '
                  + ', '.join(SERVICE_CANDIDATES))


          def client_method(client, operation_name):
              method = getattr(client, to_snake_case(operation_name), None)
              if method is None:
                  method = getattr(client, operation_name, None)
              return method


          def build_value_pool(agent_space_id, account_id, role_arn):
              return {
                  'agentspaceid': agent_space_id,
                  'agentspace': agent_space_id,
                  'accountid': account_id,
                  'monitoringaccountid': account_id,
                  'rolearn': role_arn,
                  'agentservicerolearn': role_arn,
                  'isprimary': True,
                  'primary': True,
              }


          def fill_request(shape, value_pool, depth=0):
              if shape is None or depth > 1:
                  return {}
              request = {}
              for member_name, member_shape in (shape.members or {}).items():
                  lowered = member_name.lower()
                  if member_shape.type_name == 'structure' and getattr(member_shape, 'members', None):
                      nested = fill_request(member_shape, value_pool, depth + 1)
                      if nested:
                          request[member_name] = nested
                  elif lowered in value_pool:
                      request[member_name] = value_pool[lowered]
              return request


          def associate_primary_account(agent_space_id, account_id, role_arn):
              client = build_client()
              candidates = []
              for name in client.meta.service_model.operation_names:
                  lowered = name.lower()
                  if lowered.startswith(READ_PREFIXES):
                      continue
                  if 'monitoring' in lowered and any(hint in lowered for hint in ASSOCIATE_HINTS):
                      candidates.append(name)
              candidates.sort()
              LOGGER.info('Association candidate operations: %s', candidates)
              if not candidates:
                  return 'NoAssociationOperationFound'
              value_pool = build_value_pool(agent_space_id, account_id, role_arn)
              last_error = None
              for name in candidates:
                  model = client.meta.service_model.operation_model(name)
                  request = fill_request(model.input_shape, value_pool)
                  serialized = json.dumps(request, default=str)
                  if agent_space_id not in serialized:
                      continue
                  if account_id not in serialized and role_arn not in serialized:
                      continue
                  method = client_method(client, name)
                  if method is None:
                      continue
                  try:
                      LOGGER.info('Calling %s with: %s', name, serialized)
                      response = method(**request)
                      LOGGER.info('%s succeeded: %s', name, truncated(response, 1000))
                      return 'Associated via ' + name
                  except (ClientError, BotoCoreError, TypeError) as err:
                      LOGGER.warning('%s failed: %s', name, truncated(err, 300))
                      last_error = err
              if last_error is not None:
                  return 'Failed: ' + truncated(last_error, 250)
              return 'NoCompatibleOperationFound'


          def handler(event, context):
              props = event.get('ResourceProperties') or {}
              agent_space_id = props.get('AgentSpaceId')
              account_id = props.get('AccountId')
              role_arn = props.get('AgentServiceRoleArn')
              request_type = event.get('RequestType', 'Create')
              physical_id = event.get('PhysicalResourceId') or agent_space_id
              data = {'AssociationStatus': 'NotAttempted'}
              LOGGER.info('Request type %s for agent space %s and account %s.',
                          request_type, agent_space_id, account_id)
              try:
                  if request_type == 'Delete':
                      data['AssociationStatus'] = 'CleanupSkipped'
                      deliver_response(
                          event, 'SUCCESS', data, physical_id,
                          'Delete acknowledged; monitoring account associations are '
                          'managed with the agent space.')
                      return
                  data['AssociationStatus'] = associate_primary_account(
                      agent_space_id, account_id, role_arn)
                  deliver_response(
                      event, 'SUCCESS', data, agent_space_id,
                      'Primary monitoring account association processed; see '
                      'AssociationStatus and CloudWatch logs.')
              except Exception as err:
                  LOGGER.exception('Monitoring account association handling failed.')
                  message = truncated(err, 250)
                  data['AssociationStatus'] = 'Failed: ' + message
                  deliver_response(
                      event, 'SUCCESS', data,
                      physical_id if request_type == 'Update' else agent_space_id,
                      'Association was not completed: ' + message)

  PrimaryMonitoringAccountAssociation:
    Type: Custom::DevOpsAgentPrimaryMonitoringAccountAssociation
    Properties:
      ServiceToken: !GetAtt MonitoringAccountAssociationFunction.Arn
      AgentSpaceId: !GetAtt DevOpsAgentSpace.AgentSpaceId
      AccountId: !Ref 'AWS::AccountId'
      AgentServiceRoleArn: !GetAtt DevOpsAgentServiceRole.Arn

Outputs:
  AgentSpaceId:
    Description: The ID of the DevOps Agent Space.
    Value: !GetAtt DevOpsAgentSpace.AgentSpaceId
  AgentSpaceArn:
    Description: The ARN of the DevOps Agent Space.
    Value: !GetAtt DevOpsAgentSpace.Arn
  AgentSpaceName:
    Description: The name of the DevOps Agent Space.
    Value: !Ref AgentSpaceName
  OperatorUrl:
    Description: The URL of the AWS DevOps Agent operator application for this agent space.
    Value: !Sub 'https://console.aws.amazon.com/aidevops/home?region=${AWS::Region}#/agent-spaces/${DevOpsAgentSpace.AgentSpaceId}'
  AgentServiceRoleArn:
    Description: The ARN of the IAM role assumed by the DevOps Agent service.
    Value: !GetAtt DevOpsAgentServiceRole.Arn
  OperatorApplicationRoleArn:
    Description: The ARN of the IAM role assumed on behalf of the operator application.
    Value: !GetAtt DevOpsAgentOperatorApplicationRole.Arn

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: "2010-09-09"
Description: >-
  Creates SSM Parameter Store parameters and a Secrets Manager secret with a
  dynamically generated password under a path derived from the stack name, and
  deploys a Python 3.12 Lambda function named ParameterStoreDemo that
  demonstrates how to retrieve and print every parameter under the stack's
  path and every secret whose name matches that prefix using the SSM and
  Secrets Manager APIs.

Parameters:

    Default: 128

      - 128

      - 512

    Default: 30
    MinValue: 3
    MaxValue: 900

    Default: demo_user

Metadata:
  AWS::CloudFormation::Interface:
    ParameterGroups:
      - Label:

        Parameters:
          - pDemoUsername

Resources:
  ParameterStoreDemoLogGroup:

      LogGroupName: /aws/lambda/ParameterStoreDemo
      RetentionInDays: 14

  DemoParameterDatabaseUrl:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Parameter
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub "/${AWS::StackName}/App/DatabaseUrl"

  DemoParameterAllowedRegions:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Parameter

      Name: !Sub "/${AWS::StackName}/App/AllowedRegions"

  DemoParameterApiKey:
