AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >-
  Automatically disables IMDSv1 on EC2 instances by triggering the AWS managed
  AWSSupport-ConfigureEC2Metadata Systems Manager automation document from an
  Amazon EventBridge rule whenever an instance enters the running state.

Parameters:
  HttpPutResponseHopLimit:
    Description: >-
      The desired HTTP PUT response hop limit for the instance metadata service.
      Valid values are between 1 and 64.
    Type: Number
    Default: 1
    MinValue: 1
    MaxValue: 64

Resources:
  SsmAutomationRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      Description: >-
        Role assumed by the AWSSupport-ConfigureEC2Metadata automation to describe
        instances and modify their metadata options.
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: ssm.amazonaws.com
            Action: 'sts:AssumeRole'
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: ConfigureEc2InstanceMetadataOptions
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - 'ec2:DescribeInstances'
                Resource: '*'
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - 'ec2:ModifyInstanceMetadataOptions'
                Resource: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:ec2:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:instance/*'

  EventBridgeInvokeRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      Description: >-
        Role assumed by Amazon EventBridge to start the AWSSupport-ConfigureEC2Metadata
        automation when the rule is triggered.
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: events.amazonaws.com
            Action: 'sts:AssumeRole'
            Condition:
              StringLike:
                'aws:SourceArn': !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:events:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:rule/*'
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: StartConfigureEc2MetadataAutomation
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - 'ssm:StartAutomationExecution'
                Resource:
                  - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:ssm:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:automation-definition/AWSSupport-ConfigureEC2Metadata'
                  - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:ssm:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:automation-definition/AWSSupport-ConfigureEC2Metadata:*'
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - 'iam:PassRole'
                Resource: !GetAtt SsmAutomationRole.Arn

  Ec2RunningStateRule:
    Type: AWS::Events::Rule
    Properties:
      Description: >-
        Starts the AWSSupport-ConfigureEC2Metadata automation to disable IMDSv1
        whenever an EC2 instance enters the running state.
      State: ENABLED
      EventPattern:
        source:
          - 'aws.ec2'
        detail-type:
          - 'EC2 Instance State-change Notification'
        detail:
          state:
            - 'running'
      Targets:
        - Id: ConfigureEc2MetadataAutomation
          Arn: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:ssm:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:automation-definition/AWSSupport-ConfigureEC2Metadata:$LATEST'
          RoleArn: !GetAtt EventBridgeInvokeRole.Arn
          Input: !Sub |-
            {
              "InstanceId": ["<instanceId>"],
              "AutomationAssumeRole": ["${SsmAutomationRole.Arn}"],
              "HttpTokens": ["required"],
              "HttpPutResponseHopLimit": ["${HttpPutResponseHopLimit}"]
            }

Outputs:
  EventRuleName:
    Description: Name of the EventBridge rule that triggers the automation.
    Value: !Ref Ec2RunningStateRule
  EventRuleArn:
    Description: ARN of the EventBridge rule that triggers the automation.
    Value: !GetAtt Ec2RunningStateRule.Arn
  SsmAutomationRoleArn:
    Description: ARN of the role the automation assumes to configure instance metadata options.
    Value: !GetAtt SsmAutomationRole.Arn
  EventBridgeInvokeRoleArn:
    Description: ARN of the role EventBridge assumes to start the automation.
    Value: !GetAtt EventBridgeInvokeRole.Arn

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >-
  Creates an AWS AppSync GraphQL API secured with AWS IAM authentication, a
  GraphQL schema defining a Note type (NoteId, title, content) with a getNote
  query and a saveNote mutation, and an Amazon EventBridge data source that
  puts events onto a custom EventBridge event bus, including the IAM role and
  policy that allow AppSync to write events to that bus.

Parameters:
  GraphQLApiName:
    Type: String
    Default: notes-graphql-api
    Description: Name of the AWS AppSync GraphQL API.
  EventBusName:
    Type: String
    Default: notes-event-bus
    Description: Name of the custom Amazon EventBridge event bus.

Resources:
  CustomEventBus:
    Type: AWS::Events::EventBus
    Properties:
      Name: !Ref EventBusName

  AppSyncEventBridgeRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      Description: Role assumed by AppSync to publish events to the custom EventBridge event bus.
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: appsync.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: AppSyncPutEventsToEventBus
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: AllowPutEventsToCustomBus
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - events:PutEvents
                Resource: !GetAtt CustomEventBus.Arn

  GraphQLApi:
    Type: AWS::AppSync::GraphQLApi
    Properties:
      Name: !Ref GraphQLApiName
      AuthenticationType: AWS_IAM

  GraphQLSchema:
    Type: AWS::AppSync::GraphQLSchema
    Properties:
      ApiId: !GetAtt GraphQLApi.ApiId
      Definition: |
        type Note {
          NoteId: ID!
          title: String
          content: String
        }

        type Query {
          getNote(NoteId: ID!): Note
        }

        type Mutation {
          saveNote(NoteId: ID!, title: String, content: String): Note
        }

        schema {
          query: Query
          mutation: Mutation
        }

  EventBridgeDataSource:
    Type: AWS::AppSync::DataSource
    Properties:
      ApiId: !GetAtt GraphQLApi.ApiId
      Name: EventBridgeDataSource
      Description: Data source that publishes events to the custom EventBridge event bus.
      Type: AMAZON_EVENTBRIDGE
      ServiceRoleArn: !GetAtt AppSyncEventBridgeRole.Arn
      EventBridgeConfig:
        EventBusArn: !GetAtt CustomEventBus.Arn

  SaveNoteResolver:
    Type: AWS::AppSync::Resolver
    DependsOn: GraphQLSchema
    Properties:
      ApiId: !GetAtt GraphQLApi.ApiId
      TypeName: Mutation
      FieldName: saveNote
      DataSourceName: !GetAtt EventBridgeDataSource.Name
      RequestMappingTemplate: |
        {
          "version": "2018-05-29",
          "operation": "PutEvents",
          "events": [
            {
              "source": "appsync.notes",
              "detail": $util.toJson($ctx.args),
              "detailType": "NoteSaved"
            }
          ]
        }
      ResponseMappingTemplate: |
        $util.toJson($ctx.args)

Outputs:
  GraphQLApiId:
    Description: The ID of the AppSync GraphQL API.
    Value: !GetAtt GraphQLApi.ApiId
  GraphQLApiUrl:
    Description: The GraphQL endpoint URL of the AppSync API.
    Value: !GetAtt GraphQLApi.GraphQLUrl
  GraphQLApiArn:
    Description: The ARN of the AppSync GraphQL API.
    Value: !GetAtt GraphQLApi.Arn
  EventBusName:
    Description: The name of the custom EventBridge event bus.
    Value: !Ref CustomEventBus
  EventBusArn:
    Description: The ARN of the custom EventBridge event bus.
    Value: !GetAtt CustomEventBus.Arn
  EventBridgeDataSourceName:
    Description: The name of the AppSync EventBridge data source.
    Value: !GetAtt EventBridgeDataSource.Name

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >-
  Scheduled Lambda function that periodically cleans up expired items from the
  existing DynamoDB table "throttle" by scanning for records whose range (sort)
  key is older than the current time and deleting them in batches. The cleanup
  runs every hour by default; pass an empty string for the ScheduleExpression
  parameter to disable the schedule.

Parameters:
  ScheduleExpression:
    Type: String
    Default: 'rate(1 hour)'
    Description: >-
      Schedule expression (rate() or cron()) that triggers the cleanup Lambda
      function. Pass an empty string to disable the schedule.
    AllowedPattern: '^($|rate\([^)]+\)|cron\([^)]+\))$'
    ConstraintDescription: >-
      Value must be an empty string or a valid rate(...) or cron(...) expression.
  ThrottleTableName:
    Type: String
    Default: throttle
    Description: Name of the existing DynamoDB table whose expired items are cleaned up.
    AllowedPattern: '^[a-zA-Z0-9_.-]{3,255}$'
    ConstraintDescription: >-
      DynamoDB table names may only contain a-z, A-Z, 0-9, '_', '-' and '.'.

Conditions:
  HasSchedule: !Not [!Equals [!Ref ScheduleExpression, '']]

Resources:
  DynamoDBCleanupLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    DeletionPolicy: Delete
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: '/aws/lambda/DynamoDBCleanupFunction'
      RetentionInDays: 30

  DynamoDBCleanupFunctionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: 'sts:AssumeRole'
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: DynamoDBCleanupFunctionAccess
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: WriteLambdaLogs
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - 'logs:CreateLogStream'
                  - 'logs:PutLogEvents'
                Resource: !Sub '${DynamoDBCleanupLogGroup.Arn}:*'
              - Sid: CleanThrottleTable
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - 'dynamodb:BatchWriteItem'
                  - 'dynamodb:DescribeTable'
                  - 'dynamodb:Scan'
                Resource: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:dynamodb:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:table/${ThrottleTableName}'

  DynamoDBCleanupFunction:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    DependsOn: DynamoDBCleanupLogGroup
    Properties:
      FunctionName: DynamoDBCleanupFunction
      Description: Periodically deletes expired items from the DynamoDB throttle table.
      Runtime: python3.12
      Handler: index.lambda_handler
      MemorySize: 256
      Timeout: 300
      Role: !GetAtt DynamoDBCleanupFunctionRole.Arn
      Environment:
        Variables:
          TABLE_NAME: !Ref ThrottleTableName
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import os
          import time

          import boto3

          TABLE_NAME = os.environ["TABLE_NAME"]
          BATCH_SIZE = 25  # DynamoDB allows at most 25 requests per batch write
          MAX_RETRIES = 8

          dynamodb = boto3.client("dynamodb")


          def lambda_handler(event, context):
              """Delete every item whose range key value is older than the current time."""
              now = str(int(time.time()))
              key_schema = dynamodb.describe_table(TableName=TABLE_NAME)["Table"]["KeySchema"]
              hash_key = next(
                  (k["AttributeName"] for k in key_schema if k["KeyType"] == "HASH"), None
              )
              range_key = next(
                  (k["AttributeName"] for k in key_schema if k["KeyType"] == "RANGE"), None
              )
              if hash_key is None or range_key is None:
                  raise ValueError(
                      "Table %s must have both a hash key and a range key" % TABLE_NAME
                  )

              scan_kwargs = {
                  "TableName": TABLE_NAME,
                  "FilterExpression": "#rk < :now",
                  "ExpressionAttributeNames": {"#rk": range_key, "#hk": hash_key},
                  "ExpressionAttributeValues": {":now": {"N": now}},
                  "ProjectionExpression": "#hk, #rk",
              }

              deleted = 0
              response = dynamodb.scan(**scan_kwargs)
              while True:
                  delete_requests = [
                      {
                          "DeleteRequest": {
                              "Key": {
                                  hash_key: item[hash_key],
                                  range_key: item[range_key],
                              }
                          }
                      }
                      for item in response.get("Items", [])
                  ]
                  deleted += delete_in_batches(delete_requests)
                  last_evaluated_key = response.get("LastEvaluatedKey")
                  if not last_evaluated_key:
                      break
                  response = dynamodb.scan(
                      ExclusiveStartKey=last_evaluated_key, **scan_kwargs
                  )

              print("Deleted %d expired items from table %s" % (deleted, TABLE_NAME))
              return {"deletedItems": deleted, "table": TABLE_NAME}


          def delete_in_batches(delete_requests):
              """Delete requests in batches of 25, retrying unprocessed items."""
              deleted = 0
              for start in range(0, len(delete_requests), BATCH_SIZE):
                  batch = delete_requests[start:start + BATCH_SIZE]
                  pending = batch
                  retries = 0
                  while pending and retries < MAX_RETRIES:
                      response = dynamodb.batch_write_item(
                          RequestItems={TABLE_NAME: pending}
                      )
                      pending = response.get("UnprocessedItems", {}).get(TABLE_NAME, [])
                      retries += 1
                      if pending:
                          time.sleep(min(0.1 * (2 ** retries), 1.0))
                  deleted += len(batch) - len(pending)
                  if pending:
                      print(
                          "WARNING: %d items were not deleted after %d retries"
                          % (len(pending), MAX_RETRIES)
                      )
              return deleted

  DynamoDBCleanupSchedule:
    Type: AWS::Events::Rule
    Condition: HasSchedule
    Properties:
      Name: dynamodb-cleanup-schedule
      Description: Triggers the DynamoDB cleanup Lambda function on a schedule.
      ScheduleExpression: !Ref ScheduleExpression
      State: ENABLED
      Targets:
        - Id: DynamoDBCleanupTarget
          Arn: !GetAtt DynamoDBCleanupFunction.Arn

  DynamoDBCleanupInvokePermission:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Permission
    Condition: HasSchedule
    Properties:
      Action: 'lambda:InvokeFunction'
      FunctionName: !Ref DynamoDBCleanupFunction
      Principal: events.amazonaws.com
      SourceArn: !GetAtt DynamoDBCleanupSchedule.Arn

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >
  Creates a Pet Shop GraphQL API (PetShopAPI) using AWS AppSync with API_KEY
  authentication. A Lambda function returns a static list of pets
  (Buddy, Mittens, Charlie) and serves as the data source for the getPets query.

Resources:
  PetsLambdaExecutionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSLambdaBasicExecutionRole

  PetsLambdaFunction:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    Properties:
      Description: Returns a static list of pets for the PetShop GraphQL API
      Role: !GetAtt PetsLambdaExecutionRole.Arn

      MemorySize: 128

        ZipFile: |
          def handler(event, context):

                  {"id": "1", "name": "Buddy", "type": "Dog"},

  AppSyncLambdaServiceRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: appsync.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: AppSyncInvokePetsLambda
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - lambda:InvokeFunction
                Resource: !GetAtt PetsLambdaFunction.Arn

  PetShopGraphQLApi:
    Type: AWS::AppSync::GraphQLApi
    Properties:
      Name: PetShopAPI
      AuthenticationType: API_KEY

  PetShopGraphQLSchema:
    Type: AWS::AppSync::GraphQLSchema
    Properties:
      ApiId: !GetAtt PetShopGraphQLApi.ApiId
      Definition: |
        type Pet {
          id: ID!
          name: String!
          type: String!
        }

        type Query {
          getPets: [Pet]
        }

        schema {
          query: Query
        }

  PetShopApiKey:
    Type: AWS::AppSync::ApiKey
    Properties:
      ApiId: !GetAtt PetShopGraphQLApi.ApiId
      Description: API key for anonymous access to the PetShopAPI

  PetsDataSource:
    Type: AWS::AppSync::DataSource
    Properties:
      ApiId: !GetAtt PetShopGraphQLApi.ApiId
      Name: PetsLambdaDataSource
      Type: AWS_LAMBDA
      Description: Lambda data source returning the static list of pets
      ServiceRoleArn: !GetAtt AppSyncLambdaServiceRole.Arn
      LambdaConfig:
        LambdaFunctionArn: !GetAtt PetsLambdaFunction.Arn

  GetPetsResolver:
    Type: AWS::AppSync::Resolver
    DependsOn: PetShopGraphQLSchema
    Properties:
      ApiId: !GetAtt PetShopGraphQLApi.ApiId
      TypeName: Query
      FieldName: getPets
      Kind: UNIT
      DataSourceName: !GetAtt PetsDataSource.Name
      RequestMappingTemplate: |
        {
          "version": "2018-05-29",
          "operation": "Invoke",
          "payload": $util.toJson($ctx.arguments)
        }
      ResponseMappingTemplate: |
        $util.toJson($ctx.result)

  GraphQLApiUrl:
    Description: URL of the PetShopAPI GraphQL endpoint
    Value: !GetAtt PetShopGraphQLApi.GraphQLUrl
  GraphQLApiKey:
    Description: API key used to authenticate requests to the PetShopAPI

  GraphQLApiId:
    Description: Unique AppSync API identifier for the PetShopAPI
    Value: !GetAtt PetShopGraphQLApi.ApiId

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: "2010-09-09"
Description: >-
  Creates an AWS IVS channel and an associated stream key for live streaming.
  Latency mode, channel type, and playback authorization are configurable via
  parameters. Resources are tagged with an Environment tag and a custom
  key-value pair, and the stack outputs the ingest endpoint, playback URL,
  and stream key value.

Parameters:
  LatencyMode:
    Type: String
    Description: Channel latency mode (LOW or NORMAL).
    Default: LOW
    AllowedValues:
      - LOW
      - NORMAL
  ChannelType:
    Type: String
    Description: Channel type (BASIC, STANDARD, ADVANCED_SD, or ADVANCED_HD).
    Default: STANDARD
    AllowedValues:
      - BASIC
      - STANDARD
      - ADVANCED_SD
      - ADVANCED_HD
  Authorized:
    Type: String
    Description: Whether the channel is private and playback requires authorization.
    Default: "false"
    AllowedValues:
      - "true"
      - "false"
  ChannelName:
    Type: String
    Description: Friendly name of the IVS channel.
    Default: ivs-live-stream-channel
    AllowedPattern: "^[a-zA-Z0-9_-]{1,128}$"
  Environment:
    Type: String
    Description: Value applied to the Environment tag on all resources.
    Default: dev
  CustomTagKey:
    Type: String
    Description: Key of the custom tag applied to all resources.
    Default: Application
  CustomTagValue:
    Type: String
    Description: Value of the custom tag applied to all resources.
    Default: LiveStreaming

Conditions:
  IsAuthorized: !Equals [!Ref Authorized, "true"]

Resources:
  IVSChannel:
    Type: AWS::IVS::Channel
    Properties:
      Authorized: !If [IsAuthorized, true, false]
      LatencyMode: !Ref LatencyMode
      Name: !Ref ChannelName
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment
        - Key: !Ref CustomTagKey
          Value: !Ref CustomTagValue
      Type: !Ref ChannelType

  IVSStreamKey:
    Type: AWS::IVS::StreamKey
    Properties:
      ChannelArn: !GetAtt IVSChannel.Arn
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment
        - Key: !Ref CustomTagKey
          Value: !Ref CustomTagValue

Outputs:
  ChannelArn:
    Description: ARN of the IVS channel.
    Value: !GetAtt IVSChannel.Arn
  StreamKeyArn:
    Description: ARN of the IVS stream key.
    Value: !GetAtt IVSStreamKey.Arn
  IngestEndpoint:
    Description: RTMP ingest endpoint used to push the live stream to the IVS channel.
    Value: !GetAtt IVSChannel.IngestEndpoint
  PlaybackURL:
    Description: Playback URL used to consume the live stream from the IVS channel.
    Value: !GetAtt IVSChannel.PlaybackUrl
  StreamKeyValue:
    Description: Stream key value used to authenticate the RTMP ingest into the IVS channel. Treat this as a secret.
    Value: !GetAtt IVSStreamKey.Value

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >-
  Creates two Amazon AppSync GraphQL APIs for testing purposes. Both APIs use
  API key authentication, an inline schema with a Book type and a getBook query
  that returns a generated ID and the requested book name, and a single
  APPSYNC_JS function pipeline resolver. The first API uses default
  introspection settings. The second API has introspection disabled, a query
  depth limit of 10, and a resolver count limit of 100.

Resources:
  DefaultApi:
    Type: AWS::AppSync::GraphQLApi
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-default-api'
      AuthenticationType: API_KEY

  DefaultApiKey:
    Type: AWS::AppSync::ApiKey
    Properties:
      ApiId: !GetAtt DefaultApi.ApiId
      Description: API key for the default settings test API.

  DefaultApiSchema:
    Type: AWS::AppSync::GraphQLSchema
    Properties:
      ApiId: !GetAtt DefaultApi.ApiId
      Definition: |
        type Book {
          id: ID!
          name: String
        }

        type Query {
          getBook(name: String!): Book
        }

  DefaultApiDataSource:
    Type: AWS::AppSync::DataSource
    Properties:
      ApiId: !GetAtt DefaultApi.ApiId
      Name: BookDataSource
      Type: NONE
      Description: None data source backing the AppSync JS pipeline function.

  DefaultApiGetBookFunction:
    Type: AWS::AppSync::FunctionConfiguration
    Properties:
      ApiId: !GetAtt DefaultApi.ApiId
      Name: GetBookFunction
      Description: Generates a book ID and returns the requested book name.
      DataSourceName: !GetAtt DefaultApiDataSource.Name
      FunctionVersion: '2018-05-29'
      Runtime:
        Name: APPSYNC_JS
        RuntimeVersion: '1.0.0'
      Code: |
        export function request(ctx) {
          return {};
        }

        export function response(ctx) {
          return {
            id: util.autoId(),
            name: ctx.args.name,
          };
        }

  DefaultApiGetBookResolver:
    Type: AWS::AppSync::Resolver
    DependsOn: DefaultApiSchema
    Properties:
      ApiId: !GetAtt DefaultApi.ApiId

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >
  Creates an Amazon ECS Fargate task definition with supporting IAM roles
  (a task role with SSM messages permissions for ECS Exec and a task
  execution role with the AmazonECSTaskExecutionRolePolicy) and a
  CloudWatch Logs log group for container application logs.

Parameters:
  EcrRepoName:
    Type: String
    Default: book-app
    Description: Name of the ECR repository, also used as the task definition family, container name, and log stream prefix.
    AllowedPattern: '[a-zA-Z0-9][a-zA-Z0-9._/-]*'
    ConstraintDescription: ECR repository name must start with a letter or number and may contain letters, numbers, periods, hyphens, underscores, and forward slashes.

Resources:
  EcsLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Delete
    DeletionPolicy: Delete
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Sub '/ecs/${EcrRepoName}'
      RetentionInDays: 7

  EcsTaskRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-TaskRole'
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: ecs-tasks.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: root
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ssmmessages:CreateControlChannel
                  - ssmmessages:CreateDataChannel
                  - ssmmessages:OpenControlChannel
                  - ssmmessages:OpenDataChannel
                Resource: '*'

  EcsTaskExecutionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-TaskExecutionRole'
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: ecs-tasks.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AmazonECSTaskExecutionRolePolicy

  EcsTaskDefinition:
    Type: AWS::ECS::TaskDefinition
    Properties:
      Family: !Ref EcrRepoName
      Cpu: '256'
      Memory: '512'
      NetworkMode: awsvpc
      RequiresCompatibilities:
        - FARGATE
      TaskRoleArn: !GetAtt EcsTaskRole.Arn
      ExecutionRoleArn: !GetAtt EcsTaskExecutionRole.Arn
      ContainerDefinitions:
        - Name: !Ref EcrRepoName
          Image: public.ecr.aws/nginx/nginx
          Essential: true
          Privileged: false
          PortMappings:
            - ContainerPort: 80
              Protocol: tcp
          LogConfiguration:
            LogDriver: awslogs
            Options:
              awslogs-group: !Ref EcsLogGroup
              awslogs-region: !Ref 'AWS::Region'
              awslogs-stream-prefix: !Ref EcrRepoName

Outputs:
  EcsTaskDefinitionArn:
    Description: ARN of the ECS Fargate task definition.
    Value: !Ref EcsTaskDefinition
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-TaskDefinitionArn'
  EcsTaskRoleArn:
    Description: ARN of the ECS task role with ECS Exec (SSM messages) permissions.
    Value: !GetAtt EcsTaskRole.Arn
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-TaskRoleArn'
  EcsTaskExecutionRoleArn:
    Description: ARN of the ECS task execution role.
    Value: !GetAtt EcsTaskExecutionRole.Arn
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-TaskExecutionRoleArn'
  EcsLogGroupName:
    Description: Name of the CloudWatch Logs log group for container logs.
    Value: !Ref EcsLogGroup
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-LogGroupName'

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: 2010-09-09
Description: >-
  Creates an AWS AppConfig application named ConfigSourceDemo with a Sandbox environment,
  a hosted configuration profile named json-profile, a hosted configuration version
  containing the JSON data {"interestRate": 0.15} with content type application/json,
  a Demo Strategy deployment strategy that deploys instantly over one minute with a
  100 percent growth factor and no final bake time, and a deployment of the configuration
  version to the Sandbox environment.

Resources:
  ConfigSourceDemoApplication:
    Type: AWS::AppConfig::Application
    Properties:
      Name: ConfigSourceDemo
      Description: Demo application used as the source of configuration data.

  SandboxEnvironment:
    Type: AWS::AppConfig::Environment
    Properties:
      ApplicationId: !Ref ConfigSourceDemoApplication
      Name: Sandbox
      Description: Sandbox environment for the ConfigSourceDemo application.

  JsonProfileConfigurationProfile:
    Type: AWS::AppConfig::ConfigurationProfile
    Properties:
      ApplicationId: !Ref ConfigSourceDemoApplication
      Name: json-profile
      Description: Hosted configuration profile storing freeform JSON configuration data.
      LocationUri: hosted

  JsonProfileHostedConfigurationVersion:
    Type: AWS::AppConfig::HostedConfigurationVersion
    Properties:
      ApplicationId: !Ref ConfigSourceDemoApplication
      ConfigurationProfileId: !Ref JsonProfileConfigurationProfile
      Content: |-
        {
          "interestRate": 0.15
        }
      ContentType: application/json
      Description: Initial JSON configuration containing the interest rate.
      LatestVersionNumber: 1

  DemoDeploymentStrategy:
    Type: AWS::AppConfig::DeploymentStrategy
    Properties:
      Name: Demo Strategy
      Description: Deploys instantly to all targets within one minute with no final bake time.
      DeploymentDurationInMinutes: 1
      GrowthFactor: 100
      GrowthType: LINEAR
      FinalBakeTimeInMinutes: 0
      ReplicateTo: NONE

  SandboxConfigurationDeployment:
    Type: AWS::AppConfig::Deployment
    Properties:
      ApplicationId: !Ref ConfigSourceDemoApplication
      EnvironmentId: !Ref SandboxEnvironment
      ConfigurationProfileId: !Ref JsonProfileConfigurationProfile
      ConfigurationVersion: !Ref JsonProfileHostedConfigurationVersion
      DeploymentStrategyId: !Ref DemoDeploymentStrategy
      Description: Initial deployment of the json-profile configuration to the Sandbox environment.

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: "2010-09-09"
Description: Creates two AWS IoT SiteWise asset models for a wind farm demo. The Turbine asset model defines attributes, measurements, transforms (including an overdrive state transform that triggers when torque exceeds 3) and metrics computed over a 5-minute tumbling window (average wind speed, overdrive state time and average power). The Wind Farm asset model defines its own attributes and rollup metrics computed over the same 5-minute tumbling window and is linked to the Turbine asset model through a hierarchy. Outputs both asset model identifiers and the identifier of the hierarchy association between them.
Metadata:
  AWS::CloudFormation::Interface:
    ParameterGroups:
      - Label:
          default: Metric configuration
        Parameters:
          - MetricWindowInterval
          - OverdriveTorqueThreshold
Parameters:
  MetricWindowInterval:
    Type: String
    Description: Tumbling window interval used by all asset model metrics.
    Default: "5m"
    AllowedValues:
      - "1m"
      - "5m"
      - "10m"
      - "15m"
      - "30m"
      - "1h"
    ConstraintDescription: Metric window interval must be one of 1m, 5m, 10m, 15m, 30m or 1h.
  OverdriveTorqueThreshold:
    Type: Number
    Description: Torque threshold above which the turbine Overdrive State transform evaluates to 1.
    Default: 3
    MinValue: 0
Resources:
  TurbineAssetModel:
    Type: AWS::IoTSiteWise::AssetModel
    Properties:
      AssetModelName: Demo Wind Turbine Asset Model
      AssetModelDescription: Represents a wind turbine in the demo wind farm
      AssetModelProperties:
        - LogicalId: TurbineLocation
          Name: Location
          DataType: STRING
          Type:
            TypeName: Attribute
            Attribute:
              DefaultValue: "Renewable Energy Site"
        - LogicalId: TurbineMaker
          Name: Maker
          DataType: STRING
          Type:
            TypeName: Attribute
            Attribute:
              DefaultValue: "Siemens"
        - LogicalId: TurbineModelNumber
          Name: Model
          DataType: STRING
          Type:
            TypeName: Attribute
            Attribute:
              DefaultValue: "ST300"
        - LogicalId: TurbineTorqueConstant
          Name: Torque Constant
          DataType: DOUBLE
          Unit: "Nm"
          Type:
            TypeName: Attribute
            Attribute:
              DefaultValue: "0.2"
        - LogicalId: TurbineWindSpeed
          Name: Wind Speed
          DataType: DOUBLE
          Unit: "m/s"
          Type:
            TypeName: Measurement
        - LogicalId: TurbineRotationsPerMinute
          Name: Rotations Per Minute
          DataType: DOUBLE
          Unit: "RPM"
          Type:
            TypeName: Measurement
        - LogicalId: TurbineTorque
          Name: Torque
          DataType: DOUBLE
          Unit: "Nm"
          Type:
            TypeName: Transform
            Transform:
              Expression: "rpm * torque_constant"
              Variables:
                - Name: rpm
                  Value:
                    PropertyLogicalId: TurbineRotationsPerMinute
                - Name: torque_constant
                  Value:
                    PropertyLogicalId: TurbineTorqueConstant
        - LogicalId: TurbinePower
          Name: Power
          DataType: DOUBLE
          Unit: "kW"
          Type:
            TypeName: Transform
            Transform:
              Expression: "torque * rpm * 0.1047 / 1000"
              Variables:
                - Name: torque
                  Value:
                    PropertyLogicalId: TurbineTorque
                - Name: rpm
                  Value:
                    PropertyLogicalId: TurbineRotationsPerMinute
        - LogicalId: TurbineOverdriveState
          Name: Overdrive State
          DataType: DOUBLE
          Unit: "0/1"
          Type:
            TypeName: Transform
            Transform:
              Expression: !Sub "if(torque > ${OverdriveTorqueThreshold}, 1, 0)"
              Variables:
                - Name: torque
                  Value:
                    PropertyLogicalId: TurbineTorque
        - LogicalId: TurbineAverageWindSpeed
          Name: Average Wind Speed
          DataType: DOUBLE
          Unit: "m/s"
          Type:
            TypeName: Metric
            Metric:
              Expression: "avg(wind_speed)"
              Variables:
                - Name: wind_speed
                  Value:
                    PropertyLogicalId: TurbineWindSpeed
              Window:
                Tumbling:
                  Interval: !Ref MetricWindowInterval
        - LogicalId: TurbineOverdriveStateTime
          Name: Overdrive State Time
          DataType: DOUBLE
          Unit: "seconds"
          Type:
            TypeName: Metric
            Metric:
              Expression: "sum(overdrive_state)"
              Variables:
                - Name: overdrive_state
                  Value:
                    PropertyLogicalId: TurbineOverdriveState
              Window:
                Tumbling:
                  Interval: !Ref MetricWindowInterval
        - LogicalId: TurbineAveragePower
          Name: Average Power
          DataType: DOUBLE
          Unit: "kW"
          Type:
            TypeName: Metric
            Metric:
              Expression: "avg(power)"
              Variables:
                - Name: power
                  Value:
                    PropertyLogicalId: TurbinePower
              Window:
                Tumbling:
                  Interval: !Ref MetricWindowInterval
      Tags:
        - Key: "Application"
          Value: "WindFarmDemo"
  WindFarmAssetModel:
    Type: AWS::IoTSiteWise::AssetModel
    Properties:
      AssetModelName: Demo Wind Farm Asset Model
      AssetModelDescription: Represents a wind farm that contains wind turbines
      AssetModelHierarchies:
        - LogicalId: WindFarmTurbines
          Name: Wind Turbines
          ChildAssetModelId: !Ref TurbineAssetModel
      AssetModelProperties:
        - LogicalId: WindFarmSiteLocation
          Name: Site Location
          DataType: STRING
          Type:
            TypeName: Attribute
            Attribute:
              DefaultValue: "New Hampshire, USA"
        - LogicalId: WindFarmRatedCapacity
          Name: Rated Capacity
          DataType: DOUBLE
          Unit: "MW"
          Type:
            TypeName: Attribute
            Attribute:
              DefaultValue: "12.0"
        - LogicalId: WindFarmTotalAverageWindSpeed
          Name: Total Average Wind Speed
          DataType: DOUBLE
          Unit: "m/s"
          Type:
            TypeName: Metric
            Metric:
              Expression: "avg(turbine_avg_wind_speed)"
              Variables:
                - Name: turbine_avg_wind_speed
                  Value:
                    HierarchyLogicalId: WindFarmTurbines
                    PropertyLogicalId: TurbineAverageWindSpeed
              Window:
                Tumbling:
                  Interval: !Ref MetricWindowInterval
        - LogicalId: WindFarmTotalOverdriveStateTime
          Name: Total Overdrive State Time
          DataType: DOUBLE
          Unit: "seconds"
          Type:
            TypeName: Metric
            Metric:
              Expression: "sum(turbine_overdrive_state_time)"
              Variables:
                - Name: turbine_overdrive_state_time
                  Value:
                    HierarchyLogicalId: WindFarmTurbines
                    PropertyLogicalId: TurbineOverdriveStateTime
              Window:
                Tumbling:
                  Interval: !Ref MetricWindowInterval
        - LogicalId: WindFarmTotalAveragePower
          Name: Total Average Power
          DataType: DOUBLE
          Unit: "kW"
          Type:
            TypeName: Metric
            Metric:
              Expression: "sum(turbine_avg_power)"
              Variables:
                - Name: turbine_avg_power
                  Value:
                    HierarchyLogicalId: WindFarmTurbines
                    PropertyLogicalId: TurbineAveragePower
              Window:
                Tumbling:
                  Interval: !Ref MetricWindowInterval
      Tags:
        - Key: "Application"
          Value: "WindFarmDemo"
Outputs:
  TurbineAssetModelId:
    Description: The identifier of the Demo Wind Turbine asset model.
    Value: !GetAtt TurbineAssetModel.AssetModelId
    Export:
      Name: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-TurbineAssetModelId"
  WindFarmAssetModelId:
    Description: The identifier of the Demo Wind Farm asset model.
    Value: !GetAtt WindFarmAssetModel.AssetModelId
    Export:
      Name: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-WindFarmAssetModelId"
  WindFarmTurbinesHierarchyId:
    Description: The identifier of the hierarchy that associates the Demo Wind Farm asset model with the Demo Wind Turbine asset model.
    Value: WindFarmTurbines
    Export:
      Name: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-WindFarmTurbinesHierarchyId"

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: "2010-09-09"
Description: >
  Creates two Amazon Cognito identity pools for testing with unauthenticated
  identities enabled, plus one IAM role per pool that unauthenticated Cognito
  identities can assume. The role attached to the first pool supports
  Lambda-based access (Lambda invocation, DynamoDB, SES, and Lambda service
  execution). The role attached to the second pool supports Step Functions
  workflow-based access (Lambda invocation and trust for the Step Functions
  service). Each role is attached back to its pool as the unauthenticated
  role via an identity pool role attachment, all within a single stack.

Metadata:
  AWS::CloudFormation::Interface:
    ParameterGroups:
      - Label:
          default: Identity Pool Configuration
        Parameters:
          - LambdaIdentityPoolName
          - StepFunctionsIdentityPoolName
      - Label:
          default: Optional Permission Scoping
        Parameters:
          - DynamoDBTableArn
          - SesIdentityArn
    ParameterLabels:
      LambdaIdentityPoolName:
        default: Lambda Identity Pool Name
      StepFunctionsIdentityPoolName:
        default: Step Functions Identity Pool Name
      DynamoDBTableArn:
        default: DynamoDB Table ARN (optional)
      SesIdentityArn:
        default: SES Identity ARN (optional)

Parameters:
  LambdaIdentityPoolName:
    Type: String
    Default: LambdaTestIdentityPool
    Description: Name of the Cognito identity pool used for Lambda-based access testing.
    AllowedPattern: '^[\w\s+=,.@-]{1,128}$'
    ConstraintDescription: Identity pool name must be 1-128 characters (alphanumeric, spaces, and +=,.@-_).
  StepFunctionsIdentityPoolName:
    Type: String
    Default: StepFunctionsTestIdentityPool
    Description: Name of the Cognito identity pool used for Step Functions workflow-based access testing.
    AllowedPattern: '^[\w\s+=,.@-]{1,128}$'
    ConstraintDescription: Identity pool name must be 1-128 characters (alphanumeric, spaces, and +=,.@-_).
  DynamoDBTableArn:
    Type: String
    Default: ""
    Description: >-
      Optional ARN of a specific DynamoDB table that the Lambda-facing role may
      access, for example arn:aws:dynamodb:us-east-1:123456789012:table/MyTable.
      Leave empty to allow access to all tables in this account and Region.
  SesIdentityArn:
    Type: String
    Default: ""
    Description: >-
      Optional ARN of a specific SES identity that the Lambda-facing role may
      send email from, for example arn:aws:ses:us-east-1:123456789012:identity/example.com.
      Leave empty to allow sending from all identities in this account and Region.

Conditions:
  ScopeDynamoDBTable: !Not [!Equals [!Ref DynamoDBTableArn, ""]]
  ScopeSesIdentity: !Not [!Equals [!Ref SesIdentityArn, ""]]

Resources:
  LambdaIdentityPool:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::IdentityPool
    Properties:
      IdentityPoolName: !Ref LambdaIdentityPoolName
      AllowUnauthenticatedIdentities: true

  StepFunctionsIdentityPool:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::IdentityPool
    Properties:
      IdentityPoolName: !Ref StepFunctionsIdentityPoolName
      AllowUnauthenticatedIdentities: true

  LambdaUnauthenticatedRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      Description: Unauthenticated role for the Lambda test identity pool; also executable by the Lambda service.
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Sid: AllowCognitoUnauthenticatedFederation
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Federated: cognito-identity.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - sts:AssumeRoleWithWebIdentity
              - sts:AssumeRole
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                cognito-identity.amazonaws.com:aud: !Ref LambdaIdentityPool
              ForAnyValue:StringLike:
                cognito-identity.amazonaws.com:amr: unauthenticated
          - Sid: AllowLambdaServiceToAssumeRole
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: LambdaTestAccessPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: "2012-10-17"
            Statement:
              - Sid: InvokeLambdaFunctions
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - lambda:InvokeFunction
                  - lambda:InvokeAsync
                Resource:
                  - !Sub "arn:aws:lambda:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:function:*"
                  - !Sub "arn:aws:lambda:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:function:*:*"
              - Sid: DynamoDBDataAndTableAccess
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - dynamodb:BatchGetItem
                  - dynamodb:BatchWriteItem
                  - dynamodb:ConditionCheckItem
                  - dynamodb:DeleteItem
                  - dynamodb:DescribeTable
                  - dynamodb:GetItem
                  - dynamodb:PutItem
                  - dynamodb:Query
                  - dynamodb:Scan
                  - dynamodb:UpdateItem
                Resource:
                  - !If
                    - ScopeDynamoDBTable
                    - !Ref DynamoDBTableArn
                    - !Sub "arn:aws:dynamodb:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:table/*"
                  - !If
                    - ScopeDynamoDBTable
                    - !Sub "${DynamoDBTableArn}/index/*"
                    - !Sub "arn:aws:dynamodb:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:table/*/index/*"
              - Sid: SesSendEmailAccess
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ses:SendEmail
                  - ses:SendRawEmail
                  - ses:SendTemplatedEmail
                Resource: !If
                  - ScopeSesIdentity
                  - !Ref SesIdentityArn
                  - !Sub "arn:aws:ses:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:identity/*"
              - Sid: LambdaCloudWatchLogGroupAccess
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogGroup
                Resource: !Sub "arn:aws:logs:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:*"
              - Sid: LambdaCloudWatchLogStreamAccess
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                Resource: !Sub "arn:aws:logs:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:log-group:/aws/lambda/*:log-stream:*"
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: lambda-unauthenticated-role
        - Key: Purpose
          Value: LambdaBasedAccessTesting

  StepFunctionsUnauthenticatedRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      Description: Unauthenticated role for the Step Functions test identity pool; also assumable by the Step Functions service.
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Sid: AllowCognitoUnauthenticatedFederation
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Federated: cognito-identity.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - sts:AssumeRoleWithWebIdentity
              - sts:AssumeRole
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                cognito-identity.amazonaws.com:aud: !Ref StepFunctionsIdentityPool
              ForAnyValue:StringLike:
                cognito-identity.amazonaws.com:amr: unauthenticated
          - Sid: AllowStepFunctionsServiceToAssumeRole
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: states.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: StepFunctionsTestAccessPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: "2012-10-17"
            Statement:
              - Sid: InvokeLambdaFunctions
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - lambda:InvokeFunction
                Resource:
                  - !Sub "arn:aws:lambda:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:function:*"
                  - !Sub "arn:aws:lambda:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:function:*:*"
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: stepfunctions-unauthenticated-role
        - Key: Purpose
          Value: StepFunctionsAccessTesting

  LambdaIdentityPoolRoleAttachment:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::IdentityPoolRoleAttachment
    Properties:
      IdentityPoolId: !Ref LambdaIdentityPool
      Roles:
        unauthenticated: !GetAtt LambdaUnauthenticatedRole.Arn

  StepFunctionsIdentityPoolRoleAttachment:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::IdentityPoolRoleAttachment
    Properties:
      IdentityPoolId: !Ref StepFunctionsIdentityPool
      Roles:
        unauthenticated: !GetAtt StepFunctionsUnauthenticatedRole.Arn

Outputs:
  LambdaIdentityPoolId:
    Description: ID of the Cognito identity pool used for Lambda-based access testing.
    Value: !Ref LambdaIdentityPool
  LambdaIdentityPoolArn:
    Description: ARN of the Cognito identity pool used for Lambda-based access testing.
    Value: !Sub "arn:aws:cognito-identity:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:identitypool/${LambdaIdentityPool}"
  LambdaUnauthenticatedRoleArn:
    Description: ARN of the unauthenticated role attached to the Lambda-based access test identity pool.
    Value: !GetAtt LambdaUnauthenticatedRole.Arn
  StepFunctionsIdentityPoolId:
    Description: ID of the Cognito identity pool used for Step Functions workflow-based access testing.
    Value: !Ref StepFunctionsIdentityPool
  StepFunctionsIdentityPoolArn:
    Description: ARN of the Cognito identity pool used for Step Functions workflow-based access testing.
    Value: !Sub "arn:aws:cognito-identity:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:identitypool/${StepFunctionsIdentityPool}"
  StepFunctionsUnauthenticatedRoleArn:
    Description: ARN of the unauthenticated role attached to the Step Functions workflow-based access test identity pool.
    Value: !GetAtt StepFunctionsUnauthenticatedRole.Arn

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >-
  Creates the prerequisite IAM role and the custom AWS Systems Manager Automation
  runbooks used for PCI compliance remediations with AWS Config conformance packs.
  The role is named pciautomationassumerole-<region>, trusts Systems Manager, EC2,
  and Events, and grants only the EC2 actions required by the remediation runbooks.
Resources:
  PCIAutomationAssumeRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub 'pciautomationassumerole-${AWS::Region}'
      Description: Role assumed by Systems Manager Automation, EC2, and Events to execute PCI conformance pack remediation runbooks.
      Path: /
      MaxSessionDuration: 3600
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: PCIConformancePackRemediationTrust
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service:
                - ssm.amazonaws.com
                - ec2.amazonaws.com
                - events.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: PCIConformancePackRemediationPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: PCIRemediationRequiredEc2Actions
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ec2:ReleaseAddress
                  - ec2:DescribeSecurityGroups
                  - ec2:DeleteSecurityGroup
                  - ec2:RevokeSecurityGroupIngress
                  - ec2:RevokeSecurityGroupEgress
                Resource: '*'
  PCIRestrictDefaultSGTrafficDocument:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Document
    Properties:
      Name: PCI-RestrictDefaultSGTraffic
      DocumentType: Automation
      Content:
        schemaVersion: '0.3'
        description: Restricts VPC default security group traffic by revoking all ingress and egress rules from the specified security group.
        assumeRole: '{{ AutomationAssumeRole }}'
        parameters:
          AutomationAssumeRole:
            type: String
            description: (Required) The ARN of the role that allows Automation to perform the actions on your behalf.
            allowedPattern: '^arn:(aws|aws-cn|aws-us-gov):iam::\d{12}:role/[\w+=,.@/-]+$'
          SecurityGroupId:
            type: String
            description: (Required) The ID of the security group for which all ingress and egress rules are revoked.
            allowedPattern: '^sg-[0-9a-f]{8,17}$'
        mainSteps:
          - name: RevokeAllIngressAndEgressRules
            action: aws:executeScript
            timeoutSeconds: 300
            inputs:
              Runtime: python3.11
              Handler: restrict_default_sg_traffic
              InputPayload:
                SecurityGroupId: '{{ SecurityGroupId }}'
              Script: |-
                import boto3


                def restrict_default_sg_traffic(events, context):
                    security_group_id = events['SecurityGroupId']
                    ec2_client = boto3.client('ec2')
                    security_groups = ec2_client.describe_security_groups(
                        GroupIds=[security_group_id]
                    ).get('SecurityGroups', [])
                    if not security_groups:
                        raise RuntimeError(
                            'Security group %s was not found.' % security_group_id
                        )
                    security_group = security_groups[0]
                    ingress_permissions = security_group.get('IpPermissions', [])
                    egress_permissions = security_group.get('IpPermissionsEgress', [])
                    if ingress_permissions:
                        ec2_client.revoke_security_group_ingress(
                            GroupId=security_group_id,
                            IpPermissions=ingress_permissions
                        )
                    if egress_permissions:
                        ec2_client.revoke_security_group_egress(
                            GroupId=security_group_id,
                            IpPermissions=egress_permissions
                        )
                    return {
                        'SecurityGroupId': security_group_id,
                        'RevokedIngressRuleCount': len(ingress_permissions),
                        'RevokedEgressRuleCount': len(egress_permissions)
                    }
            outputs:
              - Name: SecurityGroupId
                Selector: $.SecurityGroupId
                Type: String
              - Name: RevokedIngressRuleCount
                Selector: $.RevokedIngressRuleCount
                Type: Integer
              - Name: RevokedEgressRuleCount
                Selector: $.RevokedEgressRuleCount
                Type: Integer
  PCIDeleteUnusedSGDocument:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Document
    Properties:
      Name: PCI-DeleteUnusedSG
      DocumentType: Automation
      Content:
        schemaVersion: '0.3'
        description: Deletes an unused EC2 security group after verifying it is not the VPC default security group.
        assumeRole: '{{ AutomationAssumeRole }}'
        parameters:
          AutomationAssumeRole:
            type: String
            description: (Required) The ARN of the role that allows Automation to perform the actions on your behalf.
            allowedPattern: '^arn:(aws|aws-cn|aws-us-gov):iam::\d{12}:role/[\w+=,.@/-]+$'
          SecurityGroupId:
            type: String
            description: (Required) The ID of the unused security group to delete.
            allowedPattern: '^sg-[0-9a-f]{8,17}$'
        mainSteps:
          - name: DeleteUnusedSecurityGroup
            action: aws:executeScript
            timeoutSeconds: 300
            inputs:
              Runtime: python3.11
              Handler: delete_unused_security_group
              InputPayload:
                SecurityGroupId: '{{ SecurityGroupId }}'
              Script: |-
                import boto3


                def delete_unused_security_group(events, context):
                    security_group_id = events['SecurityGroupId']
                    ec2_client = boto3.client('ec2')
                    security_groups = ec2_client.describe_security_groups(
                        GroupIds=[security_group_id]
                    ).get('SecurityGroups', [])
                    if not security_groups:
                        raise RuntimeError(
                            'Security group %s was not found.' % security_group_id
                        )
                    if security_groups[0].get('GroupName') == 'default':
                        raise RuntimeError(
                            'Security group %s is the VPC default security group and cannot be deleted.'
                            % security_group_id
                        )
                    ec2_client.delete_security_group(GroupId=security_group_id)
                    return {
                        'SecurityGroupId': security_group_id,
                        'Status': 'Deleted'
                    }
            outputs:
              - Name: SecurityGroupId
                Selector: $.SecurityGroupId
                Type: String
              - Name: Status
                Selector: $.Status
                Type: String
  PCIReleaseElasticIPDocument:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Document
    Properties:
      Name: PCI-ReleaseElasticIP
      DocumentType: Automation
      Content:
        schemaVersion: '0.3'
        description: Releases an unassociated Elastic IP address using its allocation ID.
        assumeRole: '{{ AutomationAssumeRole }}'
        parameters:
          AutomationAssumeRole:
            type: String
            description: (Required) The ARN of the role that allows Automation to perform the actions on your behalf.
            allowedPattern: '^arn:(aws|aws-cn|aws-us-gov):iam::\d{12}:role/[\w+=,.@/-]+$'
          AllocationId:
            type: String
            description: (Required) The allocation ID of the unassociated Elastic IP address to release.
            allowedPattern: '^eipalloc-[0-9a-f]{8,17}$'
        mainSteps:
          - name: ReleaseUnassociatedElasticIpAddress
            action: aws:executeAwsApi
            maxAttempts: 3
            inputs:
              Service: ec2
              Api: ReleaseAddress
              AllocationId: '{{ AllocationId }}'
            outputs:
              - Name: ReleaseStatus
                Selector: $.Return
                Type: Boolean
  PCIUpdateASGHealthCheckDocument:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Document
    Properties:
      Name: PCI-UpdateASGHealthCheck
      DocumentType: Automation
      Content:
        schemaVersion: '0.3'
        description: Updates an Auto Scaling group to use ELB health checks with a health check grace period of 300 seconds.
        assumeRole: '{{ AutomationAssumeRole }}'
        parameters:
          AutomationAssumeRole:
            type: String
            description: (Required) The ARN of the role that allows Automation to perform the actions on your behalf.
            allowedPattern: '^arn:(aws|aws-cn|aws-us-gov):iam::\d{12}:role/[\w+=,.@/-]+$'
          AutoScalingGroupName:
            type: String
            description: (Required) The name of the Auto Scaling group to update with ELB health checks.
        mainSteps:
          - name: UpdateAutoScalingGroupHealthCheck
            action: aws:executeAwsApi
            maxAttempts: 3
            inputs:
              Service: autoscaling
              Api: UpdateAutoScalingGroup
              AutoScalingGroupName: '{{ AutoScalingGroupName }}'
              HealthCheckType: ELB
              HealthCheckGracePeriod: 300
Outputs:
  PCIAutomationAssumeRoleName:
    Description: Name of the prerequisite IAM role for PCI conformance pack remediations.
    Value: !Ref PCIAutomationAssumeRole
  PCIAutomationAssumeRoleArn:
    Description: ARN of the prerequisite IAM role for PCI conformance pack remediations.
    Value: !GetAtt PCIAutomationAssumeRole.Arn
  PCIRestrictDefaultSGTrafficDocumentName:
    Description: Name of the runbook that restricts VPC default security group traffic.
    Value: !Ref PCIRestrictDefaultSGTrafficDocument
  PCIDeleteUnusedSGDocumentName:
    Description: Name of the runbook that deletes unused security groups.
    Value: !Ref PCIDeleteUnusedSGDocument
  PCIReleaseElasticIPDocumentName:
    Description: Name of the runbook that releases unassociated Elastic IP addresses.
    Value: !Ref PCIReleaseElasticIPDocument
  PCIUpdateASGHealthCheckDocumentName:
    Description: Name of the runbook that updates Auto Scaling group ELB health checks.
    Value: !Ref PCIUpdateASGHealthCheckDocument

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >
  Provisions a CodeBuild project that mirrors the existing CodeCommit repositories
  (card-service, rule-service and ecs-pipeline) from the current deployment region
  to a target replica region, together with EventBridge rules that automatically
  start the mirror build whenever a commit is pushed to the mainline branch of any
  source repository.

Parameters:
  TargetRegion:
    Type: String
    Default: us-east-1
    Description: The target region where the CodeCommit regional replicas exist.
    AllowedPattern: '^[a-z]{2}(-gov)?-[a-z]+-\d$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must be a valid AWS region name (for example, us-east-1).
  CodeBuildComputeType:
    Type: String
    Default: BUILD_GENERAL1_SMALL
    AllowedValues:
      - BUILD_GENERAL1_SMALL
      - BUILD_GENERAL1_MEDIUM
      - BUILD_GENERAL1_LARGE
    Description: The compute type used by the mirror CodeBuild project.

Metadata:
  AWS::CloudFormation::Interface:
    ParameterGroups:
      - Label:
          default: Replication Configuration
        Parameters:
          - TargetRegion
          - CodeBuildComputeType
    ParameterLabels:
      TargetRegion:
        default: Target replica region
      CodeBuildComputeType:
        default: CodeBuild compute type

Resources:
  MirrorArtifactBucket:
    Type: AWS::S3::Bucket
    Properties:
      BucketEncryption:
        ServerSideEncryptionConfiguration:
          - ServerSideEncryptionByDefault:
              SSEAlgorithm: AES256
      OwnershipControls:
        Rules:
          - ObjectOwnership: BucketOwnerEnforced
      PublicAccessBlockConfiguration:
        BlockPublicAcls: true
        BlockPublicPolicy: true
        IgnorePublicAcls: true
        RestrictPublicBuckets: true
      VersioningConfiguration:
        Status: Enabled
      Tags:
        - Key: Purpose
          Value: CodeCommitRegionalMirrorArtifacts

  MirrorArtifactBucketPolicy:
    Type: AWS::S3::BucketPolicy
    Properties:
      Bucket: !Ref MirrorArtifactBucket
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: DenyInsecureTransport
            Effect: Deny
            Principal: '*'
            Action: 's3:*'
            Resource:
              - !GetAtt MirrorArtifactBucket.Arn
              - !Sub '${MirrorArtifactBucket.Arn}/*'
            Condition:
              Bool:
                aws:SecureTransport: 'false'

  MirrorBuildLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Sub '/aws/codebuild/${AWS::StackName}-mirror-build'
      RetentionInDays: 30
      Tags:
        - Key: Purpose
          Value: CodeCommitRegionalMirrorBuildLogs

  CodeBuildMirrorServiceRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      Description: Service role used by the CodeCommit regional mirror CodeBuild project.
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: codebuild.amazonaws.com
            Action: 'sts:AssumeRole'
      Path: /
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: CodeCommitMirrorBuildAccess
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: CloudWatchLogsAccess
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - 'logs:CreateLogGroup'
                  - 'logs:CreateLogStream'
                  - 'logs:PutLogEvents'
                  - 'logs:DescribeLogStreams'
                Resource:
                  - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:logs:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:log-group:/aws/codebuild/*'
                  - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:logs:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:log-group:/aws/codebuild/*:*'
              - Sid: MirrorArtifactBucketAccess
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - 's3:GetObject'
                  - 's3:PutObject'
                  - 's3:AbortMultipartUpload'
                  - 's3:GetBucketLocation'
                  - 's3:ListBucket'
                Resource:
                  - !GetAtt MirrorArtifactBucket.Arn
                  - !Sub '${MirrorArtifactBucket.Arn}/*'
              - Sid: SourceRepositoriesGitPull
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - 'codecommit:GitPull'
                Resource:
                  - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:codecommit:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:card-service'
                  - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:codecommit:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:rule-service'
                  - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:codecommit:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:ecs-pipeline'
              - Sid: ReplicaRepositoriesGitPush
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - 'codecommit:GitPush'
                Resource:
                  - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:codecommit:${TargetRegion}:${AWS::AccountId}:card-service'
                  - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:codecommit:${TargetRegion}:${AWS::AccountId}:rule-service'
                  - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:codecommit:${TargetRegion}:${AWS::AccountId}:ecs-pipeline'
      Tags:
        - Key: Purpose
          Value: CodeCommitRegionalMirror

  EventBridgeInvokeCodeBuildRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      Description: Allows EventBridge rules to start the CodeCommit regional mirror build.
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: events.amazonaws.com
            Action: 'sts:AssumeRole'
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                'aws:SourceAccount': !Sub '${AWS::AccountId}'
              ArnLike:
                'aws:SourceArn': !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:events:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:rule/${AWS::StackName}*'
      Path: /
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: StartMirrorBuildAccess
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: AllowStartMirrorBuild
                Effect: Allow
                Action: 'codebuild:StartBuild'
                Resource: !GetAtt MirrorBuildProject.Arn
      Tags:
        - Key: Purpose
          Value: CodeCommitRegionalMirror

  MirrorBuildProject:
    Type: AWS::CodeBuild::Project
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-mirror-build'
      Description: Mirrors the card-service, rule-service and ecs-pipeline CodeCommit repositories to the target replica region.
      ServiceRole: !GetAtt CodeBuildMirrorServiceRole.Arn
      TimeoutInMinutes: 30
      QueuedTimeoutInMinutes: 60
      Source:
        Type: NO_SOURCE
        BuildSpec: |
          version: 0.2
          phases:
            install:
              runtime-versions:
                python: 3.11
              commands:
                - pip3 install --upgrade pip
                - pip3 install git-remote-codecommit
            build:
              commands:
                - |
                  set -e
                  echo "Mirroring repositories from ${AWS_DEFAULT_REGION} to ${TARGET_REGION}"
                  mkdir -p "${CODEBUILD_SRC_DIR}/mirror-logs"
                  for REPO in ${MIRROR_REPOS}; do
                    echo "=== Mirroring ${REPO} from ${AWS_DEFAULT_REGION} to ${TARGET_REGION} ==="
                    rm -rf "${REPO}.git"
                    git clone --mirror "codecommit::${AWS_DEFAULT_REGION}://${REPO}"
                    cd "${REPO}.git"
                    git push --mirror "codecommit::${TARGET_REGION}://${REPO}"
                    cd "${CODEBUILD_SRC_DIR}"
                  done
                  echo "Mirror sync completed $(date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ)" > "${CODEBUILD_SRC_DIR}/mirror-logs/mirror-status.txt"
                  echo "All repositories mirrored successfully."
          artifacts:
            files:
              - 'mirror-logs/*'
            discard-paths: no
      Artifacts:
        Type: S3
        Location: !Ref MirrorArtifactBucket
        Name: mirror-artifacts
        NamespaceType: BUILD_ID
        Packaging: NONE
        EncryptionDisabled: false
      Environment:
        Type: LINUX_CONTAINER
        ComputeType: !Ref CodeBuildComputeType
        Image: 'aws/codebuild/standard:7.0'
        ImagePullCredentialsType: CODEBUILD
        EnvironmentVariables:
          - Name: TARGET_REGION
            Value: !Ref TargetRegion
          - Name: MIRROR_REPOS
            Value: 'card-service rule-service ecs-pipeline'
      LogsConfig:
        CloudWatchLogs:
          Status: ENABLED
          GroupName: !Ref MirrorBuildLogGroup
        S3Logs:
          Status: DISABLED
      Tags:
        - Key: Purpose
          Value: CodeCommitRegionalMirror

  CardServiceMainlinePushRule:
    Type: AWS::Events::Rule
    Properties:
      Description: Starts the mirror build when a commit is pushed to the mainline branch of card-service.
      State: ENABLED
      EventPattern:
        source:
          - aws.codecommit
        detail-type:
          - CodeCommit Repository State Change
        resources:
          - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:codecommit:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:card-service'
        detail:
          event:
            - referenceCreated
            - referenceUpdated
          referenceType:
            - branch
          referenceName:
            - mainline
      Targets:
        - Arn: !GetAtt MirrorBuildProject.Arn
          Id: CardServiceMirrorBuildTarget
          RoleArn: !GetAtt EventBridgeInvokeCodeBuildRole.Arn

  RuleServiceMainlinePushRule:
    Type: AWS::Events::Rule
    Properties:
      Description: Starts the mirror build when a commit is pushed to the mainline branch of rule-service.
      State: ENABLED
      EventPattern:
        source:
          - aws.codecommit
        detail-type:
          - CodeCommit Repository State Change
        resources:
          - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:codecommit:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:rule-service'
        detail:
          event:
            - referenceCreated
            - referenceUpdated
          referenceType:
            - branch
          referenceName:
            - mainline
      Targets:
        - Arn: !GetAtt MirrorBuildProject.Arn
          Id: RuleServiceMirrorBuildTarget
          RoleArn: !GetAtt EventBridgeInvokeCodeBuildRole.Arn

  EcsPipelineMainlinePushRule:
    Type: AWS::Events::Rule
    Properties:
      Description: Starts the mirror build when a commit is pushed to the mainline branch of ecs-pipeline.
      State: ENABLED
      EventPattern:
        source:
          - aws.codecommit
        detail-type:
          - CodeCommit Repository State Change
        resources:
          - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:codecommit:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:ecs-pipeline'
        detail:
          event:
            - referenceCreated
            - referenceUpdated
          referenceType:
            - branch
          referenceName:
            - mainline
      Targets:
        - Arn: !GetAtt MirrorBuildProject.Arn
          Id: EcsPipelineMirrorBuildTarget
          RoleArn: !GetAtt EventBridgeInvokeCodeBuildRole.Arn

Outputs:
  MirrorBuildProjectName:
    Description: Name of the CodeCommit regional mirror CodeBuild project.
    Value: !Ref MirrorBuildProject
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-MirrorBuildProjectName'
  MirrorBuildProjectArn:
    Description: ARN of the CodeCommit regional mirror CodeBuild project.
    Value: !GetAtt MirrorBuildProject.Arn
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-MirrorBuildProjectArn'
  MirrorArtifactBucketName:
    Description: Name of the S3 bucket used for mirror build artifacts (SSE-S3 with the default aws/s3 key alias).
    Value: !Ref MirrorArtifactBucket
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-MirrorArtifactBucketName'
  TargetReplicaRegion:
    Description: Region hosting the CodeCommit regional replicas.
    Value: !Ref TargetRegion
  CardServiceMainlinePushRuleArn:
    Description: EventBridge rule ARN watching card-service mainline pushes.
    Value: !GetAtt CardServiceMainlinePushRule.Arn
  RuleServiceMainlinePushRuleArn:
    Description: EventBridge rule ARN watching rule-service mainline pushes.
    Value: !GetAtt RuleServiceMainlinePushRule.Arn
  EcsPipelineMainlinePushRuleArn:
    Description: EventBridge rule ARN watching ecs-pipeline mainline pushes.
    Value: !GetAtt EcsPipelineMainlinePushRule.Arn
  CodeBuildMirrorServiceRoleArn:
    Description: IAM role assumed by the mirror CodeBuild project.
    Value: !GetAtt CodeBuildMirrorServiceRole.Arn
  EventBridgeInvokeCodeBuildRoleArn:
    Description: IAM role assumed by EventBridge to start the mirror build.
    Value: !GetAtt EventBridgeInvokeCodeBuildRole.Arn

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'

Description: >-
  Creates a secure S3 testing infrastructure: a primary bucket with AES256
  server-side encryption, versioning, blocked public access, a TLS-only bucket
  policy, server access logging, and same-region replication, plus a dedicated
  access log bucket, a same-region replica bucket, log delivery bucket policies
  on all three buckets, and an IAM role with S3 replication permissions.

Metadata:
  AWS::CloudFormation::Interface:
    ParameterGroups:
      - Label:
          default: Application Configuration
        Parameters:
          - AppName

Parameters:
  AppName:
    Type: String
    Default: testanu
    Description: Application name used to construct the S3 bucket names.
    AllowedPattern: '^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9-]{1,28}[a-z0-9]$'
    ConstraintDescription: >-
      Application name must be 3-30 characters and contain only lowercase
      letters, numbers, and hyphens (no leading or trailing hyphen).

Resources:
  AccessLogBucket:
    Type: AWS::S3::Bucket
    Properties:
      BucketName: !Sub '${AppName}-accesslogs-${AWS::AccountId}'
      BucketEncryption:
        ServerSideEncryptionConfiguration:
          - ServerSideEncryptionByDefault:
              SSEAlgorithm: AES256
      PublicAccessBlockConfiguration:
        BlockPublicAcls: true
        BlockPublicPolicy: true
        IgnorePublicAcls: true
        RestrictPublicBuckets: true
      VersioningConfiguration:
        Status: Enabled

  AccessLogBucketPolicy:
    Type: AWS::S3::BucketPolicy
    Properties:
      Bucket: !Ref AccessLogBucket
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: DenyInsecureTransport
            Effect: Deny
            Principal: '*'
            Action: 's3:*'
            Resource:
              - !GetAtt AccessLogBucket.Arn
              - !Sub '${AccessLogBucket.Arn}/*'
            Condition:
              Bool:
                aws:SecureTransport: 'false'
          - Sid: AllowS3LogDeliveryFromPrimaryBucket
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: logging.s3.amazonaws.com
            Action: 's3:PutObject'
            Resource: !Sub '${AccessLogBucket.Arn}/primary-logs/*'
            Condition:
              ArnLike:
                aws:SourceArn: !Sub 'arn:aws:s3:::${AppName}-primary-${AWS::AccountId}'
              StringEquals:
                aws:SourceAccount: !Ref AWS::AccountId
          - Sid: AllowS3LogDeliveryFromReplicaBucket
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: logging.s3.amazonaws.com
            Action: 's3:PutObject'
            Resource: !Sub '${AccessLogBucket.Arn}/replica-logs/*'
            Condition:
              ArnLike:
                aws:SourceArn: !Sub 'arn:aws:s3:::${AppName}-replica-${AWS::AccountId}'
              StringEquals:
                aws:SourceAccount: !Ref AWS::AccountId

  ReplicationRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: s3.amazonaws.com
            Action: 'sts:AssumeRole'
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: S3ReplicationPermissions
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: SourceBucketReplicationConfigurationPermissions
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - 's3:GetReplicationConfiguration'
                  - 's3:ListBucket'
                Resource:
                  - !Sub 'arn:aws:s3:::${AppName}-primary-${AWS::AccountId}'
              - Sid: SourceObjectReplicationReadPermissions
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - 's3:GetObjectVersionForReplication'
                  - 's3:GetObjectVersionAcl'
                  - 's3:GetObjectVersionTagging'
                Resource:
                  - !Sub 'arn:aws:s3:::${AppName}-primary-${AWS::AccountId}/*'
              - Sid: DestinationObjectReplicationWritePermissions
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - 's3:ReplicateObject'
                  - 's3:ReplicateDelete'
                  - 's3:ReplicateTags'
                Resource:
                  - !Sub 'arn:aws:s3:::${AppName}-replica-${AWS::AccountId}/*'

  ReplicaBucket:
    Type: AWS::S3::Bucket
    DependsOn: AccessLogBucketPolicy
    Properties:
      BucketName: !Sub '${AppName}-replica-${AWS::AccountId}'
      BucketEncryption:
        ServerSideEncryptionConfiguration:
          - ServerSideEncryptionByDefault:
              SSEAlgorithm: AES256
      PublicAccessBlockConfiguration:
        BlockPublicAcls: true
        BlockPublicPolicy: true
        IgnorePublicAcls: true
        RestrictPublicBuckets: true
      VersioningConfiguration:
        Status: Enabled
      LoggingConfiguration:
        DestinationBucketName: !Ref AccessLogBucket
        LogFilePrefix: replica-logs/

  ReplicaBucketPolicy:
    Type: AWS::S3::BucketPolicy
    Properties:
      Bucket: !Ref ReplicaBucket
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: DenyInsecureTransport
            Effect: Deny
            Principal: '*'
            Action: 's3:*'
            Resource:
              - !GetAtt ReplicaBucket.Arn
              - !Sub '${ReplicaBucket.Arn}/*'
            Condition:
              Bool:
                aws:SecureTransport: 'false'
          - Sid: AllowS3LogDelivery
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: logging.s3.amazonaws.com
            Action: 's3:PutObject'
            Resource: !Sub '${ReplicaBucket.Arn}/access-logs/*'
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                aws:SourceAccount: !Ref AWS::AccountId

  PrimaryBucket:
    Type: AWS::S3::Bucket
    DependsOn: AccessLogBucketPolicy
    Properties:
      BucketName: !Sub '${AppName}-primary-${AWS::AccountId}'
      BucketEncryption:
        ServerSideEncryptionConfiguration:
          - ServerSideEncryptionByDefault:

  FeedsCertificateFunctionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
