AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'

Description: >-
  Self-contained SLO monitoring for an FSx for ONTAP event-driven pipeline (S3AP pattern).
  Creates four CloudWatch SLO alarms (EventIngestionLatency P99, ProcessingSuccessRate average,
  FPolicyReconnectTime maximum, ReplayCompletionTime maximum), a fallback SNS notification topic,
  and a CloudWatch dashboard with annotated SLO time-series widgets, synthetic canary widgets for
  S3AP list/get latency and ONTAP health check, and an SLO alarm status widget. The dashboard and
  alarm set are created only when EnableDashboardAndAlarms is set to true.

Metadata:
  AWS::CloudFormation::Interface:
    ParameterGroups:
      - Label:
          default: Monitoring Enablement
        Parameters:
          - EnableDashboardAndAlarms
          - Region
      - Label:
          default: Naming and Metric Sources
        Parameters:
          - ProjectPrefix
          - MetricNamespace
          - CanaryMetricNamespace
      - Label:
          default: SLO Thresholds
        Parameters:
          - EventIngestionLatencyThreshold
          - ProcessingSuccessRateThreshold
          - FPolicyReconnectTimeThreshold
          - ReplayCompletionTimeThreshold
      - Label:
          default: Alarm Evaluation and Notification
        Parameters:
          - MetricPeriod
          - EvaluationPeriods
          - AlarmNotificationTopicArn
    ParameterLabels:
      EnableDashboardAndAlarms:
        default: Enable dashboard and alarms (true/false)
      Region:
        default: AWS region (must match deployment region)
      ProjectPrefix:
        default: Project prefix
      MetricNamespace:
        default: Pipeline metric namespace
      CanaryMetricNamespace:
        default: Canary metric namespace
      EventIngestionLatencyThreshold:
        default: Event ingestion latency P99 threshold (seconds)
      ProcessingSuccessRateThreshold:
        default: Processing success rate threshold (percent)
      FPolicyReconnectTimeThreshold:
        default: FPolicy reconnect time threshold (seconds)
      ReplayCompletionTimeThreshold:
        default: Replay completion time threshold (seconds)
      MetricPeriod:
        default: Metric evaluation period (seconds)
      EvaluationPeriods:
        default: Consecutive evaluation periods
      AlarmNotificationTopicArn:
        default: Existing SNS topic ARN (optional)

Parameters:
  EnableDashboardAndAlarms:
    Type: String
    Description: Set to true to create the SLO dashboard, the four SLO alarms and the notification topic. Defaults to false.
    Default: 'false'
    AllowedValues:
      - 'true'
      - 'false'
  Region:
    Type: String
    Description: AWS region used in the dashboard widget configuration. Must match the region the stack is deployed to. Defaults to us-east-1.
    Default: us-east-1
    AllowedPattern: '^[a-z]{2}(-gov)?-[a-z]+-[0-9]+$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must be a valid AWS region code, for example us-east-1.
  ProjectPrefix:
    Type: String
    Description: Prefix applied to the dashboard, alarm and topic names.
    Default: fsxn-s3ap
    AllowedPattern: '^[a-zA-Z0-9_-]+$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must contain only alphanumerics, hyphens and underscores.
    MinLength: 1
    MaxLength: 40
  MetricNamespace:
    Type: String
    Description: CloudWatch metric namespace that the event-driven pipeline publishes the four SLO metrics to.
    Default: FSxN-S3AP-Patterns
    AllowedPattern: '^[a-zA-Z0-9._/-]+$'
    MinLength: 1
    MaxLength: 255
  CanaryMetricNamespace:
    Type: String
    Description: Separate CloudWatch metric namespace published by the synthetic canaries (S3AP list/get latencies and ONTAP health check).
    Default: FSxN-S3AP-Patterns/Canary
    AllowedPattern: '^[a-zA-Z0-9._/-]+$'
    MinLength: 1
    MaxLength: 255
  EventIngestionLatencyThreshold:
    Type: Number
    Description: SLO threshold in seconds for the P99 EventIngestionLatency metric. The alarm breaches when P99 exceeds this value.
    Default: 5
    MinValue: 0
  ProcessingSuccessRateThreshold:
    Type: Number
    Description: SLO threshold in percent for the average ProcessingSuccessRate metric. The alarm breaches when the average falls below this value.
    Default: 99.5
    MinValue: 0
    MaxValue: 100
  FPolicyReconnectTimeThreshold:
    Type: Number
    Description: SLO threshold in seconds for the maximum FPolicyReconnectTime metric. The alarm breaches when the maximum exceeds this value.
    Default: 30
    MinValue: 0
  ReplayCompletionTimeThreshold:
    Type: Number
    Description: SLO threshold in seconds for the maximum ReplayCompletionTime metric. Five minutes equals 300 seconds.
    Default: 300
    MinValue: 0
  MetricPeriod:
    Type: Number
    Description: Period in seconds over which each SLO metric is evaluated (5 minutes = 300 seconds).
    Default: '300'
    AllowedValues:
      - '10'
      - '30'
      - '60'
      - '300'
      - '600'
      - '900'
      - '1800'
      - '3600'
  EvaluationPeriods:
    Type: Number
    Description: Number of consecutive periods the threshold must be breached before the alarm transitions to ALARM (3 x 5 minutes by default).
    Default: 3
    MinValue: 1
    MaxValue: 24
  AlarmNotificationTopicArn:
    Type: String
    Description: Optional ARN of an existing SNS topic that the four SLO alarms forward notifications to. Leave empty to use the topic created by this stack.
    Default: ''
    AllowedPattern: '(^$|^arn:aws[a-zA-Z-]*:sns:[a-z0-9-]+:[0-9]{12}:.+$)'
    ConstraintDescription: Must be empty or a valid SNS topic ARN.

Conditions:
  EnableMonitoring: !Equals [!Ref EnableDashboardAndAlarms, 'true']
  UseProvidedAlarmTopic: !Not [!Equals [!Ref AlarmNotificationTopicArn, '']]
  CreateDefaultAlarmTopic: !And [!Condition EnableMonitoring, !Not [!Condition UseProvidedAlarmTopic]]

Resources:
  SLOAlarmTopic:
    Type: AWS::SNS::Topic
    Condition: CreateDefaultAlarmTopic
    Properties:
      TopicName: !Sub '${ProjectPrefix}-slo-alarm-notifications'
      DisplayName: !Sub '${ProjectPrefix}-SLO-Alarms'

  EventIngestionLatencyAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Condition: EnableMonitoring
    Properties:
      AlarmName: !Sub '${ProjectPrefix}-event-ingestion-latency-slo'
      AlarmDescription: !Sub 'SLO breach - P99 EventIngestionLatency greater than ${EventIngestionLatencyThreshold} seconds for ${EvaluationPeriods} consecutive ${MetricPeriod} second periods.'
      Namespace: !Ref MetricNamespace
      MetricName: EventIngestionLatency
      ExtendedStatistic: p99
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanThreshold
      Threshold: !Ref EventIngestionLatencyThreshold
      Period: !Ref MetricPeriod
      EvaluationPeriods: !Ref EvaluationPeriods
      TreatMissingData: notBreaching
      AlarmActions: !If [UseProvidedAlarmTopic, [!Ref AlarmNotificationTopicArn], [!Ref SLOAlarmTopic]]
      OKActions: !If [UseProvidedAlarmTopic, [!Ref AlarmNotificationTopicArn], [!Ref SLOAlarmTopic]]

  ProcessingSuccessRateAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Condition: EnableMonitoring
    Properties:
      AlarmName: !Sub '${ProjectPrefix}-processing-success-rate-slo'
      AlarmDescription: !Sub 'SLO breach - average ProcessingSuccessRate below ${ProcessingSuccessRateThreshold} percent for ${EvaluationPeriods} consecutive ${MetricPeriod} second periods.'
      Namespace: !Ref MetricNamespace
      MetricName: ProcessingSuccessRate
      Statistic: Average
      ComparisonOperator: LessThanThreshold
      Threshold: !Ref ProcessingSuccessRateThreshold
      Period: !Ref MetricPeriod
      EvaluationPeriods: !Ref EvaluationPeriods
      TreatMissingData: notBreaching
      AlarmActions: !If [UseProvidedAlarmTopic, [!Ref AlarmNotificationTopicArn], [!Ref SLOAlarmTopic]]
      OKActions: !If [UseProvidedAlarmTopic, [!Ref AlarmNotificationTopicArn], [!Ref SLOAlarmTopic]]

  FPolicyReconnectTimeAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Condition: EnableMonitoring
    Properties:
      AlarmName: !Sub '${ProjectPrefix}-fpolicy-reconnect-time-slo'
      AlarmDescription: !Sub 'SLO breach - maximum FPolicyReconnectTime greater than ${FPolicyReconnectTimeThreshold} seconds for ${EvaluationPeriods} consecutive ${MetricPeriod} second periods.'
      Namespace: !Ref MetricNamespace
      MetricName: FPolicyReconnectTime
      Statistic: Maximum
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanThreshold
      Threshold: !Ref FPolicyReconnectTimeThreshold
      Period: !Ref MetricPeriod
      EvaluationPeriods: !Ref EvaluationPeriods
      TreatMissingData: notBreaching
      AlarmActions: !If [UseProvidedAlarmTopic, [!Ref AlarmNotificationTopicArn], [!Ref SLOAlarmTopic]]
      OKActions: !If [UseProvidedAlarmTopic, [!Ref AlarmNotificationTopicArn], [!Ref SLOAlarmTopic]]

  ReplayCompletionTimeAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Condition: EnableMonitoring
    Properties:
      AlarmName: !Sub '${ProjectPrefix}-replay-completion-time-slo'
      AlarmDescription: !Sub 'SLO breach - maximum ReplayCompletionTime greater than ${ReplayCompletionTimeThreshold} seconds (five minutes) for ${EvaluationPeriods} consecutive ${MetricPeriod} second periods.'
      Namespace: !Ref MetricNamespace
      MetricName: ReplayCompletionTime
      Statistic: Maximum
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanThreshold
      Threshold: !Ref ReplayCompletionTimeThreshold
      Period: !Ref MetricPeriod
      EvaluationPeriods: !Ref EvaluationPeriods
      TreatMissingData: notBreaching
      AlarmActions: !If [UseProvidedAlarmTopic, [!Ref AlarmNotificationTopicArn], [!Ref SLOAlarmTopic]]
      OKActions: !If [UseProvidedAlarmTopic, [!Ref AlarmNotificationTopicArn], [!Ref SLOAlarmTopic]]

  SLODashboard:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Dashboard
    Condition: EnableMonitoring
    Properties:
      DashboardName: !Sub '${ProjectPrefix}-slo-dashboard'
      DashboardBody: !Sub |
        {
          "widgets": [
            {
              "type": "metric",
              "x": 0,
              "y": 0,
              "width": 6,
              "height": 6,
              "properties": {
                "view": "timeSeries",
                "stacked": false,
                "region": "${Region}",
                "namespace": "${MetricNamespace}",
                "metrics": [
                  ["${MetricNamespace}", "EventIngestionLatency"]
                ],
                "stat": "p99",
                "period": ${MetricPeriod},
                "title": "SLO - Event Ingestion Latency (P99)",
                "yAxis": {
                  "left": {
                    "min": 0
                  }
                },
                "annotations": {
                  "horizontal": [
                    {
                      "label": "SLO threshold: ${EventIngestionLatencyThreshold} seconds",
                      "value": ${EventIngestionLatencyThreshold}
                    }
                  ]
                }
              }
            },
            {
              "type": "metric",
              "x": 6,
              "y": 0,
              "width": 6,
              "height": 6,
              "properties": {
                "view": "timeSeries",
                "stacked": false,
                "region": "${Region}",
                "namespace": "${MetricNamespace}",
                "metrics": [
                  ["${MetricNamespace}", "ProcessingSuccessRate"]
                ],
                "stat": "Average",
                "period": ${MetricPeriod},
                "title": "SLO - Processing Success Rate (Average)",
                "yAxis": {
                  "left": {
                    "min": 0,
                    "max": 100
                  }
                },
                "annotations": {
                  "horizontal": [
                    {
                      "label": "SLO threshold: ${ProcessingSuccessRateThreshold} percent",
                      "value": ${ProcessingSuccessRateThreshold}
                    }
                  ]
                }
              }
            },
            {
              "type": "metric",
              "x": 12,
              "y": 0,
              "width": 6,
              "height": 6,
              "properties": {
                "view": "timeSeries",
                "stacked": false,
                "region": "${Region}",
                "namespace": "${MetricNamespace}",
                "metrics": [
                  ["${MetricNamespace}", "FPolicyReconnectTime"]
                ],
                "stat": "Maximum",
                "period": ${MetricPeriod},
                "title": "SLO - FPolicy Reconnect Time (Maximum)",
                "yAxis": {
                  "left": {
                    "min": 0
                  }
                },
                "annotations": {
                  "horizontal": [
                    {
                      "label": "SLO threshold: ${FPolicyReconnectTimeThreshold} seconds",
                      "value": ${FPolicyReconnectTimeThreshold}
                    }
                  ]
                }
              }
            },
            {
              "type": "metric",
              "x": 18,
              "y": 0,
              "width": 6,
              "height": 6,
              "properties": {
                "view": "timeSeries",
                "stacked": false,
                "region": "${Region}",
                "namespace": "${MetricNamespace}",
                "metrics": [
                  ["${MetricNamespace}", "ReplayCompletionTime"]
                ],
                "stat": "Maximum",
                "period": ${MetricPeriod},
                "title": "SLO - Replay Completion Time (Maximum)",
                "yAxis": {
                  "left": {
                    "min": 0
                  }
                },
                "annotations": {
                  "horizontal": [
                    {
                      "label": "SLO threshold: ${ReplayCompletionTimeThreshold} seconds (5 minutes)",
                      "value": ${ReplayCompletionTimeThreshold}
                    }
                  ]
                }
              }
            },
            {
              "type": "metric",
              "x": 0,
              "y": 6,
              "width": 8,
              "height": 6,
              "properties": {
                "view": "timeSeries",
                "stacked": false,
                "region": "${Region}",
                "namespace": "${CanaryMetricNamespace}",
                "metrics": [
                  ["${CanaryMetricNamespace}", "S3APListLatency"]
                ],
                "stat": "Average",
                "period": ${MetricPeriod},
                "title": "Canary - S3AP List Latency",
                "yAxis": {
                  "left": {
                    "min": 0
                  }
                }
              }
            },
            {
              "type": "metric",
              "x": 8,
              "y": 6,
              "width": 8,
              "height": 6,
              "properties": {
                "view": "timeSeries",
                "stacked": false,
                "region": "${Region}",
                "namespace": "${CanaryMetricNamespace}",
                "metrics": [
                  ["${CanaryMetricNamespace}", "S3APGetLatency"]
                ],
                "stat": "Average",
                "period": ${MetricPeriod},
                "title": "Canary - S3AP Get Latency",
                "yAxis": {
                  "left": {
                    "min": 0
                  }
                }
              }
            },
            {
              "type": "metric",
              "x": 16,
              "y": 6,
              "width": 8,
              "height": 6,
              "properties": {
                "view": "timeSeries",
                "stacked": false,
                "region": "${Region}",
                "namespace": "${CanaryMetricNamespace}",
                "metrics": [
                  ["${CanaryMetricNamespace}", "S3APOntapHealthCheck"]
                ],
                "stat": "Average",
                "period": ${MetricPeriod},
                "title": "Canary - ONTAP Health Check",
                "yAxis": {
                  "left": {
                    "min": 0
                  }
                }
              }
            },
            {
              "type": "metric",
              "x": 0,
              "y": 12,
              "width": 24,
              "height": 6,
              "properties": {
                "title": "SLO Alarm Status",
                "region": "${Region}",
                "alarms": [
                  "${EventIngestionLatencyAlarm.Arn}",
                  "${ProcessingSuccessRateAlarm.Arn}",
                  "${FPolicyReconnectTimeAlarm.Arn}",
                  "${ReplayCompletionTimeAlarm.Arn}"
                ]
              }
            }
          ]
        }

Outputs:
  DashboardName:
    Description: Name of the CloudWatch dashboard containing the SLO widgets.
    Value: !Sub '${ProjectPrefix}-slo-dashboard'
  DashboardURL:
    Condition: EnableMonitoring
    Description: Direct link to the SLO dashboard in the CloudWatch console.
    Value: !Sub 'https://${Region}.console.aws.amazon.com/cloudwatch/home?region=${Region}#dashboards:name=${ProjectPrefix}-slo-dashboard'
  AlarmNotificationTargetArn:
    Condition: EnableMonitoring
    Description: SNS topic ARN receiving SLO alarm notifications (the provided topic ARN when given, otherwise the topic created by this stack).
    Value: !If [UseProvidedAlarmTopic, !Ref AlarmNotificationTopicArn, !Ref SLOAlarmTopic]
  SLOAlarmNames:
    Condition: EnableMonitoring
    Description: Names of the four SLO CloudWatch alarms.
    Value: !Join
      - ', '
      - - !Sub '${ProjectPrefix}-event-ingestion-latency-slo'
        - !Sub '${ProjectPrefix}-processing-success-rate-slo'
        - !Sub '${ProjectPrefix}-fpolicy-reconnect-time-slo'

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: "2010-09-09"
Description: >
  Amazon Cognito user pool for testing JWT authentication flows with an Amazon
  Bedrock AgentCore Gateway and MCP server. Provides self-service signup with
  email verification, a hosted UI domain, an "api" resource server with "mcp"
  and "gateway" custom scopes, one public web client (authorization code with
  PKCE plus USER_PASSWORD_AUTH and USER_SRP_AUTH) and two confidential
  machine-to-machine clients using the client credentials grant.

Metadata:
  AWS::CloudFormation::Interface:
    ParameterGroups:
      - Label:
          default: Hosted UI domain
        Parameters:
          - CognitoDomainPrefix
      - Label:
          default: Web client redirect URLs
        Parameters:
          - CallbackURLs
          - LogoutURLs
    ParameterLabels:
      CognitoDomainPrefix:
        default: Hosted UI domain prefix
      CallbackURLs:
        default: Callback URLs (comma-delimited)
      LogoutURLs:
        default: Logout URLs (comma-delimited)

Parameters:
  CognitoDomainPrefix:
    Type: String
    Default: agentcore-jwt-test
    Description: >-
      Globally unique prefix for the Cognito hosted UI domain. The AWS account
      ID is appended automatically for uniqueness. Lowercase letters, numbers
      and hyphens only. Change this value if the resulting domain is taken.
    AllowedPattern: '^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9-]*[a-z0-9]$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must contain only lowercase letters, numbers and hyphens, and must start and end with a letter or number.
    MinLength: 2
    MaxLength: 50
  CallbackURLs:
    Type: CommaDelimitedList
    Default: http://localhost:3000
    Description: >-
      Comma-delimited list of allowed callback URLs for the web client.
      Do not add spaces after commas. Example: http://localhost:3000,http://localhost:8080
  LogoutURLs:
    Type: CommaDelimitedList
    Default: http://localhost:3000
    Description: >-
      Comma-delimited list of allowed logout URLs for the web client.
      Do not add spaces after commas. Example: http://localhost:3000,http://localhost:8080

Resources:
  CognitoUserPool:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPool
    Properties:
      UserPoolName: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-user-pool"
      UsernameAttributes:
        - email
      UsernameConfiguration:
        CaseSensitive: false
      AutoVerifiedAttributes:
        - email
      MfaConfiguration: "OFF"
      AdminCreateUserConfig:
        AllowAdminCreateUserOnly: false
      Policies:
        PasswordPolicy:
          MinimumLength: 8
          RequireLowercase: true
          RequireNumbers: true
          RequireSymbols: false
          RequireUppercase: true
      AccountRecoverySetting:
        RecoveryMechanisms:
          - Name: verified_email
            Priority: 1
      EmailVerificationSubject: Your AgentCore JWT testing verification code
      EmailVerificationMessage: >-
        Welcome! Your AgentCore JWT testing verification code is {####}

  UserPoolResourceServer:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolResourceServer
    Properties:
      UserPoolId: !Ref CognitoUserPool
      Identifier: api
      Name: AgentCore API
      Scopes:
        - ScopeName: mcp
          ScopeDescription: Scope for machine clients authenticating against the MCP server.
        - ScopeName: gateway
          ScopeDescription: Scope for machine clients authenticating against the AgentCore Gateway.

  UserPoolDomain:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolDomain
    Properties:
      UserPoolId: !Ref CognitoUserPool
      Domain: !Sub "${CognitoDomainPrefix}-${AWS::AccountId}"

  WebClient:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolClient
    DependsOn: UserPoolResourceServer
    Properties:
      UserPoolId: !Ref CognitoUserPool
      ClientName: agentcore-web-client
      GenerateSecret: false
      ExplicitAuthFlows:
        - ALLOW_USER_PASSWORD_AUTH
        - ALLOW_USER_SRP_AUTH
      AllowedOAuthFlowsUserPoolClient: true
      AllowedOAuthFlows:
        - code
      AllowedOAuthScopes:
        - openid
        - profile
        - email
        - api/mcp
        - api/gateway
      SupportedIdentityProviders:
        - COGNITO
      CallbackURLs: !Ref CallbackURLs
      LogoutURLs: !Ref LogoutURLs
      TokenValidityUnits:
        AccessToken: minutes
        IdToken: minutes
        RefreshToken: days
      AccessTokenValidity: 60
      IdTokenValidity: 60
      RefreshTokenValidity: 30
      PreventUserExistenceErrors: ENABLED
      EnableTokenRevocation: true

  GatewayM2MClient:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolClient

    Properties:
      UserPoolId: !Ref CognitoUserPool
      ClientName: agentcore-gateway-m2m-client
      GenerateSecret: true
      AllowedOAuthFlowsUserPoolClient: true
      AllowedOAuthFlows:
        - client_credentials
      AllowedOAuthScopes:
        - api/gateway
      SupportedIdentityProviders:
        - COGNITO
      TokenValidityUnits:
        AccessToken: minutes
        IdToken: minutes
        RefreshToken: days
      AccessTokenValidity: 60
      IdTokenValidity: 60
      RefreshTokenValidity: 1

  McpM2MClient:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolClient
    DependsOn: UserPoolResourceServer
    Properties:
      UserPoolId: !Ref CognitoUserPool
      ClientName: agentcore-mcp-m2m-client
      GenerateSecret: true
      AllowedOAuthFlowsUserPoolClient: true
      AllowedOAuthFlows:
        - client_credentials
      AllowedOAuthScopes:
        - api/mcp
      SupportedIdentityProviders:
        - COGNITO
      TokenValidityUnits:
        AccessToken: minutes
        IdToken: minutes
        RefreshToken: days
      AccessTokenValidity: 60
      IdTokenValidity: 60
      RefreshTokenValidity: 1

Outputs:
  UserPoolId:
    Description: ID of the Cognito user pool.
    Value: !Ref CognitoUserPool
  UserPoolArn:
    Description: ARN of the Cognito user pool.
    Value: !GetAtt CognitoUserPool.Arn
  UserPoolIssuerUrl:
    Description: Token issuer URL to configure in the AgentCore Gateway JWT authorizer.
    Value: !GetAtt CognitoUserPool.ProviderURL
  HostedUIBaseUrl:
    Description: Hosted UI base URL for the signup and login pages.
    Value: !Sub "https://${UserPoolDomain}.auth.${AWS::Region}.amazoncognito.com"
  TokenEndpoint:
    Description: OAuth 2.0 token endpoint for client credentials and authorization code grant exchanges.
    Value: !Sub "https://${UserPoolDomain}.auth.${AWS::Region}.amazoncognito.com/oauth2/token"
  AuthorizeEndpoint:
    Description: OAuth 2.0 authorization endpoint for the authorization code flow with PKCE.

  OpenIdConfigurationUrl:
    Description: OpenID Connect discovery document URL (contains the JWKS URI).
    Value: !Sub "https://${UserPoolDomain}.auth.${AWS::Region}.amazoncognito.com/.well-known/openid-configuration"
  WebClientId:
    Description: Public web client ID (authorization code with PKCE, USER_PASSWORD_AUTH, USER_SRP_AUTH).
    Value: !Ref WebClient
  GatewayM2MClientId:

    Value: !Ref GatewayM2MClient
  GatewayM2MClientSecret:

    Value: !GetAtt GatewayM2MClient.ClientSecret
  McpM2MClientId:

  GatewayScope:

  McpScope:
    Description: Custom OAuth scope granted to the MCP server machine-to-machine client.

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >
  Creates a Cognito User Pool with a unique domain, a resource server exposing the
  domestic.read scope, a machine-to-machine app client using the client credentials
  flow, a customer managed KMS key with rotation and an EventBridge key policy, and
  an API Gateway REST API secured by the Cognito authorizer requiring the
  domestic.read scope, deployed to a prod stage with INFO logging and full data tracing.

Parameters:
  UserPoolName:
    Type: String
    Default: MyServerlessLandUserPool
    Description: Name of the Cognito User Pool.
    MinLength: 1
    MaxLength: 128
    AllowedPattern: '[\w\s+=,.@-]+'

  AppClientName:
    Type: String
    Default: MyWebClient
    Description: Name of the machine-to-machine app client.
    MinLength: 1
    MaxLength: 128
    AllowedPattern: '[\w\s+=,.@-]+'

  CallbackURLs:
    Type: CommaDelimitedList
    Default: https://example.com/callback
    Description: Comma-delimited list of allowed callback URLs for the app client.

  LogoutURLs:
    Type: CommaDelimitedList
    Default: https://example.com/logout
    Description: Comma-delimited list of allowed logout URLs for the app client.

Resources:
  UserPool:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPool
    Properties:
      UserPoolName: !Ref UserPoolName
      MfaConfiguration: 'OFF'
      AutoVerifiedAttributes:
        - email
      UsernameAttributes:
        - email
      Policies:
        PasswordPolicy:
          MinimumLength: 8
          RequireUppercase: true
          RequireLowercase: true
          RequireNumbers: true
          RequireSymbols: true
          TemporaryPasswordValidityDays: 7
      AdminCreateUserConfig:
        AllowAdminCreateUserOnly: true

  UserPoolDomain:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolDomain
    Properties:
      UserPoolId: !Ref UserPool
      Domain: !Join
        - '-'
        - - 'my-serverless-land'
          - !Select
            - 4
            - !Split
              - '-'
              - !Select
                - 2
                - !Split
                  - '/'
                  - !Ref 'AWS::StackId'

  UserPoolResourceServer:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolResourceServer
    Properties:
      UserPoolId: !Ref UserPool
      Identifier: petstore-api.example.com
      Name: PetStoreResourceServer
      Scopes:
        - ScopeName: domestic.read
          ScopeDescription: Read access to domestic pet store resources.

  UserPoolClient:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolClient
    DependsOn: UserPoolResourceServer
    Properties:
      ClientName: !Ref AppClientName
      UserPoolId: !Ref UserPool
      GenerateSecret: true
      PreventUserExistenceErrors: 'ENABLED'
      SupportedIdentityProviders:
        - COGNITO
      AllowedOAuthFlows:
        - client_credentials
      AllowedOAuthFlowsUserPoolClient: true
      AllowedOAuthScopes:
        - petstore-api.example.com/domestic.read
      CallbackURLs: !Ref CallbackURLs
      LogoutURLs: !Ref LogoutURLs

  KmsKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    Properties:
      Description: Customer managed key used by EventBridge for envelope encryption.
      Enabled: true
      EnableKeyRotation: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-cmk'
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: AllowRootAccountFullAccess
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub 'arn:aws:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root'
            Action: 'kms:*'
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: AllowEventBridgeGenerateDataKeysAndDecrypt
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: events.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - kms:GenerateDataKey
              - kms:Decrypt
            Resource: '*'

  KmsKeyAlias:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Alias
    Properties:
      AliasName: !Sub 'alias/${AWS::StackName}-cmk'
      TargetKeyId: !Ref KmsKey

  RestApi:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::RestApi
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-api'
      Description: REST API secured with a Cognito User Pool authorizer.
      EndpointConfiguration:
        Types:
          - REGIONAL

  ApiResource:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Resource
    Properties:
      RestApiId: !Ref RestApi
      ParentId: !GetAtt RestApi.RootResourceId
      PathPart: 'domestic'

  UserPoolAuthorizer:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Authorizer
    Properties:
      Name: CognitoUserPoolAuthorizer
      Type: COGNITO_USER_POOLS
      RestApiId: !Ref RestApi
      ProviderARNs:
        - !GetAtt UserPool.Arn
      IdentitySource: method.request.header.Authorization

  ApiMethod:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Method
    Properties:
      RestApiId: !Ref RestApi
      ResourceId: !Ref ApiResource
      HttpMethod: POST
      AuthorizationType: COGNITO_USER_POOLS
      AuthorizerId: !Ref UserPoolAuthorizer
      AuthorizationScopes:
        - petstore-api.example.com/domestic.read
      Integration:
        Type: HTTP_PROXY
        IntegrationHttpMethod: POST
        Uri: https://httpbin.org/post
        ConnectionType: INTERNET
        PassthroughBehavior: WHEN_NO_MATCH
        TimeoutInMillis: 29000

  ApiGatewayCloudWatchRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: apigateway.amazonaws.com
            Action: 'sts:AssumeRole'
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AmazonAPIGatewayPushToCloudWatchLogs

  ApiGatewayAccount:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Account
    Properties:
      CloudWatchRoleArn: !GetAtt ApiGatewayCloudWatchRole.Arn

  ApiDeployment:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Deployment
    DependsOn: ApiMethod
    Properties:
      RestApiId: !Ref RestApi

  ApiStage:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Stage
    DependsOn: ApiGatewayAccount
    Properties:
      RestApiId: !Ref RestApi
      DeploymentId: !Ref ApiDeployment
      StageName: 'prod'
      TracingEnabled: true
      MethodSettings:
        - ResourcePath: '/*'
          HttpMethod: '*'
          LoggingLevel: 'INFO'
          DataTraceEnabled: true
          MetricsEnabled: true

Outputs:
  UserPoolArn:
    Description: ARN of the Cognito User Pool.
    Value: !GetAtt UserPool.Arn

  ApiEndpoint:
    Description: Invoke URL of the prod stage of the REST API.
    Value: !Sub 'https://${RestApi}.execute-api.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com/prod'

  AppClientId:
    Description: ID of the machine-to-machine app client.
    Value: !Ref UserPoolClient

  KmsKeyArn:
    Description: ARN of the customer managed KMS key.
    Value: !GetAtt KmsKey.Arn

  UserPoolTokenEndpoint:
    Description: OAuth token endpoint of the Cognito User Pool domain.
    Value: !Sub 'https://${UserPoolDomain}.auth.${AWS::Region}.amazoncognito.com/oauth/token'

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: AWS Backup infrastructure with tag-based daily, weekly and monthly backup plans, separate encrypted backup vaults, a rotating customer managed KMS key, an IAM service role for AWS Backup, and Service Catalog TagOptions for the backup tag values.

Metadata:
  AWS::CloudFormation::Interface:
    ParameterGroups:
      - Label:
          default: Backup tagging
        Parameters:
          - BackupTagKey
      - Label:
          default: Backup schedule and retention
        Parameters:
          - BackupHourUtc
          - DailyRetentionDays
          - WeeklyRetentionDays
          - MonthlyRetentionDays

Parameters:
  BackupTagKey:
    Type: String
    Default: backup
    Description: Tag key used by the backup selections to identify resources to back up.
  BackupHourUtc:
    Type: Number
    Default: 5
    MinValue: 0
    MaxValue: 23
    Description: Hour of day in UTC at which every backup schedule starts.
  DailyRetentionDays:
    Type: Number
    Default: 14
    MinValue: 1
    MaxValue: 36500
    Description: Number of days daily backups are retained.
  WeeklyRetentionDays:
    Type: Number
    Default: 56
    MinValue: 1
    MaxValue: 36500
    Description: Number of days weekly backups are retained.
  MonthlyRetentionDays:
    Type: Number
    Default: 365
    MinValue: 1
    MaxValue: 36500
    Description: Number of days monthly backups are retained.

Resources:
  BackupKmsKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    Properties:
      Description: Customer managed KMS key used to encrypt the AWS Backup vaults.
      Enabled: true
      EnableKeyRotation: true
      KeyUsage: ENCRYPT_DECRYPT
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: EnableIAMUserPermissions
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root'
            Action: 'kms:*'
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: AllowAwsBackupServiceToUseKey
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: backup.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - 'kms:Encrypt'
              - 'kms:Decrypt'
              - 'kms:ReEncrypt*'
              - 'kms:GenerateDataKey*'
              - 'kms:DescribeKey'
            Resource: '*'

  BackupKmsKeyAlias:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Alias
    Properties:
      AliasName: !Sub 'alias/${AWS::StackName}-backup-key'
      TargetKeyId: !Ref BackupKmsKey

  BackupServiceRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: AllowAwsBackupServiceToAssumeRole
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: backup.amazonaws.com
            Action: 'sts:AssumeRole'
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSBackupServiceRolePolicyForBackup'
        - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSBackupServiceRolePolicyForRestores'
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: BackupVaultKmsAccess
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: AllowUseOfBackupVaultKey
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - 'kms:Encrypt'
                  - 'kms:Decrypt'
                  - 'kms:ReEncrypt*'
                  - 'kms:GenerateDataKey*'
                  - 'kms:DescribeKey'
                  - 'kms:CreateGrant'
                Resource: !GetAtt BackupKmsKey.Arn

  DailyBackupVault:
    Type: AWS::Backup::BackupVault
    Properties:
      BackupVaultName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-daily-vault'
      EncryptionKeyArn: !GetAtt BackupKmsKey.Arn

  WeeklyBackupVault:
    Type: AWS::Backup::BackupVault
    Properties:
      BackupVaultName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-weekly-vault'
      EncryptionKeyArn: !GetAtt BackupKmsKey.Arn

  MonthlyBackupVault:
    Type: AWS::Backup::BackupVault
    Properties:
      BackupVaultName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-monthly-vault'
      EncryptionKeyArn: !GetAtt BackupKmsKey.Arn

  DailyBackupPlan:
    Type: AWS::Backup::BackupPlan
    Properties:
      BackupPlan:
        BackupPlanName: daily-backup-plan
        BackupPlanRule:
          - RuleName: daily-backup-rule
            TargetBackupVault: !Ref DailyBackupVault
            ScheduleExpression: !Sub 'cron(0 ${BackupHourUtc} * * ? *)'
            StartWindowMinutes: 60
            Lifecycle:
              DeleteAfterDays: !Ref DailyRetentionDays

  WeeklyBackupPlan:
    Type: AWS::Backup::BackupPlan
    Properties:
      BackupPlan:
        BackupPlanName: weekly-backup-plan
        BackupPlanRule:
          - RuleName: weekly-backup-rule
            TargetBackupVault: !Ref WeeklyBackupVault
            ScheduleExpression: !Sub 'cron(0 ${BackupHourUtc} ? * SUN *)'
            StartWindowMinutes: 60
            Lifecycle:
              DeleteAfterDays: !Ref WeeklyRetentionDays

  MonthlyBackupPlan:
    Type: AWS::Backup::BackupPlan
    Properties:
      BackupPlan:
        BackupPlanName: monthly-backup-plan
        BackupPlanRule:
          - RuleName: monthly-backup-rule
            TargetBackupVault: !Ref MonthlyBackupVault
            ScheduleExpression: !Sub 'cron(0 ${BackupHourUtc} 1 * ? *)'
            StartWindowMinutes: 60
            Lifecycle:
              DeleteAfterDays: !Ref MonthlyRetentionDays

  DailyBackupSelection:
    Type: AWS::Backup::BackupSelection
    Properties:
      BackupPlanId: !GetAtt DailyBackupPlan.BackupPlanId
      BackupSelection:
        SelectionName: daily-tag-selection
        IamRoleArn: !GetAtt BackupServiceRole.Arn
        ListOfTags:
          - ConditionType: STRINGEQUALS
            ConditionKey: !Ref BackupTagKey
            ConditionValue: daily

  WeeklyBackupSelection:
    Type: AWS::Backup::BackupSelection
    Properties:
      BackupPlanId: !GetAtt WeeklyBackupPlan.BackupPlanId
      BackupSelection:
        SelectionName: weekly-tag-selection
        IamRoleArn: !GetAtt BackupServiceRole.Arn
        ListOfTags:
          - ConditionType: STRINGEQUALS
            ConditionKey: !Ref BackupTagKey
            ConditionValue: weekly

  MonthlyBackupSelection:
    Type: AWS::Backup::BackupSelection
    Properties:
      BackupPlanId: !GetAtt MonthlyBackupPlan.BackupPlanId
      BackupSelection:
        SelectionName: monthly-tag-selection
        IamRoleArn: !GetAtt BackupServiceRole.Arn
        ListOfTags:
          - ConditionType: STRINGEQUALS
            ConditionKey: !Ref BackupTagKey
            ConditionValue: monthly

  DailyTagOption:
    Type: AWS::ServiceCatalog::TagOption
    Properties:
      Active: true
      Key: !Ref BackupTagKey
      Value: daily

  WeeklyTagOption:
    Type: AWS::ServiceCatalog::TagOption
    Properties:
      Active: true
      Key: !Ref BackupTagKey
      Value: weekly

  MonthlyTagOption:
    Type: AWS::ServiceCatalog::TagOption
    Properties:
      Active: true
      Key: !Ref BackupTagKey
      Value: monthly

Outputs:
  BackupKmsKeyArn:
    Description: ARN of the customer managed KMS key that encrypts the backup vaults.
    Value: !GetAtt BackupKmsKey.Arn
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-BackupKmsKeyArn'
  BackupKmsKeyAliasName:
    Description: Alias of the customer managed KMS key.
    Value: !Ref BackupKmsKeyAlias
  BackupServiceRoleArn:
    Description: ARN of the IAM service role used by AWS Backup.
    Value: !GetAtt BackupServiceRole.Arn
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-BackupServiceRoleArn'
  DailyBackupVaultName:
    Description: Name of the backup vault used by the daily backup plan.
    Value: !Ref DailyBackupVault
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-DailyBackupVaultName'
  WeeklyBackupVaultName:
    Description: Name of the backup vault used by the weekly backup plan.
    Value: !Ref WeeklyBackupVault
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-WeeklyBackupVaultName'
  MonthlyBackupVaultName:
    Description: Name of the backup vault used by the monthly backup plan.
    Value: !Ref MonthlyBackupVault
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-MonthlyBackupVaultName'
  DailyBackupPlanId:
    Description: ID of the daily backup plan.
    Value: !GetAtt DailyBackupPlan.BackupPlanId
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-DailyBackupPlanId'
  WeeklyBackupPlanId:
    Description: ID of the weekly backup plan.
    Value: !GetAtt WeeklyBackupPlan.BackupPlanId
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-WeeklyBackupPlanId'
  MonthlyBackupPlanId:
    Description: ID of the monthly backup plan.
    Value: !GetAtt MonthlyBackupPlan.BackupPlanId
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-MonthlyBackupPlanId'
  DailyTagOptionId:
    Description: ID of the Service Catalog TagOption for backup=daily.
    Value: !Ref DailyTagOption
  WeeklyTagOptionId:
    Description: ID of the Service Catalog TagOption for backup=weekly.
    Value: !Ref WeeklyTagOption
  MonthlyTagOptionId:
    Description: ID of the Service Catalog TagOption for backup=monthly.
    Value: !Ref MonthlyTagOption

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >-
  Creates a Route 53 public hosted zone for the configured domain (default
  podcastgarage.org) plus the full set of DNS record sets needed to run the
  domain's external services: Squarespace marketing website (apex A records and
  www CNAME), Google Workspace mail (MX, SPF and site-verification apex TXT,
  DMARC TXT and DKIM TXT), ZenDesk helpdesk (verification TXT, domain
  validation CNAME and DKIM CNAMEs), Campaign Monitor email marketing (DKIM TXT
  plus a dedicated SPF-aligned sending subdomain with its own TXT and MX
  records) and an internal A record for the office printer.

Metadata:
  AWS::CloudFormation::Interface:
    ParameterGroups:
      - Label:
          default: Hosted zone
        Parameters:
          - DomainName
      - Label:
          default: Marketing website (Squarespace)
        Parameters:
          - SquarespaceARecordIPs
          - SquarespaceWwwCnameTarget
      - Label:
          default: Email (Google Workspace)
        Parameters:
          - GoogleSiteVerificationToken
          - GoogleWorkspaceDKIMKey
      - Label:
          default: Helpdesk (ZenDesk)
        Parameters:
          - ZendeskSubdomain
          - ZendeskVerificationToken
      - Label:
          default: Email marketing (Campaign Monitor)
        Parameters:
          - CampaignMonitorSendingSubdomain
          - CampaignMonitorDKIMKey
      - Label:
          default: Office network
        Parameters:
          - OfficePrinterIPAddress

Parameters:
  DomainName:
    Type: String
    Description: Registered domain name for which the public hosted zone is created.
    Default: podcastgarage.org
    AllowedPattern: '^([a-zA-Z0-9]([a-zA-Z0-9-]*[a-zA-Z0-9])?\.)+[a-zA-Z]{2,}$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must be a valid domain name, for example podcastgarage.org.
  SquarespaceARecordIPs:
    Type: CommaDelimitedList
    Description: Squarespace website hosting IPv4 addresses for the apex A record.
    Default: '198.185.159.144,198.185.159.145,198.49.23.144,198.49.23.145'
  SquarespaceWwwCnameTarget:
    Type: String
    Description: Squarespace CNAME target for the www subdomain.
    Default: ext-cust.squarespace.com
  GoogleSiteVerificationToken:
    Type: String
    Description: Google site verification token published in the apex TXT record set.
    Default: AbC123dEf456GhI789jKl012MnO345PqR678
  GoogleWorkspaceDKIMKey:
    Type: String
    Description: Full Google Workspace DKIM TXT value (v=DKIM1; k=rsa; p=...) for the google._domainkey selector.
    Default: 'v=DKIM1; k=rsa; p=MIIBIjANBgkqhkiG9w0BAQEFAAOCAQ8AMIIBCgKCAQEAReplaceWithYourGoogleWorkspaceDKIMKey'
  ZendeskSubdomain:
    Type: String
    Description: ZenDesk subdomain used as the target for the domain validation and DKIM CNAME records.
    Default: podcastgarage
  ZendeskVerificationToken:
    Type: String
    Description: ZenDesk verification token published as a TXT record.
    Default: 1234abcdef5678ghijkl
  CampaignMonitorSendingSubdomain:
    Type: String
    Description: Subdomain dedicated to Campaign Monitor sending (SPF-aligned TXT and MX records).
    Default: email
  CampaignMonitorDKIMKey:
    Type: String
    Description: Full Campaign Monitor DKIM TXT value (v=DKIM1; k=rsa; p=...) for the cm._domainkey selector.
    Default: 'v=DKIM1; k=rsa; p=MIIBIjANBgkqhkiG9w0BAQEFAAOCAQ8AMIIBCgKCAQEAReplaceWithYourCampaignMonitorDKIMKey'
  OfficePrinterIPAddress:
    Type: String
    Description: Private IPv4 address of the office printer on the local network.
    Default: 192.168.1.250
    AllowedPattern: '^((25[0-5]|2[0-4][0-9]|1?[0-9]?[0-9])\.){3}(25[0-5]|2[0-4][0-9]|1?[0-9]?[0-9])$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must be a valid IPv4 address, for example 192.168.1.250.

Resources:
  PublicHostedZone:
    Type: AWS::Route53::HostedZone
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${DomainName}.'
      HostedZoneConfig:
        Comment: !Sub 'Public hosted zone for ${DomainName} managed by CloudFormation'
      HostedZoneTags:
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: CloudFormation

  RootTxtRecordSet:
    Type: AWS::Route53::RecordSet
    Properties:
      HostedZoneId: !Ref PublicHostedZone
      Name: !Sub '${DomainName}.'
      Type: TXT
      TTL: '3600'
      ResourceRecords:
        - '"v=spf1 include:_spf.google.com ~all"'
        - !Sub '"google-site-verification=${GoogleSiteVerificationToken}"'

  RootARecordSet:
    Type: AWS::Route53::RecordSet
    Properties:
      HostedZoneId: !Ref PublicHostedZone
      Name: !Sub '${DomainName}.'
      Type: A
      TTL: '300'
      ResourceRecords: !Ref SquarespaceARecordIPs

  WwwCnameRecordSet:
    Type: AWS::Route53::RecordSet
    Properties:
      HostedZoneId: !Ref PublicHostedZone
      Name: !Sub 'www.${DomainName}.'
      Type: CNAME
      TTL: '300'
      ResourceRecords:
        - !Ref SquarespaceWwwCnameTarget

  GoogleWorkspaceMxRecordSet:
    Type: AWS::Route53::RecordSet
    Properties:
      HostedZoneId: !Ref PublicHostedZone
      Name: !Sub '${DomainName}.'
      Type: MX
      TTL: '3600'
      ResourceRecords:
        - '1 aspmx.l.google.com'

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >-
  IAM roles and customer managed policies for an e-commerce serverless
  architecture. Creates a Lambda execution role for the order processor (reads
  POC-Queue-<env> and writes to the ecommerce-orders-<env> DynamoDB table), a
  Lambda execution role for the stream processor (reads DynamoDB Streams from
  ecommerce-orders-<env> and publishes to POC-Topic-<env>), an API Gateway role
  for sending messages to the SQS queue, and a basic Lambda execution policy
  for CloudWatch Logs. Everything is parameterized by the Environment
  parameter, and the role ARNs are exported for cross-stack references.

Metadata:
  AWS::CloudFormation::Interface:
    ParameterGroups:
      - Label:
          default: Deployment Configuration
        Parameters:
          - Environment
    ParameterLabels:
      Environment:
        default: Environment (dev, test, prod)

Parameters:
  Environment:
    Type: String
    Description: >-
      Deployment environment appended to the SQS queue, DynamoDB table, and SNS
      topic names (POC-Queue-<env>, ecommerce-orders-<env>, POC-Topic-<env>).
    Default: dev
    AllowedValues:
      - dev
      - test
      - prod
    ConstraintDescription: Environment must be one of dev, test, or prod.

Resources:
  LambdaOrderProcessorRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub POC-Lambda-OrderProcessor-Role-${Environment}
      Description: !Sub >-
        Execution role for the order processor Lambda that consumes messages
        from POC-Queue-${Environment} and writes orders to the
        ecommerce-orders-${Environment} DynamoDB table.
      MaxSessionDuration: 3600
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment
        - Key: Application
          Value: ecommerce-serverless

  LambdaStreamProcessorRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub POC-Lambda-StreamProcessor-Role-${Environment}
      Description: !Sub >-
        Execution role for the stream processor Lambda that reads change
        records from the DynamoDB Streams of the
        ecommerce-orders-${Environment} table and publishes notifications to
        POC-Topic-${Environment}.
      MaxSessionDuration: 3600
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment
        - Key: Application
          Value: ecommerce-serverless

  ApiGatewaySqsRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub POC-ApiGateway-SQS-Role-${Environment}
      Description: !Sub >-
        Service role assumed by API Gateway to send messages to the
        POC-Queue-${Environment} SQS queue.
      MaxSessionDuration: 3600
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: apigateway.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment
        - Key: Application
          Value: ecommerce-serverless

  LambdaBasicExecutionPolicy:
    Type: AWS::IAM::ManagedPolicy
    Properties:
      ManagedPolicyName: !Sub POC-Lambda-BasicExecution-Policy-${Environment}
      Description: >-
        Basic Lambda execution policy granting CloudWatch Logs permissions to
        create log groups, create log streams, and put log events.
      Roles:
        - !Ref LambdaOrderProcessorRole
        - !Ref LambdaStreamProcessorRole
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: LambdaCloudWatchLogs
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - logs:CreateLogGroup
              - logs:CreateLogStream
              - logs:PutLogEvents
            Resource:
              - !Sub arn:aws:logs:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:log-group:/aws/lambda/*
              - !Sub arn:aws:logs:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:log-group:/aws/lambda/*:log-stream:*

  OrderProcessorPolicy:
    Type: AWS::IAM::ManagedPolicy
    Properties:
      ManagedPolicyName: !Sub POC-OrderProcessor-Policy-${Environment}
      Description: !Sub >-
        Grants the order processor Lambda permission to read messages from
        POC-Queue-${Environment} and write orders to the
        ecommerce-orders-${Environment} DynamoDB table.
      Roles:
        - !Ref LambdaOrderProcessorRole
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: ConsumeOrderQueue
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - sqs:ReceiveMessage
              - sqs:DeleteMessage
              - sqs:ChangeMessageVisibility
              - sqs:GetQueueAttributes
              - sqs:GetQueueUrl
            Resource: !Sub arn:aws:sqs:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:POC-Queue-${Environment}
          - Sid: WriteOrdersTable
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - dynamodb:PutItem
              - dynamodb:UpdateItem
              - dynamodb:DeleteItem
              - dynamodb:BatchWriteItem
            Resource: !Sub arn:aws:dynamodb:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:table/ecommerce-orders-${Environment}

  StreamProcessorPolicy:
    Type: AWS::IAM::ManagedPolicy
    Properties:
      ManagedPolicyName: !Sub POC-StreamProcessor-Policy-${Environment}
      Description: !Sub >-
        Grants the stream processor Lambda permission to read records from the
        DynamoDB Streams of the ecommerce-orders-${Environment} table and
        publish notifications to POC-Topic-${Environment}.
      Roles:
        - !Ref LambdaStreamProcessorRole
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: ReadOrdersTableStream
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - dynamodb:DescribeStream
              - dynamodb:GetRecords
              - dynamodb:GetShardIterator
              - dynamodb:ListStreams
            Resource: !Sub arn:aws:dynamodb:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:table/ecommerce-orders-${Environment}/stream/*
          - Sid: PublishOrderNotifications
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - sns:Publish
            Resource: !Sub arn:aws:sns:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:POC-Topic-${Environment}

  ApiGatewaySqsPolicy:
    Type: AWS::IAM::ManagedPolicy
    Properties:
      ManagedPolicyName: !Sub POC-ApiGateway-SQS-Policy-${Environment}
      Description: !Sub >-
        Grants API Gateway permission to send messages to the
        POC-Queue-${Environment} SQS queue.
      Roles:
        - !Ref ApiGatewaySqsRole
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: SendMessageToOrderQueue
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - sqs:SendMessage
              - sqs:GetQueueAttributes
              - sqs:GetQueueUrl
            Resource: !Sub arn:aws:sqs:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:POC-Queue-${Environment}

Outputs:
  OrderProcessorRoleArn:
    Description: ARN of the Lambda order processor role (SQS consumer, DynamoDB writer).
    Value: !GetAtt LambdaOrderProcessorRole.Arn
    Export:
      Name: !Sub ${AWS::StackName}-OrderProcessorRoleArn

  StreamProcessorRoleArn:
    Description: ARN of the Lambda stream processor role (DynamoDB Streams reader, SNS publisher).
    Value: !GetAtt LambdaStreamProcessorRole.Arn
    Export:
      Name: !Sub ${AWS::StackName}-StreamProcessorRoleArn

  ApiGatewaySqsRoleArn:
    Description: ARN of the API Gateway role used to send messages to the SQS order queue.
    Value: !GetAtt ApiGatewaySqsRole.Arn
    Export:
      Name: !Sub ${AWS::StackName}-ApiGatewaySqsRoleArn

  OrderProcessorPolicyArn:
    Description: ARN of the order processor managed policy.
    Value: !Ref OrderProcessorPolicy
    Export:
      Name: !Sub ${AWS::StackName}-OrderProcessorPolicyArn

  StreamProcessorPolicyArn:
    Description: ARN of the stream processor managed policy.
    Value: !Ref StreamProcessorPolicy
    Export:
      Name: !Sub ${AWS::StackName}-StreamProcessorPolicyArn

  ApiGatewaySqsPolicyArn:
    Description: ARN of the API Gateway SQS managed policy.
    Value: !Ref ApiGatewaySqsPolicy
    Export:
      Name: !Sub ${AWS::StackName}-ApiGatewaySqsPolicyArn

  LambdaBasicExecutionPolicyArn:
    Description: ARN of the basic Lambda execution (CloudWatch Logs) managed policy.
    Value: !Ref LambdaBasicExecutionPolicy
    Export:
      Name: !Sub ${AWS::StackName}-LambdaBasicExecutionPolicyArn

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >
  Creates a VPC (default 172.18.0.0/16) with one public subnet (172.18.0.0/22)
  and one private subnet (172.18.32.0/21). The private subnet reaches the
  internet through a NAT gateway in the public subnet, which uses an Internet
  Gateway. Neither subnet auto-assigns public IP addresses. Intended for
  testing outbound internet connectivity from private resources.

Metadata:
  AWS::CloudFormation::Interface:
    ParameterGroups:
      - Label:
          default: Network Configuration
        Parameters:
          - VpcCidr
          - PublicSubnetCidr
          - PrivateSubnetCidr
      - Label:
          default: Tagging
        Parameters:
          - EnvironmentName
    ParameterLabels:
      VpcCidr:
        default: VPC CIDR block
      PublicSubnetCidr:
        default: Public subnet CIDR block
      PrivateSubnetCidr:
        default: Private subnet CIDR block
      EnvironmentName:
        default: Environment name

Parameters:
  VpcCidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 172.18.0.0/16
    Description: CIDR block for the VPC. The subnet CIDRs must fall within this range.
    AllowedPattern: '^([0-9]{1,3}\.){3}[0-9]{1,3}/([0-9]|[1-2][0-9])$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must be a valid IPv4 CIDR block in the format x.x.x.x/xx.
  PublicSubnetCidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 172.18.0.0/22
    Description: CIDR block for the public subnet. Must fall within the VPC CIDR.
    AllowedPattern: '^([0-9]{1,3}\.){3}[0-9]{1,3}/([0-9]|[1-2][0-9])$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must be a valid IPv4 CIDR block in the format x.x.x.x/xx.
  PrivateSubnetCidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 172.18.32.0/21
    Description: CIDR block for the private subnet. Must fall within the VPC CIDR and not overlap the public subnet.
    AllowedPattern: '^([0-9]{1,3}\.){3}[0-9]{1,3}/([0-9]|[1-2][0-9])$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must be a valid IPv4 CIDR block in the format x.x.x.x/xx.
  EnvironmentName:
    Type: String
    Default: test
    Description: Short name of the environment, used as a prefix for resource Name tags.
    AllowedPattern: '^[a-zA-Z0-9-]{1,20}$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must contain only letters, numbers, and hyphens (max 20 characters).

Resources:
  VPC:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPC
    Properties:
      CidrBlock: !Ref VpcCidr
      EnableDnsHostnames: true
      EnableDnsSupport: true
      InstanceTenancy: default
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-vpc'

  InternetGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::InternetGateway
    Properties:
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-internet-gateway'

  VPCGatewayAttachment:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      InternetGatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  PublicSubnet:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: !Ref PublicSubnetCidr
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-public-subnet'
        - Key: Network
          Value: Public

  PrivateSubnet:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: !Ref PrivateSubnetCidr
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-private-subnet'
        - Key: Network
          Value: Private

  NatElasticIP:
    Type: AWS::EC2::EIP
    DependsOn: VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      Domain: vpc
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-nat-elastic-ip'

  NatGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NatGateway
    DependsOn: VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      AllocationId: !GetAtt NatElasticIP.AllocationId
      ConnectivityType: public
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-nat-gateway'

  PublicRouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-public-route-table'
        - Key: Network
          Value: Public

  PrivateRouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-private-route-table'
        - Key: Network
          Value: Private

  PublicRoute:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    DependsOn: VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      GatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  PrivateRoute:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      NatGatewayId: !Ref NatGateway

  PublicSubnetRouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable

  PrivateSubnetRouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnet
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable

Outputs:
  VpcId:
    Description: ID of the VPC.
    Value: !Ref VPC
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-VpcId'

  PublicSubnetId:
    Description: ID of the public subnet hosting the NAT gateway.
    Value: !Ref PublicSubnet
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-PublicSubnetId'

  PrivateSubnetId:
    Description: ID of the private subnet with outbound access via the NAT gateway.
    Value: !Ref PrivateSubnet
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-PrivateSubnetId'

  InternetGatewayId:
    Description: ID of the Internet Gateway.
    Value: !Ref InternetGateway
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-InternetGatewayId'

  NatGatewayId:
    Description: ID of the NAT Gateway.
    Value: !Ref NatGateway
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-NatGatewayId'

  NatGatewayPublicIp:
    Description: Public IP address of the NAT Gateway's Elastic IP.
    Value: !GetAtt NatElasticIP.PublicIp
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-NatGatewayPublicIp'

  PublicRouteTableId:
    Description: ID of the public route table.
    Value: !Ref PublicRouteTable
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-PublicRouteTableId'

  PrivateRouteTableId:
    Description: ID of the private route table.
    Value: !Ref PrivateRouteTable
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-PrivateRouteTableId'
