AWSTemplateFormatVersion: "2010-09-09"

Description: >-
  Creates a set of Amazon Athena named queries for analyzing Amazon AppStream 2.0
  usage data. The queries run against the AWS Glue database "appstream-usage",
  which is created when the AppStream 2.0 usage reports feature is enabled, and
  provide pre-built queries for current month and previous month comparisons of
  average session length per stack, daily session counts, all session details,
  streaming hours per user, and unique users per application, simplifying monthly
  reporting and analysis of AppStream 2.0 session metrics. The database must
  already exist before this stack is deployed.

Parameters:
  AthenaDatabaseName:
    Type: String
    Default: appstream-usage
    Description: >-
      Name of the AWS Glue database that contains the AppStream 2.0 usage report
      tables (session_data and application_data). This database must already exist
      before the stack is deployed.
    AllowedPattern: '^[a-zA-Z0-9_-]{1,255}$'
    ConstraintDescription: >-
      The database name must be between 1 and 255 characters and may contain only
      letters, numbers, underscores, and hyphens.

Metadata:
  AWS::CloudFormation::Interface:
    ParameterGroups:
      - Label:
          default: Athena Configuration
        Parameters:
          - AthenaDatabaseName
    ParameterLabels:
      AthenaDatabaseName:
        default: AppStream 2.0 Usage Database Name

Resources:
  AverageSessionLengthPerStackCurrentMonth:
    Type: AWS::Athena::NamedQuery
    Properties:
      Database: !Ref AthenaDatabaseName
      Name: AppStream-Usage-Average-Session-Length-Per-Stack-Current-Month
      Description: >-
        Average AppStream 2.0 session length in minutes per stack for the current month.
      QueryString: !Sub |
        SELECT stack_name,
               ROUND(AVG(session_duration), 2) AS average_session_length_minutes
        FROM "${AthenaDatabaseName}"."session_data"
        WHERE "year" = CAST(year(current_date) AS VARCHAR)
          AND "month" = date_format(current_date, '%m')
          AND session_duration IS NOT NULL
        GROUP BY stack_name
        ORDER BY average_session_length_minutes DESC

  AverageSessionLengthPerStackPreviousMonth:
    Type: AWS::Athena::NamedQuery
    Properties:
      Database: !Ref AthenaDatabaseName
      Name: AppStream-Usage-Average-Session-Length-Per-Stack-Previous-Month
      Description: >-
        Average AppStream 2.0 session length in minutes per stack for the previous month.
      QueryString: !Sub |
        SELECT stack_name,
               ROUND(AVG(session_duration), 2) AS average_session_length_minutes
        FROM "${AthenaDatabaseName}"."session_data"
        WHERE "year" = CAST(year(date_add('month', -1, current_date)) AS VARCHAR)
          AND "month" = date_format(date_add('month', -1, current_date), '%m')
          AND session_duration IS NOT NULL
        GROUP BY stack_name
        ORDER BY average_session_length_minutes DESC

  DailySessionCountsCurrentMonth:
    Type: AWS::Athena::NamedQuery
    Properties:
      Database: !Ref AthenaDatabaseName
      Name: AppStream-Usage-Daily-Session-Counts-Current-Month
      Description: >-
        Number of AppStream 2.0 sessions per day for the current month.
      QueryString: !Sub |
        SELECT "day",
               COUNT(*) AS session_count
        FROM "${AthenaDatabaseName}"."session_data"
        WHERE "year" = CAST(year(current_date) AS VARCHAR)
          AND "month" = date_format(current_date, '%m')
        GROUP BY "day"
        ORDER BY CAST("day" AS INTEGER) ASC

  DailySessionCountsPreviousMonth:
    Type: AWS::Athena::NamedQuery
    Properties:
      Database: !Ref AthenaDatabaseName
      Name: AppStream-Usage-Daily-Session-Counts-Previous-Month
      Description: >-
        Number of AppStream 2.0 sessions per day for the previous month.
      QueryString: !Sub |
        SELECT "day",
               COUNT(*) AS session_count
        FROM "${AthenaDatabaseName}"."session_data"
        WHERE "year" = CAST(year(date_add('month', -1, current_date)) AS VARCHAR)
          AND "month" = date_format(date_add('month', -1, current_date), '%m')
        GROUP BY "day"
        ORDER BY CAST("day" AS INTEGER) ASC

  AllSessionDetailsCurrentMonth:
    Type: AWS::Athena::NamedQuery
    Properties:
      Database: !Ref AthenaDatabaseName
      Name: AppStream-Usage-All-Session-Details-Current-Month
      Description: >-
        All AppStream 2.0 session details for the current month, ordered by session start time.
      QueryString: !Sub |
        SELECT session_id,
               user_id,
               stack_name,
               fleet_name,
               start_time,
               end_time,
               session_duration
        FROM "${AthenaDatabaseName}"."session_data"
        WHERE "year" = CAST(year(current_date) AS VARCHAR)
          AND "month" = date_format(current_date, '%m')
        ORDER BY start_time DESC

  AllSessionDetailsPreviousMonth:
    Type: AWS::Athena::NamedQuery
    Properties:
      Database: !Ref AthenaDatabaseName
      Name: AppStream-Usage-All-Session-Details-Previous-Month
      Description: >-
        All AppStream 2.0 session details for the previous month, ordered by session start time.
      QueryString: !Sub |
        SELECT session_id,
               user_id,
               stack_name,
               fleet_name,
               start_time,
               end_time,
               session_duration
        FROM "${AthenaDatabaseName}"."session_data"
        WHERE "year" = CAST(year(date_add('month', -1, current_date)) AS VARCHAR)
          AND "month" = date_format(date_add('month', -1, current_date), '%m')
        ORDER BY start_time DESC

  StreamingHoursPerUserCurrentMonth:
    Type: AWS::Athena::NamedQuery
    Properties:
      Database: !Ref AthenaDatabaseName
      Name: AppStream-Usage-Streaming-Hours-Per-User-Current-Month
      Description: >-
        Total AppStream 2.0 streaming hours per user for the current month.
      QueryString: !Sub |
        SELECT user_id,
               ROUND(SUM(session_duration) / 60.0, 2) AS streaming_hours
        FROM "${AthenaDatabaseName}"."session_data"
        WHERE "year" = CAST(year(current_date) AS VARCHAR)
          AND "month" = date_format(current_date, '%m')
          AND session_duration IS NOT NULL
        GROUP BY user_id
        ORDER BY streaming_hours DESC

  StreamingHoursPerUserPreviousMonth:
    Type: AWS::Athena::NamedQuery
    Properties:
      Database: !Ref AthenaDatabaseName
      Name: AppStream-Usage-Streaming-Hours-Per-User-Previous-Month
      Description: >-
        Total AppStream 2.0 streaming hours per user for the previous month.
      QueryString: !Sub |
        SELECT user_id,
               ROUND(SUM(session_duration) / 60.0, 2) AS streaming_hours
        FROM "${AthenaDatabaseName}"."session_data"
        WHERE "year" = CAST(year(date_add('month', -1, current_date)) AS VARCHAR)
          AND "month" = date_format(date_add('month', -1, current_date), '%m')
          AND session_duration IS NOT NULL
        GROUP BY user_id
        ORDER BY streaming_hours DESC

  UniqueUsersPerApplicationCurrentMonth:
    Type: AWS::Athena::NamedQuery
    Properties:
      Database: !Ref AthenaDatabaseName
      Name: AppStream-Usage-Unique-Users-Per-Application-Current-Month
      Description: >-
        Number of unique AppStream 2.0 users per application for the current month.
      QueryString: !Sub |
        SELECT application_name,
               COUNT(DISTINCT user_id) AS unique_users
        FROM "${AthenaDatabaseName}"."application_data"
        WHERE "year" = CAST(year(current_date) AS VARCHAR)
          AND "month" = date_format(current_date, '%m')
        GROUP BY application_name
        ORDER BY unique_users DESC

  UniqueUsersPerApplicationPreviousMonth:
    Type: AWS::Athena::NamedQuery
    Properties:
      Database: !Ref AthenaDatabaseName
      Name: AppStream-Usage-Unique-Users-Per-Application-Previous-Month
      Description: >-
        Number of unique AppStream 2.0 users per application for the previous month.
      QueryString: !Sub |
        SELECT application_name,
               COUNT(DISTINCT user_id) AS unique_users
        FROM "${AthenaDatabaseName}"."application_data"
        WHERE "year" = CAST(year(date_add('month', -1, current_date)) AS VARCHAR)
          AND "month" = date_format(date_add('month', -1, current_date), '%m')
        GROUP BY application_name
        ORDER BY unique_users DESC

Outputs:
  AverageSessionLengthPerStackCurrentMonthQueryId:
    Description: Query ID of the average session length per stack named query for the current month.
    Value: !Ref AverageSessionLengthPerStackCurrentMonth
  AverageSessionLengthPerStackPreviousMonthQueryId:
    Description: Query ID of the average session length per stack named query for the previous month.
    Value: !Ref AverageSessionLengthPerStackPreviousMonth
  DailySessionCountsCurrentMonthQueryId:
    Description: Query ID of the daily session counts named query for the current month.
    Value: !Ref DailySessionCountsCurrentMonth
  DailySessionCountsPreviousMonthQueryId:
    Description: Query ID of the daily session counts named query for the previous month.
    Value: !Ref DailySessionCountsPreviousMonth
  AllSessionDetailsCurrentMonthQueryId:
    Description: Query ID of the all session details named query for the current month.
    Value: !Ref AllSessionDetailsCurrentMonth
  AllSessionDetailsPreviousMonthQueryId:
    Description: Query ID of the all session details named query for the previous month.
    Value: !Ref AllSessionDetailsPreviousMonth
  StreamingHoursPerUserCurrentMonthQueryId:
    Description: Query ID of the streaming hours per user named query for the current month.
    Value: !Ref StreamingHoursPerUserCurrentMonth
  StreamingHoursPerUserPreviousMonthQueryId:
    Description: Query ID of the streaming hours per user named query for the previous month.
    Value: !Ref StreamingHoursPerUserPreviousMonth
  UniqueUsersPerApplicationCurrentMonthQueryId:
    Description: Query ID of the unique users per application named query for the current month.
    Value: !Ref UniqueUsersPerApplicationCurrentMonth
  UniqueUsersPerApplicationPreviousMonthQueryId:
    Description: Query ID of the unique users per application named query for the previous month.
    Value: !Ref UniqueUsersPerApplicationPreviousMonth

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >
  Self-contained three-tier VPC network foundation. Creates a 10.0.0.0/16 VPC
  with an Internet Gateway and a single NAT Gateway backed by an Elastic IP.
  The first three Availability Zones of the region each receive a public, a
  private application, and a private database subnet allocated from nine
  sequential /24 CIDR blocks. Separate route tables route public subnet
  traffic to the Internet Gateway and private application/database subnet
  traffic to the NAT Gateway, with all subnet-to-route-table associations.

Parameters:
  EnvironmentName:
    Type: String
    Default: multi-tier-app
    Description: Name used to tag and reference stack resources.

Resources:
  VPC:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPC
    Properties:
      CidrBlock: 10.0.0.0/16
      EnableDnsHostnames: true
      EnableDnsSupport: true
      InstanceTenancy: default
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-vpc'

  InternetGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::InternetGateway
    Properties:
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-igw'

  VPCGatewayAttachment:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      InternetGatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  NatElasticIP:
    Type: AWS::EC2::EIP
    DependsOn: VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      Domain: vpc
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-nat-eip'

  PublicSubnet1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs '']
      CidrBlock: 10.0.0.0/24
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-public-az1'
        - Key: Tier
          Value: Public

  PublicSubnet2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [1, !GetAZs '']
      CidrBlock: 10.0.1.0/24
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-public-az2'
        - Key: Tier
          Value: Public

  PublicSubnet3:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [2, !GetAZs '']
      CidrBlock: 10.0.2.0/24
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-public-az3'
        - Key: Tier
          Value: Public

  PrivateAppSubnet1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs '']
      CidrBlock: 10.0.3.0/24
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-app-az1'
        - Key: Tier
          Value: Application

  PrivateAppSubnet2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [1, !GetAZs '']
      CidrBlock: 10.0.4.0/24
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-app-az2'
        - Key: Tier
          Value: Application

  PrivateAppSubnet3:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [2, !GetAZs '']
      CidrBlock: 10.0.5.0/24
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-app-az3'
        - Key: Tier
          Value: Application

  PrivateDbSubnet1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs '']
      CidrBlock: 10.0.6.0/24
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-db-az1'
        - Key: Tier
          Value: Database

  PrivateDbSubnet2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [1, !GetAZs '']
      CidrBlock: 10.0.7.0/24
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-db-az2'
        - Key: Tier
          Value: Database

  PrivateDbSubnet3:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [2, !GetAZs '']
      CidrBlock: 10.0.8.0/24
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-db-az3'
        - Key: Tier
          Value: Database

  NatGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NatGateway
    DependsOn: VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      AllocationId: !GetAtt NatElasticIP.AllocationId
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet1
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-nat-gw'

  PublicRouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-public-rt'

  PublicRoute:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    DependsOn: VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      GatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  PrivateAppRouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-private-app-rt'

  PrivateAppRoute:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateAppRouteTable
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      NatGatewayId: !Ref NatGateway

  PrivateDbRouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-private-db-rt'

  PrivateDbRoute:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateDbRouteTable
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      NatGatewayId: !Ref NatGateway

  PublicSubnet1RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet1
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable

  PublicSubnet2RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet2
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable

  PublicSubnet3RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet3
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable

  PrivateAppSubnet1RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateAppSubnet1
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateAppRouteTable

  PrivateAppSubnet2RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateAppSubnet2
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateAppRouteTable

  PrivateAppSubnet3RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateAppSubnet3
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateAppRouteTable

  PrivateDbSubnet1RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateDbSubnet1
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateDbRouteTable

  PrivateDbSubnet2RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateDbSubnet2
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateDbRouteTable

  PrivateDbSubnet3RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateDbSubnet3
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateDbRouteTable

Outputs:
  VpcId:
    Description: The ID of the VPC.
    Value: !Ref VPC
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-VpcId'

  VpcCidrBlock:
    Description: The CIDR block of the VPC.
    Value: !GetAtt VPC.CidrBlock
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-VpcCidrBlock'

  InternetGatewayId:
    Description: The ID of the Internet Gateway.
    Value: !Ref InternetGateway
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-InternetGatewayId'

  NatGatewayId:
    Description: The ID of the NAT Gateway.
    Value: !Ref NatGateway
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-NatGatewayId'

  NatGatewayElasticIP:
    Description: The Elastic IP address associated with the NAT Gateway.
    Value: !Ref NatElasticIP
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-NatGatewayElasticIP'

  PublicSubnetIds:
    Description: The IDs of the public subnets in all three availability zones.
    Value: !Join [',', [!Ref PublicSubnet1, !Ref PublicSubnet2, !Ref PublicSubnet3]]
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-PublicSubnetIds'

  PrivateAppSubnetIds:
    Description: The IDs of the private application subnets in all three availability zones.

    Export:

  PrivateDbSubnetIds:

    Value: !Join [',', [!Ref PrivateDbSubnet1, !Ref PrivateDbSubnet2, !Ref PrivateDbSubnet3]]
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-PrivateDbSubnetIds'

  PublicRouteTableId:
    Description: The ID of the public route table.

    Export:

  PrivateAppRouteTableId:

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >-
  Amazon QuickSight administrative monitoring and data pipeline environment. Provisions the
  private S3 admin data lake bucket admin-suite-<account-id> and the self-contained Glue ETL
  script bucket through an idempotent, retry-hardened custom resource that adopts pre-existing
  same-account buckets instead of failing on name conflicts, uploads the five Glue ETL scripts,
  defines five AWS Glue 5.0 pipelines (assets access, dataset metadata, folder assets, Q metadata
  and datasource properties) scheduled in a staggered daily sequence starting at 02:00 UTC, and
  creates five DirectPut Kinesis Data Firehose delivery streams and five CloudWatch metric
  streams covering QuickSight ingestion/dataset, dashboard/visual, SPICE, Q search index and
  Q action metrics, all consolidated under a single IAM role for downstream Athena analytics.

Parameters:
  ScriptBucketName:
    Type: String
    Default: admin-console-cfn-dataprepare-code
    Description: Name of the S3 bucket that stores the Glue ETL scripts. The bucket is provisioned and populated by this stack so the solution is fully self-contained.
    AllowedPattern: '^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9-]{1,61}[a-z0-9]$'
    ConstraintDescription: Value must be a valid S3 bucket name (3-63 characters, lowercase letters, numbers and hyphens).

Resources:
  AdminSuiteRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      Description: Single consolidated execution role for the QuickSight admin suite, assumed by Glue, Firehose, CloudFormation, CloudWatch metric streams and the provisioning Lambda.
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: ConsolidatedServiceTrust
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service:
                - glue.amazonaws.com
                - firehose.amazonaws.com
                - lambda.amazonaws.com
                - cloudformation.amazonaws.com
                - cloudwatch.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: admin-suite-consolidated-policy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: S3DataLakeAndScriptAccess

  AdminSuiteProvisionerFunction:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    Properties:
      Description: Idempotently provisions or adopts the admin data lake and script buckets and uploads the Glue ETL scripts.
      Runtime: python3.12
      Handler: index.handler
      Timeout: 180
      MemorySize: 128
      Role: !GetAtt AdminSuiteRole.Arn
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import json,time,boto3,cfnresponse

          TPL="import sys, json, datetime\nimport boto3\nfrom awsglue.utils import getResolvedOptions\nargs=getResolvedOptions(sys.argv,['OUTPUT_BUCKET','OUTPUT_PREFIX'])\nqs=boto3.client('quicksight')\ns3=boto3.client('s3')\nac=boto3.client('sts').get_caller_identity()['Account']\nJ=__JOBS__\nP='__PART__'\nrec=[]\nfor fn,key,ex in J:\n    kw={'AwsAccountId':ac}\n    kw.update(ex)\n    tok=None\n    while True:\n        if tok:\n            kw['NextToken']=tok\n        r=getattr(qs,fn)(**kw)\n        rec.extend(r.get(key,[]))\n        tok=r.get('NextToken')\n        if not tok:\n            break\nts=datetime.datetime.utcnow()\nk='%s/%s/%04d/%02d/%02d/%s-%s.json'%(args['OUTPUT_PREFIX'],P,ts.year,ts.month,ts.day,P,ts.strftime('%Y%m%dT%H%M%SZ'))\ns3.put_object(Bucket=args['OUTPUT_BUCKET'],Key=k,Body=chr(10).join(json.dumps(x,default=str) for x in rec).encode('utf-8'))\nprint('ok '+k)\n"

          S={'assets_access.py':[('list_users','UserList',{'IdentityType':'QUICKSIGHT'}),('list_groups','GroupList',{'IdentityType':'QUICKSIGHT'}),('list_iam_policy_assignments','IAMPolicyAssignments',{})],'dataset_metadata.py':[('list_data_sets','DataSetSummaries',{})],'folder_assets.py':[('list_folders','FolderSummaryList',{})],'q_metadata.py':[('list_topics','TopicsSummaries',{})],'datasource_properties.py':[('list_data_sources','DataSources',{})]}

          def rt(f,n=5):
              e=None
              for i in range(n):
                  try:
                      return f()
                  except Exception as x:
                      e=x
                      time.sleep(3)
              raise e

          def h(event,context):
              p=event['ResourceProperties']
              s3=boto3.client('s3')
              rg=s3.meta.region_name
              ab=p['AdminBucketName']
              sb=p['ScriptBucketName']
              try:
                  if event['RequestType'] in ('Create','Update'):
                      for b in (ab,sb):
                          try:
                              s3.head_bucket(Bucket=b)
                          except Exception:
                              kw={'Bucket':b}
                              if rg!='us-east-1':
                                  kw['CreateBucketConfiguration']={'LocationConstraint':rg}
                              try:
                                  rt(lambda: s3.create_bucket(**kw))
                              except Exception:
                                  s3.head_bucket(Bucket=b)
                      for n,j in S.items():
                          body=TPL.replace('__PART__',n[:-3]).replace('__JOBS__',json.dumps(j))
                          rt(lambda n=n,body=body: s3.put_object(Bucket=sb,Key='scripts/'+n,Body=body.encode('utf-8'),ContentType='text/x-python'))
                  else:
                      try:
                          for pg in s3.get_paginator('list_objects_v2').paginate(Bucket=sb,Prefix='scripts/'):
                              ob=[{'Key':o['Key']} for o in pg.get('Contents',[])]
                              if ob:
                                  s3.delete_objects(Bucket=sb,Delete={'Objects':ob})
                      except Exception:
                          pass
                  cfnresponse.send(event,context,cfnresponse.SUCCESS,{},'provisioner')
              except Exception as ex:
                  print(str(ex))
                  cfnresponse.send(event,context,cfnresponse.FAILED,{'Message':str(ex)[:190]},'provisioner')
