AWSTemplateFormatVersion: "2010-09-09"
Description: >-
  Content-level PII classification scanner for objects exposed through an S3 Access Point. A
  Lambda lists objects through the access point (pagination, deterministic sampling, chunking
  of large files), calls Amazon Comprehend DetectPiiEntities on each chunk, and writes
  per-file reports to a DynamoDB table, with optional SNS notifications. By default the
  scanner runs outside any VPC (internet-origin access points only). If the access point
  network origin is VPC, supply VpcId, SubnetIds, RouteTableIds and optionally SecurityGroupId
  so the scanner runs inside that VPC; inputs are normalized through a custom resource. In VPC
  mode the stack can also create the S3 and DynamoDB gateway endpoints plus the Comprehend and
  SNS interface endpoints (CreateVpcEndpoints defaults to true; set it to false if the VPC
  already has any of those four endpoints, since duplicates fail and roll back the stack). If
  no security group is supplied, one is created in the VPC.

Metadata:
  AWS::CloudFormation::Interface:
    ParameterGroups:
      - Label:
          default: Scan target
        Parameters:
          - AccessPointArn
      - Label:
          default: VPC configuration (required when the access point network origin is VPC)
        Parameters:
          - VpcId
          - SubnetIds
          - SecurityGroupId
          - RouteTableIds
          - CreateVpcEndpoints
      - Label:
          default: Scanner configuration
        Parameters:
          - LambdaMemory
          - LambdaTimeout
          - LanguageCode
          - MaxFilesPerInvocation
          - SamplePercent
      - Label:
          default: Notifications and logging
        Parameters:
          - SnsTopicArn
          - LogRetentionDays

Parameters:
  AccessPointArn:
    Type: String
    Default: "arn:aws:s3:us-east-1:123456789012:accesspoint/pii-scanner-replace-me"
    Description: Full ARN of the S3 Access Point whose exposed objects should be scanned. Replace the default placeholder with your access point ARN (for example arn:aws:s3:us-east-1:111122223333:accesspoint/my-ap).
    AllowedPattern: "^arn:(aws|aws-cn|aws-us-gov):s3:.*:[0-9]{12}:accesspoint/.+$"
    ConstraintDescription: Must be a valid S3 access point ARN.

  VpcId:
    Type: String
    Default: ""
    Description: ID of the VPC that hosts the access point. Leave empty (default) to run the scanner outside any VPC (internet-origin access points only). Required together with SubnetIds when the access point network origin is VPC.

  SubnetIds:
    Type: CommaDelimitedList
    Default: ""
    Description: Comma-separated list of private subnet IDs (in the access point VPC) where the scanner Lambda ENIs will be placed. Required when VpcId is set.

  SecurityGroupId:
    Type: String
    Default: ""
    Description: Optional ID of an existing security group in the access point VPC to attach to the scanner Lambda ENIs (must allow outbound HTTPS to the service endpoints). If left empty, the stack creates a suitable security group.

  RouteTableIds:
    Type: CommaDelimitedList
    Default: ""
    Description: Comma-separated list of route table IDs (in the access point VPC) to associate with the S3 and DynamoDB gateway endpoints. Required when VpcId is set and CreateVpcEndpoints is true.

  CreateVpcEndpoints:
    Type: String
    Default: "true"
    Description: Whether to create the S3 and DynamoDB gateway endpoints plus the Comprehend and SNS interface endpoints in the target VPC. Set to false if the VPC already has any of these four endpoints, because a duplicate interface endpoint or a second S3 gateway endpoint bound to the same route tables fails and rolls back the stack.
    AllowedValues:
      - "true"
      - "false"

  LambdaMemory:
    Type: Number
    Default: 512
    Description: Memory (MB) allocated to the scanner Lambda function.
    MinValue: 128
    MaxValue: 10240

  LambdaTimeout:
    Type: Number
    Default: 600
    Description: Timeout (seconds) of the scanner Lambda function.
    MinValue: 60
    MaxValue: 900

  LanguageCode:
    Type: String
    Default: en
    Description: Default Comprehend language code used for PII detection (can be overridden per invocation with language_code).
    AllowedValues:
      - en
      - es
      - fr
      - de
      - it
      - pt
      - hi
      - ar
      - ja
      - ko
      - zh
      - zh-TW

  MaxFilesPerInvocation:
    Type: Number
    Default: 500
    Description: Default maximum number of files scanned per invocation (cost and runtime control; can be overridden per invocation with max_files).
    MinValue: 1
    MaxValue: 10000

  SamplePercent:
    Type: Number
    Default: 100
    Description: Default percentage of objects to sample (deterministic per object key; can be overridden per invocation with sample_percent).
    MinValue: 1
    MaxValue: 100

  SnsTopicArn:
    Type: String
    Default: ""
    Description: Optional ARN of an existing SNS topic that receives a summary notification after each scan. Leave empty to disable notifications.

  LogRetentionDays:
    Type: Number
    Default: 30
    Description: CloudWatch Logs retention (in days) for the scanner function log group.
    AllowedValues:
      - 1
      - 3
      - 5
      - 7
      - 14
      - 30
      - 60
      - 90
      - 180
      - 365

Conditions:
  HasVpc: !Not
    - !Equals
      - !Ref VpcId
      - ""
  HasProvidedSecurityGroup: !Not
    - !Equals
      - !Ref SecurityGroupId
      - ""
  CreateScannerSecurityGroup: !And
    - !Condition HasVpc
    - !Not
      - !Condition HasProvidedSecurityGroup
  CreateEndpoints: !And
    - !Condition HasVpc
    - !Equals
      - !Ref CreateVpcEndpoints
      - "true"
  HasSnsTopic: !Not
    - !Equals
      - !Ref SnsTopicArn
      - ""

Resources:
  PiiReportTable:
    Type: AWS::DynamoDB::Table
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      TableName: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-pii-reports"
      BillingMode: PAY_PER_REQUEST
      AttributeDefinitions:
        - AttributeName: ScanId
          AttributeType: S
        - AttributeName: ObjectKey
          AttributeType: S
      KeySchema:
        - AttributeName: ScanId
          KeyType: HASH
        - AttributeName: ObjectKey
          KeyType: RANGE
      SSESpecification:
        SSEEnabled: true
      PointInTimeRecoverySpecification:
        PointInTimeRecoveryEnabled: true

  NormalizerRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Condition: HasVpc
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSLambdaBasicExecutionRole

  NormalizerLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    Condition: HasVpc
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Sub "/aws/lambda/${AWS::StackName}-vpc-input-normalizer"
      RetentionInDays: !Ref LogRetentionDays

  VpcConfigNormalizerFunction:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    Condition: HasVpc
    DependsOn:
      - NormalizerLogGroup
    Properties:
      FunctionName: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-vpc-input-normalizer"
      Description: Echoes the VPC inputs (VPC ID, subnet IDs, security group ID, route table IDs) back as custom resource attributes.
      Role: !GetAtt NormalizerRole.Arn
      Runtime: python3.12
      Handler: index.handler
      MemorySize: 128
      Timeout: 15
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import cfnresponse

          PHYSICAL_ID = "vpc-input-normalizer"


          def handler(event, context):
              try:
                  request_type = event.get("RequestType", "Create")
                  if request_type == "Delete":
                      cfnresponse.send(event, context, cfnresponse.SUCCESS, {}, PHYSICAL_ID)
                      return
                  resource_properties = event.get("ResourceProperties") or {}
                  data = {}
                  for key, value in resource_properties.items():
                      if key == "ServiceToken":
                          continue
                      data[key] = value
                  cfnresponse.send(event, context, cfnresponse.SUCCESS, data, PHYSICAL_ID)
              except Exception as error:
                  cfnresponse.send(event, context, cfnresponse.FAILED, {"Error": str(error)}, PHYSICAL_ID)

  VpcConfigNormalizer:
    Type: AWS::CloudFormation::CustomResource
    Condition: HasVpc
    Properties:
      ServiceToken: !GetAtt VpcConfigNormalizerFunction.Arn
      VpcId: !Ref VpcId
      SubnetIdsCsv: !Join
        - ","
        - !Ref SubnetIds
      SecurityGroupId: !Ref SecurityGroupId
      RouteTableIdsCsv: !Join
        - ","
        - !Ref RouteTableIds

  ScannerSecurityGroup:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroup
    Condition: CreateScannerSecurityGroup
    Properties:
      GroupDescription: !Sub "Outbound HTTPS for the ${AWS::StackName} PII scanner Lambda"
      VpcId: !GetAtt VpcConfigNormalizer.VpcId
      SecurityGroupEgress:
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 443
          ToPort: 443
          CidrIp: 0.0.0.0/0
          Description: Allow HTTPS to the S3, DynamoDB, Comprehend and SNS endpoints

  EndpointSecurityGroup:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroup
    Condition: CreateEndpoints
    Properties:
      GroupDescription: !Sub "Inbound HTTPS for the ${AWS::StackName} Comprehend and SNS interface endpoints"
      VpcId: !GetAtt VpcConfigNormalizer.VpcId

  EndpointIngressFromScanner:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroupIngress
    Condition: CreateEndpoints
    Properties:
      GroupId: !GetAtt EndpointSecurityGroup.GroupId
      SourceSecurityGroupId: !If
        - HasProvidedSecurityGroup
        - !GetAtt VpcConfigNormalizer.SecurityGroupId
        - !GetAtt ScannerSecurityGroup.GroupId
      IpProtocol: tcp
      FromPort: 443
      ToPort: 443
      Description: Allow HTTPS from the PII scanner Lambda security group

  S3GatewayEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Condition: CreateEndpoints
    Properties:
      VpcId: !GetAtt VpcConfigNormalizer.VpcId
      ServiceName: !Sub "com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.s3"
      VpcEndpointType: Gateway
      RouteTableIds: !Split
        - ","
        - !GetAtt VpcConfigNormalizer.RouteTableIdsCsv

  DynamoDbGatewayEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Condition: CreateEndpoints
    Properties:
      VpcId: !GetAtt VpcConfigNormalizer.VpcId
      ServiceName: !Sub "com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.dynamodb"
      VpcEndpointType: Gateway
      RouteTableIds: !Split
        - ","
        - !GetAtt VpcConfigNormalizer.RouteTableIdsCsv

  ComprehendInterfaceEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Condition: CreateEndpoints
    Properties:
      VpcId: !GetAtt VpcConfigNormalizer.VpcId
      ServiceName: !Sub "com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.comprehend"
      VpcEndpointType: Interface
      SubnetIds: !Split
        - ","
        - !GetAtt VpcConfigNormalizer.SubnetIdsCsv
      SecurityGroupIds:
        - !GetAtt EndpointSecurityGroup.GroupId
      PrivateDnsEnabled: true

  SnsInterfaceEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Condition: CreateEndpoints
    Properties:
      VpcId: !GetAtt VpcConfigNormalizer.VpcId
      ServiceName: !Sub "com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.sns"
      VpcEndpointType: Interface
      SubnetIds: !Split
        - ","
        - !GetAtt VpcConfigNormalizer.SubnetIdsCsv
      SecurityGroupIds:
        - !GetAtt EndpointSecurityGroup.GroupId
      PrivateDnsEnabled: true

  ScannerLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Sub "/aws/lambda/${AWS::StackName}-pii-scanner"
      RetentionInDays: !Ref LogRetentionDays

  ScannerRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSLambdaBasicExecutionRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: AccessPointRead
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: "2012-10-17"
            Statement:
              - Sid: ListObjectsThroughAccessPoint
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - s3:ListBucket
                Resource: !Ref AccessPointArn
              - Sid: ReadObjectsThroughAccessPoint
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - s3:GetObject
                Resource: !Sub "${AccessPointArn}/object/*"
        - PolicyName: ComprehendDetect
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: "2012-10-17"
            Statement:
              - Sid: DetectPiiEntities
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - comprehend:DetectPiiEntities
                Resource: "*"
        - PolicyName: ReportTableWrite
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: "2012-10-17"
            Statement:
              - Sid: WriteClassificationReports
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - dynamodb:PutItem
                  - dynamodb:UpdateItem
                  - dynamodb:Query
                  - dynamodb:DescribeTable
                Resource: !GetAtt PiiReportTable.Arn
        - PolicyName: PublishScanNotifications
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: "2012-10-17"
            Statement:
              - Sid: PublishScanNotifications
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - sns:Publish
                Resource: !If
                  - HasSnsTopic
                  - !Ref SnsTopicArn
                  - "*"

  ScannerFunction:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    DependsOn:
      - ScannerLogGroup
    Properties:
      FunctionName: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-pii-scanner"
      Description: Scans objects exposed through an S3 Access Point for PII using Amazon Comprehend DetectPiiEntities.
      Role: !GetAtt ScannerRole.Arn
      Runtime: python3.12
      Handler: index.lambda_handler
      Architectures:
        - arm64
      MemorySize: !Ref LambdaMemory
      Timeout: !Ref LambdaTimeout
      Environment:
        Variables:
          ACCESS_POINT_ARN: !Ref AccessPointArn
          REPORT_TABLE: !Ref PiiReportTable
          LANGUAGE_CODE: !Ref LanguageCode
          MAX_FILES_PER_INVOCATION: !Sub "${MaxFilesPerInvocation}"
          SAMPLE_PERCENT: !Sub "${SamplePercent}"
          SNS_TOPIC_ARN: !Ref SnsTopicArn
          DEPLOYED_IN_VPC: !If
            - HasVpc
            - "true"
            - "false"
          LAMBDA_TIMEOUT_SECONDS: !Sub "${LambdaTimeout}"
          CHUNK_BYTES: "95000"
          MAX_BYTES_PER_OBJECT: "1048576"
          TIMEOUT_BUFFER_SECONDS: "30"
      VpcConfig: !If
        - HasVpc
        - SubnetIds: !Split
            - ","
            - !GetAtt VpcConfigNormalizer.SubnetIdsCsv
          SecurityGroupIds: !If
            - HasProvidedSecurityGroup
            - - !GetAtt VpcConfigNormalizer.SecurityGroupId
            - - !GetAtt ScannerSecurityGroup.GroupId
        - !Ref AWS::NoValue
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import json
          import os
          import time
          import uuid
          import hashlib
          import logging
          from datetime import datetime, timezone

          import boto3
          from botocore.exceptions import BotoCoreError, ClientError

          LOGGER = logging.getLogger()
          LOGGER.setLevel(logging.INFO)

          s3_client = boto3.client("s3")
          s3control_client = boto3.client("s3control")
          comprehend_client = boto3.client("comprehend")
          sns_client = boto3.client("sns")
          dynamodb_resource = boto3.resource("dynamodb")

          ACCESS_POINT_ARN = os.environ["ACCESS_POINT_ARN"]
          REPORT_TABLE_NAME = os.environ["REPORT_TABLE"]
          DEFAULT_LANGUAGE = os.environ.get("LANGUAGE_CODE", "en")
          DEFAULT_MAX_FILES = int(os.environ.get("MAX_FILES_PER_INVOCATION", "500"))
          DEFAULT_SAMPLE_PERCENT = int(os.environ.get("SAMPLE_PERCENT", "100"))
          SNS_TOPIC_ARN = os.environ.get("SNS_TOPIC_ARN", "")
          DEPLOYED_IN_VPC = os.environ.get("DEPLOYED_IN_VPC", "false").lower() == "true"
          LAMBDA_TIMEOUT_SECONDS = int(os.environ.get("LAMBDA_TIMEOUT_SECONDS", "600"))
          CHUNK_BYTES = int(os.environ.get("CHUNK_BYTES", "95000"))
          MAX_BYTES_PER_OBJECT = int(os.environ.get("MAX_BYTES_PER_OBJECT", "1048576"))
          TIMEOUT_BUFFER_SECONDS = int(os.environ.get("TIMEOUT_BUFFER_SECONDS", "30"))
          MAX_STORED_ENTITIES = 100

          report_table = dynamodb_resource.Table(REPORT_TABLE_NAME)


          def parse_access_point_arn(access_point_arn):
              parts = access_point_arn.split(":")
              if len(parts) < 6 or not parts[5].startswith("accesspoint/"):
                  raise ValueError("ACCESS_POINT_ARN is not a valid S3 access point ARN: " + access_point_arn)
              return parts[4], parts[5].split("/", 1)[1]


          def get_network_origin():
              account_id, access_point_name = parse_access_point_arn(ACCESS_POINT_ARN)
              response = s3control_client.get_access_point(AccountId=account_id, Name=access_point_name)
              return response.get("NetworkOrigin", "Internet"), response.get("VpcConfiguration") or {}


          def verify_network_origin():
              # Best-effort check: requires s3control:GetAccessPoint on the execution role.
              # Operators who require strict verification can attach that permission to the
              # scanner role out of band. When the call is not authorized or fails (for
              # example while the placeholder access point ARN is still in use), the scan
              # proceeds with a warning instead of aborting.
              try:
                  origin, vpc_configuration = get_network_origin()
              except (ClientError, BotoCoreError) as exc:
                  LOGGER.warning(
                      "Could not verify the access point network origin "
                      "(the execution role may lack s3control:GetAccessPoint, or the "
                      "access point ARN may not exist yet): %s", exc)
                  return "Unknown", {}
              LOGGER.info("Access point network origin: %s (VPC configuration: %s)", origin, vpc_configuration)
              if origin == "VPC" and not DEPLOYED_IN_VPC:
                  raise RuntimeError(
                      "Access point {0} has network origin VPC (VPC ID: {1}) but the scanner function is "
                      "deployed outside any VPC. Update the stack with VpcId, SubnetIds and RouteTableIds "
                      "(and optionally SecurityGroupId) so the scanner runs inside the same VPC as the "
                      "access point.".format(ACCESS_POINT_ARN, vpc_configuration.get("VpcId", "unknown"))
                  )
              return origin, vpc_configuration


          def is_sampled(object_key, sample_percent):
              if sample_percent >= 100:
                  return True
              digest = hashlib.md5(object_key.encode("utf-8")).hexdigest()
              return (int(digest[:8], 16) % 100) < sample_percent


          def read_object_head(object_key, size_bytes):
              bytes_to_read = min(size_bytes, MAX_BYTES_PER_OBJECT)
              range_header = "bytes=0-{0}".format(bytes_to_read - 1)
              response = s3_client.get_object(Bucket=ACCESS_POINT_ARN, Key=object_key, Range=range_header)
              return response["Body"].read(), bytes_to_read < size_bytes


          def split_text_chunks(text, max_chunk_bytes):
              # Comprehend DetectPiiEntities accepts at most 100 KB of UTF-8 text per call,
              # so large files are split into safe chunks on character boundaries.
              chunks = []
              position = 0
              total_length = len(text)
              while position < total_length:
                  end = min(position + max_chunk_bytes, total_length)
                  while end > position and len(text[position:end].encode("utf-8")) > max_chunk_bytes:
                      end -= max(1, (len(text[position:end].encode("utf-8")) - max_chunk_bytes) // 4)
                  if end < total_length:
                      newline_cut = text.rfind("\n", position, end)
                      space_cut = text.rfind(" ", position, end)
                      whitespace_cut = max(newline_cut, space_cut)
                      if whitespace_cut > position and (end - whitespace_cut) <= (max_chunk_bytes // 4):
                          end = whitespace_cut + 1
                  chunks.append(text[position:end])
                  position = end
              return chunks


          def detect_pii_in_chunks(chunks, language_code):
              entity_type_counts = {}
              stored_entities = []
              total_entities = 0
              for chunk_index, chunk_text in enumerate(chunks):
                  response = comprehend_client.detect_pii_entities(Text=chunk_text, LanguageCode=language_code)
                  for entity in response.get("Entities", []):
                      total_entities += 1
                      entity_type = entity["Type"]
                      entity_type_counts[entity_type] = entity_type_counts.get(entity_type, 0) + 1
                      if len(stored_entities) < MAX_STORED_ENTITIES:
                          stored_entities.append({
                              "Type": entity_type,
                              "Confidence": round(float(entity["Score"]), 4),
                              "BeginOffset": int(entity["BeginOffset"]),
                              "EndOffset": int(entity["EndOffset"]),
                              "Chunk": chunk_index,
                          })
              return total_entities, entity_type_counts, stored_entities


          def scan_object(object_key, size_bytes, language_code, scan_id, sample_percent):
              scanned_at = datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat()
              if size_bytes == 0:
                  report_table.put_item(Item={
                      "ScanId": scan_id,
                      "ObjectKey": object_key,
                      "AccessPointArn": ACCESS_POINT_ARN,
                      "FileSizeBytes": 0,
                      "ScannedAt": scanned_at,
                      "LanguageCode": language_code,
                      "Status": "SKIPPED_EMPTY",
                      "PiiEntityCount": 0,
                      "PiiDetected": False,
                      "SamplePercent": sample_percent,
                  })
                  return {"piiEntityCount": 0, "entityTypes": {}}
              body, file_truncated = read_object_head(object_key, size_bytes)
              text = body.decode("utf-8", errors="replace")
              chunks = split_text_chunks(text, CHUNK_BYTES)
              total_entities, entity_type_counts, stored_entities = detect_pii_in_chunks(chunks, language_code)
              report_table.put_item(Item={
                  "ScanId": scan_id,
                  "ObjectKey": object_key,
                  "AccessPointArn": ACCESS_POINT_ARN,
                  "FileSizeBytes": size_bytes,
                  "ScannedAt": scanned_at,
                  "LanguageCode": language_code,
                  "Status": "COMPLETED",
                  "PiiEntityCount": total_entities,
                  "PiiDetected": total_entities > 0,
                  "EntityTypes": entity_type_counts,
                  "Entities": stored_entities,
                  "ChunksScanned": len(chunks),
                  "FileTruncated": file_truncated,
                  "SamplePercent": sample_percent,
              })
              return {"piiEntityCount": total_entities, "entityTypes": entity_type_counts}


          def record_failed_object(object_key, size_bytes, language_code, scan_id, error_message):
              try:
                  report_table.put_item(Item={
                      "ScanId": scan_id,
                      "ObjectKey": object_key,
                      "AccessPointArn": ACCESS_POINT_ARN,
                      "FileSizeBytes": size_bytes,
                      "ScannedAt": datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(),
                      "LanguageCode": language_code,
                      "Status": "FAILED",
                      "ErrorMessage": str(error_message)[:2000],
                      "PiiEntityCount": 0,
                      "PiiDetected": False,
                  })
              except ClientError as db_error:
                  LOGGER.error("Could not record failure for %s: %s", object_key, db_error)


          def publish_scan_summary(scan_id, files_scanned, files_with_pii, total_pii_entities,
                                   entity_type_counts, files_failed):
              if not SNS_TOPIC_ARN or (files_scanned == 0 and files_failed == 0):
                  return
              summary = {
                  "scanId": scan_id,
                  "accessPointArn": ACCESS_POINT_ARN,
                  "filesScanned": files_scanned,
                  "filesFailed": files_failed,
                  "filesWithPii": files_with_pii,
                  "totalPiiEntities": total_pii_entities,
                  "entityTypeCounts": entity_type_counts,
                  "region": os.environ.get("AWS_REGION", ""),
              }
              subject = "PII scan {0}: {1} file(s) with PII".format(scan_id[:8], files_with_pii)[:99]
              try:
                  sns_client.publish(
                      TopicArn=SNS_TOPIC_ARN,
                      Subject=subject,
                      Message=json.dumps(summary, indent=2, default=str),
                  )
              except ClientError as publish_error:
                  LOGGER.error("Failed to publish SNS scan summary: %s", publish_error)


          def lambda_handler(event, context):
              started = time.time()
              deadline = started + max(LAMBDA_TIMEOUT_SECONDS - TIMEOUT_BUFFER_SECONDS, 5)
              event = event or {}
              origin, _ = verify_network_origin()

              language_code = event.get("language_code") or DEFAULT_LANGUAGE
              max_files = max(1, int(event.get("max_files", DEFAULT_MAX_FILES)))
              sample_percent = min(100, max(1, int(event.get("sample_percent", DEFAULT_SAMPLE_PERCENT))))
              prefix = event.get("prefix", "")
              last_key = event.get("start_after", "")
              scan_id = event.get("scan_id") or str(uuid.uuid4())

              files_scanned = 0
              files_failed = 0
              files_skipped_by_sampling = 0
              files_with_pii = 0
              total_pii_entities = 0
              aggregate_entity_types = {}
              more_to_scan = False

              while True:
                  if files_scanned >= max_files or time.time() > deadline:
                      more_to_scan = True
                      break
                  list_kwargs = {"Bucket": ACCESS_POINT_ARN, "MaxKeys": min(1000, max_files + 1)}
                  if prefix:
                      list_kwargs["Prefix"] = prefix
                  if last_key:
                      list_kwargs["StartAfter"] = last_key
                  try:
                      listing = s3_client.list_objects_v2(**list_kwargs)
                  except (ClientError, BotoCoreError) as list_error:
                      LOGGER.error("Listing objects through the access point failed: %s", list_error)
                      return {
                          "scanId": scan_id,
                          "accessPointArn": ACCESS_POINT_ARN,
                          "networkOrigin": origin,
                          "languageCode": language_code,
                          "samplePercent": sample_percent,
                          "filesScanned": files_scanned,
                          "filesFailed": files_failed,
                          "filesSkippedBySampling": files_skipped_by_sampling,
                          "filesWithPii": files_with_pii,
                          "totalPiiEntities": total_pii_entities,
                          "entityTypeCounts": aggregate_entity_types,
                          "error": "listing_failed",
                          "errorMessage": str(list_error)[:1000],
                          "nextStartAfter": "",
                      }
                  objects = listing.get("Contents", [])
                  if not objects:
                      break
                  object_count = len(objects)
                  stop_early = False
                  for index, obj in enumerate(objects):
                      object_key = obj["Key"]
                      if files_scanned >= max_files or time.time() > deadline:
                          if index < object_count - 1 or listing.get("IsTruncated", False):
                              more_to_scan = True
                          stop_early = True
                          break
                      last_key = object_key
                      if not is_sampled(object_key, sample_percent):
                          files_skipped_by_sampling += 1
                          continue
                      try:
                          outcome = scan_object(object_key, obj.get("Size", 0), language_code, scan_id, sample_percent)
                      except (ClientError, BotoCoreError) as scan_error:
                          files_failed += 1
                          LOGGER.error("Scanning %s failed: %s", object_key, scan_error)
                          record_failed_object(object_key, obj.get("Size", 0), language_code, scan_id, scan_error)
                          continue
                      files_scanned += 1
                      pii_count = outcome["piiEntityCount"]
                      if pii_count > 0:
                          files_with_pii += 1
                          total_pii_entities += pii_count
                          for entity_type, count in outcome["entityTypes"].items():
                              aggregate_entity_types[entity_type] = aggregate_entity_types.get(entity_type, 0) + count
                  if stop_early:
                      break
                  if not listing.get("IsTruncated", False):
                      break

              publish_scan_summary(scan_id, files_scanned, files_with_pii, total_pii_entities,
                                   aggregate_entity_types, files_failed)

              return {
                  "scanId": scan_id,
                  "accessPointArn": ACCESS_POINT_ARN,
                  "networkOrigin": origin,
                  "languageCode": language_code,
                  "samplePercent": sample_percent,
                  "filesScanned": files_scanned,
                  "filesFailed": files_failed,
                  "filesSkippedBySampling": files_skipped_by_sampling,
                  "filesWithPii": files_with_pii,
                  "totalPiiEntities": total_pii_entities,
                  "entityTypeCounts": aggregate_entity_types,
                  "nextStartAfter": last_key if more_to_scan else "",
              }

Outputs:
  ScannerFunctionArn:
    Description: ARN of the PII scanner Lambda function.
    Value: !GetAtt ScannerFunction.Arn
  ReportTableName:
    Description: Name of the DynamoDB table that stores the PII classification reports.
    Value: !Ref PiiReportTable
  ReportTableArn:
    Description: ARN of the DynamoDB classification report table.
    Value: !GetAtt PiiReportTable.Arn
  ExampleCliInvocation:
    Description: Example CLI command to invoke the scanner and inspect the JSON result.
    Value: !Sub |-
      aws lambda invoke --function-name ${ScannerFunction} \
        --payload '{"max_files":100,"sample_percent":100,"prefix":""}' \
        --cli-binary-format raw-in-base64-out response.json && cat response.json

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >-
  Creates two AWS Glue Data Catalog databases and the tables that describe the
  air-routes data set in both its property graph (LPG) and RDF forms. The
  tables use comma separated values and carry the parameters required by the
  AWS Glue connector for Amazon Neptune, so that data can be loaded from
  Amazon S3 into a Neptune graph or exported from a Neptune graph to Amazon S3.

Parameters:
  DatabaseName:
    Type: String
    Default: graph-database
    Description: The name of the Glue database that contains the property graph (LPG) tables.
  RdfDatabaseName:
    Type: String
    Default: graph-database-rdf
    Description: The name of the Glue database that contains the RDF tables.

Resources:
  GraphDatabase:
    Type: AWS::Glue::Database
    Properties:
      CatalogId: !Ref AWS::AccountId
      DatabaseInput:
        Name: !Ref DatabaseName
        Description: >-
          A database containing tables that represent the property graph (LPG)
          form of the air-routes data set.

  GraphDatabaseRdf:
    Type: AWS::Glue::Database
    Properties:
      CatalogId: !Ref AWS::AccountId
      DatabaseInput:
        Name: !Ref RdfDatabaseName
        Description: >-
          A database containing tables that represent the RDF form of the
          air-routes data set.

  AirportTable:
    Type: AWS::Glue::Table
    Properties:
      CatalogId: !Ref AWS::AccountId
      DatabaseName: !Ref GraphDatabase
      TableInput:
        Name: airport
        Description: >-
          A table of airport vertices.
        TableType: EXTERNAL_TABLE
        Parameters:
          endpointType: neptune
          label: vertex
          outputFormat: csv
          fieldSeparator: ','
        StorageDescriptor:
          Columns:
            - Name: code
              Type: string
            - Name: country
              Type: string
            - Name: desc
              Type: string
            - Name: elev
              Type: int
            - Name: icao
              Type: string
            - Name: lat
              Type: double
            - Name: lon
              Type: double
            - Name: region
              Type: string
            - Name: runways
              Type: int
            - Name: type
              Type: string
          InputFormat: org.apache.hadoop.mapred.TextInputFormat
          OutputFormat: org.apache.hadoop.hive.ql.io.HiveIgnoreKeyTextOutputFormat
          SerdeInfo:
            SerializationLibrary: org.apache.hadoop.hive.serde2.OpenCSVSerde
            Parameters:
              separatorChar: ','
              quoteChar: '"'

  CountryTable:
    Type: AWS::Glue::Table
    Properties:
      CatalogId: !Ref AWS::AccountId
      DatabaseName: !Ref GraphDatabase
      TableInput:
        Name: country
        Description: >-
          A table of country vertices.
        TableType: EXTERNAL_TABLE
        Parameters:
          endpointType: neptune
          label: vertex
          outputFormat: csv
          fieldSeparator: ','
        StorageDescriptor:
          Columns:
            - Name: code
              Type: string
            - Name: desc
              Type: string
          InputFormat: org.apache.hadoop.mapred.TextInputFormat
          OutputFormat: org.apache.hadoop.hive.ql.io.HiveIgnoreKeyTextOutputFormat
          SerdeInfo:
            SerializationLibrary: org.apache.hadoop.hive.serde2.OpenCSVSerde
            Parameters:
              separatorChar: ','
              quoteChar: '"'

  ContinentTable:
    Type: AWS::Glue::Table
    Properties:
      CatalogId: !Ref AWS::AccountId
      DatabaseName: !Ref GraphDatabase
      TableInput:
        Name: continent
        Description: >-
          A table of continent vertices.
        TableType: EXTERNAL_TABLE
        Parameters:
          endpointType: neptune
          label: vertex
          outputFormat: csv
          fieldSeparator: ','
        StorageDescriptor:
          Columns:
            - Name: code
              Type: string
            - Name: desc
              Type: string
          InputFormat: org.apache.hadoop.mapred.TextInputFormat
          OutputFormat: org.apache.hadoop.hive.ql.io.HiveIgnoreKeyTextOutputFormat
          SerdeInfo:
            SerializationLibrary: org.apache.hadoop.hive.serde2.OpenCSVSerde
            Parameters:
              separatorChar: ','
              quoteChar: '"'

  RouteTable:
    Type: AWS::Glue::Table
    Properties:
      CatalogId: !Ref AWS::AccountId
      DatabaseName: !Ref GraphDatabase
      TableInput:
        Name: route
        Description: >-
          A table of route edges.
        TableType: EXTERNAL_TABLE
        Parameters:
          endpointType: neptune
          label: edge
          outputFormat: csv
          fieldSeparator: ','
        StorageDescriptor:
          Columns:
            - Name: dist
              Type: int
          InputFormat: org.apache.hadoop.mapred.TextInputFormat
          OutputFormat: org.apache.hadoop.hive.ql.io.HiveIgnoreKeyTextOutputFormat
          SerdeInfo:
            SerializationLibrary: org.apache.hadoop.hive.serde2.OpenCSVSerde
            Parameters:
              separatorChar: ','
              quoteChar: '"'

  CustomAirportTable:
    Type: AWS::Glue::Table
    Properties:
      CatalogId: !Ref AWS::AccountId
      DatabaseName: !Ref GraphDatabase
      TableInput:
        Name: customairport
        Description: >-
          A view that uses a Gremlin traversal query to select the source and
          destination airport codes for up to 10 routes.
        TableType: EXTERNAL_TABLE
        Parameters:
          endpointType: neptune
          label: view
          outputFormat: csv
          fieldSeparator: ','
          gremlinQuery: >-
            g.E().hasLabel('route').limit(10).as('r').outV().as('src').inV().as('dst').select('src','dst').by('code')
        StorageDescriptor:
          Columns:
            - Name: src
              Type: string
            - Name: dst
              Type: string
          InputFormat: org.apache.hadoop.mapred.TextInputFormat
          OutputFormat: org.apache.hadoop.hive.ql.io.HiveIgnoreKeyTextOutputFormat
          SerdeInfo:
            SerializationLibrary: org.apache.hadoop.hive.serde2.OpenCSVSerde
            Parameters:
              separatorChar: ','
              quoteChar: '"'

  AirportRdfTable:
    Type: AWS::Glue::Table
    Properties:
      CatalogId: !Ref AWS::AccountId
      DatabaseName: !Ref GraphDatabaseRdf
      TableInput:
        Name: airport_rdf
        Description: >-
          A table of airport resources from the RDF form of the air-routes
          data set, exported by class.
        TableType: EXTERNAL_TABLE
        Parameters:
          endpointType: neptune
          rdfType: rdf
          stripUriPrefixes: 'true'
          querymode: class
          classuri: 'class:Airport'
          nsClass: 'http://kelvinlawrence.net/air-routes/class/'
          nsDatatypeProperty: 'http://kelvinlawrence.net/air-routes/datatypeProperty/'
          nsObjectProperty: 'http://kelvinlawrence.net/air-routes/objectProperty/'
          outputFormat: csv
          fieldSeparator: ','
        StorageDescriptor:
          Columns:
            - Name: code
              Type: string
            - Name: country
              Type: string
            - Name: desc
              Type: string
            - Name: elev
              Type: int
            - Name: icao
              Type: string
            - Name: lat
              Type: double
            - Name: lon
              Type: double
            - Name: region
              Type: string
            - Name: runways
              Type: int
            - Name: type
              Type: string
          InputFormat: org.apache.hadoop.mapred.TextInputFormat
          OutputFormat: org.apache.hadoop.hive.ql.io.HiveIgnoreKeyTextOutputFormat
          SerdeInfo:
            SerializationLibrary: org.apache.hadoop.hive.serde2.OpenCSVSerde
            Parameters:
              separatorChar: ','
              quoteChar: '"'

  RouteRdfTable:
    Type: AWS::Glue::Table
    Properties:
      CatalogId: !Ref AWS::AccountId
      DatabaseName: !Ref GraphDatabaseRdf
      TableInput:
        Name: route_rdf
        Description: >-
          A table of source and destination airport codes and distances for
          routes, queried with a SPARQL query that references the air-routes
          ontology namespaces through separate prefix parameters.
        TableType: EXTERNAL_TABLE
        Parameters:
          endpointType: neptune
          rdfType: rdf
          stripUriPrefixes: 'true'
          querymode: sparql
          nsClass: 'http://kelvinlawrence.net/air-routes/class/'
          nsDatatypeProperty: 'http://kelvinlawrence.net/air-routes/datatypeProperty/'
          nsObjectProperty: 'http://kelvinlawrence.net/air-routes/objectProperty/'
          sparqlQuery: >-
            SELECT ?incode ?outcode ?dist WHERE {
            ?route a class:Route ;
            objprop:source ?source ;
            objprop:destination ?destination ;
            dataprop:dist ?dist .
            ?source dataprop:code ?outcode .
            ?destination dataprop:code ?incode .
            }
            LIMIT 10
        StorageDescriptor:
          Columns:
            - Name: incode
              Type: string
            - Name: outcode
              Type: string
            - Name: dist
              Type: int
          InputFormat: org.apache.hadoop.mapred.TextInputFormat
          OutputFormat: org.apache.hadoop.hive.ql.io.HiveIgnoreKeyTextOutputFormat
          SerdeInfo:
            SerializationLibrary: org.apache.hadoop.hive.serde2.OpenCSVSerde
            Parameters:
              separatorChar: ','
              quoteChar: '"'

  RouteRdfNopfxTable:
    Type: AWS::Glue::Table
    Properties:
      CatalogId: !Ref AWS::AccountId
      DatabaseName: !Ref GraphDatabaseRdf
      TableInput:
        Name: route_rdf_nopfx
        Description: >-
          A table of source and destination airport codes and distances for
          routes, queried with a SPARQL query that embeds the air-routes
          ontology URIs directly in the query text instead of using prefix
          parameters.
        TableType: EXTERNAL_TABLE
        Parameters:
          endpointType: neptune
          rdfType: rdf
          stripUriPrefixes: 'true'
          querymode: sparql
          sparqlQuery: >-
            SELECT ?incode ?outcode ?dist WHERE {
            ?route a <http://kelvinlawrence.net/air-routes/class/Route> ;
            <http://kelvinlawrence.net/air-routes/objectProperty/source> ?source ;
            <http://kelvinlawrence.net/air-routes/objectProperty/destination> ?destination ;
            <http://kelvinlawrence.net/air-routes/datatypeProperty/dist> ?dist .
            ?source <http://kelvinlawrence.net/air-routes/datatypeProperty/code> ?outcode .
            ?destination <http://kelvinlawrence.net/air-routes/datatypeProperty/code> ?incode .
            }
            LIMIT 10
        StorageDescriptor:
          Columns:
            - Name: incode
              Type: string
            - Name: outcode
              Type: string
            - Name: dist
              Type: int
          InputFormat: org.apache.hadoop.mapred.TextInputFormat
          OutputFormat: org.apache.hadoop.hive.ql.io.HiveIgnoreKeyTextOutputFormat
          SerdeInfo:
            SerializationLibrary: org.apache.hadoop.hive.serde2.OpenCSVSerde
            Parameters:
              separatorChar: ','
              quoteChar: '"'

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >-
  Creates two Cognito authentication setups for the PiBot project: one for the main
  web application and one for IoT trusted user provisioning. Each setup includes a
  user pool, user pool client, identity pool with unauthenticated access, and IAM
  roles for authenticated and unauthenticated users. The main web app roles grant
  common IoT operations, Kinesis Video streaming, Rekognition label detection, and
  standard Cognito and Mobile Analytics permissions, while the IoT provisioning
  authenticated role grants IoT trusted user provisioning permissions. Identity
  pool IDs, user pool IDs, and client IDs are exposed as stack outputs.

Parameters:
  ProjectName:
    Type: String
    Default: PiBot
    Description: Prefix used to name the PiBot Cognito resources.

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: "2010-09-09"
Description: >-
  Production DNS for radiotopia.fm. Creates the public Route 53 hosted zone
  with the full live record set: apex TXT with an SPF policy for the
  organization's transactional and marketing email providers plus two domain
  ownership verification tokens, a DMARC TXT record with a reject policy, a
  Google Workspace MX record, Squarespace apex A records and a www CNAME,
  alias A/AAAA pairs for the dedicated media, tower, v1 and plus CloudFront
  distributions (created in this template) together with the ACM validation
  CNAMEs for each subdomain, the podcast feed proxy CNAME, the special event
  subdomain A record, and the CNAME, TXT verification and DKIM records
  required by Zendesk, MailChimp, Squarespace, Campaign Monitor and Google
  Workspace.

Parameters:
  EventSubdomain:
    Type: String
    Default: listeningparty
    Description: Single label of the special event subdomain that receives one A record.
    AllowedPattern: '^[a-z0-9]+(?:-[a-z0-9]+)*$'
    ConstraintDescription: Event subdomain must be a single lowercase DNS label.
  EventSubdomainIpAddress:
    Type: String
    Default: 18.205.93.71
    Description: IPv4 address that the special event subdomain A record points to.
    AllowedPattern: '^([0-9]{1,3}\.){3}[0-9]{1,3}$'
    ConstraintDescription: Event IP address must be a valid IPv4 address.

Resources:
  PublicHostedZone:
    Type: AWS::Route53::HostedZone
    Properties:
      Name: radiotopia.fm.
      HostedZoneConfig:
        Comment: Radiotopia production public DNS zone

  CdnContentBucket:
    Type: AWS::S3::Bucket
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      BucketName: !Sub 'radiotopia-fm-cdn-content-${AWS::AccountId}'
      OwnershipControls:
        Rules:
          - ObjectOwnership: BucketOwnerEnforced
      PublicAccessBlockConfiguration:
        BlockPublicAcls: true
        BlockPublicPolicy: true
        IgnorePublicAcls: true
        RestrictPublicBuckets: true
      BucketEncryption:
        ServerSideEncryptionConfiguration:
          - ServerSideEncryptionByDefault:
              SSEAlgorithm: AES256

  CdnOriginAccessIdentity:
    Type: AWS::CloudFront::CloudFrontOriginAccessIdentity
    Properties:
      CloudFrontOriginAccessIdentityConfig:
        Comment: Origin access identity for the radiotopia.fm CDN content bucket

  MediaCloudFrontDistribution:
    Type: AWS::CloudFront::Distribution
    Properties:
      DistributionConfig:
        Comment: Dedicated CDN distribution for media.radiotopia.fm
        Enabled: true
        HttpVersion: http2and3
        IPV6Enabled: true
        PriceClass: PriceClass_100
        DefaultRootObject: index.html
        Origins:
          - Id: MediaOrigin
            DomainName: !GetAtt CdnContentBucket.RegionalDomainName
            S3OriginConfig:
              OriginAccessIdentity: !Sub 'origin-access-identity/cloudfront/${CdnOriginAccessIdentity}'
        DefaultCacheBehavior:
          TargetOriginId: MediaOrigin
          ViewerProtocolPolicy: redirect-to-https
          AllowedMethods:
            - GET
            - HEAD
          CachedMethods:
            - GET
            - HEAD
          Compress: true
          CachePolicyId: 658327ea-f89d-4fab-a63d-7e88639e58f6
        ViewerCertificate:
          CloudFrontDefaultCertificate: true
        Restrictions:
          GeoRestriction:
            RestrictionType: none

  TowerCloudFrontDistribution:
    Type: AWS::CloudFront::Distribution
    Properties:
      DistributionConfig:
        Comment: Dedicated CDN distribution for tower.radiotopia.fm
        Enabled: true
        HttpVersion: http2and3
        IPV6Enabled: true
        PriceClass: PriceClass_100
        DefaultRootObject: index.html
        Origins:
          - Id: TowerOrigin
            DomainName: !GetAtt CdnContentBucket.RegionalDomainName
            S3OriginConfig:
              OriginAccessIdentity: !Sub 'origin-access-identity/cloudfront/${CdnOriginAccessIdentity}'
        DefaultCacheBehavior:
          TargetOriginId: TowerOrigin
          ViewerProtocolPolicy: redirect-to-https
          AllowedMethods:
            - GET
            - HEAD
          CachedMethods:
            - GET
            - HEAD
          Compress: true
          CachePolicyId: 658327ea-f89d-4fab-a63d-7e88639e58f6
        ViewerCertificate:
          CloudFrontDefaultCertificate: true
        Restrictions:
          GeoRestriction:
            RestrictionType: none

  V1CloudFrontDistribution:
    Type: AWS::CloudFront::Distribution
    Properties:
      DistributionConfig:
        Comment: Dedicated CDN distribution for v1.radiotopia.fm
        Enabled: true
        HttpVersion: http2and3
        IPV6Enabled: true
        PriceClass: PriceClass_100
        DefaultRootObject: index.html
        Origins:
          - Id: V1Origin
            DomainName: !GetAtt CdnContentBucket.RegionalDomainName
            S3OriginConfig:
              OriginAccessIdentity: !Sub 'origin-access-identity/cloudfront/${CdnOriginAccessIdentity}'
        DefaultCacheBehavior:
          TargetOriginId: V1Origin
          ViewerProtocolPolicy: redirect-to-https
          AllowedMethods:
            - GET
            - HEAD
          CachedMethods:
            - GET
            - HEAD
          Compress: true
          CachePolicyId: 658327ea-f89d-4fab-a63d-7e88639e58f6
        ViewerCertificate:
          CloudFrontDefaultCertificate: true
        Restrictions:
          GeoRestriction:
            RestrictionType: none

  PlusCloudFrontDistribution:
    Type: AWS::CloudFront::Distribution
    Properties:
      DistributionConfig:
        Comment: Dedicated CDN distribution for plus.radiotopia.fm
        Enabled: true
        HttpVersion: http2and3
        IPV6Enabled: true
        PriceClass: PriceClass_100
        DefaultRootObject: index.html
        Origins:
          - Id: PlusOrigin
            DomainName: !GetAtt CdnContentBucket.RegionalDomainName
            S3OriginConfig:
              OriginAccessIdentity: !Sub 'origin-access-identity/cloudfront/${CdnOriginAccessIdentity}'
        DefaultCacheBehavior:
          TargetOriginId: PlusOrigin
          ViewerProtocolPolicy: redirect-to-https
          AllowedMethods:
            - GET
            - HEAD
          CachedMethods:
            - GET
            - HEAD
          Compress: true
          CachePolicyId: 658327ea-f89d-4fab-a63d-7e88639e58f6
        ViewerCertificate:
          CloudFrontDefaultCertificate: true
        Restrictions:
          GeoRestriction:
            RestrictionType: none

  CdnContentBucketPolicy:
    Type: AWS::S3::BucketPolicy
    Properties:
      Bucket: !Ref CdnContentBucket
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Sid: AllowCloudFrontOriginAccessIdentityRead
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              CanonicalUser: !GetAtt CdnOriginAccessIdentity.S3CanonicalUserId
            Action: s3:GetObject
            Resource: !Sub '${CdnContentBucket.Arn}/*'

  ApexTxtRecordSet:
    Type: AWS::Route53::RecordSet
    Properties:
      HostedZoneId: !Ref PublicHostedZone
      Name: radiotopia.fm.
      Type: TXT
      TTL: 300
      Comment: SPF for transactional and marketing email providers plus two ownership verification tokens
      ResourceRecords:
        - '"v=spf1 include:_spf.google.com include:mail.zendesk.com include:servers.mcsv.net include:spf.createsend.com include:spf.mandrillapp.com -all"'
        - '"google-site-verification=Gx7Qm2Kp9RtXwL4vNzYq0sDfJh8CbAoEiU3WkM1zTqY"'
        - '"zendeskverification=zdx7f3a9c1b2e4d6f8a0b2c4d"'

  DmarcTxtRecordSet:
    Type: AWS::Route53::RecordSet
    Properties:
      HostedZoneId: !Ref PublicHostedZone
      Name: _dmarc.radiotopia.fm.
      Type: TXT
      TTL: 3600
      Comment: DMARC policy with reject enforcement
      ResourceRecords:
        - '"v=DMARC1; p=reject; rua=mailto:dmarc@radiotopia.fm; pct=100"'

  MxRecordSet:
    Type: AWS::Route53::RecordSet
    Properties:
      HostedZoneId: !Ref PublicHostedZone
      Name: radiotopia.fm.
      Type: MX
      TTL: 3600
      Comment: Mail routing to Google Workspace
      ResourceRecords:
        - "1 aspmx.l.google.com."
        - "5 alt1.aspmx.l.google.com."
        - "5 alt2.aspmx.l.google.com."
        - "10 alt3.aspmx.l.google.com."
        - "10 alt4.aspmx.l.google.com."

  ApexARecordSet:
    Type: AWS::Route53::RecordSet
    Properties:
      HostedZoneId: !Ref PublicHostedZone
      Name: radiotopia.fm.
      Type: A
      TTL: 3600
      Comment: Apex website served by Squarespace
      ResourceRecords:
        - "198.185.159.144"
        - "198.185.159.145"
        - "198.49.23.144"
        - "198.49.23.145"

  WwwCnameRecordSet:
    Type: AWS::Route53::RecordSet
    Properties:
      HostedZoneId: !Ref PublicHostedZone
      Name: www.radiotopia.fm.
      Type: CNAME
      TTL: 3600
      Comment: www alias to Squarespace hosting
      ResourceRecords:
        - "ext-cust.squarespace.com."

  MediaAliasARecordSet:
    Type: AWS::Route53::RecordSet
    Properties:
      HostedZoneId: !Ref PublicHostedZone
      Name: media.radiotopia.fm.
      Type: A
      Comment: Alias to the dedicated media CloudFront distribution
      AliasTarget:
        DNSName: !GetAtt MediaCloudFrontDistribution.DomainName
        HostedZoneId: Z2FDTNDATAQYW2
        EvaluateTargetHealth: false

  MediaAliasAaaaRecordSet:
    Type: AWS::Route53::RecordSet
    Properties:
      HostedZoneId: !Ref PublicHostedZone
      Name: media.radiotopia.fm.
      Type: AAAA
      Comment: IPv6 alias to the dedicated media CloudFront distribution
      AliasTarget:
        DNSName: !GetAtt MediaCloudFrontDistribution.DomainName
        HostedZoneId: Z2FDTNDATAQYW2

  TowerAliasARecordSet:
    Type: AWS::Route53::RecordSet
    Properties:
      HostedZoneId: !Ref PublicHostedZone
      Name: tower.radiotopia.fm.
      Type: A
      Comment: Alias to the dedicated tower CloudFront distribution
      AliasTarget:
        DNSName: !GetAtt TowerCloudFrontDistribution.DomainName

  TowerAliasAaaaRecordSet:

    Properties:

  V1AliasARecordSet:

  V1AliasAaaaRecordSet:

  MediaAcmValidationCnameRecordSet:

      Name: _a1b2c3d4e5f6a7b8c9d0e1f2a3b4c5d6.media.radiotopia.fm.
