AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >-
  Self-contained GraphQL API (CryptoTickerAPI) for cryptocurrency ticker data.
  Uses AWS AppSync with API key authentication. Query.ticker fetches the current
  USD price from the CoinGecko API through an HTTP data source and stores a
  historical record in the APIDataTable DynamoDB table via a two-function
  pipeline resolver. TickerInfo.priceHistory queries historical records from
  DynamoDB sorted descending by the sort key with a default limit of 25 items
  and nextToken pagination. The DynamoDB table's physical name is generated by
  CloudFormation (stack-scoped) to avoid name collisions with tables retained
  by previous deployments; the logical name remains APIDataTable.

Parameters:
  ApiName:
    Type: String
    Default: CryptoTickerAPI
    Description: Name of the AppSync GraphQL API.
  CoinGeckoEndpoint:
    Type: String
    Default: https://api.coingecko.com/api/v3
    Description: Base URL of the CoinGecko public API used by the HTTP data source.

Resources:
  APIDataTable:
    Type: AWS::DynamoDB::Table
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      AttributeDefinitions:
        - AttributeName: hk
          AttributeType: S
        - AttributeName: sk
          AttributeType: S
      KeySchema:
        - AttributeName: hk
          KeyType: HASH
        - AttributeName: sk
          KeyType: RANGE
      BillingMode: PAY_PER_REQUEST
      SSESpecification:
        SSEEnabled: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: APIDataTable

  AppSyncServiceRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: appsync.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: AppSyncAPIDataTableAccess
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - dynamodb:GetItem
                  - dynamodb:PutItem
                  - dynamodb:UpdateItem
                  - dynamodb:DeleteItem
                  - dynamodb:Query
                  - dynamodb:Scan
                Resource:
                  - !GetAtt APIDataTable.Arn
                  - !Sub '${APIDataTable.Arn}/index/*'

  GraphQLApi:
    Type: AWS::AppSync::GraphQLApi
    Properties:
      Name: !Ref ApiName
      AuthenticationType: API_KEY
      XrayEnabled: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Ref ApiName

  GraphQLSchema:
    Type: AWS::AppSync::GraphQLSchema
    Properties:
      ApiId: !GetAtt GraphQLApi.ApiId
      Definition: |
        type TickerInfo {
          ticker: String!
          price: Float!
          lastUpdated: String!
          priceHistory(limit: Int, nextToken: String): PriceHistoryConnection
        }

        type PriceHistoryConnection {
          items: [PricePoint]
          nextToken: String
        }

        type PricePoint {
          hk: String
          sk: String
          ticker: String
          price: Float
          timestamp: String
        }

        type Query {
          ticker(ticker: String!): TickerInfo
        }

        schema {
          query: Query
        }

  GraphQLApiKey:
    Type: AWS::AppSync::ApiKey
    DependsOn: GraphQLSchema
    Properties:
      ApiId: !GetAtt GraphQLApi.ApiId
      Description: Default API key for CryptoTickerAPI

  DynamoDBDataSource:
    Type: AWS::AppSync::DataSource
    Properties:
      ApiId: !GetAtt GraphQLApi.ApiId
      Name: APIDataTableDataSource
      Type: AMAZON_DYNAMODB
      ServiceRoleArn: !GetAtt AppSyncServiceRole.Arn
      DynamoDBConfig:
        TableName: !Ref APIDataTable
        AwsRegion: !Ref AWS::Region

  CoinGeckoDataSource:
    Type: AWS::AppSync::DataSource
    Properties:
      ApiId: !GetAtt GraphQLApi.ApiId
      Name: CoinGeckoDataSource
      Type: HTTP
      ServiceRoleArn: !GetAtt AppSyncServiceRole.Arn
      HttpConfig:
        Endpoint: !Ref CoinGeckoEndpoint

  FetchTickerPriceFunction:
    Type: AWS::AppSync::FunctionConfiguration
    Properties:
      ApiId: !GetAtt GraphQLApi.ApiId
      Name: FetchTickerPrice
      Description: Fetches the current USD price for the requested ticker from the CoinGecko API.
      DataSourceName: !GetAtt CoinGeckoDataSource.Name
      FunctionVersion: '2018-05-29'
      RequestMappingTemplate: |
        #set($ticker = $ctx.args.ticker.toLowerCase())
        {
          "version": "2018-05-29",
          "method": "GET",
          "resourcePath": "/simple/price",
          "params": {
            "headers": {
              "Content-Type": "application/json"
            },
            "query": {
              "ids": "$ticker",
              "vs_currencies": "usd"
            }
          }
        }
      ResponseMappingTemplate: |
        #set($ticker = $ctx.args.ticker.toLowerCase())
        #set($now = $util.time.nowISO8601())
        #if($ctx.error)
          $util.error($ctx.error.message, $ctx.error.type)
        #end
        #if($ctx.result.statusCode == 200)
          #set($body = $util.parseJson($ctx.result.body))
          #if($body.containsKey($ticker) && $body.get($ticker).containsKey("usd"))
            {
              "ticker": "$ticker",
              "price": $body.get($ticker).get("usd"),
              "lastUpdated": "$now"
            }
          #else
            $util.error("Ticker '$ticker' was not found on CoinGecko.")
          #end
        #else
          $util.error("CoinGecko request failed with status code $ctx.result.statusCode.")
        #end

  StoreTickerPriceFunction:
    Type: AWS::AppSync::FunctionConfiguration
    Properties:
      ApiId: !GetAtt GraphQLApi.ApiId
      Name: StoreTickerPrice
      Description: Stores the fetched price as a historical record in the APIDataTable DynamoDB table.
      DataSourceName: !GetAtt DynamoDBDataSource.Name
      FunctionVersion: '2018-05-29'
      RequestMappingTemplate: |
        #set($ticker = $ctx.args.ticker.toLowerCase())
        #set($now = $util.time.nowISO8601())
        {
          "version": "2018-05-29",
          "operation": "PutItem",
          "key": {
            "hk": $util.dynamodb.toDynamoDBJson($ticker),
            "sk": $util.dynamodb.toDynamoDBJson($now)
          },
          "attributeValues": {
            "ticker": $util.dynamodb.toDynamoDBJson($ticker),
            "price": $util.dynamodb.toDynamoDBJson($ctx.prev.result.price),
            "timestamp": $util.dynamodb.toDynamoDBJson($now)
          }
        }
      ResponseMappingTemplate: |
        $util.toJson($ctx.prev.result)

  TickerPipelineResolver:
    Type: AWS::AppSync::Resolver
    DependsOn: GraphQLSchema
    Properties:
      ApiId: !GetAtt GraphQLApi.ApiId
      TypeName: Query
      FieldName: ticker
      Kind: PIPELINE
      RequestMappingTemplate: |
        {
          "version": "2018-05-29",
          "payload": $util.toJson($ctx.args)
        }
      ResponseMappingTemplate: |
        $util.toJson($ctx.result)
      PipelineConfig:
        Functions:
          - !GetAtt FetchTickerPriceFunction.FunctionId
          - !GetAtt StoreTickerPriceFunction.FunctionId

  PriceHistoryResolver:
    Type: AWS::AppSync::Resolver
    DependsOn:
      - GraphQLSchema
      - TickerPipelineResolver
    Properties:
      ApiId: !GetAtt GraphQLApi.ApiId
      TypeName: TickerInfo
      FieldName: priceHistory
      Kind: UNIT
      DataSourceName: !GetAtt DynamoDBDataSource.Name
      RequestMappingTemplate: |
        #set( $limit = 25 )
        #if( $ctx.args.limit )
          #set( $limit = $ctx.args.limit )
        #end
        {
          "version": "2018-05-29",
          "operation": "Query",
          "query": {
            "expression": "hk = :hk",
            "expressionValues": {
              ":hk": $util.dynamodb.toDynamoDBJson($ctx.source.ticker)
            }
          },
          "scanIndexForward": false,
          "limit": $limit
          #if( $ctx.args.nextToken )
            ,"nextToken": "$ctx.args.nextToken"
          #end
        }
      ResponseMappingTemplate: |
        {
          "items": $util.toJson($ctx.result.items),
          "nextToken": #if($ctx.result.nextToken) "${ctx.result.nextToken}" #else null #end
        }

Outputs:
  GraphQLApiEndpoint:
    Description: Endpoint URL of the CryptoTickerAPI GraphQL API.
    Value: !GetAtt GraphQLApi.GraphQLUrl
  GraphQLApiId:
    Description: Unique AppSync API identifier.
    Value: !GetAtt GraphQLApi.ApiId
  DefaultApiKey:
    Description: Default API key used to authenticate requests to the GraphQL API.
    Value: !GetAtt GraphQLApiKey.ApiKey
  APIDataTableName:
    Description: Name of the DynamoDB table storing historical ticker prices.
    Value: !Ref APIDataTable

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >-
  Creates an AWS Elemental MediaPackage channel for live streaming with HLS and
  DASH origin endpoints. When an ArchiveBucket is provided, both origin
  endpoints are set to Origination DENY to support live-to-VOD workflows. The
  DASH endpoint always uses a hardcoded 2 second segment duration while the HLS
  endpoint uses a user-specified segment duration. When a VodSourceBucket and/or
  an ArchiveBucket is provided, the template also provisions the VOD packaging
  resources (packaging group and packaging configurations selected by
  OutputType) and the IAM role MediaPackage needs to access those buckets.

Metadata:
  AWS::CloudFormation::Interface:
    ParameterGroups:
      - Label:
          default: Live Streaming Configuration
        Parameters:
          - LogicalNamePrefix
          - ManifestName
          - HlsSegmentDurationSeconds
          - StartoverWindowSeconds
      - Label:
          default: VOD Workflow Configuration
        Parameters:
          - VodSourceBucket
          - ArchiveBucket
          - OutputType
      - Label:
          default: Tagging
        Parameters:
          - Environment
          - CustomTagKey1
          - CustomTagValue1
          - CustomTagKey2
          - CustomTagValue2

Parameters:
  LogicalNamePrefix:
    Type: String
    Default: LiveVod
    Description: Logical name prefix used to name the resources created by this template.
    AllowedPattern: '^[a-zA-Z0-9-]{1,32}$'
    ConstraintDescription: Logical name prefix must be 1-32 characters containing only letters, numbers, and hyphens.
  ArchiveBucket:
    Type: String
    Default: ''
    Description: >-
      Name of an existing S3 bucket used for live-to-VOD archive storage. When
      provided, both origin endpoints are set to Origination DENY and the VOD
      resources are created.
    AllowedPattern: '(^$)|(^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9.-]{1,61}[a-z0-9]$)'
    ConstraintDescription: Must be an empty string or a valid S3 bucket name.
  VodSourceBucket:
    Type: String
    Default: ''
    Description: >-
      Name of an existing S3 bucket containing VOD source content. When this
      bucket or the ArchiveBucket is provided, the VOD resources are created.
    AllowedPattern: '(^$)|(^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9.-]{1,61}[a-z0-9]$)'
    ConstraintDescription: Must be an empty string or a valid S3 bucket name.
  OutputType:
    Type: String
    Default: APPLE_HLS
    AllowedValues:
      - APPLE_HLS
      - ISO_DASH
      - ALL
    Description: >-
      Output type used for the VOD packaging configurations. APPLE_HLS creates
      an HLS packaging configuration, ISO_DASH creates a DASH packaging
      configuration, and ALL creates both.
  ManifestName:
    Type: String
    Default: index
    Description: Manifest name appended to the origin endpoint URLs.
    AllowedPattern: '^[a-zA-Z0-9_-]{1,256}$'
    ConstraintDescription: Manifest name must be 1-256 characters of letters, numbers, underscores, or hyphens.
  HlsSegmentDurationSeconds:
    Type: Number
    Default: 6
    MinValue: 1
    MaxValue: 30
    Description: Segment duration in seconds for the HLS origin endpoint package.
  StartoverWindowSeconds:
    Type: Number
    Default: 300
    MinValue: 0
    MaxValue: 172800
    Description: Startover window in seconds applied to both origin endpoints.
  Environment:
    Type: String
    Default: dev
    Description: Value applied as the Environment tag on all resources.
  CustomTagKey1:
    Type: String
    Default: ''
    Description: Optional key of the first custom tag applied to all resources.
  CustomTagValue1:
    Type: String
    Default: ''
    Description: Optional value of the first custom tag applied to all resources.
  CustomTagKey2:
    Type: String
    Default: ''
    Description: Optional key of the second custom tag applied to all resources.
  CustomTagValue2:
    Type: String
    Default: ''
    Description: Optional value of the second custom tag applied to all resources.

Conditions:
  HasArchiveBucket: !Not [!Equals [!Ref ArchiveBucket, '']]
  HasVodSourceBucket: !Not [!Equals [!Ref VodSourceBucket, '']]
  HasAnyVodBucket: !Or [!Condition HasArchiveBucket, !Condition HasVodSourceBucket]
  CreateHlsVodConfig: !And [!Condition HasAnyVodBucket, !Or [!Equals [!Ref OutputType, 'APPLE_HLS'], !Equals [!Ref OutputType, 'ALL']]]
  CreateDashVodConfig: !And [!Condition HasAnyVodBucket, !Or [!Equals [!Ref OutputType, 'ISO_DASH'], !Equals [!Ref OutputType, 'ALL']]]
  HasCustomTag1: !Not [!Equals [!Ref CustomTagKey1, '']]
  HasCustomTag2: !Not [!Equals [!Ref CustomTagKey2, '']]

Resources:
  MediaPackageLiveChannel:
    Type: AWS::MediaPackage::Channel
    Properties:
      Description: !Sub 'MediaPackage live streaming channel for ${LogicalNamePrefix}.'
      Id: !Sub '${LogicalNamePrefix}-channel'
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment
        - !If
          - HasCustomTag1
          - Key: !Ref CustomTagKey1
            Value: !Ref CustomTagValue1
          - !Ref AWS::NoValue
        - !If
          - HasCustomTag2
          - Key: !Ref CustomTagKey2
            Value: !Ref CustomTagValue2
          - !Ref AWS::NoValue

  HlsLiveOriginEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::MediaPackage::OriginEndpoint
    Properties:
      ChannelId: !Ref MediaPackageLiveChannel
      Description: !Sub 'HLS origin endpoint for the ${LogicalNamePrefix} live channel.'
      HlsPackage:
        PlaylistType: EVENT
        PlaylistWindowSeconds: 60
        ProgramDateTimeIntervalSeconds: 60
        SegmentDurationSeconds: !Ref HlsSegmentDurationSeconds
      Id: !Sub '${LogicalNamePrefix}-hls-endpoint'
      ManifestName: !Ref ManifestName
      Origination: !If [HasArchiveBucket, DENY, ALLOW]
      StartoverWindowSeconds: !Ref StartoverWindowSeconds
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment
        - !If
          - HasCustomTag1
          - Key: !Ref CustomTagKey1
            Value: !Ref CustomTagValue1
          - !Ref AWS::NoValue
        - !If
          - HasCustomTag2
          - Key: !Ref CustomTagKey2
            Value: !Ref CustomTagValue2
          - !Ref AWS::NoValue

  DashLiveOriginEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::MediaPackage::OriginEndpoint
    Properties:
      ChannelId: !Ref MediaPackageLiveChannel
      DashPackage:
        SegmentDurationSeconds: 2
      Description: !Sub 'DASH origin endpoint for the ${LogicalNamePrefix} live channel.'
      Id: !Sub '${LogicalNamePrefix}-dash-endpoint'
      ManifestName: !Ref ManifestName
      Origination: !If [HasArchiveBucket, DENY, ALLOW]
      StartoverWindowSeconds: !Ref StartoverWindowSeconds
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment
        - !If
          - HasCustomTag1
          - Key: !Ref CustomTagKey1
            Value: !Ref CustomTagValue1
          - !Ref AWS::NoValue
        - !If
          - HasCustomTag2
          - Key: !Ref CustomTagKey2
            Value: !Ref CustomTagValue2
          - !Ref AWS::NoValue

  MediaPackageVodRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Condition: HasAnyVodBucket
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: mediapackage.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Description: !Sub 'Allows AWS Elemental MediaPackage to access the VOD source and archive S3 buckets for ${LogicalNamePrefix}.'
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: mediapackage-s3-bucket-access
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - !If
                - HasVodSourceBucket
                - Sid: VodSourceBucketReadAccess
                  Effect: Allow
                  Action:
                    - s3:GetObject
                    - s3:GetObjectVersion
                    - s3:ListBucket
                  Resource:
                    - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:s3:::${VodSourceBucket}'
                    - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:s3:::${VodSourceBucket}/*'
                - !Ref AWS::NoValue
              - !If
                - HasArchiveBucket
                - Sid: ArchiveBucketReadWriteAccess
                  Effect: Allow
                  Action:
                    - s3:GetObject
                    - s3:GetObjectVersion
                    - s3:ListBucket
                    - s3:PutObject
                    - s3:AbortMultipartUpload
                  Resource:
                    - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:s3:::${ArchiveBucket}'
                    - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:s3:::${ArchiveBucket}/*'
                - !Ref AWS::NoValue
      RoleName: !Sub '${LogicalNamePrefix}-mediapackage-vod-role'
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment
        - !If
          - HasCustomTag1
          - Key: !Ref CustomTagKey1
            Value: !Ref CustomTagValue1
          - !Ref AWS::NoValue
        - !If
          - HasCustomTag2
          - Key: !Ref CustomTagKey2
            Value: !Ref CustomTagValue2
          - !Ref AWS::NoValue

        - !If

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: "2010-09-09"
Description: >-
  Creates the IAM roles, instance profiles, and AWS-managed and custom managed policies
  required by the Cluster API Provider AWS (CAPA) to manage the lifecycle of Kubernetes
  clusters on AWS, supporting both EC2-based and EKS-based cluster lifecycle management.
  Three instance profiles are created (control plane, controllers, nodes), each
  associated with a corresponding IAM role, plus a dedicated EKS control plane role
  assumed by the EKS service.

Metadata:
  AWS::CloudFormation::Interface:
    ParameterGroups:
      - Label:
          default: Naming
        Parameters:
          - ClusterName
      - Label:
          default: Permission scoping
        Parameters:
          - KMSAliasPattern
          - SecretsManagerPath
    ParameterLabels:
      ClusterName:
        default: Cluster name prefix
      KMSAliasPattern:
        default: KMS alias pattern
      SecretsManagerPath:
        default: Secrets Manager path

Parameters:
  ClusterName:
    Type: String
    Default: capa
    Description: >-
      Prefix used for the names of all IAM roles, instance profiles and managed policies
      created by this template (for example, capa-control-plane).
    AllowedPattern: ^[a-zA-Z0-9+=,.@_-]{1,40}$
    ConstraintDescription: >-
      Must be 1-40 characters and may contain only alphanumerics and the characters
      +=,.@_- per IAM resource naming rules.
  KMSAliasPattern:
    Type: String
    Default: cluster-api-*
    Description: >-
      KMS alias pattern that conditions the KMS key operations granted by the
      controllers EKS policy via the kms:RequestAlias condition key.
  SecretsManagerPath:
    Type: String
    Default: aws.cluster.x-k8s.io/*
    Description: >-
      Secrets Manager path that node secrets permissions are scoped to
      (arn:aws:secretsmanager:*:*:secret:<this path>).

Resources:
  ControlPlaneRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub "${ClusterName}-control-plane"
      Description: >-
        Assumed by EC2 instances running Kubernetes control plane machines managed by the
        Cluster API Provider AWS.
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service:
                - ec2.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - sts:AssumeRole
      Tags:
        - Key: "sigs.k8s.io/cluster-api-provider-aws/role"
          Value: control-plane
        - Key: "sigs.k8s.io/cluster-api-provider-aws/cluster"
          Value: !Ref ClusterName

  ControllersRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub "${ClusterName}-controllers"
      Description: >-
        Assumed by the Cluster API Provider AWS controllers running on EC2 instances or
        via EKS Pod Identity (pods.eks.amazonaws.com).
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service:
                - ec2.amazonaws.com
                - pods.eks.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - sts:AssumeRole
              - sts:TagSession
      Tags:
        - Key: "sigs.k8s.io/cluster-api-provider-aws/role"
          Value: controllers
        - Key: "sigs.k8s.io/cluster-api-provider-aws/cluster"
          Value: !Ref ClusterName

  NodesRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub "${ClusterName}-nodes"
      Description: Assumed by EC2 instances running Kubernetes worker (node) machines.
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service:
                - ec2.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/AmazonEKSWorkerNodePolicy
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/AmazonEKS_CNI_Policy
      Tags:
        - Key: "sigs.k8s.io/cluster-api-provider-aws/role"
          Value: nodes
        - Key: "sigs.k8s.io/cluster-api-provider-aws/cluster"
          Value: !Ref ClusterName

  EKSClusterRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub "${ClusterName}-eks-control-plane"
      Description: Assumed by the EKS service to create and operate EKS-based cluster control planes.
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service:
                - eks.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/AmazonEKSClusterPolicy
      Tags:
        - Key: "sigs.k8s.io/cluster-api-provider-aws/role"
          Value: eks-control-plane
        - Key: "sigs.k8s.io/cluster-api-provider-aws/cluster"
          Value: !Ref ClusterName

  CloudProviderControlPlanePolicy:
    Type: AWS::IAM::ManagedPolicy
    Properties:
      ManagedPolicyName: !Sub "${ClusterName}-cloud-provider-control-plane"
      Description: >-
        Broad EC2, ELB, Auto Scaling and KMS permissions required by the Kubernetes cloud
        controller manager. Attached to the control plane role.
      Roles:
        - !Ref ControlPlaneRole
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - autoscaling:DescribeAutoScalingGroups

              - autoscaling:SetDesiredCapacity

              - ec2:CreateSecurityGroup
              - ec2:CreateTags
              - ec2:CreateVolume
              - ec2:DeleteNatGateway
              - ec2:DeleteRoute
              - ec2:DeleteRouteTable
              - ec2:DeleteSecurityGroup
              - ec2:DeleteVolume
              - ec2:DescribeImages
              - ec2:DescribeInstances
              - ec2:DescribeInstanceStatus
              - ec2:DescribeRegions
              - ec2:DescribeRouteTables
              - ec2:DescribeSecurityGroups
              - ec2:DescribeSubnets
              - ec2:DescribeVolumes
              - ec2:DescribeVpcs
              - ec2:DetachVolume
              - ec2:ModifyInstanceAttribute
              - ec2:ModifyVolume
              - ec2:RevokeSecurityGroupIngress
              - elasticloadbalancing:AddTags
              - elasticloadbalancing:ApplySecurityGroupsToLoadBalancer
              - elasticloadbalancing:AttachLoadBalancerToSubnets
              - elasticloadbalancing:ConfigureHealthCheck
              - elasticloadbalancing:CreateLoadBalancer
              - elasticloadbalancing:CreateLoadBalancerListeners
              - elasticloadbalancing:CreateLoadBalancerPolicy
              - elasticloadbalancing:DeleteLoadBalancer
              - elasticloadbalancing:DeleteLoadBalancerListeners
              - elasticloadbalancing:DeregisterInstancesFromLoadBalancer
              - elasticloadbalancing:DescribeLoadBalancerAttributes
              - elasticloadbalancing:DescribeLoadBalancers
              - elasticloadbalancing:ModifyLoadBalancerAttributes
              - elasticloadbalancing:RegisterInstancesWithLoadBalancer
              - elasticloadbalancing:RemoveTags
              - elasticloadbalancing:SetLoadBalancerPoliciesForBackendServer
              - iam:CreateServiceLinkedRole
              - kms:CreateGrant
              - kms:DescribeKey
              - kms:ListAliases
            Resource: "*"

  ControllersPolicy:
    Type: AWS::IAM::ManagedPolicy
    Properties:
      ManagedPolicyName: !Sub "${ClusterName}-controllers"
      Description: >-
        Extensive permissions for the Cluster API Provider AWS controllers to manage
        VPCs, subnets, security groups, load balancers, Auto Scaling groups, launch
        templates and EKS access entries, and to create scoped service-linked roles.
        Attached to the controllers role.
      Roles:
        - !Ref ControllersRole
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Sid: Ec2NetworkingAndLaunchTemplates
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - ec2:AllocateAddress
              - ec2:AssociateAddress
              - ec2:AssociateDhcpOptions
              - ec2:AssociateRouteTable
              - ec2:AttachInternetGateway
              - ec2:AttachNetworkInterface
              - ec2:AttachVolume
              - ec2:AuthorizeSecurityGroupEgress
              - ec2:AuthorizeSecurityGroupIngress
              - ec2:CreateDhcpOptions
              - ec2:CreateEgressOnlyInternetGateway
              - ec2:CreateInternetGateway
              - ec2:CreateLaunchTemplate
              - ec2:CreateLaunchTemplateVersion
              - ec2:CreateNatGateway
              - ec2:CreateNetworkAclEntry
              - ec2:CreateNetworkInterface
              - ec2:CreateRoute
              - ec2:CreateRouteTable
              - ec2:CreateSecurityGroup
              - ec2:CreateSubnet
              - ec2:CreateTags
              - ec2:CreateVpc
              - ec2:CreateVpcEndpoint
              - ec2:DeleteDhcpOptions
              - ec2:DeleteEgressOnlyInternetGateway
              - ec2:DeleteInternetGateway
              - ec2:DeleteLaunchTemplate
              - ec2:DeleteLaunchTemplateVersions
              - ec2:DeleteNatGateway
              - ec2:DeleteNetworkInterface
              - ec2:DeleteRoute
              - ec2:DeleteRouteTable
              - ec2:DeleteSecurityGroup
              - ec2:DeleteSubnet
              - ec2:DeleteTags
              - ec2:DeleteVpc
              - ec2:DeleteVpcEndpoints
              - ec2:DescribeAccountAttributes
              - ec2:DescribeAddresses
              - ec2:DescribeAvailabilityZones
              - ec2:DescribeDhcpOptions
              - ec2:DescribeEgressOnlyInternetGateways
              - ec2:DescribeImages
              - ec2:DescribeInstanceAttribute
              - ec2:DescribeInstanceStatus
              - ec2:DescribeInstanceTypes
              - ec2:DescribeInstances
              - ec2:DescribeInternetGateways
              - ec2:DescribeLaunchTemplates
              - ec2:DescribeLaunchTemplateVersions
              - ec2:DescribeNatGateways
              - ec2:DescribeNetworkAcls
              - ec2:DescribeNetworkInterfaces
              - ec2:DescribePrefixLists
              - ec2:DescribeRegions
              - ec2:DescribeRouteTables
              - ec2:DescribeSecurityGroupRules
              - ec2:DescribeSecurityGroups
              - ec2:DescribeSubnets
              - ec2:DescribeTags
              - ec2:DescribeVpcAttribute
              - ec2:DescribeVpcEndpoints
              - ec2:DescribeVpcs
              - ec2:DetachInternetGateway
              - ec2:DetachNetworkInterface
              - ec2:DetachVolume
              - ec2:DisassociateAddress
              - ec2:DisassociateRouteTable
              - ec2:ModifyInstanceAttribute
              - ec2:ModifyNetworkInterfaceAttribute
              - ec2:ModifySubnetAttribute
              - ec2:ModifyVpcAttribute
              - ec2:ModifyVpcEndpoint
              - ec2:ReleaseAddress
              - ec2:RevokeSecurityGroupEgress
              - ec2:RevokeSecurityGroupIngress
              - ec2:RunInstances
              - ec2:TerminateInstances
            Resource: "*"
          - Sid: AutoScalingGroups
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - autoscaling:AttachLoadBalancers
              - autoscaling:AttachLoadBalancerTargetGroups
              - autoscaling:CreateAutoScalingGroup
              - autoscaling:CreateOrUpdateTags
              - autoscaling:DeleteAutoScalingGroup
              - autoscaling:DeleteTags
              - autoscaling:DescribeAutoScalingGroups
              - autoscaling:DescribeLaunchConfigurations
              - autoscaling:DescribeLoadBalancerTargetGroups
              - autoscaling:DescribeScalingActivities
              - autoscaling:DescribeTags
              - autoscaling:DetachLoadBalancerTargetGroups
              - autoscaling:DetachLoadBalancers
              - autoscaling:ResumeProcesses
              - autoscaling:SetDesiredCapacity
              - autoscaling:SuspendProcesses
              - autoscaling:TerminateInstanceInAutoScalingGroup
              - autoscaling:UpdateAutoScalingGroup
            Resource: "*"
          - Sid: LoadBalancers
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - elasticloadbalancing:AddTags
              - elasticloadbalancing:ApplySecurityGroupsToLoadBalancer
              - elasticloadbalancing:AttachLoadBalancerToSubnets
              - elasticloadbalancing:ConfigureHealthCheck
              - elasticloadbalancing:CreateListener
              - elasticloadbalancing:CreateLoadBalancer
              - elasticloadbalancing:CreateLoadBalancerListeners
              - elasticloadbalancing:CreateLoadBalancerPolicy
              - elasticloadbalancing:CreateRule
              - elasticloadbalancing:CreateTargetGroup
              - elasticloadbalancing:DeleteListener
              - elasticloadbalancing:DeleteLoadBalancer
              - elasticloadbalancing:DeleteLoadBalancerListeners
              - elasticloadbalancing:DeleteRule
              - elasticloadbalancing:DeleteTargetGroup
              - elasticloadbalancing:DeregisterInstancesFromLoadBalancer
              - elasticloadbalancing:DeregisterTargets
              - elasticloadbalancing:DescribeListeners
              - elasticloadbalancing:DescribeLoadBalancerAttributes
              - elasticloadbalancing:DescribeLoadBalancerPolicies

              - elasticloadbalancing:RegisterTargets

              - elasticloadbalancing:SetSecurityGroups
              - elasticloadbalancing:SetSubnets

  ControllersEKSPolicy:
    Type: AWS::IAM::ManagedPolicy
    Properties:
      ManagedPolicyName: !Sub "${ClusterName}-controllers-eks"
      Description: >-
        EKS cluster and nodegroup management, SSM parameter retrieval, IAM role and
        policy inspection, KMS key operations conditioned on the KMS alias pattern, and
        EKS service-linked role creation. Attached to both the controllers and control
        plane roles.
      Roles:
        - !Ref ControlPlaneRole
        - !Ref ControllersRole
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:

          - Sid: IamRoleAndPolicyInspection
            Effect: Allow

              - iam:GetPolicyVersion
              - iam:GetRole
              - iam:ListAttachedRolePolicies
              - iam:ListPolicies
              - iam:ListRolePolicies

          - Sid: KmsKeysMatchingAliasPattern

          - Sid: EksServiceLinkedRoles

  NodesPolicy:
    Type: AWS::IAM::ManagedPolicy
    Properties:
      ManagedPolicyName: !Sub "${ClusterName}-nodes"
      Description: >-
        EC2, ECR, Secrets Manager (scoped to the Cluster API secret path), SSM and S3
        permissions required by Kubernetes worker nodes. Attached to the nodes role.
      Roles:
        - !Ref NodesRole
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Sid: Ec2AndEcr
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - ec2:DescribeInstances
              - ec2:DescribeNetworkInterfaces
              - ec2:DescribeRegions
              - ec2:DescribeTags

              - ecr:GetAuthorizationToken
              - ecr:GetDownloadUrlForLayer

            Resource: "*"
          - Sid: ClusterApiSecrets
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - secretsmanager:DescribeSecret
              - secretsmanager:GetSecretValue

              - !Sub "arn:aws:secretsmanager:*:*:secret:${SecretsManagerPath}"
          - Sid: SsmParameters
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - ssm:GetParameter
              - ssm:GetParameters
              - ssm:GetParametersByPath
            Resource: "*"
          - Sid: S3ObjectRead
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - s3:GetObject
            Resource: "*"

  ControlPlaneInstanceProfile:
    Type: AWS::IAM::InstanceProfile
    Properties:
      InstanceProfileName: !Sub "${ClusterName}-control-plane"
