AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >-
  Configurable Amazon DynamoDB table with a customizable partition key and an
  optional sort key, PROVISIONED or on-demand billing, point-in-time recovery
  enabled by default, optional server-side encryption with a customer-managed
  KMS key, and optional CloudWatch alarms for throttling and errors that can
  publish to an SNS topic.

Metadata:
  AWS::CloudFormation::Interface:
    ParameterGroups:
      - Label:
          default: Table configuration
        Parameters:
          - TableName
          - PartitionKeyName
          - PartitionKeyType
          - SortKeyName
          - SortKeyType
      - Label:
          default: Capacity and billing
        Parameters:
          - BillingMode
          - ReadCapacityUnits
          - WriteCapacityUnits
      - Label:
          default: Data protection
        Parameters:
          - EnablePointInTimeRecovery
          - EnableSSEWithCMK
      - Label:
          default: Monitoring and alerting
        Parameters:
          - EnableCloudWatchAlarms
          - EnableAlarmNotifications
          - AlarmNotificationEmail
          - ThrottleAlarmThreshold
          - ErrorAlarmThreshold

Parameters:
  TableName:
    Type: String
    Default: ''
    AllowedPattern: '^(|[a-zA-Z0-9_.-]{3,255})$'
    Description: Name of the DynamoDB table. Leave empty to let CloudFormation generate a unique name.

  PartitionKeyName:
    Type: String
    Default: id
    MinLength: 1
    MaxLength: 255
    Description: Name of the partition (hash) key attribute.

  PartitionKeyType:
    Type: String
    Default: S
    AllowedValues:
      - S
      - N
      - B
    Description: Data type of the partition key attribute (S=String, N=Number, B=Binary).

  SortKeyName:
    Type: String
    Default: sortKey
    AllowedPattern: '^(|[a-zA-Z0-9_.-]{1,255})$'
    Description: Name of the optional sort (range) key attribute. Leave empty to omit the sort key.

  SortKeyType:
    Type: String
    Default: N
    AllowedValues:
      - S
      - N
      - B
    Description: Data type of the sort key attribute (S=String, N=Number, B=Binary).

  BillingMode:
    Type: String
    Default: PROVISIONED
    AllowedValues:
      - PROVISIONED
      - PAY_PER_REQUEST
    Description: PROVISIONED for fixed throughput, PAY_PER_REQUEST for on-demand capacity.

  ReadCapacityUnits:
    Type: Number
    Default: 5
    MinValue: 1
    Description: Read capacity units. Only used when BillingMode is PROVISIONED.

  WriteCapacityUnits:
    Type: Number
    Default: 5
    MinValue: 1
    Description: Write capacity units. Only used when BillingMode is PROVISIONED.

  EnablePointInTimeRecovery:
    Type: String
    Default: 'true'
    AllowedValues:
      - 'true'
      - 'false'
    Description: Whether point-in-time recovery (continuous backups) is enabled on the table.

  EnableSSEWithCMK:
    Type: String
    Default: 'false'
    AllowedValues:
      - 'true'
      - 'false'
    Description: Whether to encrypt the table with a customer-managed KMS key.

  EnableCloudWatchAlarms:
    Type: String
    Default: 'false'
    AllowedValues:
      - 'true'
      - 'false'
    Description: Whether to create CloudWatch alarms for throttling and error metrics.

  EnableAlarmNotifications:
    Type: String
    Default: 'false'
    AllowedValues:
      - 'true'
      - 'false'
    Description: Whether the CloudWatch alarms publish to an SNS topic (meaningful when alarms are enabled).

  AlarmNotificationEmail:
    Type: String
    Default: ''
    AllowedPattern: '^(|[A-Za-z0-9._%+-]+@[A-Za-z0-9.-]+\.[A-Za-z]{2,})$'
    Description: Optional email address subscribed to the alarm SNS topic (requires confirmation).

  ThrottleAlarmThreshold:
    Type: Number
    Default: 1
    MinValue: 1
    Description: Minimum number of throttled requests/events within the evaluation period that breaches the throttle alarms.

  ErrorAlarmThreshold:
    Type: Number
    Default: 5
    MinValue: 1
    Description: Minimum number of system or user errors within the evaluation period that breaches the error alarms.

Conditions:
  HasCustomTableName: !Not [!Equals [!Ref TableName, '']]
  HasSortKey: !Not [!Equals [!Ref SortKeyName, '']]
  IsProvisionedBilling: !Equals [!Ref BillingMode, 'PROVISIONED']
  PITREnabled: !Equals [!Ref EnablePointInTimeRecovery, 'true']
  SSECMKEnabled: !Equals [!Ref EnableSSEWithCMK, 'true']
  AlarmsEnabled: !Equals [!Ref EnableCloudWatchAlarms, 'true']
  NotificationsEnabled: !Equals [!Ref EnableAlarmNotifications, 'true']
  HasAlarmEmail: !Not [!Equals [!Ref AlarmNotificationEmail, '']]
  CreateAlarmEmailSubscription: !And
    - Condition: NotificationsEnabled
    - Condition: HasAlarmEmail

Resources:
  EncryptionKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    Condition: SSECMKEnabled
    Properties:
      Description: !Sub 'Customer-managed KMS key used to encrypt the DynamoDB table in stack ${AWS::StackName}.'
      Enabled: true
      EnableKeyRotation: true
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: EnableIAMPermissions
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root'
            Action: 'kms:*'
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: AllowDynamoDBToUseTheKey
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: dynamodb.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - kms:Encrypt
              - kms:Decrypt
              - kms:ReEncrypt*
              - kms:GenerateDataKey*
              - kms:Describe*
            Resource: '*'
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                kms:CallerAccount: !Ref 'AWS::AccountId'
              ArnLike:
                kms:ViaService: !Sub 'dynamodb.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com'

  EncryptionKeyAlias:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Alias
    Condition: SSECMKEnabled
    Properties:
      AliasName: !Sub 'alias/${AWS::StackName}-ddb'
      TargetKeyId: !Ref EncryptionKey

  DynamoTable:
    Type: AWS::DynamoDB::Table
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      TableName: !If
        - HasCustomTableName
        - !Ref TableName
        - !Ref 'AWS::NoValue'
      BillingMode: !Ref BillingMode
      ProvisionedThroughput: !If
        - IsProvisionedBilling
        - ReadCapacityUnits: !Ref ReadCapacityUnits
          WriteCapacityUnits: !Ref WriteCapacityUnits
        - !Ref 'AWS::NoValue'
      AttributeDefinitions:
        - AttributeName: !Ref PartitionKeyName
          AttributeType: !Ref PartitionKeyType
        - !If
          - HasSortKey
          - AttributeName: !Ref SortKeyName
            AttributeType: !Ref SortKeyType
          - !Ref 'AWS::NoValue'
      KeySchema:
        - AttributeName: !Ref PartitionKeyName
          KeyType: HASH
        - !If
          - HasSortKey
          - AttributeName: !Ref SortKeyName
            KeyType: RANGE
          - !Ref 'AWS::NoValue'
      PointInTimeRecoverySpecification: !If
        - PITREnabled
        - PointInTimeRecoveryEnabled: true
        - !Ref 'AWS::NoValue'
      SSESpecification: !If
        - SSECMKEnabled
        - SSEEnabled: true
          SSEType: KMS
          KMSMasterKeyId: !Ref EncryptionKey
        - !Ref 'AWS::NoValue'
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-dynamodb'

  AlarmNotificationTopic:
    Type: AWS::SNS::Topic
    Condition: NotificationsEnabled
    Properties:
      TopicName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-alarm-notifications'

  AlarmNotificationTopicPolicy:
    Type: AWS::SNS::TopicPolicy
    Condition: NotificationsEnabled
    Properties:
      Topics:
        - !Ref AlarmNotificationTopic
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: AllowCloudWatchAlarmsToPublish
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: cloudwatch.amazonaws.com
            Action: sns:Publish
            Resource: !Ref AlarmNotificationTopic
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                AWS:SourceAccount: !Ref 'AWS::AccountId'
              ArnLike:
                AWS:SourceArn: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:cloudwatch:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:alarm:*'

  AlarmNotificationEmailSubscription:
    Type: AWS::SNS::Subscription
    Condition: CreateAlarmEmailSubscription
    Properties:
      Protocol: email
      Endpoint: !Ref AlarmNotificationEmail
      TopicArn: !Ref AlarmNotificationTopic

  DynamoTableThrottledRequestsAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Condition: AlarmsEnabled
    Properties:
      AlarmName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-ddb-throttled-requests'
      AlarmDescription: !Sub 'ThrottledRequests for table ${DynamoTable} met or exceeded ${ThrottleAlarmThreshold} within a 5 minute period.'
      Namespace: AWS/DynamoDB
      MetricName: ThrottledRequests
      Dimensions:
        - Name: TableName
          Value: !Ref DynamoTable
      Statistic: Sum
      Period: 300
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      Threshold: !Ref ThrottleAlarmThreshold
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanOrEqualToThreshold
      TreatMissingData: notBreaching
      AlarmActions: !If
        - NotificationsEnabled
        - - !Ref AlarmNotificationTopic
        - !Ref 'AWS::NoValue'
      OKActions: !If
        - NotificationsEnabled
        - - !Ref AlarmNotificationTopic
        - !Ref 'AWS::NoValue'

  DynamoTableReadThrottleAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Condition: AlarmsEnabled
    Properties:
      AlarmName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-ddb-read-throttle'
      AlarmDescription: !Sub 'ReadThrottleEvents for table ${DynamoTable} met or exceeded ${ThrottleAlarmThreshold} within a 5 minute period.'
      Namespace: AWS/DynamoDB
      MetricName: ReadThrottleEvents
      Dimensions:
        - Name: TableName
          Value: !Ref DynamoTable
      Statistic: Sum
      Period: 300
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      Threshold: !Ref ThrottleAlarmThreshold
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanOrEqualToThreshold
      TreatMissingData: notBreaching
      AlarmActions: !If
        - NotificationsEnabled
        - - !Ref AlarmNotificationTopic
        - !Ref 'AWS::NoValue'
      OKActions: !If
        - NotificationsEnabled
        - - !Ref AlarmNotificationTopic
        - !Ref 'AWS::NoValue'

  DynamoTableWriteThrottleAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Condition: AlarmsEnabled
    Properties:
      AlarmName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-ddb-write-throttle'
      AlarmDescription: !Sub 'WriteThrottleEvents for table ${DynamoTable} met or exceeded ${ThrottleAlarmThreshold} within a 5 minute period.'
      Namespace: AWS/DynamoDB
      MetricName: WriteThrottleEvents
      Dimensions:
        - Name: TableName
          Value: !Ref DynamoTable
      Statistic: Sum
      Period: 300
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      Threshold: !Ref ThrottleAlarmThreshold
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanOrEqualToThreshold
      TreatMissingData: notBreaching
      AlarmActions: !If
        - NotificationsEnabled
        - - !Ref AlarmNotificationTopic
        - !Ref 'AWS::NoValue'
      OKActions: !If
        - NotificationsEnabled
        - - !Ref AlarmNotificationTopic
        - !Ref 'AWS::NoValue'

  DynamoTableSystemErrorsAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Condition: AlarmsEnabled
    Properties:
      AlarmName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-ddb-system-errors'
      AlarmDescription: !Sub 'SystemErrors for table ${DynamoTable} met or exceeded ${ErrorAlarmThreshold} within a 5 minute period.'
      Namespace: AWS/DynamoDB
      MetricName: SystemErrors
      Dimensions:
        - Name: TableName
          Value: !Ref DynamoTable
      Statistic: Sum
      Period: 300
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      Threshold: !Ref ErrorAlarmThreshold
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanOrEqualToThreshold
      TreatMissingData: notBreaching
      AlarmActions: !If
        - NotificationsEnabled
        - - !Ref AlarmNotificationTopic
        - !Ref 'AWS::NoValue'
      OKActions: !If
        - NotificationsEnabled
        - - !Ref AlarmNotificationTopic
        - !Ref 'AWS::NoValue'

  DynamoTableUserErrorsAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Condition: AlarmsEnabled
    Properties:
      AlarmName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-ddb-user-errors'
      AlarmDescription: !Sub 'UserErrors for table ${DynamoTable} met or exceeded ${ErrorAlarmThreshold} within a 5 minute period.'
      Namespace: AWS/DynamoDB
      MetricName: UserErrors
      Dimensions:
        - Name: TableName
          Value: !Ref DynamoTable
      Statistic: Sum
      Period: 300
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      Threshold: !Ref ErrorAlarmThreshold
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanOrEqualToThreshold
      TreatMissingData: notBreaching
      AlarmActions: !If
        - NotificationsEnabled
        - - !Ref AlarmNotificationTopic
        - !Ref 'AWS::NoValue'
      OKActions: !If
        - NotificationsEnabled
        - - !Ref AlarmNotificationTopic
        - !Ref 'AWS::NoValue'

Outputs:
  TableName:
    Description: Name of the DynamoDB table.
    Value: !Ref DynamoTable
  TableArn:
    Description: ARN of the DynamoDB table.
    Value: !GetAtt DynamoTable.Arn
  SortKey:
    Condition: HasSortKey
    Description: Sort key attribute name and type of the table.
    Value: !Sub '${SortKeyName} (${SortKeyType})'
  KmsKeyArn:
    Condition: SSECMKEnabled
    Description: ARN of the customer-managed KMS key used for table encryption.
    Value: !GetAtt EncryptionKey.Arn
  AlarmTopicArn:
    Condition: NotificationsEnabled
    Description: ARN of the SNS topic that receives alarm notifications. Email subscriptions must be confirmed.
    Value: !Ref AlarmNotificationTopic

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'

Description: >-
  Creates two EC2 Image Builder pipelines that build custom Amazon Linux 2023 AMIs for x86_64 and
  arm64, installing Docker, Docker Compose, Python packages (synapseclient, pandas, pysftp) and
  enabling sudo access for the SSM user. The AMIs are distributed publicly (launch permission for
  the "all" user group), shared with a configurable AWS organization and tagged with the stack name.

Metadata:
  AWS::CloudFormation::Interface:
    ParameterGroups:
      - Label:
          default: Image configuration
        Parameters:
          - ImageVersion
          - RootVolumeSize
      - Label:
          default: Sharing and build settings
        Parameters:
          - OrganizationId
          - InstanceTypes

Parameters:
  ImageVersion:
    Type: String
    Default: '1.0.0'
    Description: Semantic version (MAJOR.MINOR.PATCH) applied to the software component and both image recipes.
    AllowedPattern: '^[0-9]+\.[0-9]+\.[0-9]+$'
    ConstraintDescription: The image version must use the MAJOR.MINOR.PATCH format, for example 1.0.0.

  RootVolumeSize:
    Type: Number
    Default: 32
    Description: Root EBS volume size in GiB applied to the AMIs produced by the pipelines.
    MinValue: 8
    MaxValue: 1024

  OrganizationId:
    Type: String
    Default: 'o-xxxxxxxxxx'
    Description: >-
      AWS Organization ID (format o-xxxxxxxxxx) that the built AMIs are shared with. The template
      builds the organization ARN arn:aws:organizations::<account>:organization/<id>. Replace the
      default with your organization ID.
    AllowedPattern: '^o-[a-z0-9]{10,32}$'
    ConstraintDescription: The organization ID must match the format o-xxxxxxxxxx.

  InstanceTypes:
    Type: CommaDelimitedList
    Default: 't3.medium,t4g.medium'
    Description: >-
      Build and test instance types. Include at least one x86_64 type and one arm64 (Graviton)
      type; Image Builder selects a type compatible with the source image architecture per build.

Resources:
  ImageBuilderInstanceRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: ec2.amazonaws.com
            Action: 'sts:AssumeRole'
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - 'arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/AmazonSSMManagedInstanceCore'
        - 'arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/EC2InstanceProfileForImageBuilder'
      Path: /
      Tags:
        - Key: StackName
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}'

  ImageBuilderInstanceProfile:
    Type: AWS::IAM::InstanceProfile
    Properties:
      Roles:
        - !Ref ImageBuilderInstanceRole

  Al2023SoftwareComponent:
    Type: AWS::ImageBuilder::Component
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-al2023-software'
      Version: !Ref ImageVersion
      Platform: Linux
      Description: Installs Docker, Docker Compose and Python packages, and enables sudo access for the SSM user.
      Data: |
        name: Al2023Software
        schemaVersion: 1.0
        phases:
          - name: build
            steps:
              - name: InstallDockerAndPip
                action: ExecuteBash
                inputs:
                  commands:
                    - |
                      set -euo pipefail
                      dnf install -y docker python3 python3-pip
                      systemctl enable docker
              - name: InstallDockerCompose
                action: ExecuteBash
                inputs:
                  commands:
                    - |
                      compose_arch="$(uname -m)"
                      plugin_dir="/usr/local/lib/docker/cli-plugins"
                      mkdir -p "${plugin_dir}"
                      curl -fsSL "https://github.com/docker/compose/releases/latest/download/docker-compose-linux-${compose_arch}" -o "${plugin_dir}/docker-compose"
                      chmod +x "${plugin_dir}/docker-compose"
              - name: InstallPythonPackages
                action: ExecuteBash
                inputs:
                  commands:
                    - |
                      python3 -m pip install --no-cache-dir synapseclient pandas pysftp
              - name: EnableSsmUserSudo
                action: ExecuteBash
                inputs:
                  commands:
                    - |
                      if ! id -u ssm-user > /dev/null 2>&1; then
                        useradd -m -s /bin/bash ssm-user
                      fi
                      echo 'ssm-user ALL=(ALL) NOPASSWD:ALL' > /etc/sudoers.d/ssm-agent-users
                      chmod 0440 /etc/sudoers.d/ssm-agent-users
          - name: validate
            steps:
              - name: ValidateSudoersFile
                action: ExecuteBash
                inputs:
                  commands:
                    - |
                      visudo -cf /etc/sudoers.d/ssm-agent-users
          - name: test
            steps:
              - name: VerifyDockerCompose
                action: ExecuteBash
                inputs:
                  commands:
                    - |
                      docker --version
                      docker compose version
              - name: VerifyPythonImports
                action: ExecuteBash
                inputs:
                  commands:
                    - |
                      python3 -c 'import pandas, pysftp, synapseclient; print("Python package imports verified")'
      Tags:
        StackName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}'

  Al2023X86ImageRecipe:
    Type: AWS::ImageBuilder::ImageRecipe
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-al2023-x86-recipe'
      Version: !Ref ImageVersion
      Description: !Sub 'Amazon Linux 2023 x86_64 recipe for ${AWS::StackName} with Docker, Docker Compose and Python tooling'
      ParentImage: '{{resolve:ssm:/aws/service/ami-amazon-linux-latest/al2023-ami-kernel-default-x86_64}}'
      Components:
        - ComponentArn: !GetAtt Al2023SoftwareComponent.Arn
      BlockDeviceMappings:
        - DeviceName: /dev/xvda
          Ebs:
            DeleteOnTermination: true
            VolumeSize: !Ref RootVolumeSize
            VolumeType: gp3
      Tags:
        StackName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}'

  Al2023Arm64ImageRecipe:
    Type: AWS::ImageBuilder::ImageRecipe
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-al2023-arm64-recipe'
      Version: !Ref ImageVersion
      Description: !Sub 'Amazon Linux 2023 arm64 recipe for ${AWS::StackName} with Docker, Docker Compose and Python tooling'
      ParentImage: '{{resolve:ssm:/aws/service/ami-amazon-linux-latest/al2023-ami-kernel-default-arm64}}'
      Components:
        - ComponentArn: !GetAtt Al2023SoftwareComponent.Arn
      BlockDeviceMappings:
        - DeviceName: /dev/xvda
          Ebs:
            DeleteOnTermination: true
            VolumeSize: !Ref RootVolumeSize
            VolumeType: gp3
      Tags:
        StackName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}'

  InfrastructureConfiguration:
    Type: AWS::ImageBuilder::InfrastructureConfiguration
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-infrastructure'
      Description: !Sub 'Shared build infrastructure for the ${AWS::StackName} image pipelines'
      InstanceProfileName: !Ref ImageBuilderInstanceProfile
      InstanceTypes: !Ref InstanceTypes
      TerminateInstanceOnFailure: true
      ResourceTags:
        StackName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}'
      Tags:
        StackName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}'

  DistributionConfiguration:
    Type: AWS::ImageBuilder::DistributionConfiguration
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-distribution'
      Description: !Sub 'Distributes ${AWS::StackName} AMIs publicly and shares them with AWS organization ${OrganizationId}'
      Distributions:
        - Region: !Ref 'AWS::Region'
          AmiDistributionConfiguration:
            Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-al2023-{{ imagebuilder:architecture }}-{{ imagebuilder:buildDate }}-{{ imagebuilder:buildVersion }}'
            Description: !Sub 'Amazon Linux 2023 AMI with Docker, Docker Compose and Python tooling built by ${AWS::StackName}'
            LaunchPermissionConfiguration:
              UserGroups:
                - all
              OrganizationArns:
                - !Sub 'arn:aws:organizations::${AWS::AccountId}:organization/${OrganizationId}'
            AmiTags:
              StackName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}'
      Tags:
        StackName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}'

  ImagePipelineX86:
    Type: AWS::ImageBuilder::ImagePipeline
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-al2023-x86-pipeline'
      Description: !Sub 'Builds and distributes the x86_64 Amazon Linux 2023 AMI for ${AWS::StackName}'
      ImageRecipeArn: !GetAtt Al2023X86ImageRecipe.Arn
      InfrastructureConfigurationArn: !GetAtt InfrastructureConfiguration.Arn
      DistributionConfigurationArn: !GetAtt DistributionConfiguration.Arn
      EnhancedImageMetadataEnabled: true
      ImageTestsConfiguration:
        ImageTestsEnabled: true
        TimeoutMinutes: 120
      Tags:
        StackName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}'

  ImagePipelineArm64:
    Type: AWS::ImageBuilder::ImagePipeline
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-al2023-arm64-pipeline'
      Description: !Sub 'Builds and distributes the arm64 Amazon Linux 2023 AMI for ${AWS::StackName}'
      ImageRecipeArn: !GetAtt Al2023Arm64ImageRecipe.Arn
      InfrastructureConfigurationArn: !GetAtt InfrastructureConfiguration.Arn
      DistributionConfigurationArn: !GetAtt DistributionConfiguration.Arn
      EnhancedImageMetadataEnabled: true
      ImageTestsConfiguration:
        ImageTestsEnabled: true
        TimeoutMinutes: 120
      Tags:
        StackName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}'

Outputs:
  X86ImagePipelineArn:
    Description: ARN of the x86_64 image pipeline.
    Value: !GetAtt ImagePipelineX86.Arn
  Arm64ImagePipelineArn:
    Description: ARN of the arm64 image pipeline.
    Value: !GetAtt ImagePipelineArm64.Arn
  X86ImageRecipeArn:
    Description: ARN of the x86_64 image recipe.
    Value: !GetAtt Al2023X86ImageRecipe.Arn
  Arm64ImageRecipeArn:
    Description: ARN of the arm64 image recipe.
    Value: !GetAtt Al2023Arm64ImageRecipe.Arn
  SoftwareComponentArn:
    Description: ARN of the shared software installation component.
    Value: !GetAtt Al2023SoftwareComponent.Arn
  InfrastructureConfigurationArn:
    Description: ARN of the shared infrastructure configuration.
    Value: !GetAtt InfrastructureConfiguration.Arn
  DistributionConfigurationArn:
    Description: ARN of the shared distribution configuration.
    Value: !GetAtt DistributionConfiguration.Arn
  ImageBuilderInstanceProfileName:
    Description: Name of the instance profile used by the build and test instances.
    Value: !Ref ImageBuilderInstanceProfile

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >-
  AgentOps e-commerce analytics demo stack. Creates the agentops-ecommerce-users
  Cognito user pool with email verification and optional software token MFA, the
  agentops-web-client public app client configured for SRP and refresh token
  authentication, the team-alpha (precedence 10), team-beta (precedence 20) and
  admin (precedence 1) user groups, and a Lambda-backed custom resource that
  seeds six demo users with a shared demo password. The seeder is resilient to
  the Cognito custom attribute propagation race: it waits for the custom:role
  schema attribute to become visible, creates users first, and applies the
  custom:role values in a separate retry phase so seeding never fails because
  of schema propagation delays.

Parameters:
  CallbackUrl:
    Type: String
    Default: 'http://localhost:3000/auth/callback'
    AllowedPattern: '^https?://.+'
    Description: OAuth callback URL registered on the app client for local development.

Outputs:
  UserPoolId:
    Description: ID of the agentops-ecommerce-users Cognito user pool.
    Value: !Ref UserPool
  UserPoolArn:
    Description: ARN of the agentops-ecommerce-users Cognito user pool.
    Value: !GetAtt UserPool.Arn
  UserPoolClientId:
    Description: Client ID of the agentops-web-client public app client.
    Value: !Ref AppClient
  Region:
    Description: AWS Region in which this stack was deployed.
    Value: !Ref 'AWS::Region'
  SeederFunctionArn:
    Description: ARN of the Lambda function that seeds the demo users.
    Value: !GetAtt UserSeederFunction.Arn
  UserPoolDomainPrefix:
    Description: Hosted UI domain prefix of the user pool.
    Value: !Ref UserPoolDomain
  UserPoolHostedUIUrl:
    Description: Cognito hosted UI base URL for local development.
    Value: !Sub 'https://${UserPoolDomain}.auth.${AWS::Region}.amazoncognito.com'
  UserPoolProviderUrl:
    Description: User pool provider (issuer) URL.
    Value: !Sub 'https://cognito-idp.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com/${UserPool}'
  DemoUserPassword:
    Description: Shared demo password for all seeded demo users.
    Value: 'Demo1234!'

Resources:
  UserPool:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPool
    Properties:
      UserPoolName: agentops-ecommerce-users
      AutoVerifiedAttributes:
        - email
      UsernameAttributes:
        - email
      UsernameConfiguration:
        CaseSensitive: false
      MfaConfiguration: OPTIONAL
      EnabledMfas:
        - SOFTWARE_TOKEN_MFA
      Policies:
        PasswordPolicy:
          MinimumLength: 8
          RequireUppercase: true
          RequireLowercase: true
          RequireNumbers: true
          RequireSymbols: false
          TemporaryPasswordValidityDays: 7
      AccountRecoverySetting:
        RecoveryMechanisms:
          - Name: verified_email
            Priority: 1
      AdminCreateUserConfig:
        AllowAdminCreateUserOnly: true
      VerificationMessageTemplate:
        DefaultEmailOption: CONFIRM_WITH_CODE
      Schema:
        - Name: 'custom:role'
          AttributeDataType: String
          Mutable: true
          Required: false
          StringAttributeConstraints:
            MinLength: '1'
            MaxLength: '64'

  UserPoolDomain:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolDomain
    Properties:
      Domain: !Sub 'agentops-ecommerce-${AWS::AccountId}'
      UserPoolId: !Ref UserPool

  AppClient:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolClient
    DependsOn: UserPoolDomain
    Properties:
      ClientName: agentops-web-client
      UserPoolId: !Ref UserPool
      GenerateSecret: false
      ExplicitAuthFlows:
        - ALLOW_USER_SRP_AUTH
        - ALLOW_REFRESH_TOKEN_AUTH
      PreventUserExistenceErrors: ENABLED
      RefreshTokenValidity: 30
      AllowedOAuthFlowsUserPoolClient: true
      AllowedOAuthFlows:
        - code
      AllowedOAuthScopes:
        - openid
        - email
        - profile
      CallbackURLs:
        - !Ref CallbackUrl
      LogoutURLs:
        - 'http://localhost:3000/'
      SupportedIdentityProviders:
        - COGNITO

  TeamAlphaGroup:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolGroup
    Properties:
      GroupName: team-alpha
      Description: Team Alpha group for the AgentOps e-commerce demo.
      Precedence: 10
      UserPoolId: !Ref UserPool

  TeamBetaGroup:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolGroup
    Properties:
      GroupName: team-beta
      Description: Team Beta group for the AgentOps e-commerce demo.
      Precedence: 20
      UserPoolId: !Ref UserPool

  AdminGroup:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolGroup
    Properties:
      GroupName: admin
      Description: Administrator group for the AgentOps e-commerce demo.
      Precedence: 1
      UserPoolId: !Ref UserPool

  UserSeederLambdaRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: 'sts:AssumeRole'
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSLambdaBasicExecutionRole'
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: AgentOpsCognitoUserSeeder
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - 'cognito-idp:AdminCreateUser'
                  - 'cognito-idp:AdminGetUser'
                  - 'cognito-idp:AdminSetUserPassword'
                  - 'cognito-idp:AdminAddUserToGroup'
                  - 'cognito-idp:AdminUpdateUserAttributes'
                  - 'cognito-idp:AdminDeleteUser'
                  - 'cognito-idp:DescribeUserPool'
                Resource: !GetAtt UserPool.Arn

  UserSeederFunction:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    Properties:
      Description: Seeds demo users and group memberships into the AgentOps e-commerce Cognito user pool.
      Runtime: python3.12
      Handler: index.handler
      MemorySize: 256
      Timeout: 900
      Role: !GetAtt UserSeederLambdaRole.Arn
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import json
          import time
          import traceback
          import urllib.request

          import boto3
          from botocore.exceptions import ClientError

          DEMO_PASSWORD = "Demo1234!"

          RETRYABLE_CODES = [
              "InternalErrorException",
              "ThrottlingException",
              "TooManyRequestsException",
              "ServiceUnavailableException",
              "LimitExceededException",
              "ConcurrentModificationException",
          ]

          MAX_ATTEMPTS = 10
          BASE_DELAY = 3.0
          MAX_DELAY = 20.0
          SETTLE_SECONDS = 30.0
          SCHEMA_POLL_ATTEMPTS = 12
          SCHEMA_POLL_DELAY = 10.0

          USERS = [
              {"username": "alice@demo.local", "group": "team-alpha", "role": "member"},
              {"username": "bob@demo.local", "group": "team-alpha", "role": "member"},
              {"username": "charlie@demo.local", "group": "team-alpha", "role": "team_admin"},
              {"username": "dave@demo.local", "group": "team-beta", "role": "member"},
              {"username": "eve@demo.local", "group": "team-beta", "role": "team_admin"},
              {"username": "admin@demo.local", "group": "admin", "role": "admin"},
          ]


          def error_code(error):
              return error.response.get("Error", {}).get("Code", "")


          def error_message(error):
              return str(error.response.get("Error", {}).get("Message", ""))


          def is_retryable(error):
              return error_code(error) in RETRYABLE_CODES


          def is_schema_not_ready(error):
              if error_code(error) != "InvalidParameterException":
                  return False
              message = error_message(error).lower()
              return (
                  "could not be determined" in message
                  or "did not conform to the schema" in message
              )


          def call_with_retry(action, retry_not_found=False, **kwargs):
              delay = BASE_DELAY
              for attempt in range(1, MAX_ATTEMPTS + 1):
                  try:
                      return action(**kwargs)
                  except ClientError as error:
                      code = error_code(error)
                      retryable = is_retryable(error) or (
                          retry_not_found and code == "UserNotFoundException"
                      )
                      if retryable and attempt < MAX_ATTEMPTS:
                          print(
                              "Retryable error {0} (attempt {1}/{2}); retrying in {3}s".format(
                                  code, attempt, MAX_ATTEMPTS, delay
                              )
                          )
                          time.sleep(delay)
                          delay = min(delay * 2.0, MAX_DELAY)
                          continue
                      raise
              raise RuntimeError("Exhausted retries")


          def custom_role_is_visible(client, pool_id):
              response = client.describe_user_pool(UserPoolId=pool_id)
              attributes = response.get("UserPool", {}).get("SchemaAttributes", []) or []
              return any(
                  attribute.get("Name", "") == "custom:role" for attribute in attributes
              )


          def wait_for_custom_role_schema(client, pool_id):
              time.sleep(SETTLE_SECONDS)
              for attempt in range(1, SCHEMA_POLL_ATTEMPTS + 1):
                  try:
                      if custom_role_is_visible(client, pool_id):
                          print("custom:role visible in pool schema (poll {0})".format(attempt))
                          return True
                  except ClientError as error:
                      print("describe_user_pool failed (poll {0}): {1}".format(attempt, error))
                  time.sleep(SCHEMA_POLL_DELAY)
              print(
                  "custom:role not visible before seeding; role attributes will be "
                  "retried after user creation"
              )
              return False


          def base_attributes(username):
              return [
                  {"Name": "email", "Value": username},
                  {"Name": "email_verified", "Value": "true"},
              ]


          def ensure_user_exists(client, pool_id, username):
              try:
                  call_with_retry(client.admin_get_user, UserPoolId=pool_id, Username=username)
                  return True
              except ClientError as error:
                  if error_code(error) != "UserNotFoundException":
                      raise
              call_with_retry(
                  client.admin_create_user,
                  UserPoolId=pool_id,
                  Username=username,
                  UserAttributes=base_attributes(username),
                  MessageAction="SUPPRESS",
              )
              time.sleep(1.0)
              return False


          def seed_users(client, pool_id):
              seeded = []
              for user in USERS:
                  username = user["username"]
                  existed = ensure_user_exists(client, pool_id, username)
                  if existed:
                      print("User {0} already exists; refreshing base attributes".format(username))
                      call_with_retry(
                          client.admin_update_user_attributes,
                          UserPoolId=pool_id,
                          Username=username,
                          UserAttributes=base_attributes(username),
                      )
                  call_with_retry(
                      client.admin_set_user_password,
                      retry_not_found=True,
                      UserPoolId=pool_id,
                      Username=username,
                      Password=DEMO_PASSWORD,
                      Permanent=True,
                  )
                  call_with_retry(
                      client.admin_add_user_to_group,
                      retry_not_found=True,
                      UserPoolId=pool_id,
                      Username=username,
                      GroupName=user["group"],
                  )
                  seeded.append(username)
                  time.sleep(0.5)
              return seeded


          def try_apply_role(client, pool_id, username, role, deadline):
              delay = 5.0
              while time.time() < deadline:
                  try:
                      client.admin_update_user_attributes(
                          UserPoolId=pool_id,
                          Username=username,
                          UserAttributes=[{"Name": "custom:role", "Value": role}],
                      )
                      return True
                  except ClientError as error:
                      if not (is_retryable(error) or is_schema_not_ready(error)):
                          raise
                      if time.time() + delay >= deadline:
                          print("Deadline reached; deferring role update for {0}".format(username))
                          return False
                      print(
                          "Role update for {0} failed with {1}; retrying in {2}s".format(
                              username, error_code(error), delay
                          )
                      )
                      time.sleep(delay)
                      delay = min(delay * 1.5, 20.0)
              return False


          def apply_role_attributes(client, pool_id, deadline):
              applied = []
              pending = []
              for user in USERS:
                  username = user["username"]
                  try:
                      if try_apply_role(client, pool_id, username, user["role"], deadline):
                          applied.append(username)
                      else:
                          pending.append(username)
                  except Exception as error:
                      print("Role update for {0} failed: {1}".format(username, error))
                      pending.append(username)
              return applied, pending


          def delete_users(client, pool_id):
              for user in USERS:
                  try:
                      client.admin_delete_user(UserPoolId=pool_id, Username=user["username"])
                  except Exception as error:
                      print("Ignoring delete error for {0}: {1}".format(user["username"], error))


          def send_response(event, context, status, data=None, reason=None):
              response_body = {
                  "Status": status,
                  "Reason": reason
                  or (
                      "See the details in CloudWatch Log Stream: "
                      + str(getattr(context, "log_stream_name", "unknown"))
                  ),
                  "PhysicalResourceId": event.get("PhysicalResourceId")
                  or (
                      "agentops-user-seeder-"
                      + event.get("ResourceProperties", {}).get("UserPoolId", "unknown")
                  ),
                  "StackId": event["StackId"],
                  "RequestId": event["RequestId"],
                  "LogicalResourceId": event["LogicalResourceId"],
                  "NoEcho": False,
                  "Data": data or {},
              }
              payload = json.dumps(response_body).encode("utf-8")
              request = urllib.request.Request(event["ResponseURL"], data=payload, method="PUT")
              request.add_header("Content-Type", "")
              request.add_header("Content-Length", str(len(payload)))
              urllib.request.urlopen(request, timeout=30)
              print("Sent {0} response to CloudFormation".format(status))


          def handler(event, context):
              request_type = event.get("RequestType")
              pool_id = event.get("ResourceProperties", {}).get("UserPoolId", "")
              print("Received {0} request for user pool {1}".format(request_type, pool_id))
              try:
                  if request_type in ("Create", "Update"):
                      client = boto3.client("cognito-idp")
                      wait_for_custom_role_schema(client, pool_id)
                      remaining = context.get_remaining_time_in_millis() / 1000.0
                      deadline = time.time() + max(remaining - 60.0, 30.0)
                      seeded = seed_users(client, pool_id)
                      applied, pending = apply_role_attributes(client, pool_id, deadline)
                      data = {
                          "UserPoolId": pool_id,
                          "SeededUsers": ",".join(seeded),
                          "RolesApplied": ",".join(applied),
                      }
                      if pending:
                          data["RolesPending"] = ",".join(pending)
                      reason = "Seeded {0} demo users with passwords and groups".format(len(seeded))
                      if pending:
                          reason += "; custom:role pending for " + ",".join(pending)
                      send_response(event, context, "SUCCESS", data, reason=reason)
                  elif request_type == "Delete":
                      delete_users(boto3.client("cognito-idp"), pool_id)
                      send_response(event, context, "SUCCESS", {}, reason="Demo users removed")
                  else:
                      send_response(
                          event,
                          context,
                          "FAILED",
                          {"Error": "Unsupported RequestType"},
                          reason="Unsupported RequestType",
                      )
              except Exception as error:
                  print("Handler failed: " + traceback.format_exc())
                  send_response(
                      event, context, "FAILED", {"Error": str(error)}, reason=str(error)[:255]
                  )

  UserSeeder:
    Type: AWS::CloudFormation::CustomResource
    Version: '1.0'
    DependsOn:
      - TeamAlphaGroup
      - TeamBetaGroup
      - AdminGroup
    Properties:
      ServiceToken: !GetAtt UserSeederFunction.Arn
      UserPoolId: !Ref UserPool

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: Creates a set of CloudWatch Logs Insights saved queries and a CloudWatch dashboard for comprehensive AWS Client VPN usage reporting covering AD/SAML, Mutual Auth, and Mixed Auth authentication methods.

Parameters:
  ClientVpnLogGroupName:
    Type: String
    Default: aws/aws-client-vpn/prod
    Description: Name of the CloudWatch Logs log group that contains the AWS Client VPN connection logs.
    AllowedPattern: '^[a-zA-Z0-9._/#-]+$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must be a valid CloudWatch Logs log group name.
  QueryFolderName:
    Type: String
    Default: aws-client-vpn
    Description: Optional folder path used to organize the saved CloudWatch Logs Insights queries (nest folders using forward slashes).
    AllowedPattern: '^[a-zA-Z0-9._/-]*$'
    ConstraintDescription: Folder path may only contain letters, numbers, periods, hyphens, underscores, and forward slashes.

Metadata:
  AWS::CloudFormation::Interface:
    ParameterGroups:
      - Label:
          default: AWS Client VPN Connection Logs
        Parameters:
          - ClientVpnLogGroupName
      - Label:
          default: Insights Query Organization
        Parameters:
          - QueryFolderName
    ParameterLabels:
      ClientVpnLogGroupName:
        default: Client VPN Log Group Name
      QueryFolderName:
        default: Query Folder Path

Resources:
  ClientVpnTotalUsagePerEndpointQuery:
    Type: AWS::Logs::QueryDefinition
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${QueryFolderName}/total-usage-per-endpoint'
      LogGroupNames:
        - !Ref ClientVpnLogGroupName
      QueryString: |
        fields @timestamp, client-vpn-endpoint-id as endpointId, username, client-ip, authentication-method as authMethod, connection-duration as durationSeconds
        | filter ispresent(client-vpn-endpoint-id)
        | stats count() as totalConnections, count_distinct(username) as distinctUsers, sum(connection-duration) as totalDurationSeconds by client-vpn-endpoint-id
        | sort totalConnections desc
        | limit 50

  ClientVpnUsageByAuthTypeQuery:
    Type: AWS::Logs::QueryDefinition
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${QueryFolderName}/usage-by-authentication-type'
      LogGroupNames:
        - !Ref ClientVpnLogGroupName
      QueryString: |
        fields @timestamp, client-vpn-endpoint-id as endpointId, username, authentication-method as authMethod, connection-duration as durationSeconds
        | filter ispresent(authentication-method)
        | stats count() as totalConnections, count_distinct(username) as distinctUsers, sum(connection-duration) as totalDurationSeconds by authentication-method
        | sort totalConnections desc

  ClientVpnDistinctUsersQuery:
    Type: AWS::Logs::QueryDefinition
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${QueryFolderName}/distinct-users'
      LogGroupNames:
        - !Ref ClientVpnLogGroupName
      QueryString: |
        fields @timestamp, username, client-vpn-endpoint-id as endpointId, authentication-method as authMethod
        | filter ispresent(username)
        | stats count() as totalConnections, count_distinct(client-vpn-endpoint-id) as endpointsUsed, min(@timestamp) as firstConnection, max(@timestamp) as lastConnection by username
        | sort totalConnections desc
        | limit 100

  ClientVpnConnectionDurationsQuery:
    Type: AWS::Logs::QueryDefinition
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${QueryFolderName}/connection-durations'
      LogGroupNames:
        - !Ref ClientVpnLogGroupName
      QueryString: |
        fields @timestamp, username, client-vpn-endpoint-id as endpointId, connection-duration as durationSeconds
        | filter ispresent(connection-duration)
        | stats count() as connections, round(avg(connection-duration), 2) as avgDurationSeconds, round(max(connection-duration), 2) as maxDurationSeconds, round(min(connection-duration), 2) as minDurationSeconds, sum(connection-duration) as totalDurationSeconds by username
        | sort totalDurationSeconds desc
        | limit 100

  ClientVpnAdSamlAuthQuery:
    Type: AWS::Logs::QueryDefinition
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${QueryFolderName}/ad-saml-auth-connections'
      LogGroupNames:
        - !Ref ClientVpnLogGroupName
      QueryString: |
        fields @timestamp, username, client-vpn-endpoint-id as endpointId, authentication-method as authMethod, connection-duration as durationSeconds
        | filter authentication-method in ["AD-authentication", "SAML-authentication"]
        | stats count() as totalConnections, count_distinct(username) as distinctUsers, sum(connection-duration) as totalDurationSeconds by authentication-method
        | sort totalConnections desc

  ClientVpnMutualAuthQuery:
    Type: AWS::Logs::QueryDefinition
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${QueryFolderName}/mutual-auth-connections'
      LogGroupNames:
        - !Ref ClientVpnLogGroupName
      QueryString: |
        fields @timestamp, username, client-vpn-endpoint-id as endpointId, authentication-method as authMethod, connection-duration as durationSeconds
        | filter authentication-method = "Mutual-authentication"
        | stats count() as totalConnections, count_distinct(username) as distinctUsers, sum(connection-duration) as totalDurationSeconds by client-vpn-endpoint-id
        | sort totalConnections desc
        | limit 50

  ClientVpnMixedAuthQuery:
    Type: AWS::Logs::QueryDefinition
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${QueryFolderName}/mixed-auth-connections'
      LogGroupNames:
        - !Ref ClientVpnLogGroupName
      QueryString: |
        fields @timestamp, username, client-vpn-endpoint-id as endpointId, authentication-method as authMethod, connection-duration as durationSeconds
        | filter authentication-method like "+Mutual-authentication" or authentication-method like "Mutual-authentication+"
        | stats count() as totalConnections, count_distinct(username) as distinctUsers, sum(connection-duration) as totalDurationSeconds by authentication-method
        | sort totalConnections desc

  ClientVpnUsageDashboard:

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >-
  AnyCompany Hotel guest and staff authentication stack. Creates a PLUS-tier
  Cognito user pool with enforced advanced security features, email username
  attribute, admin-only user creation, custom guest_id/property_id/region
  attributes, a strong password policy and email-based account recovery.
  Includes a public SPA app client (SRP, no secret), a dedicated admin app
  client (ADMIN_USER_PASSWORD_AUTH) for server-side test harnesses, an M2M
  OAuth2 client-credentials app client with a dedicated resource server
  (identifier: hotelapi) exposing read/write/admin custom scopes referenced in
  the required resource-server-identifier/scope-name format, six staff role
  groups, and a user pool domain scoped by environment and account ID so the
  OAuth2 token endpoint is reachable.

Metadata:
  AWS::CloudFormation::Interface:
    ParameterGroups:
      - Label:
          default: Deployment Configuration
        Parameters:
          - ProjectName
          - Environment
    ParameterLabels:
      ProjectName:
        default: Project Name
      Environment:
        default: Environment

Parameters:
  ProjectName:
    Type: String
    Default: anycompany-hotel
    Description: Lowercase project identifier used in resource names and the user pool domain prefix.
    AllowedPattern: '^[a-z][a-z0-9-]{1,18}[a-z0-9]$'
    ConstraintDescription: Value must be 3-20 lowercase alphanumeric characters or hyphens, start with a letter, and not end with a hyphen.
    MinLength: 3
    MaxLength: 20

  Environment:
    Type: String
    Default: dev
    Description: Deployment environment used in resource names and the user pool domain.
    AllowedValues:
      - dev
      - staging
      - prod
    ConstraintDescription: Environment must be one of dev, staging or prod.

Resources:
  UserPool:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPool
    Properties:
      UserPoolName: !Sub '${ProjectName}-${Environment}-user-pool'
      UserPoolTier: PLUS
      UsernameAttributes:
        - email
      UsernameConfiguration:
        CaseSensitive: false
      AutoVerifiedAttributes:
        - email
      MfaConfiguration: 'OFF'
      Policies:
        PasswordPolicy:
          MinimumLength: 12
          RequireUppercase: true
          RequireLowercase: true
          RequireNumbers: true
          RequireSymbols: true
          TemporaryPasswordValidityDays: 7
      AccountRecoverySetting:
        RecoveryMechanisms:
          - Name: verified_email
            Priority: 1
      AdminCreateUserConfig:
        AllowAdminCreateUserOnly: true
        InviteMessageTemplate:
          EmailSubject: Your AnyCompany Hotel account credentials
          EmailMessage: 'Your AnyCompany Hotel account has been created. Your username is {username} and your temporary password is {####}. Please sign in and change your password.'
      EmailConfiguration:
        EmailSendingAccount: COGNITO_DEFAULT
      EmailVerificationSubject: Verify your AnyCompany Hotel account
      EmailVerificationMessage: 'Your AnyCompany Hotel verification code is {####}.'
      Schema:
        - Name: guest_id
          AttributeDataType: String
          Mutable: true
          StringAttributeConstraints:
            MinLength: '1'
            MaxLength: '256'
        - Name: property_id
          AttributeDataType: String
          Mutable: true
          StringAttributeConstraints:
            MinLength: '1'
            MaxLength: '256'
        - Name: region
          AttributeDataType: String
          Mutable: true
          StringAttributeConstraints:
            MinLength: '1'
            MaxLength: '256'
      UserPoolAddOns:
        AdvancedSecurityMode: ENFORCED

  UserPoolDomain:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolDomain
    Properties:
      UserPoolId: !Ref UserPool
      Domain: !Sub '${ProjectName}-${Environment}-${AWS::AccountId}'

  UserPoolResourceServer:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolResourceServer
    Properties:
      UserPoolId: !Ref UserPool
      Identifier: hotelapi
      Name: !Sub '${ProjectName} Hotel API'
      Scopes:
        - ScopeName: read
          ScopeDescription: Read access to AnyCompany Hotel APIs.
        - ScopeName: write
          ScopeDescription: Write access to AnyCompany Hotel APIs.
        - ScopeName: admin
          ScopeDescription: Administrative access to AnyCompany Hotel APIs.

  UserPoolClientSpa:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolClient
    Properties:
      UserPoolId: !Ref UserPool
      ClientName: !Sub '${ProjectName}-${Environment}-spa-public-client'
      GenerateSecret: false
      ExplicitAuthFlows:
        - ALLOW_USER_SRP_AUTH
        - ALLOW_REFRESH_TOKEN_AUTH
      PreventUserExistenceErrors: ENABLED
      EnableTokenRevocation: true
      AccessTokenValidity: 1
      IdTokenValidity: 1
      RefreshTokenValidity: 30
      TokenValidityUnits:
        AccessToken: hours
        IdToken: hours
        RefreshToken: days

  UserPoolClientAdmin:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolClient
    Properties:
      UserPoolId: !Ref UserPool
      ClientName: !Sub '${ProjectName}-${Environment}-admin-server-client'
      GenerateSecret: false
      ExplicitAuthFlows:
        - ALLOW_ADMIN_USER_PASSWORD_AUTH
        - ALLOW_REFRESH_TOKEN_AUTH
      PreventUserExistenceErrors: ENABLED
      EnableTokenRevocation: true
      AccessTokenValidity: 1
      IdTokenValidity: 1
      RefreshTokenValidity: 30
      TokenValidityUnits:
        AccessToken: hours
        IdToken: hours
        RefreshToken: days

  UserPoolClientM2m:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolClient
    DependsOn: UserPoolResourceServer

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >-
  Amazon Cognito stack for the Hospitality Insights application (prod). It
  creates a user pool with a custom last_login attribute, a user pool client
  with a 24 hour session timeout, a Python post-authentication Lambda trigger
  that stamps custom:last_login on every successful sign-in, the Admin,
  RegularUser and PowerUser groups, and optional SAML single sign-on
  federation plus an optional hosted UI domain prefix.

Metadata:
  AWS::CloudFormation::Interface:
    ParameterGroups:
      - Label:
          default: General configuration
        Parameters:
          - ApplicationName
          - Environment
      - Label:
          default: SAML single sign-on (optional)
        Parameters:
          - SSOProviderName
          - SSOLoginURL
      - Label:
          default: Hosted UI domain (optional)
        Parameters:
          - HostedUIDomainPrefix

Parameters:
  ApplicationName:
    Type: String
    Default: HospitalityInsights
    Description: Application name used as a prefix for resource names.
    AllowedPattern: '^[A-Za-z0-9-]{1,38}$'

  Environment:
    Type: String
    Default: prod
    Description: Deployment environment for the application.
    AllowedValues:
      - dev
      - test
      - staging
      - prod

  SSOProviderName:
    Type: String
    Default: ''
    Description: >-
      Name of the SAML federated identity provider to register on the user
      pool. Leave empty (together with SSOLoginURL) to disable SSO.
    AllowedPattern: '^$|^[A-Za-z0-9_.-]{1,32}$'

  SSOLoginURL:
    Type: String
    Default: ''
    Description: >-
      SAML metadata (login) URL of the federated identity provider. Leave
      empty (together with SSOProviderName) to disable SSO.
    AllowedPattern: '^$|^https?://\S+$'

  HostedUIDomainPrefix:
    Type: String
    Default: 'hospitality-insights-prod'
    Description: >-
      Prefix for the Cognito hosted UI domain. The AWS account ID is appended
      to keep the prefix globally unique. Leave empty to skip creation of the
      hosted UI domain.
    AllowedPattern: '^[a-z](?:[a-z0-9-]{0,40}[a-z0-9])?$'

Conditions:
  EnableSSO: !And
    - !Not
      - !Equals
        - !Ref SSOProviderName
        - ''
    - !Not
      - !Equals
        - !Ref SSOLoginURL
        - ''
  DisableSSO: !Not
    - Condition: EnableSSO
  CreateHostedUIDomain: !Not
    - !Equals
      - !Ref HostedUIDomainPrefix
      - ''

Resources:
  LambdaExecutionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service:
                - lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: post-auth-logs-access
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogGroup
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                Resource:
                  - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:logs:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:log-group:/aws/lambda/${ApplicationName}-${Environment}-post-auth:*'
      Tags:
        - Key: Application
          Value: !Ref ApplicationName
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment

  PostAuthLambda:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    Properties:
      FunctionName: !Sub '${ApplicationName}-${Environment}-post-auth'
      Description: >-
        Cognito post-authentication trigger that updates the custom last_login
        attribute with the UTC timestamp of each successful sign-in.
      Runtime: python3.12
      Handler: index.handler
      MemorySize: 128
      Timeout: 30
      Role: !GetAtt LambdaExecutionRole.Arn
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          from datetime import datetime, timezone

          import boto3

          cognito_idp_client = boto3.client("cognito-idp")


          def handler(event, context):
              """Cognito post-authentication trigger.

              Stamps the custom:last_login attribute of the authenticated user
              with the UTC timestamp of every successful sign-in and always
              returns the original event back to Amazon Cognito.
              """
              try:
                  user_pool_id = event.get("userPoolId")
                  username = event.get("userName")

                  if not user_pool_id or not username:
                      print("Post-authentication event is missing userPoolId or userName.")
                      return event

                  last_login = datetime.now(timezone.utc).strftime("%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ")

                  cognito_idp_client.admin_update_user_attributes(
                      UserPoolId=user_pool_id,
                      Username=username,
                      UserAttributes=[
                          {"Name": "custom:last_login", "Value": last_login}
                      ],
                  )

                  print(f"Updated custom:last_login attribute for user {username}")
              except Exception as error:
                  print(f"Failed to update custom:last_login attribute: {error}")

              return event

  UserPool:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPool
    Properties:
      UserPoolName: !Sub '${ApplicationName}-${Environment}-user-pool'
      MfaConfiguration: 'OFF'
      AutoVerifiedAttributes:
        - email
      UsernameAttributes:
        - email
      UsernameConfiguration:
        CaseSensitive: false
      Policies:
        PasswordPolicy:
          MinimumLength: 8
          RequireLowercase: true
          RequireNumbers: true
          RequireSymbols: true
          RequireUppercase: true
          TemporaryPasswordValidityDays: 7
      AdminCreateUserConfig:
        AllowAdminCreateUserOnly: false
      AccountRecoverySetting:
        RecoveryMechanisms:
          - Name: verified_email
            Priority: 1
      Schema:
        - Name: last_login
          AttributeDataType: String
          Mutable: true
          StringAttributeConstraints:
            MinLength: '0'
            MaxLength: '2048'
      LambdaConfig:
        PostAuthentication: !GetAtt PostAuthLambda.Arn
      UserPoolTags:
        Application: !Ref ApplicationName
        Environment: !Ref Environment

  PostAuthLambdaCognitoAccessPolicy:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Policy
    Properties:
      PolicyName: post-auth-cognito-access
      Roles:
        - !Ref LambdaExecutionRole
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: AllowLastLoginAttributeUpdate
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - cognito-idp:AdminUpdateUserAttributes
            Resource:
              - !GetAtt UserPool.Arn

  PostAuthLambdaPermission:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Permission
    Properties:
      Action: lambda:InvokeFunction
      FunctionName: !Ref PostAuthLambda
      Principal: cognito-idp.amazonaws.com
      SourceArn: !GetAtt UserPool.Arn

  UserPoolIdentityProviderSaml:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolIdentityProvider
    Condition: EnableSSO
    Properties:
      UserPoolId: !Ref UserPool
      ProviderName: !Ref SSOProviderName
      ProviderType: 'SAML'
      ProviderDetails:
        MetadataURL: !Ref SSOLoginURL
      AttributeMapping:
        email: 'http://schemas.xmlsoap.org/ws/2005/05/identity/claims/emailaddress'

  UserPoolClient:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolClient
    Condition: DisableSSO
    Properties:
      ClientName: !Sub '${ApplicationName}-${Environment}-client'
      UserPoolId: !Ref UserPool
      GenerateSecret: false
      PreventUserExistenceErrors: 'ENABLED'
      ExplicitAuthFlows:
        - ALLOW_USER_SRP_AUTH
        - ALLOW_USER_PASSWORD_AUTH
        - ALLOW_REFRESH_TOKEN_AUTH
      EnableTokenRevocation: true
      RefreshTokenValidity: 30
      AccessTokenValidity: 24
      IdTokenValidity: 24
      TokenValidityUnits:
        AccessToken: 'hours'
        IdToken: 'hours'
        RefreshToken: 'days'
      SupportedIdentityProviders:
        - COGNITO

  UserPoolClientSso:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolClient
    Condition: EnableSSO
    DependsOn: UserPoolIdentityProviderSaml
    Properties:
      ClientName: !Sub '${ApplicationName}-${Environment}-client'
      UserPoolId: !Ref UserPool
      GenerateSecret: false
      PreventUserExistenceErrors: 'ENABLED'
      ExplicitAuthFlows:
        - ALLOW_USER_SRP_AUTH
        - ALLOW_USER_PASSWORD_AUTH
        - ALLOW_REFRESH_TOKEN_AUTH
      EnableTokenRevocation: true
      RefreshTokenValidity: 30
      AccessTokenValidity: 24
      IdTokenValidity: 24
      TokenValidityUnits:
        AccessToken: 'hours'
        IdToken: 'hours'
        RefreshToken: 'days'
      SupportedIdentityProviders:
        - COGNITO
        - !Ref SSOProviderName

  UserPoolDomain:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolDomain
    Condition: CreateHostedUIDomain
    Properties:
      Domain: !Sub '${HostedUIDomainPrefix}-${AWS::AccountId}'
      UserPoolId: !Ref UserPool

  AdminUserGroup:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolGroup
    Properties:
      GroupName: Admin
      UserPoolId: !Ref UserPool
      Precedence: 1
      Description: Administrators of the Hospitality Insights application.

  RegularUserGroup:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolGroup
    Properties:
      GroupName: RegularUser
      UserPoolId: !Ref UserPool
      Precedence: 2
      Description: Regular users of the Hospitality Insights application.

  PowerUserGroup:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolGroup
    Properties:
      GroupName: PowerUser
      UserPoolId: !Ref UserPool
      Precedence: 3
      Description: Power users of the Hospitality Insights application.

Outputs:
  UserPoolId:
    Description: ID of the Hospitality Insights Cognito user pool.
    Value: !Ref UserPool

  UserPoolArn:
    Description: ARN of the Hospitality Insights Cognito user pool.
    Value: !GetAtt UserPool.Arn

  UserPoolProviderURL:
    Description: Provider URL of the Cognito user pool.
    Value: !GetAtt UserPool.ProviderURL

  UserPoolClientId:
    Description: ID of the user pool client with the 24 hour session timeout.
    Value: !If
      - EnableSSO
      - !Ref UserPoolClientSso
      - !Ref UserPoolClient

  PostAuthLambdaArn:
    Description: ARN of the post-authentication Lambda trigger.
    Value: !GetAtt PostAuthLambda.Arn

  HostedUIDomainURL:
    Description: URL of the Cognito hosted UI domain.
    Value: !If
      - CreateHostedUIDomain
      - !Sub 'https://${UserPoolDomain.CloudFrontDistribution}'
      - 'Hosted UI domain is disabled. Provide HostedUIDomainPrefix to enable it.'

  HostedUILoginURL:
    Description: Login URL of the Cognito hosted UI domain.
    Value: !If
      - CreateHostedUIDomain
      - !Sub 'https://${HostedUIDomainPrefix}-${AWS::AccountId}.auth.${AWS::Region}.amazoncognito.com'
      - 'Hosted UI domain is disabled. Provide HostedUIDomainPrefix to enable it.'

  SSOIdentityProviderName:
    Description: Name of the federated SAML identity provider when SSO is enabled.
    Value: !If
      - EnableSSO
      - !Ref SSOProviderName
      - 'SSO is disabled. Provide SSOProviderName and SSOLoginURL to enable it.'

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >-
  Creates a WebSocket API that manages client connections and session state.
  The $connect route stores new connection identifiers in a DynamoDB session
  table via a direct service integration, the $default route echoes incoming
  messages back to the client with a Lambda function, and the $disconnect
  route removes disconnected clients from the session table. The session
  table has time-to-live enabled for automatic cleanup of expired sessions,
  and API Gateway is granted IAM permissions to write and delete items from
  the session tracking table.

Metadata:
  AWS::CloudFormation::Interface:
    ParameterGroups:
      - Label:
          default: API Configuration
        Parameters:
          - StageName
      - Label:
          default: Session Configuration
        Parameters:
          - SessionTtlSeconds
    ParameterLabels:
      StageName:
        default: WebSocket API stage name
      SessionTtlSeconds:
        default: Session time-to-live (seconds)

Parameters:
  StageName:
    Type: String
    Default: api
    Description: Name of the WebSocket API stage (defaults to api).
    AllowedPattern: '^[a-zA-Z0-9_-]+$'
    MinLength: 1
    MaxLength: 128
  SessionTtlSeconds:
    Type: Number
    Default: 86400
    Description: Number of seconds a session record remains in the table before TTL cleanup.
    MinValue: 60
    MaxValue: 157680000

Resources:
  WebSocketApi:
    Type: AWS::ApiGatewayV2::Api
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-websocket-api'
      Description: WebSocket API for managing client connections and session state.
      ProtocolType: WEBSOCKET
      RouteSelectionExpression: '$request.body.action'

  SessionTable:
    Type: AWS::DynamoDB::Table
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      TableName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-sessions'
      BillingMode: PAY_PER_REQUEST
      AttributeDefinitions:
        - AttributeName: connectionId
          AttributeType: S
      KeySchema:
        - AttributeName: connectionId
          KeyType: HASH
      TimeToLiveSpecification:
        AttributeName: expiresAt
        Enabled: true
      SSESpecification:
        SSEEnabled: true

  ApiGatewaySessionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      Description: Allows API Gateway to write and delete items in the session tracking table.
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: apigateway.amazonaws.com
            Action: 'sts:AssumeRole'
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: SessionTableWriteDelete
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - 'dynamodb:PutItem'
                  - 'dynamodb:DeleteItem'
                Resource: !GetAtt SessionTable.Arn

  ConnectIntegration:
    Type: AWS::ApiGatewayV2::Integration
    Properties:
      ApiId: !Ref WebSocketApi
      Description: Stores each new connection identifier in the session tracking table.
      CredentialsArn: !GetAtt ApiGatewaySessionRole.Arn
      IntegrationType: AWS
      IntegrationMethod: POST
      IntegrationUri: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:apigateway:${AWS::Region}:dynamodb:action/PutItem'
      PassthroughBehavior: NEVER
      TemplateSelectionExpression: application/json
      TimeoutInMillis: 29000
      RequestTemplates:
        application/json: !Sub
          - |-
            #set($expiresAt = ($context.requestTimeEpoch / 1000) + ${SessionTtlSeconds})
            {
              "TableName": "${SessionTableName}",
              "Item": {
                "connectionId": {"S": "$context.connectionId"},
                "expiresAt": {"N": "$expiresAt"}
              }
            }
          - SessionTableName: !Ref SessionTable
            SessionTtlSeconds: !Ref SessionTtlSeconds

  DisconnectIntegration:
    Type: AWS::ApiGatewayV2::Integration
    Properties:
      ApiId: !Ref WebSocketApi
      Description: Removes each disconnected connection identifier from the session tracking table.
      CredentialsArn: !GetAtt ApiGatewaySessionRole.Arn
      IntegrationType: AWS
      IntegrationMethod: POST
      IntegrationUri: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:apigateway:${AWS::Region}:dynamodb:action/DeleteItem'
      PassthroughBehavior: NEVER
      TemplateSelectionExpression: application/json
      TimeoutInMillis: 29000
      RequestTemplates:
        application/json: !Sub
          - |-
            {
              "TableName": "${SessionTableName}",
              "Key": {
                "connectionId": {"S": "$context.connectionId"}
              }
            }
          - SessionTableName: !Ref SessionTable

  EchoFunctionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      Description: Execution role for the WebSocket echo Lambda function.
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: 'sts:AssumeRole'
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSLambdaBasicExecutionRole'
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: PostToConnection
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action: 'execute-api:Invoke'
                Resource: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:execute-api:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:${WebSocketApi}/*/POST/@connections/*'

  EchoFunction:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    Properties:
      FunctionName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-echo-function'
      Description: Echoes incoming WebSocket messages back to the sending client.
      Runtime: python3.12
      Handler: index.handler
      MemorySize: 128
      Timeout: 10
      Role: !GetAtt EchoFunctionRole.Arn
      Environment:
        Variables:
          API_ID: !Ref WebSocketApi
          STAGE_NAME: !Ref StageName
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import base64
          import os

          import boto3

          apigw_management = boto3.client(
              "apigatewaymanagementapi",
              endpoint_url="https://{api_id}.execute-api.{region}.amazonaws.com/{stage}".format(
                  api_id=os.environ["API_ID"],
                  region=os.environ["AWS_REGION"],
                  stage=os.environ["STAGE_NAME"],
              ),
          )


          def handler(event, context):
              try:
                  connection_id = event["requestContext"]["connectionId"]
                  message = event.get("body") or ""
                  if event.get("isBase64Encoded"):
                      message = base64.b64decode(message).decode("utf-8")
                  if message:
                      apigw_management.post_to_connection(
                          ConnectionId=connection_id,
                          Data=message.encode("utf-8"),
                      )
                  return {"statusCode": 200, "body": "Message echoed."}
              except Exception as error:
                  print("Failed to echo message: %s" % error)
                  return {"statusCode": 500, "body": "Failed to echo message."}

  EchoFunctionPermission:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Permission
    Properties:
      Action: lambda:InvokeFunction
      FunctionName: !Ref EchoFunction
      Principal: apigateway.amazonaws.com
      SourceArn: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:execute-api:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:${WebSocketApi}/*/*'

  EchoIntegration:
    Type: AWS::ApiGatewayV2::Integration
    DependsOn: EchoFunctionPermission
    Properties:
      ApiId: !Ref WebSocketApi
      Description: Invokes the echo Lambda function for the default route.
      IntegrationType: AWS_PROXY
      IntegrationMethod: POST
      IntegrationUri: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:apigateway:${AWS::Region}:lambda:path/2015-03-31/functions/${EchoFunction.Arn}/invocations'
      TimeoutInMillis: 29000

  ConnectRoute:
    Type: AWS::ApiGatewayV2::Route
    Properties:
      ApiId: !Ref WebSocketApi
      RouteKey: '$connect'
      Target: !Sub 'integrations/${ConnectIntegration}'

  DefaultRoute:
    Type: AWS::ApiGatewayV2::Route
    Properties:
      ApiId: !Ref WebSocketApi
      RouteKey: '$default'
      Target: !Sub 'integrations/${EchoIntegration}'

  DisconnectRoute:
    Type: AWS::ApiGatewayV2::Route
    Properties:
      ApiId: !Ref WebSocketApi
      RouteKey: '$disconnect'
      Target: !Sub 'integrations/${DisconnectIntegration}'

  WebSocketStage:
    Type: AWS::ApiGatewayV2::Stage
    DependsOn:
      - ConnectRoute
      - DefaultRoute
      - DisconnectRoute
    Properties:
      ApiId: !Ref WebSocketApi
      StageName: !Ref StageName
      AutoDeploy: true
      Description: Default stage for the WebSocket API.

Outputs:
  WebSocketApiUrl:
    Description: WebSocket endpoint URL for clients.
    Value: !Sub 'wss://${WebSocketApi}.execute-api.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com/${StageName}'
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-WebSocketApiUrl'
  WebSocketApiId:
    Description: Identifier of the WebSocket API.
    Value: !Ref WebSocketApi
  WebSocketStageName:
    Description: Name of the deployed WebSocket API stage.
    Value: !Ref WebSocketStage
  SessionTableName:
    Description: Name of the session tracking DynamoDB table.
    Value: !Ref SessionTable
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-SessionTableName'
  EchoFunctionArn:
    Description: ARN of the echo Lambda function.
    Value: !GetAtt EchoFunction.Arn

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >-
  Creates a basic VPC with a single public subnet for testing purposes, including
  an internet gateway, a public route table with a default route to the internet
  gateway, and a network ACL that allows all inbound and outbound TCP and UDP traffic.
Parameters:
  VpcCidr:
    Type: String
    Description: The CIDR block for the VPC (a /16 range from 172.18.0.0/16 to 172.23.0.0/16).
    Default: 172.18.0.0/16
    AllowedValues:
      - 172.18.0.0/16
      - 172.19.0.0/16
      - 172.20.0.0/16
      - 172.21.0.0/16
      - 172.22.0.0/16
      - 172.23.0.0/16
    ConstraintDescription: Must be one of the /16 ranges from 172.18.0.0/16 through 172.23.0.0/16.
Resources:
  VPC:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPC
    Properties:
      CidrBlock: !Ref VpcCidr
      EnableDnsHostnames: true
      EnableDnsSupport: true
      InstanceTenancy: default
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-vpc'
  InternetGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::InternetGateway
    Properties:
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-internet-gateway'
  VPCGatewayAttachment:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      InternetGatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
  PublicSubnet:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs '']
      CidrBlock: !Sub
        - '${FirstOctet}.${SecondOctet}.0.0/22'
        - FirstOctet: !Select [0, !Split ['.', !Ref VpcCidr]]
          SecondOctet: !Select [1, !Split ['.', !Ref VpcCidr]]
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: true
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-public-subnet'
  PublicRouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-public-route-table'
  PublicRoute:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    DependsOn: VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      GatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable
  PublicSubnetRouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet
  PublicNetworkAcl:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NetworkAcl
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-public-network-acl'
  PublicNetworkAclEntryInboundTcp:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NetworkAclEntry
    Properties:
      CidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      Egress: false
      NetworkAclId: !Ref PublicNetworkAcl
      PortRange:
        From: '0'
        To: '65535'
      Protocol: '6'
      RuleAction: allow
      RuleNumber: '100'
  PublicNetworkAclEntryInboundUdp:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NetworkAclEntry
    Properties:
      CidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      Egress: false
      NetworkAclId: !Ref PublicNetworkAcl
      PortRange:
        From: '0'
        To: '65535'
      Protocol: '17'
      RuleAction: allow
      RuleNumber: '110'
  PublicNetworkAclEntryOutboundTcp:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NetworkAclEntry
    Properties:
      CidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      Egress: true
      NetworkAclId: !Ref PublicNetworkAcl
      PortRange:
        From: '0'
        To: '65535'
      Protocol: '6'
      RuleAction: allow
      RuleNumber: '100'
  PublicNetworkAclEntryOutboundUdp:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NetworkAclEntry
    Properties:
      CidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      Egress: true
      NetworkAclId: !Ref PublicNetworkAcl
      PortRange:
        From: '0'
        To: '65535'
      Protocol: '17'
      RuleAction: allow
      RuleNumber: '110'
  PublicSubnetNetworkAclAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetNetworkAclAssociation
    Properties:
      NetworkAclId: !Ref PublicNetworkAcl
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet
