final_template:
AWSTemplateFormatVersion: "2010-09-09"
Description: >-
  AWS FIS chaos engineering experiment template that blocks application network traffic from the
  local deployment Region toward the target Region (provided by the TargetRegion parameter and
  recorded as a template tag) by disrupting connectivity for subnets tagged ChaosAllowed=true, and
  pauses S3 cross-region replication for buckets tagged ChaosAllowed=true. All actions run for the
  configurable duration (default 20 minutes). The stack defines ChaosAllowed=true targets for
  subnets, transit gateways, S3 buckets, and DynamoDB global tables, and provisions the FIS execution
  IAM role with scoped policies for network disruption, S3 replication pause, DynamoDB global table
  replication pause, and experiment log delivery, a CloudWatch alarm stop condition, and a
  CloudWatch Logs log group encrypted with a dedicated KMS key.

Metadata:
  AWS::CloudFormation::Interface:
    ParameterGroups:
      - Label:
          default: Chaos experiment configuration
        Parameters:
          - TargetRegion
          - ChaosDuration
    ParameterLabels:
      TargetRegion:
        default: Target Region (traffic from the local Region is blocked to this Region)
      ChaosDuration:
        default: Disruption and replication pause duration (ISO 8601)

Parameters:
  TargetRegion:
    Type: String
    Description: >-
      The AWS Region toward which application network traffic originating from the local deployment
      Region is blocked during the experiment. The value is recorded on the FIS experiment template
      as the TargetRegion tag.
    Default: us-west-2
    AllowedPattern: '^[a-z]{2}(-gov)?-[a-z]+-[0-9]$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must be a valid AWS Region identifier, for example us-east-1.
  ChaosDuration:
    Type: String
    Description: >-
      ISO 8601 duration supplied as the duration parameter of every FIS action, controlling how long
      network connectivity is disrupted and how long S3 cross-region replication stays paused.
      Defaults to 20 minutes (PT20M).
    Default: PT20M
    AllowedPattern: '^PT[0-9]+[SMH]$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must be a valid ISO 8601 time duration, for example PT20M, PT1H, or PT30S.

Resources:
  ChaosLogEncryptionKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      Description: !Sub 'Dedicated KMS key encrypting the FIS experiment CloudWatch Logs log group for stack ${AWS::StackName}.'
      Enabled: true
      EnableKeyRotation: true
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Sid: EnableIAMUserPermissions
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub 'arn:aws:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root'
            Action: 'kms:*'
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: AllowCloudWatchLogsToUseTheKey
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: !Sub 'logs.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com'
            Action:
              - kms:Encrypt
              - kms:Decrypt
              - kms:ReEncrypt*
              - kms:GenerateDataKey*
              - kms:Describe*
            Resource: '*'
            Condition:
              ArnLike:
                'kms:EncryptionContext:aws:logs:arn': !Sub 'arn:aws:logs:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:log-group:/aws/fis/*'

  FISExperimentLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Sub '/aws/fis/${AWS::StackName}'
      KmsKeyId: !GetAtt ChaosLogEncryptionKey.Arn
      RetentionInDays: 90

  FISLogDeliveryResourcePolicy:
    Type: AWS::Logs::ResourcePolicy
    Properties:
      PolicyName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-fis-log-delivery'
      PolicyDocument: !Sub |
        {
          "Version": "2012-10-17",
          "Statement": [
            {
              "Sid": "AllowFISToPublishExperimentLogs",
              "Effect": "Allow",
              "Principal": {
                "Service": "fis.amazonaws.com"
              },
              "Action": [
                "logs:CreateLogStream",
                "logs:DescribeLogStreams",
                "logs:PutLogEvents"
              ],
              "Resource": "${FISExperimentLogGroup.Arn}:*"
            },
            {
              "Sid": "AllowCloudWatchLogsDeliveryToPublishExperimentLogs",
              "Effect": "Allow",
              "Principal": {
                "Service": "delivery.logs.amazonaws.com"
              },
              "Action": [
                "logs:CreateLogStream",
                "logs:DescribeLogStreams",
                "logs:PutLogEvents"
              ],
              "Resource": "${FISExperimentLogGroup.Arn}:*",
              "Condition": {
                "ArnLike": {
                  "aws:SourceArn": "arn:aws:logs:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:*"
                }
              }
            }
          ]
        }

  FISExecutionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      Description: >-
        Execution role assumed by AWS Fault Injection Simulator to run the cross-region chaos
        engineering experiment.
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: fis.amazonaws.com
            Action: 'sts:AssumeRole'
      MaxSessionDuration: 7200
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-fis-execution-role'
        - Key: Purpose
          Value: ChaosEngineering

  FISNetworkDisruptionPolicy:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Policy
    Properties:
      PolicyName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-fis-network-disruption'
      Roles:
        - !Ref FISExecutionRole
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Sid: DisruptTransitGatewayAndRouteTableConnectivity
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - ec2:CreateNetworkAcl
              - ec2:CreateNetworkAclEntry
              - ec2:CreateRoute
              - ec2:CreateTags
              - ec2:CreateTransitGatewayRoute
              - ec2:DeleteNetworkAcl
              - ec2:DeleteNetworkAclEntry
              - ec2:DeleteRoute
              - ec2:DeleteTransitGatewayRoute
              - ec2:DescribeManagedPrefixLists
              - ec2:DescribeNetworkAcls
              - ec2:DescribeRouteTables
              - ec2:DescribeSubnets
              - ec2:DescribeTransitGatewayAttachments
              - ec2:DescribeTransitGateways
              - ec2:DescribeTransitGatewayRouteTables
              - ec2:DescribeVpcs
              - ec2:GetManagedPrefixListEntries
              - ec2:ModifyTransitGateway
              - ec2:ReplaceRoute
              - ec2:ReplaceTransitGatewayRoute
              - ec2:SearchTransitGatewayRoutes
            Resource: '*'

  FISS3ReplicationPolicy:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Policy
    Properties:
      PolicyName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-fis-s3-replication'
      Roles:
        - !Ref FISExecutionRole
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Sid: PauseS3CrossRegionReplication
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - s3:GetBucketVersioning
              - s3:GetReplicationConfiguration
              - s3:PutReplicationConfiguration
            Resource: '*'

  FISDynamoDBReplicationPolicy:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Policy
    Properties:
      PolicyName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-fis-dynamodb-replication'
      Roles:
        - !Ref FISExecutionRole
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Sid: PauseDynamoDBGlobalTableReplication
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - dynamodb:DescribeContinuousBackups
              - dynamodb:DescribeGlobalTable
              - dynamodb:DescribeGlobalTableSettings
              - dynamodb:DescribeTable
              - dynamodb:ListGlobalTables
              - dynamodb:ListTagsOfResource
              - dynamodb:UpdateContinuousBackups
              - dynamodb:UpdateGlobalTable
              - dynamodb:UpdateGlobalTableSettings
            Resource: '*'

  FISLoggingPolicy:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Policy
    Properties:
      PolicyName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-fis-logging'
      Roles:
        - !Ref FISExecutionRole
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Sid: ManageFISExperimentLogDelivery
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - logs:CreateLogDelivery
              - logs:DeleteLogDelivery
              - logs:DescribeLogGroups
              - logs:DescribeResourcePolicies
              - logs:GetLogDelivery
              - logs:ListLogDeliveries
              - logs:PutResourcePolicy
              - logs:UpdateLogDelivery
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: WriteFISExperimentLogs
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - logs:CreateLogStream
              - logs:DescribeLogStreams
              - logs:PutLogEvents
            Resource: !Sub '${FISExperimentLogGroup.Arn}:*'

  ChaosStopConditionAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-chaos-stop-condition'
      AlarmDescription: >-
        Manual stop condition for the FIS chaos experiment. Publish a value of 1 or greater to the
        StopExperiment metric in the alarm namespace with dimension ExperimentTemplate set to the
        stack name, or set this alarm state to ALARM, to stop a running experiment.
      Namespace: !Sub 'Chaos/${AWS::StackName}'
      MetricName: StopExperiment
      Dimensions:
        - Name: ExperimentTemplate
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}'
      Statistic: Maximum
      Period: 60
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      DatapointsToAlarm: 1
      Threshold: 1
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanOrEqualToThreshold
      TreatMissingData: notBreaching

  FISChaosExperimentTemplate:
    Type: AWS::FIS::ExperimentTemplate
    DependsOn:
      - FISNetworkDisruptionPolicy
      - FISS3ReplicationPolicy
      - FISDynamoDBReplicationPolicy
      - FISLoggingPolicy
      - FISLogDeliveryResourcePolicy
    Properties:
      Description: !Sub >-
        Blocks application network traffic from the local deployment Region (${AWS::Region}) toward
        the target Region (${TargetRegion}) and pauses S3 cross-region replication for resources
        tagged ChaosAllowed=true. Targets include ChaosAllowed=true tagged subnets, transit
        gateways, S3 buckets, and DynamoDB global tables, and the execution role is granted
        permissions to pause DynamoDB global table replication.
      RoleArn: !GetAtt FISExecutionRole.Arn
      Tags:
        Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-cross-region-chaos'
        ChaosExperiment: cross-region-replication-pause
        TargetRegion: !Ref TargetRegion
      Targets:
        ChaosSubnets:
          ResourceType: aws:ec2:subnet
          ResourceTags:
            ChaosAllowed: "true"
          SelectionMode: ALL
        ChaosTransitGateways:
          ResourceType: aws:ec2:transit-gateway
          ResourceTags:
            ChaosAllowed: "true"
          SelectionMode: ALL
        ChaosS3Buckets:
          ResourceType: aws:s3:bucket
          ResourceTags:
            ChaosAllowed: "true"
          SelectionMode: ALL
        ChaosDynamoDBGlobalTables:
          ResourceType: aws:dynamodb:global-table
          ResourceTags:
            ChaosAllowed: "true"
          SelectionMode: ALL
      Actions:
        BlockNetworkTrafficToTargetRegion:
          ActionId: aws:network:disrupt-connectivity
          Description: >-
            Blocks application network traffic from the local deployment Region toward the target
            Region recorded in the TargetRegion tag by disrupting connectivity for the subnets
            tagged ChaosAllowed=true within their Availability Zone, isolating the local application
            network paths. FIS reverts all network changes when the action completes or the
            experiment is stopped.
          Parameters:
            duration: !Ref ChaosDuration
            scope: availability-zone
          Targets:
            Subnets: ChaosSubnets
        PauseS3Replication:
          ActionId: aws:s3:pause-replication
          Description: Pauses cross-region replication for the S3 buckets tagged ChaosAllowed=true.
          Parameters:
            duration: !Ref ChaosDuration
          Targets:
            Buckets: ChaosS3Buckets
      StopConditions:
        - Source: aws:cloudwatch:alarm
          Value: !GetAtt ChaosStopConditionAlarm.Arn
      LogConfiguration:
        LogSchemaVersion: 2
        CloudWatchLogsConfiguration:
          LogGroupArn: !GetAtt FISExperimentLogGroup.Arn

Outputs:
  ExperimentTemplateId:
    Description: The ID of the FIS experiment template.
    Value: !Ref FISChaosExperimentTemplate
  ExperimentTemplateArn:
    Description: The ARN of the FIS experiment template.
    Value: !Sub 'arn:aws:fis:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:experiment-template/${FISChaosExperimentTemplate}'
  ChaosTargetRegion:
    Description: The target Region toward which network traffic is blocked during the experiment.
    Value: !Ref TargetRegion
  FISExecutionRoleArn:
    Description: The ARN of the IAM role assumed by FIS to run the experiment.
    Value: !GetAtt FISExecutionRole.Arn
  ExperimentLogGroupArn:
    Description: The ARN of the KMS-encrypted CloudWatch Logs log group used for experiment logging.
    Value: !GetAtt FISExperimentLogGroup.Arn
  ChaosLogEncryptionKeyArn:
    Description: The ARN of the dedicated KMS key encrypting the experiment log group.
    Value: !GetAtt ChaosLogEncryptionKey.Arn
  ChaosStopConditionAlarmArn:
    Description: The ARN of the CloudWatch alarm used as a manual experiment stop condition.
    Value: !GetAtt ChaosStopConditionAlarm.Arn

final_template:
AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'

Description: >-
  VPC network foundation for a Kerberos-secured Amazon EMR on EKS deployment.
  Provisions a VPC (default 10.0.1.0/24) with two public and two private subnets
  across two Availability Zones using distinct, configurable /26 CIDR blocks,
  Kubernetes load balancer subnet tags, an internet gateway for the public
  subnets, one NAT gateway with its own Elastic IP per Availability Zone for
  redundant private outbound internet access, the corresponding route tables
  and subnet associations, and a customer-managed KMS key, IAM role, 30-day
  CloudWatch Logs log group, and VPC flow log capturing all traffic for the VPC.

Metadata:
  AWS::CloudFormation::Interface:
    ParameterGroups:
      - Label:
          default: Network configuration
        Parameters:
          - VpcCidr
          - PublicSubnet1Cidr
          - PublicSubnet2Cidr
          - PrivateSubnet1Cidr
          - PrivateSubnet2Cidr
    ParameterLabels:
      VpcCidr:
        default: VPC CIDR block
      PublicSubnet1Cidr:
        default: Public subnet 1 CIDR block (/26)
      PublicSubnet2Cidr:
        default: Public subnet 2 CIDR block (/26)
      PrivateSubnet1Cidr:
        default: Private subnet 1 CIDR block (/26)
      PrivateSubnet2Cidr:
        default: Private subnet 2 CIDR block (/26)

Parameters:
  VpcCidr:
    Type: String
    Description: CIDR block for the VPC.
    Default: 10.0.1.0/24
    AllowedPattern: '^(([0-9]|[1-9][0-9]|1[0-9]{2}|2[0-4][0-9]|25[0-5])\.){3}([0-9]|[1-9][0-9]|1[0-9]{2}|2[0-4][0-9]|25[0-5])(/([0-9]|[12][0-9]|3[0-2]))$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must be a valid IPv4 CIDR block, for example 10.0.1.0/24.

  PublicSubnet1Cidr:
    Type: String
    Description: CIDR block (/26) for the first public subnet in Availability Zone 1.
    Default: 10.0.1.0/26
    AllowedPattern: '^(([0-9]|[1-9][0-9]|1[0-9]{2}|2[0-4][0-9]|25[0-5])\.){3}([0-9]|[1-9][0-9]|1[0-9]{2}|2[0-4][0-9]|25[0-5])/26$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must be a valid /26 IPv4 CIDR block, for example 10.0.1.0/26.

  PublicSubnet2Cidr:
    Type: String
    Description: CIDR block (/26) for the second public subnet in Availability Zone 2.
    Default: 10.0.1.64/26
    AllowedPattern: '^(([0-9]|[1-9][0-9]|1[0-9]{2}|2[0-4][0-9]|25[0-5])\.){3}([0-9]|[1-9][0-9]|1[0-9]{2}|2[0-4][0-9]|25[0-5])/26$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must be a valid /26 IPv4 CIDR block, for example 10.0.1.64/26.

  PrivateSubnet1Cidr:
    Type: String
    Description: CIDR block (/26) for the first private subnet in Availability Zone 1.
    Default: 10.0.1.128/26
    AllowedPattern: '^(([0-9]|[1-9][0-9]|1[0-9]{2}|2[0-4][0-9]|25[0-5])\.){3}([0-9]|[1-9][0-9]|1[0-9]{2}|2[0-4][0-9]|25[0-5])/26$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must be a valid /26 IPv4 CIDR block, for example 10.0.1.128/26.

  PrivateSubnet2Cidr:
    Type: String
    Description: CIDR block (/26) for the second private subnet in Availability Zone 2.
    Default: 10.0.1.192/26
    AllowedPattern: '^(([0-9]|[1-9][0-9]|1[0-9]{2}|2[0-4][0-9]|25[0-5])\.){3}([0-9]|[1-9][0-9]|1[0-9]{2}|2[0-4][0-9]|25[0-5])/26$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must be a valid /26 IPv4 CIDR block, for example 10.0.1.192/26.

Resources:
  VPC:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPC
    Properties:
      CidrBlock: !Ref VpcCidr
      EnableDnsHostnames: true
      EnableDnsSupport: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-vpc'

  InternetGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::InternetGateway
    Properties:
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-internet-gateway'

  InternetGatewayAttachment:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      InternetGatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  PublicSubnet1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs '']
      CidrBlock: !Ref PublicSubnet1Cidr
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-public-subnet-1'
        - Key: kubernetes.io/role/elb
          Value: '1'

  PublicSubnet2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [1, !GetAZs '']
      CidrBlock: !Ref PublicSubnet2Cidr
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-public-subnet-2'
        - Key: kubernetes.io/role/elb
          Value: '1'

  PrivateSubnet1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs '']
      CidrBlock: !Ref PrivateSubnet1Cidr
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-private-subnet-1'
        - Key: kubernetes.io/role/internal-elb
          Value: '1'

  PrivateSubnet2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [1, !GetAZs '']
      CidrBlock: !Ref PrivateSubnet2Cidr
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-private-subnet-2'
        - Key: kubernetes.io/role/internal-elb
          Value: '1'

  NatGatewayEIP1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::EIP
    DependsOn: InternetGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      Domain: vpc
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-nat-eip-1'

  NatGatewayEIP2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::EIP
    DependsOn: InternetGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      Domain: vpc
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-nat-eip-2'

  NatGateway1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NatGateway
    DependsOn: InternetGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      AllocationId: !GetAtt NatGatewayEIP1.AllocationId
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet1
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-nat-gateway-1'

  NatGateway2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NatGateway
    DependsOn: InternetGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      AllocationId: !GetAtt NatGatewayEIP2.AllocationId
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet2
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-nat-gateway-2'

  PublicRouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-public-route-table'

  PublicRoute:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    DependsOn: InternetGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      GatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  PrivateRouteTable1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-private-route-table-1'

  PrivateRoute1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable1
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      NatGatewayId: !Ref NatGateway1

  PrivateRouteTable2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-private-route-table-2'

  PrivateRoute2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable2
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      NatGatewayId: !Ref NatGateway2

  PublicSubnet1RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet1
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable

  PublicSubnet2RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet2
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable

  PrivateSubnet1RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnet1
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable1

  PrivateSubnet2RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnet2
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable2

  VpcFlowLogsKmsKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    Properties:
      Description: Customer-managed KMS key used to encrypt VPC flow log data delivered to CloudWatch Logs.
      Enabled: true
      EnableKeyRotation: true
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: EnableIAMUserPermissions
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root'
            Action: 'kms:*'
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: AllowCloudWatchLogsToUseTheKey
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: !Sub 'logs.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com'
            Action:
              - kms:Encrypt
              - kms:Decrypt
              - kms:ReEncrypt*
              - kms:GenerateDataKey*
              - kms:Describe*
            Resource: '*'
            Condition:
              ArnLike:
                'kms:EncryptionContext:aws:logs:arn': !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:logs:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:log-group:*'
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-vpc-flow-logs-key'

  VpcFlowLogsLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Sub '/aws/vpc-flow-logs/${AWS::StackName}'
      RetentionInDays: 30
      KmsKeyId: !GetAtt VpcFlowLogsKmsKey.Arn
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-vpc-flow-logs'

  VpcFlowLogsRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      Description: IAM role assumed by the VPC Flow Logs service to publish flow logs to the KMS-encrypted CloudWatch Logs log group.
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: vpc-flow-logs.amazonaws.com
            Action: 'sts:AssumeRole'
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                aws:SourceAccount: !Ref 'AWS::AccountId'
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: vpc-flow-logs-to-cloudwatch
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: WriteFlowLogsToCloudWatchLogs
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:DescribeLogStreams
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                Resource: !GetAtt VpcFlowLogsLogGroup.Arn
              - Sid: GenerateDataKeysForLogEncryption
                Effect: Allow
                Action: kms:GenerateDataKey
                Resource: !GetAtt VpcFlowLogsKmsKey.Arn
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-vpc-flow-logs-role'

  VpcFlowLog:
    Type: AWS::EC2::FlowLog
    DependsOn: VpcFlowLogsLogGroup
    Properties:
      DeliverLogsPermissionArn: !GetAtt VpcFlowLogsRole.Arn
      LogDestination: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:logs:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:log-group:/aws/vpc-flow-logs/${AWS::StackName}'
      LogDestinationType: cloud-watch-logs
      MaxAggregationInterval: 60
      ResourceId: !Ref VPC
      ResourceType: VPC
      TrafficType: ALL
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-vpc-flow-log'

Outputs:
  VpcId:
    Description: ID of the VPC.
    Value: !Ref VPC
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-VpcId'

  InternetGatewayId:
    Description: ID of the internet gateway attached to the VPC.
    Value: !Ref InternetGateway
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-InternetGatewayId'

  PublicSubnetIds:
    Description: IDs of the two public subnets (tagged kubernetes.io/role/elb for Kubernetes load balancers).
    Value: !Join [',', [!Ref PublicSubnet1, !Ref PublicSubnet2]]
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-PublicSubnetIds'

  PrivateSubnetIds:
    Description: IDs of the two private subnets (tagged kubernetes.io/role/internal-elb for Kubernetes internal load balancers).
    Value: !Join [',', [!Ref PrivateSubnet1, !Ref PrivateSubnet2]]
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-PrivateSubnetIds'

  PublicRouteTableId:
    Description: ID of the public route table associated with the internet gateway.
    Value: !Ref PublicRouteTable
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-PublicRouteTableId'

  PrivateRouteTableIds:
    Description: IDs of the private route tables, one per Availability Zone, routed to the NAT gateways.
    Value: !Join [',', [!Ref PrivateRouteTable1, !Ref PrivateRouteTable2]]
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-PrivateRouteTableIds'

  NatGatewayIds:
    Description: IDs of the NAT gateways, one per Availability Zone.
    Value: !Join [',', [!Ref NatGateway1, !Ref NatGateway2]]
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-NatGatewayIds'

  VpcFlowLogId:
    Description: ID of the VPC flow log capturing all traffic for the VPC.
    Value: !Ref VpcFlowLog
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-VpcFlowLogId'

  VpcFlowLogsLogGroupArn:
    Description: ARN of the CloudWatch Logs log group storing the VPC flow logs.
    Value: !GetAtt VpcFlowLogsLogGroup.Arn
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-VpcFlowLogsLogGroupArn'

  VpcFlowLogsKmsKeyArn:
    Description: ARN of the customer-managed KMS key encrypting the VPC flow logs.
    Value: !GetAtt VpcFlowLogsKmsKey.Arn
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-VpcFlowLogsKmsKeyArn'

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >-
  Complete EC2 Image Builder testing pipeline: a custom sample-component (1.0.0) that installs and runs
  Chef Client on Linux via the WebDownload action, a custom sample-workflow (BUILD) that updates the SSM
  agent and builds an AMI, a sample-recipe image recipe combining the custom component with the AWS-managed
  chrony-time-configuration-test component on the AWS-managed amazon-linux-2-ecs-optimized-x86 parent image
  with a 30GB gp2 root volume, infrastructure configuration that terminates instances on failure, AMI
  distribution to us-east-1 with launch permissions granted to the current account, a sample-image-pipeline
  running daily at 9 AM UTC with expression match and dependency update triggering plus image scanning and
  tests enabled, and a sample-lifecycle-policy that deprecates AMIs older than 6 months for resources tagged
  Environment=Dev, alongside IAM roles with AdministratorAccess for the build infrastructure and lifecycle
  execution.

Resources:
  ImageBuilderInstanceProfileRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: ec2.amazonaws.com
            Action: 'sts:AssumeRole'
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - 'arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/AdministratorAccess'

  ImageBuilderInstanceProfile:
    Type: AWS::IAM::InstanceProfile
    Properties:
      Roles:
        - !Ref ImageBuilderInstanceProfileRole

  ImageBuilderLifecycleExecutionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: imagebuilder.amazonaws.com
            Action: 'sts:AssumeRole'
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - 'arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/AdministratorAccess'

  ImageBuilderComponent:
    Type: AWS::ImageBuilder::Component
    Properties:
      Name: sample-component
      Version: 1.0.0
      Platform: Linux
      Description: Sample component that installs and runs Chef Client on Linux using a WebDownload action
      Data: |
        name: sample-component
        description: Sample component that installs and runs Chef Client on Linux using a WebDownload action
        schemaVersion: '1.0'
        phases:
          - name: build
            steps:
              - name: DownloadChefClientInstallScript
                action: WebDownload
                onFailure: Abort
                inputs:
                  - source: https://omnitruck.chef.io/install.sh
                    destination: /tmp/install-chef-client.sh
              - name: InstallChefClient
                action: ExecuteBash
                onFailure: Abort
                inputs:
                  commands:
                    - chmod +x /tmp/install-chef-client.sh
                    - /tmp/install-chef-client.sh
              - name: RunChefClient
                action: ExecuteBash
                onFailure: Abort
                inputs:
                  commands:
                    - chef-client --version

  ImageBuilderWorkflow:
    Type: AWS::ImageBuilder::Workflow
    Properties:
      Name: sample-workflow
      Version: 1.0.0
      Type: BUILD
      Description: Sample build workflow that updates the SSM agent and builds an AMI
      Data: |
        name: sample-workflow
        description: Sample build workflow that updates the SSM agent and builds an AMI
        schemaVersion: 1.0
        parameters:
          - name: InstanceId
            type: string
          - name: PlatformType
            type: string
          - name: ParentImageId
            type: string
          - name: InstanceProfileName
            type: string
        steps:
          - name: LaunchBuildInstance
            action: LaunchInstance
            onFailure: Abort
            inputs:
              waitFor: ssmAgent
          - name: UpdateSSMAgent
            action: RunCommand
            onFailure: Abort
            inputs:
              instanceId: '{{ InstanceId }}'
              documentName: AWS-UpdateSSMAgent
          - name: ExecuteComponents
            action: ExecuteComponents
            onFailure: Abort
            inputs:
              instanceId: '{{ InstanceId }}'
          - name: CreateImage
            action: CreateImage
            onFailure: Abort
            inputs:
              instanceId: '{{ InstanceId }}'
              noReboot: false
          - name: TerminateInstance
            action: TerminateInstance
            onFailure: Ignore
            inputs:
              instanceId: '{{ InstanceId }}'

  ImageBuilderImageRecipe:
    Type: AWS::ImageBuilder::ImageRecipe
    Properties:
      Name: sample-recipe
      Version: 1.0.0
      Description: Sample image recipe combining the custom component with the AWS-managed chrony time configuration test component
      ParentImage: !Sub 'arn:aws:imagebuilder:${AWS::Region}:aws:image/amazon-linux-2-ecs-optimized-x86/x.x.x'
      Components:
        - ComponentArn: !Ref ImageBuilderComponent
        - ComponentArn: !Sub 'arn:aws:imagebuilder:${AWS::Region}:aws:component/chrony-time-configuration-test/1.0.0/1'
      BlockDeviceMappings:
        - DeviceName: /dev/xvda
          Ebs:
            VolumeSize: 30
            VolumeType: gp2
            DeleteOnTermination: true

  ImageBuilderInfrastructureConfiguration:
    Type: AWS::ImageBuilder::InfrastructureConfiguration
    Properties:
      Name: sample-infrastructure-configuration
      Description: Sample infrastructure configuration that terminates build instances on failure
      InstanceProfileName: !Ref ImageBuilderInstanceProfile
      TerminateInstanceOnFailure: true

  ImageBuilderDistributionConfiguration:
    Type: AWS::ImageBuilder::DistributionConfiguration
    Properties:
      Name: sample-distribution-configuration
      Description: Sample distribution configuration that distributes the AMI to us-east-1
      Distributions:
        - Region: us-east-1
          AmiDistributionConfiguration:
            Name: 'sample-ami-{{ imagebuilder:buildDate }}'
            Description: Sample AMI built by EC2 Image Builder
            LaunchPermissionConfiguration:
              UserIds:
                - !Ref 'AWS::AccountId'

  ImageBuilderImagePipeline:
    Type: AWS::ImageBuilder::ImagePipeline
    Properties:
      Name: sample-image-pipeline
      Description: Sample image pipeline that runs daily at 9 AM UTC
      ImageRecipeArn: !Ref ImageBuilderImageRecipe
      InfrastructureConfigurationArn: !Ref ImageBuilderInfrastructureConfiguration
      DistributionConfigurationArn: !Ref ImageBuilderDistributionConfiguration
      Schedule:
        ScheduleExpression: 'cron(0 9 * * ? *)'
        PipelineExecutionStartCondition: EXPRESSION_MATCH_AND_DEPENDENCY_UPDATES_AVAILABLE
      ImageScanningConfiguration:
        ImageScanningEnabled: true
      ImageTestsConfiguration:
        ImageTestsEnabled: true
        TimeoutMinutes: 60
      Status: ENABLED

  ImageBuilderLifecyclePolicy:
    Type: AWS::ImageBuilder::LifecyclePolicy
    DependsOn:
      - ImageBuilderImageRecipe
    Properties:
      Name: sample-lifecycle-policy
      Description: Sample lifecycle policy that deprecates AMIs older than 6 months for resources tagged Environment=Dev
      ResourceType: AMI_IMAGE
      ExecutionRole: !GetAtt ImageBuilderLifecycleExecutionRole.Arn
      PolicyDetails:
        - Filter:
            Type: AGE
            Value: 6
            Unit: MONTHS
          Action:
            Type: DEPRECATE
            IncludeResources:
              Snapshots: false
      ResourceSelection:
        Recipes:
          - Name: sample-recipe
            SemanticVersion: '1.0.0'
        TagMap:
          Environment: Dev
      Status: ENABLED

Outputs:
  ImagePipelineArn:
    Description: ARN of the EC2 Image Builder image pipeline
    Value: !Ref ImageBuilderImagePipeline
  ImageRecipeArn:
    Description: ARN of the image recipe
    Value: !Ref ImageBuilderImageRecipe
  ComponentArn:
    Description: ARN of the custom sample component
    Value: !Ref ImageBuilderComponent
  WorkflowArn:
    Description: ARN of the custom build workflow
    Value: !Ref ImageBuilderWorkflow
  InfrastructureConfigurationArn:
    Description: ARN of the infrastructure configuration
    Value: !Ref ImageBuilderInfrastructureConfiguration
  DistributionConfigurationArn:
    Description: ARN of the distribution configuration
    Value: !Ref ImageBuilderDistributionConfiguration
  LifecyclePolicyArn:
    Description: ARN of the lifecycle policy
    Value: !Ref ImageBuilderLifecyclePolicy
  InstanceProfileName:
    Description: Name of the instance profile used by the build infrastructure
    Value: !Ref ImageBuilderInstanceProfile

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >
  Cognito-based authentication layer for an Amazon Lex chatbot web UI.
  Creates a Cognito User Pool (email as the username alias with auto-verified
  email), a User Pool Client without a secret, a Cognito Identity Pool that
  allows unauthenticated identities and is linked to the user pool, the
  identity pool role attachment, and separate IAM roles for authenticated and
  unauthenticated identities. Inline policies grant Amazon Lex V1 actions
  (PostText and PostContent) when a Lex V1 bot name is provided, or Amazon
  Lex V2 actions (RecognizeText and RecognizeUtterance) when a Lex V2 bot ID
  is provided. Authenticated users can also synthesize speech with Amazon
  Polly, and both roles can optionally invoke a live chat API endpoint.

Metadata:
  AWS::CloudFormation::Interface:
    ParameterGroups:
      - Label:
          default: Identity Pool Configuration
        Parameters:
          - IdentityPoolName
      - Label:
          default: Amazon Lex Bot Configuration
        Parameters:
          - LexV1BotName
          - LexV2BotId
          - LexV2AliasId
      - Label:
          default: Optional Features
        Parameters:
          - ForceCognitoLogin
          - ShouldEnableLiveChat
    ParameterLabels:
      IdentityPoolName:
        default: Identity Pool Name
      LexV1BotName:
        default: Lex V1 Bot Name
      LexV2BotId:
        default: Lex V2 Bot ID
      LexV2AliasId:
        default: Lex V2 Alias ID
      ForceCognitoLogin:
        default: Force Cognito Login
      ShouldEnableLiveChat:
        default: Enable Live Chat

Parameters:
  IdentityPoolName:
    Type: String
    Description: Name of the Cognito Identity Pool to create.
    Default: identity pool
    MinLength: 1
    MaxLength: 128
    AllowedPattern: '[\w\s+=,.@-]+'
    ConstraintDescription: Can include up to 128 letters, numbers, spaces, and the characters =,.@-.

  LexV1BotName:
    Type: String
    Description: >
      Name of the Amazon Lex V1 bot. Lex V1 actions (PostText and PostContent)
      are granted to the roles when this value is provided and no Lex V2 bot
      ID is specified. Leave empty to disable Lex V1 permissions.
    Default: OrderFlowers
    MinLength: 0
    MaxLength: 50
    AllowedPattern: '^[a-zA-Z][a-zA-Z0-9_-]*$|^$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must start with a letter and can include letters, numbers, underscores, and hyphens.

  LexV2BotId:
    Type: String
    Description: >
      Bot ID of the Amazon Lex V2 bot. When provided, Lex V2 actions
      (RecognizeText and RecognizeUtterance) are granted to the roles instead
      of Lex V1 actions. Leave empty to use the Lex V1 bot.
    Default: ''
    MinLength: 0
    MaxLength: 20
    AllowedPattern: '^[a-zA-Z0-9]*$'
    ConstraintDescription: Can include letters and numbers only.

  LexV2AliasId:
    Type: String
    Description: >
      Alias ID of the Amazon Lex V2 bot. Required when a Lex V2 bot ID is
      provided.
    Default: ''
    MinLength: 0
    MaxLength: 20
    AllowedPattern: '^[a-zA-Z0-9]*$'
    ConstraintDescription: Can include letters and numbers only.

  ForceCognitoLogin:
    Type: String
    Description: >
      When true, explicit Deny statements prevent unauthenticated identities
      from invoking Amazon Lex and API actions, effectively forcing users to
      sign in with Cognito.
    Default: 'false'
    AllowedValues:
      - 'true'
      - 'false'
    ConstraintDescription: Must be either true or false.

  ShouldEnableLiveChat:
    Type: String
    Description: >
      When true, adds an execute-api Invoke permission to both roles so the
      chatbot web UI can invoke the live chat API endpoint.
    Default: 'false'
    AllowedValues:
      - 'true'
      - 'false'
    ConstraintDescription: Must be either true or false.

Conditions:
  ForceCognitoLoginCondition: !Equals
    - !Ref ForceCognitoLogin
    - 'true'
  ShouldEnableLiveChatCondition: !Equals
    - !Ref ShouldEnableLiveChat
    - 'true'
  ShouldUseLexV2: !Not
    - !Equals
      - !Ref LexV2BotId
      - ''
  ShouldUseLexV1: !And
    - !Not
      - !Equals
        - !Ref LexV1BotName
        - ''
    - !Not
      - !Condition ShouldUseLexV2

Resources:
  CognitoUserPool:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPool
    Properties:
      UserPoolName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-user-pool'
      UsernameAttributes:
        - email
      AutoVerifiedAttributes:
        - email
      Schema:
        - Name: given_name
          Required: true
          Mutable: true
        - Name: family_name
          Required: true
          Mutable: true
        - Name: email
          Required: true
          Mutable: true
        - Name: preferred_username
          Required: true
          Mutable: true
      Policies:
        PasswordPolicy:
          MinimumLength: 8
          RequireLowercase: true
          RequireNumbers: true
          RequireSymbols: true
          RequireUppercase: true

  CognitoUserPoolClient:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolClient
    Properties:
      ClientName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-userpool-client'
      GenerateSecret: false
      RefreshTokenValidity: 30
      ExplicitAuthFlows:
        - ALLOW_USER_SRP_AUTH
        - ALLOW_REFRESH_TOKEN_AUTH
      UserPoolId: !Ref CognitoUserPool

  IdentityPool:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::IdentityPool
    Properties:
      IdentityPoolName: !Ref IdentityPoolName
      AllowUnauthenticatedIdentities: true
      CognitoIdentityProviders:
        - ClientId: !Ref CognitoUserPoolClient
          ProviderName: !GetAtt CognitoUserPool.ProviderName

  CognitoAuthRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      Path: /
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: TrustCognitoIdentityPoolForAuth
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Federated: cognito-identity.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRoleWithWebIdentity
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                'cognito-identity.amazonaws.com:aud': !Ref IdentityPool
              'ForAnyValue:StringLike':
                'cognito-identity.amazonaws.com:amr': authenticated
      Policies:
        - !If
          - ShouldUseLexV1
          - PolicyName: lex-v1-auth
            PolicyDocument:
              Version: '2012-10-17'
              Statement:
                - Sid: LexV1PostTextAndPostContent
                  Effect: Allow
                  Action:
                    - lex:PostText
                    - lex:PostContent
                  Resource: !Sub 'arn:aws:lex:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:bot:${LexV1BotName}'
          - !Ref AWS::NoValue
        - !If
          - ShouldUseLexV2
          - PolicyName: lex-v2-auth
            PolicyDocument:
              Version: '2012-10-17'
              Statement:
                - Sid: LexV2RecognizeTextAndUtterance
                  Effect: Allow
                  Action:
                    - lex:RecognizeText
                    - lex:RecognizeUtterance
                  Resource: !Sub 'arn:aws:lex:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:bot-alias/${LexV2BotId}/${LexV2AliasId}'
          - !Ref AWS::NoValue
        - PolicyName: polly-auth
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: PollySynthesizeSpeech
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - polly:SynthesizeSpeech
                Resource: '*'
        - !If
          - ShouldEnableLiveChatCondition
          - PolicyName: live-chat-auth
            PolicyDocument:
              Version: '2012-10-17'
              Statement:
                - Sid: InvokeLiveChatAPI
                  Effect: Allow
                  Action:
                    - execute-api:Invoke
                  Resource: !Sub 'arn:aws:execute-api:*:${AWS::AccountId}:*/*'
          - !Ref AWS::NoValue

  CognitoUnauthRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      Path: /
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: TrustCognitoIdentityPoolForUnauth
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Federated: cognito-identity.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRoleWithWebIdentity
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                'cognito-identity.amazonaws.com:aud': !Ref IdentityPool
              'ForAnyValue:StringLike':
                'cognito-identity.amazonaws.com:amr': unauthenticated
      Policies:
        - !If
          - ForceCognitoLoginCondition
          - PolicyName: force-cognito-login-unauth
            PolicyDocument:
              Version: '2012-10-17'
              Statement:
                - Sid: DenyUnauthenticatedLexAndApiActions
                  Effect: Deny
                  Action:
                    - lex:*
                    - execute-api:*
                  Resource: '*'
          - !Ref AWS::NoValue
        - !If
          - ShouldUseLexV1
          - PolicyName: lex-v1-unauth
            PolicyDocument:
              Version: '2012-10-17'
              Statement:
                - Sid: LexV1PostTextAndPostContent
                  Effect: Allow
                  Action:
                    - lex:PostText
                    - lex:PostContent
                  Resource: !Sub 'arn:aws:lex:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:bot:${LexV1BotName}'
          - !Ref AWS::NoValue
        - !If
          - ShouldUseLexV2
          - PolicyName: lex-v2-unauth
            PolicyDocument:
              Version: '2012-10-17'
              Statement:
                - Sid: LexV2RecognizeTextAndUtterance
                  Effect: Allow
                  Action:
                    - lex:RecognizeText
                    - lex:RecognizeUtterance
                  Resource: !Sub 'arn:aws:lex:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:bot-alias/${LexV2BotId}/${LexV2AliasId}'
          - !Ref AWS::NoValue
        - !If
          - ShouldEnableLiveChatCondition
          - PolicyName: live-chat-unauth
            PolicyDocument:
              Version: '2012-10-17'
              Statement:
                - Sid: InvokeLiveChatAPI
                  Effect: Allow
                  Action:
                    - execute-api:Invoke
                  Resource: !Sub 'arn:aws:execute-api:*:${AWS::AccountId}:*/*'
          - !Ref AWS::NoValue

  IdentityPoolRoleMap:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::IdentityPoolRoleAttachment
    Properties:
      IdentityPoolId: !Ref IdentityPool
      Roles:
        authenticated: !GetAtt CognitoAuthRole.Arn
        unauthenticated: !GetAtt CognitoUnauthRole.Arn

Outputs:
  IdentityPoolId:
    Description: ID of the Cognito Identity Pool.
    Value: !Ref IdentityPool
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-IdentityPoolId'
  UserPoolId:
    Description: ID of the Cognito User Pool.
    Value: !Ref CognitoUserPool
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-UserPoolId'
  UserPoolClientId:
    Description: ID of the Cognito User Pool Client.
    Value: !Ref CognitoUserPoolClient
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-UserPoolClientId'

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >-
  Public Route 53 hosted zone for passengerlist.org with all DNS record sets
  required by the platform: apex TXT records for SPF and site verification,
  G Suite MX records with standard priorities, a DMARC TXT record on _dmarc,
  A/AAAA alias records for the apex and the www, departures, join, athena and
  feed subdomains pointing at their CloudFront distributions using the
  CloudFront alias hosted zone ID Z2FDTNDATAQYW2, Zendesk mail routing and
  DKIM CNAME records, a Squarespace domain verification CNAME record, and ACM
  certificate validation CNAME records whose values are supplied by the
  stacks that own the certificates and distributions.
Metadata:
  AWS::CloudFormation::Interface:
    ParameterGroups:
      - Label:
          default: Hosted zone
        Parameters:
          - DomainName
      - Label:
          default: Mail and verification records
        Parameters:
          - SpfRecordValue
          - SiteVerificationTxtValue
          - DmarcRecordValue
          - ZendeskMailSubdomain
          - ZendeskMailTarget
          - SquarespaceVerificationSubdomain
          - SquarespaceVerificationTarget
      - Label:
          default: CloudFront alias targets
        Parameters:
          - RootCloudFrontDomain
          - WwwCloudFrontDomain
          - DeparturesCloudFrontDomain
          - JoinCloudFrontDomain
          - AthenaCloudFrontDomain
          - FeedCloudFrontDomain
      - Label:
          default: ACM certificate validation records
        Parameters:
          - AcmValidationRecord1Name
          - AcmValidationRecord1Value
          - AcmValidationRecord2Name
          - AcmValidationRecord2Value
          - AcmValidationRecord3Name
          - AcmValidationRecord3Value
Parameters:
  DomainName:
    Type: String
    Default: passengerlist.org
    Description: Registered public domain name for the hosted zone.
  SpfRecordValue:
    Type: String
    Default: 'v=spf1 include:_spf.google.com ~all'
    Description: SPF policy published on the apex TXT record set.
  SiteVerificationTxtValue:
    Type: String
    Default: 'google-site-verification=REPLACE-WITH-SITE-VERIFICATION-TOKEN'
    Description: Site verification token published on the apex TXT record set.
  DmarcRecordValue:
    Type: String
    Default: 'v=DMARC1; p=none; rua=mailto:postmaster@passengerlist.org'
    Description: DMARC policy published on the _dmarc subdomain TXT record.
  RootCloudFrontDomain:
    Type: String
    Default: ''
    Description: >-
      CloudFront distribution domain name, for example
      d111111abcdef8.cloudfront.net, that serves the apex domain. Leave empty
      to skip the apex alias records.
  WwwCloudFrontDomain:
    Type: String
    Default: ''
    Description: >-
      CloudFront distribution domain name that serves www. Leave empty to skip
      the www alias records.
  DeparturesCloudFrontDomain:
    Type: String
    Default: ''
    Description: >-
      CloudFront distribution domain name that serves departures. Leave empty
      to skip the departures alias records.
  JoinCloudFrontDomain:
    Type: String
    Default: ''
    Description: >-
      CloudFront distribution domain name that serves join. Leave empty to
      skip the join alias records.
  AthenaCloudFrontDomain:
    Type: String
    Default: ''
    Description: >-
      CloudFront distribution domain name that serves athena. Leave empty to
      skip the athena alias records.
  FeedCloudFrontDomain:
    Type: String
    Default: ''
    Description: >-
      CloudFront distribution domain name that serves feed. Leave empty to
      skip the feed alias records.
  ZendeskMailSubdomain:
    Type: String
    Default: mail
    Description: Subdomain used for Zendesk inbound mail routing.
  ZendeskMailTarget:
    Type: String
    Default: mail.zendesk.com
    Description: Target of the Zendesk mail routing CNAME record.
  SquarespaceVerificationSubdomain:
    Type: String
    Default: squarespace-verify
    Description: Unique verification code subdomain provided by Squarespace.
  SquarespaceVerificationTarget:
    Type: String
    Default: verify.squarespace.com
    Description: Target of the Squarespace domain verification CNAME record.
  AcmValidationRecord1Name:
    Type: String
    Default: ''
    Description: >-
      ACM DNS validation record label for the first subdomain, for example
      _abc123. Leave empty to skip this validation record.
  AcmValidationRecord1Value:
    Type: String
    Default: ''
    Description: >-
      ACM DNS validation CNAME target for the first subdomain, for example
      _xyz789.acm-validations.aws.
  AcmValidationRecord2Name:
    Type: String
    Default: ''
    Description: >-
      ACM DNS validation record label for the second subdomain, for example
      _def456. Leave empty to skip this validation record.
  AcmValidationRecord2Value:
    Type: String
    Default: ''
    Description: >-
      ACM DNS validation CNAME target for the second subdomain, for example
      _uvw321.acm-validations.aws.
  AcmValidationRecord3Name:
    Type: String
    Default: ''
    Description: >-
      ACM DNS validation record label for the third subdomain, for example
      _ghi789. Leave empty to skip this validation record.
  AcmValidationRecord3Value:
    Type: String
    Default: ''
    Description: >-
      ACM DNS validation CNAME target for the third subdomain, for example
      _rst654.acm-validations.aws.
Conditions:
  HasRootDistribution: !Not [!Equals [!Ref RootCloudFrontDomain, '']]
  HasWwwDistribution: !Not [!Equals [!Ref WwwCloudFrontDomain, '']]
  HasDeparturesDistribution: !Not [!Equals [!Ref DeparturesCloudFrontDomain, '']]
  HasJoinDistribution: !Not [!Equals [!Ref JoinCloudFrontDomain, '']]
  HasAthenaDistribution: !Not [!Equals [!Ref AthenaCloudFrontDomain, '']]
  HasFeedDistribution: !Not [!Equals [!Ref FeedCloudFrontDomain, '']]
  HasAcmValidationRecord1: !And
    - !Not [!Equals [!Ref AcmValidationRecord1Name, '']]
    - !Not [!Equals [!Ref AcmValidationRecord1Value, '']]
  HasAcmValidationRecord2: !And
    - !Not [!Equals [!Ref AcmValidationRecord2Name, '']]
    - !Not [!Equals [!Ref AcmValidationRecord2Value, '']]
  HasAcmValidationRecord3: !And
    - !Not [!Equals [!Ref AcmValidationRecord3Name, '']]
    - !Not [!Equals [!Ref AcmValidationRecord3Value, '']]
Resources:
  PassengerListHostedZone:
    Type: AWS::Route53::HostedZone
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${DomainName}.'
      HostedZoneConfig:
        Comment: !Sub 'Public hosted zone for ${DomainName} (apex, www, departures, join, athena, feed).'
      HostedZoneTags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${DomainName}'
  RootTxtRecordSet:
    Type: AWS::Route53::RecordSet
    Properties:
      HostedZoneId: !Ref PassengerListHostedZone
      Name: !Sub '${DomainName}.'
      Type: TXT
      TTL: '300'
      ResourceRecords:
        - !Sub '"${SpfRecordValue}"'
        - !Sub '"${SiteVerificationTxtValue}"'
  DmarcTxtRecordSet:
    Type: AWS::Route53::RecordSet
    Properties:
      HostedZoneId: !Ref PassengerListHostedZone
      Name: !Sub '_dmarc.${DomainName}.'
      Type: TXT
      TTL: '300'
      ResourceRecords:
        - !Sub '"${DmarcRecordValue}"'
  MxRecordSet:
    Type: AWS::Route53::RecordSet
    Properties:
      HostedZoneId: !Ref PassengerListHostedZone
      Name: !Sub '${DomainName}.'
      Type: MX
      TTL: '3600'
      ResourceRecords:
        - '1 aspmx.l.google.com'
        - '5 alt1.aspmx.l.google.com'
        - '5 alt2.aspmx.l.google.com'
        - '10 alt3.aspmx.l.google.com'
        - '10 alt4.aspmx.l.google.com'
  RootAliasARecordSet:
    Type: AWS::Route53::RecordSet
    Condition: HasRootDistribution
    Properties:
      HostedZoneId: !Ref PassengerListHostedZone
      Name: !Sub '${DomainName}.'
      Type: A
      AliasTarget:
        HostedZoneId: Z2FDTNDATAQYW2
        DNSName: !Ref RootCloudFrontDomain
        EvaluateTargetHealth: false
  RootAliasAaaaRecordSet:
    Type: AWS::Route53::RecordSet
    Condition: HasRootDistribution
    Properties:
      HostedZoneId: !Ref PassengerListHostedZone
      Name: !Sub '${DomainName}.'
      Type: AAAA
      AliasTarget:
        HostedZoneId: Z2FDTNDATAQYW2
        DNSName: !Ref RootCloudFrontDomain
        EvaluateTargetHealth: false
  WwwAliasARecordSet:
    Type: AWS::Route53::RecordSet
    Condition: HasWwwDistribution
    Properties:
      HostedZoneId: !Ref PassengerListHostedZone
      Name: !Sub 'www.${DomainName}.'
      Type: A
      AliasTarget:
        HostedZoneId: Z2FDTNDATAQYW2
        DNSName: !Ref WwwCloudFrontDomain
        EvaluateTargetHealth: false
  WwwAliasAaaaRecordSet:
    Type: AWS::Route53::RecordSet
    Condition: HasWwwDistribution
    Properties:
      HostedZoneId: !Ref PassengerListHostedZone
      Name: !Sub 'www.${DomainName}.'
      Type: AAAA
      AliasTarget:
        HostedZoneId: Z2FDTNDATAQYW2
        DNSName: !Ref WwwCloudFrontDomain
        EvaluateTargetHealth: false
  DeparturesAliasARecordSet:
    Type: AWS::Route53::RecordSet
    Condition: HasDeparturesDistribution
    Properties:
      HostedZoneId: !Ref PassengerListHostedZone
      Name: !Sub 'departures.${DomainName}.'
      Type: A
      AliasTarget:
        HostedZoneId: Z2FDTNDATAQYW2
        DNSName: !Ref DeparturesCloudFrontDomain
        EvaluateTargetHealth: false
  DeparturesAliasAaaaRecordSet:
    Type: AWS::Route53::RecordSet
    Condition: HasDeparturesDistribution
    Properties:
      HostedZoneId: !Ref PassengerListHostedZone
      Name: !Sub 'departures.${DomainName}.'
      Type: AAAA
      AliasTarget:
        HostedZoneId: Z2FDTNDATAQYW2

  JoinAliasARecordSet:

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >
  Customer support authentication infrastructure built on Amazon Cognito.
  Creates a user pool that uses email as the username with automatic email
  verification, "admin" and "customer" user groups where admin has the higher
  precedence, a web application client using the authorization code grant flow
  and a machine-to-machine client using the client credentials grant (both
  authorized for a custom read scope defined on a resource server), a Cognito
  domain for the hosted UI, a post-confirmation Lambda that automatically adds
  new sign-ups to the customer group, and SSM parameters under
  /app/customersupport/agentcore/ for consumption by backend services.

Parameters:
  UserPoolName:
    Type: String
    Default: customersupport-user-pool
    Description: Name of the Cognito user pool.

  CognitoDomainPrefix:
    Type: String
    Default: customersupport-auth
    MinLength: 2
    MaxLength: 50
    AllowedPattern: '^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9-]{1,49}$'
    ConstraintDescription: >-
      The domain prefix must be 2-50 characters of lowercase letters, numbers
      and hyphens, and must not start or end with a hyphen.
    Description: >-
      Globally unique prefix for the Cognito hosted UI domain. The stack appends
      the AWS account ID to guarantee uniqueness, resulting in
      <prefix>-<account-id>.auth.<region>.amazoncognito.com.

  CallbackUrl:
    Type: String
    Default: http://localhost:3000/api/auth/callback
    Description: Allowed redirect (callback) URL for the web application client.

  LogoutUrl:
    Type: String
    Default: http://localhost:3000/
    Description: Allowed logout URL for the web application client.

Resources:
  UserPool:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPool
    Properties:
      UserPoolName: !Ref UserPoolName
      UsernameAttributes:
        - email
      UsernameConfiguration:
        CaseSensitive: false
      AutoVerifiedAttributes:
        - email
      MfaConfiguration: 'OFF'
      Policies:
        PasswordPolicy:
          MinimumLength: 8
          RequireLowercase: true
          RequireNumbers: true
          RequireSymbols: true
          RequireUppercase: true
          TemporaryPasswordValidityDays: 7
      AdminCreateUserConfig:
        AllowAdminCreateUserOnly: false
      EmailVerificationSubject: Verify your customer support account
      EmailVerificationMessage: 'Welcome! Your customer support account verification code is {####}.'
      AccountRecoverySetting:
        RecoveryMechanisms:
          - Name: verified_email
            Priority: 1
      LambdaConfig:
        PostConfirmation: !GetAtt PostConfirmationFunction.Arn

  PostConfirmationLambdaRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      Description: >-
        Execution role for the post-confirmation Lambda function that adds new
        sign-ups to the customer group.
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSLambdaBasicExecutionRole'
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: CognitoAddUserToGroup
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: AddUserToCustomerGroup
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - cognito-idp:AdminAddUserToGroup
                Resource:
                  - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:cognito-idp:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:userpool/*'

  PostConfirmationFunction:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    Properties:
      Description: >-
        Post-confirmation trigger that adds every newly confirmed sign-up to
        the customer group of the user pool.
      Runtime: python3.12
      Handler: index.lambda_handler
      MemorySize: 128
      Timeout: 20
      Role: !GetAtt PostConfirmationLambdaRole.Arn
      Environment:
        Variables:
          CUSTOMER_GROUP_NAME: customer
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import os

          import boto3

          GROUP_NAME = os.environ["CUSTOMER_GROUP_NAME"]
          cognito = boto3.client("cognito-idp")


          def lambda_handler(event, context):
              user_pool_id = event.get("userPoolId")
              user_attributes = event.get("request", {}).get("userAttributes", {})
              user_sub = user_attributes.get("sub")

              if not user_pool_id or not user_sub:
                  print("Missing userPoolId or user sub in event; skipping group assignment.")
                  return event

              try:
                  cognito.admin_add_user_to_group(
                      UserPoolId=user_pool_id,
                      Username=user_sub,
                      GroupName=GROUP_NAME,
                  )
                  print(f"Added user {user_sub} to group {GROUP_NAME}.")
              except cognito.exceptions.ResourceNotFoundException as error:
                  print(f"Resource not found while adding user to group: {error}")
                  raise
              except Exception as error:
                  print(f"Failed to add user {user_sub} to group {GROUP_NAME}: {error}")
                  raise

              return event

  PostConfirmationInvokePermission:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Permission
    Properties:
      Action: lambda:InvokeFunction
      FunctionName: !Ref PostConfirmationFunction
      Principal: cognito-idp.amazonaws.com
      SourceArn: !GetAtt UserPool.Arn

  ResourceServer:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolResourceServer
    Properties:
      UserPoolId: !Ref UserPool
      Identifier: customersupport
      Name: Customer Support API
      Scopes:
        - ScopeName: read
          ScopeDescription: Read access to customer support resources.

  AdminUserGroup:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolGroup
    Properties:
      GroupName: admin
      UserPoolId: !Ref UserPool
      Description: Administrator group with the highest precedence.
      Precedence: 1

  CustomerUserGroup:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolGroup
    Properties:
      GroupName: customer
      UserPoolId: !Ref UserPool
      Description: Default group assigned to newly confirmed sign-ups.
      Precedence: 10

  WebClient:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolClient
    DependsOn: ResourceServer
    Properties:
      ClientName: customersupport-web-client
      UserPoolId: !Ref UserPool
      GenerateSecret: false
      PreventUserExistenceErrors: ENABLED
      SupportedIdentityProviders:
        - COGNITO
      AllowedOAuthFlowsUserPoolClient: true
      AllowedOAuthFlows:
        - code
      AllowedOAuthScopes:
        - openid
        - email
        - profile
        - customersupport/read
      CallbackURLs:
        - !Ref CallbackUrl
      LogoutURLs:
        - !Ref LogoutUrl
      ExplicitAuthFlows:
        - ALLOW_USER_SRP_AUTH
        - ALLOW_USER_PASSWORD_AUTH
        - ALLOW_REFRESH_TOKEN_AUTH
      AccessTokenValidity: 1
      IdTokenValidity: 1
      RefreshTokenValidity: 30
      TokenValidityUnits:
        AccessToken: hours
        IdToken: hours
        RefreshToken: days
      EnableTokenRevocation: true

  MachineClient:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolClient
    DependsOn: ResourceServer
    Properties:
      ClientName: customersupport-machine-client
      UserPoolId: !Ref UserPool
      GenerateSecret: true
      SupportedIdentityProviders:
        - COGNITO
      AllowedOAuthFlowsUserPoolClient: true
      AllowedOAuthFlows:
        - client_credentials
      AllowedOAuthScopes:
        - customersupport/read
      CallbackURLs:
        - !Ref CallbackUrl
      AccessTokenValidity: 1
      TokenValidityUnits:
        AccessToken: hours

  UserPoolDomain:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolDomain
    Properties:
      UserPoolId: !Ref UserPool
      Domain: !Sub '${CognitoDomainPrefix}-${AWS::AccountId}'

  UserPoolIdParameter:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Parameter
    Properties:
      Name: /app/customersupport/agentcore/user_pool_id
      Type: String
      Value: !Ref UserPool
      Description: Cognito user pool ID for the customer support system.

  WebClientIdParameter:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Parameter
    Properties:
      Name: /app/customersupport/agentcore/web_client_id
      Type: String
      Value: !Ref WebClient
      Description: App client ID of the web application client (authorization code flow).

  MachineClientIdParameter:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Parameter
    Properties:
      Name: /app/customersupport/agentcore/machine_client_id
      Type: String
      Value: !Ref MachineClient
      Description: App client ID of the machine-to-machine client (client credentials flow).

  MachineClientSecretParameter:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Parameter
    Properties:
      Name: /app/customersupport/agentcore/machine_client_secret
      Type: String
      Value: !GetAtt MachineClient.ClientSecret
      Description: App client secret of the machine-to-machine client.

  OAuthScopeParameter:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Parameter
    Properties:
      Name: /app/customersupport/agentcore/oauth_scope
      Type: String
      Value: customersupport/read
      Description: Custom OAuth read scope defined on the customer support resource server.

  DiscoveryUrlParameter:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Parameter
    Properties:
      Name: /app/customersupport/agentcore/discovery_url
      Type: String
      Value: !Sub 'https://cognito-idp.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com/${UserPool}/.well-known/openid-configuration'
      Description: OIDC discovery document URL for the customer support user pool.

  TokenEndpointParameter:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Parameter
    DependsOn: UserPoolDomain
    Properties:
      Name: /app/customersupport/agentcore/token_endpoint
      Type: String
      Value: !Sub 'https://${CognitoDomainPrefix}-${AWS::AccountId}.auth.${AWS::Region}.amazoncognito.com/oauth2/token'
      Description: OAuth 2.0 token endpoint of the hosted UI domain.

  AuthorizeEndpointParameter:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Parameter
    DependsOn: UserPoolDomain
    Properties:
      Name: /app/customersupport/agentcore/authorize_endpoint
      Type: String
      Value: !Sub 'https://${CognitoDomainPrefix}-${AWS::AccountId}.auth.${AWS::Region}.amazoncognito.com/oauth2/authorize'
      Description: OAuth 2.0 authorize endpoint of the hosted UI domain.

  CognitoDomainParameter:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Parameter
    DependsOn: UserPoolDomain
    Properties:
      Name: /app/customersupport/agentcore/cognito_domain
      Type: String
      Value: !Sub 'https://${CognitoDomainPrefix}-${AWS::AccountId}.auth.${AWS::Region}.amazoncognito.com'
      Description: Base URL of the Cognito hosted UI domain.

Outputs:
  UserPoolId:
    Description: The Cognito user pool ID.
    Value: !Ref UserPool
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-UserPoolId'

  UserPoolArn:
    Description: The Cognito user pool ARN.
    Value: !GetAtt UserPool.Arn
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-UserPoolArn'

  WebClientId:
    Description: The app client ID of the web application client.
    Value: !Ref WebClient
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-WebClientId'

  MachineClientId:
    Description: The app client ID of the machine-to-machine client.
    Value: !Ref MachineClient
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-MachineClientId'

  OAuthScope:
    Description: The custom OAuth read scope granted to both clients.
    Value: customersupport/read
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-OAuthScope'

  HostedUIBaseUrl:
    Description: Base URL of the Cognito hosted UI domain.
    Value: !Sub 'https://${CognitoDomainPrefix}-${AWS::AccountId}.auth.${AWS::Region}.amazoncognito.com'
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-HostedUIBaseUrl'

  DiscoveryUrl:
    Description: OIDC discovery document URL for the user pool.

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >-
  Provisions a VPC (10.10.0.0/16) spanning two Availability Zones with public and
  private subnets, an Internet Gateway, and a NAT Gateway (with an Elastic IP) in
  each public subnet so that private subnets can route outbound traffic to the
  internet.

Metadata:
  AWS::CloudFormation::Interface:
    ParameterGroups:
      - Label:
          default: Network Configuration
        Parameters:
          - VpcCidr
          - PublicSubnet1Cidr
          - PublicSubnet2Cidr
          - PrivateSubnet1Cidr
          - PrivateSubnet2Cidr
      - Label:
          default: Environment
        Parameters:
          - EnvironmentName
    ParameterLabels:
      VpcCidr:
        default: VPC CIDR Block
      PublicSubnet1Cidr:
        default: Public Subnet 1 CIDR
      PublicSubnet2Cidr:
        default: Public Subnet 2 CIDR
      PrivateSubnet1Cidr:
        default: Private Subnet 1 CIDR
      PrivateSubnet2Cidr:
        default: Private Subnet 2 CIDR
      EnvironmentName:
        default: Environment Name

Parameters:
  EnvironmentName:
    Type: String
    Default: production
    Description: Environment name used for resource tagging.
  VpcCidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.10.0.0/16
    Description: CIDR block for the VPC.
  PublicSubnet1Cidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.10.0.0/24
    Description: CIDR block for the public subnet in the first Availability Zone.
  PublicSubnet2Cidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.10.1.0/24
    Description: CIDR block for the public subnet in the second Availability Zone.
  PrivateSubnet1Cidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.10.10.0/24
    Description: CIDR block for the private subnet in the first Availability Zone.
  PrivateSubnet2Cidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.10.11.0/24
    Description: CIDR block for the private subnet in the second Availability Zone.

Resources:
  VPC:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPC
    Properties:
      CidrBlock: !Ref VpcCidr
      EnableDnsHostnames: true
      EnableDnsSupport: true
      InstanceTenancy: default
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-vpc'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  InternetGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::InternetGateway
    Properties:
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-igw'
        - Key: Environment

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >-
  Creates a Route53 hosted zone and records for prxu.org in the Production
  environment. Includes apex TXT and MX records with a 300 second TTL for
  Google Workspace domain verification and email routing, alias (A and AAAA)
  records routing CDN subdomains to CloudFront distributions, legacy CNAME
  records pointing to the corresponding dovetail-cdn subdomains, CNAME
  records for the authenticated feed proxy and dovetail router subdomains,
  and ACM DNS validation CNAME records for certificates covering the service
  and environment-specific subdomains.

Parameters:
  HostedZoneName:
    Type: String
    Default: prxu.org.
    Description: >-
      The domain name of the hosted zone to create, including a trailing
      period.

  Environment:
    Type: String
    Default: Production
    AllowedValues:
      - Staging
      - Production
    Description: >-
      The environment this hosted zone belongs to, applied as a hosted zone
      tag.

  GoogleSiteVerificationToken:
    Type: String
    Default: google-site-verification=8kPq2VxN9mWzR5tY3bJ7cL0dF4hG6sA1eQ
    Description: >-
      The content of the Google site verification TXT record for the apex
      domain.

  DovetailCdnDnsName:
    Type: String
    Default: d1a2b3c4d5e6f7.cloudfront.net
    Description: >-
      The CloudFront distribution domain name for the dovetail-cdn
      distribution. Defaults to a placeholder that should be replaced with
      the actual distribution domain name at deploy time.

  DovetailCdnStagingDnsName:
    Type: String
    Default: d8h9i0j1k2l3m4.cloudfront.net
    Description: >-
      The CloudFront distribution domain name for the dovetail-cdn-staging
      distribution. Defaults to a placeholder that should be replaced with
      the actual distribution domain name at deploy time.

  FeederCdnDnsName:
    Type: String
    Default: d5n6o7p8q9r0s1.cloudfront.net
    Description: >-
      The CloudFront distribution domain name for the feeder CDN distribution,
      which serves the f, f-staging, and f.development subdomains. Defaults to
      a placeholder that should be replaced with the actual distribution
      domain name at deploy time.

  AdFilesCdnDnsName:
    Type: String
    Default: d2t3u4v5w6x7y8.cloudfront.net
    Description: >-
      The CloudFront distribution domain name for the ad files CDN
      distribution, which serves the a subdomain. Defaults to a placeholder
      that should be replaced with the actual distribution domain name at
      deploy time.

  RyanCdnDnsName:
    Type: String
    Default: d9z0a1b2c3d4e5.cloudfront.net
    Description: >-
      The CloudFront distribution domain name for the ryan-cdn development
      sandbox distribution. Defaults to a placeholder that should be replaced
      with the actual distribution domain name at deploy time.

Resources:
  HostedZone:
    Type: AWS::Route53::HostedZone
    Properties:
      Name: !Ref HostedZoneName
      HostedZoneConfig:
        Comment: >-
          Hosted zone for prxu.org, used for Google Workspace email and
          podcast service CDN routing.
      HostedZoneTags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment

  RootTxtRecordSet:
    Type: AWS::Route53::RecordSet
    Properties:
      HostedZoneId: !Ref HostedZone
      Name: !Ref HostedZoneName
      Type: TXT
      TTL: '300'
      ResourceRecords:
        - !Sub '"${GoogleSiteVerificationToken}"'
        - '"v=spf1 include:_spf.google.com ~all"'

  RootMxRecordSet:
    Type: AWS::Route53::RecordSet
    Properties:
      HostedZoneId: !Ref HostedZone
      Name: !Ref HostedZoneName
      Type: MX
      TTL: '300'
      ResourceRecords:
        - 1 ASPMX.L.GOOGLE.COM.
        - 5 ALT1.ASPMX.L.GOOGLE.COM.
        - 5 ALT2.ASPMX.L.GOOGLE.COM.
        - 10 ALT3.ASPMX.L.GOOGLE.COM.
        - 10 ALT4.ASPMX.L.GOOGLE.COM.

  DovetailCdnARecordSet:
    Type: AWS::Route53::RecordSet
    Properties:
      HostedZoneId: !Ref HostedZone
      Name: !Sub dovetail-cdn.${HostedZoneName}
      Type: A
      AliasTarget:
        HostedZoneId: Z2FDTNDATAQYW2
        DNSName: !Ref DovetailCdnDnsName
        EvaluateTargetHealth: false

  DovetailCdnAAAARecordSet:
    Type: AWS::Route53::RecordSet
    Properties:
      HostedZoneId: !Ref HostedZone
      Name: !Sub dovetail-cdn.${HostedZoneName}
      Type: AAAA
      AliasTarget:
        HostedZoneId: Z2FDTNDATAQYW2
        DNSName: !Ref DovetailCdnDnsName
        EvaluateTargetHealth: false

  DovetailCdnStagingARecordSet:
    Type: AWS::Route53::RecordSet
    Properties:
      HostedZoneId: !Ref HostedZone
      Name: !Sub dovetail-cdn-staging.${HostedZoneName}
      Type: A
      AliasTarget:
        HostedZoneId: Z2FDTNDATAQYW2
        DNSName: !Ref DovetailCdnStagingDnsName
        EvaluateTargetHealth: false

  DovetailCdnStagingAAAARecordSet:
    Type: AWS::Route53::RecordSet
    Properties:
      HostedZoneId: !Ref HostedZone
      Name: !Sub dovetail-cdn-staging.${HostedZoneName}
      Type: AAAA
      AliasTarget:
        HostedZoneId: Z2FDTNDATAQYW2
        DNSName: !Ref DovetailCdnStagingDnsName
        EvaluateTargetHealth: false

  FeederCdnARecordSet:
    Type: AWS::Route53::RecordSet
    Properties:
      HostedZoneId: !Ref HostedZone
      Name: !Sub f.${HostedZoneName}
      Type: A
      AliasTarget:
        HostedZoneId: Z2FDTNDATAQYW2
        DNSName: !Ref FeederCdnDnsName
        EvaluateTargetHealth: false

  FeederCdnAAAARecordSet:
    Type: AWS::Route53::RecordSet
    Properties:
      HostedZoneId: !Ref HostedZone
      Name: !Sub f.${HostedZoneName}
      Type: AAAA
      AliasTarget:
        HostedZoneId: Z2FDTNDATAQYW2
        DNSName: !Ref FeederCdnDnsName
        EvaluateTargetHealth: false

  FeederCdnStagingARecordSet:
    Type: AWS::Route53::RecordSet
    Properties:
      HostedZoneId: !Ref HostedZone
      Name: !Sub f-staging.${HostedZoneName}
      Type: A
      AliasTarget:
        HostedZoneId: Z2FDTNDATAQYW2
        DNSName: !Ref FeederCdnDnsName
        EvaluateTargetHealth: false

  FeederCdnStagingAAAARecordSet:
    Type: AWS::Route53::RecordSet
    Properties:
      HostedZoneId: !Ref HostedZone
      Name: !Sub f-staging.${HostedZoneName}
      Type: AAAA
      AliasTarget:
        HostedZoneId: Z2FDTNDATAQYW2
        DNSName: !Ref FeederCdnDnsName
        EvaluateTargetHealth: false

  FeederCdnDevelopmentARecordSet:
    Type: AWS::Route53::RecordSet
    Properties:
      HostedZoneId: !Ref HostedZone
      Name: !Sub f.development.${HostedZoneName}
      Type: A
      AliasTarget:
        HostedZoneId: Z2FDTNDATAQYW2
        DNSName: !Ref FeederCdnDnsName
        EvaluateTargetHealth: false

  FeederCdnDevelopmentAAAARecordSet:
