AWSTemplateFormatVersion: "2010-09-09"
Description: PCI DSS remediation prerequisites and nine AWS Systems Manager Automation documents for automated remediation of specific PCI DSS controls. All resource identifiers are exported for use by custom AWS Config conformance packs.

Parameters:
  CloudTrailLogGroupRetentionInDays:
    Type: Number
    Default: 1827
    Description: Retention period in days for the CloudTrail CloudWatch Logs log group. 1827 days equals five years.

Resources:
  CloudTrailLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Sub "/aws/cloudtrail/${AWS::StackName}"
      RetentionInDays: !Ref CloudTrailLogGroupRetentionInDays

  CloudTrailKmsKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    Properties:
      Description: KMS customer master key used to encrypt CloudTrail log files with key rotation enabled.
      Enabled: true
      EnableKeyRotation: true
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Sid: GrantRootAccountFullKmsAccess
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root"
            Action: "kms:*"
            Resource: "*"
          - Sid: GrantCloudTrailServiceAccess
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: cloudtrail.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - "kms:GenerateDataKey*"
              - "kms:DescribeKey"
            Resource: "*"
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                kms:CallerAccount: !Sub "${AWS::AccountId}"

  SsmAutomationRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      Description: IAM role assumed by the PCI DSS remediation SSM Automation documents.
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: ssm.amazonaws.com
            Action: "sts:AssumeRole"
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/IAMFullAccess"
        - !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/AdministratorAccess"

  CloudTrailCloudWatchLogsRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      Description: IAM role assumed by CloudTrail to deliver log events to CloudWatch Logs.
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: cloudtrail.amazonaws.com
            Action: "sts:AssumeRole"
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: CloudTrailCloudWatchLogsDelivery
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: "2012-10-17"
            Statement:
              - Sid: ManageLogGroupsStreamsAndWriteLogEvents
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - "logs:CreateLogGroup"
                  - "logs:CreateLogStream"
                  - "logs:PutLogEvents"
                  - "logs:DescribeLogGroups"
                  - "logs:DescribeLogStreams"
                  - "logs:PutRetentionPolicy"
                  - "logs:GetLogEvents"
                  - "logs:FilterLogEvents"
                Resource: "*"

  EncryptCloudTrailTrailAutomationDocument:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Document
    Properties:
      DocumentType: Automation
      DocumentFormat: YAML
      Name: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-EncryptCloudTrailTrail"
      Content:
        schemaVersion: "0.3"
        description: Encrypts the specified CloudTrail trail with the provided KMS key and integrates the trail with Amazon CloudWatch Logs.
        parameters:
          TrailName:
            type: String
            description: The name or ARN of the CloudTrail trail to encrypt and integrate with CloudWatch Logs.
          KmsKeyId:
            type: String
            description: The key ID, key ARN, alias name or alias ARN of the KMS key used to encrypt the trail log files.
          CloudWatchLogsLogGroupArn:
            type: String
            description: 'The ARN of the CloudWatch Logs log group that receives the trail log events, in the format arn:aws:logs:region:account-id:log-group:log-group-name:*.'
          CloudWatchLogsRoleArn:
            type: String
            description: The ARN of the IAM role that CloudTrail assumes to deliver log events to CloudWatch Logs.
          AutomationAssumeRole:
            type: String
            description: The ARN of the IAM role that allows Systems Manager Automation to perform the actions on your behalf.
            default: ''
            allowedPattern: '^$|^arn:aws[a-zA-Z-]*:iam::[0-9]{12}:role/.+'
        mainSteps:
          - name: UpdateTrailWithKmsKeyAndCloudWatchLogs
            action: aws:executeAwsApi
            inputs:
              Service: cloudtrail
              Api: UpdateTrail
              Name: "{{ TrailName }}"
              KmsKeyId: "{{ KmsKeyId }}"
              CloudWatchLogsLogGroupArn: "{{ CloudWatchLogsLogGroupArn }}"
              CloudWatchLogsRoleArn: "{{ CloudWatchLogsRoleArn }}"

  EnableKmsKeyRotationAutomationDocument:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Document
    Properties:
      DocumentType: Automation
      DocumentFormat: YAML
      Name: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-EnableKmsKeyRotation"
      Content:
        schemaVersion: "0.3"
        description: Enables automatic annual key rotation for the specified KMS key.
        parameters:
          KeyId:
            type: String
            description: The key ID, key ARN, alias name or alias ARN of the KMS key for which key rotation is enabled.
          AutomationAssumeRole:
            type: String
            description: The ARN of the IAM role that allows Systems Manager Automation to perform the actions on your behalf.
            default: ''
            allowedPattern: '^$|^arn:aws[a-zA-Z-]*:iam::[0-9]{12}:role/.+'
        mainSteps:
          - name: EnableKmsKeyRotation
            action: aws:executeAwsApi
            inputs:
              Service: kms
              Api: EnableKeyRotation
              KeyId: "{{ KeyId }}"

  IntegrateCloudTrailWithCloudWatchAutomationDocument:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Document
    Properties:
      DocumentType: Automation
      DocumentFormat: YAML
      Name: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-IntegrateCloudTrailCloudWatch"
      Content:
        schemaVersion: "0.3"
        description: Integrates the specified CloudTrail trail with Amazon CloudWatch Logs.
        parameters:
          TrailName:
            type: String
            description: The name or ARN of the CloudTrail trail to integrate with CloudWatch Logs.
          CloudWatchLogsLogGroupArn:
            type: String
            description: 'The ARN of the CloudWatch Logs log group that receives the trail log events, in the format arn:aws:logs:region:account-id:log-group:log-group-name:*.'
          CloudWatchLogsRoleArn:
            type: String
            description: The ARN of the IAM role that CloudTrail assumes to deliver log events to CloudWatch Logs.
          AutomationAssumeRole:
            type: String
            description: The ARN of the IAM role that allows Systems Manager Automation to perform the actions on your behalf.
            default: ''
            allowedPattern: '^$|^arn:aws[a-zA-Z-]*:iam::[0-9]{12}:role/.+'
        mainSteps:
          - name: UpdateTrailWithCloudWatchLogs
            action: aws:executeAwsApi
            inputs:
              Service: cloudtrail
              Api: UpdateTrail
              Name: "{{ TrailName }}"
              CloudWatchLogsLogGroupArn: "{{ CloudWatchLogsLogGroupArn }}"
              CloudWatchLogsRoleArn: "{{ CloudWatchLogsRoleArn }}"

  UpdateIamPasswordPolicyAutomationDocument:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Document
    Properties:
      DocumentType: Automation
      DocumentFormat: YAML
      Name: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-UpdateIamPasswordPolicy"
      Content:
        schemaVersion: "0.3"
        description: Updates the account IAM password policy to enforce PCI DSS password requirements.
        parameters:
          AutomationAssumeRole:
            type: String
            description: The ARN of the IAM role that allows Systems Manager Automation to perform the actions on your behalf.
            default: ''
            allowedPattern: '^$|^arn:aws[a-zA-Z-]*:iam::[0-9]{12}:role/.+'
        mainSteps:
          - name: UpdateAccountPasswordPolicy
            action: aws:executeAwsApi
            inputs:
              Service: iam
              Api: UpdateAccountPasswordPolicy
              MinimumPasswordLength: 14
              RequireUppercaseCharacters: true
              RequireLowercaseCharacters: true
              RequireNumbers: true
              RequireSymbols: true
              AllowUsersToChangePassword: true
              HardExpiry: true
              MaxPasswordAge: 90
              PasswordReusePrevention: 24

  EnableCloudTrailLogFileValidationAutomationDocument:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Document
    Properties:
      DocumentType: Automation
      DocumentFormat: YAML
      Name: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-EnableTrailLogFileValidation"
      Content:
        schemaVersion: "0.3"
        description: Enables log file validation for the specified CloudTrail trail and ensures the trail is a multi-region trail integrated with Amazon CloudWatch Logs.
        parameters:
          TrailName:
            type: String
            description: The name or ARN of the CloudTrail trail to update.
          CloudWatchLogsLogGroupArn:
            type: String
            description: 'The ARN of the CloudWatch Logs log group that receives the trail log events, in the format arn:aws:logs:region:account-id:log-group:log-group-name:*.'
          CloudWatchLogsRoleArn:
            type: String
            description: The ARN of the IAM role that CloudTrail assumes to deliver log events to CloudWatch Logs.
          AutomationAssumeRole:
            type: String
            description: The ARN of the IAM role that allows Systems Manager Automation to perform the actions on your behalf.
            default: ''
            allowedPattern: '^$|^arn:aws[a-zA-Z-]*:iam::[0-9]{12}:role/.+'
        mainSteps:
          - name: UpdateTrailEnableLogFileValidation
            action: aws:executeAwsApi
            inputs:
              Service: cloudtrail
              Api: UpdateTrail
              Name: "{{ TrailName }}"
              EnableLogFileValidation: true
              IsMultiRegionTrail: true
              CloudWatchLogsLogGroupArn: "{{ CloudWatchLogsLogGroupArn }}"
              CloudWatchLogsRoleArn: "{{ CloudWatchLogsRoleArn }}"

  RevokeDefaultSecurityGroupRulesAutomationDocument:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Document
    Properties:
      DocumentType: Automation
      DocumentFormat: YAML
      Name: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-RevokeDefaultSgRules"
      Content:
        schemaVersion: "0.3"
        description: Revokes all inbound and outbound rules on the specified default security group.
        parameters:
          SecurityGroupId:
            type: String
            description: The ID of the default security group for which all inbound and outbound rules are revoked.
            allowedPattern: '^sg-[0-9a-f]{8,17}$'
          AutomationAssumeRole:
            type: String
            description: The ARN of the IAM role that allows Systems Manager Automation to perform the actions on your behalf.
            default: ''
            allowedPattern: '^$|^arn:aws[a-zA-Z-]*:iam::[0-9]{12}:role/.+'
        mainSteps:
          - name: RevokeSecurityGroupRules
            action: aws:executeScript
            inputs:
              Runtime: python3.11
              Handler: script_handler
              Script: |-
                import boto3

                def script_handler(events, context):
                    ec2_client = boto3.client('ec2')
                    group_id = events['GroupId']
                    response = ec2_client.describe_security_groups(GroupIds=[group_id])
                    security_group = response['SecurityGroups'][0]
                    ingress_permissions = security_group.get('IpPermissions', [])
                    egress_permissions = security_group.get('IpPermissionsEgress', [])
                    if ingress_permissions:
                        ec2_client.revoke_security_group_ingress(
                            GroupId=group_id,
                            IpPermissions=ingress_permissions
                        )
                    if egress_permissions:
                        ec2_client.revoke_security_group_egress(
                            GroupId=group_id,
                            IpPermissions=egress_permissions
                        )
                    return {
                        'RevokedIngressRuleCount': len(ingress_permissions),
                        'RevokedEgressRuleCount': len(egress_permissions)
                    }
              InputPayload:
                GroupId: "{{ SecurityGroupId }}"

  DeleteSecurityGroupAutomationDocument:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Document
    Properties:
      DocumentType: Automation
      DocumentFormat: YAML
      Name: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-DeleteSecurityGroup"
      Content:
        schemaVersion: "0.3"
        description: Deletes the specified security group.
        parameters:
          SecurityGroupId:
            type: String
            description: The ID of the security group to delete.
            allowedPattern: '^sg-[0-9a-f]{8,17}$'
          AutomationAssumeRole:
            type: String
            description: The ARN of the IAM role that allows Systems Manager Automation to perform the actions on your behalf.
            default: ''
            allowedPattern: '^$|^arn:aws[a-zA-Z-]*:iam::[0-9]{12}:role/.+'
        mainSteps:
          - name: DeleteSecurityGroup
            action: aws:executeAwsApi
            inputs:
              Service: ec2
              Api: DeleteSecurityGroup
              GroupId: "{{ SecurityGroupId }}"

  ReleaseElasticIpAutomationDocument:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Document
    Properties:
      DocumentType: Automation
      DocumentFormat: YAML
      Name: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-ReleaseElasticIp"
      Content:
        schemaVersion: "0.3"
        description: Releases the unused Elastic IP address identified by the provided allocation ID.
        parameters:
          AllocationId:
            type: String
            description: The allocation ID of the unused Elastic IP address to release.
            allowedPattern: '^eipalloc-[0-9a-f]{8,17}$'
          AutomationAssumeRole:

        mainSteps:
          - name: ReleaseElasticIpAddress
            action: aws:executeAwsApi
            inputs:
              Service: ec2
              Api: ReleaseAddress
              AllocationId: "{{ AllocationId }}"

  RemoveCodeBuildCredentialsAutomationDocument:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Document
    Properties:
      DocumentType: Automation
      DocumentFormat: YAML
      Name: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-RemoveCodeBuildCredentials"
      Content:
        schemaVersion: "0.3"
        description: Updates the specified CodeBuild project so that plaintext AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID and AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY environment variables are removed.
        parameters:
          ProjectName:
            type: String
            description: The name of the CodeBuild project to update.
          AutomationAssumeRole:
            type: String
            description: The ARN of the IAM role that allows Systems Manager Automation to perform the actions on your behalf.
            default: ''
            allowedPattern: '^$|^arn:aws[a-zA-Z-]*:iam::[0-9]{12}:role/.+'
        mainSteps:
          - name: RemovePlaintextAwsCredentials
            action: aws:executeScript
            inputs:
              Runtime: python3.11
              Handler: script_handler
              Script: |-
                import boto3

                def script_handler(events, context):
                    codebuild_client = boto3.client('codebuild')
                    project_name = events['ProjectName']
                    response = codebuild_client.batch_get_projects(names=[project_name])
                    projects = response.get('projects', [])
                    if not projects:
                        raise Exception('CodeBuild project %s was not found.' % project_name)
                    environment = projects[0].get('environment', {})
                    environment_variables = environment.get('environmentVariables', [])
                    sensitive_variable_names = ['AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID', 'AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY']
                    remaining_variables = [
                        variable for variable in environment_variables
                        if variable.get('name') not in sensitive_variable_names
                    ]
                    environment['environmentVariables'] = remaining_variables
                    codebuild_client.update_project(
                        name=project_name,
                        environment=environment
                    )
                    return {
                        'RemovedSensitiveEnvironmentVariables': len(environment_variables) - len(remaining_variables)
                    }
              InputPayload:
                ProjectName: "{{ ProjectName }}"

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >-
  Telemetry monitoring for Claude Desktop (CoWork) usage. Creates a CloudWatch
  Logs log group for CoWork telemetry events plus metric filters that extract
  input tokens, output tokens, cache read tokens, cache creation tokens,
  estimated cost and session turn counts into shared metric names. CoWork emits
  two event schemas: local agent mode (flat usage object, estimatedCostUSD) and
  Claude Code for Desktop (nested message.usage, costUSD), each with its own
  filters publishing to the same metrics. Unattributed metrics use DefaultValue
  zero so unmatched fields still publish zero, while attributed metrics use
  User/Model dimensions on filters that require the field. Also creates a
  CloudWatch dashboard (configurable name, metrics region defaulting to
  us-east-1) showing total tokens, total cost, session turns, cache hits, usage
  and cost trends, average cost per turn, per user breakdowns, active users and
  a recent raw events table, and outputs the direct dashboard console URL.
Parameters:
  DashboardName:
    Type: String
    Description: Name of the CloudWatch dashboard to create.
    Default: Claude-CoWork-Telemetry
    AllowedPattern: '^[a-zA-Z0-9][a-zA-Z0-9._-]{0,254}$'
  MetricsRegion:
    Type: String
    Description: AWS region that all dashboard metric widgets are scoped to.
    Default: us-east-1
    AllowedPattern: '^[a-z]{2}(-gov)?-[a-z]+-[0-9]+$'
  MetricNamespace:
    Type: String
    Description: CloudWatch namespace that all CoWork telemetry metrics are published to.
    Default: ClaudeCoWork
    AllowedPattern: '^[a-zA-Z0-9._/-]{1,255}$'
  LogGroupName:
    Type: String
    Description: Name of the CloudWatch Logs log group that receives CoWork telemetry events.
    Default: /claude-cowork/telemetry
    AllowedPattern: '^[a-zA-Z0-9._#/-]{1,512}$'
  RetentionInDays:
    Type: Number
    Description: Log retention period in days for the CoWork telemetry log group.
    Default: 30
    AllowedValues:
      - 1
      - 3
      - 5
      - 7
      - 14
      - 30
      - 60
      - 90
      - 120
      - 180
      - 365
      - 731
      - 1827
      - 3653
Resources:

              "type": "metric",
              "x": 0,
              "y": 0,
              "width": 6,
              "height": 4,
              "properties": {
                "view": "singlevalue",
                "title": "Total Token Usage (input + output + cache)",
                "region": "${MetricsRegion}",
                "stat": "Sum",
                "period": 86400,
                "metrics": [

                  ["${MetricNamespace}", "OutputTokens", { "id": "m2", "visible": false }],
                  ["${MetricNamespace}", "CacheReadTokens", { "id": "m3", "visible": false }],
                  ["${MetricNamespace}", "CacheCreationTokens", { "id": "m4", "visible": false }],

              "type": "metric",
              "x": 6,
              "y": 0,

            },

                "period": 86400,

            },
            {

              "x": 0,
              "y": 4,
              "width": 12,
              "height": 6,
              "properties": {
                "view": "timeSeries",
                "title": "Token Usage Trend",
                "region": "${MetricsRegion}",
                "stat": "Sum",
                "period": 300,

                "metrics": [

                  ["${MetricNamespace}", "OutputTokens"],

            {
              "type": "metric",
              "x": 12,
              "y": 4,
              "width": 12,
              "height": 6,
              "properties": {
                "view": "timeSeries",
                "title": "Estimated Cost Trend (USD)",

                "stat": "Sum",
                "period": 300,
                "metrics": [
                  ["${MetricNamespace}", "EstimatedCost"]

            },
            {
              "type": "metric",
              "x": 0,
              "y": 10,
              "width": 6,
              "height": 4,
              "properties": {
                "view": "singlevalue",
                "title": "Average Cost per Turn (USD)",

                "view": "timeSeries",
                "title": "Session Turn Count Trend",

            {

              "height": 6,

                "view": "table",
                "title": "Token Usage by User",

                "metrics": [
                  [{ "expression": "SEARCH('{${MetricNamespace},User} UserInputTokens UserOutputTokens', 'Sum', 86400)", "id": "", "region": "${MetricsRegion}" }]
                ]
              }
            },
            {
              "type": "metric",
              "x": 8,
              "y": 14,
              "width": 8,
              "height": 6,
              "properties": {
                "view": "table",
                "title": "Estimated Cost by User (USD)",
                "region": "${MetricsRegion}",
                "metrics": [
                  [{ "expression": "SEARCH('{${MetricNamespace},User} UserEstimatedCost', 'Sum', 86400)", "id": "", "region": "${MetricsRegion}" }]
                ]
              }
            },
            {
              "type": "metric",
              "x": 16,
              "y": 14,
              "width": 8,
              "height": 6,
              "properties": {
                "view": "table",
                "title": "Session Activity by User (Turns)",
                "region": "${MetricsRegion}",
                "metrics": [
                  [{ "expression": "SEARCH('{${MetricNamespace},User} UserSessionTurns', 'Sum', 86400)", "id": "", "region": "${MetricsRegion}" }]
                ]
              }
            },
            {
              "type": "metric",
              "x": 0,
              "y": 20,
              "width": 6,
              "height": 6,
              "properties": {
                "view": "table",
                "title": "Token Usage by Model",
                "region": "${MetricsRegion}",
                "metrics": [
                  [{ "expression": "SEARCH('{${MetricNamespace},Model} ModelInputTokens ModelOutputTokens', 'Sum', 86400)", "id": "", "region": "${MetricsRegion}" }]
                ]
              }
            },
            {
              "type": "log",
              "x": 6,
              "y": 20,
              "width": 6,
              "height": 6,
              "properties": {
                "view": "table",
                "title": "Active Users per Hour",
                "region": "${AWS::Region}",
                "query": "SOURCE('${CoWorkLogGroup}') | filter ispresent(user)\n| stats count_distinct(user) as activeUsers by bin(1h)"
              }
            },
            {
              "type": "log",
              "x": 12,
              "y": 20,
              "width": 12,
              "height": 6,
              "properties": {
                "view": "table",
                "title": "Recent CoWork Events (raw)",
                "region": "${AWS::Region}",
                "query": "SOURCE('${CoWorkLogGroup}') | fields @timestamp, @message\n| sort @timestamp desc\n| limit 50"
              }
            }
          ]
        }
Outputs:

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: "2010-09-09"

Description: >-
  This stack includes resources needed to deploy AWS CDK applications into this
  environment. It creates an encrypted, versioned S3 bucket for file assets with
  HTTPS-only access, an immutable ECR repository for container assets with
  scanning on push, a customer-managed KMS key with a customizable alias, IAM
  roles for file publishing, image publishing, account lookups, deployment
  actions and CloudFormation execution with configurable trusted accounts and
  managed policy ARNs, and an SSM parameter that tracks the bootstrap version.

Metadata:
  AWS::CloudFormation::Interface:
    ParameterGroups:
      - Label:
          default: Bootstrap configuration
        Parameters:
          - Qualifier
      - Label:
          default: File assets bucket
        Parameters:
          - FileAssetsBucketName
          - FileAssetsBucketKmsKeyId
          - FileAssetsBucketEncryptionKeyAlias
          - PublicAccessBlockConfiguration
      - Label:
          default: Trust and deployment permissions
        Parameters:
          - TrustedAccounts
          - CloudFormationExecutionPolicies
          - PermissionsBoundary

Parameters:
  Qualifier:
    Type: String
    Description: >-
      An identifier included in the name of every resource in this stack. It can
      be customized to create multiple bootstrap stacks in the same account and
      region.
    AllowedPattern: "[A-Za-z0-9]+"
    ConstraintDescription: The qualifier must be 1-10 alphanumeric characters.
    Default: hnb659fds
    MinLength: 1
    MaxLength: 10
  FileAssetsBucketName:
    Type: String
    Description: >-
      The name of the S3 bucket used for file assets. If left empty, a unique
      name is generated automatically.
    Default: ""
  FileAssetsBucketKmsKeyId:
    Type: String
    Description: >-
      The KMS key ID used to encrypt the file assets bucket. If left empty, a
      new customer-managed KMS key is created. If set to AWS_MANAGED_KEY, the
      AWS managed S3 key is used. Otherwise, the specified existing key is
      used.
    Default: ""
  FileAssetsBucketEncryptionKeyAlias:
    Type: String
    Description: >-
      The alias (without the alias/ prefix) for the customer-managed KMS key
      created for the file assets bucket. If left empty, the alias
      cdk-<qualifier>-assets is used.
    Default: ""
  TrustedAccounts:
    Type: CommaDelimitedList
    Description: >-
      A list of account IDs that are trusted to assume the bootstrap roles. If
      left empty, only this account's root principal is trusted. When set, this
      list replaces the default trust, so include this account's ID if local
      access should be retained.
    Default: ""
  CloudFormationExecutionPolicies:
    Type: CommaDelimitedList
    Description: >-
      A list of managed policy ARNs attached to the CloudFormation execution
      role used to deploy CDK applications.
    Default: "arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/AdministratorAccess"
  PublicAccessBlockConfiguration:
    Type: String
    Description: >-
      Whether the S3 public access block should be enabled for the file assets
      bucket.
    AllowedValues:
      - "true"
      - "false"
    Default: "true"
  PermissionsBoundary:
    Type: String
    Description: >-
      The ARN of the policy used to set the permissions boundary for every role
      created by this stack. If left empty, no permissions boundary is set.
    Default: ""

Conditions:
  HasCustomFileAssetsBucketName: !Not [!Equals [!Ref FileAssetsBucketName, ""]]
  HasTrustedAccounts: !Not [!Equals [!Join [",", !Ref TrustedAccounts], ""]]
  CreateNewKey: !Equals [!Ref FileAssetsBucketKmsKeyId, ""]
  UseDefaultKey: !Equals [!Ref FileAssetsBucketKmsKeyId, "AWS_MANAGED_KEY"]
  UseCustomKey: !And [!Not [!Condition CreateNewKey], !Not [!Condition UseDefaultKey]]
  UseKeyAlias: !Not [!Equals [!Ref FileAssetsBucketEncryptionKeyAlias, ""]]
  ShouldCreatePublicAccessBlock: !Equals [!Ref PublicAccessBlockConfiguration, "true"]
  ShouldCreatePermissionsBoundary: !Not [!Equals [!Ref PermissionsBoundary, ""]]

Resources:
  FileAssetsBucketEncryptionKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    Condition: CreateNewKey
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      Description: !Sub "Customer-managed KMS key for CDK file assets (qualifier: ${Qualifier})"
      EnableKeyRotation: true
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Sid: EnableIAMUserPermissions
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root"
            Action: "kms:*"
            Resource: "*"

  FileAssetsBucketKeyAlias:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Alias
    Condition: CreateNewKey
    Properties:
      AliasName: !If
        - UseKeyAlias
        - !Sub "alias/${FileAssetsBucketEncryptionKeyAlias}"
        - !Sub "alias/cdk-${Qualifier}-assets"
      TargetKeyId: !Ref FileAssetsBucketEncryptionKey

  FileAssetsBucket:
    Type: AWS::S3::Bucket
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      BucketName: !If
        - HasCustomFileAssetsBucketName
        - !Ref FileAssetsBucketName
        - !Ref "AWS::NoValue"
      BucketEncryption:
        ServerSideEncryptionConfiguration:
          - ServerSideEncryptionByDefault:
              SSEAlgorithm: "aws:kms"
              KMSMasterKeyID: !If
                - CreateNewKey
                - !Ref FileAssetsBucketEncryptionKey
                - !If
                  - UseDefaultKey
                  - !Ref "AWS::NoValue"
                  - !Ref FileAssetsBucketKmsKeyId
      OwnershipControls:
        Rules:
          - ObjectOwnership: BucketOwnerEnforced
      PublicAccessBlockConfiguration: !If
        - ShouldCreatePublicAccessBlock
        - BlockPublicAcls: true
          BlockPublicPolicy: true
          IgnorePublicAcls: true
          RestrictPublicBuckets: true
        - !Ref "AWS::NoValue"
      VersioningConfiguration:
        Status: Enabled
      Tags:
        - Key: "aws-cdk:bootstrap-version"
          Value: "18"

  FileAssetsBucketPolicy:
    Type: AWS::S3::BucketPolicy
    Properties:
      Bucket: !Ref FileAssetsBucket
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Sid: RequireSecureTransport
            Effect: Deny
            Principal: "*"
            Action: "s3:*"
            Resource:
              - !Sub "${FileAssetsBucket.Arn}"
              - !Sub "${FileAssetsBucket.Arn}/*"
            Condition:
              Bool:
                aws:SecureTransport: "false"
          - Sid: AllowBootstrapReadAccess
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS:
                - !GetAtt DeploymentActionRole.Arn
                - !GetAtt FilePublishingRole.Arn
                - !GetAtt LookupRole.Arn
            Action:
              - "s3:GetBucketLocation"
              - "s3:GetObject"
              - "s3:ListBucket"
            Resource:
              - !GetAtt FileAssetsBucket.Arn
              - !Sub "${FileAssetsBucket.Arn}/*"

  FilePublishingRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub "cdk-${Qualifier}-file-publishing-role-${AWS::AccountId}-${AWS::Region}"
      Description: Used by the CDK CLI to publish file assets to the file assets bucket.
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Action: "sts:AssumeRole"
            Principal:
              AWS: !If
                - HasTrustedAccounts
                - !Ref TrustedAccounts
                - !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root"
      PermissionsBoundary: !If
        - ShouldCreatePermissionsBoundary
        - !Ref PermissionsBoundary
        - !Ref "AWS::NoValue"
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: FilePublishingRolePolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: "2012-10-17"
            Statement:
              - Sid: PublishFileAssets
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - "s3:Abort*"
                  - "s3:DeleteObject*"
                  - "s3:GetObject*"
                  - "s3:PutObject*"
                Resource:
                  - !Sub "${FileAssetsBucket.Arn}"
                  - !Sub "${FileAssetsBucket.Arn}/*"
              - Sid: ListFileAssetsBucket
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - "s3:GetBucketLocation"
                  - "s3:ListBucket"
                Resource: !GetAtt FileAssetsBucket.Arn
              - Sid: UseEncryptionKey
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - "kms:Decrypt"
                  - "kms:DescribeKey"
                  - "kms:Encrypt"
                  - "kms:GenerateDataKey*"
                  - "kms:ReEncrypt*"
                Resource: !If
                  - CreateNewKey
                  - !GetAtt FileAssetsBucketEncryptionKey.Arn
                  - !If
                    - UseDefaultKey
                    - !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:kms:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:alias/aws/s3"
                    - !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:kms:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:key/${FileAssetsBucketKmsKeyId}"

  ImagePublishingRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub "cdk-${Qualifier}-image-publishing-role-${AWS::AccountId}-${AWS::Region}"
      Description: Used by the CDK CLI to publish Docker image assets to the container assets repository.
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Action: "sts:AssumeRole"
            Principal:
              AWS: !If
                - HasTrustedAccounts
                - !Ref TrustedAccounts
                - !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root"
      PermissionsBoundary: !If
        - ShouldCreatePermissionsBoundary
        - !Ref PermissionsBoundary
        - !Ref "AWS::NoValue"
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: ImagePublishingRolePolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: "2012-10-17"
            Statement:
              - Sid: EcrAuthorization
                Effect: Allow
                Action: "ecr:GetAuthorizationToken"
                Resource: "*"
              - Sid: EcrGetImages
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - "ecr:BatchCheckLayerAvailability"
                  - "ecr:BatchGetImage"
                  - "ecr:DescribeImages"
                  - "ecr:GetDownloadUrlForLayer"
                Resource: "*"
              - Sid: EcrPutImages
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - "ecr:BatchCheckLayerAvailability"
                  - "ecr:CompleteLayerUpload"
                  - "ecr:InitiateLayerUpload"
                  - "ecr:PutImage"
                  - "ecr:UploadLayerPart"
                Resource: "*"

  LookupRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub "cdk-${Qualifier}-lookup-role-${AWS::AccountId}-${AWS::Region}"
      Description: Used by the CDK CLI to perform read-only context lookups in this environment.
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Action: "sts:AssumeRole"
            Principal:
              AWS: !If
                - HasTrustedAccounts
                - !Ref TrustedAccounts
                - !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root"
      PermissionsBoundary: !If
        - ShouldCreatePermissionsBoundary
        - !Ref PermissionsBoundary
        - !Ref "AWS::NoValue"
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: LookupRolePolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: "2012-10-17"
            Statement:
              - Sid: ContextLookupReadAccess
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - "cloudformation:DescribeStackEvents"
                  - "cloudformation:DescribeStackResource"
                  - "cloudformation:DescribeStackResources"
                  - "cloudformation:DescribeStacks"
                  - "cloudformation:GetTemplate"
                  - "cloudformation:ListStackResources"
                  - "cloudformation:ListStacks"
                  - "cloudformation:ValidateTemplate"
                  - "ec2:Describe*"
                  - "ssm:GetParameter"
                  - "ssm:GetParameters"
                  - "ssm:GetParametersByPath"
                  - "sts:GetCallerIdentity"
                Resource: "*"
              - Sid: ReadFileAssetsBucket
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - "s3:GetBucketLocation"
                  - "s3:GetObject"
                  - "s3:ListBucket"
                Resource:
                  - !GetAtt FileAssetsBucket.Arn
                  - !Sub "${FileAssetsBucket.Arn}/*"
              - Sid: DecryptFileAssets
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - "kms:Decrypt"
                  - "kms:DescribeKey"
                Resource: !If
                  - CreateNewKey
                  - !GetAtt FileAssetsBucketEncryptionKey.Arn
                  - !If
                    - UseCustomKey
                    - !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:kms:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:key/${FileAssetsBucketKmsKeyId}"
                    - !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:kms:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:alias/aws/s3"

  DeploymentActionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub "cdk-${Qualifier}-deploy-role-${AWS::AccountId}-${AWS::Region}"
      Description: Used by the CDK CLI to orchestrate deployments in this environment.
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Action: "sts:AssumeRole"
            Principal:
              AWS: !If
                - HasTrustedAccounts
                - !Ref TrustedAccounts
                - !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root"
      PermissionsBoundary: !If
        - ShouldCreatePermissionsBoundary
        - !Ref PermissionsBoundary
        - !Ref "AWS::NoValue"
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: DeploymentActionRolePolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: "2012-10-17"
            Statement:
              - Sid: CloudFormationDeployments
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - "cloudformation:CancelUpdateStack"
                  - "cloudformation:ContinueUpdateRollback"
                  - "cloudformation:CreateChangeSet"
                  - "cloudformation:DeleteChangeSet"
                  - "cloudformation:DeleteStack"
                  - "cloudformation:DescribeAccountLimits"
                  - "cloudformation:DescribeChangeSet"
                  - "cloudformation:DescribeStackEvents"
                  - "cloudformation:DescribeStackResource"
                  - "cloudformation:DescribeStackResources"
                  - "cloudformation:DescribeStacks"
                  - "cloudformation:ExecuteChangeSet"
                  - "cloudformation:GetTemplate"
                  - "cloudformation:GetTemplateSummary"
                  - "cloudformation:ListStackResources"
                  - "cloudformation:ListStacks"
                  - "cloudformation:RollbackStack"
                  - "cloudformation:UpdateTerminationProtection"
                  - "cloudformation:ValidateTemplate"
                Resource: "*"
              - Sid: PassCloudFormationExecutionRole
                Effect: Allow
                Action: "iam:PassRole"
                Resource: !GetAtt CloudFormationExecutionRole.Arn
              - Sid: AssumeBootstrapRoles
                Effect: Allow
                Action: "sts:AssumeRole"
                Resource:
                  - !GetAtt CloudFormationExecutionRole.Arn
                  - !GetAtt FilePublishingRole.Arn
                  - !GetAtt ImagePublishingRole.Arn
                  - !GetAtt LookupRole.Arn
              - Sid: FileAssetsBucketAccess
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - "s3:Abort*"
                  - "s3:DeleteObject*"
                  - "s3:GetBucket*"
                  - "s3:GetObject*"
                  - "s3:List*"
                Resource:
                  - !Sub "${FileAssetsBucket.Arn}"
                  - !Sub "${FileAssetsBucket.Arn}/*"
              - Sid: DecryptFileAssets
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - "kms:Decrypt"
                  - "kms:DescribeKey"
                Resource: !If
                  - CreateNewKey
                  - !GetAtt FileAssetsBucketEncryptionKey.Arn
                  - !If
                    - UseCustomKey
                    - !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:kms:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:key/${FileAssetsBucketKmsKeyId}"
                    - !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:kms:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:alias/aws/s3"
              - Sid: ContainerAssetsPull
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - "ecr:BatchCheckLayerAvailability"
                  - "ecr:BatchGetImage"
                  - "ecr:DescribeImages"
                  - "ecr:GetDownloadUrlForLayer"
                  - "ecr:GetAuthorizationToken"
                Resource: "*"
              - Sid: CliPermissions
                Effect: Allow
                Action: "sts:GetCallerIdentity"
                Resource: "*"

  CloudFormationExecutionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub "cdk-${Qualifier}-cfn-exec-role-${AWS::AccountId}-${AWS::Region}"
      Description: Used by AWS CloudFormation to create and update CDK application resources.
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Action: "sts:AssumeRole"
            Principal:
              Service: cloudformation.amazonaws.com
      ManagedPolicyArns: !Ref CloudFormationExecutionPolicies
      PermissionsBoundary: !If
        - ShouldCreatePermissionsBoundary
        - !Ref PermissionsBoundary
        - !Ref "AWS::NoValue"

  ContainerAssetsRepository:
    Type: AWS::ECR::Repository
    Properties:
      RepositoryName: !Sub "cdk-${Qualifier}-container-assets-${AWS::AccountId}-${AWS::Region}"
      ImageScanningConfiguration:
        ScanOnPush: true
      ImageTagMutability: IMMUTABLE
      EncryptionConfiguration:
        EncryptionType: AES256
      Tags:
        - Key: "aws-cdk:bootstrap-version"
          Value: "18"

  CdkBootstrapVersion:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Parameter
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub "/cdk-bootstrap/${Qualifier}/version"
      Description: !Sub "The version of the CDK bootstrap resources in this environment (qualifier: ${Qualifier})."
      Type: String
      Value: "18"

Outputs:
  BucketName:
    Description: The name of the file assets bucket.
    Value: !Ref FileAssetsBucket
  BucketDomainName:
    Description: The regional domain name of the file assets bucket.
    Value: !GetAtt FileAssetsBucket.RegionalDomainName
  FileAssetsBucketKeyArn:
    Description: The ARN of the KMS key used to encrypt the file assets bucket.
    Value: !If
      - CreateNewKey
      - !GetAtt FileAssetsBucketEncryptionKey.Arn
      - !If
        - UseCustomKey
        - !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:kms:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:key/${FileAssetsBucketKmsKeyId}"
        - !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:kms:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:alias/aws/s3"
  RepositoryName:
    Description: The name of the container assets repository.
    Value: !Ref ContainerAssetsRepository
  RepositoryUri:
    Description: The URI of the container assets repository.
    Value: !GetAtt ContainerAssetsRepository.RepositoryUri
  FilePublishingRoleArn:
    Description: The ARN of the file publishing role.
    Value: !GetAtt FilePublishingRole.Arn
  ImagePublishingRoleArn:
    Description: The ARN of the image publishing role.
    Value: !GetAtt ImagePublishingRole.Arn
  LookupRoleArn:
    Description: The ARN of the lookup role.
    Value: !GetAtt LookupRole.Arn
  DeploymentActionRoleArn:
    Description: The ARN of the deployment action role.
    Value: !GetAtt DeploymentActionRole.Arn
  CloudFormationExecutionRoleArn:
    Description: The ARN of the CloudFormation execution role.
    Value: !GetAtt CloudFormationExecutionRole.Arn
  BootstrapVersion:
    Description: The version of the bootstrap resources created by this stack.
    Value: !GetAtt CdkBootstrapVersion.Value

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: "2010-09-09"

Description: >-
  AWS Service Catalog environment for a machine learning workshop. Creates two portfolios
  (admin team and end users) with products for a VPC with private subnets and endpoints,
  IAM roles with KMS keys and S3 buckets, AWS Data Exchange, infrastructure, an application,
  a SageMaker notebook instance and a third-party ML model. Each product template is
  uploaded to a private S3 bucket by its own small custom resource, and each provisioning
  artifact references a SigV4 presigned template URL returned by that resource, keeping
  every custom resource response short and avoiding external template dependencies. Each
  product is associated with its portfolio and constrained by a dedicated launch role. IAM
  roles for the admin lead end user and standard end user are created with read/describe
  permissions, access to SSM parameters under the MLWorkshop path and S3 objects tagged
  for provisioning, and are associated as portfolio principals.

      - Label:
          default: Service Catalog Workshop Configuration
        Parameters:
          - RepoRootURL
          - EnvironmentPrefix
    ParameterLabels:
      RepoRootURL:
        default: Root S3 URL for the workshop product template sources
      EnvironmentPrefix:
        default: Environment Prefix

Parameters:

    Type: String
    Description: The root S3 URL location of the workshop product template sources.
    Default: https://aws-service-catalog-reference-architectures.s3.amazonaws.com/blog_content/securing-third-party-data-and-ml-apps
  EnvironmentPrefix:
    Type: String
    Description: Environment prefix used to uniquely name portfolios, products and IAM roles.
    Default: user-1
    AllowedPattern: ^[a-zA-Z0-9-]*$
    ConstraintDescription: Environment prefix can only contain letters, numbers and hyphens.

      Value: !Ref RepoRootURL

            Action: s3:GetObject

      Policies:
        - PolicyName: ManageProductTemplates
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: "2012-10-17"
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - s3:PutObject
                  - s3:GetObject
                  - s3:DeleteObject
                Resource: !Sub "${ProductTemplateBucket.Arn}/product-templates/*"

  ProductTemplateUploadFunction:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    Properties:
      Description: Uploads one workshop Service Catalog product template to S3 and returns a presigned URL.
      Runtime: python3.12
      Handler: index.handler
      Role: !GetAtt ProductTemplateUploadRole.Arn
      Timeout: 60
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import boto3
          import cfnresponse

          def handler(event, context):
              props = event.get('ResourceProperties', {})
              bucket = props.get('Bucket', '')
              name = props.get('TemplateName', 'workshop-template')
              try:
                  s3 = boto3.client('s3')
                  key = 'product-templates/' + name + '.json'
                  if event['RequestType'] == 'Delete':
                      try:
                          s3.delete_object(Bucket=bucket, Key=key)
                      except Exception:
                          pass
                      cfnresponse.send(event, context, cfnresponse.SUCCESS, {}, name)
                      return
                  body = props.get('TemplateBody', '')
                  s3.put_object(Bucket=bucket, Key=key, Body=body.encode('utf-8'), ContentType='application/json')
                  url = s3.generate_presigned_url(
                      'get_object',
                      Params={'Bucket': bucket, 'Key': key},
                      ExpiresIn=604800
                  )
                  cfnresponse.send(event, context, cfnresponse.SUCCESS, {'TemplateUrl': url}, name)
              except Exception as err:
                  print(str(err))
                  cfnresponse.send(event, context, cfnresponse.FAILED, {'Error': str(err)}, name + '-failed')

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >-
  Provisions a dual-stack (IPv4 and IPv6) VPC for a staging or production
  environment, selectable via parameter, with environment-specific VPC and
  subnet CIDR ranges defined in the template. Includes three public subnets
  (two in the first availability zone for the presentation or load-balancer
  tier and one in an additional availability zone for compute), two private
  subnets in the first availability zone (application and data tiers), an
  internet gateway, an egress-only internet gateway for IPv6, an optional NAT
  gateway with its own Elastic IP, public and private network ACLs, an EC2
  placement group for tightly coupled workloads, and a DHCP options set.
  Exports the VPC ID, VPC CIDR, public and private subnet IDs, and the private
  route table ID so other stacks can reference this network.

    Type: String
    Default: staging
    AllowedValues:
      - staging
      - production
    Description: The environment this network serves. Determines the VPC and subnet CIDR ranges and the DHCP domain name.
  CreateNatGateway:
    Type: String
    Default: 'Yes'
    AllowedValues:
      - 'Yes'
      - 'No'
    Description: Whether to deploy a NAT gateway with its own Elastic IP for the private subnets. Choose No if a bastion host performs NAT for the private subnets.

Metadata:
  AWS::CloudFormation::Interface:
    ParameterGroups:
      - Label:
          default: Environment
        Parameters:
          - EnvironmentType
      - Label:
          default: Networking Options
        Parameters:
          - CreateNatGateway
    ParameterLabels:
      EnvironmentType:
        default: Environment Type
      CreateNatGateway:
        default: Create NAT Gateway

Mappings:
  EnvironmentConfig:
    staging:
      VpcCidr: '10.20.0.0/16'
      PublicSubnet1ACidr: '10.20.0.0/20'
      PublicSubnet1BCidr: '10.20.16.0/20'
      PublicSubnet2ACidr: '10.20.32.0/20'
      PrivateSubnet1ACidr: '10.20.48.0/20'
      PrivateSubnet1BCidr: '10.20.64.0/20'
      DomainName: 'staging.example.internal'
    production:
      VpcCidr: '10.30.0.0/16'
      PublicSubnet1ACidr: '10.30.0.0/20'
      PublicSubnet1BCidr: '10.30.16.0/20'
      PublicSubnet2ACidr: '10.30.32.0/20'
      PrivateSubnet1ACidr: '10.30.48.0/20'
      PrivateSubnet1BCidr: '10.30.64.0/20'
      DomainName: 'prod.example.internal'

Conditions:
  CreateNatGatewayCondition: !Equals [!Ref CreateNatGateway, 'Yes']

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >-
  Fully self-contained serverless Movies API. Python 3.12 Lambda functions for
  create, read, update, and delete operations against a pay-per-request
  DynamoDB table keyed on the title attribute, exposed through a regional
  API Gateway REST API with CORS preflight MOCK integrations, pre-created
  CloudWatch log groups with 1-day retention, and a shared Lambda execution
  role granting DynamoDB CRUD access.

Metadata:
  AWS::CloudFormation::Interface:
    ParameterGroups:
      - Label:
          default: Deployment Configuration
        Parameters:
          - Environment
    ParameterLabels:
      Environment:
        default: Environment Name

Parameters:
  Environment:
    Type: String
    Default: dev
    Description: Environment name used as the API Gateway stage name.
    AllowedValues:
      - dev
      - test
      - staging
      - prod

Resources:
  MoviesTable:
    Type: AWS::DynamoDB::Table
    Properties:
      TableName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-movies'
      AttributeDefinitions:
        - AttributeName: title
          AttributeType: S
      KeySchema:
        - AttributeName: title
          KeyType: HASH
      BillingMode: PAY_PER_REQUEST
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment
        - Key: Application
          Value: MoviesApi

  MoviesLambdaExecutionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      Description: Shared execution role for the Movies API Lambda functions with DynamoDB CRUD access.
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSLambdaBasicExecutionRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: MoviesTableCrudAccess
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - dynamodb:BatchGetItem
                  - dynamodb:BatchWriteItem
                  - dynamodb:ConditionCheckItem
                  - dynamodb:DeleteItem
                  - dynamodb:DescribeTable
                  - dynamodb:GetItem
                  - dynamodb:PutItem
                  - dynamodb:Query
                  - dynamodb:Scan
                  - dynamodb:UpdateItem
                Resource: !GetAtt MoviesTable.Arn
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment
        - Key: Application
          Value: MoviesApi

  CreateMovieLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Sub '/aws/lambda/${AWS::StackName}-create-movie'
      RetentionInDays: 1

  ReadMovieLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Sub '/aws/lambda/${AWS::StackName}-read-movie'
      RetentionInDays: 1

  UpdateMovieLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Sub '/aws/lambda/${AWS::StackName}-update-movie'
      RetentionInDays: 1

  DeleteMovieLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Sub '/aws/lambda/${AWS::StackName}-delete-movie'
      RetentionInDays: 1

  CreateMovieFunction:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    DependsOn:
      - CreateMovieLogGroup
    Properties:
      FunctionName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-create-movie'
      Description: Creates a movie item in the Movies DynamoDB table.
      Runtime: python3.12
      Handler: index.handler
      MemorySize: 128
      Timeout: 30
      Role: !GetAtt MoviesLambdaExecutionRole.Arn
      Environment:
        Variables:
          TABLE_NAME: !Ref MoviesTable
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment
        - Key: Application
          Value: MoviesApi
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import json
          import os
          import boto3

          table = boto3.resource('dynamodb').Table(os.environ['TABLE_NAME'])
          cors_headers = {
              'Access-Control-Allow-Origin': '*',
              'Content-Type': 'application/json'
          }

          def handler(event, context):
              try:
                  body = json.loads(event.get('body') or '{}')
                  title = body.get('title')
                  if not title:
                      return {'statusCode': 400, 'headers': cors_headers, 'body': json.dumps({'message': 'title is required'})}
                  item = {'title': title}
                  for key, value in body.items():
                      if key != 'title' and isinstance(value, (str, int, float, bool)):
                          item[key] = value
                  table.put_item(Item=item)
                  return {'statusCode': 201, 'headers': cors_headers, 'body': json.dumps(item, default=str)}
              except Exception as error:
                  return {'statusCode': 500, 'headers': cors_headers, 'body': json.dumps({'message': str(error)})}

  ReadMovieFunction:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    DependsOn:
      - ReadMovieLogGroup
    Properties:
      FunctionName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-read-movie'
      Description: Reads a movie item from the Movies DynamoDB table by title.
      Runtime: python3.12
      Handler: index.handler
      MemorySize: 128
      Timeout: 30
      Role: !GetAtt MoviesLambdaExecutionRole.Arn
      Environment:
        Variables:
          TABLE_NAME: !Ref MoviesTable
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment
        - Key: Application
          Value: MoviesApi
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import json
          import os
          import urllib.parse
          import boto3

          table = boto3.resource('dynamodb').Table(os.environ['TABLE_NAME'])
          cors_headers = {
              'Access-Control-Allow-Origin': '*',
              'Content-Type': 'application/json'
          }

          def handler(event, context):
              try:
                  path_params = event.get('pathParameters') or {}
                  title = path_params.get('title')
                  if not title:
                      return {'statusCode': 400, 'headers': cors_headers, 'body': json.dumps({'message': 'title path parameter is required'})}
                  response = table.get_item(Key={'title': urllib.parse.unquote(title)})
                  item = response.get('Item')
                  if not item:
                      return {'statusCode': 404, 'headers': cors_headers, 'body': json.dumps({'message': 'Movie not found'})}
                  return {'statusCode': 200, 'headers': cors_headers, 'body': json.dumps(item, default=str)}
              except Exception as error:
                  return {'statusCode': 500, 'headers': cors_headers, 'body': json.dumps({'message': str(error)})}

  UpdateMovieFunction:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    DependsOn:
      - UpdateMovieLogGroup
    Properties:
      FunctionName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-update-movie'
      Description: Updates a movie item in the Movies DynamoDB table.
      Runtime: python3.12
      Handler: index.handler
      MemorySize: 128
      Timeout: 30
      Role: !GetAtt MoviesLambdaExecutionRole.Arn
      Environment:
        Variables:
          TABLE_NAME: !Ref MoviesTable
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment
        - Key: Application
          Value: MoviesApi
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import json
          import os
          import boto3

          table = boto3.resource('dynamodb').Table(os.environ['TABLE_NAME'])
          cors_headers = {
              'Access-Control-Allow-Origin': '*',
              'Content-Type': 'application/json'
          }

          def handler(event, context):
              try:
                  body = json.loads(event.get('body') or '{}')
                  title = body.get('title')
                  if not title:
                      return {'statusCode': 400, 'headers': cors_headers, 'body': json.dumps({'message': 'title is required'})}
                  attributes = {key: value for key, value in body.items() if key != 'title'}
                  if not attributes:
                      return {'statusCode': 400, 'headers': cors_headers, 'body': json.dumps({'message': 'at least one attribute to update is required'})}
                  names = {'#' + key: key for key in attributes}
                  values = {':' + key: value for key, value in attributes.items()}
                  update_expression = 'SET ' + ', '.join('#' + key + ' = :' + key for key in attributes)
                  response = table.update_item(
                      Key={'title': title},
                      UpdateExpression=update_expression,
                      ExpressionAttributeNames=names,
                      ExpressionAttributeValues=values,
                      ReturnValues='ALL_NEW'
                  )
                  return {'statusCode': 200, 'headers': cors_headers, 'body': json.dumps(response.get('Attributes'), default=str)}
              except Exception as error:
                  return {'statusCode': 500, 'headers': cors_headers, 'body': json.dumps({'message': str(error)})}

  DeleteMovieFunction:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    DependsOn:
      - DeleteMovieLogGroup
    Properties:
      FunctionName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-delete-movie'
      Description: Deletes a movie item from the Movies DynamoDB table.
      Runtime: python3.12
      Handler: index.handler
      MemorySize: 128
      Timeout: 30
      Role: !GetAtt MoviesLambdaExecutionRole.Arn
      Environment:
        Variables:
          TABLE_NAME: !Ref MoviesTable
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment
        - Key: Application
          Value: MoviesApi
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import json
          import os
          import boto3

          table = boto3.resource('dynamodb').Table(os.environ['TABLE_NAME'])
          cors_headers = {
              'Access-Control-Allow-Origin': '*',
              'Content-Type': 'application/json'
          }

          def handler(event, context):
              try:
                  title = None
                  body = event.get('body')
                  if body:
                      title = json.loads(body).get('title')
                  if not title:
                      query_params = event.get('queryStringParameters') or {}
                      title = query_params.get('title')
                  if not title:
                      return {'statusCode': 400, 'headers': cors_headers, 'body': json.dumps({'message': 'title is required in the request body or as a query string parameter'})}
                  table.delete_item(Key={'title': title}, ConditionExpression='attribute_exists(title)')
                  return {'statusCode': 200, 'headers': cors_headers, 'body': json.dumps({'message': 'Movie deleted', 'title': title})}
              except table.meta.client.exceptions.ConditionalCheckFailedException:
                  return {'statusCode': 404, 'headers': cors_headers, 'body': json.dumps({'message': 'Movie not found'})}
              except Exception as error:
                  return {'statusCode': 500, 'headers': cors_headers, 'body': json.dumps({'message': str(error)})}

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: "2010-09-09"
Description: >-
  Provisions an Amazon SageMaker Studio user profile for an MLOps engineer persona
  with a persona-scoped IAM execution role and a per-user SageMaker execution role.
  If no existing SageMaker Studio domain ID is provided, the template creates a
  self-contained VPC with two subnets and a public-internet-access SageMaker Studio
  domain that uses the created execution role as its default user setting, and the
  new user profile is attached to that domain.

Metadata:
  AWS::CloudFormation::Interface:
    ParameterGroups:
      - Label:
          default: Existing SageMaker Studio Domain (optional)
        Parameters:
          - ExistingDomainId
          - ExistingDomainSecurityGroupIds
          - ExistingDomainSubnetIds
      - Label:
          default: New Domain Network Configuration (used only when no existing domain is provided)
        Parameters:
          - VpcCidr
          - SubnetAz1Cidr
          - SubnetAz2Cidr
      - Label:
          default: MLOps Engineer User Profile
        Parameters:
          - UserProfileName

Parameters:
  ExistingDomainId:
    Type: String
    Default: ""
    Description: >-
      ID of an existing SageMaker Studio domain to attach the MLOps engineer user
      profile to. Leave empty to create a new self-contained VPC and a
      public-internet-access SageMaker Studio domain.
  ExistingDomainSecurityGroupIds:
    Type: String
    Default: ""
    Description: >-
      Comma-delimited security group IDs associated with the existing domain, applied
      to the user profile (optional). Example: sg-0123456789abcdef0,sg-0123456789abcdef1
  ExistingDomainSubnetIds:
    Type: String
    Default: ""
    Description: >-
      Comma-delimited subnet IDs associated with the existing domain (optional).
      Example: subnet-0123456789abcdef0,subnet-0123456789abcdef1
  UserProfileName:
    Type: String
    Default: mlops-engineer
    AllowedPattern: '^[a-zA-Z0-9](-*[a-zA-Z0-9]){0,62}$'
    Description: Name of the SageMaker Studio user profile for the MLOps engineer persona.
  VpcCidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.0.0/16
    AllowedPattern: '^(([0-9]|[1-9][0-9]|1[0-9]{2}|2[0-4][0-9]|25[0-5])\.){3}([0-9]|[1-9][0-9]|1[0-9]{2}|2[0-4][0-9]|25[0-5])(\/([0-9]|[12][0-9]|3[0-2]))$'
    Description: CIDR block for the VPC created when no existing domain ID is provided.
  SubnetAz1Cidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.1.0/24
    AllowedPattern: '^(([0-9]|[1-9][0-9]|1[0-9]{2}|2[0-4][0-9]|25[0-5])\.){3}([0-9]|[1-9][0-9]|1[0-9]{2}|2[0-4][0-9]|25[0-5])(\/([0-9]|[12][0-9]|3[0-2]))$'
    Description: CIDR block for the first subnet. Must reside within the VPC CIDR block.
  SubnetAz2Cidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.2.0/24
    AllowedPattern: '^(([0-9]|[1-9][0-9]|1[0-9]{2}|2[0-4][0-9]|25[0-5])\.){3}([0-9]|[1-9][0-9]|1[0-9]{2}|2[0-4][0-9]|25[0-5])(\/([0-9]|[12][0-9]|3[0-2]))$'
    Description: CIDR block for the second subnet. Must reside within the VPC CIDR block.

Conditions:
  CreateDomainAndVpc: !Equals [!Ref ExistingDomainId, ""]
  UseExistingDomain: !Not [!Condition CreateDomainAndVpc]
  HasSecurityGroupIds: !Not [!Equals [!Ref ExistingDomainSecurityGroupIds, ""]]
  AttachExistingSecurityGroups: !And
    - !Condition UseExistingDomain
    - !Condition HasSecurityGroupIds
  HasSubnetIds: !Not [!Equals [!Ref ExistingDomainSubnetIds, ""]]

Resources:
  StudioVpc:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPC
    Condition: CreateDomainAndVpc
    Properties:
      CidrBlock: !Ref VpcCidr
      EnableDnsHostnames: true
      EnableDnsSupport: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-studio-vpc"

  StudioSubnetAz1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Condition: CreateDomainAndVpc
    Properties:
      AvailabilityZone: !Select
        - 0
        - !GetAZs ""
      CidrBlock: !Ref SubnetAz1Cidr
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      VpcId: !Ref StudioVpc
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-studio-subnet-az1"

  StudioSubnetAz2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Condition: CreateDomainAndVpc
    Properties:
      AvailabilityZone: !Select
        - 1
        - !GetAZs ""
      CidrBlock: !Ref SubnetAz2Cidr
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      VpcId: !Ref StudioVpc
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-studio-subnet-az2"

                  - sagemaker:CreateModelBiasJobDefinition
                  - sagemaker:DescribeModelBiasJobDefinition

                  - sagemaker:ListModelBiasJobDefinitions
                  - sagemaker:CreateModelExplainabilityJobDefinition
                  - sagemaker:DescribeModelExplainabilityJobDefinition
                  - sagemaker:DeleteModelExplainabilityJobDefinition
                  - sagemaker:ListModelExplainabilityJobDefinitions

              - Sid: SageMakerModelsAndModelRegistry

                  - sagemaker:ListModels
                  - sagemaker:ListModelMetadata
                  - sagemaker:CreateModelPackageGroup

                  - sagemaker:DescribeModelPackageGroup
                  - sagemaker:ListModelPackageGroups
                  - sagemaker:CreateModelPackage

                  - sagemaker:DescribeModelPackage

                  - sagemaker:Search

                  - sagemaker:DescribeEndpointConfig
                  - sagemaker:ListEndpoints
                  - sagemaker:ListEndpointConfigs
                  - sagemaker:InvokeEndpoint
                  - sagemaker:InvokeEndpointAsync

              - Sid: SageMakerStudioOwnedAppsAndSpaces

                  - sagemaker:CreateApp
                  - sagemaker:DeleteApp
                  - sagemaker:CreateSpace
                  - sagemaker:DeleteSpace
                  - sagemaker:UpdateSpace

                Effect: Allow

  SageMakerUserExecutionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Sid: SageMakerServiceAssumeRole
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: sagemaker.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Description: >-
        Per-user SageMaker execution role that the MLOps engineer persona role can
        pass to SageMaker training, processing, tuning, and monitoring jobs.
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: SageMakerUserExecutionPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: "2012-10-17"
            Statement:
              - Sid: SageMakerArtifactsBucketReadWrite
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - s3:GetObject
                  - s3:GetObjectVersion
                  - s3:PutObject
                  - s3:DeleteObject
                  - s3:AbortMultipartUpload

              - Sid: SageMakerS3ListAllBuckets

                Action:
                  - s3:ListAllMyBuckets

                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                  - logs:DescribeLogStreams

                  - ec2:DescribeSubnets
                  - ec2:DescribeVpcs

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'

Description: >-
  Sets up CloudWatch monitoring for cross-language database encryption SDK
  performance benchmarks. Creates a CloudWatch Logs log group with a 30 day
  retention period that receives structured JSON benchmark result events, and
  attaches a comprehensive set of CloudWatch Logs metric filters covering
  Java, .NET, Python, Go, and Rust. For each language, filters extract the
  memory efficiency ratio and peak memory usage from memory test results,
  extract the p50, p95, and p99 latency from throughput test results at a
  specific data size, and extract the p50, p95, and p99 latency from
  concurrency test results, publishing every metric into a language-specific
  CloudWatch namespace with a dimension identifying the language.

# Expected structured JSON benchmark event contract (one event per log record):
# {
#   "benchmark_type": "memory" | "throughput" | "concurrency",
#   "language": "Java" | ".NET" | "Python" | "Go" | "Rust",
#   "data_size": <number>,                # throughput events only
#   "memory_efficiency_ratio": <number>,  # memory events only
#   "peak_memory_usage": <number>,        # memory events only
#   "p50_latency": <number>,              # throughput and concurrency events
#   "p95_latency": <number>,
#   "p99_latency": <number>
# }

Metadata:
  AWS::CloudFormation::Interface:
    ParameterGroups:
      - Label:
          default: Benchmark log group
        Parameters:
          - LogGroupName
      - Label:
          default: Benchmark metric filters
        Parameters:
          - MetricNamespacePrefix
          - ThroughputDataSize
    ParameterLabels:
      LogGroupName:
        default: Log group name
      MetricNamespacePrefix:
        default: Metric namespace prefix
      ThroughputDataSize:
        default: Throughput test data size (bytes)

Parameters:
  LogGroupName:
    Type: String
    Default: /benchmarks/database-encryption-sdk
    Description: >-
      Name of the CloudWatch Logs log group that receives the structured JSON
      benchmark result events.
    AllowedPattern: '[\.\-_/#A-Za-z0-9]+'
    ConstraintDescription: >-
      Log group name can only contain letters, numbers, hyphens, underscores,
      periods, forward slashes, and hash signs.

  MetricNamespacePrefix:
    Type: String
    Default: DatabaseEncryptionSDKBenchmarks
    Description: >-
      Prefix used to build the per-language CloudWatch metric namespaces. Each
      language publishes its benchmark metrics to its own namespace named
      <prefix>/<language>.
    AllowedPattern: '[A-Za-z0-9_\-\.]+'
    ConstraintDescription: >-
      Metric namespace prefix can only contain letters, numbers, hyphens,
      underscores, and periods.

  ThroughputDataSize:
    Type: Number
    Default: 1048576
    Description: >-
      Data size in bytes that throughput benchmark result events must report in
      the data_size field to be matched by the throughput latency metric

    MinValue: 1
