      FilterPattern: '{ $.benchmark_type = "concurrency" && $.language = "Rust" }'
      LogGroupName: !Ref BenchmarkLogGroup
      MetricTransformations:
        - MetricName: ConcurrencyP99Latency
          MetricNamespace: !Sub '${MetricNamespacePrefix}/Rust'
          MetricValue: '$.p99_latency'
          Dimensions:
            - Key: Language
              Value: '$.language'

Outputs:
  BenchmarkLogGroupName:
    Description: Name of the CloudWatch Logs log group that receives the structured JSON benchmark result events.
    Value: !Ref BenchmarkLogGroup
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-BenchmarkLogGroupName'

  BenchmarkMetricNamespaces:
    Description: Comma-delimited list of the per-language CloudWatch metric namespaces created for the benchmark metrics.
    Value: !Join
      - ','
      - - !Sub '${MetricNamespacePrefix}/Java'
        - !Sub '${MetricNamespacePrefix}/.NET'
        - !Sub '${MetricNamespacePrefix}/Python'
        - !Sub '${MetricNamespacePrefix}/Go'
        - !Sub '${MetricNamespacePrefix}/Rust'

  JavaMetricNamespace:
    Description: CloudWatch metric namespace for the Java benchmark metrics.
    Value: !Sub '${MetricNamespacePrefix}/Java'

  DotNetMetricNamespace:
    Description: CloudWatch metric namespace for the .NET benchmark metrics.
    Value: !Sub '${MetricNamespacePrefix}/.NET'

  PythonMetricNamespace:
    Description: CloudWatch metric namespace for the Python benchmark metrics.
    Value: !Sub '${MetricNamespacePrefix}/Python'

  GoMetricNamespace:
    Description: CloudWatch metric namespace for the Go benchmark metrics.
    Value: !Sub '${MetricNamespacePrefix}/Go'

  RustMetricNamespace:
    Description: CloudWatch metric namespace for the Rust benchmark metrics.
    Value: !Sub '${MetricNamespacePrefix}/Rust'

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'

Description: >-
  Data Master project - comprehensive self-contained set of IAM roles for the end-to-end
  data pipeline (DMS to Kinesis, EventBridge Pipes to Firehose, Lambda processing and
  routing, Glue crawlers and ETL jobs, Lake Formation data lake access, Step Functions
  orchestration, ECS Fargate tasks, EMR Serverless jobs and Amazon Managed Grafana
  monitoring). Roles requiring KMS encryption or decryption permissions reference the
  existing KMS key supplied through the KmsKeyArn parameter (no KMS key is created by
  this template). The DMS VPC role restricts its sts:AssumeRole policy statement to
  resources in the TargetAccountId parameter. Cross-account account ARNs are never used
  as trust policy principals, so the template deploys cleanly even with placeholder
  defaults. Every role is tagged Project=DataMaster and Component=Roles, and its ARN
  is exported using a dm- prefix and a -role-arn suffix.

Metadata:
  AWS::CloudFormation::Interface:
    ParameterGroups:
      - Label:
          default: Raw data encryption
        Parameters:
          - KmsKeyArn
      - Label:
          default: Cross-account access
        Parameters:
          - TargetAccountId
    ParameterLabels:
      KmsKeyArn:
        default: Existing KMS key ARN
      TargetAccountId:
        default: Target AWS account ID

Parameters:
  KmsKeyArn:
    Type: String
    Default: 'arn:aws:kms:us-east-1:123456789012:key/1234abcd-12ab-34cd-56ef-1234567890ab'
    Description: ARN of the existing KMS key used for raw data encryption. Referenced by all roles that require KMS encryption or decryption permissions. The default is a placeholder and should be overridden with the real key ARN.
    AllowedPattern: '^arn:(aws|aws-cn|aws-us-gov):kms:[a-z0-9-]+:[0-9]{12}:(key|alias)/.+$'
    ConstraintDescription: 'KmsKeyArn must be a valid KMS key or alias ARN (e.g. arn:aws:kms:us-east-1:123456789012:key/1234abcd-12ab-34cd-56ef-1234567890ab)'
  TargetAccountId:
    Type: String
    Default: '123456789012'
    Description: Target AWS account ID used to restrict the sts:AssumeRole policy statement of the DMS VPC role. The default is a placeholder and should be overridden with the real account ID.
    AllowedPattern: '^[0-9]{12}$'
    ConstraintDescription: 'TargetAccountId must be a 12-digit AWS account ID'
    MinLength: 12
    MaxLength: 12

Resources:

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------
  # DMS roles
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------

  DMSKinesisTargetRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: dm-dms-kinesis-target-role
      Description: Allows AWS DMS to write replicated raw data to Amazon Kinesis Data Streams.
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: dms.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: DMSKinesisWrite
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - kinesis:PutRecord
                  - kinesis:PutRecords
                  - kinesis:DescribeStream
                  - kinesis:DescribeStreamSummary
                  - kinesis:ListStreams
                  - kinesis:ListShards
                Resource:
                  - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:kinesis:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:stream/*'
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - kms:GenerateDataKey
                  - kms:Decrypt
                Resource: !Ref KmsKeyArn
      Tags:
        - Key: Project
          Value: DataMaster
        - Key: Component
          Value: Roles

  DMSVPCRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: dms-vpc-role
      Description: AWS DMS service role used to manage network interfaces. Its sts:AssumeRole policy statement is restricted to resources in the TargetAccountId parameter account.
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: dms.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: DMSVPCManagement
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ec2:CreateNetworkInterface
                  - ec2:DeleteNetworkInterface
                  - ec2:ModifyNetworkInterfaceAttribute
                  - ec2:DescribeAvailabilityZones
                  - ec2:DescribeInternetGateways
                  - ec2:DescribeNetworkInterfaces
                  - ec2:DescribeSecurityGroups
                  - ec2:DescribeSubnets
                  - ec2:DescribeVpcs
                Resource: '*'
        - PolicyName: DMSTargetAccountAssumeRole
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: AssumeRoleInTargetAccount
                Effect: Allow
                Action: sts:AssumeRole
                Resource:
                  - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${TargetAccountId}:root'
                  - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${TargetAccountId}:role/*'
      Tags:
        - Key: Project
          Value: DataMaster
        - Key: Component
          Value: Roles

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------
  # EventBridge Pipes role
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------

  EventBridgePipesRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: dm-eventbridge-pipes-role
      Description: Allows EventBridge Pipes to read the raw Kinesis stream and forward records to the Firehose delivery stream, with optional Lambda enrichment.
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: pipes.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: PipesKinesisToFirehose
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - kinesis:DescribeStream
                  - kinesis:DescribeStreamSummary
                  - kinesis:GetRecords
                  - kinesis:GetShardIterator
                  - kinesis:ListShards
                  - kinesis:ListStreams
                Resource:
                  - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:kinesis:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:stream/*'
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - firehose:PutRecord
                  - firehose:PutRecordBatch
                Resource:
                  - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:firehose:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:deliverystream/*'
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - lambda:InvokeFunction
                Resource:
                  - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:lambda:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:function:*'
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - kms:Decrypt
                Resource: !Ref KmsKeyArn
      Tags:
        - Key: Project
          Value: DataMaster
        - Key: Component
          Value: Roles

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Firehose role
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------

  FirehoseAccessRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: dm-firehose-access-role
      Description: Allows Kinesis Data Firehose to deliver raw data to Amazon S3 encrypted with the provided KMS key.
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: firehose.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: FirehoseS3KmsDelivery
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - s3:AbortMultipartUpload
                  - s3:GetBucketLocation
                  - s3:GetObject
                  - s3:ListBucket
                  - s3:ListBucketMultipartUploads
                  - s3:ListMultipartUploadParts
                  - s3:PutObject
                  - s3:PutObjectAcl
                Resource:
                  - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:s3:::*'
                  - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:s3:::*/*'
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - kms:Decrypt
                  - kms:Encrypt
                  - kms:GenerateDataKey
                  - kms:GenerateDataKeyWithoutPlaintext
                  - kms:DescribeKey
                Resource: !Ref KmsKeyArn
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogGroup
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                Resource: '*'
      Tags:
        - Key: Project
          Value: DataMaster
        - Key: Component
          Value: Roles

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Lambda roles
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------

  DataProcessingLambdaRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: dm-data-processing-lambda-role
      Description: Execution role for Lambda functions that process, transform and route pipeline data.
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: DataProcessingLambdaPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogGroup
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                Resource: '*'
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - s3:GetObject
                  - s3:GetObjectVersion
                  - s3:PutObject
                  - s3:DeleteObject
                  - s3:ListBucket
                  - s3:GetBucketLocation
                Resource:
                  - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:s3:::*'
                  - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:s3:::*/*'
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - kinesis:DescribeStream
                  - kinesis:DescribeStreamSummary
                  - kinesis:GetRecords
                  - kinesis:GetShardIterator
                  - kinesis:ListShards
                Resource:
                  - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:kinesis:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:stream/*'
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - firehose:PutRecord
                  - firehose:PutRecordBatch
                Resource:
                  - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:firehose:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:deliverystream/*'
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - sns:Publish
                Resource:
                  - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:sns:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:*'
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - sqs:SendMessage
                  - sqs:GetQueueAttributes
                  - sqs:GetQueueUrl
                Resource:
                  - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:sqs:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:*'
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - kms:Decrypt
                  - kms:Encrypt
                  - kms:GenerateDataKey
                  - kms:DescribeKey
                Resource: !Ref KmsKeyArn
      Tags:
        - Key: Project
          Value: DataMaster
        - Key: Component
          Value: Roles

  ProcessingControllerRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: dm-processing-controller-role
      Description: Execution role for the processing controller Lambda function. Encrypts and decrypts raw data with the provided KMS key and drives pipeline orchestration.
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: ProcessingControllerPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogGroup
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                Resource: '*'
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - kms:Decrypt
                  - kms:Encrypt
                  - kms:GenerateDataKey
                  - kms:GenerateDataKeyWithoutPlaintext
                  - kms:DescribeKey
                Resource: !Ref KmsKeyArn
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - states:StartExecution
                Resource:
                  - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:states:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:stateMachine:*'
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - lambda:InvokeFunction
                Resource:
                  - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:lambda:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:function:*'
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - glue:StartJobRun
                  - glue:GetJobRun
                Resource: '*'
      Tags:
        - Key: Project
          Value: DataMaster
        - Key: Component
          Value: Roles

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Glue roles
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------

  GlueCrawlerRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: dm-glue-crawler-role
      Description: Service role for Glue crawlers cataloging raw and curated data stored in Amazon S3.
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: glue.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: GlueCrawlerPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - s3:GetObject
                  - s3:PutObject
                  - s3:DeleteObject
                Resource:
                  - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:s3:::*/*'
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - s3:ListBucket
                  - s3:GetBucketLocation
                Resource:
                  - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:s3:::*'
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - kms:Decrypt
                  - kms:DescribeKey
                Resource: !Ref KmsKeyArn
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogGroup
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                Resource: '*'
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - cloudwatch:PutMetricData
                Resource: '*'
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - glue:GetDatabase
                  - glue:GetDatabases
                  - glue:GetTable
                  - glue:GetTables
                  - glue:GetPartition
                  - glue:GetPartitions
                  - glue:GetUserDefinedFunction
                  - glue:GetUserDefinedFunctions
                  - glue:CreateTable
                  - glue:UpdateTable
                  - glue:CreatePartition
                  - glue:UpdatePartition
                  - glue:BatchCreatePartition
                Resource: '*'
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - lakeformation:GetDataAccess
                Resource: '*'
      Tags:
        - Key: Project
          Value: DataMaster
        - Key: Component
          Value: Roles

  GlueETLRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: dm-glue-etl-role
      Description: Service role for Glue ETL jobs reading raw data and writing curated datasets to the data lake.
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: glue.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: GlueEtlJobPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - s3:GetObject
                  - s3:GetObjectVersion
                  - s3:PutObject
                  - s3:DeleteObject
                Resource:
                  - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:s3:::*/*'
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - s3:ListBucket
                  - s3:GetBucketLocation
                Resource:
                  - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:s3:::*'
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - kms:Decrypt
                  - kms:Encrypt
                  - kms:GenerateDataKey
                  - kms:DescribeKey
                Resource: !Ref KmsKeyArn
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogGroup
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                Resource: '*'
              - Effect: Allow

                Resource: '*'
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - glue:GetDatabase
                  - glue:GetDatabases
                  - glue:CreateDatabase
                  - glue:UpdateDatabase
                  - glue:GetTable
                  - glue:GetTables
                  - glue:CreateTable
                  - glue:UpdateTable
                  - glue:GetPartition
                  - glue:GetPartitions
                  - glue:CreatePartition
                  - glue:UpdatePartition
                  - glue:BatchCreatePartition
                  - glue:GetUserDefinedFunction
                  - glue:GetUserDefinedFunctions
                  - glue:GetJobRun
                  - glue:GetJobRuns
                Resource: '*'
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - lakeformation:GetDataAccess
                Resource: '*'
      Tags:
        - Key: Project
          Value: DataMaster
        - Key: Component
          Value: Roles

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Lake Formation role
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------

  LakeFormationDataLakeRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: dm-lake-formation-role
      Description: Data lake access role registered with Lake Formation to govern access to S3 data locations encrypted with the provided KMS key.
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service:
                - lakeformation.amazonaws.com
                - glue.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: LakeFormationDataLakeAccess
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'

                  - s3:DeleteObject

                  - s3:GetBucketLocation

              - Effect: Allow

            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:

          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:

  ECSTaskExecutionRole:

        - Key: Component

  WorkerTaskRole:

        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow

            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:

          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'

                  - s3:PutObject

              - Effect: Allow

      Policies:
        - PolicyName: EMRServerlessJobPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:

                  - s3:GetObjectVersion

                  - s3:DeleteObject
                Resource:
                  - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:s3:::*/*'
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:

                  - s3:GetBucketLocation
                Resource:
                  - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:s3:::*'
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:

                  - glue:GetDatabases
                  - glue:GetTable

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Amazon Managed Grafana role
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------

  GrafanaMonitoringRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: dm-grafana-role
      Description: Service role for the Amazon Managed Grafana workspace to query CloudWatch metrics and logs for pipeline monitoring.
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: grafana.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: GrafanaMonitoringPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - cloudwatch:DescribeAlarms
                  - cloudwatch:GetMetricData
                  - cloudwatch:GetMetricStatistics
                  - cloudwatch:ListMetrics
                Resource: '*'
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:DescribeLogGroups
                  - logs:DescribeLogStreams
                  - logs:GetLogEvents
                  - logs:FilterLogEvents
                  - logs:StartQuery
                  - logs:StopQuery
                  - logs:GetQueryResults
                  - logs:GetLogGroupFields
                  - logs:GetLogRecord

  DataProcessingLambdaRoleArn:

  ProcessingControllerRoleArn:

    Export:

  GlueCrawlerRoleArn:

  GlueETLRoleArn:

  LakeFormationDataLakeRoleArn:

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >-
  Creates CloudWatch metric alarms and three composite alarms (API Gateway Health,
  Lambda Health, and RDS Health) that monitor the health of a cross-region failover
  application built on the existing Remittance API Gateway API, the existing
  GetRemittances and CreateRemittance Lambda functions, and the existing
  dbcluster1-instance1 RDS instance. Each composite alarm aggregates its underlying
  metric alarms with an OR-based alarm rule so that any single triggered condition
  trips the composite alarm.

Parameters:
  ApiName:
    Type: String
    Description: Name of the existing Remittance API Gateway REST API.
    Default: Remittance
  GetRemittancesFunctionName:
    Type: String
    Description: Name of the existing GetRemittances Lambda function.
    Default: GetRemittances
  CreateRemittanceFunctionName:
    Type: String
    Description: Name of the existing CreateRemittance Lambda function.
    Default: CreateRemittance
  DBInstanceIdentifier:
    Type: String
    Description: Identifier of the existing RDS DB instance to monitor.
    Default: dbcluster1-instance1

Resources:
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # API Gateway metric alarms
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  ApiGateway4xxErrorAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-ApiGateway-4XXErrors'
      AlarmDescription: Average 4XXError count for the Remittance API Gateway API exceeded 0 over a 300 second period.
      ActionsEnabled: true
      Namespace: AWS/ApiGateway
      MetricName: 4XXError
      Dimensions:
        - Name: ApiName
          Value: !Ref ApiName
      Statistic: Average
      Period: 300
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      DatapointsToAlarm: 1
      Threshold: 0
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanThreshold
      TreatMissingData: notBreaching

  ApiGateway5xxErrorAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-ApiGateway-5XXErrors'
      AlarmDescription: Average 5XXError count for the Remittance API Gateway API exceeded 1 over a 60 second period.
      ActionsEnabled: true
      Namespace: AWS/ApiGateway
      MetricName: 5XXError
      Dimensions:
        - Name: ApiName
          Value: !Ref ApiName
      Statistic: Average
      Period: 60
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      DatapointsToAlarm: 1
      Threshold: 1
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanThreshold
      TreatMissingData: notBreaching

  ApiGatewayLatencyAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-ApiGateway-Latency'
      AlarmDescription: Average latency for the Remittance API Gateway API reached 10000 milliseconds over a 300 second period.
      ActionsEnabled: true
      Namespace: AWS/ApiGateway
      MetricName: Latency
      Dimensions:
        - Name: ApiName
          Value: !Ref ApiName
      Statistic: Average
      Period: 300
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      DatapointsToAlarm: 1
      Threshold: 10000
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanOrEqualToThreshold
      TreatMissingData: notBreaching

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Lambda metric alarms
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  GetRemittancesErrorsAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-GetRemittances-Errors'
      AlarmDescription: Sum of Errors for the GetRemittances Lambda function exceeded 0 over a 60 second period.
      ActionsEnabled: true
      Namespace: AWS/Lambda
      MetricName: Errors
      Dimensions:
        - Name: FunctionName
          Value: !Ref GetRemittancesFunctionName
      Statistic: Sum
      Period: 60
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      DatapointsToAlarm: 1
      Threshold: 0
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanThreshold
      TreatMissingData: notBreaching

  CreateRemittanceErrorsAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-CreateRemittance-Errors'
      AlarmDescription: Sum of Errors for the CreateRemittance Lambda function exceeded 0 over a 60 second period.
      ActionsEnabled: true
      Namespace: AWS/Lambda
      MetricName: Errors
      Dimensions:
        - Name: FunctionName
          Value: !Ref CreateRemittanceFunctionName
      Statistic: Sum
      Period: 60
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      DatapointsToAlarm: 1
      Threshold: 0
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanThreshold
      TreatMissingData: notBreaching

  GetRemittancesInvocationsAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-GetRemittances-Invocations'
      AlarmDescription: Sum of Invocations for the GetRemittances Lambda function exceeded 2 over a 60 second period.
      ActionsEnabled: true
      Namespace: AWS/Lambda
      MetricName: Invocations
      Dimensions:
        - Name: FunctionName
          Value: !Ref GetRemittancesFunctionName
      Statistic: Sum
      Period: 60
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      DatapointsToAlarm: 1
      Threshold: 2
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanThreshold
      TreatMissingData: notBreaching

  CreateRemittanceInvocationsAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-CreateRemittance-Invocations'
      AlarmDescription: Sum of Invocations for the CreateRemittance Lambda function exceeded 2 over a 60 second period.
      ActionsEnabled: true
      Namespace: AWS/Lambda
      MetricName: Invocations
      Dimensions:
        - Name: FunctionName
          Value: !Ref CreateRemittanceFunctionName
      Statistic: Sum
      Period: 60
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      DatapointsToAlarm: 1
      Threshold: 2
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanThreshold
      TreatMissingData: notBreaching

  GetRemittancesDurationAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-GetRemittances-Duration'
      AlarmDescription: Average Duration for the GetRemittances Lambda function reached 10000 milliseconds over a 900 second period.
      ActionsEnabled: true
      Namespace: AWS/Lambda
      MetricName: Duration
      Dimensions:
        - Name: FunctionName
          Value: !Ref GetRemittancesFunctionName
      Statistic: Average
      Period: 900
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      DatapointsToAlarm: 1
      Threshold: 10000
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanOrEqualToThreshold
      TreatMissingData: missing

  CreateRemittanceDurationAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-CreateRemittance-Duration'
      AlarmDescription: Average Duration for the CreateRemittance Lambda function reached 10000 milliseconds over a 900 second period.
      ActionsEnabled: true
      Namespace: AWS/Lambda
      MetricName: Duration
      Dimensions:
        - Name: FunctionName
          Value: !Ref CreateRemittanceFunctionName
      Statistic: Average
      Period: 900
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      DatapointsToAlarm: 1
      Threshold: 10000
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanOrEqualToThreshold
      TreatMissingData: missing

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # RDS metric alarms (TreatMissingData intentionally left unset so the
  # CloudWatch standard default treatment applies)
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  RdsCpuUtilizationAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-RDS-CPUUtilization'
      AlarmDescription: Average CPUUtilization for dbcluster1-instance1 reached 70 percent over a 300 second period.
      ActionsEnabled: true
      Namespace: AWS/RDS
      MetricName: CPUUtilization
      Dimensions:
        - Name: DBInstanceIdentifier
          Value: !Ref DBInstanceIdentifier
      Statistic: Average
      Period: 300
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      DatapointsToAlarm: 1
      Threshold: 70
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanOrEqualToThreshold

  RdsDatabaseConnectionsAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-RDS-DatabaseConnections'
      AlarmDescription: Average DatabaseConnections for dbcluster1-instance1 reached 100 over a 300 second period.
      ActionsEnabled: true
      Namespace: AWS/RDS
      MetricName: DatabaseConnections
      Dimensions:
        - Name: DBInstanceIdentifier
          Value: !Ref DBInstanceIdentifier
      Statistic: Average
      Period: 300
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      DatapointsToAlarm: 1
      Threshold: 100
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanOrEqualToThreshold

  RdsDeadlocksAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-RDS-Deadlocks'
      AlarmDescription: Average Deadlocks for dbcluster1-instance1 reached 10 over a 300 second period.
      ActionsEnabled: true
      Namespace: AWS/RDS
      MetricName: Deadlocks
      Dimensions:
        - Name: DBInstanceIdentifier
          Value: !Ref DBInstanceIdentifier
      Statistic: Average
      Period: 300
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      DatapointsToAlarm: 1
      Threshold: 10
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanOrEqualToThreshold

  RdsNetworkTransmitThroughputAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-RDS-NetworkTransmitThroughput'
      AlarmDescription: Average NetworkTransmitThroughput for dbcluster1-instance1 reached 10485760 bytes over a 300 second period.
      ActionsEnabled: true
      Namespace: AWS/RDS
      MetricName: NetworkTransmitThroughput
      Dimensions:
        - Name: DBInstanceIdentifier
          Value: !Ref DBInstanceIdentifier
      Statistic: Average
      Period: 300
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      DatapointsToAlarm: 1
      Threshold: 10485760
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanOrEqualToThreshold

  RdsNetworkReceiveThroughputAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-RDS-NetworkReceiveThroughput'
      AlarmDescription: Average NetworkReceiveThroughput for dbcluster1-instance1 reached 10485760 bytes over a 300 second period.
      ActionsEnabled: true
      Namespace: AWS/RDS
      MetricName: NetworkReceiveThroughput
      Dimensions:
        - Name: DBInstanceIdentifier
          Value: !Ref DBInstanceIdentifier
      Statistic: Average
      Period: 300
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      DatapointsToAlarm: 1
      Threshold: 10485760
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanOrEqualToThreshold

  RdsQueriesAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-RDS-Queries'
      AlarmDescription: Average Queries for dbcluster1-instance1 reached 100 over a 300 second period.
      ActionsEnabled: true
      Namespace: AWS/RDS
      MetricName: Queries
      Dimensions:
        - Name: DBInstanceIdentifier
          Value: !Ref DBInstanceIdentifier
      Statistic: Average
      Period: 300
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      DatapointsToAlarm: 1
      Threshold: 100
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanOrEqualToThreshold

  RdsDiskQueueDepthAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-RDS-DiskQueueDepth'
      AlarmDescription: Average DiskQueueDepth for dbcluster1-instance1 reached 50 over a 300 second period.
      ActionsEnabled: true
      Namespace: AWS/RDS
      MetricName: DiskQueueDepth
      Dimensions:
        - Name: DBInstanceIdentifier
          Value: !Ref DBInstanceIdentifier
      Statistic: Average
      Period: 300
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      DatapointsToAlarm: 1
      Threshold: 50
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanOrEqualToThreshold

  RdsReadLatencyAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-RDS-ReadLatency'
      AlarmDescription: Average ReadLatency for dbcluster1-instance1 reached 0.1 seconds over a 300 second period.
      ActionsEnabled: true
      Namespace: AWS/RDS
      MetricName: ReadLatency
      Dimensions:
        - Name: DBInstanceIdentifier
          Value: !Ref DBInstanceIdentifier
      Statistic: Average
      Period: 300
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      DatapointsToAlarm: 1
      Threshold: 0.1
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanOrEqualToThreshold

  RdsWriteLatencyAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-RDS-WriteLatency'
      AlarmDescription: Average WriteLatency for dbcluster1-instance1 reached 0.1 seconds over a 300 second period.
      ActionsEnabled: true
      Namespace: AWS/RDS
      MetricName: WriteLatency
      Dimensions:
        - Name: DBInstanceIdentifier
          Value: !Ref DBInstanceIdentifier
      Statistic: Average
      Period: 300
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      DatapointsToAlarm: 1
      Threshold: 0.1
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanOrEqualToThreshold

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Composite alarms (OR-based rules so any single breached condition trips
  # the composite; alarm names are resolved with Ref-style Sub references)
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  ApiGatewayHealthCompositeAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::CompositeAlarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: API Gateway Health
      AlarmDescription: >-
        Composite health alarm for the Remittance API Gateway API. Enters the ALARM
        state when any of the 4XX error, 5XX error, or latency metric alarms is in
        the ALARM state.
      ActionsEnabled: true
      AlarmRule: !Sub 'ALARM("${ApiGateway4xxErrorAlarm}") OR ALARM("${ApiGateway5xxErrorAlarm}") OR ALARM("${ApiGatewayLatencyAlarm}")'

  LambdaHealthCompositeAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::CompositeAlarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: Lambda Health
      AlarmDescription: >-
        Composite health alarm for the GetRemittances and CreateRemittance Lambda
        functions. Enters the ALARM state when any of the referenced error or
        duration metric alarms is in the ALARM state.
      ActionsEnabled: true
      AlarmRule: !Sub 'ALARM("${GetRemittancesErrorsAlarm}") OR ALARM("${CreateRemittanceErrorsAlarm}") OR ALARM("${GetRemittancesDurationAlarm}") OR ALARM("${CreateRemittanceDurationAlarm}")'

  RdsHealthCompositeAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::CompositeAlarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: RDS Health
      AlarmDescription: >-
        Composite health alarm for the dbcluster1-instance1 RDS instance. Enters
        the ALARM state when any of the underlying RDS metric alarms is in the
        ALARM state.
      ActionsEnabled: true
      AlarmRule: !Sub 'ALARM("${RdsCpuUtilizationAlarm}") OR ALARM("${RdsDatabaseConnectionsAlarm}") OR ALARM("${RdsDeadlocksAlarm}") OR ALARM("${RdsNetworkTransmitThroughputAlarm}") OR ALARM("${RdsNetworkReceiveThroughputAlarm}") OR ALARM("${RdsQueriesAlarm}") OR ALARM("${RdsDiskQueueDepthAlarm}") OR ALARM("${RdsReadLatencyAlarm}") OR ALARM("${RdsWriteLatencyAlarm}")'

Outputs:
  ApiGatewayHealthCompositeAlarmName:
    Description: Name of the API Gateway Health composite alarm.
    Value: !Ref ApiGatewayHealthCompositeAlarm
  ApiGatewayHealthCompositeAlarmArn:
    Description: ARN of the API Gateway Health composite alarm.
    Value: !GetAtt ApiGatewayHealthCompositeAlarm.Arn
  LambdaHealthCompositeAlarmName:
    Description: Name of the Lambda Health composite alarm.
    Value: !Ref LambdaHealthCompositeAlarm
  LambdaHealthCompositeAlarmArn:
    Description: ARN of the Lambda Health composite alarm.
    Value: !GetAtt LambdaHealthCompositeAlarm.Arn
  RdsHealthCompositeAlarmName:
    Description: Name of the RDS Health composite alarm.
    Value: !Ref RdsHealthCompositeAlarm
  RdsHealthCompositeAlarmArn:
    Description: ARN of the RDS Health composite alarm.
    Value: !GetAtt RdsHealthCompositeAlarm.Arn

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: "2010-09-09"
Description: >-
  QuickSight admin suite monitoring and data extraction pipeline. Creates seven AWS Glue
  jobs (five Python shell jobs running Python 3.9 on Glue 4.0 shell runtime, and two
  Spark ETL jobs on Glue 5.0 with G.1X workers), seven scheduled Glue triggers running
  every 3 hours, a private S3 output bucket (named admin-suite-<account-id> with a
  per-deployment unique suffix to avoid collisions with retained buckets), five CloudWatch
  metric streams in JSON output format for AWS/QuickSight metrics, and five dedicated
  DirectPut Kinesis Data Firehose delivery streams writing to the same S3 bucket, all
  managed by a single shared IAM role.

Parameters:
  ScriptBucketName:
    Type: String
    Description: Name of the pre-existing S3 bucket that contains the Glue job Python scripts.
    Default: admin-suite-scripts
  ScriptPath:
    Type: String
    Description: Key prefix (folder path) in the script bucket that holds the Glue job scripts, without leading or trailing slashes.
    Default: scripts

Outputs:
  AdminSuiteBucketName:
    Description: Name of the private S3 bucket that stores admin suite outputs and delivered metric data.
    Value: !Ref AdminSuiteBucket
  AdminSuiteBucketArn:
    Description: ARN of the private S3 bucket.
    Value: !GetAtt AdminSuiteBucket.Arn
  AdminSuiteRoleArn:
    Description: ARN of the single shared IAM role.
    Value: !GetAtt AdminSuiteRole.Arn
  AdminSuiteGlueJobNames:
    Description: Names of the seven Glue extraction jobs.
    Value: !Join
      - ", "
      - - !Ref AdminSuiteAssetsAccessJob
        - !Ref AdminSuiteAssetsMetadataJob
        - !Ref AdminSuiteFolderAssetsJob
        - !Ref AdminSuiteQMetadataJob
        - !Ref AdminSuiteQAccessJob
        - !Ref AdminSuiteDatasetPropertiesJob
        - !Ref AdminSuiteDataSourcePropertiesJob
  AdminSuiteFirehoseStreamNames:
    Description: Names of the five Kinesis Data Firehose delivery streams.
    Value: !Join
      - ", "
      - - !Ref IngestionMetricsDeliveryStream
        - !Ref UsageMetricsDeliveryStream
        - !Ref SpiceCapacityMetricsDeliveryStream
        - !Ref QIndexMetricsDeliveryStream
        - !Ref QActionMetricsDeliveryStream
  AdminSuiteMetricStreamNames:
    Description: Names of the five CloudWatch metric streams.
    Value: !Join
      - ", "
      - - !Ref IngestionMetricsStream
        - !Ref UsageMetricsStream
        - !Ref SpiceCapacityMetricsStream
        - !Ref QIndexMetricsStream
        - !Ref QActionMetricsStream

Resources:
  AdminSuiteBucket:
    Type: AWS::S3::Bucket
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      BucketName: !Sub
        - "admin-suite-${AWS::AccountId}-${BucketSuffix}"
        - BucketSuffix: !Select
            - 0
            - !Split
              - "-"
              - !Select
                - 2
                - !Split
                  - "/"
                  - !Ref "AWS::StackId"
      PublicAccessBlockConfiguration:
        BlockPublicAcls: true
        BlockPublicPolicy: true
        IgnorePublicAcls: true
        RestrictPublicBuckets: true
      BucketEncryption:
        ServerSideEncryptionConfiguration:
          - ServerSideEncryptionByDefault:
              SSEAlgorithm: AES256

  AdminSuiteRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      Description: Single shared role for the QuickSight admin suite pipeline, assumable by Glue, CloudFormation, Firehose and CloudWatch Metric Streams, with permissions for QuickSight, Glue, S3, CloudWatch, Firehose and IAM operations.
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Sid: AllowGlueAssume
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: glue.amazonaws.com
            Action: "sts:AssumeRole"
          - Sid: AllowCloudFormationAssume
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: cloudformation.amazonaws.com
            Action: "sts:AssumeRole"
          - Sid: AllowFirehoseAssume
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: firehose.amazonaws.com
            Action: "sts:AssumeRole"
          - Sid: AllowCloudWatchMetricStreamsAssume
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: streams.metrics.cloudwatch.amazonaws.com
            Action: "sts:AssumeRole"
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: AdminSuitePipelineAccess
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: "2012-10-17"
            Statement:
              - Sid: QuickSightAccess
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - "quicksight:*"
                Resource: "*"
              - Sid: GlueAccess
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - "glue:*"
                Resource: "*"
              - Sid: S3ScriptAndOutputAccess
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - s3:GetObject
                  - s3:GetObjectVersion
                  - s3:PutObject
                  - s3:PutObjectAcl
                  - s3:DeleteObject
                  - s3:AbortMultipartUpload
                  - s3:ListBucket
                  - s3:ListBucketMultipartUploads
                  - s3:ListMultipartUploadParts
                  - s3:GetBucketLocation
                Resource:
                  - !GetAtt AdminSuiteBucket.Arn
                  - !Sub "${AdminSuiteBucket.Arn}/*"
                  - !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:s3:::${ScriptBucketName}"
                  - !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:s3:::${ScriptBucketName}/*"
              - Sid: CloudWatchAndLogsAccess
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - cloudwatch:PutMetricData
                  - cloudwatch:GetMetricData
                  - cloudwatch:GetMetricStatistics
                  - cloudwatch:ListMetrics
                  - logs:CreateLogGroup
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                  - logs:DescribeLogGroups
                  - logs:DescribeLogStreams
                Resource: "*"
              - Sid: FirehoseAccess
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - "firehose:*"
                Resource: "*"
              - Sid: IamReadAccess
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - iam:GetRole
                  - iam:GetRolePolicy
                  - iam:ListRoles
                  - iam:ListRolePolicies
                  - iam:ListAttachedRolePolicies
                Resource: "*"

  AdminSuiteAssetsAccessJob:
    Type: AWS::Glue::Job
    Properties:
      Name: etl_job_admin_suite_assets_access
      Description: Extracts QuickSight asset access details into the admin suite S3 bucket.
      Role: !GetAtt AdminSuiteRole.Arn
      Command:
        Name: pythonshell
        PythonVersion: "3.9"
        ScriptLocation: !Sub "s3://${ScriptBucketName}/${ScriptPath}/etl_job_admin_suite_assets_access.py"
      GlueVersion: "4.0"
      MaxCapacity: 1
      ExecutionProperty:
        MaxConcurrentRuns: 1
      Timeout: 120
      DefaultArguments:
        "--region": !Sub "${AWS::Region}"
        "--account_id": !Sub "${AWS::AccountId}"

  AdminSuiteAssetsMetadataJob:
    Type: AWS::Glue::Job
    Properties:
      Name: etl_job_admin_suite_assets_metadata
      Description: Extracts QuickSight asset metadata into the admin suite S3 bucket.
      Role: !GetAtt AdminSuiteRole.Arn
      Command:
        Name: pythonshell
        PythonVersion: "3.9"
        ScriptLocation: !Sub "s3://${ScriptBucketName}/${ScriptPath}/etl_job_admin_suite_assets_metadata.py"
      GlueVersion: "4.0"
      MaxCapacity: 1
      ExecutionProperty:
        MaxConcurrentRuns: 1
      Timeout: 120
      DefaultArguments:
        "--region": !Sub "${AWS::Region}"
        "--account_id": !Sub "${AWS::AccountId}"

  AdminSuiteFolderAssetsJob:
    Type: AWS::Glue::Job

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >
  Fully self-contained serverless CRUD API for the Kitten service. Amazon API
  Gateway integrates directly with an Amazon DynamoDB table named Kitten
  (partition key KittenId of type String, on-demand billing) using AWS service
  proxy integrations, so no Lambda functions are required. The API exposes
  POST /kitten (KittenId auto-generated from the request context), GET /kitten
  (scans all items), GET /kitten/{id}, PUT /kitten/{id} and DELETE /kitten/{id},
  plus OPTIONS preflight methods on every resource for CORS support. All
  methods return appropriate status codes for success (200), bad input (400),
  not found (404) and internal server errors (500).

Resources:

  KittenTable:
    Type: AWS::DynamoDB::Table
    Properties:
      TableName: Kitten
      BillingMode: PAY_PER_REQUEST
      AttributeDefinitions:
        - AttributeName: KittenId
          AttributeType: S
      KeySchema:
        - AttributeName: KittenId
          KeyType: HASH
      SSESpecification:
        SSEEnabled: true
      PointInTimeRecoverySpecification:
        PointInTimeRecoveryEnabled: true

  ApiGatewayDynamoDBRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      Description: Role assumed by API Gateway to call Amazon DynamoDB for the Kitten API
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: apigateway.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: KittenApiDynamoDBAccess
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - dynamodb:PutItem
                  - dynamodb:GetItem
                  - dynamodb:Scan
                  - dynamodb:DeleteItem
                Resource: !GetAtt KittenTable.Arn

  KittenApi:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::RestApi
    Properties:
      Name: KittenApi
      Description: Serverless CRUD API for the Kitten service backed by Amazon DynamoDB
      EndpointConfiguration:
        Types:
          - REGIONAL

  KittenResource:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Resource
    Properties:
      RestApiId: !Ref KittenApi
      ParentId: !GetAtt KittenApi.RootResourceId
      PathPart: kitten

  KittenIdResource:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Resource
    Properties:
      RestApiId: !Ref KittenApi
      ParentId: !Ref KittenResource
      PathPart: '{id}'

  KittenModel:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Model
    Properties:
      RestApiId: !Ref KittenApi
      Name: KittenModel
      ContentType: application/json
      Description: JSON schema of the Kitten request body
      Schema:
        $schema: 'http://json-schema.org/draft-04/schema#'
        title: KittenModel
        type: object
        properties:
          name:
            type: string
          color:
            type: string
        required:
          - name
          - color

  KittenRequestValidator:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::RequestValidator
    Properties:
      RestApiId: !Ref KittenApi
      Name: kitten-request-validator
      ValidateRequestBody: true
      ValidateRequestParameters: true

  KittenPostMethod:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Method
    Properties:
      RestApiId: !Ref KittenApi
      ResourceId: !Ref KittenResource
      HttpMethod: POST
      AuthorizationType: NONE
      RequestValidatorId: !Ref KittenRequestValidator
      RequestModels:
        application/json: !Ref KittenModel
      Integration:
        Type: AWS
        IntegrationHttpMethod: POST
        Credentials: !GetAtt ApiGatewayDynamoDBRole.Arn
        Uri: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:apigateway:${AWS::Region}:dynamodb:action/PutItem'
        PassthroughBehavior: NEVER
        RequestTemplates:
          application/json: |
            {
              "TableName": "Kitten",
              "Item": {
                "KittenId": {"S": "$context.requestId"},
                "name": {"S": $input.json('$.name')},
                "color": {"S": $input.json('$.color')}
              }
            }
        IntegrationResponses:
          - StatusCode: '400'
            SelectionPattern: '.*ValidationException.*'
            ResponseParameters:
              method.response.header.Access-Control-Allow-Origin: "'*'"
            ResponseTemplates:
              application/json: '{"message": "Bad request"}'
          - StatusCode: '500'
            SelectionPattern: '.*__type.*'
            ResponseParameters:
              method.response.header.Access-Control-Allow-Origin: "'*'"
            ResponseTemplates:
              application/json: '{"message": "Internal server error"}'
          - StatusCode: '200'
            ResponseParameters:
              method.response.header.Access-Control-Allow-Origin: "'*'"
            ResponseTemplates:
              application/json: |
                {
                  "KittenId": "$context.requestId",
                  "message": "Kitten created"
                }
      MethodResponses:
        - StatusCode: '200'
          ResponseModels:
            application/json: Empty
          ResponseParameters:
            method.response.header.Access-Control-Allow-Origin: true
        - StatusCode: '400'
          ResponseModels:
            application/json: Empty
          ResponseParameters:
            method.response.header.Access-Control-Allow-Origin: true
        - StatusCode: '500'
          ResponseModels:
            application/json: Empty
          ResponseParameters:
            method.response.header.Access-Control-Allow-Origin: true

    Properties:
      RestApiId: !Ref KittenApi
      ResourceId: !Ref KittenResource
      HttpMethod: GET
      AuthorizationType: NONE

        IntegrationHttpMethod: POST
        Credentials: !GetAtt ApiGatewayDynamoDBRole.Arn

        PassthroughBehavior: NEVER

          - StatusCode: '200'

            ResponseTemplates:
              application/json: |

                  #foreach($item in $inputRoot.Items)

                      "KittenId": "$item.KittenId.S",
                      "name": "$item.name.S",
                      "color": "$item.color.S"
                    }#if($foreach.hasNext),#end
                  #end
                  ]
                }
      MethodResponses:
        - StatusCode: '200'
          ResponseModels:
            application/json: Empty
          ResponseParameters:
            method.response.header.Access-Control-Allow-Origin: true
        - StatusCode: '400'

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >-
  Creates a standard AWS Step Functions state machine containing a single Pass
  state that returns a result of 1, publishes a version of that state machine,
  and creates an alias that routes all traffic to that version. The alias is
  wired into five event-driven triggers, each with its own dedicated IAM role
  granted states:StartExecution on the alias ARN: an API Gateway REST API GET
  method that starts an execution, an EventBridge rule matching EC2 terminated
  instance state changes, an EventBridge rate(1 minute) rule that is initially
  disabled, an EventBridge rule matching AWS Tag service tag change events, and
  an EventBridge Scheduler schedule running every minute with the flexible time
  window disabled.

Parameters:
  AliasName:
    Type: String
    Default: live
    Description: Name of the state machine alias that points to the published version.
    AllowedPattern: '^[a-zA-Z0-9_-]{1,80}$'
    ConstraintDescription: Alias name must be 1-80 characters of letters, numbers, hyphens, or underscores.
  ApiStageName:
    Type: String
    Default: prod
    Description: Name of the API Gateway stage for the start-execution API.
    AllowedPattern: '^[a-zA-Z0-9_]{1,64}$'
    ConstraintDescription: Stage name must be 1-64 characters of letters, numbers, or underscores.
  ApiResourcePath:
    Type: String
    Default: start
    Description: Path segment of the API Gateway GET method that starts an execution.
    AllowedPattern: '^[a-zA-Z0-9_-]{1,64}$'
    ConstraintDescription: Resource path must be a single segment of letters, numbers, hyphens, or underscores.

Outputs:
  StateMachineArn:
    Description: ARN of the Step Functions state machine.
    Value: !Ref PassResultStateMachine
  StateMachineVersionArn:
    Description: ARN of the published state machine version.
    Value: !Ref PassResultStateMachineVersion
  StateMachineAliasArn:
    Description: ARN of the state machine alias targeted by every trigger.
    Value: !Ref PassResultStateMachineAlias
  ApiGatewayStartExecutionUrl:
    Description: Invoke URL of the API Gateway GET method that starts an execution on the alias.
    Value: !Sub 'https://${ApiGatewayRestApi}.execute-api.${AWS::Region}.${AWS::URLSuffix}/${ApiStageName}/${ApiResourcePath}'
  TerminatedInstanceStateRuleArn:
    Description: ARN of the EventBridge rule matching EC2 terminated state changes.
    Value: !GetAtt TerminatedInstanceStateRule.Arn
  DisabledScheduledRuleArn:
    Description: ARN of the initially disabled EventBridge rule that runs every minute.
    Value: !GetAtt DisabledScheduledRule.Arn
  TagChangeRuleArn:
    Description: ARN of the EventBridge rule matching AWS Tag service tag change events.
    Value: !GetAtt TagChangeRule.Arn
  SchedulerScheduleArn:
    Description: ARN of the EventBridge Scheduler schedule that runs every minute.
    Value: !GetAtt MinuteSchedulerSchedule.Arn

Resources:
  StateMachineRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      Description: Execution role assumed by the Step Functions state machine. The Pass state requires no additional permissions.
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: states.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole

  PassResultStateMachine:
    Type: AWS::StepFunctions::StateMachine
    Properties:
      StateMachineType: STANDARD
      RoleArn: !GetAtt StateMachineRole.Arn
      Definition:
        Comment: State machine with a single Pass state that returns a result of 1.
        StartAt: PassState
        States:
          PassState:
            Type: Pass
            Comment: Pass state that returns a static result of 1.
            Result: 1
            End: true

  PassResultStateMachineVersion:
    Type: AWS::StepFunctions::StateMachineVersion
    Properties:
      StateMachineArn: !Ref PassResultStateMachine
      Description: Version 1 - initial definition with a single Pass state returning 1.

  PassResultStateMachineAlias:
    Type: AWS::StepFunctions::StateMachineAlias
    Properties:
      Name: !Ref AliasName
      RoutingConfiguration:
        - StateMachineVersionArn: !Ref PassResultStateMachineVersion
          Weight: 100

  ApiGatewayTriggerRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      Description: Assumed by API Gateway to start executions on the state machine alias.
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: apigateway.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: StartExecutionOnAlias
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: AllowStartExecutionOnAlias
                Effect: Allow
                Action: states:StartExecution
                Resource: !Ref PassResultStateMachineAlias

  TerminatedInstanceStateRuleRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      Description: Assumed by EventBridge to start executions for terminated EC2 instance state changes.
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: events.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: StartExecutionOnAlias
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: AllowStartExecutionOnAlias
                Effect: Allow
                Action: states:StartExecution
                Resource: !Ref PassResultStateMachineAlias

  DisabledScheduledRuleRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      Description: Assumed by EventBridge to start executions on the scheduled rule cadence.
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: events.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: StartExecutionOnAlias
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: AllowStartExecutionOnAlias
                Effect: Allow
                Action: states:StartExecution
                Resource: !Ref PassResultStateMachineAlias

  TagChangeRuleRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      Description: Assumed by EventBridge to start executions for AWS Tag service tag change events.
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: events.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: StartExecutionOnAlias
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: AllowStartExecutionOnAlias
                Effect: Allow
                Action: states:StartExecution
                Resource: !Ref PassResultStateMachineAlias

  SchedulerTriggerRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      Description: Assumed by EventBridge Scheduler to start executions on the state machine alias.
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: scheduler.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: StartExecutionOnAlias
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: AllowStartExecutionOnAlias
                Effect: Allow
                Action: states:StartExecution
                Resource: !Ref PassResultStateMachineAlias

  ApiGatewayRestApi:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::RestApi
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-start-execution-api'
      Description: REST API that starts Step Functions executions on the state machine alias.
      EndpointConfiguration:
        Types:
          - REGIONAL

  ApiGatewayStartResource:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Resource
    Properties:
      RestApiId: !Ref ApiGatewayRestApi
      ParentId: !GetAtt ApiGatewayRestApi.RootResourceId
      PathPart: !Ref ApiResourcePath

  ApiGatewayStartMethod:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Method
    Properties:
      RestApiId: !Ref ApiGatewayRestApi
      ResourceId: !Ref ApiGatewayStartResource
      HttpMethod: GET
      AuthorizationType: NONE
      ApiKeyRequired: false
      OperationName: StartExecutionOnAlias
      Integration:
        Type: AWS
        IntegrationHttpMethod: POST
        Uri: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:apigateway:${AWS::Region}:states:action/StartExecution'
        Credentials: !GetAtt ApiGatewayTriggerRole.Arn
        RequestTemplates:
          application/json: !Sub |
            {
              "stateMachineArn": "${PassResultStateMachineAlias}",
              "input": "{}"
            }
        IntegrationResponses:
          - StatusCode: '200'
            SelectionPattern: ''
            ResponseParameters:
              method.response.header.Content-Type: "'application/json'"
      MethodResponses:
        - StatusCode: '200'
          ResponseModels:
            application/json: 'Empty'
          ResponseParameters:
            method.response.header.Content-Type: true

  ApiGatewayDeployment:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Deployment
    DependsOn: ApiGatewayStartMethod
    Properties:
      RestApiId: !Ref ApiGatewayRestApi
      Description: Deployment containing the GET start-execution method.

  ApiGatewayStage:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Stage
    Properties:
      RestApiId: !Ref ApiGatewayRestApi
      DeploymentId: !Ref ApiGatewayDeployment
      StageName: !Ref ApiStageName
      Description: Stage exposing the GET method that starts executions on the alias.

  TerminatedInstanceStateRule:
    Type: AWS::Events::Rule
    Properties:
      Description: Starts an execution on the state machine alias when an EC2 instance enters the terminated state.
      State: ENABLED
      EventPattern:
        source:
          - aws.ec2
        detail-type:
          - EC2 Instance State-change Notification
        detail:
          state:
            - terminated
      Targets:
        - Id: StartExecutionOnAlias
          Arn: !Ref PassResultStateMachineAlias
          RoleArn: !GetAtt TerminatedInstanceStateRuleRole.Arn

  DisabledScheduledRule:
    Type: AWS::Events::Rule
    Properties:
      Description: Starts an execution on the state machine alias every minute. Created disabled; enable manually or via automation.
      State: DISABLED
      ScheduleExpression: rate(1 minute)
      Targets:
        - Id: StartExecutionOnAlias
          Arn: !Ref PassResultStateMachineAlias
          RoleArn: !GetAtt DisabledScheduledRuleRole.Arn

  TagChangeRule:
    Type: AWS::Events::Rule
    Properties:
      Description: Starts an execution on the state machine alias when the AWS Tag service emits a tag change event.
      State: ENABLED
      EventPattern:
        source:
          - aws.tag
        detail-type:
          - Tag Change on Resource
      Targets:
        - Id: StartExecutionOnAlias
          Arn: !Ref PassResultStateMachineAlias
          RoleArn: !GetAtt TagChangeRuleRole.Arn

  MinuteSchedulerSchedule:
    Type: AWS::Scheduler::Schedule
    Properties:
      Description: Starts an execution on the state machine alias every minute with the flexible time window disabled.
      ScheduleExpression: rate(1 minute)
      ScheduleExpressionTimezone: UTC
      FlexibleTimeWindow:
        Mode: 'OFF'
      State: ENABLED
      Target:
        Arn: !Ref PassResultStateMachineAlias
        RoleArn: !GetAtt SchedulerTriggerRole.Arn
        Input: '{}'

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: "2010-09-09"

Description: >-
  IAM identities and permission policies required by the Cluster API Provider AWS (CAPA)
  bootstrap process for a cluster that uses Amazon EKS. Creates control-plane, nodes and
  controllers roles assumable by EC2 (controllers also assumable by EKS pods) with matching
  instance profiles, a dedicated EKS control plane role assumable by the EKS service with
  the AWS managed AmazonEKSClusterPolicy attached, customer managed policies for the legacy
  in-tree AWS cloud provider, node registration and image pull, Cluster API controllers and
  EKS controllers, plus a standalone read-only console policy for human users or groups.

Resources:

  ControlPlaneRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-control-plane"
      Description: >-
        Control plane machine role for the Cluster API Provider AWS cluster. Assumable by
        EC2 for instance profile bootstrapping.
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: ec2.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Ref CloudControllerPolicy
        - !Ref ClusterControllerPolicy
        - !Ref NodeManagedPolicy
        - !Ref EKSClusterControllerPolicy
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-control-plane"
        - Key: sigs.k8s.io/cluster-api-provider-aws/managed
          Value: "true"

  NodesRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-nodes"
      Description: >-
        Kubernetes nodes (worker machines) role for the Cluster API Provider AWS cluster.
        Assumable by EC2 for instance profile bootstrapping.
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: ec2.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Ref NodeManagedPolicy
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-nodes"
        - Key: sigs.k8s.io/cluster-api-provider-aws/managed
          Value: "true"

  ControllersRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-controllers"
      Description: >-
        Cluster API controllers role. Assumable by EC2 (for bootstrapped controller
        machines) and by EKS pods via eks.amazonaws.com and pods.eks.amazonaws.com.
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: ec2.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: eks.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: pods.eks.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Ref ClusterControllerPolicy
        - !Ref EKSClusterControllerPolicy
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-controllers"
        - Key: sigs.k8s.io/cluster-api-provider-aws/managed
          Value: "true"

  EKSClusterRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-eks-control-plane"
      Description: >-
        Amazon EKS control plane role. Assumable by the EKS service, with the AWS managed
        AmazonEKSClusterPolicy attached.
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: eks.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/AmazonEKSClusterPolicy"
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-eks-control-plane"
        - Key: sigs.k8s.io/cluster-api-provider-aws/managed
          Value: "true"

  ControlPlaneInstanceProfile:
    Type: AWS::IAM::InstanceProfile
    Properties:
      InstanceProfileName: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-control-plane-instance-profile"
      Roles:

    Type: AWS::IAM::InstanceProfile
    Properties:

      Roles:

    Type: AWS::IAM::ManagedPolicy

      ManagedPolicyName: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-cloud-controller-policy"

              - ec2:AuthorizeSecurityGroupIngress
