AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >-
  General purpose networking foundation. Provisions a VPC with two public and two
  private subnets across two Availability Zones, an internet gateway, one NAT gateway
  (each with its own Elastic IP) per public subnet, per-AZ private route tables, VPC
  flow logs delivered to a CloudWatch Logs log group through a dedicated IAM role with
  configurable retention and traffic type, a gateway VPC endpoint for S3 attached to
  all route tables, and interface VPC endpoints for the ECR API and ECR Docker
  registry in the private subnets. Core network identifiers are exported for use by
  other stacks.
Metadata:
  AWS::CloudFormation::Interface:
    ParameterGroups:
      - Label:
          default: Network configuration
        Parameters:
          - VpcCidr
          - PublicSubnet1Cidr
          - PublicSubnet2Cidr
          - PrivateSubnet1Cidr
          - PrivateSubnet2Cidr
      - Label:
          default: Flow logs configuration
        Parameters:
          - FlowLogRetentionInDays
          - FlowLogTrafficType
    ParameterLabels:
      VpcCidr:
        default: VPC CIDR block
      PublicSubnet1Cidr:
        default: Public subnet 1 CIDR
      PublicSubnet2Cidr:
        default: Public subnet 2 CIDR
      PrivateSubnet1Cidr:
        default: Private subnet 1 CIDR
      PrivateSubnet2Cidr:
        default: Private subnet 2 CIDR
      FlowLogRetentionInDays:
        default: Flow log retention period (days)
      FlowLogTrafficType:
        default: Flow log traffic type
Parameters:
  VpcCidr:
    Type: String
    Description: CIDR block for the VPC.
    Default: 10.0.0.0/16
    AllowedPattern: '^(([0-9]|[1-9][0-9]|1[0-9]{2}|2[0-4][0-9]|25[0-5])\.){3}([0-9]|[1-9][0-9]|1[0-9]{2}|2[0-4][0-9]|25[0-5])(/(1[6-9]|2[0-8]))$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must be a valid IPv4 CIDR block with a prefix length between /16 and /28.
  PublicSubnet1Cidr:
    Type: String
    Description: CIDR block for the public subnet in the first Availability Zone.
    Default: 10.0.0.0/24
    AllowedPattern: '^(([0-9]|[1-9][0-9]|1[0-9]{2}|2[0-4][0-9]|25[0-5])\.){3}([0-9]|[1-9][0-9]|1[0-9]{2}|2[0-4][0-9]|25[0-5])(/(1[6-9]|2[0-8]))$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must be a valid IPv4 CIDR block with a prefix length between /16 and /28.
  PublicSubnet2Cidr:
    Type: String
    Description: CIDR block for the public subnet in the second Availability Zone.
    Default: 10.0.1.0/24
    AllowedPattern: '^(([0-9]|[1-9][0-9]|1[0-9]{2}|2[0-4][0-9]|25[0-5])\.){3}([0-9]|[1-9][0-9]|1[0-9]{2}|2[0-4][0-9]|25[0-5])(/(1[6-9]|2[0-8]))$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must be a valid IPv4 CIDR block with a prefix length between /16 and /28.
  PrivateSubnet1Cidr:
    Type: String
    Description: CIDR block for the private subnet in the first Availability Zone.
    Default: 10.0.10.0/24
    AllowedPattern: '^(([0-9]|[1-9][0-9]|1[0-9]{2}|2[0-4][0-9]|25[0-5])\.){3}([0-9]|[1-9][0-9]|1[0-9]{2}|2[0-4][0-9]|25[0-5])(/(1[6-9]|2[0-8]))$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must be a valid IPv4 CIDR block with a prefix length between /16 and /28.
  PrivateSubnet2Cidr:
    Type: String
    Description: CIDR block for the private subnet in the second Availability Zone.
    Default: 10.0.11.0/24
    AllowedPattern: '^(([0-9]|[1-9][0-9]|1[0-9]{2}|2[0-4][0-9]|25[0-5])\.){3}([0-9]|[1-9][0-9]|1[0-9]{2}|2[0-4][0-9]|25[0-5])(/(1[6-9]|2[0-8]))$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must be a valid IPv4 CIDR block with a prefix length between /16 and /28.
  FlowLogRetentionInDays:
    Type: Number
    Description: Number of days to retain VPC flow logs in the CloudWatch Logs log group.
    Default: 90
    AllowedValues:
      - 1
      - 3
      - 5
      - 7
      - 14
      - 30
      - 60
      - 90
      - 120
      - 150
      - 180
      - 365
      - 400
      - 545
      - 731
      - 1096
      - 1827
      - 2192
      - 2557
      - 2922
      - 3288
      - 3653
    ConstraintDescription: Must be a valid CloudWatch Logs retention period in days.
  FlowLogTrafficType:
    Type: String
    Description: Traffic type to capture in the VPC flow logs.
    Default: ALL
    AllowedValues:
      - ACCEPT
      - REJECT
      - ALL
    ConstraintDescription: Must be one of ACCEPT, REJECT, or ALL.
Resources:
  VPC:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPC
    Properties:
      CidrBlock: !Ref VpcCidr
      EnableDnsHostnames: true
      EnableDnsSupport: true
      InstanceTenancy: default
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-vpc'
  InternetGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::InternetGateway
    Properties:
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-internet-gateway'
  VPCGatewayAttachment:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      InternetGatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
  PublicSubnet1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs '']
      CidrBlock: !Ref PublicSubnet1Cidr
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: true
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-public-subnet-1'
  PublicSubnet2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [1, !GetAZs '']
      CidrBlock: !Ref PublicSubnet2Cidr
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: true
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-public-subnet-2'
  PrivateSubnet1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs '']
      CidrBlock: !Ref PrivateSubnet1Cidr
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-private-subnet-1'
  PrivateSubnet2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [1, !GetAZs '']
      CidrBlock: !Ref PrivateSubnet2Cidr
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-private-subnet-2'
  PublicRouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-public-route-table'
  PublicRoute:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    DependsOn: VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      GatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable
  PublicSubnet1RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet1
  PublicSubnet2RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet2
  NatGatewayEIP1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::EIP
    DependsOn: VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      Domain: vpc
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-nat-gateway-eip-1'
  NatGatewayEIP2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::EIP
    DependsOn: VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      Domain: vpc
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-nat-gateway-eip-2'
  NatGateway1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NatGateway
    DependsOn: VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      AllocationId: !GetAtt NatGatewayEIP1.AllocationId
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet1
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-nat-gateway-1'
  NatGateway2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NatGateway
    DependsOn: VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      AllocationId: !GetAtt NatGatewayEIP2.AllocationId
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet2
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-nat-gateway-2'
  PrivateRouteTable1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-private-route-table-1'
  PrivateRouteTable2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-private-route-table-2'
  PrivateRoute1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    Properties:
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      NatGatewayId: !Ref NatGateway1
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable1
  PrivateRoute2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    Properties:
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      NatGatewayId: !Ref NatGateway2
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable2
  PrivateSubnet1RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable1
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnet1
  PrivateSubnet2RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable2
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnet2
  FlowLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Sub '/vpc-flow-logs/${AWS::StackName}'
      RetentionInDays: !Ref FlowLogRetentionInDays
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-vpc-flow-logs'
  FlowLogRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: delivery.logs.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                'aws:SourceAccount': !Sub '${AWS::AccountId}'
              ArnLike:
                'aws:SourceArn': !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:logs:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:*'
      Description: Role assumed by VPC flow logs to deliver records to CloudWatch Logs.
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-vpc-flow-logs-role'
  FlowLogRolePolicy:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Policy
    Properties:
      PolicyName: vpc-flow-logs-to-cloudwatch
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - logs:CreateLogStream
              - logs:DescribeLogStreams
              - logs:PutLogEvents
            Resource:
              - !GetAtt FlowLogGroup.Arn
              - !Sub '${FlowLogGroup.Arn}:*'
      Roles:
        - !Ref FlowLogRole
  FlowLog:
    Type: AWS::EC2::FlowLog
    DependsOn: FlowLogRolePolicy
    Properties:
      DeliverLogsPermissionArn: !GetAtt FlowLogRole.Arn
      LogDestination: !GetAtt FlowLogGroup.Arn
      LogDestinationType: cloud-watch-logs
      MaxAggregationInterval: 60
      ResourceId: !Ref VPC
      ResourceType: VPC
      TrafficType: !Ref FlowLogTrafficType
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-vpc-flow-log'
  EndpointSecurityGroup:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroup
    Properties:
      GroupDescription: Allows HTTPS traffic only within the VPC CIDR for interface VPC endpoints.
      SecurityGroupEgress:
        - CidrIp: !Ref VpcCidr
          Description: Allow outbound HTTPS within the VPC CIDR only.
          FromPort: 443
          IpProtocol: tcp
          ToPort: 443
      SecurityGroupIngress:
        - CidrIp: !Ref VpcCidr
          Description: Allow inbound HTTPS from within the VPC CIDR only.
          FromPort: 443
          IpProtocol: tcp
          ToPort: 443
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-vpc-endpoint-sg'
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
  S3GatewayEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:
      RouteTableIds:
        - !Ref PublicRouteTable
        - !Ref PrivateRouteTable1
        - !Ref PrivateRouteTable2
      ServiceName: !Sub 'com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.s3'
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-s3-gateway-endpoint'
      VpcEndpointType: Gateway
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
  EcrApiEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:
      PrivateDnsEnabled: true
      SecurityGroupIds:
        - !Ref EndpointSecurityGroup
      ServiceName: !Sub 'com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.ecr.api'
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet1
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet2
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-ecr-api-endpoint'
      VpcEndpointType: Interface
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
  EcrDkrEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:
      PrivateDnsEnabled: true
      SecurityGroupIds:
        - !Ref EndpointSecurityGroup
      ServiceName: !Sub 'com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.ecr.dkr'
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet1
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet2
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-ecr-dkr-endpoint'
      VpcEndpointType: Interface
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
Outputs:
  VpcId:
    Description: The ID of the VPC.
    Value: !Ref VPC
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-VpcId'
  VpcCidr:
    Description: The CIDR block of the VPC.
    Value: !GetAtt VPC.CidrBlock
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-VpcCidr'
  AvailabilityZone1:
    Description: The first Availability Zone used by the subnets.
    Value: !GetAtt PublicSubnet1.AvailabilityZone
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-AvailabilityZone1'
  AvailabilityZone2:
    Description: The second Availability Zone used by the subnets.
    Value: !GetAtt PublicSubnet2.AvailabilityZone
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-AvailabilityZone2'
  PublicSubnet1Id:
    Description: The ID of the public subnet in the first Availability Zone.
    Value: !Ref PublicSubnet1
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-PublicSubnet1Id'
  PublicSubnet2Id:
    Description: The ID of the public subnet in the second Availability Zone.
    Value: !Ref PublicSubnet2
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-PublicSubnet2Id'
  PrivateSubnet1Id:
    Description: The ID of the private subnet in the first Availability Zone.
    Value: !Ref PrivateSubnet1
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-PrivateSubnet1Id'
  PrivateSubnet2Id:
    Description: The ID of the private subnet in the second Availability Zone.
    Value: !Ref PrivateSubnet2
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-PrivateSubnet2Id'
  EndpointSecurityGroupId:
    Description: The ID of the security group protecting the interface VPC endpoints.
    Value: !GetAtt EndpointSecurityGroup.GroupId
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-EndpointSecurityGroupId'

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >-
  KerberosEMRonEKS VPC infrastructure to support a Microsoft AD environment.
  Creates a 10.0.0.0/24 VPC with two public and two private /26 subnets across
  two Availability Zones, an Internet Gateway, two NAT Gateways with Elastic
  IPs, complete public and private routing, a rotation-enabled KMS key for VPC
  Flow Logs encryption, VPC Flow Logs (ALL traffic) delivered to a CloudWatch
  Logs group with 30-day retention, and VPC interface endpoints for SSM, SSM
  Messages, EC2 Messages and Secrets Manager restricted to HTTPS from the VPC
  CIDR by a shared security group.

Metadata:
  AWS::CloudFormation::Interface:
    ParameterGroups:
      - Label:
          default: Network Configuration
        Parameters:
          - EnvironmentName
          - VPCCIDR
          - PublicSubnet1CIDR
          - PublicSubnet2CIDR
          - PrivateSubnet1CIDR
          - PrivateSubnet2CIDR
    ParameterLabels:
      EnvironmentName:
        default: Environment Name
      VPCCIDR:
        default: VPC CIDR Block
      PublicSubnet1CIDR:
        default: Public Subnet 1 CIDR
      PublicSubnet2CIDR:
        default: Public Subnet 2 CIDR
      PrivateSubnet1CIDR:
        default: Private Subnet 1 CIDR
      PrivateSubnet2CIDR:
        default: Private Subnet 2 CIDR

Parameters:
  EnvironmentName:
    Type: String
    Default: KerberosEMRonEKS
    Description: Name prefix applied to all resources created by this template.
  VPCCIDR:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.0.0/24
    Description: CIDR block for the KerberosEMRonEKS VPC.
    AllowedPattern: '^(([0-9]|[1-9][0-9]|1[0-9]{2}|2[0-4][0-9]|25[0-5])\.){3}([0-9]|[1-9][0-9]|1[0-9]{2}|2[0-4][0-9]|25[0-5])(\/(1[6-9]|2[0-8]))$'
  PublicSubnet1CIDR:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.0.0/26
    Description: CIDR block for public subnet 1 in Availability Zone 1.
    AllowedPattern: '^(([0-9]|[1-9][0-9]|1[0-9]{2}|2[0-4][0-9]|25[0-5])\.){3}([0-9]|[1-9][0-9]|1[0-9]{2}|2[0-4][0-9]|25[0-5])(\/(1[6-9]|2[0-8]))$'
  PublicSubnet2CIDR:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.0.64/26
    Description: CIDR block for public subnet 2 in Availability Zone 2.
    AllowedPattern: '^(([0-9]|[1-9][0-9]|1[0-9]{2}|2[0-4][0-9]|25[0-5])\.){3}([0-9]|[1-9][0-9]|1[0-9]{2}|2[0-4][0-9]|25[0-5])(\/(1[6-9]|2[0-8]))$'
  PrivateSubnet1CIDR:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.0.128/26
    Description: CIDR block for private subnet 1 in Availability Zone 1.
    AllowedPattern: '^(([0-9]|[1-9][0-9]|1[0-9]{2}|2[0-4][0-9]|25[0-5])\.){3}([0-9]|[1-9][0-9]|1[0-9]{2}|2[0-4][0-9]|25[0-5])(\/(1[6-9]|2[0-8]))$'
  PrivateSubnet2CIDR:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.0.192/26
    Description: CIDR block for private subnet 2 in Availability Zone 2.
    AllowedPattern: '^(([0-9]|[1-9][0-9]|1[0-9]{2}|2[0-4][0-9]|25[0-5])\.){3}([0-9]|[1-9][0-9]|1[0-9]{2}|2[0-4][0-9]|25[0-5])(\/(1[6-9]|2[0-8]))$'

Resources:
  VPC:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPC
    Properties:
      CidrBlock: !Ref VPCCIDR
      EnableDnsHostnames: true
      EnableDnsSupport: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-VPC'

  InternetGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::InternetGateway
    Properties:
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-InternetGateway'

  VPCGatewayAttachment:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      InternetGatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  PublicSubnet1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: !Ref PublicSubnet1CIDR
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs '']
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-PublicSubnet1'

  PublicSubnet2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: !Ref PublicSubnet2CIDR
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [1, !GetAZs '']
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-PublicSubnet2'

  PrivateSubnet1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: !Ref PrivateSubnet1CIDR
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs '']
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-PrivateSubnet1'

  PrivateSubnet2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: !Ref PrivateSubnet2CIDR
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [1, !GetAZs '']
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-PrivateSubnet2'

  NATGatewayEIP1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::EIP
    DependsOn: VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      Domain: vpc

  NATGatewayEIP2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::EIP
    DependsOn: VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      Domain: vpc

  NATGateway1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NatGateway
    Properties:
      AllocationId: !GetAtt NATGatewayEIP1.AllocationId
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet1
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-NATGateway1'

  NATGateway2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NatGateway
    Properties:
      AllocationId: !GetAtt NATGatewayEIP2.AllocationId
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet2
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-NATGateway2'

  PublicRouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-PublicRouteTable'

  PublicRoute:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    DependsOn: VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      GatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  PublicSubnet1RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet1
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable

  PublicSubnet2RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet2
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable

  PrivateRouteTable1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-PrivateRouteTable1'

  PrivateRoute1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable1
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      NatGatewayId: !Ref NATGateway1

  PrivateSubnet1RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnet1
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable1

  PrivateRouteTable2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-PrivateRouteTable2'

  PrivateRoute2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable2
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      NatGatewayId: !Ref NATGateway2

  PrivateSubnet2RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnet2
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable2

  KMSKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    Properties:
      Description: !Sub 'KMS key used to encrypt VPC Flow Logs for ${EnvironmentName}'
      Enabled: true
      EnableKeyRotation: true
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: EnableIAMUserPermissions
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root'
            Action: 'kms:*'
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: AllowCloudWatchLogsToUseTheKey
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: !Sub 'logs.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com'
            Action:
              - 'kms:Encrypt'
              - 'kms:Decrypt'
              - 'kms:ReEncrypt*'
              - 'kms:GenerateDataKey*'
              - 'kms:Describe*'
            Resource: '*'
            Condition:
              ArnLike:
                'kms:EncryptionContext:aws:logs:arn': !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:logs:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:*'
          - Sid: AllowVPCFlowLogsToUseTheKey
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: delivery.logs.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - 'kms:Encrypt'
              - 'kms:Decrypt'
              - 'kms:ReEncrypt*'
              - 'kms:GenerateDataKey*'
              - 'kms:DescribeKey'
            Resource: '*'
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                'aws:SourceAccount': !Ref 'AWS::AccountId'

  EndpointsSecurityGroup:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroup
    Properties:
      GroupDescription: !Sub 'Restricts inbound and outbound traffic to HTTPS from the ${EnvironmentName} VPC CIDR'
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      SecurityGroupIngress:
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 443
          ToPort: 443
          CidrIp: !GetAtt VPC.CidrBlock
      SecurityGroupEgress:
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 443
          ToPort: 443
          CidrIp: !GetAtt VPC.CidrBlock
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-EndpointsSecurityGroup'

  FlowLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Sub '/vpcflowlogs/${EnvironmentName}'
      RetentionInDays: 30
      KmsKeyId: !GetAtt KMSKey.Arn

  FlowLogRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: delivery.logs.amazonaws.com
            Action: 'sts:AssumeRole'
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                'aws:SourceAccount': !Ref 'AWS::AccountId'
      Path: '/'
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-VPCFlowLogsPolicy'
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - 'logs:CreateLogStream'
                  - 'logs:PutLogEvents'
                  - 'logs:DescribeLogStreams'
                Resource:
                  - !GetAtt FlowLogGroup.Arn
                  - !Sub '${FlowLogGroup.Arn}:*'

  FlowLog:
    Type: AWS::EC2::FlowLog
    Properties:
      ResourceId: !Ref VPC
      ResourceType: VPC
      TrafficType: ALL
      LogDestinationType: cloud-watch-logs
      LogDestination: !GetAtt FlowLogGroup.Arn
      DeliverLogsPermissionArn: !GetAtt FlowLogRole.Arn
      MaxAggregationInterval: 60
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-FlowLog'

  VPCEndpointSSM:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      ServiceName: !Sub 'com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.ssm'
      VpcEndpointType: Interface
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet1
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet2
      SecurityGroupIds:
        - !Ref EndpointsSecurityGroup
      PrivateDnsEnabled: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-VPCEndpointSSM'

  VPCEndpointSSMMessages:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      ServiceName: !Sub 'com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.ssmmessages'
      VpcEndpointType: Interface
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet1
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet2
      SecurityGroupIds:
        - !Ref EndpointsSecurityGroup
      PrivateDnsEnabled: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-VPCEndpointSSMMessages'

  VPCEndpointEC2Messages:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      ServiceName: !Sub 'com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.ec2messages'
      VpcEndpointType: Interface
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet1
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet2
      SecurityGroupIds:
        - !Ref EndpointsSecurityGroup
      PrivateDnsEnabled: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-VPCEndpointEC2Messages'

  VPCEndpointSecretsManager:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      ServiceName: !Sub 'com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.secretsmanager'
      VpcEndpointType: Interface
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet1
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet2
      SecurityGroupIds:
        - !Ref EndpointsSecurityGroup
      PrivateDnsEnabled: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-VPCEndpointSecretsManager'

Outputs:
  VPCId:
    Description: ID of the KerberosEMRonEKS VPC
    Value: !Ref VPC
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-VPCId'
  VPCCidrBlock:
    Description: CIDR block of the KerberosEMRonEKS VPC
    Value: !GetAtt VPC.CidrBlock
  PublicSubnetIds:
    Description: IDs of the two public subnets (Availability Zone 1 and 2)
    Value: !Join [',', [!Ref PublicSubnet1, !Ref PublicSubnet2]]
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-PublicSubnetIds'
  PrivateSubnetIds:
    Description: IDs of the two private subnets (Availability Zone 1 and 2)
    Value: !Join [',', [!Ref PrivateSubnet1, !Ref PrivateSubnet2]]
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-PrivateSubnetIds'
  EndpointsSecurityGroupId:
    Description: ID of the security group attached to the VPC interface endpoints
    Value: !Ref EndpointsSecurityGroup
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-EndpointsSecurityGroupId'
  KMSKeyArn:
    Description: ARN of the KMS key used to encrypt VPC Flow Logs
    Value: !GetAtt KMSKey.Arn
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-KMSKeyArn'
  FlowLogGroupId:
    Description: CloudWatch Logs group receiving the VPC Flow Logs
    Value: !Ref FlowLogGroup
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-FlowLogGroupId'
  FlowLogId:
    Description: ID of the VPC Flow Log
    Value: !Ref FlowLog
  VPCEndpointIds:
    Description: Interface endpoint IDs for SSM, SSM Messages, EC2 Messages and Secrets Manager
    Value: !Join [',', [!Ref VPCEndpointSSM, !Ref VPCEndpointSSMMessages, !Ref VPCEndpointEC2Messages, !Ref VPCEndpointSecretsManager]]

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >-
  Creates a self-contained Amazon SageMaker Domain configured in VPC-only mode with a
  single test user profile and a dedicated IAM execution role. The role grants
  permissions to manage SageMaker jobs (training, transform, processing, AutoML and
  hyperparameter tuning), experiments, lineage and artifacts, model packages and model
  package groups, and Studio apps, spaces and presigned domain URLs, along with
  read-write access to the default S3 bucket and the ability to pass itself to
  SageMaker. If no bucket ARN, VPC, subnets or security groups are provided, the
  template automatically creates a dedicated encrypted S3 bucket, a VPC with two
  private subnets, an S3 gateway VPC endpoint and a Studio application security group.
  Note: in VPC-only mode, additional VPC endpoints or a NAT gateway are required for
  Studio application internet access.

Parameters:
  DomainName:
    Type: String
    Description: Name of the SageMaker Domain to create.
    Default: sagemaker-test-domain
    AllowedPattern: '^[a-zA-Z0-9](-*[a-zA-Z0-9]){0,62}$'
    ConstraintDescription: >-
      Domain name must start and end with an alphanumeric character, may contain
      hyphens, and can be up to 63 characters long.
  TestUserName:
    Type: String
    Description: Name of the single test user profile to create in the domain.
    Default: test-user
    AllowedPattern: '^[a-zA-Z0-9](-*[a-zA-Z0-9]){0,62}$'
    ConstraintDescription: >-
      User profile name must start and end with an alphanumeric character, may contain
      hyphens, and can be up to 63 characters long.
  DefaultBucketArn:
    Type: String
    Description: >-
      ARN of the default S3 bucket the test user gets read-write access to, for
      example arn:aws:s3:::my-sagemaker-bucket. If left empty, a new encrypted S3
      bucket is created and used as the default bucket.
    Default: ''
    AllowedPattern: '^$|^arn:(aws[a-zA-Z-]*):s3:::[a-zA-Z0-9][a-zA-Z0-9.\-]{1,61}[a-zA-Z0-9]$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must be a valid S3 bucket ARN, for example arn:aws:s3:::my-bucket.
  VpcId:
    Type: String
    Description: >-
      ID of the VPC in which the SageMaker Domain is created (VPC-only mode). If left
      empty, a dedicated VPC is created for the domain.
    Default: ''
    AllowedPattern: '^$|^vpc-[0-9a-f]{8,17}$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must be an empty string or a valid VPC ID (vpc-xxxxxxxx).
  SubnetIds:
    Type: String
    Description: >-
      Comma-separated list of subnet IDs (private subnets with outbound connectivity or
      configured VPC endpoints) in which the SageMaker Domain is deployed. If left
      empty, two private subnets are created.
    Default: ''
    AllowedPattern: '^$|^(subnet-[0-9a-f]{8,17})(,subnet-[0-9a-f]{8,17})*$'
    ConstraintDescription: >-
      Must be an empty string or a comma-separated list of valid subnet IDs
      (subnet-xxxxxxxx).
  SecurityGroupIds:
    Type: String
    Description: >-
      Comma-separated list of security group IDs attached to the SageMaker Studio
      applications in the domain. If left empty, a dedicated security group is created.
    Default: ''
    AllowedPattern: '^$|^(sg-[0-9a-f]{8,17})(,sg-[0-9a-f]{8,17})*$'
    ConstraintDescription: >-
      Must be an empty string or a comma-separated list of valid security group IDs
      (sg-xxxxxxxx).

Metadata:
  AWS::CloudFormation::Interface:
    ParameterGroups:
      - Label:
          default: SageMaker Domain and test user
        Parameters:
          - DomainName
          - TestUserName
          - DefaultBucketArn
      - Label:
          default: Networking (leave empty to let this template create the network resources)
        Parameters:
          - VpcId
          - SubnetIds
          - SecurityGroupIds

Conditions:
  CreateVpc: !Equals [!Ref VpcId, '']
  CreateSubnets: !Equals [!Ref SubnetIds, '']
  UseProvidedSubnets: !Not [Condition: CreateSubnets]
  CreateSecurityGroups: !Equals [!Ref SecurityGroupIds, '']
  UseProvidedSecurityGroups: !Not [Condition: CreateSecurityGroups]
  CreateDefaultBucket: !Equals [!Ref DefaultBucketArn, '']
  UseProvidedBucket: !Not [Condition: CreateDefaultBucket]
  CreateVpcAndSubnets: !And [Condition: CreateVpc, Condition: CreateSubnets]

Resources:
  VPCNetwork:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPC
    Condition: CreateVpc
    Properties:
      CidrBlock: 10.0.0.0/16
      EnableDnsSupport: true
      EnableDnsHostnames: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-sagemaker-vpc'

  VPCRouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Condition: CreateVpc
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPCNetwork
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-sagemaker-route-table'

  S3GatewayEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Condition: CreateVpc
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPCNetwork
      ServiceName: !Sub 'com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.s3'
      VpcEndpointType: Gateway
      RouteTableIds:
        - !Ref VPCRouteTable

  SubnetPrivateA:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Condition: CreateSubnets
    Properties:
      VpcId: !If
        - CreateVpc
        - !Ref VPCNetwork
        - !Ref VpcId
      CidrBlock: 10.0.0.0/24
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs '']
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-sagemaker-subnet-a'

  SubnetPrivateB:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Condition: CreateSubnets
    Properties:
      VpcId: !If
        - CreateVpc
        - !Ref VPCNetwork
        - !Ref VpcId
      CidrBlock: 10.0.1.0/24
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [1, !GetAZs '']
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-sagemaker-subnet-b'

  SubnetARouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Condition: CreateVpcAndSubnets
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref SubnetPrivateA
      RouteTableId: !Ref VPCRouteTable

  SubnetBRouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Condition: CreateVpcAndSubnets
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref SubnetPrivateB
      RouteTableId: !Ref VPCRouteTable

  StudioAppSecurityGroup:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroup
    Condition: CreateSecurityGroups
    Properties:
      GroupDescription: Security group for SageMaker Studio applications in the VPC-only domain
      VpcId: !If
        - CreateVpc
        - !Ref VPCNetwork
        - !Ref VpcId
      SecurityGroupEgress:
        - IpProtocol: '-1'
          CidrIp: 0.0.0.0/0
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-sagemaker-studio-sg'

  StudioAppSecurityGroupSelfIngress:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroupIngress
    Condition: CreateSecurityGroups
    Properties:
      GroupId: !Ref StudioAppSecurityGroup
      SourceSecurityGroupId: !Ref StudioAppSecurityGroup
      Description: Allow all traffic between SageMaker Studio applications sharing this group
      IpProtocol: '-1'

  DefaultS3Bucket:
    Type: AWS::S3::Bucket
    Condition: CreateDefaultBucket
    Properties:
      BucketEncryption:
        ServerSideEncryptionConfiguration:
          - ServerSideEncryptionByDefault:
              SSEAlgorithm: AES256
      PublicAccessBlockConfiguration:
        BlockPublicAcls: true
        BlockPublicPolicy: true
        IgnorePublicAcls: true
        RestrictPublicBuckets: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-sagemaker-default-bucket'

  SageMakerExecutionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      Description: >-
        Dedicated execution role for the SageMaker Studio test user profile in the
        VPC-only domain.
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: AllowSageMakerToAssumeRole
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service:
                - sagemaker.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - sts:AssumeRole
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-sagemaker-test-user-role'
        - Key: sagemaker-domain
          Value: !Ref DomainName

  SageMakerUserRolePolicy:
    Type: AWS::IAM::ManagedPolicy
    Properties:
      Description: >-
        Permissions for the SageMaker test user: manage jobs, experiments, lineage,
        model registry, Studio apps, spaces and presigned URLs, read-write access to
        the default S3 bucket, and pass-role of the execution role to SageMaker.
      Roles:
        - !Ref SageMakerExecutionRole
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: SageMakerJobs
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - sagemaker:CreateTrainingJob
              - sagemaker:DescribeTrainingJob
              - sagemaker:ListTrainingJobs
              - sagemaker:StopTrainingJob
              - sagemaker:CreateTransformJob
              - sagemaker:DescribeTransformJob
              - sagemaker:ListTransformJobs
              - sagemaker:StopTransformJob
              - sagemaker:CreateProcessingJob
              - sagemaker:DescribeProcessingJob
              - sagemaker:ListProcessingJobs
              - sagemaker:StopProcessingJob
              - sagemaker:CreateAutoMLJob
              - sagemaker:CreateAutoMLJobV2
              - sagemaker:DescribeAutoMLJob
              - sagemaker:DescribeAutoMLJobV2
              - sagemaker:ListAutoMLJobs
              - sagemaker:StopAutoMLJob
              - sagemaker:ListCandidatesForAutoMLJob
              - sagemaker:CreateHyperParameterTuningJob
              - sagemaker:DescribeHyperParameterTuningJob
              - sagemaker:ListHyperParameterTuningJobs
              - sagemaker:StopHyperParameterTuningJob
              - sagemaker:ListTrainingJobsForHyperParameterTuningJob
              - sagemaker:Search
              - sagemaker:AddTags
              - sagemaker:DeleteTags
              - sagemaker:ListTags
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: SageMakerExperimentsAndLineage
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - sagemaker:CreateExperiment
              - sagemaker:DescribeExperiment
              - sagemaker:ListExperiments
              - sagemaker:UpdateExperiment
              - sagemaker:DeleteExperiment
              - sagemaker:CreateTrial
              - sagemaker:DescribeTrial
              - sagemaker:ListTrials
              - sagemaker:UpdateTrial
              - sagemaker:DeleteTrial
              - sagemaker:CreateTrialComponent
              - sagemaker:DescribeTrialComponent
              - sagemaker:ListTrialComponents
              - sagemaker:UpdateTrialComponent
              - sagemaker:DeleteTrialComponent
              - sagemaker:AssociateTrialComponent
              - sagemaker:DisassociateTrialComponent
              - sagemaker:CreateAction
              - sagemaker:DescribeAction
              - sagemaker:ListActions
              - sagemaker:UpdateAction
              - sagemaker:DeleteAction
              - sagemaker:CreateContext
              - sagemaker:DescribeContext
              - sagemaker:ListContexts
              - sagemaker:UpdateContext
              - sagemaker:DeleteContext
              - sagemaker:CreateArtifact
              - sagemaker:DescribeArtifact
              - sagemaker:ListArtifacts
              - sagemaker:UpdateArtifact
              - sagemaker:DeleteArtifact
              - sagemaker:AddAssociation
              - sagemaker:DeleteAssociation
              - sagemaker:ListAssociations
              - sagemaker:QueryLineage
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: SageMakerModelsAndModelRegistry
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - sagemaker:CreateModel
              - sagemaker:DescribeModel
              - sagemaker:ListModels
              - sagemaker:DeleteModel
              - sagemaker:CreateModelPackage
              - sagemaker:DescribeModelPackage
              - sagemaker:UpdateModelPackage
              - sagemaker:DeleteModelPackage
              - sagemaker:ListModelPackages
              - sagemaker:BatchDescribeModelPackage
              - sagemaker:CreateModelPackageGroup
              - sagemaker:DescribeModelPackageGroup
              - sagemaker:DeleteModelPackageGroup
              - sagemaker:ListModelPackageGroups
              - sagemaker:PutModelPackageGroupPolicy
              - sagemaker:GetModelPackageGroupPolicy
              - sagemaker:DeleteModelPackageGroupPolicy
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: SageMakerStudioAppsSpacesAndPresignedUrls
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - sagemaker:CreateApp
              - sagemaker:DescribeApp
              - sagemaker:ListApps
              - sagemaker:DeleteApp
              - sagemaker:CreateSpace
              - sagemaker:DescribeSpace
              - sagemaker:ListSpaces
              - sagemaker:UpdateSpace
              - sagemaker:DeleteSpace
              - sagemaker:CreatePresignedDomainUrl
              - sagemaker:DescribeDomain
              - sagemaker:ListDomains
              - sagemaker:DescribeUserProfile
              - sagemaker:ListUserProfiles
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: DefaultBucketObjectReadWrite
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - s3:GetObject
              - s3:PutObject
              - s3:DeleteObject
              - s3:AbortMultipartUpload
              - s3:ListMultipartUploadParts
            Resource: !If
              - UseProvidedBucket
              - !Sub '${DefaultBucketArn}/*'
              - !Sub '${DefaultS3Bucket.Arn}/*'
          - Sid: DefaultBucketList
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - s3:ListBucket
              - s3:GetBucketLocation
            Resource: !If
              - UseProvidedBucket
              - !Ref DefaultBucketArn
              - !GetAtt DefaultS3Bucket.Arn
          - Sid: PassExecutionRoleToSageMaker
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - iam:PassRole
            Resource: !GetAtt SageMakerExecutionRole.Arn
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                iam:PassedToService: sagemaker.amazonaws.com

  SageMakerDomain:
    Type: AWS::SageMaker::Domain
    Properties:
      DomainName: !Ref DomainName
      AuthMode: IAM
      AppNetworkAccessType: VpcOnly
      AppSecurityGroupManagement: Customer
      VpcId: !If
        - CreateVpc
        - !Ref VPCNetwork
        - !Ref VpcId
      SubnetIds: !If
        - UseProvidedSubnets
        - !Split [',', !Ref SubnetIds]
        - - !Ref SubnetPrivateA
          - !Ref SubnetPrivateB
      DefaultUserSettings:
        ExecutionRole: !GetAtt SageMakerExecutionRole.Arn
        SecurityGroups: !If
          - UseProvidedSecurityGroups
          - !Split [',', !Ref SecurityGroupIds]
          - - !Ref StudioAppSecurityGroup
      DefaultSpaceSettings:
        ExecutionRole: !GetAtt SageMakerExecutionRole.Arn
        SecurityGroups: !If
          - UseProvidedSecurityGroups
          - !Split [',', !Ref SecurityGroupIds]
          - - !Ref StudioAppSecurityGroup
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Ref DomainName
        - Key: stack
          Value: !Ref AWS::StackName

  SageMakerTestUserProfile:
    Type: AWS::SageMaker::UserProfile
    Properties:
      DomainId: !GetAtt SageMakerDomain.DomainId
      UserProfileName: !Ref TestUserName
      UserSettings:
        ExecutionRole: !GetAtt SageMakerExecutionRole.Arn
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Ref TestUserName
        - Key: sagemaker-domain
          Value: !Ref DomainName

Outputs:
  DomainId:
    Description: The ID of the SageMaker Domain.
    Value: !GetAtt SageMakerDomain.DomainId
  ExecutionRoleName:
    Description: The name of the dedicated SageMaker execution role for the test user.
    Value: !Ref SageMakerExecutionRole
  StudioConsoleUrl:
    Description: Direct URL to the SageMaker Studio console for the new domain.
    Value: !Sub 'https://${SageMakerDomain.DomainId}.studio.${AWS::Region}.sagemaker.aws'

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'

Description: >-
  Creates 19 saved Amazon CloudWatch Logs Insights queries for analyzing usage,
  performance, and cost metrics produced by a Claude Code application. All
  queries are scoped to the Claude Code metrics log group and are organized in
  the Logs Insights console under the folders ClaudeCode/RealTime,
  ClaudeCode/UserAnalytics, ClaudeCode/CostAttribution, and ClaudeCode/Analysis.

Parameters:
  LogGroupName:
    Type: String
    Default: /aws/claude-code/metrics
    Description: Name of the CloudWatch Logs log group containing Claude Code metric events. All saved queries will be scoped to this log group.
    AllowedPattern: '^[a-zA-Z0-9_./-]{1,512}$'
    ConstraintDescription: Log group name may only contain letters, numbers, periods, underscores, hyphens, and slashes.

Metadata:
  AWS::CloudFormation::Interface:
    ParameterGroups:
      - Label:
          default: Claude Code Metrics Log Source
        Parameters:
          - LogGroupName
    ParameterLabels:
      LogGroupName:
        default: Metrics Log Group

Resources:
  TokenRatePerUserQuery:
    Type: AWS::Logs::QueryDefinition
    Properties:
      Name: ClaudeCode/RealTime/TokenRatePerUser
      LogGroupNames:
        - !Ref LogGroupName
      QueryString: |
        fields @timestamp, userId, inputTokens, outputTokens
        | stats sum(inputTokens) as inputTokensPerMin, sum(outputTokens) as outputTokensPerMin, sum(inputTokens + outputTokens) as totalTokensPerMin by bin(1m) as timeBin, userId
        | sort timeBin desc
        | limit 100

  RequestRatePerUserQuery:
    Type: AWS::Logs::QueryDefinition
    Properties:
      Name: ClaudeCode/RealTime/RequestRatePerUser
      LogGroupNames:
        - !Ref LogGroupName
      QueryString: |
        fields @timestamp, userId
        | stats count(*) as requestsPerMin by userId, bin(1m) as timeBin
        | sort timeBin desc
        | limit 100

  CurrentTPMAverageQuery:
    Type: AWS::Logs::QueryDefinition
    Properties:
      Name: ClaudeCode/RealTime/CurrentTPMAverage
      LogGroupNames:
        - !Ref LogGroupName
      QueryString: |
        fields @timestamp, inputTokens, outputTokens
        | stats sum(inputTokens + outputTokens) as tokensPerMin by bin(1m) as timeBin
        | stats avg(tokensPerMin) as avgTPM, max(tokensPerMin) as peakTPM, max(timeBin) as latestMinute

  CurrentRPMAverageQuery:
    Type: AWS::Logs::QueryDefinition
    Properties:
      Name: ClaudeCode/RealTime/CurrentRPMAverage
      LogGroupNames:
        - !Ref LogGroupName
      QueryString: |
        fields @timestamp
        | stats count(*) as requestsPerMin by bin(1m) as timeBin
        | stats avg(requestsPerMin) as avgRPM, max(requestsPerMin) as peakRPM, max(timeBin) as latestMinute

  RateLimitRiskQuery:
    Type: AWS::Logs::QueryDefinition
    Properties:
      Name: ClaudeCode/RealTime/RateLimitRisk
      LogGroupNames:
        - !Ref LogGroupName
      QueryString: |
        fields @timestamp, userId, inputTokens, outputTokens
        | stats count(*) as requestsPerMin, sum(inputTokens + outputTokens) as tokensPerMin by userId, bin(1m) as timeBin
        | filter requestsPerMin > 40 or tokensPerMin > 80000
        | sort tokensPerMin desc
        | limit 50

  SessionLevelUsageQuery:
    Type: AWS::Logs::QueryDefinition
    Properties:
      Name: ClaudeCode/UserAnalytics/SessionLevelUsage
      LogGroupNames:
        - !Ref LogGroupName
      QueryString: |
        fields @timestamp, sessionId, userId, model, inputTokens, outputTokens
        | stats count(*) as requests, sum(inputTokens) as inputTokens, sum(outputTokens) as outputTokens, sum(inputTokens + outputTokens) as totalTokens, min(@timestamp) as sessionStart, max(@timestamp) as sessionEnd by sessionId, userId
        | sort totalTokens desc
        | limit 100

  HourlyActivityTimelineQuery:
    Type: AWS::Logs::QueryDefinition
    Properties:
      Name: ClaudeCode/UserAnalytics/HourlyActivityTimeline
      LogGroupNames:
        - !Ref LogGroupName
      QueryString: |
        fields @timestamp, userId, sessionId, inputTokens, outputTokens
        | stats count(*) as requests, sum(inputTokens) as inputTokens, sum(outputTokens) as outputTokens, count_distinct(userId) as activeUsers, count_distinct(sessionId) as activeSessions by bin(1h) as hour
        | sort hour desc
        | limit 48

  ErrorThrottlingDetectionQuery:
    Type: AWS::Logs::QueryDefinition
    Properties:
      Name: ClaudeCode/UserAnalytics/ErrorThrottlingDetection
      LogGroupNames:
        - !Ref LogGroupName
      QueryString: |
        fields @timestamp, userId, sessionId, model, statusCode, errorCode, errorMessage
        | filter (ispresent(statusCode) and statusCode >= 400) or ispresent(errorCode) or ispresent(errorMessage)
        | stats count(*) as errorCount, max(@timestamp) as lastSeen by userId, statusCode, errorCode
        | sort errorCount desc
        | limit 100

  CostByUserQuery:
    Type: AWS::Logs::QueryDefinition
    Properties:
      Name: ClaudeCode/CostAttribution/CostByUser
      LogGroupNames:
        - !Ref LogGroupName
      QueryString: |
        fields @timestamp, userId, cost, inputTokens, outputTokens
        | filter ispresent(cost)
        | stats sum(cost) as totalCost, count(*) as requests, sum(inputTokens + outputTokens) as totalTokens by userId
        | sort totalCost desc
        | limit 100

  CostByModelQuery:
    Type: AWS::Logs::QueryDefinition
    Properties:
      Name: ClaudeCode/CostAttribution/CostByModel
      LogGroupNames:
        - !Ref LogGroupName
      QueryString: |
        fields @timestamp, model, cost, inputTokens, outputTokens
        | filter ispresent(cost)
        | stats sum(cost) as totalCost, count(*) as requests, sum(inputTokens) as inputTokens, sum(outputTokens) as outputTokens by model
        | sort totalCost desc

  CostByOrganizationQuery:
    Type: AWS::Logs::QueryDefinition
    Properties:
      Name: ClaudeCode/CostAttribution/CostByOrganization
      LogGroupNames:
        - !Ref LogGroupName
      QueryString: |
        fields @timestamp, organizationId, userId, sessionId, cost
        | filter ispresent(cost)
        | stats sum(cost) as totalCost, count_distinct(userId) as activeUsers, count_distinct(sessionId) as activeSessions, count(*) as requests by organizationId
        | sort totalCost desc

  ModelEfficiencyQuery:
    Type: AWS::Logs::QueryDefinition
    Properties:
      Name: ClaudeCode/Analysis/ModelEfficiency
      LogGroupNames:
        - !Ref LogGroupName
      QueryString: |
        fields @timestamp, model, inputTokens, outputTokens, cacheReadTokens, cacheCreationTokens
        | stats sum(inputTokens) as totalInputTokens, sum(outputTokens) as totalOutputTokens, sum(cacheReadTokens) as totalCacheReadTokens, sum(cacheCreationTokens) as totalCacheCreationTokens, sum(outputTokens) * 1.0 / sum(inputTokens) as outputToInputRatio, count(*) as requests by model
        | sort totalOutputTokens desc

  CacheHitMissRateQuery:
    Type: AWS::Logs::QueryDefinition
    Properties:
      Name: ClaudeCode/Analysis/CacheHitMissRateOverall
      LogGroupNames:
        - !Ref LogGroupName
      QueryString: |
        fields @timestamp, inputTokens, outputTokens, cacheReadTokens, cacheCreationTokens
        | stats sum(cacheReadTokens) as totalCacheReadTokens, sum(cacheCreationTokens) as totalCacheCreationTokens, sum(inputTokens) as totalUncachedInputTokens, sum(cacheReadTokens) * 100.0 / (sum(cacheReadTokens) + sum(cacheCreationTokens) + sum(inputTokens)) as cacheHitRatePct, sum(inputTokens + outputTokens) as totalTokens

  CacheHitRateOverTimeQuery:
    Type: AWS::Logs::QueryDefinition
    Properties:
      Name: ClaudeCode/Analysis/CacheHitRateOverTime
      LogGroupNames:
        - !Ref LogGroupName
      QueryString: |
        fields @timestamp, inputTokens, cacheReadTokens, cacheCreationTokens
        | stats sum(cacheReadTokens) as cacheReadTokens, sum(cacheCreationTokens) as cacheCreationTokens, sum(inputTokens) as uncachedInputTokens, sum(cacheReadTokens) * 100.0 / (sum(cacheReadTokens) + sum(cacheCreationTokens) + sum(inputTokens)) as cacheHitRatePct by bin(1h) as hour
        | sort hour desc
        | limit 48

  CacheHitRateBySessionQuery:
    Type: AWS::Logs::QueryDefinition
    Properties:
      Name: ClaudeCode/Analysis/CacheHitRateBySession
      LogGroupNames:
        - !Ref LogGroupName
      QueryString: |
        fields @timestamp, sessionId, userId, inputTokens, cacheReadTokens, cacheCreationTokens
        | stats sum(cacheReadTokens) as cacheReadTokens, sum(cacheCreationTokens) as cacheCreationTokens, sum(inputTokens) as uncachedInputTokens, sum(cacheReadTokens) * 100.0 / (sum(cacheReadTokens) + sum(cacheCreationTokens) + sum(inputTokens)) as cacheHitRatePct by sessionId, userId
        | sort cacheReadTokens desc
        | limit 100

  PeakUsageWindowsQuery:
    Type: AWS::Logs::QueryDefinition
    Properties:
      Name: ClaudeCode/Analysis/PeakUsageWindows
      LogGroupNames:
        - !Ref LogGroupName
      QueryString: |
        fields @timestamp, userId, sessionId, inputTokens, outputTokens
        | stats count(*) as requests, sum(inputTokens + outputTokens) as totalTokens, count_distinct(userId) as activeUsers by bin(5m) as window
        | sort totalTokens desc
        | limit 20

  SessionDeepDiveQuery:
    Type: AWS::Logs::QueryDefinition
    Properties:
      Name: ClaudeCode/Analysis/SessionDeepDive
      LogGroupNames:
        - !Ref LogGroupName
      QueryString: |
        filter sessionId = 'REPLACE_WITH_SESSION_ID'
        | fields @timestamp, @message, userId, model, requestId, inputTokens, outputTokens, cacheReadTokens, cacheCreationTokens, cost, statusCode
        | sort @timestamp asc
        | limit 500

  FieldExplorerQuery:
    Type: AWS::Logs::QueryDefinition
    Properties:
      Name: ClaudeCode/Analysis/FieldExplorer
      LogGroupNames:
        - !Ref LogGroupName
      QueryString: |
        fields @timestamp, @message, @logStream
        | sort @timestamp desc
        | limit 25

  DailyUsageSummaryQuery:
    Type: AWS::Logs::QueryDefinition
    Properties:
      Name: ClaudeCode/Analysis/DailyUsageSummary
      LogGroupNames:
        - !Ref LogGroupName
      QueryString: |
        fields @timestamp, userId, sessionId, model, inputTokens, outputTokens, cost
        | stats count(*) as requests, count_distinct(userId) as activeUsers, count_distinct(sessionId) as activeSessions, sum(inputTokens) as inputTokens, sum(outputTokens) as outputTokens, sum(cost) as totalCost by bin(1d) as day
        | sort day desc
        | limit 30

Outputs:
  LogGroupName:
    Description: CloudWatch Logs log group that all saved queries are scoped to.
    Value: !Ref LogGroupName
  RealTimeQueries:
    Description: Saved queries in the ClaudeCode/RealTime folder (token rate, request rate, TPM/RPM averages, rate-limit risk).
    Value: !Join [', ', [!Ref TokenRatePerUserQuery, !Ref RequestRatePerUserQuery, !Ref CurrentTPMAverageQuery, !Ref CurrentRPMAverageQuery, !Ref RateLimitRiskQuery]]
  UserAndSessionQueries:
    Description: Saved queries in the ClaudeCode/UserAnalytics folder (session usage, hourly timeline, error and throttling detection).
    Value: !Join [', ', [!Ref SessionLevelUsageQuery, !Ref HourlyActivityTimelineQuery, !Ref ErrorThrottlingDetectionQuery]]
  CostAttributionQueries:
    Description: Saved queries in the ClaudeCode/CostAttribution folder (cost by user, model, and organization).
    Value: !Join [', ', [!Ref CostByUserQuery, !Ref CostByModelQuery, !Ref CostByOrganizationQuery]]
  DebuggingAnalysisQueries:
    Description: Saved queries in the ClaudeCode/Analysis folder (model efficiency, cache rates, peak windows, session deep dive, field explorer, daily summary).
    Value: !Join [', ', [!Ref ModelEfficiencyQuery, !Ref CacheHitMissRateQuery, !Ref CacheHitRateOverTimeQuery, !Ref CacheHitRateBySessionQuery, !Ref PeakUsageWindowsQuery, !Ref SessionDeepDiveQuery, !Ref FieldExplorerQuery, !Ref DailyUsageSummaryQuery]]

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >-
  AppSync GraphQL API SuperCoolAPI with AWS IAM authentication and full CloudWatch
  request logging, backed by an on-demand DynamoDB table named Table1. Multiple
  DynamoDB data sources attach to the table using different approaches to table and
  region referencing, IAM roles and policies grant full read-write access to the
  table and its secondary indexes, and resolvers implement getTodo and addTodo.

Metadata:
  AWS::CloudFormation::Interface:
    ParameterGroups:
      - Label:
          default: DynamoDB Configuration
        Parameters:
          - DynamoDBTableName
    ParameterLabels:
      DynamoDBTableName:
        default: DynamoDB Table Name

Parameters:
  DynamoDBTableName:
    Type: String
    Default: Table1
    Description: Physical table name used by the parameterized DynamoDB data source.
    AllowedPattern: '[a-zA-Z0-9_.-]{3,255}'
    ConstraintDescription: Table name must be 3-255 characters of a-z, A-Z, 0-9, _ . and -.

Resources:
  Table1:
    Type: AWS::DynamoDB::Table
    Properties:
      TableName: Table1
      AttributeDefinitions:
        - AttributeName: id
          AttributeType: S
        - AttributeName: description
          AttributeType: S
      KeySchema:
        - AttributeName: id
          KeyType: HASH
      BillingMode: PAY_PER_REQUEST
      GlobalSecondaryIndexes:
        - IndexName: description-index
          KeySchema:
            - AttributeName: description
              KeyType: HASH
          Projection:
            ProjectionType: ALL
      SSESpecification:
        SSEEnabled: true
      PointInTimeRecoverySpecification:
        PointInTimeRecoveryEnabled: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: Table1
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: CloudFormation

  SuperCoolAPICloudWatchLogsRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: appsync.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: SuperCoolAPICloudWatchLogsPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogGroup
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                  - logs:DescribeLogStreams
                Resource:
                  - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:logs:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:*'

  AppSyncDynamoDBServiceRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: appsync.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: SuperCoolAPIDynamoDBReadWrite
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - dynamodb:BatchGetItem
                  - dynamodb:BatchWriteItem
                  - dynamodb:ConditionCheckItem
                  - dynamodb:DeleteItem
                  - dynamodb:DescribeTable
                  - dynamodb:GetItem
                  - dynamodb:PutItem
                  - dynamodb:Query
                  - dynamodb:Scan
                  - dynamodb:UpdateItem
                Resource:
                  - !GetAtt Table1.Arn
                  - !Sub '${Table1.Arn}/index/*'

  SuperCoolAPI:
    Type: AWS::AppSync::GraphQLApi
    Properties:
      Name: SuperCoolAPI
      AuthenticationType: AWS_IAM
      LogConfig:
        CloudWatchLogsRoleArn: !GetAtt SuperCoolAPICloudWatchLogsRole.Arn
        FieldLogLevel: ALL

  SuperCoolAPISchema:
    Type: AWS::AppSync::GraphQLSchema
    Properties:
      ApiId: !GetAtt SuperCoolAPI.ApiId
      Definition: |
        type Todo {
          id: ID!
          description: String
        }

        type Query {
          getTodo(id: ID!): Todo
        }

        type Mutation {
          addTodo(id: ID!, description: String!): Todo
        }

        schema {
          query: Query
          mutation: Mutation
        }

  Table1DataSourceLiteral:
    Type: AWS::AppSync::DataSource
    Properties:
      ApiId: !GetAtt SuperCoolAPI.ApiId
      Name: Table1Literal
      Description: References the table by literal name and the region via the AWS::Region pseudo parameter.
      Type: AMAZON_DYNAMODB
      ServiceRoleArn: !GetAtt AppSyncDynamoDBServiceRole.Arn
      DynamoDBConfig:
        TableName: Table1
        AwsRegion: !Ref 'AWS::Region'

  Table1DataSourceRef:
    Type: AWS::AppSync::DataSource
    Properties:
      ApiId: !GetAtt SuperCoolAPI.ApiId
      Name: Table1Ref
      Description: References the table via Fn::Ref of the table resource and the region via Fn::Sub.
      Type: AMAZON_DYNAMODB
      ServiceRoleArn: !GetAtt AppSyncDynamoDBServiceRole.Arn
      DynamoDBConfig:
        TableName: !Ref Table1
        AwsRegion: !Sub '${AWS::Region}'

  Table1DataSourceSub:
    Type: AWS::AppSync::DataSource
    Properties:
      ApiId: !GetAtt SuperCoolAPI.ApiId
      Name: Table1Sub
      Description: References both the table name and the region via Fn::Sub string interpolation.
      Type: AMAZON_DYNAMODB
      ServiceRoleArn: !GetAtt AppSyncDynamoDBServiceRole.Arn
      DynamoDBConfig:
        TableName: !Sub '${Table1}'
        AwsRegion: !Sub '${AWS::Region}'

  Table1DataSourceParameter:
    Type: AWS::AppSync::DataSource
    Properties:
      ApiId: !GetAtt SuperCoolAPI.ApiId
      Name: Table1Parameterized
      Description: References the table name through the DynamoDBTableName template parameter.
      Type: AMAZON_DYNAMODB
      ServiceRoleArn: !GetAtt AppSyncDynamoDBServiceRole.Arn
      DynamoDBConfig:
        TableName: !Ref DynamoDBTableName
        AwsRegion: !Ref 'AWS::Region'

  GetTodoResolver:
    Type: AWS::AppSync::Resolver
    DependsOn: SuperCoolAPISchema
    Properties:
      ApiId: !GetAtt SuperCoolAPI.ApiId
      TypeName: Query
      FieldName: getTodo
      DataSourceName: !GetAtt Table1DataSourceLiteral.Name
      RequestMappingTemplate: |
        {
          "version": "2017-02-28",
          "operation": "GetItem",
          "key": {
            "id": $util.dynamodb.toDynamoDBJson($ctx.args.id)
          }
        }
      ResponseMappingTemplate: |
        $util.toJson($ctx.result)

  AddTodoResolver:
    Type: AWS::AppSync::Resolver
    DependsOn: SuperCoolAPISchema
    Properties:
      ApiId: !GetAtt SuperCoolAPI.ApiId
      TypeName: Mutation
      FieldName: addTodo
      DataSourceName: !GetAtt Table1DataSourceRef.Name
      RequestMappingTemplate: |
        {
          "version": "2017-02-28",
          "operation": "PutItem",
          "key": {
            "id": $util.dynamodb.toDynamoDBJson($ctx.args.id)
          },
          "attributeValues": {
            "description": $util.dynamodb.toDynamoDBJson($ctx.args.description)
          }
        }
      ResponseMappingTemplate: |
        $util.toJson($ctx.result)

Outputs:
  GraphQlApiEndpoint:
    Description: Endpoint URL of the SuperCoolAPI GraphQL API.
    Value: !GetAtt SuperCoolAPI.GraphQLUrl
  GraphQlApiId:
    Description: Unique AppSync API identifier for SuperCoolAPI.
    Value: !GetAtt SuperCoolAPI.ApiId
  GraphQlApiArn:
    Description: ARN of the SuperCoolAPI GraphQL API.
    Value: !GetAtt SuperCoolAPI.Arn
  DynamoDBTable1Name:
    Description: Name of the DynamoDB table backing the GraphQL API.
    Value: !Ref Table1
  DynamoDBTable1Arn:
    Description: ARN of the DynamoDB table backing the GraphQL API.
    Value: !GetAtt Table1.Arn

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: "2010-09-09"

Description: >-
  Provisions the IAM identities and permission policies required by the
  Cluster API Provider AWS (CAPA) bootstrap process for a cluster that uses
  Amazon EKS with managed node groups and Fargate support. Creates EC2
  assumable control plane, controllers (also assumable by EKS pods) and node
  roles with matching instance profiles, three EKS service roles for the
  cluster control plane, Fargate pods and managed node groups, and customer
  managed policies for the legacy in-tree AWS cloud provider, node
  registration and image pulls, CAPA controller infrastructure management,
  and EKS cluster lifecycle operations.

Parameters:
  ClusterName:
    Type: String
    Description: >-
      Name of the workload cluster, used to prefix the names of the IAM roles,
      instance profiles and customer managed policies created by this stack.
      Limited to 37 characters so that the longest generated IAM role name
      remains within the 64 character IAM limit.
    Default: capa-eks-cluster
    MinLength: 1
    MaxLength: 37
    AllowedPattern: "^[a-zA-Z0-9][a-zA-Z0-9-]{0,36}$"
    ConstraintDescription: >-
      Cluster name must start with an alphanumeric character and may contain
      only alphanumeric characters and hyphens (up to 37 characters).

Resources:

  ###########################################################################
  # Control plane role (assumable by EC2) and its matching instance profile
  ###########################################################################

  ControlPlaneRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub "${ClusterName}-control-plane"
      Description: >-
        Role assumed by EC2 for the CAPA control plane, including instances
        running the legacy in-tree AWS cloud provider.
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service:
                - ec2.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - sts:AssumeRole
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${ClusterName}-control-plane"
        - Key: sigs.k8s.io/cluster-api-provider-aws/role
          Value: control-plane

  ControlPlaneInstanceProfile:
    Type: AWS::IAM::InstanceProfile
    Properties:
      InstanceProfileName: !Sub "${ClusterName}-control-plane"
      Roles:
        - !Ref ControlPlaneRole

  ###########################################################################
  # Controllers role (assumable by EC2 and EKS pods) and its instance profile
  ###########################################################################

  ControllersRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub "${ClusterName}-controllers"
      Description: >-
        Role assumed by EC2 and by EKS pods (via the EKS Pod Identity agent)
        for the Cluster API Provider AWS controllers.
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service:
                - ec2.amazonaws.com
                - eks.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - sts:AssumeRole
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service:
                - pods.eks.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - sts:AssumeRole
              - sts:TagSession
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                aws:SourceAccount: !Ref AWS::AccountId
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${ClusterName}-controllers"
        - Key: sigs.k8s.io/cluster-api-provider-aws/role
          Value: controllers

  ControllersInstanceProfile:
    Type: AWS::IAM::InstanceProfile
    Properties:
      InstanceProfileName: !Sub "${ClusterName}-controllers"
      Roles:
        - !Ref ControllersRole

  ###########################################################################
  # Nodes role (assumable by EC2) and its matching instance profile
  ###########################################################################

  NodesRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub "${ClusterName}-nodes"
      Description: >-
        Role assumed by EC2 for cluster nodes (worker machines) registered
        with the EKS cluster.
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service:
                - ec2.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/AmazonEKSWorkerNodePolicy"
        - !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/AmazonEKS_CNI_Policy"
        - !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/AmazonEC2ContainerRegistryReadOnly"
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${ClusterName}-nodes"
        - Key: sigs.k8s.io/cluster-api-provider-aws/role
          Value: node

  NodesInstanceProfile:
    Type: AWS::IAM::InstanceProfile
    Properties:
      InstanceProfileName: !Sub "${ClusterName}-nodes"
      Roles:
        - !Ref NodesRole

  ###########################################################################
  # EKS service roles
  ###########################################################################

  EKSControlPlaneRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub "${ClusterName}-eks-cluster-role"
      Description: Role assumed by the Amazon EKS service for the cluster control plane.
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service:
                - eks.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/AmazonEKSClusterPolicy"
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${ClusterName}-eks-cluster-role"

  EKSFargateExecutionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub "${ClusterName}-eks-fargate-execution-role"
      Description: Role assumed by the EKS Fargate pods service for pods in Fargate profiles.
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service:
                - eks-fargate-pods.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - sts:AssumeRole
