AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >-
  Shared VPC supporting EMR on EKS and a Celeborn shuffle service cluster. Creates a
  VPC with two public and two private subnets across two Availability Zones (resolved
  automatically from the region), an Internet Gateway, one NAT Gateway per
  Availability Zone, an S3 gateway endpoint, interface VPC endpoints for Systems
  Manager, EC2, CloudWatch Logs, CloudWatch Monitoring, STS, EMR and KMS protected by
  a dedicated security group, and VPC Flow Logs for ALL traffic encrypted with a
  customer managed KMS key delivered to a CloudWatch Logs log group through a
  dedicated IAM role.

Metadata:
  AWS::CloudFormation::Interface:
    ParameterGroups:
      - Label:
          default: VPC configuration
        Parameters:
          - VpcCidr
      - Label:
          default: Subnet configuration
        Parameters:
          - PublicSubnet1Cidr
          - PublicSubnet2Cidr
          - PrivateSubnet1Cidr
          - PrivateSubnet2Cidr
      - Label:
          default: Flow Logs configuration
        Parameters:
          - FlowLogsRetentionInDays
    ParameterLabels:
      FlowLogsRetentionInDays:
        default: Flow logs retention (days)
      PrivateSubnet1Cidr:
        default: Private subnet 1 CIDR
      PrivateSubnet2Cidr:
        default: Private subnet 2 CIDR
      PublicSubnet1Cidr:
        default: Public subnet 1 CIDR
      PublicSubnet2Cidr:
        default: Public subnet 2 CIDR
      VpcCidr:
        default: VPC CIDR block

Parameters:
  VpcCidr:
    Type: String
    Description: CIDR block for the shared VPC.
    Default: 10.0.0.0/16
    AllowedPattern: ^(([0-9]|[1-9][0-9]|1[0-9]{2}|2[0-4][0-9]|25[0-5])\.){3}([0-9]|[1-9][0-9]|1[0-9]{2}|2[0-4][0-9]|25[0-5])(/(1[6-9]|2[0-4]))$
    ConstraintDescription: Must be a valid IPv4 CIDR block with a prefix between /16 and /24.
  PublicSubnet1Cidr:
    Type: String
    Description: CIDR block for public subnet 1 (first Availability Zone).
    Default: 10.0.0.0/20
    AllowedPattern: ^(([0-9]|[1-9][0-9]|1[0-9]{2}|2[0-4][0-9]|25[0-5])\.){3}([0-9]|[1-9][0-9]|1[0-9]{2}|2[0-4][0-9]|25[0-5])(/(1[6-9]|2[0-8]))$
    ConstraintDescription: Must be a valid IPv4 CIDR block with a prefix between /16 and /28.
  PublicSubnet2Cidr:
    Type: String
    Description: CIDR block for public subnet 2 (second Availability Zone).
    Default: 10.0.16.0/20
    AllowedPattern: ^(([0-9]|[1-9][0-9]|1[0-9]{2}|2[0-4][0-9]|25[0-5])\.){3}([0-9]|[1-9][0-9]|1[0-9]{2}|2[0-4][0-9]|25[0-5])(/(1[6-9]|2[0-8]))$
    ConstraintDescription: Must be a valid IPv4 CIDR block with a prefix between /16 and /28.
  PrivateSubnet1Cidr:
    Type: String
    Description: CIDR block for private subnet 1 (first Availability Zone).
    Default: 10.0.32.0/20
    AllowedPattern: ^(([0-9]|[1-9][0-9]|1[0-9]{2}|2[0-4][0-9]|25[0-5])\.){3}([0-9]|[1-9][0-9]|1[0-9]{2}|2[0-4][0-9]|25[0-5])(/(1[6-9]|2[0-8]))$
    ConstraintDescription: Must be a valid IPv4 CIDR block with a prefix between /16 and /28.
  PrivateSubnet2Cidr:
    Type: String
    Description: CIDR block for private subnet 2 (second Availability Zone).
    Default: 10.0.48.0/20
    AllowedPattern: ^(([0-9]|[1-9][0-9]|1[0-9]{2}|2[0-4][0-9]|25[0-5])\.){3}([0-9]|[1-9][0-9]|1[0-9]{2}|2[0-4][0-9]|25[0-5])(/(1[6-9]|2[0-8]))$
    ConstraintDescription: Must be a valid IPv4 CIDR block with a prefix between /16 and /28.
  FlowLogsRetentionInDays:
    Type: Number
    Description: Retention period in days for the VPC flow logs CloudWatch Logs log group.
    Default: 30
    AllowedValues:
      - 1
      - 3
      - 5
      - 7
      - 14
      - 30
      - 60
      - 90
      - 120
      - 150
      - 180
      - 365
      - 400
      - 545
      - 731
      - 1096
      - 1827
      - 2192
      - 2557
      - 2922
      - 3288
      - 3653

Resources:
  VPC:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPC
    Properties:
      CidrBlock: !Ref VpcCidr
      EnableDnsHostnames: true
      EnableDnsSupport: true
      InstanceTenancy: default
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-vpc'

  InternetGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::InternetGateway
    Properties:
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-igw'

  InternetGatewayAttachment:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      InternetGatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway
      VpcId: !Ref VPC

  PublicSubnet1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      AvailabilityZone: !Select
        - 0
        - !GetAZs ''
      CidrBlock: !Ref PublicSubnet1Cidr
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-public-subnet-1'
        - Key: kubernetes.io/role/elb
          Value: '1'
      VpcId: !Ref VPC

  PublicSubnet2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      AvailabilityZone: !Select
        - 1
        - !GetAZs ''
      CidrBlock: !Ref PublicSubnet2Cidr
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-public-subnet-2'
        - Key: kubernetes.io/role/elb
          Value: '1'
      VpcId: !Ref VPC

  PrivateSubnet1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      AvailabilityZone: !Select
        - 0
        - !GetAZs ''
      CidrBlock: !Ref PrivateSubnet1Cidr
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-private-subnet-1'
        - Key: kubernetes.io/role/internal-elb
          Value: '1'
      VpcId: !Ref VPC

  PrivateSubnet2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      AvailabilityZone: !Select
        - 1
        - !GetAZs ''
      CidrBlock: !Ref PrivateSubnet2Cidr
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-private-subnet-2'
        - Key: kubernetes.io/role/internal-elb
          Value: '1'
      VpcId: !Ref VPC

  NatGatewayEIP1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::EIP
    DependsOn: InternetGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      Domain: vpc
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-nat-eip-1'

  NatGateway1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NatGateway
    DependsOn: InternetGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      AllocationId: !GetAtt NatGatewayEIP1.AllocationId
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet1
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-nat-gateway-1'

  NatGatewayEIP2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::EIP
    DependsOn: InternetGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      Domain: vpc
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-nat-eip-2'

  NatGateway2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NatGateway
    DependsOn: InternetGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      AllocationId: !GetAtt NatGatewayEIP2.AllocationId
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet2
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-nat-gateway-2'

  PublicRouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-public-rt'

  PublicRoute:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    DependsOn: InternetGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      GatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable

  PublicSubnet1RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet1

  PublicSubnet2RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet2

  PrivateRouteTable1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-private-rt-1'

  PrivateRoute1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    Properties:
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      NatGatewayId: !Ref NatGateway1
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable1

  PrivateRouteTable2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-private-rt-2'

  PrivateRoute2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    Properties:
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      NatGatewayId: !Ref NatGateway2
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable2

  PrivateSubnet1RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable1
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnet1

  PrivateSubnet2RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable2
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnet2

  S3GatewayEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:
      PolicyDocument:
        Statement:
          - Action: 's3:*'
            Effect: Allow
            Principal: '*'
            Resource: '*'
        Version: '2012-10-17'
      RouteTableIds:
        - !Ref PublicRouteTable
        - !Ref PrivateRouteTable1
        - !Ref PrivateRouteTable2
      ServiceName: !Sub 'com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.s3'
      VpcEndpointType: Gateway
      VpcId: !Ref VPC

  VpcEndpointSecurityGroup:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroup
    Properties:
      GroupDescription: Allows HTTPS access to the interface VPC endpoints only from the VPC CIDR.
      GroupName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-vpc-endpoints-sg'
      SecurityGroupIngress:
        - CidrIp: !Ref VpcCidr
          Description: Allow HTTPS from within the VPC to the interface endpoints.
          FromPort: 443
          IpProtocol: tcp
          ToPort: 443
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-vpc-endpoints-sg'
      VpcId: !Ref VPC

  VpcEndpointSSM:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:
      PrivateDnsEnabled: true
      SecurityGroupIds:
        - !Ref VpcEndpointSecurityGroup
      ServiceName: !Sub 'com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.ssm'
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet1
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet2
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-vpce-ssm'
      VpcEndpointType: Interface
      VpcId: !Ref VPC

  VpcEndpointEC2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:
      PrivateDnsEnabled: true
      SecurityGroupIds:
        - !Ref VpcEndpointSecurityGroup
      ServiceName: !Sub 'com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.ec2'
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet1
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet2
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-vpce-ec2'
      VpcEndpointType: Interface
      VpcId: !Ref VPC

  VpcEndpointLogs:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:
      PrivateDnsEnabled: true
      SecurityGroupIds:
        - !Ref VpcEndpointSecurityGroup
      ServiceName: !Sub 'com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.logs'
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet1
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet2
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-vpce-logs'
      VpcEndpointType: Interface
      VpcId: !Ref VPC

  VpcEndpointMonitoring:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:
      PrivateDnsEnabled: true
      SecurityGroupIds:
        - !Ref VpcEndpointSecurityGroup
      ServiceName: !Sub 'com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.monitoring'
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet1
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet2
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-vpce-monitoring'
      VpcEndpointType: Interface
      VpcId: !Ref VPC

  VpcEndpointSTS:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:
      PrivateDnsEnabled: true
      SecurityGroupIds:
        - !Ref VpcEndpointSecurityGroup
      ServiceName: !Sub 'com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.sts'
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet1
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet2
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-vpce-sts'
      VpcEndpointType: Interface
      VpcId: !Ref VPC

  VpcEndpointEMR:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:
      PrivateDnsEnabled: true
      SecurityGroupIds:
        - !Ref VpcEndpointSecurityGroup
      ServiceName: !Sub 'com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.elasticmapreduce'
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet1
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet2
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-vpce-emr'
      VpcEndpointType: Interface
      VpcId: !Ref VPC

  VpcEndpointKMS:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:
      PrivateDnsEnabled: true
      SecurityGroupIds:
        - !Ref VpcEndpointSecurityGroup
      ServiceName: !Sub 'com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.kms'
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet1
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet2
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-vpce-kms'
      VpcEndpointType: Interface
      VpcId: !Ref VPC

  FlowLogsKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      Description: Customer managed key used to encrypt the VPC flow logs log group.
      Enabled: true
      EnableKeyRotation: true
      KeyPolicy:
        Statement:
          - Action: 'kms:*'
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub 'arn:aws:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root'
            Resource: '*'
            Sid: EnableIAMUserPermissions
          - Action:
              - 'kms:Encrypt*'
              - 'kms:Decrypt*'
              - 'kms:ReEncrypt*'
              - 'kms:GenerateDataKey*'
              - 'kms:Describe*'
            Condition:
              ArnLike:
                'kms:EncryptionContext:aws:logs:arn': !Sub 'arn:aws:logs:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:log-group:/${AWS::StackName}/vpc-flow-logs*'
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: !Sub 'logs.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com'
            Resource: '*'
            Sid: AllowCloudWatchLogsToUseTheKey
          - Action:
              - 'kms:Encrypt*'
              - 'kms:Decrypt*'
              - 'kms:ReEncrypt*'
              - 'kms:GenerateDataKey*'
              - 'kms:Describe*'
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                aws:SourceAccount: !Ref 'AWS::AccountId'
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: vpc-flow-logs.amazonaws.com
            Resource: '*'
            Sid: AllowVPCFlowLogsServiceToUseTheKey
        Version: '2012-10-17'
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-flow-logs-key'

  FlowLogsLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    Properties:
      KmsKeyId: !GetAtt FlowLogsKey.Arn
      LogGroupName: !Sub '/${AWS::StackName}/vpc-flow-logs'
      RetentionInDays: !Ref FlowLogsRetentionInDays
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-vpc-flow-logs'

  FlowLogsRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Statement:
          - Action: 'sts:AssumeRole'
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                aws:SourceAccount: !Ref 'AWS::AccountId'
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: vpc-flow-logs.amazonaws.com
            Sid: AllowVPCFlowLogsToAssumeRole
        Version: '2012-10-17'
      Description: IAM role assumed by VPC Flow Logs to publish flow logs to CloudWatch Logs.
      Policies:
        - PolicyDocument:
            Statement:
              - Action: 'logs:CreateLogGroup'
                Effect: Allow
                Resource: '*'
                Sid: AllowLogGroupCreation
              - Action:
                  - 'logs:CreateLogStream'
                  - 'logs:DescribeLogStreams'
                  - 'logs:PutLogEvents'
                Effect: Allow
                Resource: !GetAtt FlowLogsLogGroup.Arn
                Sid: AllowPublishingToLogGroup
            Version: '2012-10-17'
          PolicyName: vpc-flow-logs-publish
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-flow-logs-role'

  VPCFlowLog:
    Type: AWS::EC2::FlowLog
    Properties:
      DeliverLogsPermissionArn: !GetAtt FlowLogsRole.Arn
      LogDestination: !GetAtt FlowLogsLogGroup.Arn
      LogDestinationType: cloud-watch-logs
      MaxAggregationInterval: 60
      ResourceId: !Ref VPC
      ResourceType: VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-vpc-flow-log'
      TrafficType: ALL

Outputs:
  VpcId:
    Description: ID of the shared VPC.
    Value: !Ref VPC
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-VpcId'
  VpcCidr:
    Description: CIDR block of the shared VPC.
    Value: !Ref VpcCidr
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-VpcCidr'
  AvailabilityZone1:
    Description: Availability Zone used for the first public and private subnets.
    Value: !GetAtt PublicSubnet1.AvailabilityZone
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-AvailabilityZone1'
  AvailabilityZone2:
    Description: Availability Zone used for the second public and private subnets.
    Value: !GetAtt PublicSubnet2.AvailabilityZone
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-AvailabilityZone2'
  PublicSubnet1Id:
    Description: ID of public subnet 1 (first Availability Zone).
    Value: !Ref PublicSubnet1
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-PublicSubnet1Id'
  PublicSubnet2Id:
    Description: ID of public subnet 2 (second Availability Zone).
    Value: !Ref PublicSubnet2
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-PublicSubnet2Id'
  PrivateSubnet1Id:
    Description: ID of private subnet 1 (first Availability Zone).
    Value: !Ref PrivateSubnet1
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-PrivateSubnet1Id'
  PrivateSubnet2Id:
    Description: ID of private subnet 2 (second Availability Zone).
    Value: !Ref PrivateSubnet2
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-PrivateSubnet2Id'
  InternetGatewayId:
    Description: ID of the Internet Gateway attached to the VPC.
    Value: !Ref InternetGateway
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-InternetGatewayId'
  PublicRouteTableId:
    Description: ID of the public route table.
    Value: !Ref PublicRouteTable
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-PublicRouteTableId'
  PrivateRouteTable1Id:
    Description: ID of the private route table for the first Availability Zone.
    Value: !Ref PrivateRouteTable1
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-PrivateRouteTable1Id'
  PrivateRouteTable2Id:
    Description: ID of the private route table for the second Availability Zone.
    Value: !Ref PrivateRouteTable2
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-PrivateRouteTable2Id'
  VpcEndpointSecurityGroupId:
    Description: ID of the security group attached to the interface VPC endpoints.
    Value: !Ref VpcEndpointSecurityGroup
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-VpcEndpointSecurityGroupId'
  S3GatewayEndpointId:
    Description: ID of the S3 gateway VPC endpoint.
    Value: !Ref S3GatewayEndpoint
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-S3GatewayEndpointId'
  FlowLogsLogGroupName:
    Description: Name of the CloudWatch Logs log group receiving VPC flow logs.
    Value: !Ref FlowLogsLogGroup
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-FlowLogsLogGroupName'
  FlowLogsKeyArn:
    Description: ARN of the customer managed KMS key encrypting the VPC flow logs.
    Value: !GetAtt FlowLogsKey.Arn
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-FlowLogsKeyArn'
  FlowLogsRoleArn:
    Description: ARN of the IAM role used by VPC Flow Logs.
    Value: !GetAtt FlowLogsRole.Arn
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-FlowLogsRoleArn'

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: "2010-09-09"

Description: >-
  Creates a dual-stack (IPv4 and Amazon-provided IPv6) VPC that spans three
  Availability Zones. Three private subnets (one per Availability Zone) and a
  single private route table are always created. Optionally, three public
  subnets (one per Availability Zone), an Internet Gateway attached to the
  VPC, and a single public route table with a default route to the internet
  can be created as well. Each subnet receives an IPv4 CIDR carved out of the
  VPC's IPv4 range and an IPv6 /64 CIDR carved out of the Amazon-provided VPC
  IPv6 range. The VPC ID and the lists of public and private subnet IDs are
  exposed as stack outputs.

Metadata:
  AWS::CloudFormation::Interface:
    ParameterGroups:
      - Label:
          default: VPC Configuration
        Parameters:
          - VpcIdentifier
          - VpcCidrBlock
      - Label:
          default: Public Networking Options
        Parameters:
          - CreatePublicSubnets
    ParameterLabels:
      VpcIdentifier:
        default: VPC Identifier
      VpcCidrBlock:
        default: VPC IPv4 CIDR Block
      CreatePublicSubnets:
        default: Create Public Subnets

Parameters:
  VpcIdentifier:
    Type: String
    Description: Identifier for the VPC, also used to name the associated network resources.
    Default: my-vpc
    AllowedPattern: '^[a-zA-Z][-a-zA-Z0-9]{0,63}$'
    ConstraintDescription: VPC identifier must start with a letter and contain up to 64 alphanumeric characters or hyphens.

  VpcCidrBlock:
    Type: String
    Description: IPv4 CIDR block for the VPC. Must be between /16 and /20 so that six subnets can be carved out of it.
    Default: "10.0.0.0/16"
    AllowedPattern: '^(([0-9]|[1-9][0-9]|1[0-9]{2}|2[0-4][0-9]|25[0-5])\.){3}([0-9]|[1-9][0-9]|1[0-9]{2}|2[0-4][0-9]|25[0-5])/(1[6-9]|20)$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must be a valid IPv4 CIDR block with a prefix length between /16 and /20, for example 10.0.0.0/16.

  CreatePublicSubnets:
    Type: String
    Description: Whether to create three public subnets, an Internet Gateway attached to the VPC, and a public route table with a default route to the internet.
    Default: "true"
    AllowedValues:
      - "true"
      - "false"
    ConstraintDescription: Must be either "true" or "false".

Conditions:
  ShouldCreatePublicSubnets: !Equals [!Ref CreatePublicSubnets, "true"]

Resources:
  VPC:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPC
    Properties:
      CidrBlock: !Ref VpcCidrBlock
      EnableDnsSupport: true
      EnableDnsHostnames: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Ref VpcIdentifier

  VPCIpv6CidrBlock:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCCidrBlock
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      AmazonProvidedIpv6CidrBlock: true

  InternetGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::InternetGateway
    Condition: ShouldCreatePublicSubnets
    Properties:
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${VpcIdentifier}-igw"

  VPCGatewayAttachment:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCGatewayAttachment
    Condition: ShouldCreatePublicSubnets
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      InternetGatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  PublicSubnet1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Condition: ShouldCreatePublicSubnets
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs ""]
      CidrBlock: !Select [0, !Cidr [!Ref VpcCidrBlock, 6, 8]]
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${VpcIdentifier}-public-subnet-1"
        - Key: Tier
          Value: public

  PublicSubnet2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Condition: ShouldCreatePublicSubnets
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [1, !GetAZs ""]
      CidrBlock: !Select [1, !Cidr [!Ref VpcCidrBlock, 6, 8]]
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${VpcIdentifier}-public-subnet-2"
        - Key: Tier
          Value: public

  PublicSubnet3:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Condition: ShouldCreatePublicSubnets
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [2, !GetAZs ""]
      CidrBlock: !Select [2, !Cidr [!Ref VpcCidrBlock, 6, 8]]
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${VpcIdentifier}-public-subnet-3"
        - Key: Tier
          Value: public

  PublicSubnet1Ipv6CidrBlock:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetCidrBlock
    Condition: ShouldCreatePublicSubnets
    DependsOn: VPCIpv6CidrBlock
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet1
      Ipv6CidrBlock: !Select [0, !Cidr [!Select [0, !GetAtt VPC.Ipv6CidrBlocks], 6, 64]]

  PublicSubnet2Ipv6CidrBlock:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetCidrBlock
    Condition: ShouldCreatePublicSubnets
    DependsOn: VPCIpv6CidrBlock
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet2
      Ipv6CidrBlock: !Select [1, !Cidr [!Select [0, !GetAtt VPC.Ipv6CidrBlocks], 6, 64]]

  PublicSubnet3Ipv6CidrBlock:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetCidrBlock
    Condition: ShouldCreatePublicSubnets
    DependsOn: VPCIpv6CidrBlock
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet3
      Ipv6CidrBlock: !Select [2, !Cidr [!Select [0, !GetAtt VPC.Ipv6CidrBlocks], 6, 64]]

  PublicRouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Condition: ShouldCreatePublicSubnets
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${VpcIdentifier}-public-route-table"

  PublicDefaultRoute:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    Condition: ShouldCreatePublicSubnets
    DependsOn: VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      GatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  PublicSubnet1RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Condition: ShouldCreatePublicSubnets
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet1
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable

  PublicSubnet2RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Condition: ShouldCreatePublicSubnets
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet2
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable

  PublicSubnet3RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Condition: ShouldCreatePublicSubnets
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet3
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable

  PrivateSubnet1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs ""]
      CidrBlock: !Select [3, !Cidr [!Ref VpcCidrBlock, 6, 8]]
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${VpcIdentifier}-private-subnet-1"
        - Key: Tier
          Value: private

  PrivateSubnet2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [1, !GetAZs ""]
      CidrBlock: !Select [4, !Cidr [!Ref VpcCidrBlock, 6, 8]]
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${VpcIdentifier}-private-subnet-2"
        - Key: Tier
          Value: private

  PrivateSubnet3:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [2, !GetAZs ""]
      CidrBlock: !Select [5, !Cidr [!Ref VpcCidrBlock, 6, 8]]
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${VpcIdentifier}-private-subnet-3"
        - Key: Tier
          Value: private

  PrivateSubnet1Ipv6CidrBlock:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetCidrBlock
    DependsOn: VPCIpv6CidrBlock
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnet1
      Ipv6CidrBlock: !Select [3, !Cidr [!Select [0, !GetAtt VPC.Ipv6CidrBlocks], 6, 64]]

  PrivateSubnet2Ipv6CidrBlock:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetCidrBlock
    DependsOn: VPCIpv6CidrBlock
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnet2
      Ipv6CidrBlock: !Select [4, !Cidr [!Select [0, !GetAtt VPC.Ipv6CidrBlocks], 6, 64]]

  PrivateSubnet3Ipv6CidrBlock:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetCidrBlock
    DependsOn: VPCIpv6CidrBlock
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnet3
      Ipv6CidrBlock: !Select [5, !Cidr [!Select [0, !GetAtt VPC.Ipv6CidrBlocks], 6, 64]]

  PrivateRouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${VpcIdentifier}-private-route-table"

  PrivateSubnet1RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnet1
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable

  PrivateSubnet2RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnet2
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable

  PrivateSubnet3RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnet3
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable

Outputs:
  VpcId:
    Description: The ID of the VPC.
    Value: !Ref VPC
    Export:
      Name: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-VpcId"

  PublicSubnetIds:
    Description: Comma-delimited list of the public subnet IDs (empty when public subnets are not created).
    Value: !If [ShouldCreatePublicSubnets, !Join [",", [!Ref PublicSubnet1, !Ref PublicSubnet2, !Ref PublicSubnet3]], ""]
    Export:
      Name: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-PublicSubnetIds"

  PrivateSubnetIds:
    Description: Comma-delimited list of the private subnet IDs.
    Value: !Join [",", [!Ref PrivateSubnet1, !Ref PrivateSubnet2, !Ref PrivateSubnet3]]
    Export:
      Name: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-PrivateSubnetIds"

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >-
  IAM identities and permissions required to bootstrap and operate the Cluster
  API Provider for AWS. Creates dedicated roles and instance profiles for the
  Kubernetes control plane, the cluster controllers and the worker nodes, a
  dedicated role for the EKS control plane, managed policies for the AWS cloud
  provider integration and the Cluster API controllers, and a bootstrapper IAM
  group and user for cluster lifecycle operations.

Resources:
  ControllersPolicy:
    Type: AWS::IAM::ManagedPolicy
    Properties:
      Description: >-
        Broader permissions required by the Cluster API Provider for AWS
        controllers, covering EC2 networking and instance management, Elastic
        Load Balancing, Auto Scaling, EKS cluster and nodegroup management and
        service-linked role creation.
      ManagedPolicyName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-controllers-policy'
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: ClusterAPIControllersEC2Mutate
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - ec2:AllocateAddress
              - ec2:AssignPrivateIpAddresses
              - ec2:AssociateAddress
              - ec2:AssociateDhcpOptions
              - ec2:AssociateRouteTable
              - ec2:AssociateSubnetCidrBlock
              - ec2:AssociateVpcCidrBlock
              - ec2:AttachInternetGateway
              - ec2:AttachVolume
              - ec2:CreateDhcpOptions
              - ec2:CreateEgressOnlyInternetGateway
              - ec2:CreateInternetGateway
              - ec2:CreateLaunchTemplate
              - ec2:CreateLaunchTemplateVersion
              - ec2:CreateNatGateway
              - ec2:CreateNetworkInterface
              - ec2:CreateRoute
              - ec2:CreateRouteTable
              - ec2:CreateSecurityGroup
              - ec2:CreateSnapshot
              - ec2:CreateSubnet
              - ec2:CreateTags
              - ec2:CreateVolume
              - ec2:CreateVpc
              - ec2:CreateVpcEndpoint
              - ec2:DeleteDhcpOptions
              - ec2:DeleteEgressOnlyInternetGateway

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: "2010-09-09"
Description: >
  VPC networking infrastructure for OpenSearch cross-region resilience. Creates
  a VPC with three public and three private subnets spread across three
  Availability Zones, an Internet Gateway, an optional NAT Gateway topology
  (single cost-effective NAT Gateway or one NAT Gateway per Availability Zone
  for high availability), and VPC Flow Logs delivered to CloudWatch Logs with a
  7-day retention period. Deploy this stack once per region to support
  cross-region OpenSearch resilience.

Metadata:
  AWS::CloudFormation::Interface:
    ParameterGroups:
      - Label:
          default: General Configuration
        Parameters:
          - EnvironmentName
      - Label:
          default: Network Configuration
        Parameters:
          - VpcCidr
          - PublicSubnet1Cidr
          - PublicSubnet2Cidr
          - PublicSubnet3Cidr
          - PrivateSubnet1Cidr
          - PrivateSubnet2Cidr
          - PrivateSubnet3Cidr
      - Label:
          default: NAT Gateway Configuration
        Parameters:
          - NATGatewayType
    ParameterLabels:
      EnvironmentName:
        default: Environment Name
      VpcCidr:
        default: VPC CIDR Block
      PublicSubnet1Cidr:
        default: Public Subnet 1 CIDR (AZ 1)
      PublicSubnet2Cidr:
        default: Public Subnet 2 CIDR (AZ 2)
      PublicSubnet3Cidr:
        default: Public Subnet 3 CIDR (AZ 3)
      PrivateSubnet1Cidr:
        default: Private Subnet 1 CIDR (AZ 1)
      PrivateSubnet2Cidr:
        default: Private Subnet 2 CIDR (AZ 2)
      PrivateSubnet3Cidr:
        default: Private Subnet 3 CIDR (AZ 3)
      NATGatewayType:
        default: NAT Gateway Deployment Type

Parameters:
  EnvironmentName:
    Type: String
    Default: production
    Description: Environment name used for resource naming and tagging (e.g. production, staging).

  VpcCidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.0.0/16
    Description: CIDR block for the VPC.
    AllowedPattern: '^(([0-9]|[1-9][0-9]|1[0-9]{2}|2[0-4][0-9]|25[0-5])\.){3}([0-9]|[1-9][0-9]|1[0-9]{2}|2[0-4][0-9]|25[0-5])(/(1[6-9]|2[0-8]))$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must be a valid IPv4 CIDR block with a prefix length between /16 and /28.

  PublicSubnet1Cidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.101.0/24
    Description: CIDR block for the public subnet in the first Availability Zone.
    AllowedPattern: '^(([0-9]|[1-9][0-9]|1[0-9]{2}|2[0-4][0-9]|25[0-5])\.){3}([0-9]|[1-9][0-9]|1[0-9]{2}|2[0-4][0-9]|25[0-5])(/(1[6-9]|2[0-8]))$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must be a valid IPv4 CIDR block with a prefix length between /16 and /28.

  PublicSubnet2Cidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.102.0/24
    Description: CIDR block for the public subnet in the second Availability Zone.
    AllowedPattern: '^(([0-9]|[1-9][0-9]|1[0-9]{2}|2[0-4][0-9]|25[0-5])\.){3}([0-9]|[1-9][0-9]|1[0-9]{2}|2[0-4][0-9]|25[0-5])(/(1[6-9]|2[0-8]))$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must be a valid IPv4 CIDR block with a prefix length between /16 and /28.

  PublicSubnet3Cidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.103.0/24
    Description: CIDR block for the public subnet in the third Availability Zone.
    AllowedPattern: '^(([0-9]|[1-9][0-9]|1[0-9]{2}|2[0-4][0-9]|25[0-5])\.){3}([0-9]|[1-9][0-9]|1[0-9]{2}|2[0-4][0-9]|25[0-5])(/(1[6-9]|2[0-8]))$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must be a valid IPv4 CIDR block with a prefix length between /16 and /28.

  PrivateSubnet1Cidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.1.0/24
    Description: CIDR block for the private subnet in the first Availability Zone.
    AllowedPattern: '^(([0-9]|[1-9][0-9]|1[0-9]{2}|2[0-4][0-9]|25[0-5])\.){3}([0-9]|[1-9][0-9]|1[0-9]{2}|2[0-4][0-9]|25[0-5])(/(1[6-9]|2[0-8]))$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must be a valid IPv4 CIDR block with a prefix length between /16 and /28.

  PrivateSubnet2Cidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.2.0/24
    Description: CIDR block for the private subnet in the second Availability Zone.
    AllowedPattern: '^(([0-9]|[1-9][0-9]|1[0-9]{2}|2[0-4][0-9]|25[0-5])\.){3}([0-9]|[1-9][0-9]|1[0-9]{2}|2[0-4][0-9]|25[0-5])(/(1[6-9]|2[0-8]))$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must be a valid IPv4 CIDR block with a prefix length between /16 and /28.

  PrivateSubnet3Cidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.3.0/24
    Description: CIDR block for the private subnet in the third Availability Zone.
    AllowedPattern: '^(([0-9]|[1-9][0-9]|1[0-9]{2}|2[0-4][0-9]|25[0-5])\.){3}([0-9]|[1-9][0-9]|1[0-9]{2}|2[0-4][0-9]|25[0-5])(/(1[6-9]|2[0-8]))$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must be a valid IPv4 CIDR block with a prefix length between /16 and /28.

  NATGatewayType:
    Type: String
    Default: single
    AllowedValues:
      - single
      - multi-az
    Description: NAT Gateway deployment type. Select single for one cost-effective NAT Gateway, or multi-az for one NAT Gateway per Availability Zone (high availability).

Conditions:
  CreateMultiAzNATGateways: !Equals [!Ref NATGatewayType, "multi-az"]

Resources:
  VPC:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPC
    Properties:
      CidrBlock: !Ref VpcCidr
      EnableDnsHostnames: true
      EnableDnsSupport: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${EnvironmentName}-vpc"
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  InternetGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::InternetGateway
    Properties:
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${EnvironmentName}-internet-gateway"
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  InternetGatewayAttachment:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      InternetGatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  PublicSubnet1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs ""]
      CidrBlock: !Ref PublicSubnet1Cidr
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${EnvironmentName}-public-subnet-1"

          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  PublicSubnet2:

      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [1, !GetAZs ""]

      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${EnvironmentName}-public-subnet-2"
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  PublicSubnet3:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [2, !GetAZs ""]
      CidrBlock: !Ref PublicSubnet3Cidr
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${EnvironmentName}-public-subnet-3"
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  PrivateSubnet1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs ""]
      CidrBlock: !Ref PrivateSubnet1Cidr
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${EnvironmentName}-private-subnet-1"
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  PrivateSubnet2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [1, !GetAZs ""]
      CidrBlock: !Ref PrivateSubnet2Cidr
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${EnvironmentName}-private-subnet-2"
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  PrivateSubnet3:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [2, !GetAZs ""]
      CidrBlock: !Ref PrivateSubnet3Cidr
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${EnvironmentName}-private-subnet-3"
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  PublicRouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${EnvironmentName}-public-route-table"
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  PublicRoute:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    DependsOn: InternetGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      GatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  PublicSubnet1RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet1
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable

  PublicSubnet2RouteTableAssociation:

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >-
  Fully isolated multi-AZ private VPC for an AI-powered customer support application
  with no direct internet access. VPC endpoints provide private connectivity to
  Bedrock, ECR, CloudWatch Logs and Monitoring, DynamoDB, RDS Data API, Secrets
  Manager, SSM Parameter Store, KMS, S3 and X-Ray. VPC Flow Logs capture ALL traffic
  into a CloudWatch Logs group encrypted with a customer-managed KMS key (referenced
  by full ARN, as required by CloudWatch Logs) that has automatic rotation enabled.
  Dedicated security groups for Agent Runtime, MCP Runtime and Lambda functions
  enforce HTTPS-only egress to the VPC endpoints and permit direct DynamoDB access
  via the DynamoDB gateway endpoint, plus S3 access required for ECR container image
  layers. A Lambda-backed custom resource resolves the region-specific S3 and
  DynamoDB managed prefix list IDs used in the security group egress rules.

Metadata:
  AWS::CloudFormation::Interface:
    ParameterGroups:
      - Label:
          default: Network configuration
        Parameters:
          - VpcCidr
      - Label:
          default: Operational settings
        Parameters:
          - EnvironmentName
          - FlowLogRetentionInDays
    ParameterLabels:
      VpcCidr:
        default: VPC CIDR block
      EnvironmentName:
        default: Environment name
      FlowLogRetentionInDays:
        default: Flow Logs retention (days)

Parameters:
  VpcCidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.0.0/16
    Description: CIDR block for the isolated VPC, from which three private subnets are carved.
    AllowedPattern: '^(([0-9]|[1-9][0-9]|1[0-9]{2}|2[0-4][0-9]|25[0-5])\.){3}([0-9]|[1-9][0-9]|1[0-9]{2}|2[0-4][0-9]|25[0-5])(\/([0-9]|[1-2][0-9]|3[0-2]))$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must be a valid IPv4 CIDR block, for example 10.0.0.0/16.
  EnvironmentName:
    Type: String
    Default: production
    Description: Environment name applied as a tag to all resources.
  FlowLogRetentionInDays:
    Type: Number
    Default: 365
    Description: Retention period in days for the VPC Flow Logs CloudWatch Logs group.
    AllowedValues:
      - 1
      - 3
      - 5
      - 7
      - 14
      - 30
      - 60
      - 90
      - 120
      - 150
      - 180
      - 365
      - 400
      - 545
      - 731
      - 1096
      - 1827
      - 2192
      - 2557
      - 2922
      - 3288
      - 3653

  S3GatewayEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:

      VpcEndpointType: Gateway

            Effect: Allow
            Principal: '*'
            Action: 'dynamodb:*'
            Resource: '*'

  PrefixListResolverRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      Description: Execution role for the Lambda custom resource that resolves the region-specific S3 and DynamoDB managed prefix list IDs.
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: 'sts:AssumeRole'
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                aws:SourceAccount: !Ref 'AWS::AccountId'
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSLambdaBasicExecutionRole'
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: describe-prefix-lists
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: DescribeManagedPrefixLists
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - 'ec2:DescribeManagedPrefixLists'
                  - 'ec2:DescribePrefixLists'
                Resource: '*'
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-prefix-list-resolver-role'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  PrefixListResolverFunction:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    Properties:
      Description: Resolves the AWS-managed prefix list IDs for S3 and DynamoDB in the current region for use in security group egress rules.
      Runtime: python3.12
      Handler: index.handler
      Timeout: 60
      MemorySize: 128
      Role: !GetAtt PrefixListResolverRole.Arn
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import boto3
          import cfnresponse


          def handler(event, context):
              region = event['ResourceProperties']['Region']
              physical_id = event.get('PhysicalResourceId') or event['LogicalResourceId']
              try:
                  if event['RequestType'] == 'Delete':
                      cfnresponse.send(event, context, cfnresponse.SUCCESS, {}, physical_id)
                      return
                  ec2 = boto3.client('ec2', region_name=region)
                  wanted = {
                      'com.amazonaws.%s.s3' % region: 'S3PrefixListId',
                      'com.amazonaws.%s.dynamodb' % region: 'DynamoDbPrefixListId'
                  }
                  prefix_lists = []
                  response = ec2.describe_managed_prefix_lists()
                  prefix_lists.extend(response.get('PrefixLists', []))
                  next_token = response.get('NextToken')
                  while next_token:
                      response = ec2.describe_managed_prefix_lists(NextToken=next_token)
                      prefix_lists.extend(response.get('PrefixLists', []))
                      next_token = response.get('NextToken')
                  found = {}
                  for prefix_list in prefix_lists:
                      name = prefix_list.get('PrefixListName')
                      if name in wanted and wanted[name] not in found:
                          found[wanted[name]] = prefix_list.get('PrefixListId')
                  missing = [attribute for attribute in wanted.values() if attribute not in found]
                  if missing:
                      raise RuntimeError(
                          'Unable to resolve managed prefix lists for attributes: %s in region %s'
                          % (', '.join(missing), region)
                      )
                  cfnresponse.send(event, context, cfnresponse.SUCCESS, found, physical_id)
              except Exception as e:
                  cfnresponse.send(
                      event,
                      context,
                      cfnresponse.FAILED,
                      {'Error': str(e)},
                      physical_id
                  )
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-prefix-list-resolver'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  ServicePrefixLists:
    Type: Custom::VpcServicePrefixLists
    Properties:
      ServiceToken: !GetAtt PrefixListResolverFunction.Arn
      Region: !Ref 'AWS::Region'

  VPCEndpointSecurityGroup:

    Properties:

  CloudWatchLogsVPCEndpoint:

  CloudWatchMonitoringVPCEndpoint:

      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      ServiceName: !Sub 'com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.monitoring'
      VpcEndpointType: Interface
      PrivateDnsEnabled: true
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet1
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet2
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet3

        - !Ref VPCEndpointSecurityGroup

  RdsDataApiVPCEndpoint:

    Properties:

  SecretsManagerVPCEndpoint:

    Properties:

      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet1
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet2

        - !Ref VPCEndpointSecurityGroup

        - Key: Name

  SsmVPCEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:

      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet1

        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-ssm-endpoint'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  KmsVPCEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      ServiceName: !Sub 'com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.kms'
      VpcEndpointType: Interface
      PrivateDnsEnabled: true
      SubnetIds:

        - !Ref PrivateSubnet2
