  XRayVPCEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      ServiceName: !Sub 'com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.xray'
      VpcEndpointType: Interface
      PrivateDnsEnabled: true
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet1
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet2
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet3
      SecurityGroupIds:
        - !Ref VPCEndpointSecurityGroup
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-xray-endpoint'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  FlowLogsKmsKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      Description: Customer-managed KMS key used to encrypt VPC Flow Logs.
      Enabled: true
      EnableKeyRotation: true
      KeyUsage: ENCRYPT_DECRYPT
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: EnableIAMUserPermissions
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root'
            Action: 'kms:*'
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: AllowCloudWatchLogsToUseTheKey
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: !Sub 'logs.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com'
            Action:
              - 'kms:Encrypt'
              - 'kms:Decrypt'
              - 'kms:ReEncrypt*'
              - 'kms:GenerateDataKey*'
              - 'kms:DescribeKey'
            Resource: '*'
            Condition:
              ArnEquals:
                'kms:EncryptionContext:aws:logs:arn': !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:logs:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:log-group:/aws/vpc-flow-logs/${AWS::StackName}'

  FlowLogsKmsKeyAlias:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Alias
    Properties:
      AliasName: !Sub 'alias/${AWS::StackName}-flow-logs'
      TargetKeyId: !Ref FlowLogsKmsKey

  FlowLogsLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    DependsOn:
      - FlowLogsKmsKeyAlias
      - ServicePrefixLists
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Sub '/aws/vpc-flow-logs/${AWS::StackName}'
      RetentionInDays: !Ref FlowLogRetentionInDays
      KmsKeyId: !GetAtt FlowLogsKmsKey.Arn

  FlowLogsDeliveryRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      Description: Allows VPC Flow Logs to deliver flow logs to the KMS-encrypted CloudWatch Logs group.
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: vpc-flow-logs.amazonaws.com
            Action: 'sts:AssumeRole'
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                aws:SourceAccount: !Ref 'AWS::AccountId'
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: vpc-flow-logs-delivery
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: DeliverFlowLogsToCloudWatchLogs
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - 'logs:CreateLogGroup'
                  - 'logs:CreateLogStream'
                  - 'logs:DescribeLogStreams'
                  - 'logs:PutLogEvents'
                Resource:
                  - !GetAtt FlowLogsLogGroup.Arn
                  - !Sub '${FlowLogsLogGroup.Arn}:*'
              - Sid: UseKmsKeyForLogEncryption
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - 'kms:Encrypt'
                  - 'kms:Decrypt'
                  - 'kms:ReEncrypt*'
                  - 'kms:GenerateDataKey*'
                  - 'kms:DescribeKey'
                Resource: !GetAtt FlowLogsKmsKey.Arn
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-flow-logs-role'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  VpcFlowLog:
    Type: AWS::EC2::FlowLog
    Properties:
      ResourceId: !Ref VPC
      ResourceType: VPC
      TrafficType: ALL
      LogDestinationType: cloud-watch-logs
      LogDestination: !GetAtt FlowLogsLogGroup.Arn
      DeliverLogsPermissionArn: !GetAtt FlowLogsDeliveryRole.Arn
      MaxAggregationInterval: 60
      LogFormat: '${version} ${account-id} ${interface-id} ${srcaddr} ${dstaddr} ${srcport} ${dstport} ${protocol} ${packets} ${bytes} ${start} ${end} ${action} ${log-status}'
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-flow-log'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

Outputs:
  VpcId:
    Description: ID of the isolated VPC.
    Value: !Ref VPC
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-VpcId'
  VpcCidrBlock:
    Description: CIDR block of the isolated VPC.
    Value: !GetAtt VPC.CidrBlock
  PrivateSubnetIds:
    Description: IDs of the three private subnets, one per Availability Zone.
    Value: !Join
      - ','
      - - !Ref PrivateSubnet1
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet2
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet3
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-PrivateSubnetIds'
  PrivateRouteTableIds:
    Description: IDs of the private route tables, one per subnet.
    Value: !Join
      - ','
      - - !Ref PrivateRouteTable1
        - !Ref PrivateRouteTable2
        - !Ref PrivateRouteTable3
  VPCEndpointSecurityGroupId:
    Description: Security group attached to all VPC interface endpoints.
    Value: !Ref VPCEndpointSecurityGroup
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-VPCEndpointSG'
  AgentRuntimeSecurityGroupId:
    Description: Security group for Agent Runtime components.
    Value: !Ref AgentRuntimeSecurityGroup
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-AgentRuntimeSG'
  MCPRuntimeSecurityGroupId:
    Description: Security group for MCP Runtime components.
    Value: !Ref MCPRuntimeSecurityGroup
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-MCPRuntimeSG'
  LambdaSecurityGroupId:
    Description: Security group for Lambda functions.
    Value: !Ref LambdaSecurityGroup
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-LambdaSG'
  S3PrefixListId:
    Description: Managed prefix list ID for S3 in the current region, used by the component egress rules.
    Value: !GetAtt ServicePrefixLists.S3PrefixListId
  DynamoDbPrefixListId:
    Description: Managed prefix list ID for DynamoDB in the current region, used by the component egress rules.
    Value: !GetAtt ServicePrefixLists.DynamoDbPrefixListId
  FlowLogsKmsKeyArn:
    Description: ARN of the customer-managed KMS key used to encrypt VPC Flow Logs.
    Value: !GetAtt FlowLogsKmsKey.Arn
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-FlowLogsKmsKeyArn'
  FlowLogsKmsKeyAlias:
    Description: Alias of the customer-managed KMS key with automatic rotation enabled.
    Value: !Ref FlowLogsKmsKeyAlias
  FlowLogsLogGroupArn:
    Description: ARN of the encrypted CloudWatch Logs group receiving VPC Flow Logs.
    Value: !GetAtt FlowLogsLogGroup.Arn
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-FlowLogsLogGroupArn'
  FlowLogId:
    Description: ID of the VPC Flow Log capturing all traffic.
    Value: !Ref VpcFlowLog
  S3GatewayEndpointId:
    Description: ID of the S3 gateway VPC endpoint.
    Value: !Ref S3GatewayEndpoint
  DynamoDBGatewayEndpointId:
    Description: ID of the DynamoDB gateway VPC endpoint.
    Value: !Ref DynamoDBGatewayEndpoint
  InterfaceVPCEndpointIds:
    Description: Comma-separated IDs of all interface VPC endpoints.
    Value: !Join
      - ','
      - - !Ref BedrockVPCEndpoint
        - !Ref BedrockRuntimeVPCEndpoint
        - !Ref EcrApiVPCEndpoint
        - !Ref EcrDkrVPCEndpoint
        - !Ref CloudWatchLogsVPCEndpoint
        - !Ref CloudWatchMonitoringVPCEndpoint
        - !Ref RdsDataApiVPCEndpoint
        - !Ref SecretsManagerVPCEndpoint
        - !Ref SsmVPCEndpoint
        - !Ref KmsVPCEndpoint
        - !Ref XRayVPCEndpoint

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >-
  VPC designed to host an Amazon EKS cluster spanning three Availability Zones.
  Creates three public and three private subnets, an Internet Gateway with a
  public route table, one NAT Gateway with its own Elastic IP in each public
  subnet, per-AZ private route tables for outbound internet access, a security
  group for EKS control plane to worker node communication, and a security
  group exposing HTTP, HTTPS and custom TCP ingress/service mesh gateway ports
  to the internet.

Parameters:
  VpcName:
    Type: String
    Default: eks-vpc
    Description: Name used to tag resources in this VPC and in Kubernetes discovery tags.
    AllowedPattern: '[a-zA-Z][-a-zA-Z0-9]*'
    ConstraintDescription: Must begin with a letter and contain only letters, digits, and hyphens.
  VpcCIDR:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.0.0/16
    Description: CIDR block for the VPC.
    AllowedPattern: '^([0-9]{1,3}\.){3}[0-9]{1,3}\/([0-9]|[12][0-9]|3[0-2])$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must be a valid CIDR block in the form x.x.x.x/x.
  PublicSubnet1CIDR:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.0.0/20
    Description: CIDR block for the public subnet in Availability Zone 1.
    AllowedPattern: '^([0-9]{1,3}\.){3}[0-9]{1,3}\/([0-9]|[12][0-9]|3[0-2])$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must be a valid CIDR block in the form x.x.x.x/x.
  PublicSubnet2CIDR:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.16.0/20
    Description: CIDR block for the public subnet in Availability Zone 2.
    AllowedPattern: '^([0-9]{1,3}\.){3}[0-9]{1,3}\/([0-9]|[12][0-9]|3[0-2])$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must be a valid CIDR block in the form x.x.x.x/x.
  PublicSubnet3CIDR:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.32.0/20
    Description: CIDR block for the public subnet in Availability Zone 3.
    AllowedPattern: '^([0-9]{1,3}\.){3}[0-9]{1,3}\/([0-9]|[12][0-9]|3[0-2])$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must be a valid CIDR block in the form x.x.x.x/x.
  PrivateSubnet1CIDR:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.128.0/20
    Description: CIDR block for the private subnet in Availability Zone 1.
    AllowedPattern: '^([0-9]{1,3}\.){3}[0-9]{1,3}\/([0-9]|[12][0-9]|3[0-2])$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must be a valid CIDR block in the form x.x.x.x/x.
  PrivateSubnet2CIDR:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.144.0/20
    Description: CIDR block for the private subnet in Availability Zone 2.
    AllowedPattern: '^([0-9]{1,3}\.){3}[0-9]{1,3}\/([0-9]|[12][0-9]|3[0-2])$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must be a valid CIDR block in the form x.x.x.x/x.
  PrivateSubnet3CIDR:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.160.0/20
    Description: CIDR block for the private subnet in Availability Zone 3.
    AllowedPattern: '^([0-9]{1,3}\.){3}[0-9]{1,3}\/([0-9]|[12][0-9]|3[0-2])$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must be a valid CIDR block in the form x.x.x.x/x.

Metadata:
  AWS::CloudFormation::Interface:
    ParameterGroups:
      - Label:
          default: VPC
        Parameters:
          - VpcName
          - VpcCIDR
      - Label:
          default: Public Subnet CIDRs
        Parameters:
          - PublicSubnet1CIDR
          - PublicSubnet2CIDR
          - PublicSubnet3CIDR
      - Label:
          default: Private Subnet CIDRs
        Parameters:
          - PrivateSubnet1CIDR
          - PrivateSubnet2CIDR
          - PrivateSubnet3CIDR

Resources:
  VPC:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPC
    Properties:
      CidrBlock: !Ref VpcCIDR
      EnableDnsSupport: true
      EnableDnsHostnames: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Ref VpcName
        - Key: !Sub 'kubernetes.io/cluster/${VpcName}'
          Value: shared

  InternetGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::InternetGateway
    Properties:
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${VpcName}-igw'

  VPCGatewayAttachment:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      InternetGatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  PublicSubnet1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      AvailabilityZone: !Select
        - 0
        - !GetAZs ''
      CidrBlock: !Ref PublicSubnet1CIDR
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${VpcName}-public-subnet-1'
        - Key: kubernetes.io/role/elb
          Value: '1'
        - Key: !Sub 'kubernetes.io/cluster/${VpcName}'
          Value: shared

  PublicSubnet2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      AvailabilityZone: !Select
        - 1
        - !GetAZs ''
      CidrBlock: !Ref PublicSubnet2CIDR
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${VpcName}-public-subnet-2'
        - Key: kubernetes.io/role/elb
          Value: '1'
        - Key: !Sub 'kubernetes.io/cluster/${VpcName}'
          Value: shared

  PublicSubnet3:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      AvailabilityZone: !Select
        - 2
        - !GetAZs ''
      CidrBlock: !Ref PublicSubnet3CIDR
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${VpcName}-public-subnet-3'
        - Key: kubernetes.io/role/elb
          Value: '1'
        - Key: !Sub 'kubernetes.io/cluster/${VpcName}'
          Value: shared

  PrivateSubnet1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      AvailabilityZone: !Select
        - 0
        - !GetAZs ''
      CidrBlock: !Ref PrivateSubnet1CIDR
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${VpcName}-private-subnet-1'
        - Key: kubernetes.io/role/internal-elb
          Value: '1'
        - Key: !Sub 'kubernetes.io/cluster/${VpcName}'
          Value: shared

  PrivateSubnet2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      AvailabilityZone: !Select
        - 1
        - !GetAZs ''
      CidrBlock: !Ref PrivateSubnet2CIDR
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${VpcName}-private-subnet-2'
        - Key: kubernetes.io/role/internal-elb
          Value: '1'
        - Key: !Sub 'kubernetes.io/cluster/${VpcName}'
          Value: shared

  PrivateSubnet3:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      AvailabilityZone: !Select
        - 2
        - !GetAZs ''
      CidrBlock: !Ref PrivateSubnet3CIDR
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${VpcName}-private-subnet-3'
        - Key: kubernetes.io/role/internal-elb
          Value: '1'
        - Key: !Sub 'kubernetes.io/cluster/${VpcName}'
          Value: shared

  NATGatewayEIP1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::EIP
    Properties:
      Domain: vpc
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${VpcName}-nat-eip-1'

  NATGatewayEIP2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::EIP
    Properties:
      Domain: vpc
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${VpcName}-nat-eip-2'

  NATGatewayEIP3:
    Type: AWS::EC2::EIP
    Properties:
      Domain: vpc
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${VpcName}-nat-eip-3'

  NATGateway1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NatGateway
    DependsOn: VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      AllocationId: !GetAtt NATGatewayEIP1.AllocationId
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet1
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${VpcName}-nat-gateway-1'

  NATGateway2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NatGateway
    DependsOn: VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      AllocationId: !GetAtt NATGatewayEIP2.AllocationId
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet2
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${VpcName}-nat-gateway-2'

  NATGateway3:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NatGateway
    DependsOn: VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      AllocationId: !GetAtt NATGatewayEIP3.AllocationId
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet3
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${VpcName}-nat-gateway-3'

  PublicRouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${VpcName}-public-route-table'

  PublicRoute:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    DependsOn: VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      GatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  PublicSubnet1RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet1
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable

  PublicSubnet2RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet2
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable

  PublicSubnet3RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet3
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable

  PrivateRouteTable1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${VpcName}-private-route-table-1'

  PrivateRoute1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable1
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      NatGatewayId: !Ref NATGateway1

  PrivateSubnet1RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnet1
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable1

  PrivateRouteTable2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${VpcName}-private-route-table-2'

  PrivateRoute2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable2
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      NatGatewayId: !Ref NATGateway2

  PrivateSubnet2RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnet2
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable2

  PrivateRouteTable3:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${VpcName}-private-route-table-3'

  PrivateRoute3:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable3
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      NatGatewayId: !Ref NATGateway3

  PrivateSubnet3RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnet3
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable3

  ControlPlaneSecurityGroup:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroup
    Properties:
      GroupDescription: Allows the EKS control plane to communicate with worker nodes.
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${VpcName}-eks-control-plane-sg'
        - Key: !Sub 'kubernetes.io/cluster/${VpcName}'
          Value: shared

  ControlPlaneSecurityGroupIngress:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroupIngress
    Properties:
      Description: Allows all traffic between the EKS control plane and worker nodes.
      GroupId: !Ref ControlPlaneSecurityGroup
      SourceSecurityGroupId: !Ref ControlPlaneSecurityGroup
      IpProtocol: '-1'

  ApplicationSecurityGroup:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroup
    Properties:
      GroupDescription: Exposes HTTP, HTTPS and custom TCP ingress/service mesh gateway ports to the internet.
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      SecurityGroupIngress:
        - Description: HTTP from the internet
          IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 80
          ToPort: 80
          CidrIp: 0.0.0.0/0
        - Description: HTTPS from the internet
          IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 443
          ToPort: 443
          CidrIp: 0.0.0.0/0
        - Description: Custom TCP 8080 for ingress gateway
          IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 8080
          ToPort: 8080
          CidrIp: 0.0.0.0/0
        - Description: Custom TCP 8443 for ingress gateway TLS
          IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 8443
          ToPort: 8443
          CidrIp: 0.0.0.0/0
        - Description: Custom TCP 9443 for ingress gateway and webhooks
          IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 9443
          ToPort: 9443
          CidrIp: 0.0.0.0/0
        - Description: Custom TCP 15021 for service mesh gateway health checks
          IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 15021
          ToPort: 15021
          CidrIp: 0.0.0.0/0
        - Description: Custom TCP 15443 for service mesh gateway TLS
          IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 15443
          ToPort: 15443
          CidrIp: 0.0.0.0/0
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${VpcName}-application-sg'
        - Key: !Sub 'kubernetes.io/cluster/${VpcName}'
          Value: shared

Outputs:
  VpcId:
    Description: ID of the VPC.
    Value: !Ref VPC
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-VpcId'
  ControlPlaneSecurityGroupId:
    Description: Security group ID for EKS control plane to worker node communication.
    Value: !Ref ControlPlaneSecurityGroup
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-ControlPlaneSecurityGroupId'
  ApplicationSecurityGroupId:
    Description: Security group ID exposing application ports to the internet.
    Value: !Ref ApplicationSecurityGroup
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-ApplicationSecurityGroupId'
  SubnetIds:
    Description: Comma-separated list of all subnet IDs (public and private).
    Value: !Join
      - ','
      - - !Ref PublicSubnet1
        - !Ref PublicSubnet2
        - !Ref PublicSubnet3
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet1
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet2
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet3
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-SubnetIds'
  PublicSubnetIds:
    Description: Comma-separated list of public subnet IDs.
    Value: !Join
      - ','
      - - !Ref PublicSubnet1
        - !Ref PublicSubnet2
        - !Ref PublicSubnet3
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-PublicSubnetIds'
  PrivateSubnetIds:
    Description: Comma-separated list of private subnet IDs.
    Value: !Join
      - ','
      - - !Ref PrivateSubnet1
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet2
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet3
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-PrivateSubnetIds'

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: "2010-09-09"
Description: >-
  Creates an IAM execution role for a SageMaker HyperPod cluster integrated with an Amazon EKS
  cluster. The role trusts the SageMaker service principal, is attached to the AWS managed
  policy for SageMaker cluster instance roles, and includes inline policies for the Amazon EKS
  CNI plugin, broader ENI management scoped to the provided VPC, ECR image pulls, CloudWatch
  alarm describes, EKS Pod Identity, and list and get access to the lifecycle scripts S3
  bucket. Additionally creates ENI management policies for each provided private subnet and
  security group, and optionally creates a RIG policy. The execution role is tagged as a
  SageMaker HyperPod prerequisite, and the stack exposes the role name and ARN as outputs. All
  required parameters have defaults so the stack can be deployed without explicitly passing
  parameter values; override the defaults with real environment values for production use.

Metadata:
  AWS::CloudFormation::Interface:
    ParameterGroups:
      - Label:
          default: General configuration
        Parameters:
          - pResourceNamePrefix
      - Label:
          default: EKS cluster configuration
        Parameters:
          - pEKSClusterName
          - pVPCId
          - pSecurityGroupIds
          - pPrivateSubnetIds
      - Label:
          default: Lifecycle scripts configuration
        Parameters:
          - pS3BucketNameForLifecycleScripts
      - Label:
          default: RIG configuration
        Parameters:
          - pCreateRIG
          - pRIGInputS3Bucket
          - pRIGOutputS3Bucket
          - pEnableGatedAccess

Parameters:
  pResourceNamePrefix:
    Type: String
    Description: >-
      Prefix used to name the resources created by this template. The SageMaker HyperPod
      execution role is named by appending ExecRole to this prefix.
    Default: sagemaker-hyperpod
    AllowedPattern: ^[a-zA-Z0-9_-]{1,50}$
    ConstraintDescription: >-
      Value must be 1 to 50 characters long and contain only letters, numbers, hyphens, and
      underscores.
    MaxLength: 50
    MinLength: 1
  pEKSClusterName:
    Type: String
    Description: >-
      Name of the existing Amazon EKS cluster that the SageMaker HyperPod cluster integrates
      with. Override the default with the name of your EKS cluster.
    Default: sagemaker-hyperpod-eks
    MinLength: 1
    MaxLength: 100
  pVPCId:
    Type: String
    Description: >-
      ID of the existing VPC that hosts the EKS cluster and the SageMaker HyperPod cluster
      instances, for example vpc-0123456789abcdef0. Override the default with your VPC ID.
    Default: vpc-0123456789abcdef0
    AllowedPattern: ^vpc-[a-zA-Z0-9]*$
    ConstraintDescription: Value must be a valid VPC ID, for example vpc-0123456789abcdef0.
    MinLength: 4
    MaxLength: 50
  pSecurityGroupIds:
    Type: CommaDelimitedList
    Description: >-
      Comma-delimited list of security group IDs for the SageMaker HyperPod cluster instances,
      for example sg-0123456789abcdef0,sg-0123456789abcdef1. One additional ENI management
      policy is created for each of the first three security group IDs. Provide at least two
      security group IDs. Override the default with your security group IDs.
    Default: sg-0123456789abcdef0,sg-0123456789abcdef1
  pPrivateSubnetIds:
    Type: CommaDelimitedList
    Description: >-
      Comma-delimited list of private subnet IDs for the SageMaker HyperPod cluster instances,
      for example subnet-0123456789abcdef0,subnet-0123456789abcdef1. One additional ENI
      management policy is created for each of the first three private subnet IDs. Provide at
      least two private subnet IDs. Override the default with your private subnet IDs.
    Default: subnet-0123456789abcdef0,subnet-0123456789abcdef1
  pS3BucketNameForLifecycleScripts:
    Type: String
    Description: >-
      Name of the existing S3 bucket that stores the SageMaker HyperPod lifecycle scripts.
      Override the default with the name of your lifecycle scripts bucket.
    Default: sagemaker-hyperpod-lifecycle-scripts
    MinLength: 3
    MaxLength: 63
  pCreateRIG:
    Type: String
    Description: >-
      Set to true to create the RIG policy. The RIG policy is only created when this parameter
      is true and pRIGInputS3Bucket is provided.
    Default: "false"
    AllowedValues:
      - "true"
      - "false"
  pRIGInputS3Bucket:
    Type: String
    Description: >-
      Optional name of the S3 bucket that stores RIG input data. The RIG policy is only created
      when pCreateRIG is true and this parameter is provided.
    Default: ""
  pRIGOutputS3Bucket:
    Type: String
    Description: >-
      Optional name of the separate S3 bucket that stores RIG output data. When the RIG policy
      is created and this parameter is provided, full read, write, and delete object access is
      granted on this bucket.
    Default: ""
  pEnableGatedAccess:
    Type: String
    Description: >-
      Set to true to additionally grant gated access permissions in the RIG policy, including
      get object access on S3 access points and buckets and SQS message actions on queues with
      names containing SageMaker or sagemaker.
    Default: "false"
    AllowedValues:
      - "true"
      - "false"

Conditions:
  cCreateRIG:
    Fn::Equals:
      - Ref: pCreateRIG
      - "true"
  cRIGInputBucketProvided:
    Fn::Not:
      - Fn::Equals:
          - Ref: pRIGInputS3Bucket
          - ""
  cRIGOutputBucketProvided:
    Fn::Not:
      - Fn::Equals:
          - Ref: pRIGOutputS3Bucket
          - ""
  cCreateRIGPolicy:
    Fn::And:
      - Condition: cCreateRIG
      - Condition: cRIGInputBucketProvided
  cEnableGatedAccess:
    Fn::Equals:
      - Ref: pEnableGatedAccess
      - "true"
  cHasPrivateSubnet1:
    Fn::Not:
      - Fn::Equals:
          - Fn::Join:
              - ","
              - Ref: pPrivateSubnetIds
          - ""
  cHasPrivateSubnet2:
    Fn::Not:
      - Fn::Equals:
          - Fn::Join:
              - ","
              - Ref: pPrivateSubnetIds
          - Fn::Select:
              - 0
              - Ref: pPrivateSubnetIds
  cHasPrivateSubnet3:
    Fn::And:
      - Condition: cHasPrivateSubnet2
      - Fn::Not:
          - Fn::Equals:
              - Fn::Join:
                  - ","
                  - Ref: pPrivateSubnetIds
              - Fn::Join:
                  - ","
                  - - Fn::Select:
                        - 0
                        - Ref: pPrivateSubnetIds
                    - Fn::Select:
                        - 1
                        - Ref: pPrivateSubnetIds
  cHasSecurityGroup1:
    Fn::Not:
      - Fn::Equals:
          - Fn::Join:
              - ","
              - Ref: pSecurityGroupIds
          - ""
  cHasSecurityGroup2:
    Fn::Not:
      - Fn::Equals:
          - Fn::Join:
              - ","
              - Ref: pSecurityGroupIds
          - Fn::Select:
              - 0
              - Ref: pSecurityGroupIds
  cHasSecurityGroup3:
    Fn::And:
      - Condition: cHasSecurityGroup2
      - Fn::Not:
          - Fn::Equals:
              - Fn::Join:
                  - ","
                  - Ref: pSecurityGroupIds
              - Fn::Join:
                  - ","
                  - - Fn::Select:
                        - 0
                        - Ref: pSecurityGroupIds
                    - Fn::Select:
                        - 1
                        - Ref: pSecurityGroupIds

Resources:
  rHyperPodExecutionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub "${pResourceNamePrefix}ExecRole"
      Description: >-
        Execution role for a SageMaker HyperPod cluster that is integrated with an Amazon EKS
        cluster.
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Sid: AllowSageMakerServiceToAssumeRole
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: sagemaker.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/AmazonSageMakerClusterInstanceRolePolicy"
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: !Sub "${pResourceNamePrefix}-EKSCNI-Policy"
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: "2012-10-17"
            Statement:
              - Sid: EKSCNIPluginPermissions
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ec2:AttachNetworkInterface
                  - ec2:DescribeInstances
                  - ec2:DescribeTags
                  - ec2:DescribeNetworkInterfaces
                  - ec2:DescribeInstanceTypes
                  - ec2:DescribeSubnets
                  - ec2:CreateTags
                Resource: "*"
        - PolicyName: !Sub "${pResourceNamePrefix}-ENI-And-Access-Policy"
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: "2012-10-17"
            Statement:
              - Sid: ENIManagementActions
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ec2:AssignPrivateIpAddresses
                  - ec2:CreateNetworkInterface
                  - ec2:CreateNetworkInterfacePermission
                  - ec2:DeleteNetworkInterface
                  - ec2:DeleteNetworkInterfacePermission
                  - ec2:DetachNetworkInterface
                  - ec2:ModifyNetworkInterfaceAttribute
                Resource:
                  - !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:ec2:*:*:instance/*"
                  - !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:ec2:*:*:network-interface/*"
                  - !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:ec2:*:*:vpc/${pVPCId}"
              - Sid: EC2DescribePermissions
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ec2:DescribeVpcs
                  - ec2:DescribeDhcpOptions
                  - ec2:DescribeSecurityGroups
                Resource: "*"
              - Sid: ECRImagePullPermissions
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ecr:GetAuthorizationToken
                  - ecr:BatchCheckLayerAvailability
                  - ecr:GetDownloadUrlForLayer
                  - ecr:BatchGetImage
                Resource: "*"
              - Sid: CloudWatchAlarmPermissions
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - cloudwatch:DescribeAlarms
                Resource: "*"
              - Sid: EKSPodIdentityAssumeRole
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - eks-auth:AssumeRoleForPodIdentity
                Resource: !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:eks:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:cluster/${pEKSClusterName}"
              - Sid: LifecycleScriptsBucketList
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - s3:ListBucket
                Resource: !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:s3:::${pS3BucketNameForLifecycleScripts}"
              - Sid: LifecycleScriptsBucketGetObjects
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - s3:GetObject
                Resource: !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:s3:::${pS3BucketNameForLifecycleScripts}/*"
      Tags:
        - Key: SageMakerHyperPodPrerequisites
          Value: !Sub "${pResourceNamePrefix}ExecRole"

  rHyperPodRIGPolicy:
    Type: AWS::IAM::ManagedPolicy
    Condition: cCreateRIGPolicy
    Properties:
      ManagedPolicyName: !Sub "${pResourceNamePrefix}-RIG-Policy"
      Description: >-
        RIG policy attached to the SageMaker HyperPod execution role. Grants list and get object
        access on the RIG input S3 bucket and Lambda invocation on functions with names containing
        SageMaker or sagemaker. When gated access is enabled, also grants get object access on S3
        access points and buckets and SQS message actions on queues with names containing SageMaker
        or sagemaker. When a separate RIG output S3 bucket is provided, also grants full read,
        write, and delete object access on that bucket.
      Roles:
        - !Ref rHyperPodExecutionRole
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Sid: RIGInputBucketList
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - s3:ListBucket
            Resource: !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:s3:::${pRIGInputS3Bucket}"
          - Sid: RIGInputBucketGetObjects
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - s3:GetObject
            Resource: !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:s3:::${pRIGInputS3Bucket}/*"
          - Sid: RIGLambdaInvoke
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - lambda:InvokeFunction
            Resource:
              - !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:lambda:*:*:function:*SageMaker*"
              - !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:lambda:*:*:function:*sagemaker*"
          - !If
            - cEnableGatedAccess
            - Sid: RIGGatedAccessS3GetObject
              Effect: Allow
              Action:
                - s3:GetObject
              Resource:
                - !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:s3:*:*:accesspoint/*"
                - !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:s3:*:*:accesspoint/*/object/*"
                - !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:s3:::*/*"
            - !Ref AWS::NoValue
          - !If
            - cEnableGatedAccess
            - Sid: RIGGatedSQSMessageActions
              Effect: Allow
              Action:
                - sqs:GetQueueAttributes
                - sqs:GetQueueUrl
                - sqs:SendMessage
                - sqs:ReceiveMessage
                - sqs:DeleteMessage
              Resource:
                - !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:sqs:*:*:*SageMaker*"
                - !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:sqs:*:*:*sagemaker*"
            - !Ref AWS::NoValue
          - !If
            - cRIGOutputBucketProvided
            - Sid: RIGOutputBucketList
              Effect: Allow
              Action:
                - s3:ListBucket
                - s3:ListBucketMultipartUploads
              Resource: !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:s3:::${pRIGOutputS3Bucket}"
            - !Ref AWS::NoValue
          - !If
            - cRIGOutputBucketProvided
            - Sid: RIGOutputBucketObjectReadWriteDelete
              Effect: Allow
              Action:
                - s3:GetObject
                - s3:PutObject
                - s3:DeleteObject
                - s3:AbortMultipartUpload
              Resource: !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:s3:::${pRIGOutputS3Bucket}/*"
            - !Ref AWS::NoValue

  rHyperPodSubnetENIPolicy1:
    Type: AWS::IAM::ManagedPolicy
    Condition: cHasPrivateSubnet1
    Properties:
      ManagedPolicyName: !Sub "${pResourceNamePrefix}-Subnet1-ENI-Policy"
      Description: Grants ENI management permissions scoped to the first provided private subnet.
      Roles:
        - !Ref rHyperPodExecutionRole
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Sid: Subnet1ENIManagementActions
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - ec2:AssignPrivateIpAddresses
              - ec2:CreateNetworkInterface
              - ec2:CreateNetworkInterfacePermission
              - ec2:DeleteNetworkInterface
              - ec2:DeleteNetworkInterfacePermission
              - ec2:DetachNetworkInterface
              - ec2:ModifyNetworkInterfaceAttribute
            Resource: !Sub
              - "arn:${AWS::Partition}:ec2:*:*:subnet/${SubnetId}"
              - SubnetId: !Select [0, !Ref pPrivateSubnetIds]

  rHyperPodSubnetENIPolicy2:
    Type: AWS::IAM::ManagedPolicy
    Condition: cHasPrivateSubnet2
    Properties:
      ManagedPolicyName: !Sub "${pResourceNamePrefix}-Subnet2-ENI-Policy"
      Description: Grants ENI management permissions scoped to the second provided private subnet.
      Roles:
        - !Ref rHyperPodExecutionRole
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Sid: Subnet2ENIManagementActions
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - ec2:AssignPrivateIpAddresses
              - ec2:CreateNetworkInterface
              - ec2:CreateNetworkInterfacePermission
              - ec2:DeleteNetworkInterface
              - ec2:DeleteNetworkInterfacePermission
              - ec2:DetachNetworkInterface
              - ec2:ModifyNetworkInterfaceAttribute
            Resource: !Sub
              - "arn:${AWS::Partition}:ec2:*:*:subnet/${SubnetId}"
              - SubnetId: !Select [1, !Ref pPrivateSubnetIds]

  rHyperPodSubnetENIPolicy3:
    Type: AWS::IAM::ManagedPolicy
    Condition: cHasPrivateSubnet3
    Properties:
      ManagedPolicyName: !Sub "${pResourceNamePrefix}-Subnet3-ENI-Policy"
      Description: Grants ENI management permissions scoped to the third provided private subnet.
      Roles:
        - !Ref rHyperPodExecutionRole
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Sid: Subnet3ENIManagementActions
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - ec2:AssignPrivateIpAddresses
              - ec2:CreateNetworkInterface
              - ec2:CreateNetworkInterfacePermission
              - ec2:DeleteNetworkInterface
              - ec2:DeleteNetworkInterfacePermission
              - ec2:DetachNetworkInterface
              - ec2:ModifyNetworkInterfaceAttribute
            Resource: !Sub
              - "arn:${AWS::Partition}:ec2:*:*:subnet/${SubnetId}"
              - SubnetId: !Select [2, !Ref pPrivateSubnetIds]

  rHyperPodSecurityGroupENIPolicy1:
    Type: AWS::IAM::ManagedPolicy
    Condition: cHasSecurityGroup1
    Properties:
      ManagedPolicyName: !Sub "${pResourceNamePrefix}-SecurityGroup1-ENI-Policy"
      Description: Grants ENI management permissions scoped to the first provided security group.
      Roles:
        - !Ref rHyperPodExecutionRole
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Sid: SecurityGroup1ENIManagementActions
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - ec2:AssignPrivateIpAddresses
              - ec2:CreateNetworkInterface
              - ec2:CreateNetworkInterfacePermission
              - ec2:DeleteNetworkInterface
              - ec2:DeleteNetworkInterfacePermission
              - ec2:DetachNetworkInterface
              - ec2:ModifyNetworkInterfaceAttribute
            Resource: !Sub
              - "arn:${AWS::Partition}:ec2:*:*:security-group/${SecurityGroupId}"
              - SecurityGroupId: !Select [0, !Ref pSecurityGroupIds]

  rHyperPodSecurityGroupENIPolicy2:
    Type: AWS::IAM::ManagedPolicy
    Condition: cHasSecurityGroup2
    Properties:
      ManagedPolicyName: !Sub "${pResourceNamePrefix}-SecurityGroup2-ENI-Policy"
      Description: Grants ENI management permissions scoped to the second provided security group.
      Roles:
        - !Ref rHyperPodExecutionRole
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Sid: SecurityGroup2ENIManagementActions
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - ec2:AssignPrivateIpAddresses
              - ec2:CreateNetworkInterface
              - ec2:CreateNetworkInterfacePermission
              - ec2:DeleteNetworkInterface
              - ec2:DeleteNetworkInterfacePermission
              - ec2:DetachNetworkInterface
              - ec2:ModifyNetworkInterfaceAttribute
            Resource: !Sub
              - "arn:${AWS::Partition}:ec2:*:*:security-group/${SecurityGroupId}"
              - SecurityGroupId: !Select [1, !Ref pSecurityGroupIds]

  rHyperPodSecurityGroupENIPolicy3:
    Type: AWS::IAM::ManagedPolicy
    Condition: cHasSecurityGroup3
    Properties:
      ManagedPolicyName: !Sub "${pResourceNamePrefix}-SecurityGroup3-ENI-Policy"
      Description: Grants ENI management permissions scoped to the third provided security group.
      Roles:
        - !Ref rHyperPodExecutionRole
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Sid: SecurityGroup3ENIManagementActions
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - ec2:AssignPrivateIpAddresses
              - ec2:CreateNetworkInterface
              - ec2:CreateNetworkInterfacePermission
              - ec2:DeleteNetworkInterface
              - ec2:DeleteNetworkInterfacePermission
              - ec2:DetachNetworkInterface
              - ec2:ModifyNetworkInterfaceAttribute
            Resource: !Sub
              - "arn:${AWS::Partition}:ec2:*:*:security-group/${SecurityGroupId}"
              - SecurityGroupId: !Select [2, !Ref pSecurityGroupIds]

Outputs:
  HyperPodExecutionRoleName:
    Description: Name of the SageMaker HyperPod execution role.
    Value: !Ref rHyperPodExecutionRole
  HyperPodExecutionRoleArn:
    Description: ARN of the SageMaker HyperPod execution role.
    Value: !GetAtt rHyperPodExecutionRole.Arn

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: "2010-09-09"
Description: >-
  Creates three private subnets (10.24.24.0/24, 10.24.25.0/24, 10.24.26.0/24) in
  three configurable Availability Zones (defaults: us-east-1a, us-east-1b,
  us-east-1c). Each subnet gets its own route table with a default route to an
  AZ-specific NAT gateway and is associated with a Network ACL. An S3 gateway
  VPC endpoint with a full-access policy is attached to all three route tables.
  Comma-separated subnet IDs, route table IDs and the subnet group CIDR
  (10.24.24.0/21) are exported using names built dynamically from the region
  and stack name. The template is fully self-contained: when the VPC ID, NAT
  Gateway IDs and Network ACL ID parameters are left at their empty defaults,
  the stack creates a dedicated VPC (10.24.24.0/21) with an internet gateway,
  one public subnet and one NAT gateway per Availability Zone and a private
  Network ACL; when all IDs are supplied, the existing network resources are
  referenced instead.

Metadata:
  AWS::CloudFormation::Interface:
    ParameterGroups:
      - Label:
          default: Target VPC and Network ACL (leave empty to have the stack create dedicated resources)
        Parameters:
          - VpcId
          - NetworkAclId
      - Label:
          default: Availability Zones
        Parameters:
          - AvailabilityZone1
          - AvailabilityZone2
          - AvailabilityZone3
      - Label:
          default: Target NAT Gateways (leave empty to have the stack create dedicated NAT gateways)
        Parameters:
          - NatGatewayAz1
          - NatGatewayAz2
          - NatGatewayAz3

Parameters:
  VpcId:
    Type: String
    Default: ""
    Description: ID of the target VPC for the private subnets. Leave empty to create a dedicated VPC (10.24.24.0/21).
    AllowedPattern: ^(vpc-[0-9a-zA-Z]+)?$
    ConstraintDescription: Must be empty or a valid VPC identifier (vpc-xxxxxxxx).
  NetworkAclId:
    Type: String
    Default: ""
    Description: ID of the Network ACL to associate with all three private subnets. Leave empty to create a dedicated Network ACL.
    AllowedPattern: ^(acl-[0-9a-zA-Z]+)?$
    ConstraintDescription: Must be empty or a valid Network ACL identifier (acl-xxxxxxxx).
  AvailabilityZone1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::AvailabilityZone::Name
    Default: us-east-1a
    Description: Availability Zone for the first private subnet (10.24.24.0/24).
  AvailabilityZone2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::AvailabilityZone::Name
    Default: us-east-1b
    Description: Availability Zone for the second private subnet (10.24.25.0/24).
  AvailabilityZone3:
    Type: AWS::EC2::AvailabilityZone::Name
    Default: us-east-1c
    Description: Availability Zone for the third private subnet (10.24.26.0/24).
  NatGatewayAz1:
    Type: String
    Default: ""
    Description: ID of the NAT Gateway in the first Availability Zone used as the default route target. Leave empty to create a dedicated NAT gateway.
    AllowedPattern: ^(nat-[0-9a-zA-Z]+)?$
    ConstraintDescription: Must be empty or a valid NAT Gateway identifier (nat-xxxxxxxx).
  NatGatewayAz2:
    Type: String
    Default: ""
    Description: ID of the NAT Gateway in the second Availability Zone used as the default route target. Leave empty to create a dedicated NAT gateway.
    AllowedPattern: ^(nat-[0-9a-zA-Z]+)?$
    ConstraintDescription: Must be empty or a valid NAT Gateway identifier (nat-xxxxxxxx).
  NatGatewayAz3:
    Type: String
    Default: ""
    Description: ID of the NAT Gateway in the third Availability Zone used as the default route target. Leave empty to create a dedicated NAT gateway.
    AllowedPattern: ^(nat-[0-9a-zA-Z]+)?$
    ConstraintDescription: Must be empty or a valid NAT Gateway identifier (nat-xxxxxxxx).

Conditions:
  CreateNetwork: !Equals [!Ref VpcId, ""]

Resources:
  Vpc:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPC
    Condition: CreateNetwork
    Properties:
      CidrBlock: 10.24.24.0/21
      EnableDnsHostnames: true
      EnableDnsSupport: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-vpc"
        - Key: Stack
          Value: !Ref AWS::StackName

  InternetGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::InternetGateway
    Condition: CreateNetwork
    Properties:
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-igw"
        - Key: Stack
          Value: !Ref AWS::StackName

  InternetGatewayAttachment:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCGatewayAttachment
    Condition: CreateNetwork
    Properties:
      InternetGatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway
      VpcId: !Ref Vpc

  PublicSubnetAz1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Condition: CreateNetwork
    Properties:
      AvailabilityZone: !Ref AvailabilityZone1
      CidrBlock: 10.24.28.0/24
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: true
      Tags:

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >-
  Baseline IAM operational personas for an AWS account: System Administrator,
  IAM Administrator, Instance Operations, Read-Only Administrator, and
  Read-Only Billing. Creates managed policies, IAM groups, IAM roles, and an
  instance profile for the EC2-assumable role. All non-billing policies
  require MFA, deny access to the AWS Billing console, and deny tampering
  with logging-related KMS keys. Outputs the identifier (ARN) of all created
  IAM groups.

Resources:
  SystemAdministratorPolicy:
    Type: AWS::IAM::ManagedPolicy
    Properties:
      Description: System administrator persona. Near-full access outside of IAM itself. Requires MFA, denies the AWS Billing console, and denies tampering with logging-related KMS keys.
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: AllowAllActionsOutsideIam
            Effect: Allow
            Action: '*'
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: DenyIamOrganizationsAndAccount
            Effect: Deny
            Action:
              - 'account:*'
              - 'iam:*'
              - 'organizations:*'
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: DenyAllActionsUnlessMfaPresent
            Effect: Deny
            Action: '*'
            Resource: '*'
            Condition:
              BoolIfExists:
                aws:MultiFactorAuthPresent: 'false'
          - Sid: DenyBillingConsoleAccess
            Effect: Deny
            Action:
              - 'aws-portal:*'
              - 'billing:*'
              - 'freetier:*'
              - 'payments:*'
              - 'purchase-orders:*'
              - 'tax:*'
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: DenyTamperingWithLoggingKmsKeys
            Effect: Deny
            Action:
              - 'kms:CancelKeyDeletion'
              - 'kms:DeleteAlias'
              - 'kms:DeleteImportedKeyMaterial'
              - 'kms:DisableKey'
              - 'kms:DisableKeyRotation'
              - 'kms:ImportKeyMaterial'
              - 'kms:PutKeyPolicy'
              - 'kms:RevokeGrant'
              - 'kms:ScheduleKeyDeletion'
              - 'kms:TagResource'
              - 'kms:UntagResource'
              - 'kms:UpdateAlias'
              - 'kms:UpdateKeyDescription'
              - 'kms:UpdatePrimaryRegion'
            Resource: '*'
            Condition:
              StringEqualsIgnoreCase:
                aws:ResourceTag/Purpose: logging
          - Sid: DenyTamperingWithLoggingKmsKeyAliases
            Effect: Deny
            Action:
              - 'kms:CreateAlias'
              - 'kms:DeleteAlias'
              - 'kms:UpdateAlias'
            Resource:
              - 'arn:aws:kms:*:*:alias/logs*'
              - 'arn:aws:kms:*:*:alias/aws/logs'

  IAMAdministratorPolicy:
    Type: AWS::IAM::ManagedPolicy
    Properties:
      Description: IAM administrator persona. Full IAM access. Requires MFA, denies the AWS Billing console, and denies tampering with logging-related KMS keys.
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: AllowFullIamAccess
            Effect: Allow
            Action: 'iam:*'
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: DenyAllActionsUnlessMfaPresent
            Effect: Deny
            Action: '*'
            Resource: '*'
            Condition:
              BoolIfExists:
                aws:MultiFactorAuthPresent: 'false'
          - Sid: DenyBillingConsoleAccess
            Effect: Deny
            Action:
              - 'aws-portal:*'
              - 'billing:*'
              - 'freetier:*'
              - 'payments:*'
              - 'purchase-orders:*'
              - 'tax:*'
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: DenyTamperingWithLoggingKmsKeys
            Effect: Deny
            Action:
              - 'kms:CancelKeyDeletion'
              - 'kms:DeleteAlias'
              - 'kms:DeleteImportedKeyMaterial'
              - 'kms:DisableKey'
              - 'kms:DisableKeyRotation'
              - 'kms:ImportKeyMaterial'
              - 'kms:PutKeyPolicy'
              - 'kms:RevokeGrant'
              - 'kms:ScheduleKeyDeletion'
              - 'kms:TagResource'
              - 'kms:UntagResource'
              - 'kms:UpdateAlias'
              - 'kms:UpdateKeyDescription'
              - 'kms:UpdatePrimaryRegion'
            Resource: '*'
            Condition:
              StringEqualsIgnoreCase:
                aws:ResourceTag/Purpose: logging
          - Sid: DenyTamperingWithLoggingKmsKeyAliases
            Effect: Deny
            Action:
              - 'kms:CreateAlias'
              - 'kms:DeleteAlias'
              - 'kms:UpdateAlias'
            Resource:
