              StringEqualsIgnoreCase:
                aws:ResourceTag/Purpose: logging
          - Sid: DenyTamperingWithLoggingKmsKeyAliases
            Effect: Deny
            Action:
              - 'kms:CreateAlias'
              - 'kms:DeleteAlias'
              - 'kms:UpdateAlias'
            Resource:
              - 'arn:aws:kms:*:*:alias/logs*'
              - 'arn:aws:kms:*:*:alias/aws/logs'

  BillingReadOnlyPolicy:
    Type: AWS::IAM::ManagedPolicy
    Properties:
      Description: Read-only billing persona. View-only access to billing information. As the billing persona policy, it intentionally does not include the MFA, billing-console-denial, or logging-KMS-key guardrails.
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: AllowViewBillingInformation
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - 'aws-portal:View*'
              - 'billing:Get*'
              - 'billing:List*'
              - 'budgets:ViewBudget'
              - 'ce:Get*'
              - 'ce:List*'
              - 'cur:Describe*'
              - 'freetier:Get*'
              - 'payments:Get*'
              - 'payments:List*'
              - 'purchase-orders:View*'
              - 'tax:Get*'
              - 'tax:List*'
            Resource: '*'

  SystemAdministratorRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: SystemAdministrator
      Description: System administrator persona role. Near-full access outside of IAM itself.
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: AllowAccountPrincipalsToAssumeRole
            Effect: Allow
            Action: 'sts:AssumeRole'
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root'
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Ref SystemAdministratorPolicy

  IAMAdministratorRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: IAMAdministrator
      Description: IAM administrator persona role. Full IAM access.
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: AllowAccountPrincipalsToAssumeRole
            Effect: Allow
            Action: 'sts:AssumeRole'
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root'
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Ref IAMAdministratorPolicy

  InstanceOperationsRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: InstanceOperations
      Description: Instance operations persona role. EC2, Elastic Load Balancing, CloudWatch, and Auto Scaling access with VPC modification denials. Assumable by account principals and by EC2.
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: AllowAccountPrincipalsToAssumeRole
            Effect: Allow
            Action: 'sts:AssumeRole'
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root'
          - Sid: AllowEc2ServiceToAssumeRole
            Effect: Allow
            Action: 'sts:AssumeRole'
            Principal:
              Service: ec2.amazonaws.com
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Ref InstanceOperationsPolicy

  ReadOnlyAdministratorRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: ReadOnlyAdministrator
      Description: Read-only administrator persona role. Broad read-only access across core services.
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: AllowAccountPrincipalsToAssumeRole
            Effect: Allow
            Action: 'sts:AssumeRole'
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root'
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Ref ReadOnlyAdministratorPolicy

  BillingReadOnlyRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: BillingReadOnly
      Description: Read-only billing persona role. View-only access to billing information.
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: AllowAccountPrincipalsToAssumeRole
            Effect: Allow
            Action: 'sts:AssumeRole'
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root'
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Ref BillingReadOnlyPolicy

  SystemAdministratorGroup:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Group
    Properties:
      GroupName: SystemAdministrator
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Ref SystemAdministratorPolicy
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: AssumeSystemAdministratorRole
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: AllowAssumeSystemAdministratorRole
                Effect: Allow
                Action: 'sts:AssumeRole'
                Resource: !GetAtt SystemAdministratorRole.Arn

  IAMAdministratorGroup:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Group
    Properties:
      GroupName: IAMAdministrator
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Ref IAMAdministratorPolicy
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: AssumeIAMAdministratorRole
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: AllowAssumeIAMAdministratorRole
                Effect: Allow
                Action: 'sts:AssumeRole'
                Resource: !GetAtt IAMAdministratorRole.Arn

  InstanceOperationsGroup:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Group
    Properties:
      GroupName: InstanceOperations
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Ref InstanceOperationsPolicy
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: AssumeInstanceOperationsRole
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: AllowAssumeInstanceOperationsRole
                Effect: Allow
                Action: 'sts:AssumeRole'
                Resource: !GetAtt InstanceOperationsRole.Arn

  ReadOnlyAdministratorGroup:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Group
    Properties:
      GroupName: ReadOnlyAdministrator
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Ref ReadOnlyAdministratorPolicy
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: AssumeReadOnlyAdministratorRole
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: AllowAssumeReadOnlyAdministratorRole
                Effect: Allow
                Action: 'sts:AssumeRole'
                Resource: !GetAtt ReadOnlyAdministratorRole.Arn

  BillingReadOnlyGroup:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Group
    Properties:
      GroupName: BillingReadOnly
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Ref BillingReadOnlyPolicy
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: AssumeBillingReadOnlyRole
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: AllowAssumeBillingReadOnlyRole
                Effect: Allow
                Action: 'sts:AssumeRole'
                Resource: !GetAtt BillingReadOnlyRole.Arn

  InstanceOperationsInstanceProfile:
    Type: AWS::IAM::InstanceProfile
    Properties:
      InstanceProfileName: InstanceOperations
      Roles:
        - !Ref InstanceOperationsRole

Outputs:
  SystemAdministratorGroupId:
    Description: Group ID (ARN) of the SystemAdministrator IAM group.
    Value: !GetAtt SystemAdministratorGroup.Arn
  IAMAdministratorGroupId:
    Description: Group ID (ARN) of the IAMAdministrator IAM group.
    Value: !GetAtt IAMAdministratorGroup.Arn
  InstanceOperationsGroupId:
    Description: Group ID (ARN) of the InstanceOperations IAM group.
    Value: !GetAtt InstanceOperationsGroup.Arn
  ReadOnlyAdministratorGroupId:
    Description: Group ID (ARN) of the ReadOnlyAdministrator IAM group.
    Value: !GetAtt ReadOnlyAdministratorGroup.Arn
  BillingReadOnlyGroupId:
    Description: Group ID (ARN) of the BillingReadOnly IAM group.
    Value: !GetAtt BillingReadOnlyGroup.Arn
  GroupIds:
    Description: Comma-separated list of the IDs (ARNs) of all created IAM groups.
    Value: !Join [',', [!GetAtt SystemAdministratorGroup.Arn, !GetAtt IAMAdministratorGroup.Arn, !GetAtt InstanceOperationsGroup.Arn, !GetAtt ReadOnlyAdministratorGroup.Arn, !GetAtt BillingReadOnlyGroup.Arn]]

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >-
  VPC spanning three Availability Zones with web, application, and database tiers.
  The web tier is public and shares a single route table with a default route to an
  Internet Gateway. Each Availability Zone has a NAT Gateway with its own Elastic IP
  in the web subnet, and the application and database subnets in that zone use their
  own route tables with default routes through the corresponding NAT Gateway.

Metadata:
  AWS::CloudFormation::Interface:
    ParameterGroups:
      - Label:
          default: General
        Parameters:
          - EnvironmentName
      - Label:
          default: VPC and Subnet CIDR Blocks
        Parameters:
          - VpcCidr
          - WebSubnetACidr
          - WebSubnetBCidr
          - WebSubnetCCidr
          - AppSubnetACidr
          - AppSubnetBCidr
          - AppSubnetCCidr
          - DbSubnetACidr
          - DbSubnetBCidr
          - DbSubnetCCidr

Parameters:
  EnvironmentName:
    Type: String
    Default: production
    Description: Prefix used for resource Name tags and output export names.

  VpcCidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.0.0/16
    Description: CIDR block for the VPC. Must contain all subnet CIDR blocks.

  WebSubnetACidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.0.0/22
    Description: CIDR block for the web subnet in the first Availability Zone.

  WebSubnetBCidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.4.0/22
    Description: CIDR block for the web subnet in the second Availability Zone.

  WebSubnetCCidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.8.0/22
    Description: CIDR block for the web subnet in the third Availability Zone.

  AppSubnetACidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.16.0/22
    Description: CIDR block for the application subnet in the first Availability Zone.

  AppSubnetBCidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.20.0/22
    Description: CIDR block for the application subnet in the second Availability Zone.

  AppSubnetCCidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.24.0/22
    Description: CIDR block for the application subnet in the third Availability Zone.

  DbSubnetACidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.32.0/22
    Description: CIDR block for the database subnet in the first Availability Zone.

  DbSubnetBCidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.36.0/22
    Description: CIDR block for the database subnet in the second Availability Zone.

  DbSubnetCCidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.40.0/22
    Description: CIDR block for the database subnet in the third Availability Zone.

Resources:
  VPC:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPC
    Properties:
      CidrBlock: !Ref VpcCidr
      EnableDnsHostnames: true
      EnableDnsSupport: true
      InstanceTenancy: default
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-vpc'

  InternetGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::InternetGateway
    Properties:
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-igw'

  InternetGatewayAttachment:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      InternetGatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway
      VpcId: !Ref VPC

  WebSubnetA:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs '']
      CidrBlock: !Ref WebSubnetACidr
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-web-a'
        - Key: Tier
          Value: web
      VpcId: !Ref VPC

  WebSubnetB:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [1, !GetAZs '']
      CidrBlock: !Ref WebSubnetBCidr
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-web-b'
        - Key: Tier
          Value: web
      VpcId: !Ref VPC

  WebSubnetC:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [2, !GetAZs '']
      CidrBlock: !Ref WebSubnetCCidr
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-web-c'
        - Key: Tier
          Value: web
      VpcId: !Ref VPC

  AppSubnetA:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs '']
      CidrBlock: !Ref AppSubnetACidr
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-app-a'
        - Key: Tier
          Value: application
      VpcId: !Ref VPC

  AppSubnetB:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [1, !GetAZs '']
      CidrBlock: !Ref AppSubnetBCidr
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-app-b'
        - Key: Tier
          Value: application
      VpcId: !Ref VPC

  AppSubnetC:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [2, !GetAZs '']
      CidrBlock: !Ref AppSubnetCCidr
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-app-c'
        - Key: Tier
          Value: application
      VpcId: !Ref VPC

  DbSubnetA:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs '']
      CidrBlock: !Ref DbSubnetACidr
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-db-a'
        - Key: Tier
          Value: database
      VpcId: !Ref VPC

  DbSubnetB:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [1, !GetAZs '']
      CidrBlock: !Ref DbSubnetBCidr
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-db-b'
        - Key: Tier
          Value: database
      VpcId: !Ref VPC

  DbSubnetC:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [2, !GetAZs '']
      CidrBlock: !Ref DbSubnetCCidr
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-db-c'
        - Key: Tier
          Value: database
      VpcId: !Ref VPC

  NatEIPA:
    Type: AWS::EC2::EIP
    DependsOn: InternetGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      Domain: vpc
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-nat-eip-a'

  NatEIPB:
    Type: AWS::EC2::EIP
    DependsOn: InternetGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      Domain: vpc
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-nat-eip-b'

  NatEIPC:
    Type: AWS::EC2::EIP
    DependsOn: InternetGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      Domain: vpc
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-nat-eip-c'

  NatGatewayA:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NatGateway
    DependsOn: InternetGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      AllocationId: !GetAtt NatEIPA.AllocationId
      SubnetId: !Ref WebSubnetA
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-nat-a'

  NatGatewayB:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NatGateway
    DependsOn: InternetGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      AllocationId: !GetAtt NatEIPB.AllocationId
      SubnetId: !Ref WebSubnetB
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-nat-b'

  NatGatewayC:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NatGateway
    DependsOn: InternetGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      AllocationId: !GetAtt NatEIPC.AllocationId
      SubnetId: !Ref WebSubnetC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-nat-c'

  WebRouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-web-rt'
        - Key: Tier
          Value: web
      VpcId: !Ref VPC

  WebDefaultRoute:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    DependsOn: InternetGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      GatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway
      RouteTableId: !Ref WebRouteTable

  AppRouteTableA:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-app-rt-a'
        - Key: Tier
          Value: application
      VpcId: !Ref VPC

  AppDefaultRouteA:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    Properties:
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      NatGatewayId: !Ref NatGatewayA
      RouteTableId: !Ref AppRouteTableA

  AppRouteTableB:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-app-rt-b'
        - Key: Tier
          Value: application
      VpcId: !Ref VPC

  AppDefaultRouteB:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    Properties:
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      NatGatewayId: !Ref NatGatewayB
      RouteTableId: !Ref AppRouteTableB

  AppRouteTableC:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-app-rt-c'
        - Key: Tier
          Value: application
      VpcId: !Ref VPC

  AppDefaultRouteC:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    Properties:
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      NatGatewayId: !Ref NatGatewayC
      RouteTableId: !Ref AppRouteTableC

  DbRouteTableA:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-db-rt-a'
        - Key: Tier
          Value: database
      VpcId: !Ref VPC

  DbDefaultRouteA:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    Properties:
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      NatGatewayId: !Ref NatGatewayA
      RouteTableId: !Ref DbRouteTableA

  DbRouteTableB:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-db-rt-b'
        - Key: Tier
          Value: database
      VpcId: !Ref VPC

  DbDefaultRouteB:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    Properties:
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      NatGatewayId: !Ref NatGatewayB
      RouteTableId: !Ref DbRouteTableB

  DbRouteTableC:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-db-rt-c'
        - Key: Tier
          Value: database
      VpcId: !Ref VPC

  DbDefaultRouteC:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    Properties:
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      NatGatewayId: !Ref NatGatewayC
      RouteTableId: !Ref DbRouteTableC

  WebSubnetARouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref WebRouteTable
      SubnetId: !Ref WebSubnetA

  WebSubnetBRouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref WebRouteTable
      SubnetId: !Ref WebSubnetB

  WebSubnetCRouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref WebRouteTable
      SubnetId: !Ref WebSubnetC

  AppSubnetARouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref AppRouteTableA
      SubnetId: !Ref AppSubnetA

  AppSubnetBRouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref AppRouteTableB
      SubnetId: !Ref AppSubnetB

  AppSubnetCRouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref AppRouteTableC
      SubnetId: !Ref AppSubnetC

  DbSubnetARouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref DbRouteTableA
      SubnetId: !Ref DbSubnetA

  DbSubnetBRouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref DbRouteTableB
      SubnetId: !Ref DbSubnetB

  DbSubnetCRouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref DbRouteTableC
      SubnetId: !Ref DbSubnetC

Outputs:
  VpcId:
    Description: The ID of the VPC.
    Value: !Ref VPC
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-VpcId'

  AvailabilityZones:
    Description: The three Availability Zones used by the tiers, comma-separated.
    Value: !Join [',', [!Select [0, !GetAZs ''], !Select [1, !GetAZs ''], !Select [2, !GetAZs '']]]
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-AvailabilityZones'

  WebSubnetIds:
    Description: The IDs of the web tier subnets, comma-separated, ordered by Availability Zone.
    Value: !Join [',', [!Ref WebSubnetA, !Ref WebSubnetB, !Ref WebSubnetC]]
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-WebSubnetIds'

  AppSubnetIds:
    Description: The IDs of the application tier subnets, comma-separated, ordered by Availability Zone.
    Value: !Join [',', [!Ref AppSubnetA, !Ref AppSubnetB, !Ref AppSubnetC]]
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-AppSubnetIds'

  DbSubnetIds:
    Description: The IDs of the database tier subnets, comma-separated, ordered by Availability Zone.
    Value: !Join [',', [!Ref DbSubnetA, !Ref DbSubnetB, !Ref DbSubnetC]]
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-DbSubnetIds'

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: "2010-09-09"

Description: >-
  Creates the shared IAM roles and instance profiles required by the Amazon EKS
  Quick Start stacks. All role names use the eks-quickstart prefix and the
  shared role references are stored as SSM parameters under the
  /quickstart/amazon-eks parameter path.

Resources:

  CopyZipsRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: eks-quickstart-copy-zip-role
      Description: Lambda execution role for copying zip artifacts from S3
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: "sts:AssumeRole"
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSLambdaBasicExecutionRole"
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: eks-quickstart-copy-zip-policy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: "2012-10-17"
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - s3:GetBucketLocation
                  - s3:ListBucket
                Resource: !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:s3:::*"
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - s3:GetObject
                Resource: !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:s3:::*/*"

  ResourceInfoRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: eks-quickstart-resource-info-role
      Description: Lambda execution role for reading resource information with account-wide read-only access
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: "sts:AssumeRole"
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/ReadOnlyAccess"
        - !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSLambdaBasicExecutionRole"

  CreateVpcRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: eks-quickstart-create-vpc-role
      Description: Lambda execution role for creating and deleting the Amazon VPC network resources
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: "sts:AssumeRole"
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSLambdaBasicExecutionRole"
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: eks-quickstart-create-vpc-policy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: "2012-10-17"
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ec2:AllocateAddress
                  - ec2:AssociateDhcpOptions
                  - ec2:AssociateRouteTable
                  - ec2:AssociateVpcCidrBlock
                  - ec2:AttachInternetGateway
                  - ec2:CreateDhcpOptions
                  - ec2:CreateInternetGateway
                  - ec2:CreateNatGateway
                  - ec2:CreateNetworkAcl
                  - ec2:CreateNetworkAclEntry
                  - ec2:CreateRoute
                  - ec2:CreateRouteTable
                  - ec2:CreateSubnet
                  - ec2:CreateTags
                  - ec2:CreateVpc
                  - ec2:DeleteDhcpOptions
                  - ec2:DeleteInternetGateway
                  - ec2:DeleteNatGateway
                  - ec2:DeleteNetworkAcl
                  - ec2:DeleteNetworkAclEntry
                  - ec2:DeleteRoute
                  - ec2:DeleteRouteTable
                  - ec2:DeleteSubnet
                  - ec2:DeleteTags
                  - ec2:DeleteVpc
                  - ec2:DescribeAddresses
                  - ec2:DescribeAvailabilityZones
                  - ec2:DescribeDhcpOptions
                  - ec2:DescribeInternetGateways
                  - ec2:DescribeNatGateways
                  - ec2:DescribeNetworkAcls
                  - ec2:DescribePrefixLists
                  - ec2:DescribeRouteTables
                  - ec2:DescribeSecurityGroups
                  - ec2:DescribeSubnets
                  - ec2:DescribeTags
                  - ec2:DescribeVpcAttribute
                  - ec2:DescribeVpcs
                  - ec2:DetachInternetGateway
                  - ec2:DisassociateRouteTable
                  - ec2:DisassociateVpcCidrBlock
                  - ec2:ModifySubnetAttribute
                  - ec2:ModifyVpcAttribute
                  - ec2:ReleaseAddress
                  - ec2:ReplaceRouteTableAssociation
                Resource: "*"

  DeleteBucketContentsRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: eks-quickstart-delete-bucket-contents-role
      Description: Lambda execution role for deleting the contents of an S3 bucket
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: "sts:AssumeRole"
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSLambdaBasicExecutionRole"
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: eks-quickstart-delete-bucket-contents-policy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: "2012-10-17"
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - s3:GetBucketLocation
                  - s3:ListBucket
                  - s3:ListBucketVersions
                Resource: !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:s3:::*"
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - s3:DeleteObject
                  - s3:DeleteObjectVersion
                Resource: !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:s3:::*/*"

  ElbCleanupRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: eks-quickstart-elb-cleanup-role
      Description: Lambda execution role for cleaning up load balancers and target groups
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: "sts:AssumeRole"
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSLambdaBasicExecutionRole"
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: eks-quickstart-elb-cleanup-policy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: "2012-10-17"
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - elasticloadbalancing:DeleteListener
                  - elasticloadbalancing:DeleteLoadBalancer
                  - elasticloadbalancing:DeleteRule
                  - elasticloadbalancing:DeleteTargetGroup
                  - elasticloadbalancing:DescribeListeners
                  - elasticloadbalancing:DescribeLoadBalancerAttributes
                  - elasticloadbalancing:DescribeLoadBalancers
                  - elasticloadbalancing:DescribeRules
                  - elasticloadbalancing:DescribeTags
                  - elasticloadbalancing:DescribeTargetGroupAttributes
                  - elasticloadbalancing:DescribeTargetGroups
                  - elasticloadbalancing:DescribeTargetHealth
                  - elasticloadbalancing:ModifyLoadBalancerAttributes
                Resource: "*"

  SecurityGroupCleanupRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: eks-quickstart-sg-cleanup-role
      Description: Lambda execution role for cleaning up security group dependencies
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: "sts:AssumeRole"
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSLambdaBasicExecutionRole"
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: eks-quickstart-sg-cleanup-policy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: "2012-10-17"
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ec2:DeleteSecurityGroup
                  - ec2:DescribeInstances
                  - ec2:DescribeNetworkInterfaceAttribute
                  - ec2:DescribeNetworkInterfaces
                  - ec2:DescribeSecurityGroupReferences
                  - ec2:DescribeSecurityGroups
                  - ec2:DescribeVpcs
                  - ec2:RevokeSecurityGroupEgress
                  - ec2:RevokeSecurityGroupIngress
                Resource: "*"

  LambdaCleanupRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: eks-quickstart-lambda-cleanup-role
      Description: Lambda execution role for cleaning up Lambda functions
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: "sts:AssumeRole"
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSLambdaBasicExecutionRole"
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: eks-quickstart-lambda-cleanup-policy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: "2012-10-17"
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - lambda:DeleteFunction
                  - lambda:GetFunction
                  - lambda:GetFunctionConfiguration
                  - lambda:ListEventSourceMappings
                  - lambda:ListFunctions
                  - lambda:ListTags
                  - lambda:RemovePermission
                Resource: "*"

  GetCallerIdentityRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: eks-quickstart-get-caller-identity-role
      Description: Lambda execution role for resolving the caller ARN
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: "sts:AssumeRole"
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSLambdaBasicExecutionRole"
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: eks-quickstart-get-caller-identity-policy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: "2012-10-17"
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - sts:GetCallerIdentity
                Resource: "*"

  CustomResourceTypeRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: eks-quickstart-custom-resource-type-role
      Description: Lambda execution role for registering CloudFormation custom resource types
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: "sts:AssumeRole"
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSLambdaBasicExecutionRole"
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: eks-quickstart-custom-resource-type-policy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: "2012-10-17"
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - cloudformation:DeregisterType
                  - cloudformation:DescribeType
                  - cloudformation:DescribeTypeRegistration
                  - cloudformation:ListTypeRegistrations
                  - cloudformation:ListTypes
                  - cloudformation:RecordHandlerProgress
                  - cloudformation:RegisterType
                  - cloudformation:SetTypeConfiguration
                  - cloudformation:TestType
                Resource: "*"

  NodeSecurityGroupRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: eks-quickstart-node-sg-role
      Description: Lambda execution role for managing node security groups
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: "sts:AssumeRole"
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSLambdaBasicExecutionRole"
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: eks-quickstart-node-sg-policy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: "2012-10-17"
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ec2:AuthorizeSecurityGroupEgress
                  - ec2:AuthorizeSecurityGroupIngress
                  - ec2:CreateSecurityGroup
                  - ec2:CreateTags
                  - ec2:DeleteSecurityGroup
                  - ec2:DeleteTags
                  - ec2:DescribeInstances
                  - ec2:DescribeNetworkInterfaces
                  - ec2:DescribeSecurityGroupRules
                  - ec2:DescribeSecurityGroups
                  - ec2:DescribeSubnets
                  - ec2:DescribeVpcs
                  - ec2:RevokeSecurityGroupEgress
                  - ec2:RevokeSecurityGroupIngress
                Resource: "*"

  EksRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: eks-quickstart-eks-role
      Description: EKS control plane role that can be assumed by the EKS service
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: eks.amazonaws.com
            Action: "sts:AssumeRole"
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/AmazonEKSClusterPolicy"
        - !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/AmazonEKSServicePolicy"
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: eks-quickstart-eks-role-policy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: "2012-10-17"
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ec2:DescribeAccountAttributes
                  - ec2:DescribeAddresses
                  - ec2:DescribeInternetGateways
                Resource: "*"

  FargateExecutionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: eks-quickstart-fargate-execution-role
      Description: Fargate pod execution role that can be assumed by the EKS Fargate pods service
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: eks-fargate-pods.amazonaws.com
            Action: "sts:AssumeRole"
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/AmazonEKSFargatePodExecutionRolePolicy"

  FargateProfileRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: eks-quickstart-fargate-profile-role
      Description: Lambda execution role for creating and deleting EKS Fargate profiles
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: "sts:AssumeRole"
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSLambdaBasicExecutionRole"
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: eks-quickstart-fargate-profile-policy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: "2012-10-17"
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - eks:CreateFargateProfile
                  - eks:DeleteFargateProfile
                  - eks:DescribeCluster
                  - eks:DescribeFargateProfile
                  - eks:ListClusters
                  - eks:ListFargateProfiles
                Resource: "*"
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - iam:PassRole
                Resource: !GetAtt FargateExecutionRole.Arn
                Condition:
                  StringEquals:
                    "iam:PassedToService": eks-fargate-pods.amazonaws.com

  ManagedNodeRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: eks-quickstart-managed-node-role
      Description: Node instance role for EKS managed node groups that can be assumed by EC2 instances
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: ec2.amazonaws.com
            Action: "sts:AssumeRole"
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/AmazonEKSWorkerNodePolicy"
        - !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/AmazonEKS_CNI_Policy"
        - !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/AmazonEC2ContainerRegistryReadOnly"
        - !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/AmazonElasticFileSystemReadOnlyAccess"
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: eks-quickstart-node-signal-policy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: "2012-10-17"
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - cloudformation:SignalResource
                Resource: "*"

  ManagedNodeInstanceProfile:
    Type: AWS::IAM::InstanceProfile
    Properties:
      InstanceProfileName: eks-quickstart-managed-node-instance-profile
      Roles:
        - !Ref ManagedNodeRole

  UnmanagedNodeRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: eks-quickstart-unmanaged-node-role
      Description: Node instance role for EKS unmanaged node groups that can be assumed by EC2 instances
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: ec2.amazonaws.com
            Action: "sts:AssumeRole"
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/AmazonEKSWorkerNodePolicy"
        - !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/AmazonEKS_CNI_Policy"
        - !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/AmazonEC2ContainerRegistryReadOnly"
        - !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/AmazonElasticFileSystemReadOnlyAccess"
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: eks-quickstart-node-signal-policy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: "2012-10-17"
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - cloudformation:SignalResource
                Resource: "*"

  UnmanagedNodeInstanceProfile:
    Type: AWS::IAM::InstanceProfile
    Properties:
      InstanceProfileName: eks-quickstart-unmanaged-node-instance-profile
      Roles:
        - !Ref UnmanagedNodeRole

  RoleCreationRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: eks-quickstart-create-role-role
      Description: Lambda execution role for creating the CloudFormation-Kubernetes-VPC role
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: "sts:AssumeRole"
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSLambdaBasicExecutionRole"
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: eks-quickstart-create-role-policy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: "2012-10-17"
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - iam:CreateRole
                  - iam:DeleteRole
                  - iam:GetRole
                  - iam:ListAttachedRolePolicies
                  - iam:TagRole
                  - iam:UntagRole
                  - iam:UpdateAssumeRolePolicy
                  - iam:UpdateRole
                Resource: !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:role/CloudFormation-Kubernetes-VPC"
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - iam:AttachRolePolicy
                  - iam:DetachRolePolicy
                Resource: !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:role/CloudFormation-Kubernetes-VPC"
                Condition:
                  ArnEquals:
                    "iam:PolicyArn":
                      - !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSLambdaENIManagementAccess"
                      - !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSLambdaBasicExecutionRole"

  EksRoleArnParameter:

      Name: /quickstart/amazon-eks/eks-role-arn

  FargateExecutionRoleArnParameter:

  ManagedNodeRoleArnParameter:

    Properties:
      Name: /quickstart/amazon-eks/managed-node-role-arn
      Description: ARN of the shared EKS managed node instance role used by the EKS Quick Start stacks
      Type: String
      Value: !GetAtt ManagedNodeRole.Arn

  ManagedNodeInstanceProfileParameter:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Parameter
    Properties:
      Name: /quickstart/amazon-eks/managed-node-instance-profile

      Value: !Ref UnmanagedNodeInstanceProfile

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >-
  Small lab VPC spanning two Availability Zones with two web-tier subnets and
  two application-tier subnets sharing a single route table. Includes a
  web-tier security group allowing inbound HTTPS from the VPC CIDR range, a
  gateway VPC endpoint for Amazon S3 with read-only access for any principal,
  and interface VPC endpoints for Amazon Kinesis Data Firehose and Amazon
  Kinesis Data Streams in the web-tier subnets secured by the web-tier
  security group.

Metadata:
  AWS::CloudFormation::Interface:
    ParameterGroups:
      - Label:
          default: Network Configuration
        Parameters:
          - VpcCidr
    ParameterLabels:
      VpcCidr:
        default: VPC CIDR block

Parameters:
  VpcCidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.0.0/16
    Description: CIDR block for the lab VPC. Four subnets are derived automatically by extending the VPC prefix by 8 bits.
    AllowedPattern: '^(([0-9]|[1-9][0-9]|1[0-9]{2}|2[0-4][0-9]|25[0-5])\.){3}([0-9]|[1-9][0-9]|1[0-9]{2}|2[0-4][0-9]|25[0-5])/(1[6-9]|20)$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must be a valid IPv4 CIDR block with a prefix between /16 and /20.

Outputs:
  VpcId:
    Description: ID of the lab VPC.
    Value: !Ref VPC
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-VpcId'
  WebSubnet1Id:
    Description: ID of the first web-tier subnet (first Availability Zone).
    Value: !Ref WebSubnet1
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-WebSubnet1Id'
  WebSubnet2Id:
    Description: ID of the second web-tier subnet (second Availability Zone).
    Value: !Ref WebSubnet2
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-WebSubnet2Id'
  AppSubnet1Id:
    Description: ID of the first application-tier subnet (first Availability Zone).
    Value: !Ref AppSubnet1
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-AppSubnet1Id'
  AppSubnet2Id:
    Description: ID of the second application-tier subnet (second Availability Zone).
    Value: !Ref AppSubnet2
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-AppSubnet2Id'
  WebTierSecurityGroupId:
    Description: ID of the web-tier security group.
    Value: !Ref WebTierSecurityGroup
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-WebTierSecurityGroupId'

Resources:
  VPC:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPC
    Properties:
      CidrBlock: !Ref VpcCidr
      EnableDnsHostnames: true
      EnableDnsSupport: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-vpc'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: lab

  SharedRouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-shared-route-table'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: lab

  WebSubnet1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      AvailabilityZone: !Select
        - 0
        - !GetAZs ''
      CidrBlock: !Select
        - 0
        - !Cidr
          - !Ref VpcCidr
          - 4
          - 8
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-web-subnet-1'
        - Key: Tier
          Value: web

  WebSubnet2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      AvailabilityZone: !Select
        - 1
        - !GetAZs ''
      CidrBlock: !Select
        - 1
        - !Cidr
          - !Ref VpcCidr
          - 4
          - 8
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-web-subnet-2'
        - Key: Tier
          Value: web

  AppSubnet1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      AvailabilityZone: !Select
        - 0
        - !GetAZs ''
      CidrBlock: !Select
        - 2
        - !Cidr
          - !Ref VpcCidr
          - 4
          - 8
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-app-subnet-1'
        - Key: Tier
          Value: application

  AppSubnet2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      AvailabilityZone: !Select
        - 1
        - !GetAZs ''
      CidrBlock: !Select
        - 3
        - !Cidr
          - !Ref VpcCidr
          - 4
          - 8
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-app-subnet-2'
        - Key: Tier
          Value: application

  WebSubnet1RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref WebSubnet1
      RouteTableId: !Ref SharedRouteTable

  WebSubnet2RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref WebSubnet2
      RouteTableId: !Ref SharedRouteTable

  AppSubnet1RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref AppSubnet1
      RouteTableId: !Ref SharedRouteTable

  AppSubnet2RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref AppSubnet2
      RouteTableId: !Ref SharedRouteTable

  WebTierSecurityGroup:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroup
    Properties:
      GroupDescription: Allows inbound HTTPS traffic from within the VPC address range.
      GroupName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-web-tier-sg'
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      SecurityGroupIngress:
        - Description: HTTPS from within the VPC address range
          IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 443
          ToPort: 443
          CidrIp: !Ref VpcCidr
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-web-tier-sg'
        - Key: Tier
          Value: web

  S3GatewayEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      ServiceName: !Sub 'com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.s3'
      VpcEndpointType: Gateway
      RouteTableIds:
        - !Ref SharedRouteTable
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: AllowS3ReadOnlyAccessForAnyPrincipal
            Effect: Allow
            Principal: '*'
            Action:
              - 's3:Get*'
              - 's3:List*'
            Resource: '*'
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-s3-gateway-endpoint'

  FirehoseInterfaceEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      ServiceName: !Sub 'com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.kinesis-firehose'
      VpcEndpointType: Interface
      PrivateDnsEnabled: true
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref WebSubnet1
        - !Ref WebSubnet2
      SecurityGroupIds:
        - !Ref WebTierSecurityGroup
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-firehose-endpoint'

  KinesisStreamsInterfaceEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      ServiceName: !Sub 'com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.kinesis-streams'
      VpcEndpointType: Interface
      PrivateDnsEnabled: true
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref WebSubnet1
        - !Ref WebSubnet2
      SecurityGroupIds:
        - !Ref WebTierSecurityGroup
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-kinesis-streams-endpoint'

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: "2010-09-09"
Description: >-
  Shared per-account IAM prerequisites for multiple Amazon EKS cluster deployments driven by
  CloudFormation custom resources backed by Lambda functions in this account. Creates scoped
  Lambda execution roles for each custom-resource handler (copying deployment assets between
  S3 buckets, reading arbitrary AWS resources, creating a VPC-related IAM role, emptying the
  contents of S3 buckets, cleaning up orphaned load balancers and their dependent security
  groups and network interfaces, cleaning up leftover Lambda functions, looking up the calling
  identity, registering CloudFormation resource provider types and associated custom
  resources, resolving Systems Manager parameters under a common configuration path, and
  creating the IAM role that CloudFormation assumes when provisioning cluster VPC resources),
  plus the Amazon EKS control plane role, the Fargate profile role, and managed/unmanaged
  worker node roles with matching instance profiles. All names derive from a single common
  name prefix.

Parameters:
  NamePrefix:
    Type: String
    Description: >-
      Common name prefix applied to every role and instance profile created by this template
      so that names stay consistent across all Amazon EKS cluster deployments in the account.
    Default: eks-cluster
    MinLength: 2
    MaxLength: 30
    AllowedPattern: "^[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9-]{1,29}$"
    ConstraintDescription: >-
      Name prefix must start with a letter and contain 2 to 30 letters, digits or hyphens.

Metadata:
  AWS::CloudFormation::Interface:
    ParameterGroups:
      - Label:
          default: Naming convention
        Parameters:
          - NamePrefix
    ParameterLabels:
      NamePrefix:
        default: Common name prefix

Resources:
  CopyAssetsLambdaRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub "${NamePrefix}-copy-assets-role"
      Description: Execution role for the custom resource handler that copies deployment assets between S3 buckets.
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                aws:SourceAccount: !Ref "AWS::AccountId"
      ManagedPolicyArns:

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >-
  Creates a self-contained IAM user and group configuration with an automatically
  generated Secrets Manager secret for testing purposes. The IAM user's username
  and console login password resolve directly from the username and password keys
  of the generated secret.

Parameters:
  ID:
    Type: String
    Default: 999hadvhgchjesr
    Description: Unique identifier used when naming the IAM group and the stack exports.
    MinLength: 1
    MaxLength: 64
    AllowedPattern: '^[a-zA-Z0-9_-]+$'
    ConstraintDescription: ID must contain only alphanumeric characters, hyphens, and underscores.

Resources:
  MinesweeperSecret:
    Type: AWS::SecretsManager::Secret
    Properties:
      Description: Minesweeper user secret
      GenerateSecretString:
        SecretStringTemplate: '{"username":"minesweeper-user"}'
        GenerateStringKey: password
        PasswordLength: 15
        RequireEachIncludedType: true
        ExcludeCharacters: '|;,."<>%`'

  MinesweeperGroup:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Group
    Properties:
      GroupName: !Sub 'minesweeper-${ID}'
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: !Sub 'minesweeper-inline-policy-${ID}'
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - 'ec2:*'
                  - 'cloudformation:*'
                  - 'secretsmanager:*'
                Resource: '*'

  MinesweeperUser:
    Type: AWS::IAM::User
    Properties:
      UserName: !Sub '{{resolve:secretsmanager:${MinesweeperSecret}:SecretString:username}}'
      LoginProfile:
        Password: !Sub '{{resolve:secretsmanager:${MinesweeperSecret}:SecretString:password}}'
        PasswordResetRequired: false
      Groups:
        - !Ref MinesweeperGroup

Outputs:
  MinesweeperUserArn:
    Description: ARN of the minesweeper IAM user.
    Value: !GetAtt MinesweeperUser.Arn
    Export:
      Name: !Sub 'minesweeper-user-arn-${ID}'

  MinesweeperSecretArn:
    Description: ARN of the secret that stores the minesweeper user credentials.
    Value: !Ref MinesweeperSecret
    Export:
      Name: !Sub 'minesweeper-secret-arn-${ID}'
