AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >
  Production stack for author catalog data. Provisions the DynamoDB table
  AuthorsTable_prod (string HASH partition key AuthorName, string RANGE sort
  key BookTitle, provisioned throughput of 10 RCU and 5 WCU, SSE explicitly
  disabled, TTL enabled on the ExpirationTime attribute) and its supporting
  IAM query infrastructure: an IAM role at path / trusting
  dynamodb.amazonaws.com with an attached IAM policy named
  DynamoDBQueryPolicy that allows dynamodb:Query on all resources.

Resources:
  AuthorsTable:
    Type: AWS::DynamoDB::Table
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      TableName: AuthorsTable_prod
      AttributeDefinitions:
        - AttributeName: AuthorName
          AttributeType: S
        - AttributeName: BookTitle
          AttributeType: S
      KeySchema:
        - AttributeName: AuthorName
          KeyType: HASH
        - AttributeName: BookTitle
          KeyType: RANGE
      ProvisionedThroughput:
        ReadCapacityUnits: 10
        WriteCapacityUnits: 5
      SSESpecification:
        SSEEnabled: false
      TimeToLiveSpecification:
        AttributeName: ExpirationTime
        Enabled: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: prod
        - Key: Application
          Value: AuthorCatalog

  AuthorsTableQueryRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: dynamodb.amazonaws.com
            Action: 'sts:AssumeRole'
      Path: /
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: prod
        - Key: Application
          Value: AuthorCatalog

  AuthorsTableQueryPolicy:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Policy
    Properties:
      PolicyName: DynamoDBQueryPolicy
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Action: 'dynamodb:Query'
            Resource: '*'
      Roles:
        - !Ref AuthorsTableQueryRole

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: "2010-09-09"
Description: >
  EC2 supporting infrastructure for the CocktailDB deployment. Provisions an
  IAM role trusted by EC2 with CloudWatch Agent and S3 analytics/backup bucket
  permissions, an IAM instance profile referencing the role, and a VPC-domain
  Elastic IP. Environment and Project tags are applied across all resources
  and key attributes are exported as stack outputs.

Metadata:
  AWS::CloudFormation::Interface:
    ParameterGroups:
      - Label:
          default: Environment Configuration
        Parameters:
          - Environment
    ParameterLabels:
      Environment:
        default: Deployment Environment

Parameters:
  Environment:
    Type: String
    Default: prod
    AllowedValues:
      - dev
      - prod
    Description: Deployment environment for the CocktailDB stack (dev or prod).

Resources:
  CocktailDbEc2Role:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub cocktaildb-${Environment}-ec2-role
      Path: /
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: ec2.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/CloudWatchAgentServerPolicy
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: cocktaildb-s3-bucket-access
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: "2012-10-17"
            Statement:
              - Sid: CocktailDbListAnalyticsAndBackupBuckets
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - s3:ListBucket
                Resource:
                  - !Sub arn:aws:s3:::cocktailanalytics-${AWS::AccountId}-${Environment}
                  - !Sub arn:aws:s3:::cocktaildbbackups-${AWS::AccountId}-${Environment}
              - Sid: CocktailDbObjectAccessAnalyticsAndBackupBuckets
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - s3:GetObject
                  - s3:PutObject
                  - s3:DeleteObject
                Resource:
                  - !Sub arn:aws:s3:::cocktailanalytics-${AWS::AccountId}-${Environment}/*
                  - !Sub arn:aws:s3:::cocktaildbbackups-${AWS::AccountId}-${Environment}/*
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub cocktaildb-${Environment}-ec2-role
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment
        - Key: Project
          Value: cocktaildb

  CocktailDbInstanceProfile:
    Type: AWS::IAM::InstanceProfile
    Properties:
      InstanceProfileName: !Sub cocktaildb-${Environment}-ec2-profile
      Path: /
      Roles:
        - !Ref CocktailDbEc2Role

  CocktailDbElasticIp:
    Type: AWS::EC2::EIP
    Properties:
      Domain: vpc
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub cocktaildb-${Environment}
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment
        - Key: Project
          Value: cocktaildb

Outputs:
  RoleName:
    Description: Name of the CocktailDB EC2 IAM role.
    Value: !Ref CocktailDbEc2Role
    Export:
      Name: !Sub ${AWS::StackName}-CocktailDbRoleName
  RoleArn:
    Description: ARN of the CocktailDB EC2 IAM role.
    Value: !GetAtt CocktailDbEc2Role.Arn
    Export:
      Name: !Sub ${AWS::StackName}-CocktailDbRoleArn
  InstanceProfileName:
    Description: Name of the CocktailDB EC2 instance profile.
    Value: !Ref CocktailDbInstanceProfile
    Export:
      Name: !Sub ${AWS::StackName}-CocktailDbInstanceProfileName
  ElasticIpAddress:
    Description: Elastic IP address allocated for the CocktailDB deployment.
    Value: !Ref CocktailDbElasticIp
    Export:
      Name: !Sub ${AWS::StackName}-CocktailDbElasticIpAddress
  AllocationId:
    Description: Allocation ID of the CocktailDB Elastic IP.
    Value: !GetAtt CocktailDbElasticIp.AllocationId
    Export:
      Name: !Sub ${AWS::StackName}-CocktailDbAllocationId

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >-
  Creates an on-demand DynamoDB orders table with an optional DAX caching
  cluster and the supporting VPC networking infrastructure for lab testing.

Metadata:
  AWS::CloudFormation::Interface:
    ParameterGroups:
      - Label:
          default: General configuration
        Parameters:
          - ProjectName
          - EnableDax
          - DaxReplicationFactor
    ParameterLabels:
      ProjectName:
        default: Project name
      EnableDax:
        default: Enable DAX cluster
      DaxReplicationFactor:
        default: DAX replication factor

Parameters:
  ProjectName:
    Type: String
    Default: saa-lab-05
    Description: Name prefix applied to all resources created by this stack.
    AllowedPattern: '^[a-zA-Z0-9-]{3,40}$'
  EnableDax:
    Type: String
    Default: 'false'
    Description: Set to true to also deploy a DAX caching cluster.
    AllowedValues:
      - 'true'
      - 'false'
  DaxReplicationFactor:
    Type: Number
    Default: 1
    Description: Number of nodes in the DAX cluster when EnableDax is true.
    AllowedValues:
      - 1
      - 3

Conditions:
  ShouldEnableDax: !Equals [!Ref EnableDax, 'true']

Resources:
  OrdersTable:
    Type: AWS::DynamoDB::Table
    DeletionPolicy: Delete
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Delete
    Properties:
      TableName: !Sub '${ProjectName}-orders'
      BillingMode: PAY_PER_REQUEST
      AttributeDefinitions:
        - AttributeName: customerId
          AttributeType: S
        - AttributeName: orderId
          AttributeType: S
      KeySchema:
        - AttributeName: customerId
          KeyType: HASH
        - AttributeName: orderId
          KeyType: RANGE
      SSESpecification:
        SSEEnabled: true
      PointInTimeRecoverySpecification:
        PointInTimeRecoveryEnabled: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${ProjectName}-orders'

  Vpc:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPC
    Properties:
      CidrBlock: 10.50.0.0/16
      EnableDnsSupport: true
      EnableDnsHostnames: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${ProjectName}-vpc'

  Subnet1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref Vpc
      CidrBlock: 10.50.10.0/24
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs '']
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${ProjectName}-subnet-1'

  Subnet2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref Vpc
      CidrBlock: 10.50.11.0/24
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [1, !GetAZs '']
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${ProjectName}-subnet-2'

  ClientSecurityGroup:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroup
    Properties:
      GroupDescription: !Sub 'Client security group for ${ProjectName} - attach to hosts that need access to DynamoDB or DAX'
      VpcId: !Ref Vpc
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${ProjectName}-client-sg'

  DaxSecurityGroup:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroup
    Properties:
      GroupDescription: !Sub 'DAX security group for ${ProjectName} - allows inbound TCP 8111 only from the client security group'
      VpcId: !Ref Vpc
      SecurityGroupIngress:
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 8111
          ToPort: 8111
          SourceSecurityGroupId: !Ref ClientSecurityGroup
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${ProjectName}-dax-sg'

  DaxSubnetGroup:
    Type: AWS::DAX::SubnetGroup
    Condition: ShouldEnableDax
    Properties:
      SubnetGroupName: !Sub '${ProjectName}-dax-subnets'
      Description: !Sub 'Subnet group for the ${ProjectName} DAX cluster'
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref Subnet1
        - !Ref Subnet2

  DaxServiceRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Condition: ShouldEnableDax
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub '${ProjectName}-dax-role'
      Description: !Sub 'Service role assumed by dax.amazonaws.com for the ${ProjectName} DAX cluster'
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: dax.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: !Sub '${ProjectName}-dax-dynamodb-access'
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - dynamodb:BatchGetItem
                  - dynamodb:BatchWriteItem
                  - dynamodb:ConditionCheckItem
                  - dynamodb:DeleteItem
                  - dynamodb:DescribeTable
                  - dynamodb:GetItem
                  - dynamodb:PutItem
                  - dynamodb:Query
                  - dynamodb:Scan
                  - dynamodb:UpdateItem
                Resource:
                  - !GetAtt OrdersTable.Arn
                  - !Sub '${OrdersTable.Arn}/index/*'

  DaxCluster:
    Type: AWS::DAX::Cluster
    Condition: ShouldEnableDax
    Properties:
      ClusterName: !Sub '${ProjectName}-dax'
      Description: !Sub 'DAX caching cluster for the ${ProjectName} orders table'
      IAMRoleARN: !GetAtt DaxServiceRole.Arn
      NodeType: dax.t3.small
      ReplicationFactor: !Ref DaxReplicationFactor
      SubnetGroupName: !Ref DaxSubnetGroup
      SecurityGroupIds:
        - !Ref DaxSecurityGroup
      SSESpecification:
        SSEEnabled: true

Outputs:
  TableName:
    Description: Name of the DynamoDB orders table.
    Value: !Ref OrdersTable
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-TableName'
  TableArn:
    Description: ARN of the DynamoDB orders table.
    Value: !GetAtt OrdersTable.Arn
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-TableArn'
  DaxStatus:
    Description: Indicates whether the DAX cluster is enabled for this stack.
    Value: !If [ShouldEnableDax, 'enabled', 'disabled']
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-DaxStatus'
  ClientSecurityGroupId:
    Description: ID of the client security group to attach to DAX client resources.
    Value: !Ref ClientSecurityGroup
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-ClientSecurityGroupId'
  DaxEndpoint:
    Description: DAX cluster discovery endpoint, or disabled when DAX is not enabled.
    Value: !If [ShouldEnableDax, !GetAtt DaxCluster.ClusterDiscoveryEndpoint, 'disabled']
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-DaxEndpoint'

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'

Description: >-
  Self-contained test environment for an Amazon ElastiCache for Redis replication
  group with cluster mode enabled, spread across two Availability Zones. The stack
  builds its own VPC with two private subnets, a security group permitting traffic
  between those subnets, an ElastiCache subnet group, a customer-managed KMS key
  used for Redis at-rest encryption and SNS topic encryption, an SNS topic for
  CloudWatch alarm notifications, and an IAM role for sending SSM Automation
  approval signals during resilience or gameday testing.

Metadata:
  AWS::CloudFormation::Interface:
    ParameterGroups:
      - Label:
          default: Network configuration
        Parameters:
          - VpcCidr
          - PrivateSubnet1Cidr
          - PrivateSubnet2Cidr
          - RedisPort
      - Label:
          default: Redis replication group configuration
        Parameters:
          - RedisReplicationGroupId
          - CacheNodeType
          - NumShards
          - ReplicasPerShard
          - SnapshotRetentionLimit
          - PreferredMaintenanceWindow
    ParameterLabels:
      VpcCidr:
        default: VPC CIDR block
      PrivateSubnet1Cidr:
        default: Private subnet 1 CIDR (first AZ)
      PrivateSubnet2Cidr:
        default: Private subnet 2 CIDR (second AZ)
      RedisPort:
        default: Redis port
      RedisReplicationGroupId:
        default: Replication group ID
      CacheNodeType:
        default: Cache node type
      NumShards:
        default: Number of shards (node groups)
      ReplicasPerShard:
        default: Replicas per shard
      SnapshotRetentionLimit:
        default: Snapshot retention (days)
      PreferredMaintenanceWindow:
        default: Preferred maintenance window (UTC)

Parameters:
  VpcCidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.0.0/22
    Description: >-
      CIDR block for the dedicated test VPC. The default private subnet CIDRs
      must fit within this block.
    AllowedPattern: '^([0-9]{1,3}\.){3}[0-9]{1,3}/(1[6-9]|2[0-8])$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must be a valid IPv4 CIDR block with a prefix length between /16 and /28.
  PrivateSubnet1Cidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.0.0/24
    Description: CIDR block for the private subnet in the first Availability Zone.
    AllowedPattern: '^([0-9]{1,3}\.){3}[0-9]{1,3}/(1[6-9]|2[0-8])$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must be a valid IPv4 CIDR block with a prefix length between /16 and /28.
  PrivateSubnet2Cidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.1.0/24
    Description: CIDR block for the private subnet in the second Availability Zone.
    AllowedPattern: '^([0-9]{1,3}\.){3}[0-9]{1,3}/(1[6-9]|2[0-8])$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must be a valid IPv4 CIDR block with a prefix length between /16 and /28.
  RedisPort:
    Type: Number
    Default: 6379
    Description: TCP port on which the Redis cluster accepts connections.
    MinValue: 1024
    MaxValue: 65535
  RedisReplicationGroupId:
    Type: String
    Default: redis-cme-test
    Description: Identifier of the ElastiCache replication group.
    MinLength: 1
    MaxLength: 40
    AllowedPattern: '^[a-zA-Z][a-zA-Z0-9-]*$'
    ConstraintDescription: >-
      Must start with a letter, contain only alphanumeric characters and hyphens,
      and be at most 40 characters long (no trailing or consecutive hyphens).
  CacheNodeType:
    Type: String
    Default: cache.t3.medium
    Description: Node type used for every shard primary and replica in the replication group.
    AllowedValues:
      - cache.t3.micro
      - cache.t3.small
      - cache.t3.medium
      - cache.m6g.large
      - cache.r6g.large
  NumShards:
    Type: Number
    Default: 2
    Description: Number of shards (node groups) in the cluster-mode-enabled replication group.
    MinValue: 2
    MaxValue: 500
  ReplicasPerShard:
    Type: Number
    Default: 1
    Description: Number of replica nodes per shard. Must be at least 1 for Multi-AZ automatic failover.
    MinValue: 1
    MaxValue: 5
  SnapshotRetentionLimit:
    Type: Number
    Default: 7
    Description: Number of days for which automatic snapshots are retained (0 disables snapshots).
    MinValue: 0
    MaxValue: 35
  PreferredMaintenanceWindow:
    Type: String
    Default: sun:05:00-sun:06:30
    Description: Weekly maintenance window (UTC) in the format ddd:hh24:mi-ddd:hh24:mi.
    AllowedPattern: '^[a-z]{3}:[0-9]{2}:[0-9]{2}-[a-z]{3}:[0-9]{2}:[0-9]{2}$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must match ddd:hh24:mi-ddd:hh24:mi (UTC), for example sun:05:00-sun:06:30.

Resources:
  TestVpc:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPC
    Properties:
      CidrBlock: !Ref VpcCidr
      EnableDnsHostnames: true
      EnableDnsSupport: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-vpc'
        - Key: Purpose
          Value: resilience-testing

  PrivateSubnet1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      AvailabilityZone: !Select
        - 0
        - !GetAZs ''
      CidrBlock: !Ref PrivateSubnet1Cidr
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-private-az1'
        - Key: Purpose
          Value: resilience-testing
      VpcId: !Ref TestVpc

  PrivateSubnet2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      AvailabilityZone: !Select
        - 1
        - !GetAZs ''
      CidrBlock: !Ref PrivateSubnet2Cidr
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-private-az2'
        - Key: Purpose
          Value: resilience-testing
      VpcId: !Ref TestVpc

  RedisSecurityGroup:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroup
    Properties:
      GroupDescription: Allows Redis traffic between the private subnets of the test VPC.
      SecurityGroupIngress:
        - CidrIp: !Ref PrivateSubnet1Cidr
          Description: Redis traffic from the private subnet in the first AZ
          FromPort: !Ref RedisPort
          IpProtocol: tcp
          ToPort: !Ref RedisPort
        - CidrIp: !Ref PrivateSubnet2Cidr
          Description: Redis traffic from the private subnet in the second AZ
          FromPort: !Ref RedisPort
          IpProtocol: tcp
          ToPort: !Ref RedisPort
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-redis-sg'
        - Key: Purpose
          Value: resilience-testing
      VpcId: !Ref TestVpc

  RedisKmsKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    DeletionPolicy: Delete
    Properties:
      Description: !Sub 'Customer-managed key for the ${AWS::StackName} ElastiCache and SNS test environment.'
      Enabled: true
      EnableKeyRotation: true
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: EnableIAMPermissionsForKeyAdministration
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root'
            Action: 'kms:*'
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: AllowElastiCacheToUseKeyForAtRestEncryption
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: elasticache.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - kms:CreateGrant
              - kms:DescribeKey
              - kms:Decrypt
              - kms:GenerateDataKey
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: AllowSnsToUseKeyForServerSideEncryption
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: sns.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - 'kms:GenerateDataKey*'
              - kms:Decrypt
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: AllowCloudWatchToUseKeyForAlarmNotifications
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: cloudwatch.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - 'kms:GenerateDataKey*'
              - kms:Decrypt
            Resource: '*'
      PendingWindowInDays: 7
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-redis-kms-key'
        - Key: Purpose
          Value: resilience-testing

  RedisKmsKeyAlias:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Alias
    Properties:
      AliasName: !Sub 'alias/${AWS::StackName}-redis-key'
      TargetKeyId: !Ref RedisKmsKey

  RedisSubnetGroup:
    Type: AWS::ElastiCache::SubnetGroup
    Properties:
      Description: !Sub 'Subnet group for the ${AWS::StackName} Redis replication group.'
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet1
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet2
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-redis-subnet-group'
        - Key: Purpose
          Value: resilience-testing

  RedisReplicationGroup:
    Type: AWS::ElastiCache::ReplicationGroup
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Delete
    DeletionPolicy: Delete
    Properties:
      AtRestEncryptionEnabled: true
      AutomaticFailoverEnabled: true
      CacheNodeType: !Ref CacheNodeType
      CacheParameterGroupName: default.redis7.cluster.on
      CacheSubnetGroupName: !Ref RedisSubnetGroup
      ReplicationGroupDescription: !Sub 'Cluster-mode-enabled Redis replication group for the ${AWS::StackName} resilience test environment.'
      Engine: redis
      EngineVersion: '7.0'
      KmsKeyId: !Ref RedisKmsKey
      MultiAZEnabled: true
      NumNodeGroups: !Ref NumShards
      Port: !Ref RedisPort
      PreferredMaintenanceWindow: !Ref PreferredMaintenanceWindow
      ReplicasPerNodeGroup: !Ref ReplicasPerShard
      ReplicationGroupId: !Ref RedisReplicationGroupId
      SecurityGroupIds:
        - !GetAtt RedisSecurityGroup.GroupId
      SnapshotRetentionLimit: !Ref SnapshotRetentionLimit
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Ref RedisReplicationGroupId
        - Key: Purpose
          Value: resilience-testing
      TransitEncryptionEnabled: true

  AlarmNotificationTopic:
    Type: AWS::SNS::Topic
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Delete
    DeletionPolicy: Delete
    Properties:
      DisplayName: redis-resilience-alarms
      KmsMasterKeyId: !Ref RedisKmsKey
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-alarm-topic'
        - Key: Purpose
          Value: resilience-testing

  AlarmNotificationTopicPolicy:
    Type: AWS::SNS::TopicPolicy
    Properties:
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: AllowCloudWatchAlarmsToPublish
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: cloudwatch.amazonaws.com
            Action: 'sns:Publish'
            Resource: !Ref AlarmNotificationTopic
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                AWS:SourceAccount: !Ref 'AWS::AccountId'
      Topics:
        - !Ref AlarmNotificationTopic

  SsmApprovalRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: AllowAccountPrincipalsToAssumeRole
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root'
            Action: 'sts:AssumeRole'
      Description: Allows approvers to send SSM Automation approval signals during resilience or gameday testing runbooks.
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: SendSsmAutomationSignal
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: SendAutomationApprovalSignals
                Effect: Allow
                Action: 'ssm:SendAutomationSignal'
                Resource: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:ssm:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:automation-execution/*'
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-ssm-approval-role'
        - Key: Purpose
          Value: resilience-testing

Outputs:
  VpcId:
    Description: ID of the dedicated test VPC.

  PrivateSubnet1Id:

  PrivateSubnet2Id:

  RedisSecurityGroupId:

  RedisKmsKeyArn:

  RedisReplicationGroupId:
    Description: ID of the cluster-mode-enabled Redis replication group.

  RedisConfigurationEndpointAddress:

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >
  Self-contained AWS AppSync GraphQL API for a simple songs service. The API uses
  IAM authorization and has X-Ray request tracing enabled. Songs are stored in a
  DynamoDB table (partition key: id) that is retained when the stack is deleted or
  replaced. The addSong mutation is implemented as a two-step pipeline resolver:
  the first function validates the artist argument (required, letters only) and
  the second function writes the song to DynamoDB with an auto-generated id. The
  getSongs query scans all songs from the table.

Resources:
  SongsTable:
    Type: AWS::DynamoDB::Table
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      BillingMode: PAY_PER_REQUEST
      AttributeDefinitions:
        - AttributeName: id
          AttributeType: S
      KeySchema:
        - AttributeName: id
          KeyType: HASH
      SSESpecification:
        SSEEnabled: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Application
          Value: SongsService

  AppSyncServiceRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      Description: Service role that allows AppSync to read from and write to the Songs DynamoDB table
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: appsync.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: AppSyncSongsTableAccess
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - dynamodb:BatchGetItem
                  - dynamodb:BatchWriteItem
                  - dynamodb:DeleteItem
                  - dynamodb:DescribeTable
                  - dynamodb:GetItem
                  - dynamodb:PutItem
                  - dynamodb:Query
                  - dynamodb:Scan
                  - dynamodb:UpdateItem
                Resource:
                  - !GetAtt SongsTable.Arn

  SongsGraphQLApi:
    Type: AWS::AppSync::GraphQLApi
    Properties:
      Name: songs-api
      AuthenticationType: AWS_IAM
      XrayEnabled: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Application
          Value: SongsService

  SongsGraphQLSchema:
    Type: AWS::AppSync::GraphQLSchema
    Properties:
      ApiId: !GetAtt SongsGraphQLApi.ApiId
      Definition: |
        type Song {
          id: ID!
          name: String!
          artist: String!
        }

        type Query {
          getSongs: [Song]
        }

        type Mutation {
          addSong(name: String!, artist: String): Song
        }

        schema {
          query: Query
          mutation: Mutation
        }

  NoneDataSource:
    Type: AWS::AppSync::DataSource
    Properties:
      ApiId: !GetAtt SongsGraphQLApi.ApiId
      Name: noneDataSource
      Type: NONE
      Description: Local data source used by the artist validation function

  SongsTableDataSource:
    Type: AWS::AppSync::DataSource
    Properties:
      ApiId: !GetAtt SongsGraphQLApi.ApiId
      Name: songsTableDataSource
      Type: AMAZON_DYNAMODB
      Description: DynamoDB data source backed by the Songs table
      ServiceRoleArn: !GetAtt AppSyncServiceRole.Arn
      DynamoDBConfig:
        AwsRegion: !Ref AWS::Region
        TableName: !Ref SongsTable

  ValidateArtistFunction:
    Type: AWS::AppSync::FunctionConfiguration
    Properties:
      ApiId: !GetAtt SongsGraphQLApi.ApiId
      Name: validateArtist
      Description: Validates that the artist argument is present and contains only letters
      DataSourceName: !GetAtt NoneDataSource.Name
      FunctionVersion: '2018-05-29'
      RequestMappingTemplate: |
        {
          "version": "2018-05-29",
          "payload": $util.toJson($ctx.args)
        }
      ResponseMappingTemplate: |
        #if(!$ctx.result.artist || $ctx.result.artist == "")
          $util.error("Artist is required", "ValidationError")
        #end
        #if(!$ctx.result.artist.matches("^[a-zA-Z]+$"))
          $util.error("Artist must contain only letters", "ValidationError")
        #end
        $util.toJson($ctx.result)

  PutSongFunction:
    Type: AWS::AppSync::FunctionConfiguration
    Properties:
      ApiId: !GetAtt SongsGraphQLApi.ApiId
      Name: putSong
      Description: Writes the new song to the Songs table with an auto-generated id
      DataSourceName: !GetAtt SongsTableDataSource.Name
      FunctionVersion: '2018-05-29'
      RequestMappingTemplate: |
        {
          "version": "2018-05-29",
          "operation": "PutItem",
          "key": {
            "id": $util.dynamodb.toDynamoDBJson($util.autoId())
          },
          "attributeValues": {
            "name": $util.dynamodb.toDynamoDBJson($ctx.args.name),
            "artist": $util.dynamodb.toDynamoDBJson($ctx.args.artist)
          }
        }
      ResponseMappingTemplate: |
        $util.toJson($ctx.result)

  AddSongResolver:
    Type: AWS::AppSync::Resolver
    DependsOn: SongsGraphQLSchema
    Properties:
      ApiId: !GetAtt SongsGraphQLApi.ApiId
      TypeName: Mutation
      FieldName: addSong
      Kind: PIPELINE
      PipelineConfig:
        Functions:
          - !GetAtt ValidateArtistFunction.FunctionId
          - !GetAtt PutSongFunction.FunctionId
      RequestMappingTemplate: |
        {
          "version": "2018-05-29",
          "payload": {}
        }
      ResponseMappingTemplate: |
        $util.toJson($ctx.result)

  GetSongsResolver:
    Type: AWS::AppSync::Resolver
    DependsOn: SongsGraphQLSchema
    Properties:
      ApiId: !GetAtt SongsGraphQLApi.ApiId
      TypeName: Query
      FieldName: getSongs
      Kind: UNIT
      DataSourceName: !GetAtt SongsTableDataSource.Name
      RequestMappingTemplate: |
        {
          "version": "2018-05-29",
          "operation": "Scan"
        }
      ResponseMappingTemplate: |
        $util.toJson($ctx.result.items)

Outputs:
  GraphQLApiUrl:
    Description: GraphQL endpoint of the songs AppSync API
    Value: !GetAtt SongsGraphQLApi.GraphQLUrl
  GraphQLApiId:
    Description: AppSync API ID of the songs AppSync API
    Value: !GetAtt SongsGraphQLApi.ApiId
  SongsTableName:
    Description: Name of the DynamoDB table that stores songs
    Value: !Ref SongsTable
  SongsTableArn:
    Description: ARN of the DynamoDB table that stores songs
    Value: !GetAtt SongsTable.Arn

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'

Description: >-
  Creates a Cognito user pool that authenticates users by email with a strong password
  policy, a public app client supporting username/password and refresh-token sign-in,
  and a regional REST API with a Cognito authorizer-protected GET /me endpoint and an
  open GET /open endpoint, both backed by a single Lambda function and deployed to a
  prod stage.

Parameters:
  StageName:
    Type: String
    Default: prod
    Description: Stage name for the API Gateway deployment.
    AllowedPattern: '^[a-zA-Z0-9_-]{1,128}$'
    ConstraintDescription: Stage name must be 1-128 alphanumeric, hyphen, or underscore characters.

Resources:
  UserPool:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPool
    Properties:
      UserPoolName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-users'
      UsernameAttributes:
        - email
      AutoVerifiedAttributes:
        - email
      MfaConfiguration: 'OFF'
      Policies:
        PasswordPolicy:
          MinimumLength: 8
          RequireUppercase: true
          RequireLowercase: true
          RequireNumbers: true
          RequireSymbols: true
      AdminCreateUserConfig:
        AllowAdminCreateUserOnly: false
      AccountRecoverySetting:
        RecoveryMechanisms:
          - Name: verified_email
            Priority: 1

  UserPoolClient:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolClient
    Properties:
      ClientName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-client'
      UserPoolId: !Ref UserPool
      GenerateSecret: false
      ExplicitAuthFlows:
        - ALLOW_USER_PASSWORD_AUTH
        - ALLOW_REFRESH_TOKEN_AUTH
      PreventUserExistenceErrors: ENABLED
      AccessTokenValidity: 60
      IdTokenValidity: 60
      RefreshTokenValidity: 30
      TokenValidityUnits:
        AccessToken: minutes
        IdToken: minutes
        RefreshToken: days
      EnableTokenRevocation: true

  LambdaExecutionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      Description: Execution role for the shared API backend Lambda function.
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSLambdaBasicExecutionRole'

  ApiLambdaFunction:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    Properties:
      Description: Returns authenticated identity claims for GET /me and an open response for GET /open.
      Role: !GetAtt LambdaExecutionRole.Arn
      Runtime: python3.12
      Handler: index.handler
      MemorySize: 128
      Timeout: 10
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import json


          def handler(event, context):
              http_method = event.get("httpMethod", "GET")
              path = event.get("path", "")
              request_context = event.get("requestContext") or {}
              authorizer = request_context.get("authorizer") or {}
              claims = authorizer.get("claims")

              if path.endswith("/me"):
                  if not claims:
                      body = {
                          "endpoint": path,
                          "method": http_method,
                          "authenticated": False,
                          "message": "Missing or invalid access token.",
                      }
                      return {
                          "statusCode": 401,
                          "headers": {"Content-Type": "application/json"},
                          "body": json.dumps(body),
                      }
                  body = {
                      "endpoint": path,
                      "method": http_method,
                      "authenticated": True,
                      "message": "Authenticated identity claims from a valid access token.",
                      "claims": claims,
                  }
              else:
                  body = {
                      "endpoint": path,
                      "method": http_method,
                      "authenticated": False,
                      "message": "Open endpoint. No access token required.",
                      "claims": None,
                  }

              return {
                  "statusCode": 200,
                  "headers": {"Content-Type": "application/json"},
                  "body": json.dumps(body, default=str),
              }

  RestApi:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::RestApi
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-api'
      Description: Regional REST API exposing a protected /me endpoint and an open /open endpoint.
      EndpointConfiguration:
        Types:
          - REGIONAL

  UserPoolAuthorizer:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Authorizer
    Properties:
      Name: cognito-user-pool-authorizer
      RestApiId: !Ref RestApi
      Type: COGNITO_USER_POOLS
      ProviderARNs:
        - !GetAtt UserPool.Arn
      IdentitySource: method.request.header.Authorization

  MeResource:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Resource
    Properties:
      RestApiId: !Ref RestApi
      ParentId: !GetAtt RestApi.RootResourceId
      PathPart: me

  OpenResource:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Resource
    Properties:
      RestApiId: !Ref RestApi
      ParentId: !GetAtt RestApi.RootResourceId
      PathPart: open

  MeGetMethod:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Method
    Properties:
      RestApiId: !Ref RestApi
      ResourceId: !Ref MeResource
      HttpMethod: GET
      AuthorizationType: COGNITO_USER_POOLS
      AuthorizerId: !Ref UserPoolAuthorizer
      ApiKeyRequired: false
      RequestParameters:
        method.request.header.Authorization: true
      Integration:
        Type: AWS_PROXY
        IntegrationHttpMethod: POST
        Uri: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:apigateway:${AWS::Region}:lambda:path/2015-03-31/functions/${ApiLambdaFunction.Arn}/invocations'

  OpenGetMethod:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Method
    Properties:
      RestApiId: !Ref RestApi
      ResourceId: !Ref OpenResource
      HttpMethod: GET
      AuthorizationType: NONE
      ApiKeyRequired: false
      Integration:
        Type: AWS_PROXY
        IntegrationHttpMethod: POST
        Uri: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:apigateway:${AWS::Region}:lambda:path/2015-03-31/functions/${ApiLambdaFunction.Arn}/invocations'

  MeInvokePermission:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Permission
    Properties:
      Action: lambda:InvokeFunction
      FunctionName: !Ref ApiLambdaFunction
      Principal: apigateway.amazonaws.com
      SourceArn: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:execute-api:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:${RestApi}/${StageName}/GET/me'

  OpenInvokePermission:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Permission
    Properties:
      Action: lambda:InvokeFunction
      FunctionName: !Ref ApiLambdaFunction
      Principal: apigateway.amazonaws.com
      SourceArn: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:execute-api:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:${RestApi}/${StageName}/GET/open'

  ApiDeployment:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Deployment
    DependsOn:
      - MeGetMethod
      - OpenGetMethod
    Properties:
      RestApiId: !Ref RestApi

  ApiStage:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Stage
    Properties:
      RestApiId: !Ref RestApi
      DeploymentId: !Ref ApiDeployment
      StageName: !Ref StageName
      MethodSettings:
        - ResourcePath: '/*'
          HttpMethod: '*'
          MetricsEnabled: true
          ThrottlingRateLimit: 100
          ThrottlingBurstLimit: 50

Outputs:
  UserPoolId:
    Description: ID of the Cognito user pool.
    Value: !Ref UserPool
  UserPoolArn:
    Description: ARN of the Cognito user pool.
    Value: !GetAtt UserPool.Arn
  UserPoolClientId:
    Description: ID of the public app client (no client secret).
    Value: !Ref UserPoolClient
  RestApiId:
    Description: ID of the regional REST API.
    Value: !Ref RestApi
  ApiBaseUrl:
    Description: Base URL of the API stage.
    Value: !Sub 'https://${RestApi}.execute-api.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com/${StageName}'
  MeEndpointUrl:
    Description: Protected GET /me endpoint (requires a valid access token in the Authorization header).
    Value: !Sub 'https://${RestApi}.execute-api.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com/${StageName}/me'
  OpenEndpointUrl:
    Description: Open GET /open endpoint (no token required).
    Value: !Sub 'https://${RestApi}.execute-api.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com/${StageName}/open'
  LambdaFunctionArn:
    Description: ARN of the shared Lambda function backing both endpoints.
    Value: !GetAtt ApiLambdaFunction.Arn

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >-
  Connects an AWS account to the marbot.io monitoring and alerting service. Creates an
  EventBridge connection and API destination authenticated with an API key derived from
  the marbot endpoint ID, a scheduled rule that posts account and stack identification
  details to marbot every 30 days to establish and keep the connection alive, the IAM
  role EventBridge needs to invoke that destination, a cross-account IAM role that
  marbot can assume using an external ID unique to this stack, with permissions gated
  behind feature flags and restricted by an optional permissions boundary, plus a
  custom resource that registers the account connection with marbot.

Metadata:
  AWS::CloudFormation::Interface:
    ParameterGroups:
      - Label:
          default: marbot configuration
        Parameters:
          - EndpointID
          - MarbotAccountId
      - Label:
          default: Feature flags
        Parameters:
          - EnableAutomaticMonitoring
          - EnableAccountAliasLookup
          - EnableGraphEmbedding
          - EnableCodePipelineApprovals

Parameters:
  EndpointID:
    Type: String
    Description: >-
      Your marbot endpoint ID in the format endpoint+<id>@marbot.io. Copy it from the
      setup instructions that marbot sent to your chat channel. The default is a
      syntactically valid placeholder that lets the stack deploy; replace it with your
      real endpoint ID to establish the live connection.
    Default: 'endpoint+00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000@marbot.io'
    AllowedPattern: '^\S+$'
    ConstraintDescription: The endpoint ID must be a non-empty value without whitespace.
  MarbotAccountId:
    Type: String
    Description: The AWS account ID that marbot.io uses to assume the cross-account monitoring role.
    Default: '812267161201'
    AllowedPattern: '^[0-9]{12}$'
    ConstraintDescription: The marbot AWS account ID must be a 12 digit number.
  EnableAutomaticMonitoring:
    Type: String
    Description: >-
      If true, marbot is allowed to automatically configure CloudWatch alarms and
      monitoring rules across your resources. When enabled, the monitoring role is also
      restricted by a permissions boundary.
    Default: 'true'
    AllowedValues: ['true', 'false']
  EnableAccountAliasLookup:
    Type: String
    Description: If true, marbot is allowed to enrich account IDs with friendly account aliases.
    Default: 'true'
    AllowedValues: ['true', 'false']
  EnableGraphEmbedding:
    Type: String
    Description: If true, marbot is allowed to embed metric graphs into CloudWatch alarm notifications.
    Default: 'true'
    AllowedValues: ['true', 'false']
  EnableCodePipelineApprovals:
    Type: String
    Description: If true, marbot is allowed to approve or reject CodePipeline manual approval requests.
    Default: 'false'
    AllowedValues: ['true', 'false']

Conditions:
  AutomaticMonitoringEnabled: !Equals [!Ref EnableAutomaticMonitoring, 'true']
  AccountAliasLookupEnabled: !Equals [!Ref EnableAccountAliasLookup, 'true']
  GraphEmbeddingEnabled: !Equals [!Ref EnableGraphEmbedding, 'true']
  CodePipelineApprovalsEnabled: !Equals [!Ref EnableCodePipelineApprovals, 'true']

Resources:
  MarbotConnection:
    Type: AWS::Events::Connection
    Properties:
      Description: Connection to the marbot.io API authenticated with an API key derived from the marbot endpoint ID.
      AuthorizationType: API_KEY
      AuthParameters:
        ApiKeyAuthParameters:
          ApiKeyName: x-api-key
          ApiKeyValue: !Select
            - 0
            - !Split
              - '@'
              - !Ref EndpointID

  MarbotApiDestination:
    Type: AWS::Events::ApiDestination
    Properties:
      ConnectionArn: !GetAtt MarbotConnection.Arn
      InvocationEndpoint: !Sub 'https://api.marbot.io/v1/endpoint/${EndpointID}'
      HttpMethod: POST
      InvocationRateLimitPerSecond: 1

  MarbotEventBridgeInvokeRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      Description: IAM role that EventBridge assumes to invoke the marbot API destination.
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: events.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: invoke-marbot-api-destination
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: InvokeMarbotApiDestination
                Effect: Allow
                Action: events:InvokeApiDestination
                Resource: !GetAtt MarbotApiDestination.Arn

  MarbotKeepAliveRule:
    Type: AWS::Events::Rule
    Properties:
      Description: Posts account and stack identification details to marbot every 30 days to establish and keep the account connection alive.
      ScheduleExpression: rate(30 days)
      State: ENABLED
      Targets:
        - Id: marbot-account-connection
          Arn: !GetAtt MarbotApiDestination.Arn
          RoleArn: !GetAtt MarbotEventBridgeInvokeRole.Arn
          Input: !Sub '{"type":"account-connection-keep-alive","endpointId":"${EndpointID}","accountId":"${AWS::AccountId}","region":"${AWS::Region}","stackName":"${AWS::StackName}","stackId":"${AWS::StackId}","externalId":"${AWS::StackId}","roleArn":"${MarbotRole.Arn}"}'

  MarbotAutomaticMonitoringPolicy:
    Type: AWS::IAM::ManagedPolicy
    Condition: AutomaticMonitoringEnabled
    Properties:
      Description: Allows marbot to automatically configure CloudWatch alarms and monitoring rules across resources.
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: ManageCloudWatchAlarms
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - cloudwatch:PutMetricAlarm
              - cloudwatch:DeleteAlarms
              - cloudwatch:DescribeAlarms
              - cloudwatch:DescribeAlarmHistory
              - cloudwatch:EnableAlarmActions
              - cloudwatch:DisableAlarmActions
              - cloudwatch:TagResource
              - cloudwatch:UntagResource
              - cloudwatch:ListTagsForResource
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: ReadMetrics
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - cloudwatch:GetMetricData
              - cloudwatch:GetMetricStatistics
              - cloudwatch:ListMetrics
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: ManageMonitoringRules
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - events:PutRule
              - events:DeleteRule
              - events:DescribeRule
              - events:EnableRule
              - events:DisableRule
              - events:PutTargets
              - events:RemoveTargets
              - events:ListRules
              - events:ListTargetsByRule
              - events:TagResource
              - events:UntagResource
              - events:ListTagsForResource
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: ManageMetricFilters
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - logs:DescribeLogGroups
              - logs:DescribeMetricFilters
              - logs:PutMetricFilter
              - logs:DeleteMetricFilter
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: ManageAlertingTopics
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - sns:CreateTopic
              - sns:DeleteTopic
              - sns:Subscribe
              - sns:Unsubscribe
              - sns:GetTopicAttributes
              - sns:SetTopicAttributes
              - sns:ListTopics
              - sns:ListSubscriptions
              - sns:ListSubscriptionsByTopic
              - sns:TagResource
              - sns:UntagResource
              - sns:ListTagsForResource
            Resource: '*'

  MarbotAccountAliasLookupPolicy:
    Type: AWS::IAM::ManagedPolicy
    Condition: AccountAliasLookupEnabled
    Properties:
      Description: Allows marbot to enrich account IDs with friendly account aliases.
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: LookupAccountAliases
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - iam:ListAccountAliases
              - organizations:DescribeAccount
              - organizations:ListAccounts
            Resource: '*'

  MarbotGraphEmbeddingPolicy:
    Type: AWS::IAM::ManagedPolicy
    Condition: GraphEmbeddingEnabled
    Properties:
      Description: Allows marbot to read alarms and metrics so it can embed metric graphs into CloudWatch alarm notifications.
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: ReadAlarmsAndMetrics
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - cloudwatch:DescribeAlarms
              - cloudwatch:DescribeAlarmsForMetric
              - cloudwatch:GetMetricData
              - cloudwatch:GetMetricStatistics
              - cloudwatch:ListMetrics
              - cloudwatch:GetDashboard
              - cloudwatch:ListDashboards
            Resource: '*'

  MarbotCodePipelineApprovalsPolicy:
    Type: AWS::IAM::ManagedPolicy
    Condition: CodePipelineApprovalsEnabled
    Properties:
      Description: Allows marbot to approve or reject CodePipeline manual approval requests.
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: ManageCodePipelineManualApprovals
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - codepipeline:PutApprovalResult
              - codepipeline:GetPipelineState
              - codepipeline:GetPipeline
              - codepipeline:GetPipelineExecution
              - codepipeline:ListPipelines
            Resource: '*'

  MarbotPermissionBoundary:
    Type: AWS::IAM::ManagedPolicy
    Condition: AutomaticMonitoringEnabled
    Properties:
      Description: Permissions boundary that restricts the marbot monitoring role to monitoring activities and denies privilege escalation.
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: AllowMonitoringActivities
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - cloudwatch:*
              - events:*
              - sns:*
              - codepipeline:*
              - logs:DescribeLogGroups
              - logs:DescribeMetricFilters
              - logs:PutMetricFilter
              - logs:DeleteMetricFilter
              - sts:GetCallerIdentity
              - iam:ListAccountAliases
              - organizations:DescribeAccount
              - organizations:ListAccounts
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: DenyPrivilegeEscalation
            Effect: Deny
            Action:
              - iam:CreateRole
              - iam:DeleteRole
              - iam:UpdateAssumeRolePolicy
              - iam:PutRolePolicy
              - iam:AttachRolePolicy
              - iam:DetachRolePolicy
              - iam:CreateUser
              - iam:DeleteUser
              - iam:CreateAccessKey
              - iam:PutUserPolicy
              - iam:AttachUserPolicy
              - iam:PutGroupPolicy
              - iam:CreatePolicy
              - iam:DeletePolicy
              - iam:CreatePolicyVersion
              - iam:SetDefaultPolicyVersion
              - iam:PassRole
              - organizations:CreateOrganization
              - organizations:CreateAccount
              - organizations:RemoveAccountFromOrganization
            Resource: '*'

  MarbotRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      Description: Cross-account role that marbot.io assumes (with an external ID unique to this stack) to monitor this account on our behalf.
      MaxSessionDuration: 3600
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: AllowMarbotToAssumeRole
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: '*'
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                sts:ExternalId: !Ref AWS::StackId
                aws:PrincipalAccount: !Ref MarbotAccountId
      PermissionsBoundary: !If
        - AutomaticMonitoringEnabled
        - !Ref MarbotPermissionBoundary
        - !Ref 'AWS::NoValue'
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !If
          - AutomaticMonitoringEnabled
          - !Ref MarbotAutomaticMonitoringPolicy
          - !Ref 'AWS::NoValue'
        - !If
          - AccountAliasLookupEnabled
          - !Ref MarbotAccountAliasLookupPolicy
          - !Ref 'AWS::NoValue'
        - !If
          - GraphEmbeddingEnabled
          - !Ref MarbotGraphEmbeddingPolicy
          - !Ref 'AWS::NoValue'
        - !If
          - CodePipelineApprovalsEnabled
          - !Ref MarbotCodePipelineApprovalsPolicy
          - !Ref 'AWS::NoValue'
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: marbot-base-access
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: BaseAccess
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - sts:GetCallerIdentity
                  - cloudwatch:DescribeAlarms
                Resource: '*'

  MarbotRegistrationFunctionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      Description: Execution role for the Lambda function that registers the account connection with marbot.io.
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: marbot-registration-function-logs
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: WriteLogs
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogGroup
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                Resource:
                  - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:logs:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:log-group:/aws/lambda/*'
                  - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:logs:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:log-group:/aws/lambda/*:log-stream:*'

  MarbotRegistrationFunction:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    Properties:
      Description: Registers the account connection with the marbot.io service.
      Handler: index.handler
      MemorySize: 128
      Role: !GetAtt MarbotRegistrationFunctionRole.Arn
      Runtime: python3.12
      Timeout: 60
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import json
          import time
          import urllib.error
          import urllib.request

          try:
              import cfnresponse
          except ImportError:
              cfnresponse = None

          API_ENDPOINT = 'https://api.marbot.io/v1/endpoint/'

          def put_response(event, status, data, reason):
              response_url = event.get('ResponseURL')
              if not response_url:
                  return
              body = json.dumps({
                  'Status': status,
                  'Reason': reason,
                  'PhysicalResourceId': event.get('PhysicalResourceId') or 'marbot-account-registration',
                  'StackId': event.get('StackId', ''),
                  'RequestId': event.get('RequestId', ''),
                  'LogicalResourceId': event.get('LogicalResourceId', ''),
                  'Data': data
              }).encode('utf-8')
              for attempt in range(3):
                  try:
                      request = urllib.request.Request(response_url, data=body, headers={'content-type': '', 'content-length': str(len(body))})
                      request.get_method = lambda: 'PUT'
                      urllib.request.urlopen(request, timeout=10).read()
                      return
                  except Exception:
                      time.sleep(1)

          def register(properties, request_type):
              endpoint_id = properties.get('EndpointID', '')
              payload = {
                  'type': 'account-connection',
                  'requestType': request_type,
                  'endpointId': endpoint_id,
                  'accountId': properties.get('AccountId', ''),
                  'region': properties.get('Region', ''),
                  'stackName': properties.get('StackName', ''),
                  'stackId': properties.get('StackId', ''),
                  'externalId': properties.get('ExternalId', ''),
                  'roleArn': properties.get('RoleArn', ''),
                  'features': {
                      'automaticMonitoring': properties.get('EnableAutomaticMonitoring') == 'true',
                      'accountAliasLookup': properties.get('EnableAccountAliasLookup') == 'true',
                      'graphEmbedding': properties.get('EnableGraphEmbedding') == 'true',
                      'codePipelineApprovals': properties.get('EnableCodePipelineApprovals') == 'true'
                  }
              }
              try:
                  request = urllib.request.Request(
                      API_ENDPOINT + endpoint_id,
                      data=json.dumps(payload).encode('utf-8'),
                      headers={'Content-Type': 'application/json', 'x-api-key': endpoint_id.split('@')[0]},
                      method='POST'
                  )
                  return 'sent-http-%s' % urllib.request.urlopen(request, timeout=8).getcode()
              except urllib.error.HTTPError:
                  return 'sent-http-error'
              except Exception:
                  return 'unreachable'

          def handler(event, context):
              request_type = event.get('RequestType', 'Create')
              registration_status = 'skipped'
              if request_type != 'Delete':
                  try:
                      registration_status = register(event.get('ResourceProperties') or {}, request_type)
                  except Exception:
                      registration_status = 'unreachable'
              stack_id = str(event.get('StackId') or '')
              physical_id = 'marbot-account-registration-' + (stack_id[-36:] if stack_id else 'unknown')
              if cfnresponse is not None:
                  cfnresponse.send(event, context, cfnresponse.SUCCESS, {'RegistrationStatus': registration_status}, physical_id)
              else:
                  event['PhysicalResourceId'] = physical_id
                  put_response(event, 'SUCCESS', {'RegistrationStatus': registration_status}, 'marbot registration processed (%s)' % registration_status)

  MarbotAccountRegistration:
    Type: AWS::CloudFormation::CustomResource
    Properties:
      ServiceToken: !GetAtt MarbotRegistrationFunction.Arn
      EndpointID: !Ref EndpointID
      AccountId: !Ref AWS::AccountId
      Region: !Ref AWS::Region
      StackName: !Ref AWS::StackName
      StackId: !Ref AWS::StackId
      ExternalId: !Ref AWS::StackId
      RoleArn: !GetAtt MarbotRole.Arn
      EnableAutomaticMonitoring: !Ref EnableAutomaticMonitoring
      EnableAccountAliasLookup: !Ref EnableAccountAliasLookup
      EnableGraphEmbedding: !Ref EnableGraphEmbedding
      EnableCodePipelineApprovals: !Ref EnableCodePipelineApprovals

Outputs:
  MarbotRoleArn:
    Description: ARN of the cross-account IAM role that marbot.io assumes to monitor this account.
    Value: !GetAtt MarbotRole.Arn
  MarbotExternalId:
    Description: External ID that marbot.io must use when assuming the monitoring role. Unique to this stack.
    Value: !Ref AWS::StackId
  MarbotConnectionArn:
    Description: ARN of the EventBridge connection that authenticates requests to the marbot.io API.
    Value: !GetAtt MarbotConnection.Arn
  MarbotApiDestinationArn:
    Description: ARN of the EventBridge API destination that points to the marbot.io endpoint.
    Value: !GetAtt MarbotApiDestination.Arn
  MarbotKeepAliveRuleArn:
    Description: ARN of the scheduled rule that keeps the marbot account connection alive.
    Value: !GetAtt MarbotKeepAliveRule.Arn

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: "2010-09-09"

Description: >
  Self-contained backend for a simple mobile or web application. Provisions a
  DynamoDB table with a numeric partition key and a global secondary index,
  an Amazon Cognito identity pool that allows unauthenticated guest access,
  the IAM role assumed by unauthenticated identities, and the identity pool
  role attachment linking the two. Guest users can submit mobile analytics
  events, use Cognito Sync, publish to SNS topics, and write items to the
  DynamoDB table directly from the client.

Parameters:
  TableReadCapacityUnits:
    Type: Number
    Default: 10
    Description: Read capacity units for the DynamoDB table.
  TableWriteCapacityUnits:
    Type: Number
    Default: 10
    Description: Write capacity units for the DynamoDB table.
  IndexReadCapacityUnits:
    Type: Number
    Default: 5
    Description: Read capacity units for the global secondary index.
  IndexWriteCapacityUnits:
    Type: Number
    Default: 10
    Description: Write capacity units for the global secondary index.

Resources:
  DynamoDBTable:
    Type: AWS::DynamoDB::Table
    Properties:
      AttributeDefinitions:
        - AttributeName: id
          AttributeType: N
      KeySchema:
        - AttributeName: id
          KeyType: HASH
      ProvisionedThroughput:
        ReadCapacityUnits: !Ref TableReadCapacityUnits
        WriteCapacityUnits: !Ref TableWriteCapacityUnits
      GlobalSecondaryIndexes:
        - IndexName: id-index
          KeySchema:
            - AttributeName: id
              KeyType: HASH
          Projection:
            ProjectionType: ALL
          ProvisionedThroughput:
            ReadCapacityUnits: !Ref IndexReadCapacityUnits
            WriteCapacityUnits: !Ref IndexWriteCapacityUnits
      SSESpecification:
        SSEEnabled: true
      PointInTimeRecoverySpecification:
        PointInTimeRecoveryEnabled: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-items"

  IdentityPool:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::IdentityPool
    Properties:
      IdentityPoolName: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-identity-pool"
      AllowUnauthenticatedIdentities: true
      AllowClassicFlow: true

  CognitoUnauthRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Federated: cognito-identity.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRoleWithWebIdentity
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                "cognito-identity.amazonaws.com:aud": !Ref IdentityPool
              "ForAnyValue:StringLike":
                "cognito-identity.amazonaws.com:amr": unauthenticated
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: CognitoUnauthMobileBackendPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: "2012-10-17"
            Statement:
              - Sid: MobileAnalyticsPutEvents
                Effect: Allow
                Action: "mobileanalytics:PutEvents"
                Resource: "*"
              - Sid: CognitoSyncAccess
                Effect: Allow
                Action: "cognito-sync:*"
                Resource: "*"
              - Sid: SnsPublish
                Effect: Allow
                Action: "sns:Publish"
                Resource: !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:sns:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:*"
              - Sid: DynamoDbWriteItems
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - "dynamodb:PutItem"
                  - "dynamodb:UpdateItem"
                  - "dynamodb:DeleteItem"
                Resource:
                  - !GetAtt DynamoDBTable.Arn
                  - !Sub "${DynamoDBTable.Arn}/index/*"

  IdentityPoolRoleAttachment:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::IdentityPoolRoleAttachment
    Properties:
      IdentityPoolId: !Ref IdentityPool
      Roles:
        unauthenticated: !GetAtt CognitoUnauthRole.Arn

Outputs:
  DynamoDBTableName:
    Description: Name of the application DynamoDB table.
    Value: !Ref DynamoDBTable
  DynamoDBTableArn:
    Description: ARN of the application DynamoDB table.
    Value: !GetAtt DynamoDBTable.Arn
  IdentityPoolId:
    Description: ID of the Cognito identity pool used by the client application.
    Value: !Ref IdentityPool
  IdentityPoolName:
    Description: Name of the Cognito identity pool.
    Value: !GetAtt IdentityPool.Name
  UnauthenticatedRoleArn:
    Description: ARN of the IAM role assumed by unauthenticated guest identities.
    Value: !GetAtt CognitoUnauthRole.Arn

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >-
  Data lake catalog and transform layer: a Glue Data Catalog database with an
  optional scheduled, log-only, new-data-only S3 crawler and an optional
  bookmark-enabled, continuously logged Glue Spark ETL job, sharing one IAM
  service role scoped to the source and target S3 buckets. All resources that
  require a source or target bucket are created only when the corresponding
  bucket ARN parameter is supplied, so the stack deploys with defaults alone.

Metadata:
  AWS::CloudFormation::Interface:
    ParameterGroups:
      - Label:
          default: General
        Parameters:
          - NamingPrefix
          - Environment
      - Label:
          default: Source data location
        Parameters:
          - SourceBucketArn
          - SourceBucketPrefix
      - Label:
          default: Crawler
        Parameters:
          - CrawlerEnabled
          - CrawlerSchedule
      - Label:
          default: ETL job
        Parameters:
          - JobEnabled
          - JobScriptLocation
          - TargetBucketArn
          - TargetPrefix
          - JobGlueVersion
          - JobWorkerType
          - JobNumberOfWorkers
          - JobTimeoutMinutes
          - JobMaxConcurrentRuns
          - LogRetentionInDays

Parameters:
  NamingPrefix:
    Type: String
    Default: datalake
    Description: Naming prefix used to build the database, crawler, and job names.
    AllowedPattern: '^[a-z][a-z0-9-]{0,28}$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must start with a lowercase letter and contain only lowercase letters, numbers and hyphens (max 29 characters).
  Environment:
    Type: String
    Default: dev
    Description: Target environment used in resource names.
    AllowedValues:
      - dev
      - staging
      - prod
  SourceBucketArn:
    Type: String
    Default: ''
    Description: ARN of the existing source S3 bucket that the crawler scans and the ETL job reads, e.g. arn:aws:s3:::my-source-bucket. The crawler is only created when this is provided; leave empty to create only the catalog database.
    AllowedPattern: '^$|^arn:(aws|aws-cn|aws-us-gov):s3:::[a-z0-9][a-z0-9.-]{1,61}[a-z0-9]$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must be empty or a valid S3 bucket ARN such as arn:aws:s3:::my-source-bucket.
  SourceBucketPrefix:
    Type: String
    Default: ''
    Description: Key prefix inside the source bucket for the crawler to scan. Leave empty to crawl the entire bucket.
  CrawlerEnabled:
    Type: String
    Default: 'true'
    Description: Whether to create the Glue crawler (a source bucket must also be provided). When off or when no source bucket is given, nothing is added to the catalog.
    AllowedValues:
      - 'true'
      - 'false'
  CrawlerSchedule:
    Type: String
    Default: 'cron(0 6 * * ? *)'
    Description: Cron or rate schedule expression for the crawler (default runs once daily at 06:00 UTC).
    AllowedPattern: '^(cron|rate)\(.+\)$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must be a valid cron() or rate() schedule expression.
  JobEnabled:
    Type: String
    Default: 'false'
    Description: Whether to create the Glue Spark ETL job.
    AllowedValues:
      - 'true'
      - 'false'
  JobScriptLocation:
    Type: String
    Default: ''
    Description: S3 URI of the Spark ETL script, for example s3://my-bucket/scripts/job.py. Required when JobEnabled is true.
    AllowedPattern: '^$|^s3://.+$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must be empty or an S3 URI such as s3://my-bucket/scripts/job.py.
  TargetBucketArn:
    Type: String
    Default: ''
    Description: ARN of the target S3 bucket for transformed output. Required when JobEnabled is true.
    AllowedPattern: '^$|^arn:(aws|aws-cn|aws-us-gov):s3:::[a-z0-9][a-z0-9.-]{1,61}[a-z0-9]$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must be empty or a valid S3 bucket ARN such as arn:aws:s3:::my-target-bucket.
  TargetPrefix:
    Type: String
    Default: ''
    Description: Key prefix under which the ETL job writes transformed output.
  JobGlueVersion:
    Type: String
    Default: '3.0'
    Description: Glue version of the Spark ETL job.
    AllowedValues:
      - '2.0'
      - '3.0'
      - '4.0'
  JobWorkerType:
    Type: String
    Default: 'G.1X'
    Description: Worker type of the Spark ETL job.
    AllowedValues:
      - Standard
      - G.1X
      - G.2X
  JobNumberOfWorkers:
    Type: Number
    Default: 2
    Description: Number of workers of the Spark ETL job.
    MinValue: 2
    MaxValue: 1000
  JobTimeoutMinutes:
    Type: Number
    Default: 60
    Description: Timeout of the Spark ETL job in minutes.
    MinValue: 1
    MaxValue: 2880
  JobMaxConcurrentRuns:
    Type: Number
    Default: 1
    Description: Maximum number of concurrent runs of the Spark ETL job.
    MinValue: 1
    MaxValue: 100
  LogRetentionInDays:
    Type: Number
    Default: 30
    Description: Retention period in days for the job CloudWatch log group.
    AllowedValues:
      - 1
      - 3
      - 5
      - 7
      - 14
      - 30
      - 60
      - 90
      - 120
      - 150
      - 180
      - 365
      - 400
      - 545
      - 731
      - 1096
      - 1827
      - 2192
      - 2557
      - 2922
      - 3288
      - 3653

Rules:
  JobParametersProvided:
    RuleCondition: !Equals [!Ref JobEnabled, 'true']
    Assertions:
      - Assert: !Not [!Equals [!Ref JobScriptLocation, '']]
        AssertDescription: JobScriptLocation must be provided when JobEnabled is true.
      - Assert: !Not [!Equals [!Ref TargetBucketArn, '']]
        AssertDescription: TargetBucketArn must be provided when JobEnabled is true.

Conditions:
  HasSourceBucket: !Not [!Equals [!Ref SourceBucketArn, '']]
  HasSourcePrefix: !And
    - !Not [!Equals [!Ref SourceBucketArn, '']]
    - !Not [!Equals [!Ref SourceBucketPrefix, '']]
  HasTargetBucket: !Not [!Equals [!Ref TargetBucketArn, '']]
  HasTargetPrefix: !And
    - !Not [!Equals [!Ref TargetBucketArn, '']]
    - !Not [!Equals [!Ref TargetPrefix, '']]
  CreateCrawler: !And
    - !Equals [!Ref CrawlerEnabled, 'true']
    - !Not [!Equals [!Ref SourceBucketArn, '']]
  CreateJob: !Equals [!Ref JobEnabled, 'true']

Resources:
  GlueServiceRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      Description: Shared service role for the Glue crawler and Spark ETL job.
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: glue.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSGlueServiceRole'
      Policies:
        - !If
          - HasSourceBucket
          - PolicyName: SourceBucketReadOnly
            PolicyDocument:
              Version: '2012-10-17'
              Statement:
                - Sid: ReadSourceBucketObjects
                  Effect: Allow
                  Action:
                    - s3:GetObject
                    - s3:GetObjectVersion
                  Resource: !Sub '${SourceBucketArn}/*'
                - Sid: ListSourceBucket
                  Effect: Allow
                  Action:
                    - s3:ListBucket
                    - s3:GetBucketLocation
                  Resource: !Ref SourceBucketArn
          - !Ref 'AWS::NoValue'
        - !If
          - HasTargetBucket
          - PolicyName: TargetBucketWriteAccess
            PolicyDocument:
              Version: '2012-10-17'
              Statement:
                - Sid: WriteTargetBucketObjects
                  Effect: Allow
                  Action:
                    - s3:GetObject
                    - s3:GetObjectVersion
                    - s3:PutObject
                    - s3:DeleteObject
                    - s3:AbortMultipartUpload
                  Resource: !Sub '${TargetBucketArn}/*'
                - Sid: ListTargetBucket
                  Effect: Allow
                  Action:
                    - s3:ListBucket
                    - s3:GetBucketLocation
                  Resource: !Ref TargetBucketArn
          - !Ref 'AWS::NoValue'
        - !If
          - CreateJob
          - PolicyName: EtlJobContinuousLogging
            PolicyDocument:
              Version: '2012-10-17'
              Statement:
                - Sid: WriteJobLogs
                  Effect: Allow
                  Action:
                    - logs:CreateLogStream
                    - logs:PutLogEvents
                  Resource:
                    - !GetAtt JobLogGroup.Arn
                    - !Sub '${JobLogGroup.Arn}:*'
          - !Ref 'AWS::NoValue'
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment

  CatalogDatabase:
    Type: AWS::Glue::Database
    Properties:
      CatalogId: !Ref AWS::AccountId
      DatabaseInput:
        Name: !Sub '${NamingPrefix}-${Environment}-catalog'
        Description: !Sub 'Data lake catalog database for ${NamingPrefix} (${Environment}).'
        LocationUri: !If
          - HasSourceBucket
          - !If
            - HasSourcePrefix
            - !Sub
              - 's3://${SourceBucketName}/${SourceBucketPrefix}'
              - SourceBucketName: !Select [5, !Split [':', !Ref SourceBucketArn]]
            - !Sub
              - 's3://${SourceBucketName}'
              - SourceBucketName: !Select [5, !Split [':', !Ref SourceBucketArn]]
          - !Ref 'AWS::NoValue'

  JobLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    Condition: CreateJob
    Properties:
      RetentionInDays: !Ref LogRetentionInDays
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment

  CatalogCrawler:
    Type: AWS::Glue::Crawler
    Condition: CreateCrawler
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${NamingPrefix}-${Environment}-crawler'
      Description: Log-only, new-data-only schema and partition discovery crawler.
      Role: !GetAtt GlueServiceRole.Arn
      DatabaseName: !Ref CatalogDatabase
      Schedule:
        ScheduleExpression: !Ref CrawlerSchedule
      Targets:
        S3Targets:
          - Path: !If
              - HasSourcePrefix
              - !Sub
                - 's3://${SourceBucketName}/${SourceBucketPrefix}'
                - SourceBucketName: !Select [5, !Split [':', !Ref SourceBucketArn]]
              - !Sub
                - 's3://${SourceBucketName}'
                - SourceBucketName: !Select [5, !Split [':', !Ref SourceBucketArn]]
      SchemaChangePolicy:
        UpdateBehavior: LOG
        DeleteBehavior: LOG
      Configuration: '{"Version":1,"CrawlerOutput":{"Tables":{"AddOrUpdateBehavior":"Log"}}}'
      RecrawlPolicy:
        RecrawlBehavior: CRAWL_NEW_FOLDERS_ONLY
      Tags:
        Environment: !Ref Environment

  CatalogEtlJob:
    Type: AWS::Glue::Job
    Condition: CreateJob
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${NamingPrefix}-${Environment}-etl-job'
      Description: Bookmark-enabled, continuously logged Glue Spark ETL job.
      Role: !GetAtt GlueServiceRole.Arn
      GlueVersion: !Ref JobGlueVersion
      WorkerType: !Ref JobWorkerType
      NumberOfWorkers: !Ref JobNumberOfWorkers
      Timeout: !Ref JobTimeoutMinutes
      ExecutionProperty:
        MaxConcurrentRuns: !Ref JobMaxConcurrentRuns
      Command:
        Name: glueetl
        PythonVersion: '3'
        ScriptLocation: !Ref JobScriptLocation
      DefaultArguments:
        '--job-bookmark-option': 'job-bookmark-enable'
        '--enable-continuous-cloudwatch-log': 'true'
        '--enable-continuous-log-filter': 'true'
        '--continuous-log-logGroup': !Ref JobLogGroup
        '--continuous-log-logStreamPrefix': !Sub '${NamingPrefix}-${Environment}-etl-'
        '--enable-metrics': ''
        '--source-s3-path': !If
          - HasSourceBucket
          - !If
            - HasSourcePrefix
            - !Sub
              - 's3://${SourceBucketName}/${SourceBucketPrefix}'
              - SourceBucketName: !Select [5, !Split [':', !Ref SourceBucketArn]]
            - !Sub
              - 's3://${SourceBucketName}'
              - SourceBucketName: !Select [5, !Split [':', !Ref SourceBucketArn]]
          - !Ref 'AWS::NoValue'
        '--target-s3-path': !If
          - HasTargetBucket
          - !If
            - HasTargetPrefix
            - !Sub
              - 's3://${TargetBucketName}/${TargetPrefix}'
              - TargetBucketName: !Select [5, !Split [':', !Ref TargetBucketArn]]
            - !Sub
              - 's3://${TargetBucketName}'
              - TargetBucketName: !Select [5, !Split [':', !Ref TargetBucketArn]]
          - !Ref 'AWS::NoValue'
      Tags:
        Environment: !Ref Environment

Outputs:
  CatalogDatabaseName:
    Description: Name of the Glue Data Catalog database.
    Value: !Ref CatalogDatabase
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-DatabaseName'
  GlueServiceRoleArn:
    Description: ARN of the shared IAM service role used by the crawler and ETL job.
    Value: !GetAtt GlueServiceRole.Arn
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-GlueServiceRoleArn'
  SourceDataLocation:
    Condition: HasSourceBucket
    Description: S3 location scanned by the crawler and read by the ETL job.
    Value: !If
      - HasSourcePrefix
      - !Sub
        - 's3://${SourceBucketName}/${SourceBucketPrefix}'
        - SourceBucketName: !Select [5, !Split [':', !Ref SourceBucketArn]]
      - !Sub
        - 's3://${SourceBucketName}'
        - SourceBucketName: !Select [5, !Split [':', !Ref SourceBucketArn]]
  CatalogCrawlerName:
    Condition: CreateCrawler
    Description: Name of the Glue crawler.
    Value: !Ref CatalogCrawler
  EtlJobName:
    Condition: CreateJob
    Description: Name of the Glue Spark ETL job.
    Value: !Ref CatalogEtlJob
  EtlJobLogGroupName:
    Condition: CreateJob
    Description: CloudWatch log group receiving the continuous job logs.
    Value: !Ref JobLogGroup
  EtlJobTargetLocation:
    Condition: CreateJob
    Description: S3 location where the ETL job writes transformed output.
    Value: !If
      - HasTargetPrefix
      - !Sub
        - 's3://${TargetBucketName}/${TargetPrefix}'
