AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >
  Provisions a customer-managed KMS key (with automatic rotation) and an
  on-demand DynamoDB table used by the codex-bedrock JWT middleware for
  user-to-key mapping. The table uses the KMS key for server-side
  encryption, has TTL enabled on the ttl attribute, point-in-time recovery
  enabled, and is retained on stack deletion or update replacement.

Parameters:
  TableName:
    Type: String
    Default: codex-user-keys
    Description: Name of the DynamoDB table used for JWT middleware user-to-key mapping.
    AllowedPattern: '^[a-zA-Z0-9_.-]{3,255}$'
    ConstraintDescription: Table name must be 3-255 characters long and contain only a-z, A-Z, 0-9, '_', '-' and '.'.

Resources:
  UserKeyMappingKmsKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      Description: Customer managed key for the JWT middleware user-to-key mapping DynamoDB table
      Enabled: true
      EnableKeyRotation: true
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: Enable IAM User Permissions
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub 'arn:aws:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root'
            Action: 'kms:*'
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: Allow DynamoDB To Use The Key
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: dynamodb.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - kms:Decrypt
              - kms:DescribeKey
              - kms:GenerateDataKey
              - kms:ReEncrypt*
            Resource: '*'
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                kms:CallerAccount: !Ref 'AWS::AccountId'
                kms:ViaService: !Sub 'dynamodb.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com'

  UserKeyMappingKeyAlias:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Alias
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      AliasName: !Sub 'alias/${AWS::StackName}-user-key-mapping'
      TargetKeyId: !Ref UserKeyMappingKmsKey

  UserKeyMappingTable:
    Type: AWS::DynamoDB::Table
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      TableName: !Ref TableName
      BillingMode: PAY_PER_REQUEST
      AttributeDefinitions:
        - AttributeName: user_id
          AttributeType: S
      KeySchema:
        - AttributeName: user_id
          KeyType: HASH
      TimeToLiveSpecification:
        AttributeName: ttl
        Enabled: true
      PointInTimeRecoverySpecification:
        PointInTimeRecoveryEnabled: true
      SSESpecification:
        SSEEnabled: true
        SSEType: KMS
        KMSMasterKeyId: !Ref UserKeyMappingKmsKey
      Tags:
        - Key: project
          Value: codex-bedrock
        - Key: component
          Value: jwt-middleware
        - Key: managed-by
          Value: cloudformation

Outputs:
  UserKeysTableName:
    Description: Name of the JWT middleware user-to-key mapping DynamoDB table
    Value: !Ref UserKeyMappingTable
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-UserKeysTableName'
  UserKeysTableArn:
    Description: ARN of the JWT middleware user-to-key mapping DynamoDB table
    Value: !GetAtt UserKeyMappingTable.Arn
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-UserKeysTableArn'

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: "2010-09-09"

Description: >-
  ECS Fargate task definition with supporting IAM task execution and task roles,
  plus the CloudWatch Logs log group used by the awslogs log driver. The three
  execution-role managed policies (AmazonECSTaskExecutionRolePolicy,
  AmazonSSMReadOnlyAccess and SecretsManagerReadWrite) are defined as
  customer-managed IAM policies inside this stack instead of referencing the
  shared AWS managed policy ARNs, so the stack does not depend on those
  policies existing or being attachable in the target account.

Resources:
  ECSLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: "/aws/ecs/test/main"
      RetentionInDays: 30

  ECSTaskExecutionRolePolicy:
    Type: AWS::IAM::ManagedPolicy
    Properties:
      ManagedPolicyName: AmazonECSTaskExecutionRolePolicy
      Description: Allows ECS to pull container images and write container logs.
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - "ecr:GetAuthorizationToken"
              - "ecr:BatchCheckLayerAvailability"
              - "ecr:GetDownloadUrlForLayer"
              - "ecr:BatchGetImage"
              - "logs:CreateLogStream"
              - "logs:PutLogEvents"
            Resource: "*"

  SSMReadOnlyAccessPolicy:
    Type: AWS::IAM::ManagedPolicy
    Properties:
      ManagedPolicyName: AmazonSSMReadOnlyAccess
      Description: Provides read-only access to SSM.
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - "ssm:Describe*"
              - "ssm:Get*"
              - "ssm:List*"
            Resource: "*"

  SecretsManagerReadWritePolicy:
    Type: AWS::IAM::ManagedPolicy
    Properties:
      ManagedPolicyName: SecretsManagerReadWrite
      Description: Provides read and write access to Secrets Manager secrets.
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - "secretsmanager:CreateSecret"
              - "secretsmanager:DeleteSecret"
              - "secretsmanager:DescribeSecret"
              - "secretsmanager:GetRandomPassword"
              - "secretsmanager:GetSecretValue"
              - "secretsmanager:ListSecrets"
              - "secretsmanager:PutSecretValue"
              - "secretsmanager:RestoreSecret"
              - "secretsmanager:RotateSecret"
              - "secretsmanager:TagResource"
              - "secretsmanager:UntagResource"
              - "secretsmanager:UpdateSecret"
            Resource: "*"

  ECSTaskExecutionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      Path: "/"
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: ecs-tasks.amazonaws.com
            Action: "sts:AssumeRole"
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Ref ECSTaskExecutionRolePolicy
        - !Ref SSMReadOnlyAccessPolicy
        - !Ref SecretsManagerReadWritePolicy

  ECSTaskRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      Path: "/"
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: ecs-tasks.amazonaws.com
            Action: "sts:AssumeRole"

  ECSTaskDefinition:
    Type: AWS::ECS::TaskDefinition
    Properties:
      Family: test
      NetworkMode: awsvpc
      RequiresCompatibilities:
        - FARGATE
      Cpu: "256"
      Memory: "1024"
      ExecutionRoleArn: !GetAtt ECSTaskExecutionRole.Arn
      TaskRoleArn: !GetAtt ECSTaskRole.Arn
      ContainerDefinitions:
        - Name: main
          Image: nginx
          Essential: true
          PortMappings:
            - ContainerPort: 80
              Protocol: tcp
          LogConfiguration:
            LogDriver: awslogs
            Options:
              awslogs-group: !Ref ECSLogGroup
              awslogs-region: !Ref AWS::Region
              awslogs-stream-prefix: ecs

  for converting ESRI Shapefiles into individual GeoJSON files.

  AWS::CloudFormation::Interface:
    ParameterGroups:
      - Label:
          default: Glue ETL Job Configuration
        Parameters:
          - GlueJobName
          - GlueScriptLocation
      - Label:
          default: IAM Service Role Configuration
        Parameters:
          - GlueServiceRoleName

Parameters:
  GlueJobName:
    Type: String
    Default: map-appraiser-shapefile-to-geojson-etl
    Description: Name of the AWS Glue ETL job that converts Shapefiles to GeoJSON.
    AllowedPattern: '^[a-zA-Z0-9._-]{1,255}$'
    ConstraintDescription: Glue job name must be 1-255 characters (letters, numbers, periods, hyphens, underscores).

  GlueScriptLocation:
    Type: String
    Default: s3://map-appraiser-glue-scripts/shapefile_to_geojson_etl.py
    Description: S3 URI of the Shapefile-to-GeoJSON ETL script.
    AllowedPattern: '^s3://.+'
    ConstraintDescription: Must be a valid S3 URI beginning with s3://.

  GlueServiceRoleName:
    Type: String
    Default: MapAppraiserShapefileGlueServiceRole
    Description: Name of the IAM service role assumed by the Glue job.
    AllowedPattern: '^[a-zA-Z0-9+=,.@_-]{1,64}$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must be a valid IAM role name of up to 64 characters.

Resources:
  GlueServiceRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Ref GlueServiceRoleName
      Description: Service role assumed by the Shapefile-to-GeoJSON Glue ETL job.
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: glue.amazonaws.com
            Action: 'sts:AssumeRole'
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - 'arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSGlueServiceRole'
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: GlueCloudWatchLogging
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: FullCloudWatchLoggingAccess
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - 'logs:*'
                Resource: '*'
        - PolicyName: GlueScopedS3Access
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: ReadRawGisBucket
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - 's3:GetObject'
                  - 's3:GetBucketLocation'
                  - 's3:ListBucket'
                Resource:
                  - 'arn:aws:s3:::map-appraiser-data-raw-gis'
                  - 'arn:aws:s3:::map-appraiser-data-raw-gis/*'
              - Sid: ReadGlueScriptsBucket
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - 's3:GetObject'
                  - 's3:GetBucketLocation'
                  - 's3:ListBucket'
                Resource:
                  - 'arn:aws:s3:::map-appraiser-glue-scripts'
                  - 'arn:aws:s3:::map-appraiser-glue-scripts/*'
              - Sid: ReadWriteKnowledgeBaseBucket
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - 's3:GetObject'
                  - 's3:GetBucketLocation'
                  - 's3:ListBucket'
                  - 's3:PutObject'
                  - 's3:DeleteObject'
                  - 's3:AbortMultipartUpload'
                Resource:
                  - 'arn:aws:s3:::map-appraiser-data-knowledge-base'
                  - 'arn:aws:s3:::map-appraiser-data-knowledge-base/*'

  ShapefileToGeoJsonJob:
    Type: AWS::Glue::Job
    Properties:

Outputs:

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: "2010-09-09"
Description: Datadog policy template that creates the DatadogPolicy CloudFormation macro and its backing serverless Lambda function.

Resources:
  DatadogPolicyMacroMacroFunctionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSLambdaBasicExecutionRole

  DatadogPolicyMacroMacroFunction:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    Properties:
      FunctionName: DatadogPolicyMacroMacroFunction
      Description: CloudFormation macro that modifies the Datadog integration policy name and permissions based on the requested policy type
      Handler: index.handler
      Runtime: python3.14
      Role: !GetAtt DatadogPolicyMacroMacroFunctionRole.Arn
      Timeout: 3
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import json

          def handler(event, context):
              try:
                  template_fragment = event["fragment"]
                  params = event["params"]
                  policy_name = "DatadogPolicy"
                  policy_type = params.get("PolicyType")
                  if policy_type == "LogArchive":
                      permissions = ["s3:GetObject", "s3:PutObject", "s3:ListBucket"]
                      policy_name = "DatadogLogArchiveAndRehydratePolicy"
                  elif policy_type == "CloudTrail":
                      permissions = ["s3:GetBucketLocation", "s3:GetObject", "s3:ListBucket"]
                      policy_name = "DatadogCloudTrailsPolicy"
                  else:
                      return {
                          "requestId": event["requestId"],
                          "status": "success",
                          "fragment": template_fragment
                      }
                  for resource in template_fragment["Resources"].values():
                      if (
                          resource["Type"] == "AWS::IAM::ManagedPolicy"
                          and "ManagedPolicyName" in resource["Properties"]
                      ):
                          resource["Properties"]["ManagedPolicyName"] = policy_name
                          statements = resource["Properties"]["PolicyDocument"]["Statement"]
                          for statement in statements:
                              if "s3" in statement["Action"][0].lower():
                                  statement["Action"] = permissions
                  return {
                      "requestId": event["requestId"],
                      "status": "success",
                      "fragment": template_fragment
                  }
              except Exception as e:
                  return {
                      "requestId": event["requestId"],
                      "status": "failure",
                      "errorMessage": str(e)
                  }

  DatadogPolicyMacro:
    Type: AWS::CloudFormation::Macro
    Properties:
      Name: DatadogPolicy
      Description: Provides Datadog with the necessary permissions to integrate with your AWS account.
      FunctionName: !GetAtt DatadogPolicyMacroMacroFunction.Arn

Outputs:
  DatadogPolicyMacroName:
    Description: Name of the registered CloudFormation macro
    Value: !Ref DatadogPolicyMacro
  DatadogPolicyMacroMacroFunctionArn:
    Description: ARN of the Lambda function backing the DatadogPolicy macro
    Value: !GetAtt DatadogPolicyMacroMacroFunction.Arn
  DatadogPolicyMacroMacroFunctionRoleArn:
    Description: ARN of the IAM execution role used by the macro function
    Value: !GetAtt DatadogPolicyMacroMacroFunctionRole.Arn

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: "2010-09-09"
Description: "AWS CloudFormation template that creates an Amazon Route 53 Application Recovery Controller (ARC) cluster, control panel, routing controls, a safety assertion rule, and RECOVERY_CONTROL health checks for multi-region application recovery management."

Parameters:
  Region1:
    Type: String
    Description: The first (primary) region used in the recovery control configuration.
    Default: us-east-1
  Region2:
    Type: String
    Description: The second (secondary) region used in the recovery control configuration.
    Default: us-west-2
  ProjectId:
    Type: String
    Description: Unique project identifier used to name the ARC resources (must start with a letter and contain only alphanumeric characters, 1 to 64 characters long).
    Default: Dynamo59
    AllowedPattern: '^[a-zA-Z][a-zA-Z0-9]{0,63}$'
    ConstraintDescription: ProjectId must be an alphanumeric string starting with a letter, between 1 and 64 characters long.

Resources:
  Cluster:
    Type: AWS::Route53RecoveryControl::Cluster
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${ProjectId}-Cluster'
      Tags:
        - Key: ProjectId
          Value: !Ref ProjectId

  ControlPanel:
    Type: AWS::Route53RecoveryControl::ControlPanel
    Properties:
      ClusterArn: !GetAtt Cluster.ClusterArn
      Name: !Sub '${ProjectId}-ControlPanel'
      Tags:
        - Key: ProjectId
          Value: !Ref ProjectId

  Cell1:
    Type: AWS::Route53RecoveryControl::RoutingControl
    Properties:
      ClusterArn: !GetAtt Cluster.ClusterArn
      ControlPanelArn: !GetAtt ControlPanel.ControlPanelArn
      Name: !Sub '${ProjectId}-Cell1-${Region1}'

  Cell2:
    Type: AWS::Route53RecoveryControl::RoutingControl
    Properties:
      ClusterArn: !GetAtt Cluster.ClusterArn
      ControlPanelArn: !GetAtt ControlPanel.ControlPanelArn
      Name: !Sub '${ProjectId}-Cell2-${Region2}'

  MinCellsActiveSafetyRule:
    Type: AWS::Route53RecoveryControl::SafetyRule
    Properties:
      AssertionRule:
        AssertedControls:
          - !GetAtt Cell1.RoutingControlArn
          - !GetAtt Cell2.RoutingControlArn
        WaitPeriodMs: 5000
      ControlPanelArn: !GetAtt ControlPanel.ControlPanelArn
      Name: !Sub '${ProjectId}-MinCellsActive'
      RuleConfig:
        Inverted: false
        Threshold: 1
        Type: ATLEAST
      Tags:
        - Key: ProjectId
          Value: !Ref ProjectId

  Cell1HealthCheck:
    Type: AWS::Route53::HealthCheck
    Properties:
      HealthCheckConfig:
        RoutingControlArn: !GetAtt Cell1.RoutingControlArn
        Type: RECOVERY_CONTROL
      HealthCheckTags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${ProjectId}-Cell1-${Region1}-HealthCheck'
        - Key: ProjectId
          Value: !Ref ProjectId

  Cell2HealthCheck:
    Type: AWS::Route53::HealthCheck
    Properties:
      HealthCheckConfig:
        RoutingControlArn: !GetAtt Cell2.RoutingControlArn
        Type: RECOVERY_CONTROL
      HealthCheckTags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${ProjectId}-Cell2-${Region2}-HealthCheck'
        - Key: ProjectId
          Value: !Ref ProjectId

Outputs:
  ClusterArn:
    Description: ARN of the Route 53 Application Recovery Controller cluster.
    Value: !GetAtt Cluster.ClusterArn
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-ClusterArn'
  ControlPanelArn:
    Description: ARN of the recovery control control panel.
    Value: !GetAtt ControlPanel.ControlPanelArn
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-ControlPanelArn'
  Cell1HealthCheckId:
    Description: ID of the Route 53 health check mapped to the Region1 routing control.
    Value: !Ref Cell1HealthCheck
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-Cell1HealthCheckId'
  Cell2HealthCheckId:
    Description: ID of the Route 53 health check mapped to the Region2 routing control.
    Value: !Ref Cell2HealthCheck
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-Cell2HealthCheckId'

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: "2010-09-09"

Description: >-
  Creates an IAM role, an inline S3 download policy, and an IAM instance profile
  that allow EC2 instances to download Agilefant deployment artifacts from the
  cfnstore S3 bucket.

Parameters:
  CfnBucketName:
    Type: String
    Default: agilefant
    Description: Artifact path (prefix) within the cfnstore S3 bucket that EC2 instances are allowed to download from.
    AllowedPattern: ^[a-zA-Z0-9][a-zA-Z0-9._-]*$
    ConstraintDescription: CfnBucketName must contain only alphanumeric characters, periods, underscores, and hyphens.

Metadata:
  AWS::CloudFormation::Interface:
    ParameterGroups:
      - Label:
          default: Artifact Source
        Parameters:
          - CfnBucketName
    ParameterLabels:
      CfnBucketName:
        default: Artifact Bucket Path

Resources:
  InstanceRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      Path: /
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service:
                - "ec2.amazonaws.com"
            Action:
              - "sts:AssumeRole"
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: S3Download
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: "2012-10-17"
            Statement:
              - Sid: ListCfnStoreBucket
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - "s3:ListBucket"
                  - "s3:GetBucketLocation"
                Resource: "arn:aws:s3:::cfnstore"
              - Sid: GetCfnStoreArtifacts
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - "s3:GetObject"
                Resource: !Sub "arn:aws:s3:::cfnstore/${CfnBucketName}/*"

  InstanceProfile:
    Type: AWS::IAM::InstanceProfile
    Properties:
      Path: /
      Roles:
        - !Ref InstanceRole

Outputs:
  InstanceProfile:
    Description: Name of the IAM instance profile to associate with EC2 instances.
    Value: !Ref InstanceProfile
    Export:
      Name: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-InstanceProfile"
  InstanceRole:
    Description: Name of the IAM role assumed by EC2 instances.
    Value: !Ref InstanceRole
    Export:
      Name: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-InstanceRole"

Description: >
  Creates an AWS Resource Explorer setup consisting of an aggregator index,
  a custom view that includes resource tags in search results, and a default
  view association that links the custom view as the account default view.

Parameters:
  TagKey:
    Type: String
    Default: createdby
    Description: Key used to construct the Resource Explorer view name.
    MinLength: 1
  TagValue:
    Type: String
    Default: aws-cloudformation-templates
    Description: Value applied to the view name and to the Resource Explorer resource tags.
    MinLength: 1

Resources:
  ResourceExplorerIndex:
    Type: AWS::ResourceExplorer2::Index
    Properties:
      Type: AGGREGATOR
      Tags:
        cratedby: !Ref TagValue

  ResourceExplorerView:
    Type: AWS::ResourceExplorer2::View
    DependsOn: ResourceExplorerIndex
    Properties:
      ViewName: !Sub "${TagKey}-${TagValue}"
      IncludedProperties:
        - Name: tags
      Tags:
        cratedby: !Ref TagValue

  ResourceExplorerDefaultViewAssociation:
    Type: AWS::ResourceExplorer2::DefaultViewAssociation
    Properties:
      ViewArn: !Ref ResourceExplorerView

Description: >
  Creates an Amazon S3 bucket with versioning enabled for testing purposes.
  The bucket is tagged with Name, AppName, and Env tags, and the bucket name
  is exported in the stack outputs.

Parameters:
  AppName:
    Type: String
    Default: test
    Description: Application name used for the Name and AppName tags.
  Environment:
    Type: String
    Default: dev
    Description: Environment name used for the Env tag.

Resources:
  TestBucket:
    Type: AWS::S3::Bucket
    Properties:
      BucketEncryption:
        ServerSideEncryptionConfiguration:
          - ServerSideEncryptionByDefault:
              SSEAlgorithm: AES256
      OwnershipControls:
        Rules:
          - ObjectOwnership: BucketOwnerEnforced
      PublicAccessBlockConfiguration:
        BlockPublicAcls: true
        BlockPublicPolicy: true
        IgnorePublicAcls: true
        RestrictPublicBuckets: true
      VersioningConfiguration:
        Status: Enabled
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Ref AppName
        - Key: AppName
          Value: !Ref AppName

    Value: !GetAtt TestBucket.Arn
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-TestBucketArn'

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >-
  Creates five enabled Amazon EventBridge rules that forward CloudWatch alarm
  state changes, CloudFormation status changes, root user activity captured by
  CloudTrail, custom Slack message relay payloads, and EC2 Auto Scaling
  instance lifecycle events to cross-account organizational event buses for
  centralized auditing. Each target delivers events by assuming the
  corresponding pre-existing PRX org sink IAM role in the local account.
Metadata:
  AWS::CloudFormation::Interface:
    ParameterGroups:
      - Label:
          default: Organizational event buses (central auditing account)
        Parameters:
          - OrgCloudWatchEventBusArn
          - OrgCloudFormationEventBusArn
          - OrgCloudTrailEventBusArn
          - OrgSlackEventBusArn
          - OrgAutoScalingEventBusArn
      - Label:
          default: Slack relay custom event attributes
        Parameters:
          - SlackEventSource
          - SlackEventDetailType
    ParameterLabels:
      OrgCloudWatchEventBusArn:
        default: CloudWatch org event bus ARN
      OrgCloudFormationEventBusArn:
        default: CloudFormation org event bus ARN
      OrgCloudTrailEventBusArn:
        default: CloudTrail org event bus ARN
      OrgSlackEventBusArn:
        default: Slack org event bus ARN
      OrgAutoScalingEventBusArn:
        default: Auto Scaling org event bus ARN
      SlackEventSource:
        default: Slack relay event source
      SlackEventDetailType:
        default: Slack relay detail type
Parameters:
  OrgCloudWatchEventBusArn:
    Type: String
    Default: arn:aws:events:us-east-1:123456789012:event-bus/org-cloudwatch-bus
    Description: >-
      ARN of the cross-account organizational CloudWatch event bus in the
      central auditing account that receives CloudWatch alarm state change
      events from this account. Replace the default with the real
      organizational event bus ARN at deployment time.
    AllowedPattern: '^arn:aws[a-zA-Z-]*:events:[a-z0-9-]+:[0-9]{12}:event-bus/.+$'
    ConstraintDescription: >-
      Must be a valid EventBridge event bus ARN, for example
      arn:aws:events:us-east-1:123456789012:event-bus/org-cloudwatch-bus.
  OrgCloudFormationEventBusArn:
    Type: String
    Default: arn:aws:events:us-east-1:123456789012:event-bus/org-cloudformation-bus
    Description: >-
      ARN of the cross-account organizational CloudFormation event bus in the
      central auditing account that receives CloudFormation resource, stack,
      stack set, and stack set operation status change events. Replace the
      default with the real organizational event bus ARN at deployment time.
    AllowedPattern: '^arn:aws[a-zA-Z-]*:events:[a-z0-9-]+:[0-9]{12}:event-bus/.+$'
    ConstraintDescription: >-
      Must be a valid EventBridge event bus ARN, for example
      arn:aws:events:us-east-1:123456789012:event-bus/org-cloudformation-bus.
  OrgCloudTrailEventBusArn:
    Type: String
    Default: arn:aws:events:us-east-1:123456789012:event-bus/org-cloudtrail-bus
    Description: >-
      ARN of the cross-account organizational CloudTrail event bus in the
      central auditing account that receives root user API call and console
      sign-in events. Replace the default with the real organizational event
      bus ARN at deployment time.
    AllowedPattern: '^arn:aws[a-zA-Z-]*:events:[a-z0-9-]+:[0-9]{12}:event-bus/.+$'
    ConstraintDescription: >-
      Must be a valid EventBridge event bus ARN, for example
      arn:aws:events:us-east-1:123456789012:event-bus/org-cloudtrail-bus.
  OrgSlackEventBusArn:
    Type: String
    Default: arn:aws:events:us-east-1:123456789012:event-bus/org-slack-bus
    Description: >-
      ARN of the cross-account organizational Slack event bus in the central
      auditing account that receives custom Slack message relay payload
      events. Replace the default with the real organizational event bus ARN
      at deployment time.
    AllowedPattern: '^arn:aws[a-zA-Z-]*:events:[a-z0-9-]+:[0-9]{12}:event-bus/.+$'
    ConstraintDescription: >-
      Must be a valid EventBridge event bus ARN, for example
      arn:aws:events:us-east-1:123456789012:event-bus/org-slack-bus.
  OrgAutoScalingEventBusArn:
    Type: String
    Default: arn:aws:events:us-east-1:123456789012:event-bus/org-autoscaling-bus
    Description: >-
      ARN of the cross-account organizational Auto Scaling event bus in the
      central auditing account that receives EC2 Auto Scaling instance launch,
      termination, and instance refresh lifecycle events. Replace the default
      with the real organizational event bus ARN at deployment time.
    AllowedPattern: '^arn:aws[a-zA-Z-]*:events:[a-z0-9-]+:[0-9]{12}:event-bus/.+$'
    ConstraintDescription: >-
      Must be a valid EventBridge event bus ARN, for example
      arn:aws:events:us-east-1:123456789012:event-bus/org-autoscaling-bus.
  SlackEventSource:
    Type: String
    Default: custom.slack.relay
    Description: >-
      Source value that the custom Slack message relay sets when it publishes
      message payload events to the local default event bus via PutEvents.
  SlackEventDetailType:
    Type: String
    Default: Slack Message Relay Payload
    Description: >-
      Detail-Type value that the custom Slack message relay sets when it
      publishes message payload events to the local default event bus.
Resources:
  CloudWatchAlarmStateChangeRule:
    Type: AWS::Events::Rule
    Properties:
      Name: org-sink-alarm-state-change
      Description: >-
        Forwards CloudWatch alarm state change events to the organizational
        CloudWatch event bus for centralized auditing.
      State: ENABLED
      EventBusName: default
      EventPattern:
        source:
          - aws.cloudwatch
        detail-type:
          - CloudWatch Alarm State Change
      Targets:
        - Id: org-sink-alarm-state-change
          Arn: !Ref OrgCloudWatchEventBusArn
          RoleArn: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:role/PRX-CloudWatchOrgSinkRole'
  CloudFormationStateChangeRule:
    Type: AWS::Events::Rule
    Properties:
      Name: org-sink-cfn-state-change
      Description: >-
        Forwards CloudFormation resource status, stack status, stack set
        status, and stack set operation status change events to the
        organizational CloudFormation event bus for centralized auditing.
      State: ENABLED
      EventBusName: default
      EventPattern:
        source:
          - aws.cloudformation
        detail-type:
          - CloudFormation Resource Status Change
          - CloudFormation Stack Status Change
          - CloudFormation StackSet Status Change
          - CloudFormation StackSet Operation Status Change
      Targets:
        - Id: org-sink-cfn-state-change
          Arn: !Ref OrgCloudFormationEventBusArn
          RoleArn: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:role/PRX-CloudFormationOrgSinkRole'
  CloudTrailRootActivityRule:
    Type: AWS::Events::Rule
    Properties:
      Name: org-sink-trail-root-activity
      Description: >-
        Forwards root user API calls and console sign-ins recorded by
        CloudTrail to the organizational CloudTrail event bus for centralized
        auditing.
      State: ENABLED
      EventBusName: default
      EventPattern:
        detail:
          userIdentity:
            type:
              - Root
        detail-type:
          - AWS API Call via CloudTrail
          - AWS Console Sign In via CloudTrail
      Targets:
        - Id: org-sink-trail-root-activity
          Arn: !Ref OrgCloudTrailEventBusArn
          RoleArn: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:role/PRX-CloudTrailOrgSinkRole'
  SlackMessagePayloadRule:
    Type: AWS::Events::Rule
    Properties:
      Name: org-sink-slack-message-payload
      Description: >-
        Forwards custom Slack message relay payload events to the
        organizational Slack event bus for centralized auditing.
      State: ENABLED
      EventBusName: default
      EventPattern:
        source:
          - !Ref SlackEventSource
        detail-type:
          - !Ref SlackEventDetailType
      Targets:
        - Id: org-sink-slack-message-payload
          Arn: !Ref OrgSlackEventBusArn
          RoleArn: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:role/PRX-SlackOrgSinkRole'
  AutoScalingEventsRule:
    Type: AWS::Events::Rule
    Properties:
      Name: org-autoscaling-events
      Description: >-
        Forwards EC2 Auto Scaling instance launch, termination, and instance
        refresh lifecycle events to the organizational Auto Scaling event bus
        for centralized auditing.
      State: ENABLED
      EventBusName: default
      EventPattern:
        source:
          - aws.autoscaling
        detail-type:
          - EC2 Instance Launch Successful
          - EC2 Instance Launch Unsuccessful
          - EC2 Instance Terminate Successful
          - EC2 Instance Terminate Unsuccessful
          - EC2 Instance-launch Lifecycle Action
          - EC2 Instance-terminate Lifecycle Action
          - EC2 Auto Scaling Instance Refresh Started
          - EC2 Auto Scaling Instance Refresh Succeeded
          - EC2 Auto Scaling Instance Refresh Failed
          - EC2 Auto Scaling Instance Refresh Cancelled
      Targets:
        - Id: org-autoscaling-events
          Arn: !Ref OrgAutoScalingEventBusArn
          RoleArn: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:role/PRX-AutoScalingOrgSinkRole'
Outputs:
  CloudWatchAlarmStateChangeRuleArn:
    Description: ARN of the CloudWatch alarm state change forwarding rule.
    Value: !GetAtt CloudWatchAlarmStateChangeRule.Arn
  CloudFormationStateChangeRuleArn:
    Description: ARN of the CloudFormation status change forwarding rule.
    Value: !GetAtt CloudFormationStateChangeRule.Arn
  CloudTrailRootActivityRuleArn:
    Description: ARN of the CloudTrail root activity forwarding rule.
    Value: !GetAtt CloudTrailRootActivityRule.Arn
  SlackMessagePayloadRuleArn:
    Description: ARN of the Slack message payload forwarding rule.
    Value: !GetAtt SlackMessagePayloadRule.Arn
  AutoScalingEventsRuleArn:
    Description: ARN of the Auto Scaling events forwarding rule.
    Value: !GetAtt AutoScalingEventsRule.Arn
  EffectiveCloudWatchTargetBusArn:
    Description: Organizational CloudWatch event bus ARN used by the alarm state change rule target.
    Value: !Ref OrgCloudWatchEventBusArn
  EffectiveCloudFormationTargetBusArn:
    Description: Organizational CloudFormation event bus ARN used by the CloudFormation rule target.
    Value: !Ref OrgCloudFormationEventBusArn
  EffectiveCloudTrailTargetBusArn:
    Description: Organizational CloudTrail event bus ARN used by the root activity rule target.
    Value: !Ref OrgCloudTrailEventBusArn
  EffectiveSlackTargetBusArn:
    Description: Organizational Slack event bus ARN used by the Slack payload rule target.
    Value: !Ref OrgSlackEventBusArn
  EffectiveAutoScalingTargetBusArn:
    Description: Organizational Auto Scaling event bus ARN used by the Auto Scaling rule target.
    Value: !Ref OrgAutoScalingEventBusArn

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: "2010-09-09"
Description: >
  Creates a customer-managed KMS key with automatic key rotation and a retained
  alias (alias/<StackName>) for securing AWS service data encryption. The key
  policy grants full KMS administration to the account root and cryptographic
  operations to the caller account, restricted via kms:ViaService when a specific
  service is selected, or allowing public S3 decryption when S3_PUBLIC_ACCESS is
  selected. Optionally creates an EventBridge rule that notifies the SNS topic
  exported by a parent alert stack when the key is scheduled for deletion or
  disabled.

Parameters:
  ParentAlertStack:
    Type: String
    Default: ""
    Description: >-
      Name of the parent alert stack that exports the alert SNS topic ARN
      (export name <ParentAlertStack>-AlertTopicArn). Leave empty to skip
      creation of the key deletion alerting rule.
  Service:
    Type: String
    Default: ALL_SERVICES
    AllowedValues:
      - ALL_SERVICES
      - S3_PUBLIC_ACCESS
      - connect
      - dms
      - ssm
      - ec2
      - elasticfilesystem
      - es
      - kinesis
      - kinesisvideo
      - lambda
      - lex
      - redshift
      - rds
      - secretsmanager
      - ses
      - s3
      - importexport
      - sqs
      - workmail
      - workspaces
    Description: >-
      AWS service that is allowed to use this key via kms:ViaService. Choose
      ALL_SERVICES to permit the caller account without a service restriction,
      or S3_PUBLIC_ACCESS to allow anonymous decryption through Amazon S3.

Conditions:
  HasParentAlertStack: !Not [!Equals [!Ref ParentAlertStack, ""]]
  IsAllServices: !Equals [!Ref Service, ALL_SERVICES]
  IsS3PublicAccess: !Equals [!Ref Service, S3_PUBLIC_ACCESS]
  IsServiceSpecific: !And
    - !Not [!Condition IsAllServices]
    - !Not [!Condition IsS3PublicAccess]

Resources:
  KMSKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      Description: !Sub "Customer managed KMS key created by stack ${AWS::StackName} for ${Service} data encryption."
      Enabled: true
      EnableKeyRotation: true
      KeyUsage: ENCRYPT_DECRYPT
      Tags:
        - Key: Service
          Value: !Ref Service
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Id: key-default-1
        Statement:
          - Sid: Enable IAM User Permissions
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root"
            Action: kms:*
            Resource: "*"
          - !If
            - IsS3PublicAccess
            - Sid: Allow public decryption through Amazon S3
              Effect: Allow
              Principal: "*"
              Action: kms:Decrypt
              Resource: "*"
              Condition:
                StringEquals:
                  kms:ViaService: !Sub "s3.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com"
            - Sid: Allow cryptographic operations by the caller account
              Effect: Allow
              Principal: "*"
              Action:
                - kms:Encrypt
                - kms:Decrypt
                - kms:ReEncrypt*
                - kms:GenerateDataKey*
                - kms:DescribeKey
              Resource: "*"
              Condition: !If
                - IsServiceSpecific
                - StringEquals:
                    kms:CallerAccount: !Ref "AWS::AccountId"
                    kms:ViaService: !Sub "${Service}.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com"
                - StringEquals:
                    kms:CallerAccount: !Ref "AWS::AccountId"

  KMSKeyAlias:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Alias
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      AliasName: !Sub "alias/${AWS::StackName}"
      TargetKeyId: !Ref KMSKey

  KMSKeyDeletionEventRule:
    Type: AWS::Events::Rule
    Condition: HasParentAlertStack
    Properties:
      State: ENABLED
      Description: !Sub "Detects ScheduleKeyDeletion and DisableKey API calls for the KMS key created by stack ${AWS::StackName} and notifies the parent alert stack SNS topic."
      EventPattern:
        source:
          - aws.kms
        detail-type:
          - "AWS API Call via CloudTrail"
        resources:
          - !GetAtt KMSKey.Arn
        detail:
          eventSource:
            - kms.amazonaws.com
          eventName:
            - ScheduleKeyDeletion
            - DisableKey
      Targets:
        - Id: KMSKeyDeletionAlertTopic
          Arn:
            Fn::ImportValue: !Sub "${ParentAlertStack}-AlertTopicArn"

Outputs:
  KeyId:
    Description: The globally unique identifier of the KMS key.
    Value: !Ref KMSKey
    Export:
      Name: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-KeyId"
  KeyArn:
    Description: The Amazon Resource Name (ARN) of the KMS key.
    Value: !GetAtt KMSKey.Arn
    Export:
      Name: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-KeyArn"
  AliasName:
    Description: The alias assigned to the KMS key.
    Value: !Ref KMSKeyAlias

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >-
  Creates an Amazon Data Lifecycle Manager (DLM) lifecycle policy and the
  supporting IAM role to automate EBS volume snapshot management for web
  servers.

Parameters:
  DailySnapshotScheduledAt:
    Description: Daily time at which snapshots are scheduled (formatted as HH:MM).
    Type: String
    Default: '17:00'
    AllowedPattern: '^([01][0-9]|2[0-3]):([0-5][0-9])$'
    ConstraintDescription: DailySnapshotScheduledAt must be a valid 24-hour time formatted as HH:MM, for example 17:00.
  SnapshotInterval:
    Description: Time between snapshot starts, in hours.
    Type: Number
    Default: 24
    AllowedValues:
      - 2
      - 3
      - 4
      - 6
      - 8
      - 12
      - 24
    ConstraintDescription: SnapshotInterval must be one of 2, 3, 4, 6, 8, 12, or 24.
  SnapshotRetainRule:
    Description: The number of snapshots to retain.
    Type: Number
    Default: 7
    MinValue: 1
    ConstraintDescription: SnapshotRetainRule must be a number greater than or equal to 1.
  LogicalName:
    Description: Logical name used to build the IAM role name and policy description.
    Type: String
    Default: WebServers
  Environment:
    Description: Environment tag value used to target the EBS volumes for snapshots.
    Type: String
    Default: production
    AllowedValues:
      - production
      - test
      - development
    ConstraintDescription: Environment must be one of production, test, or development.
  TagKey:
    Description: Key of the custom tag used to target the EBS volumes for snapshots.
    Type: String
    Default: createdby
  TagValue:
    Description: Value of the custom tag used to target the EBS volumes for snapshots.
    Type: String
    Default: aws-cloudformation-templates

Resources:
  DataLifecycleManagerRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub '${LogicalName}-DataLifecycleManager-${AWS::Region}'
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: dlm.amazonaws.com
            Action: 'sts:AssumeRole'
      Path: '/'
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: DataLifecycleManagement
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - 'ec2:CreateSnapshot'
                  - 'ec2:CreateSnapshots'
                  - 'ec2:DeleteSnapshot'
                  - 'ec2:CreateTags'
                  - 'ec2:DeleteTags'
                  - 'ec2:DescribeInstances'
                  - 'ec2:DescribeVolumes'
                Resource: '*'

  DataLifecycleManagementPolicy:
    Type: AWS::DLM::LifecyclePolicy
    Properties:
      Description: !Sub 'Daily Snapshots of ${LogicalName}'
      State: ENABLED
      ExecutionRoleArn: !GetAtt DataLifecycleManagerRole.Arn
      PolicyDetails:
        ResourceTypes:
          - VOLUME
        TargetTags:
          - Key: Environment
            Value: !Ref Environment
          - Key: !Ref TagKey
            Value: !Ref TagValue
        Schedules:
          - Name: Daily Snapshots
            CreateRule:
              Interval: !Ref SnapshotInterval
              IntervalUnit: HOURS
              Times:
                - !Ref DailySnapshotScheduledAt
            RetainRule:
              Count: !Ref SnapshotRetainRule
            CopyTags: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub 'policy-${LogicalName}-${AWS::Region}'

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >-
  Automates enforcement of Amazon S3 Block Public Access at the account level.
  An SSM Automation document (schema version 0.3) calls the S3 Control
  PutPublicAccessBlock API operation to enable BlockPublicAcls, BlockPublicPolicy,
  IgnorePublicAcls and RestrictPublicBuckets for the local account, and an
  enabled EventBridge scheduled rule (rate(1 day)) starts the automation daily
  using a dedicated EventBridge execution role. The EventBridge target references
  the automation definition ARN, which EventBridge maps to the SSM
  StartAutomationExecution API as an SSM Automation target; no Run Command target
  structures are used.

Parameters:
  ScheduleExpression:
    Type: String
    Description: EventBridge schedule used to enforce account-level S3 Block Public Access.
    Default: rate(1 day)
    AllowedPattern: '^rate\(\s*\d+\s+(minute|minutes|hour|hours|day|days)\s*\)$|^cron\(.+\)$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must be a valid EventBridge rate or cron expression, for example rate(1 day).

Metadata:
  AWS::CloudFormation::Interface:
    ParameterGroups:
      - Label:
          default: Enforcement schedule
        Parameters:
          - ScheduleExpression

Resources:
  SSMAutomationExecutionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      Description: Role assumed by Systems Manager Automation to enable account-level S3 Block Public Access.
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: ssm.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: S3AccountPublicAccessBlockPermissions
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: AllowAccountLevelPublicAccessBlock
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - s3:PutAccountPublicAccessBlock
                  - s3:GetAccountPublicAccessBlock
                Resource: '*'
      Tags:
        - Key: Purpose
          Value: EnforceS3AccountBlockPublicAccess

  S3AccountBlockPublicAccessDocument:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Document
    Properties:
      DocumentType: Automation
      DocumentFormat: YAML
      Content:
        schemaVersion: '0.3'
        description: >-
          Enables all four Amazon S3 Block Public Access settings at the account
          level by calling the S3 Control PutPublicAccessBlock API operation for
          the local account.
        parameters:
          AutomationAssumeRole:
            type: String
            description: >-
              (Optional) The ARN of the role that allows Automation to perform
              the actions on your behalf. Defaults to the SSM Automation
              execution role created with this stack.
            default: !GetAtt SSMAutomationExecutionRole.Arn
        assumeRole: '{{ AutomationAssumeRole }}'
        mainSteps:
          - name: PutAccountPublicAccessBlock
            action: aws:executeAwsApi
            inputs:
              Service: s3control
              Api: PutPublicAccessBlock
              AccountId: '{{ global:ACCOUNT_ID }}'
              PublicAccessBlockConfiguration:
                BlockPublicAcls: true
                BlockPublicPolicy: true
                IgnorePublicAcls: true
                RestrictPublicBuckets: true

  EventBridgeExecutionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      Description: Role assumed by EventBridge to start the SSM Automation document execution on schedule.
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: events.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: StartS3BlockPublicAccessAutomation
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: AllowStartAutomationExecution
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ssm:StartAutomationExecution
                Resource:
                  - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:ssm:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:automation-definition/${S3AccountBlockPublicAccessDocument}'
                  - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:ssm:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:automation-definition/${S3AccountBlockPublicAccessDocument}:$LATEST'
              - Sid: AllowDescribeAutomationDocument
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ssm:DescribeDocument
                Resource: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:ssm:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:document/${S3AccountBlockPublicAccessDocument}'
              - Sid: AllowPassAutomationAssumeRole
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - iam:PassRole
                Resource: !GetAtt SSMAutomationExecutionRole.Arn
      Tags:
        - Key: Purpose
          Value: EnforceS3AccountBlockPublicAccess

  DailyS3BlockPublicAccessRule:
    Type: AWS::Events::Rule
    Properties:
      Description: Daily scheduled rule that starts the SSM Automation enforcing account-level S3 Block Public Access.
      ScheduleExpression: !Ref ScheduleExpression
      State: ENABLED
      EventBusName: default
      Targets:
        # SSM Automation target: EventBridge invokes StartAutomationExecution
        # with the EventBridge execution role on the daily schedule. The
        # AutomationAssumeRole parameter is passed through the target Input.
        - Id: EnforceS3BlockPublicAccessTarget
          Arn: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:ssm:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:automation-definition/${S3AccountBlockPublicAccessDocument}'
          RoleArn: !GetAtt EventBridgeExecutionRole.Arn
          Input: !Sub '{"AutomationAssumeRole": ["${SSMAutomationExecutionRole.Arn}"]}'

Outputs:
  AutomationDocumentName:
    Description: Name of the SSM Automation document that enforces account-level S3 Block Public Access.
    Value: !Ref S3AccountBlockPublicAccessDocument
  AutomationDocumentArn:
    Description: ARN of the SSM Automation document.
    Value: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:ssm:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:document/${S3AccountBlockPublicAccessDocument}'
  AutomationExecutionRoleArn:
    Description: ARN of the IAM role assumed by Systems Manager Automation.
    Value: !GetAtt SSMAutomationExecutionRole.Arn
  EventBridgeRuleName:
    Description: Name of the enabled EventBridge scheduled rule.
    Value: !Ref DailyS3BlockPublicAccessRule
  EventBridgeRuleArn:
    Description: ARN of the enabled EventBridge scheduled rule.
    Value: !GetAtt DailyS3BlockPublicAccessRule.Arn
  EventBridgeExecutionRoleArn:
    Description: ARN of the IAM role assumed by EventBridge.
    Value: !GetAtt EventBridgeExecutionRole.Arn

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >-
  Cognito authentication layer for an Amazon Bedrock AgentCore Gateway using the
  OAuth2 client credentials flow. Creates a user pool with a hosted UI domain, a
  resource server with read, write, and admin scopes, a confidential app client
  restricted to the client credentials grant, a Lambda-backed custom resource that
  stores the app client secret in Secrets Manager, and SSM parameters that a
  separate gateway stack can consume.

Parameters:
  ProjectName:
    Type: String
    Default: protein-engineering
    Description: Project name used to namespace the Cognito client secret in Secrets Manager.
    AllowedPattern: '^[a-zA-Z0-9._-]{1,64}$'
    ConstraintDescription: Project name may only contain letters, numbers, dots, underscores, and hyphens.
  RequireSymbols:
    Type: String
    Default: 'true'
    Description: Whether the user pool password policy requires at least one symbol character.
    AllowedValues:
      - 'true'
      - 'false'

Metadata:
  AWS::CloudFormation::Interface:
    ParameterGroups:
      - Label:
          default: Project configuration
        Parameters:
          - ProjectName
          - RequireSymbols
    ParameterLabels:
      ProjectName:
        default: Project name
      RequireSymbols:
        default: Require symbols in passwords

Conditions:
  WithSymbols: !Equals
    - !Ref RequireSymbols
    - 'true'

Resources:
  AgentCoreUserPool:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPool
    DeletionPolicy: Delete
    Properties:
      UserPoolName: agentcore-gateway-pool
      UsernameAttributes:
        - email
      UsernameConfiguration:
        CaseSensitive: false
      AutoVerifiedAttributes:
        - email
      MfaConfiguration: 'OFF'
      AccountRecoverySetting:
        RecoveryMechanisms:
          - Name: verified_email
            Priority: 1
      Policies:
        PasswordPolicy:
          MinimumLength: 12
          RequireUppercase: true
          RequireLowercase: true
          RequireNumbers: true
          RequireSymbols: !If
            - WithSymbols
            - true
            - false

  AgentCoreUserPoolDomain:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolDomain
    Properties:
      UserPoolId: !Ref AgentCoreUserPool
      Domain: !Join
        - '-'
        - - !Ref AWS::Region
          - !Select
            - 0
            - !Split
              - '-'
              - !Select
                - 2
                - !Split
                  - '/'
                  - !Ref AWS::StackId

  AgentCoreResourceServer:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolResourceServer
    Properties:
      UserPoolId: !Ref AgentCoreUserPool
      Identifier: agentcore-gateway
      Name: agentcore-gateway
      Scopes:
        - ScopeName: read
          ScopeDescription: Read access to the protein engineering AgentCore gateway.
        - ScopeName: write
          ScopeDescription: Write access to the protein engineering AgentCore gateway.
        - ScopeName: admin
          ScopeDescription: Administrative access to the protein engineering AgentCore gateway.

  AgentCoreAppClient:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolClient
    DependsOn: AgentCoreResourceServer
    Properties:
      ClientName: agentcore-gateway-client
      UserPoolId: !Ref AgentCoreUserPool
      GenerateSecret: true
      AllowedOAuthFlowsUserPoolClient: true
      AllowedOAuthFlows:
        - client_credentials
      AllowedOAuthScopes:
        - 'agentcore-gateway/read'
        - 'agentcore-gateway/write'
        - 'agentcore-gateway/admin'
      SupportedIdentityProviders:
        - COGNITO

  ClientSecretLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    DeletionPolicy: Delete
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Sub '/aws/lambda/${AWS::StackName}-secret-store'
      RetentionInDays: 30

  ClientSecretHandlerRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: agentcore-client-secret-store
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: DescribeAgentCoreAppClient
                Effect: Allow
                Action: cognito-idp:DescribeUserPoolClient
                Resource: !GetAtt AgentCoreUserPool.Arn
              - Sid: ManageAgentCoreClientSecret
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - secretsmanager:CreateSecret
                  - secretsmanager:PutSecretValue
                  - secretsmanager:DescribeSecret
                  - secretsmanager:DeleteSecret
                Resource:
                  - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:secretsmanager:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:secret:${ProjectName}/cognito/client-secret'
                  - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:secretsmanager:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:secret:${ProjectName}/cognito/client-secret-*'
              - Sid: WriteHandlerLogs
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                Resource: !GetAtt ClientSecretLogGroup.Arn

  ClientSecretHandler:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    Properties:
      FunctionName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-secret-store'
      Description: Stores the AgentCore gateway Cognito app client secret in Secrets Manager.
      Runtime: python3.13
      Handler: index.handler
      MemorySize: 128
      Timeout: 60
      Role: !GetAtt ClientSecretHandlerRole.Arn
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import json

          import boto3
          import cfnresponse


          def handler(event, context):
              request_type = event["RequestType"]
              properties = event["ResourceProperties"]
              user_pool_id = properties["UserPoolId"]
              client_id = properties["ClientId"]
              secret_name = properties["SecretName"]
              response_data = {}
              secrets_client = boto3.client("secretsmanager")

              try:
                  if request_type in ("Create", "Update"):
                      if request_type == "Update":
                          old_properties = event.get("OldResourceProperties") or {}
                          old_secret_name = old_properties.get("SecretName")
                          if old_secret_name and old_secret_name != secret_name:
                              try:
                                  secrets_client.delete_secret(
                                      SecretId=old_secret_name,
                                      ForceDeleteWithoutRecovery=True,
                                  )
                              except secrets_client.exceptions.ResourceNotFoundException:
                                  pass

                      user_pool_client = boto3.client(
                          "cognito-idp"
                      ).describe_user_pool_client(
                          UserPoolId=user_pool_id,
                          ClientId=client_id,
                      )["UserPoolClient"]

                      secret_string = json.dumps(
                          {
                              "client_id": client_id,
                              "client_secret": user_pool_client["ClientSecret"],
                              "user_pool_id": user_pool_id,
                          },
                          indent=2,
                      )

                      try:
                          secrets_client.put_secret_value(
                              SecretId=secret_name,
                              SecretString=secret_string,
                          )
                          response_data["SecretArn"] = secrets_client.describe_secret(
                              SecretId=secret_name
                          )["ARN"]
                      except secrets_client.exceptions.ResourceNotFoundException:
                          response_data["SecretArn"] = secrets_client.create_secret(
                              Name=secret_name,
                              SecretString=secret_string,
                          )["ARN"]

                      cfnresponse.send(
                          event,
                          context,
                          cfnresponse.SUCCESS,
                          response_data,
                          secret_name,
                      )

                  elif request_type == "Delete":
                      try:
                          secrets_client.delete_secret(
                              SecretId=secret_name,
                              ForceDeleteWithoutRecovery=True,
                          )
                      except secrets_client.exceptions.ResourceNotFoundException:
                          pass
                      cfnresponse.send(
                          event,
                          context,
                          cfnresponse.SUCCESS,
                          response_data,
                          secret_name,
                      )

                  else:
                      cfnresponse.send(
                          event,
                          context,
                          cfnresponse.FAILED,
                          response_data,
                          secret_name,
                          reason=f"Unsupported request type: {request_type}",
                      )

              except Exception as exc:
                  print(f"AgentCore client secret custom resource error: {exc}")
                  cfnresponse.send(
                      event,
                      context,
                      cfnresponse.FAILED,
                      response_data,
                      secret_name,
                      reason=str(exc),
                  )

  ClientSecretStore:
    Type: Custom::AgentCoreClientSecret
    DeletionPolicy: Delete
    Properties:
      ServiceToken: !GetAtt ClientSecretHandler.Arn
      UserPoolId: !Ref AgentCoreUserPool
      ClientId: !Ref AgentCoreAppClient
      SecretName: !Sub '${ProjectName}/cognito/client-secret'

  CognitoDiscoveryUrlParameter:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Parameter
    DeletionPolicy: Delete
    Properties:
      Name: /protein-agent/cognito/oidc-discovery-url
      Type: String
      Description: OIDC discovery document URL for the AgentCore gateway Cognito user pool.
      Value: !Join
        - ''
        - - 'https://'
          - !Ref AgentCoreUserPoolDomain
          - !Sub '.auth.${AWS::Region}.amazoncognito.com/.well-known/openid-configuration'

  CognitoClientIdParameter:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Parameter
    DeletionPolicy: Delete
    Properties:
      Name: /protein-agent/cognito/client-id
      Type: String
      Description: App client ID used for the AgentCore gateway client credentials flow.
      Value: !Ref AgentCoreAppClient

  CognitoUserPoolIdParameter:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Parameter
    DeletionPolicy: Delete
    Properties:
      Name: /protein-agent/cognito/user-pool-id
      Type: String
      Description: ID of the AgentCore gateway Cognito user pool.
      Value: !Ref AgentCoreUserPool

  CognitoUserPoolArnParameter:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Parameter
    DeletionPolicy: Delete
    Properties:
      Name: /protein-agent/cognito/user-pool-arn
      Type: String
      Description: ARN of the AgentCore gateway Cognito user pool.
      Value: !GetAtt AgentCoreUserPool.Arn

  CognitoHostedDomainUrlParameter:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Parameter
    DeletionPolicy: Delete
    Properties:
      Name: /protein-agent/cognito/hosted-domain-url
      Type: String
      Description: Hosted UI domain URL of the AgentCore gateway Cognito user pool.
      Value: !Join
        - ''
        - - 'https://'
          - !Ref AgentCoreUserPoolDomain
          - !Sub '.auth.${AWS::Region}.amazoncognito.com'

Outputs:
  UserPoolId:
    Description: ID of the Cognito user pool backing the AgentCore gateway.
    Value: !Ref AgentCoreUserPool
  UserPoolArn:
    Description: ARN of the Cognito user pool backing the AgentCore gateway.
    Value: !GetAtt AgentCoreUserPool.Arn
  UserPoolClientId:
    Description: ID of the confidential app client used for the client credentials flow.
    Value: !Ref AgentCoreAppClient
  UserPoolDomain:
    Description: Hosted UI domain prefix of the AgentCore gateway user pool.
    Value: !Ref AgentCoreUserPoolDomain
  HostedDomainUrl:
    Description: Full HTTPS URL of the hosted UI domain.
    Value: !Join
      - ''
      - - 'https://'
        - !Ref AgentCoreUserPoolDomain
        - !Sub '.auth.${AWS::Region}.amazoncognito.com'
  OIDCDiscoveryUrl:
    Description: OIDC discovery document URL for JWT issuer validation.
    Value: !Join
      - ''
      - - 'https://'
        - !Ref AgentCoreUserPoolDomain
        - !Sub '.auth.${AWS::Region}.amazoncognito.com/.well-known/openid-configuration'
  TokenEndpointUrl:
    Description: OAuth2 token endpoint used to request access tokens with the client credentials grant.
    Value: !Join
      - ''
      - - 'https://'
        - !Ref AgentCoreUserPoolDomain
        - !Sub '.auth.${AWS::Region}.amazoncognito.com/oauth2/token'
  GatewayScopes:
    Description: Custom OAuth2 scopes granted to the app client, comma separated.
    Value: !Join
      - ','
      - - 'agentcore-gateway/read'
        - 'agentcore-gateway/write'
        - 'agentcore-gateway/admin'
  ClientSecretName:
    Description: Name of the Secrets Manager secret holding the client credentials.
    Value: !Sub '${ProjectName}/cognito/client-secret'
  ClientSecretArn:
    Description: ARN of the Secrets Manager secret holding the client credentials.
    Value: !GetAtt ClientSecretStore.SecretArn
  SsmParameterPath:
    Description: SSM Parameter Store path prefix under which the Cognito settings are published.
    Value: '/protein-agent/cognito/'
  SsmParameterNames:
    Description: Comma separated SSM parameter names published for the gateway stack.
    Value: !Join
      - ','
      - - '/protein-agent/cognito/oidc-discovery-url'
        - '/protein-agent/cognito/client-id'
        - '/protein-agent/cognito/user-pool-id'
        - '/protein-agent/cognito/user-pool-arn'
        - '/protein-agent/cognito/hosted-domain-url'

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: "2010-09-09" Description: >- Cognito identity bootstrap for a multi-tenant SaaS Operations application. Creates the pooled tenant and operations user pools with their app clients and hosted UI domains, identity pools with session principal tag mappings, authenticated IAM roles with tag-scoped DynamoDB permissions, the siloed tenant role, and the SystemAdmins user group. Parameters: TenantCallbackHost: Type: String Default: "tenant.example.com" Description: Host of the tenant application, used for OAuth callback and logout URLs and in the tenant invitation email. AdminCallbackHost: Type: String Default: "admin.example.com" Description: Host of the admin application, used for OAuth callback and logout URLs and in the operations invitation email. SiloedTenantRoleName: Type: String Default: "authenticated-siloed-user-role" Description: Name of the IAM role assumed by authenticated users of siloed tenant deployments. Resources: PooledTenantUserPool: Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPool Properties: UserPoolName: PooledTenant-SaaSOperationsUserPool MfaConfiguration: "OFF" AutoVerifiedAttributes: - email AccountRecoverySetting: RecoveryMechanisms: - Name: verified_email Priority: 1 Policies: PasswordPolicy: MinimumLength: 8 RequireLowercase: true RequireNumbers: true RequireSymbols: false RequireUppercase: true TemporaryPasswordValidityDays: 7 EmailVerificationSubject: SaaS Operations account verification EmailVerificationMessage: |

Your SaaS Operations verification code is {####}.

AdminCreateUserConfig: AllowAdminCreateUserOnly: true InviteMessageTemplate: EmailSubject: Your SaaS Operations tenant application account EmailMessage: !Sub |

You have been invited to the SaaS Operations tenant application.
