AWSTemplateFormatVersion: "2010-09-09"
Description: Reusable Amazon DynamoDB table stack with optional sort key, up to three extra attribute definitions, up to two global secondary indexes projecting all attributes, TTL, streams, provisioned capacity with auto scaling or on-demand billing, point-in-time recovery, optional AWS managed KMS encryption, AWS Backup protection, and optional CloudWatch alarms and backup vault notifications.

Parameters:
  TableName:
    Type: String
    Default: ""
    AllowedPattern: "[a-zA-Z0-9_.-]*"
    Description: Optional name of the DynamoDB table. Leave empty to let AWS CloudFormation generate a unique name.

  PartitionKeyName:
    Type: String
    Default: id
    MinLength: 1
    MaxLength: 255
    Description: Name of the table partition key attribute. Defaults to id.

  PartitionKeyType:
    Type: String
    Default: S
    AllowedValues:
      - S
      - N
      - B
    Description: Data type of the partition key attribute. Defaults to string (S).

  SortKeyName:
    Type: String
    Default: ""
    Description: Optional name of the sort key attribute. Leave empty for a table without a sort key.

  SortKeyType:
    Type: String
    Default: N
    AllowedValues:
      - S
      - N
      - B
    Description: Data type of the sort key attribute. Defaults to number (N).

  Attribute1Name:
    Type: String
    Default: ""
    Description: Optional first additional attribute definition name. Leave empty to skip. Must be unique among all declared attribute names.

  Attribute1Type:
    Type: String
    Default: S
    AllowedValues:
      - S
      - N
      - B
    Description: Data type of the first additional attribute definition.

  Attribute2Name:
    Type: String
    Default: ""
    Description: Optional second additional attribute definition name. Leave empty to skip. Must be unique among all declared attribute names.

  Attribute2Type:
    Type: String
    Default: S
    AllowedValues:
      - S
      - N
      - B
    Description: Data type of the second additional attribute definition.

  Attribute3Name:
    Type: String
    Default: ""
    Description: Optional third additional attribute definition name. Leave empty to skip. Must be unique among all declared attribute names.

  Attribute3Type:
    Type: String
    Default: S
    AllowedValues:
      - S
      - N
      - B
    Description: Data type of the third additional attribute definition.

  GSI1Name:
    Type: String
    Default: ""
    Description: Optional name of the first global secondary index. Leave empty to skip this index.

  GSI1PartitionKeyName:
    Type: String
    Default: ""
    Description: Partition key attribute name of the first global secondary index. When non-empty it is automatically added to the attribute definitions and must be unique among all declared attribute names.

  GSI1PartitionKeyType:
    Type: String
    Default: S
    AllowedValues:
      - S
      - N
      - B
    Description: Data type of the first global secondary index partition key.

  GSI1SortKeyName:
    Type: String
    Default: ""
    Description: Optional sort key attribute name of the first global secondary index. When non-empty it is automatically added to the attribute definitions and must be unique among all declared attribute names. Leave empty for a partition-key-only index.

  GSI1SortKeyType:
    Type: String
    Default: N
    AllowedValues:
      - S
      - N
      - B
    Description: Data type of the first global secondary index sort key.

  GSI2Name:
    Type: String
    Default: ""
    Description: Optional name of the second global secondary index. Leave empty to skip this index.

  GSI2PartitionKeyName:
    Type: String
    Default: ""
    Description: Partition key attribute name of the second global secondary index. When non-empty it is automatically added to the attribute definitions and must be unique among all declared attribute names.

  GSI2PartitionKeyType:
    Type: String
    Default: S
    AllowedValues:
      - S
      - N
      - B
    Description: Data type of the second global secondary index partition key.

  GSI2SortKeyName:
    Type: String
    Default: ""
    Description: Optional sort key attribute name of the second global secondary index. When non-empty it is automatically added to the attribute definitions and must be unique among all declared attribute names. Leave empty for a partition-key-only index.

  GSI2SortKeyType:
    Type: String
    Default: N
    AllowedValues:
      - S
      - N
      - B
    Description: Data type of the second global secondary index sort key.

  TimeToLiveAttribute:
    Type: String
    Default: ""
    Description: Optional attribute name used for DynamoDB Time to Live. Leave empty to disable TTL.

  StreamViewType:
    Type: String
    Default: DISABLED
    AllowedPattern: "^(DISABLED|KEYS_ONLY|NEW_IMAGE|OLD_IMAGE|NEW_AND_OLD_IMAGES)$"
    Description: Stream view type of the DynamoDB stream. Defaults to DISABLED (streaming disabled).

  BillingMode:
    Type: String
    Default: PROVISIONED
    AllowedValues:
      - PROVISIONED
      - PAY_PER_REQUEST
    Description: Billing mode of the table. PAY_PER_REQUEST skips all provisioned capacity and auto scaling resources.

  MinimumReadCapacityUnits:
    Type: Number
    Default: 1
    MinValue: 1
    Description: Minimum read capacity units for the table and its global secondary indexes when using PROVISIONED billing mode.

  MaximumReadCapacityUnits:
    Type: Number
    Default: 10
    MinValue: 1
    Description: Maximum read capacity units for the table and its global secondary indexes when using PROVISIONED billing mode.

  MinimumWriteCapacityUnits:
    Type: Number
    Default: 1
    MinValue: 1
    Description: Minimum write capacity units for the table and its global secondary indexes when using PROVISIONED billing mode.

  MaximumWriteCapacityUnits:
    Type: Number
    Default: 10
    MinValue: 1
    Description: Maximum write capacity units for the table and its global secondary indexes when using PROVISIONED billing mode.

  EnablePointInTimeRecovery:
    Type: String
    Default: "true"
    AllowedValues:
      - "true"
      - "false"
    Description: Whether point-in-time recovery is enabled. Defaults to true.

  ServerSideEncryptionEnabled:
    Type: String
    Default: "false"
    AllowedValues:
      - "true"
      - "false"
    Description: Whether server-side encryption with the AWS managed KMS key is enabled. Defaults to false.

  BackupRetentionDays:
    Type: Number
    Default: 30
    MinValue: 0
    Description: Number of days AWS Backup retains recovery points. Defaults to 30. Set to 0 to disable AWS Backup protection entirely.

  AlarmTopicArn:
    Type: String
    Default: ""
    Description: Optional ARN of an existing SNS topic for CloudWatch alarms and backup vault notifications. Leave empty to skip all alarms and backup vault notifications.

Conditions:
  HasTableName: !Not [!Equals [!Ref TableName, ""]]
  HasSortKey: !Not [!Equals [!Ref SortKeyName, ""]]
  HasAttribute1: !Not [!Equals [!Ref Attribute1Name, ""]]
  HasAttribute2: !Not [!Equals [!Ref Attribute2Name, ""]]
  HasAttribute3: !Not [!Equals [!Ref Attribute3Name, ""]]
  HasGSI1: !Not [!Equals [!Ref GSI1Name, ""]]
  HasGSI2: !Not [!Equals [!Ref GSI2Name, ""]]
  HasAnyGSI: !Or
    - Condition: HasGSI1
    - Condition: HasGSI2
  GSI1PartitionKeyDefined: !Not [!Equals [!Ref GSI1PartitionKeyName, ""]]
  GSI1SortKeyDefined: !Not [!Equals [!Ref GSI1SortKeyName, ""]]
  GSI2PartitionKeyDefined: !Not [!Equals [!Ref GSI2PartitionKeyName, ""]]
  GSI2SortKeyDefined: !Not [!Equals [!Ref GSI2SortKeyName, ""]]
  HasTTLAttribute: !Not [!Equals [!Ref TimeToLiveAttribute, ""]]
  StreamsEnabled: !Not [!Equals [!Ref StreamViewType, DISABLED]]
  IsProvisionedMode: !Equals [!Ref BillingMode, PROVISIONED]
  PITREnabled: !Equals [!Ref EnablePointInTimeRecovery, "true"]
  SSEEnabled: !Equals [!Ref ServerSideEncryptionEnabled, "true"]
  BackupsEnabled: !Not [!Equals [!Ref BackupRetentionDays, "0"]]
  HasAlarmTopic: !Not [!Equals [!Ref AlarmTopicArn, ""]]
  GSI1ScalingEnabled: !And
    - Condition: IsProvisionedMode
    - Condition: HasGSI1
  GSI2ScalingEnabled: !And
    - Condition: IsProvisionedMode
    - Condition: HasGSI2

Resources:
  DynamoDBTable:
    Type: AWS::DynamoDB::Table
    Properties:
      AttributeDefinitions:
        - AttributeName: !Ref PartitionKeyName
          AttributeType: !Ref PartitionKeyType
        - !If
          - HasSortKey
          - AttributeName: !Ref SortKeyName
            AttributeType: !Ref SortKeyType
          - !Ref AWS::NoValue
        - !If
          - HasAttribute1
          - AttributeName: !Ref Attribute1Name
            AttributeType: !Ref Attribute1Type
          - !Ref AWS::NoValue
        - !If
          - HasAttribute2
          - AttributeName: !Ref Attribute2Name
            AttributeType: !Ref Attribute2Type
          - !Ref AWS::NoValue
        - !If
          - HasAttribute3
          - AttributeName: !Ref Attribute3Name
            AttributeType: !Ref Attribute3Type
          - !Ref AWS::NoValue
        - !If
          - GSI1PartitionKeyDefined
          - AttributeName: !Ref GSI1PartitionKeyName
            AttributeType: !Ref GSI1PartitionKeyType
          - !Ref AWS::NoValue
        - !If
          - GSI1SortKeyDefined
          - AttributeName: !Ref GSI1SortKeyName
            AttributeType: !Ref GSI1SortKeyType
          - !Ref AWS::NoValue
        - !If
          - GSI2PartitionKeyDefined
          - AttributeName: !Ref GSI2PartitionKeyName
            AttributeType: !Ref GSI2PartitionKeyType
          - !Ref AWS::NoValue
        - !If
          - GSI2SortKeyDefined
          - AttributeName: !Ref GSI2SortKeyName
            AttributeType: !Ref GSI2SortKeyType
          - !Ref AWS::NoValue
      BillingMode: !Ref BillingMode
      GlobalSecondaryIndexes: !If
        - HasAnyGSI
        - - !If
            - HasGSI1
            - IndexName: !Ref GSI1Name
              KeySchema:
                - AttributeName: !Ref GSI1PartitionKeyName
                  KeyType: HASH
                - !If
                  - GSI1SortKeyDefined
                  - AttributeName: !Ref GSI1SortKeyName
                    KeyType: RANGE
                  - !Ref AWS::NoValue
              Projection:
                ProjectionType: ALL
              ProvisionedThroughput: !If
                - IsProvisionedMode
                - ReadCapacityUnits: !Ref MinimumReadCapacityUnits
                  WriteCapacityUnits: !Ref MinimumWriteCapacityUnits
                - !Ref AWS::NoValue
            - !Ref AWS::NoValue
          - !If
            - HasGSI2
            - IndexName: !Ref GSI2Name
              KeySchema:
                - AttributeName: !Ref GSI2PartitionKeyName
                  KeyType: HASH
                - !If
                  - GSI2SortKeyDefined
                  - AttributeName: !Ref GSI2SortKeyName
                    KeyType: RANGE
                  - !Ref AWS::NoValue
              Projection:
                ProjectionType: ALL
              ProvisionedThroughput: !If
                - IsProvisionedMode
                - ReadCapacityUnits: !Ref MinimumReadCapacityUnits
                  WriteCapacityUnits: !Ref MinimumWriteCapacityUnits
                - !Ref AWS::NoValue
            - !Ref AWS::NoValue
        - !Ref AWS::NoValue
      KeySchema:
        - AttributeName: !Ref PartitionKeyName
          KeyType: HASH
        - !If
          - HasSortKey
          - AttributeName: !Ref SortKeyName
            KeyType: RANGE
          - !Ref AWS::NoValue
      PointInTimeRecoverySpecification:
        PointInTimeRecoveryEnabled: !If
          - PITREnabled
          - true
          - false
      ProvisionedThroughput: !If
        - IsProvisionedMode
        - ReadCapacityUnits: !Ref MinimumReadCapacityUnits
          WriteCapacityUnits: !Ref MinimumWriteCapacityUnits
        - !Ref AWS::NoValue
      SSESpecification: !If
        - SSEEnabled
        - SSEEnabled: true
          SSEType: KMS
        - !Ref AWS::NoValue
      StreamSpecification: !If
        - StreamsEnabled
        - StreamViewType: !Ref StreamViewType
        - !Ref AWS::NoValue
      TableName: !If
        - HasTableName
        - !Ref TableName
        - !Ref AWS::NoValue
      TimeToLiveSpecification: !If
        - HasTTLAttribute
        - AttributeName: !Ref TimeToLiveAttribute
          Enabled: true
        - !Ref AWS::NoValue

  DynamoDBAutoScalingRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Condition: IsProvisionedMode
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: application-autoscaling.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: DynamoDBAutoScalingAccess
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: "2012-10-17"
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - dynamodb:DescribeTable
                  - dynamodb:UpdateTable
                Resource:
                  - !GetAtt DynamoDBTable.Arn
                  - !Sub "${DynamoDBTable.Arn}/*"
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - dynamodb:DescribeLimits
                Resource: "*"

  TableReadScalableTarget:
    Type: AWS::ApplicationAutoScaling::ScalableTarget
    Condition: IsProvisionedMode
    Properties:
      MaxCapacity: !Ref MaximumReadCapacityUnits
      MinCapacity: !Ref MinimumReadCapacityUnits
      ResourceId: !Sub "table/${DynamoDBTable}"
      RoleARN: !GetAtt DynamoDBAutoScalingRole.Arn
      ScalableDimension: dynamodb:table:ReadCapacityUnits
      ServiceNamespace: dynamodb

  TableWriteScalableTarget:
    Type: AWS::ApplicationAutoScaling::ScalableTarget
    Condition: IsProvisionedMode
    Properties:
      MaxCapacity: !Ref MaximumWriteCapacityUnits
      MinCapacity: !Ref MinimumWriteCapacityUnits
      ResourceId: !Sub "table/${DynamoDBTable}"
      RoleARN: !GetAtt DynamoDBAutoScalingRole.Arn
      ScalableDimension: dynamodb:table:WriteCapacityUnits
      ServiceNamespace: dynamodb

  TableReadScalingPolicy:
    Type: AWS::ApplicationAutoScaling::ScalingPolicy
    Condition: IsProvisionedMode
    Properties:
      PolicyName: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-table-read-target-tracking"
      PolicyType: TargetTrackingScaling
      ScalingTargetId: !Ref TableReadScalableTarget
      TargetTrackingScalingPolicyConfiguration:
        PredefinedMetricSpecification:
          PredefinedMetricType: DynamoDBReadCapacityUtilization
        TargetValue: 80

  TableWriteScalingPolicy:
    Type: AWS::ApplicationAutoScaling::ScalingPolicy
    Condition: IsProvisionedMode
    Properties:
      PolicyName: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-table-write-target-tracking"
      PolicyType: TargetTrackingScaling
      ScalingTargetId: !Ref TableWriteScalableTarget
      TargetTrackingScalingPolicyConfiguration:
        PredefinedMetricSpecification:
          PredefinedMetricType: DynamoDBWriteCapacityUtilization
        TargetValue: 80

  GSI1ReadScalableTarget:
    Type: AWS::ApplicationAutoScaling::ScalableTarget
    Condition: GSI1ScalingEnabled
    Properties:
      MaxCapacity: !Ref MaximumReadCapacityUnits
      MinCapacity: !Ref MinimumReadCapacityUnits
      ResourceId: !Sub "table/${DynamoDBTable}/index/${GSI1Name}"
      RoleARN: !GetAtt DynamoDBAutoScalingRole.Arn
      ScalableDimension: dynamodb:index:ReadCapacityUnits
      ServiceNamespace: dynamodb

  GSI1WriteScalableTarget:
    Type: AWS::ApplicationAutoScaling::ScalableTarget
    Condition: GSI1ScalingEnabled
    Properties:
      MaxCapacity: !Ref MaximumWriteCapacityUnits
      MinCapacity: !Ref MinimumWriteCapacityUnits
      ResourceId: !Sub "table/${DynamoDBTable}/index/${GSI1Name}"
      RoleARN: !GetAtt DynamoDBAutoScalingRole.Arn
      ScalableDimension: dynamodb:index:WriteCapacityUnits
      ServiceNamespace: dynamodb

  GSI1ReadScalingPolicy:
    Type: AWS::ApplicationAutoScaling::ScalingPolicy
    Condition: GSI1ScalingEnabled
    Properties:
      PolicyName: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-gsi1-read-target-tracking"
      PolicyType: TargetTrackingScaling
      ScalingTargetId: !Ref GSI1ReadScalableTarget
      TargetTrackingScalingPolicyConfiguration:
        PredefinedMetricSpecification:
          PredefinedMetricType: DynamoDBReadCapacityUtilization
        TargetValue: 80

  GSI1WriteScalingPolicy:
    Type: AWS::ApplicationAutoScaling::ScalingPolicy
    Condition: GSI1ScalingEnabled
    Properties:
      PolicyName: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-gsi1-write-target-tracking"
      PolicyType: TargetTrackingScaling
      ScalingTargetId: !Ref GSI1WriteScalableTarget
      TargetTrackingScalingPolicyConfiguration:
        PredefinedMetricSpecification:
          PredefinedMetricType: DynamoDBWriteCapacityUtilization
        TargetValue: 80

  GSI2ReadScalableTarget:
    Type: AWS::ApplicationAutoScaling::ScalableTarget
    Condition: GSI2ScalingEnabled
    Properties:
      MaxCapacity: !Ref MaximumReadCapacityUnits
      MinCapacity: !Ref MinimumReadCapacityUnits
      ResourceId: !Sub "table/${DynamoDBTable}/index/${GSI2Name}"
      RoleARN: !GetAtt DynamoDBAutoScalingRole.Arn
      ScalableDimension: dynamodb:index:ReadCapacityUnits
      ServiceNamespace: dynamodb

  GSI2WriteScalableTarget:
    Type: AWS::ApplicationAutoScaling::ScalableTarget
    Condition: GSI2ScalingEnabled
    Properties:
      MaxCapacity: !Ref MaximumWriteCapacityUnits
      MinCapacity: !Ref MinimumWriteCapacityUnits
      ResourceId: !Sub "table/${DynamoDBTable}/index/${GSI2Name}"
      RoleARN: !GetAtt DynamoDBAutoScalingRole.Arn
      ScalableDimension: dynamodb:index:WriteCapacityUnits
      ServiceNamespace: dynamodb

  GSI2ReadScalingPolicy:
    Type: AWS::ApplicationAutoScaling::ScalingPolicy
    Condition: GSI2ScalingEnabled
    Properties:
      PolicyName: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-gsi2-read-target-tracking"
      PolicyType: TargetTrackingScaling
      ScalingTargetId: !Ref GSI2ReadScalableTarget
      TargetTrackingScalingPolicyConfiguration:
        PredefinedMetricSpecification:
          PredefinedMetricType: DynamoDBReadCapacityUtilization
        TargetValue: 80

  GSI2WriteScalingPolicy:
    Type: AWS::ApplicationAutoScaling::ScalingPolicy
    Condition: GSI2ScalingEnabled
    Properties:
      PolicyName: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-gsi2-write-target-tracking"
      PolicyType: TargetTrackingScaling
      ScalingTargetId: !Ref GSI2WriteScalableTarget
      TargetTrackingScalingPolicyConfiguration:
        PredefinedMetricSpecification:
          PredefinedMetricType: DynamoDBWriteCapacityUtilization
        TargetValue: 80

  BackupVault:
    Type: AWS::Backup::BackupVault
    Condition: BackupsEnabled
    Properties:
      BackupVaultName: !Ref AWS::StackName
      Notifications: !If
        - HasAlarmTopic
        - BackupVaultEvents:
            - BACKUP_JOB_STARTED
            - BACKUP_JOB_COMPLETED
            - BACKUP_JOB_FAILED
            - COPY_JOB_STARTED
            - COPY_JOB_COMPLETED
            - COPY_JOB_FAILED
            - RESTORE_JOB_STARTED
            - RESTORE_JOB_COMPLETED
            - RESTORE_JOB_FAILED
          SNSTopicArn: !Ref AlarmTopicArn
        - !Ref AWS::NoValue

  BackupPlan:
    Type: AWS::Backup::BackupPlan
    Condition: BackupsEnabled
    Properties:
      BackupPlan:
        BackupPlanName: !Ref AWS::StackName
        BackupPlanRule:
          - RuleName: Daily
            ScheduleExpression: "cron(0 5 * * ? *)"
            StartWindowMinutes: 60
            CompletionWindowMinutes: 1440
            TargetBackupVault: !Ref BackupVault
            Lifecycle:
              DeleteAfterDays: !Ref BackupRetentionDays

  BackupRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Condition: BackupsEnabled
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: backup.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: DynamoDBBackupAccess
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: "2012-10-17"
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - dynamodb:DescribeTable
                  - dynamodb:DescribeContinuousBackups
                  - dynamodb:CreateBackup
                  - dynamodb:ExportTableToPointInTime
                Resource: !GetAtt DynamoDBTable.Arn

  BackupSelection:
    Type: AWS::Backup::BackupSelection
    Condition: BackupsEnabled
    Properties:
      BackupPlanId: !Ref BackupPlan
      BackupSelection:
        IamRoleArn: !GetAtt BackupRole.Arn
        Resources:
          - !GetAtt DynamoDBTable.Arn
        SelectionName: DynamoDBTableBackupSelection

  ReadThrottleAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Condition: HasAlarmTopic
    Properties:
      AlarmName: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-dynamodb-read-throttle-events"
      AlarmDescription: Read throttle events for the DynamoDB table met or exceeded 1 in a one-minute period.
      AlarmActions:
        - !Ref AlarmTopicArn
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanOrEqualToThreshold
      Dimensions:
        - Name: TableName
          Value: !Ref DynamoDBTable
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      MetricName: ReadThrottleEvents
      Namespace: AWS/DynamoDB
      Period: 60
      Statistic: Sum
      Threshold: 1
      TreatMissingData: notBreaching

  WriteThrottleAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Condition: HasAlarmTopic
    Properties:
      AlarmName: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-dynamodb-write-throttle-events"
      AlarmDescription: Write throttle events for the DynamoDB table met or exceeded 1 in a one-minute period.
      AlarmActions:
        - !Ref AlarmTopicArn
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanOrEqualToThreshold
      Dimensions:
        - Name: TableName
          Value: !Ref DynamoDBTable
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      MetricName: WriteThrottleEvents
      Namespace: AWS/DynamoDB
      Period: 60
      Statistic: Sum
      Threshold: 1
      TreatMissingData: notBreaching

  ThrottledRequestsAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Condition: HasAlarmTopic
    Properties:
      AlarmName: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-dynamodb-throttled-requests"
      AlarmDescription: Throttled requests for the DynamoDB table met or exceeded 1 in a one-minute period.
      AlarmActions:
        - !Ref AlarmTopicArn
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanOrEqualToThreshold
      Dimensions:
        - Name: TableName
          Value: !Ref DynamoDBTable
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      MetricName: ThrottledRequests
      Namespace: AWS/DynamoDB
      Period: 60
      Statistic: Sum
      Threshold: 1
      TreatMissingData: notBreaching

  UserErrorsAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Condition: HasAlarmTopic
    Properties:
      AlarmName: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-dynamodb-user-errors"
      AlarmDescription: User errors for the DynamoDB table met or exceeded 1 in a one-minute period.
      AlarmActions:
        - !Ref AlarmTopicArn
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanOrEqualToThreshold
      Dimensions:
        - Name: TableName
          Value: !Ref DynamoDBTable
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      MetricName: UserErrors
      Namespace: AWS/DynamoDB
      Period: 60
      Statistic: Sum
      Threshold: 1
      TreatMissingData: notBreaching

  SystemErrorsAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Condition: HasAlarmTopic
    Properties:
      AlarmName: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-dynamodb-system-errors"
      AlarmDescription: System errors for the DynamoDB table met or exceeded 1 in a one-minute period.
      AlarmActions:
        - !Ref AlarmTopicArn
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanOrEqualToThreshold
      Dimensions:
        - Name: TableName
          Value: !Ref DynamoDBTable
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      MetricName: SystemErrors
      Namespace: AWS/DynamoDB
      Period: 60
      Statistic: Sum
      Threshold: 1
      TreatMissingData: notBreaching

Outputs:
  TableName:
    Description: Name of the DynamoDB table.
    Value: !Ref DynamoDBTable
  StreamArn:
    Condition: StreamsEnabled
    Description: ARN of the DynamoDB table stream. Only available when streams are enabled.
    Value: !GetAtt DynamoDBTable.StreamArn

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: DynamoDB tables and Application Auto Scaling for an AWS account-vending automation tool. A Stage parameter (with a default value) is appended to every table name.

Parameters:
  Stage:
    Type: String
    Description: Stage identifier appended to every table name (for example dev, test or prod).
    Default: dev
    AllowedPattern: '^[a-zA-Z0-9_-]+$'
    ConstraintDescription: Stage must contain only letters, numbers, hyphens and underscores.
    MinLength: 1
    MaxLength: 30

Resources:

  CbInfoTable:
    Type: AWS::DynamoDB::Table
    Properties:
      TableName: !Sub 'talr-cbInfo-${Stage}'
      AttributeDefinitions:
        - AttributeName: accountCbAlias
          AttributeType: S
      KeySchema:
        - AttributeName: accountCbAlias
          KeyType: HASH
      BillingMode: PROVISIONED
      ProvisionedThroughput:
        ReadCapacityUnits: 1
        WriteCapacityUnits: 1

  AccountInfoTable:
    Type: AWS::DynamoDB::Table
    Properties:
      TableName: !Sub 'talr-accountInfo-${Stage}'
      AttributeDefinitions:
        - AttributeName: accountEmailAddress
          AttributeType: S
        - AttributeName: requestId
          AttributeType: S
        - AttributeName: accountId
          AttributeType: S
      KeySchema:
        - AttributeName: accountEmailAddress
          KeyType: HASH
      BillingMode: PROVISIONED
      ProvisionedThroughput:
        ReadCapacityUnits: 1
        WriteCapacityUnits: 1
      GlobalSecondaryIndexes:
        - IndexName: gsiRequestId
          KeySchema:
            - AttributeName: requestId
              KeyType: HASH
          Projection:
            ProjectionType: KEYS_ONLY
          ProvisionedThroughput:
            ReadCapacityUnits: 1
            WriteCapacityUnits: 1
        - IndexName: gsiAccountId
          KeySchema:
            - AttributeName: accountId
              KeyType: HASH
          Projection:
            ProjectionType: ALL
          ProvisionedThroughput:
            ReadCapacityUnits: 1
            WriteCapacityUnits: 1

  TaskStatusTable:
    Type: AWS::DynamoDB::Table
    Properties:
      TableName: !Sub 'talr-taskStatus-${Stage}'
      AttributeDefinitions:
        - AttributeName: requestId
          AttributeType: S
        - AttributeName: eventTimestamp
          AttributeType: S
      KeySchema:
        - AttributeName: requestId
          KeyType: HASH
        - AttributeName: eventTimestamp
          KeyType: RANGE
      BillingMode: PROVISIONED
      ProvisionedThroughput:
        ReadCapacityUnits: 1
        WriteCapacityUnits: 1
      StreamSpecification:
        StreamViewType: NEW_AND_OLD_IMAGES

  NipapCfnTable:
    Type: AWS::DynamoDB::Table
    Properties:
      TableName: !Sub 'talr-nipapCfn-${Stage}'
      AttributeDefinitions:
        - AttributeName: nipapAlias
          AttributeType: S
      KeySchema:
        - AttributeName: nipapAlias
          KeyType: HASH
      BillingMode: PROVISIONED
      ProvisionedThroughput:
        ReadCapacityUnits: 1
        WriteCapacityUnits: 1

  OpsTable:
    Type: AWS::DynamoDB::Table
    Properties:
      TableName: !Sub 'talr-ops-${Stage}'
      AttributeDefinitions:
        - AttributeName: layer
          AttributeType: S
      KeySchema:
        - AttributeName: layer
          KeyType: HASH
      BillingMode: PROVISIONED
      ProvisionedThroughput:
        ReadCapacityUnits: 1
        WriteCapacityUnits: 1

  DxInterfaceTable:
    Type: AWS::DynamoDB::Table
    Properties:
      TableName: !Sub 'talr-dxInterface-${Stage}'
      AttributeDefinitions:
        - AttributeName: divisionDcRegion
          AttributeType: S
        - AttributeName: vlan
          AttributeType: S
      KeySchema:
        - AttributeName: divisionDcRegion
          KeyType: HASH
        - AttributeName: vlan
          KeyType: RANGE
      BillingMode: PROVISIONED
      ProvisionedThroughput:
        ReadCapacityUnits: 1
        WriteCapacityUnits: 1

  ClaStatusTable:
    Type: AWS::DynamoDB::Table
    Properties:
      TableName: !Sub 'talr-claStatus-${Stage}'
      AttributeDefinitions:
        - AttributeName: requestId
          AttributeType: S
      KeySchema:
        - AttributeName: requestId
          KeyType: HASH
      BillingMode: PROVISIONED
      ProvisionedThroughput:
        ReadCapacityUnits: 1
        WriteCapacityUnits: 1

  ConfigRulesComplianceTable:
    Type: AWS::DynamoDB::Table
    Properties:
      TableName: !Sub 'talr-configRulesCompliance-${Stage}'
      AttributeDefinitions:
        - AttributeName: accountId
          AttributeType: S
        - AttributeName: pollTimestamp
          AttributeType: S
      KeySchema:
        - AttributeName: accountId
          KeyType: HASH
        - AttributeName: pollTimestamp
          KeyType: RANGE
      BillingMode: PROVISIONED
      ProvisionedThroughput:
        ReadCapacityUnits: 1
        WriteCapacityUnits: 1

  ScalingRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      Description: Dedicated role assumed by Application Auto Scaling to adjust DynamoDB provisioned capacity.
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: application-autoscaling.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: DynamoDBAutoScalingTableAccess
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - dynamodb:DescribeTable
                  - dynamodb:UpdateTable
                Resource:
                  - !GetAtt AccountInfoTable.Arn
                  - !GetAtt TaskStatusTable.Arn
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - dynamodb:DescribeLimits
                Resource: '*'
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - cloudwatch:DeleteAlarms
                  - cloudwatch:DescribeAlarms
                  - cloudwatch:PutMetricAlarm
                Resource: '*'

  AccountInfoTableReadTarget:
    Type: AWS::ApplicationAutoScaling::ScalableTarget
    Properties:
      MaxCapacity: 10
      MinCapacity: 1
      ResourceId: !Sub 'table/${AccountInfoTable}'
      RoleARN: !GetAtt ScalingRole.Arn
      ScalableDimension: dynamodb:table:ReadCapacityUnits
      ServiceNamespace: dynamodb

  AccountInfoTableWriteTarget:
    Type: AWS::ApplicationAutoScaling::ScalableTarget
    Properties:
      MaxCapacity: 10
      MinCapacity: 1
      ResourceId: !Sub 'table/${AccountInfoTable}'
      RoleARN: !GetAtt ScalingRole.Arn
      ScalableDimension: dynamodb:table:WriteCapacityUnits
      ServiceNamespace: dynamodb

  GsiRequestIdReadTarget:
    Type: AWS::ApplicationAutoScaling::ScalableTarget
    Properties:
      MaxCapacity: 10
      MinCapacity: 1
      ResourceId: !Sub 'table/${AccountInfoTable}/index/gsiRequestId'
      RoleARN: !GetAtt ScalingRole.Arn
      ScalableDimension: dynamodb:index:ReadCapacityUnits
      ServiceNamespace: dynamodb

  GsiRequestIdWriteTarget:
    Type: AWS::ApplicationAutoScaling::ScalableTarget
    Properties:
      MaxCapacity: 10
      MinCapacity: 1
      ResourceId: !Sub 'table/${AccountInfoTable}/index/gsiRequestId'
      RoleARN: !GetAtt ScalingRole.Arn
      ScalableDimension: dynamodb:index:WriteCapacityUnits
      ServiceNamespace: dynamodb

  GsiAccountIdReadTarget:
    Type: AWS::ApplicationAutoScaling::ScalableTarget
    Properties:
      MaxCapacity: 10
      MinCapacity: 1
      ResourceId: !Sub 'table/${AccountInfoTable}/index/gsiAccountId'
      RoleARN: !GetAtt ScalingRole.Arn
      ScalableDimension: dynamodb:index:ReadCapacityUnits
      ServiceNamespace: dynamodb

  GsiAccountIdWriteTarget:
    Type: AWS::ApplicationAutoScaling::ScalableTarget
    Properties:
      MaxCapacity: 10
      MinCapacity: 1
      ResourceId: !Sub 'table/${AccountInfoTable}/index/gsiAccountId'
      RoleARN: !GetAtt ScalingRole.Arn
      ScalableDimension: dynamodb:index:WriteCapacityUnits
      ServiceNamespace: dynamodb

  TaskStatusTableReadTarget:
    Type: AWS::ApplicationAutoScaling::ScalableTarget
    Properties:
      MaxCapacity: 10
      MinCapacity: 1
      ResourceId: !Sub 'table/${TaskStatusTable}'
      RoleARN: !GetAtt ScalingRole.Arn
      ScalableDimension: dynamodb:table:ReadCapacityUnits
      ServiceNamespace: dynamodb

  TaskStatusTableWriteTarget:
    Type: AWS::ApplicationAutoScaling::ScalableTarget
    Properties:
      MaxCapacity: 10
      MinCapacity: 1
      ResourceId: !Sub 'table/${TaskStatusTable}'
      RoleARN: !GetAtt ScalingRole.Arn
      ScalableDimension: dynamodb:table:WriteCapacityUnits
      ServiceNamespace: dynamodb

  AccountInfoTableReadPolicy:
    Type: AWS::ApplicationAutoScaling::ScalingPolicy
    DependsOn: AccountInfoTableReadTarget
    Properties:
      PolicyName: AccountInfoTableReadTargetTracking
      PolicyType: TargetTrackingScaling
      ResourceId: !Sub 'table/${AccountInfoTable}'
      ScalableDimension: dynamodb:table:ReadCapacityUnits
      ServiceNamespace: dynamodb
      TargetTrackingScalingPolicyConfiguration:
        PredefinedMetricSpecification:
          PredefinedMetricType: DynamoDBReadCapacityUtilization
        ScaleInCooldown: 60
        ScaleOutCooldown: 60
        TargetValue: 50

  AccountInfoTableWritePolicy:
    Type: AWS::ApplicationAutoScaling::ScalingPolicy
    DependsOn: AccountInfoTableWriteTarget
    Properties:
      PolicyName: AccountInfoTableWriteTargetTracking
      PolicyType: TargetTrackingScaling
      ResourceId: !Sub 'table/${AccountInfoTable}'
      ScalableDimension: dynamodb:table:WriteCapacityUnits
      ServiceNamespace: dynamodb
      TargetTrackingScalingPolicyConfiguration:
        PredefinedMetricSpecification:
          PredefinedMetricType: DynamoDBWriteCapacityUtilization
        ScaleInCooldown: 60
        ScaleOutCooldown: 60
        TargetValue: 50

  GsiRequestIdReadPolicy:
    Type: AWS::ApplicationAutoScaling::ScalingPolicy
    DependsOn: GsiRequestIdReadTarget
    Properties:
      PolicyName: GsiRequestIdReadTargetTracking
      PolicyType: TargetTrackingScaling
      ResourceId: !Sub 'table/${AccountInfoTable}/index/gsiRequestId'
      ScalableDimension: dynamodb:index:ReadCapacityUnits
      ServiceNamespace: dynamodb
      TargetTrackingScalingPolicyConfiguration:
        PredefinedMetricSpecification:
          PredefinedMetricType: DynamoDBReadCapacityUtilization
        ScaleInCooldown: 60
        ScaleOutCooldown: 60
        TargetValue: 50

  GsiRequestIdWritePolicy:
    Type: AWS::ApplicationAutoScaling::ScalingPolicy
    DependsOn: GsiRequestIdWriteTarget
    Properties:
      PolicyName: GsiRequestIdWriteTargetTracking
      PolicyType: TargetTrackingScaling
      ResourceId: !Sub 'table/${AccountInfoTable}/index/gsiRequestId'
      ScalableDimension: dynamodb:index:WriteCapacityUnits
      ServiceNamespace: dynamodb
      TargetTrackingScalingPolicyConfiguration:
        PredefinedMetricSpecification:
          PredefinedMetricType: DynamoDBWriteCapacityUtilization
        ScaleInCooldown: 60
        ScaleOutCooldown: 60
        TargetValue: 50

  GsiAccountIdReadPolicy:
    Type: AWS::ApplicationAutoScaling::ScalingPolicy
    DependsOn: GsiAccountIdReadTarget
    Properties:
      PolicyName: GsiAccountIdReadTargetTracking
      PolicyType: TargetTrackingScaling
      ResourceId: !Sub 'table/${AccountInfoTable}/index/gsiAccountId'
      ScalableDimension: dynamodb:index:ReadCapacityUnits
      ServiceNamespace: dynamodb
      TargetTrackingScalingPolicyConfiguration:
        PredefinedMetricSpecification:
          PredefinedMetricType: DynamoDBReadCapacityUtilization
        ScaleInCooldown: 60
        ScaleOutCooldown: 60
        TargetValue: 50

  GsiAccountIdWritePolicy:
    Type: AWS::ApplicationAutoScaling::ScalingPolicy
    DependsOn: GsiAccountIdWriteTarget
    Properties:
      PolicyName: GsiAccountIdWriteTargetTracking
      PolicyType: TargetTrackingScaling
      ResourceId: !Sub 'table/${AccountInfoTable}/index/gsiAccountId'
      ScalableDimension: dynamodb:index:WriteCapacityUnits
      ServiceNamespace: dynamodb
      TargetTrackingScalingPolicyConfiguration:
        PredefinedMetricSpecification:
          PredefinedMetricType: DynamoDBWriteCapacityUtilization
        ScaleInCooldown: 60
        ScaleOutCooldown: 60
        TargetValue: 50

  TaskStatusTableReadPolicy:
    Type: AWS::ApplicationAutoScaling::ScalingPolicy
    DependsOn: TaskStatusTableReadTarget
    Properties:
      PolicyName: TaskStatusTableReadTargetTracking
      PolicyType: TargetTrackingScaling
      ResourceId: !Sub 'table/${TaskStatusTable}'
      ScalableDimension: dynamodb:table:ReadCapacityUnits
      ServiceNamespace: dynamodb
      TargetTrackingScalingPolicyConfiguration:
        PredefinedMetricSpecification:
          PredefinedMetricType: DynamoDBReadCapacityUtilization
        ScaleInCooldown: 60
        ScaleOutCooldown: 60
        TargetValue: 50

  TaskStatusTableWritePolicy:
    Type: AWS::ApplicationAutoScaling::ScalingPolicy
    DependsOn: TaskStatusTableWriteTarget
    Properties:
      PolicyName: TaskStatusTableWriteTargetTracking
      PolicyType: TargetTrackingScaling
      ResourceId: !Sub 'table/${TaskStatusTable}'
      ScalableDimension: dynamodb:table:WriteCapacityUnits
      ServiceNamespace: dynamodb
      TargetTrackingScalingPolicyConfiguration:
